Headline_English: Former cricketer accuses Rohit of selfishness
Content_Enlish:
This is the gist of Aakash Chopra's analysis of Rohit Sharma. According to the former Indian cricketer and analyst, India captain Rohit prioritized his own interests over the interests of the team in the Melbourne Test. India lost the fourth Test in Melbourne by 184 runs in the ongoing Border-Gavaskar series, leaving them 2-1 down. The fifth and final Test begins in Sydney on Friday. 
India's captain Rohit could not play the first Test of the series in Perth. He came out to bat at six in the Adelaide Test. The same in Brisbane. Although Rohit is an opener in the shorter version, he is not always seen in this role in Tests. 

In India's winning Test in Perth, India scored 201 runs in the second innings from the opening pair of Lokesh Rahul and Yashasvi Jaiswal. Although they could not succeed in the opening pair in Adelaide and Brisbane. Rohit opened by bringing Rahul down to three in Melbourne. But he could not succeed like he did in the previous two Tests in the series. He was out for 3 and 9 runs in the Melbourne Test. He scored 10 runs in the rain-affected Brisbane, 3 and 6 in Adelaide. 
Aakash Chopra criticized Rohit for breaking the opening pair that India won the Test by playing well in at least one innings. The former cricketer, who played 10 Tests for India, believes that the decision was for Rohit himself. Along with this, Akash also questioned the decision to keep another opener, Shubman Gill, out of the team for the Melbourne Test. 
On his YouTube show, Aakash criticized Rohit and said, 'This is the first time in his career that he has taken a decision for himself. In the past, decisions were made for him. MS Dhoni and Virat Kohli brought him up from the middle order. Dhoni did it in ODIs, Virat in Tests. Because, they wanted to see Rohit in an aggressive role. 
Aakash Chopra also said that the decision to open in Melbourne was for Rohit himself, 'This is the first time that Rohit took a decision and that too in his own interest. Honestly, it was not taken in the interest of the team. Because, Rahul was doing very well in opening. Shubman Gill did well in 2023 too, was the second highest run-scorer. He also faced difficult situations. And he did well in Adelaide too. But he was kept out of the team. All this was done because Rohit thought about himself, not about the team. This is the first time in his captaincy career that the matter did not yield good results. India could not even draw.'

Headline_English: Shilpakala Academy's 'Youth Festival' in the New Year
Content_Enlish:
Bangladesh Shilpakala Academy has announced new programs on the occasion of the New Year. The 'Youth Festival' will continue throughout the month of January of the new year. Various programs will be celebrated at the district, division and central levels across the country. Notable programs organized throughout the month include the National Pitha Festival, Folk Drama Festival and other colorful programs. These programs will continue throughout the month of January in continuation of the previous ones. This information was given in a press release. 
Among the programs, the 'Sixth National Sculpture Exhibition' will continue until January 20 and a month-long poster, painting, photography, video, cartoon exhibition titled '2024: Oi Nutaner Ketan Ore' will continue until January 17. The 'National Pitha Festival' will be held on the academy premises from January 24 to February 1 under the organization of the academy. 
In addition, the New Year program will start on January 1 with a 3-day 'Folk Drama Festival' in Sirajganj under the management of the Department of Drama and Film. There will be a 3-day 'Folk Drama Festival' in 14 districts throughout the month of January. Under the program 'Shilper Potchalay Natyayatra 2024-2025 without discrimination', plays will be staged in Comilla, Munshiganj, Rangpur, Sylhet, Thakurgaon and Jessore in January. The '23rd Dhaka International Film Festival' will be organized by the Rainbow Film Society at the National Cinema Hall from January 11 to 19 in collaboration with Bangladesh Shilpakala Academy. 

The Chinese Embassy's 'Opera Show' will be held in Dhaka on January 21 and in Chittagong on January 23. The Chinese opera troupe will visit the Department of Theatre and Performance Studies of Dhaka University on January 22 and the Department of Theatre and Performance Studies of Chittagong University on January 24. 'Bangladesh Shilpakala Academy Acrobatic Exhibition' will be organized in Faridpur, Gopalganj, Kushtia, Satkhira and Jhenaidah.

Headline_English: Abolishing the constitution will deny the Liberation War and independence: Ruhul Kabir Rizvi
Content_Enlish:
BNP Senior Joint Secretary General Ruhul Kabir Rizvi said that if the constitution is repealed, the liberation war and independence will be denied. Amendments or additions can be made. If the country's constitution is repealed, the 1971 liberation war will be denied. 

Ruhul Kabir Rizvi said this while speaking as a special guest at a public meeting at Dubashuri Dwimukhi Dakhil Madrasa ground in Ramganj, Nilphamari Sadar on Monday afternoon. BNP Acting Chairman Tarique Rahman spoke as the chief guest at the public meeting via video conference from London. The public meeting was organized by 'Amra BNP Paribas' on the occasion of handing over a new house to the family of BNP leader Golam Rabbani, who was killed in the crossfire of RAB in Nilphamari Sadar Upazila on January 18, 2014. 

Mentioning that many young students are asking to repeal the constitution, Rizvi said that the constitution is the autobiography of a nation. It can be added to, amended. The characteristics of Awami League fascism can be eliminated there. But it cannot be canceled. In the United States, the constitution has continuity, there are amendments. But it has not been canceled. 

Ruhul Kabir Rizvi said at the public meeting, 'After the July-August revolution, everyone supported Professor Muhammad Yunus. But if the interim government goes beyond our statement, public expectations, and aspirations and works on another agenda, the people of the country will not accept it. The price of rice has not come down yet, the price of sugar and potatoes has not come down. Potatoes have to be imported from India since last year because of Sheikh Hasina. If potatoes have to be imported this time too, people will say, we supported Professor Muhammad Yunus' government, so what is the benefit? Why is the price of broiler chicken increasing in the market?' 

Opposing the proposal for a proportional electoral system, this central leader of the BNP said, 'Some people are saying, proportional elections. Why? What is proportional elections for? Do grassroots people understand this? Political parties whose votes are not high are talking about proportional representation. Those who want to fish in troubled waters, whose votes are not high, have taken this as a strategy. The people of the country will not accept this. If you conspire with such a method, this conspiracy will destroy the people.' 

Ruhul Kabir Rizvi also said, 'Murder, kidnapping, robbery, bank robbery are happening in the country. The IGP says in his speech, "We do not have magic." It is not possible to bring about a change in law and order in one day. But the people of the country will see your responsibility and initiative. Why are businessmen being killed, who is doing it, no one is able to arrest the real culprits. The people do not want to see your failure, the people want to see good results.’ 

Presided over by Atiqur Rahman, the convener of the BNP family, the public meeting was addressed by former deputy minister and BNP’s Rangpur divisional organizing secretary Asadul Habib (Dulu), the party’s central treasurer M Rashiduzzaman, BNP’s central associate science and technology secretary Ashraf Uddin, rural development secretary and Panchagarh district BNP member secretary Farhad Hossain, Rangpur metropolitan BNP convener Shamsuzzaman, Nilphamari district BNP president Alamgir Sarkar, vice presidents Mir Selim Faruk, Mostafa Prodhan, general secretary Zahurul Alam, and others.

Headline_English: Mass shoe-throwing program held at Sheikh Hasina's 'hate pillar' at Dhaka University
Content_Enlish:
A mass shoe throwing program was held at Sheikh Hasina's 'hate pillar' at the metro rail pillar in the Student-Teacher Center (TSC) area of ​​Dhaka University. This program was held at around 1:30 pm today, Monday with the participation of various student organizations of the university. Along with students, the general public also participated in it. 

Participants in the protest program demanded justice for Sheikh Hasina. 

Slogans emerged from the shoe throwing program - 'Khuni Hasina's two cheeks, shoes are beaten to the beat', 'Phansi Phansi Phansi Chai, Khuni Hasina's hanging is wanted', 'Apos na Sangram, Sangram Sangram', 'Each one league, Dhaira Dhaira Jail Bhar', 'If there is a rope, take the rope, hang the killer Hasina'. 

About the organization of the program, Abu Baker Majumder, former coordinator of the anti-discrimination student movement, told Prothom Alo, 'It has been organized at the initiative of all active student organizations. We saw ordinary students, anti-discrimination student movements, leftist student organizations and other cultural organizations on campus participating in it. But we did not see much of the student camp.’ 

Earlier, a protest was held on the Dhaka University campus last Saturday night in protest against the removal of Sheikh Hasina’s hate column graffiti from the metro rail pillar in the TSC area. On Sunday, students held a protest march demanding the resignation of the Dhaka University proctor for allowing the removal of this graffiti. 

When the hate column graffiti was removed last Saturday, the students painted another graffiti there that night. Later, when that was also removed yesterday, the students painted another new graffiti.

Headline_English: How Soviet technology in space stung the United States
Content_Enlish:
After World War II, there was a fierce competition for influence in world politics between the two major superpowers, the United States and the Soviet Union. The period is known as the Cold War or the Nervous War. 

Various competitions over who has more power, more influence, and more success also put other countries of the world into conflict. Scientific and technological achievements were also an important aspect in this. 

The current dominance of America in space began with the challenge thrown by the Soviet Union. 

World Space Week is being observed from October 4th to October 10th. This week is observed in the context of sending the first artificial satellite into space. 

On October 4th, 1957, the then Soviet Union successfully launched the world's first artificial satellite into space, which was named Sputnik-1. 

The US State Department website described the event as follows: "The Soviet Union had successfully accomplished the task, which was a shock to 'American experts and citizens, who had expected the United States to be the first to make such a scientific breakthrough.'" 

The Soviet Union's success in space was the beginning of a new era. 

It was a surprise to scientists and ordinary people around the world, not just America. It was a huge victory for the Soviet Union and an embarrassing defeat for the United States.

Headline_English: America returns to the moon after fifty years
Content_Enlish:
For the first time, a spacecraft from a private company has landed on the moon. The U.S.-based Houston-based Intuitive Machines' 'Odyssey' is the first American spacecraft to land on the moon's surface since the Apollo mission in 1972. 

The unmanned Odyssey has landed near the moon's south pole. 

It took a while for the control room to confirm the landing. Because, at the very last moment, no signal was received. However, after waiting for several minutes, the concerned people were confirmed by receiving a signal. 

The first announcement came from the mouth of flight director Tim Crane. 

"We can now say without a doubt that our equipment is on the lunar surface and transmission has begun."

Headline_English: Ad-free Facebook and Instagram are launching in Europe
Content_Enlish:
Facebook and Instagram are set to introduce paid subscriptions in most European countries, allowing users to use the two social media platforms without ads or permission to use personal information. 

Users will have to pay €9.99 (£8.72) per month to use Meta’s platforms. However, the service is not available in the UK right now. 

Meta was fined €390 million in January this year for violating EU advertising laws. 

It was also made clear at the time that Meta cannot ‘force consent’ from users of its platforms in any way. 

The complaint was that Meta obtains consent from users on the condition that they (Meta) accept the rules on how users’ personal information (i.e. data about their online searches or purchases and preferred services) will be used or they (users) can stop using the platform. 

It is in that context that Meta launched this new service. As a result, Meta will not be able to use the personal information of those who use these social media platforms in exchange for payment or show ads based on that information. 

These paid customer services will only be available in the European Union (EU), the European Economic Area (EEA) or the European Economic Area and Switzerland from next November. 

For now, users over the age of 18 can use these customer services. Meta will also examine how to provide advertising services to young people within the framework of the law.

Headline_English: Russian lunar probe Luna-25 crashes on the moon, mission fails
Content_Enlish:
Russia's Luna-25 spacecraft has crashed on the moon after a 47-year hiatus. Russia sent a spacecraft named Luna-25 to the moon. The news agency Reuters reported that it lost control due to complications with the lunar landing orbit. 
It was the first spacecraft to land on the moon's south pole. But the spacecraft encountered problems after moving into its pre-landing orbit. The spacecraft was supposed to conduct an operation in a part of the moon where scientists believe there may be frozen water and valuable materials. 

The Russian space agency Roscosmos said on Saturday morning that communication with the Luna-25 spacecraft was lost at 11:57 GMT. 

Roscosmos said in a statement that initial information suggests that the 800-kilogram lunar rover crashed on the lunar surface. The spacecraft was scheduled to land on the lunar surface on Monday.

Roscosmos said it will form a special commission to investigate why the lander crashed. 

The crash of the Luna-25 lander is a major blow to Roscosmos. The agency has been in decline for several years as a large part of Russia's budget is spent on the military. 

Russia's Luna-25 is competing with India's Chandrayaan-3 to land on the moon's south pole. India's Chandrayaan-3 is scheduled to land on the moon's south pole in the next three weeks.

Headline_English: Artificial intelligence makes breast cancer treatment easy and affordable in India
Content_Enlish:
A company in India has developed a new technology for breast cancer screening. 

This test uses thermal imaging and artificial intelligence. 

It is also less expensive. 

Although thermal imaging is considered less reliable than traditional mammograms, 

In countries like India, where breast cancer kills a lot of people, many are now getting breast screening done using this new technology.

Headline_English: Bangabandhu Satellite: Company reports revenue of over Tk 300 crore in three years
Content_Enlish:
Bangladesh's Bangabandhu Satellite has earned more than Tk 3 billion since its launch, authorities said. The company said the satellite company is currently earning about Tk 100 million per month from the domestic market. 

The Bangladesh Satellite Company said that the report published in BBC Bangla last week on the income of Bangabandhu Satellite did not reflect the company's 'real picture'. 

Currently, 38 TV channels, including Bangladesh Television, are using the satellite. In addition, Bangladesh Betar and DTH operator 'Akash' are using the satellite to serve customers, the company said. 

Seven facts about Bangabandhu Satellite that you should not miss 
Bangladesh Satellite: How commercially successful will it be? 
On May 14, a news item titled 'Bangabandhu Satellite: Couldn't earn for three years, when will the expenses be recovered' was published in BBC Bangla. 

Bangladesh Satellite Company Limited, the owner of Bangabandhu Satellite, protested against the news. 
"The report did not reflect the actual business picture of the company, which has created confusion in the public mind," the protest letter signed by company secretary Mohammad Rafiqul Haque said. 

Bangladesh launched the Bangabandhu satellite in 2018. With this, Bangladesh's name was added to the list of countries with artificial satellites in space. Earlier, 56 countries in the world have sent satellites into space. 

The Bangladesh government sees the matter as part of national pride.

Headline_English: The body of the housewife was lying on the floor of the house, while the body of the husband was hanging in another room.
Content_Enlish:
A husband has allegedly committed suicide after killing his wife in Satkhira. The incident took place in the Kushkhali area of ​​Satkhira Sadar Upazila around 7 pm on Monday. 

The couple is Abdul Jalil (35), son of Abul Hossain of Kushkhali village in Satkhira Sadar Upazila, and his wife Fatema Begum (26). 

Neighbor Mahmuda Khatun said that a fierce argument broke out between the couple Abdul Jalil and Fatema Begum around 7 pm today due to a family dispute. At one stage, Abdul Jalil severely beat his wife Fatema. At one stage, the wife died. Leaving his wife's body inside the house, he went to the market next to the house. After half an hour, Abdul Jalil returned home from the market and committed suicide by hanging himself from the roof of a house. 

Inspector Sushanta Ghosh of Satkhira Sadar Police Station said that Fatema Khatun worked in a ready-made garment factory in Dhaka. She returned home from Dhaka at around 2:30 pm today. Around 6:30 pm, she had an argument with Fatema over her husband's money. At one point, Abdul Jalil beat Fatema to death. Later, Abdul Jalil committed suicide by hanging himself from the ceiling of the house. In the evening, Abdul Jalil's mother Sakhina Khatun went to the house and saw the body of her daughter-in-law lying on the floor of one room. The body of her son was hanging from the ceiling in another room. Later, after receiving information from local people, the police visited the scene. The two bodies will be sent to Satkhira Sadar Hospital for autopsy.

Headline_English: 'Barir Naam Shahana' is going to the Oscars
Content_Enlish:
'Barir Naam Shahana' will represent Bangladesh at the world's most prestigious film award, the Oscars. It will compete in the Best International Feature Film category at the upcoming 98th Academy Awards. 
The Oscar committee formed by the Bangladesh Federation of Film Societies (BFFS) made this announcement on Saturday (September 27). 
This film, based on a true story, tells the story of a woman's dream and struggle to live independently. Directed by Lisa Gazi. Anan Siddique plays the lead role. 
The film has previously achieved unprecedented success in the international arena. The film, which has increased the country's reputation by winning awards at international festivals in London, Chicago, Melbourne, Rome and Mumbai, is now going to reach the world's cinematographers through the Oscars. 
Its screenplay is written by directors Lisa Gazi and Anan Siddique. Cinematography is by Zohayar Musavvir. Music is by Sohini Alam. Arifur Rahman and Bijan Imtiaz are producing. 

Most of the scenes of the film have been shot in a provincial town in Bangladesh and the rest in a small town in England. All the scenes have been shot in natural environments in keeping with the time and context of the story. 100% on-location sound has been used without any dubbing. 

It is worth noting that 'Barir Naam Shahana' was released in theaters in the country on September 19. At the center of the film is a brave woman named Deepa, who is steadfast in fulfilling her dreams.

Headline_English: Anmol Bishnoi arrested for firing at Salman's house
Content_Enlish:
Anmol Bishnoi, the brother of jailed gangster Lawrence Bishnoi, has been arrested immediately after his extradition to India. 

The National Investigation Agency (NIA) arrested him immediately after the plane carrying him landed at the Delhi airport on Wednesday (November 19). 

A Delhi court has ordered Anmol Bishnoi to be kept in custody for 11 days. According to several media outlets in the country. 

Anmol was arrested in the United States in April this year. He is an accused in 31 cases in India, including several high-profile ones. Among them, he was arrested for his direct involvement in the murder of popular Punjabi singer Sidhu Moosewala. In addition, he was accused of involvement in the murder of controversial politician and former Maharashtra minister Baba Siddiqui. 
In April last year, there was a shooting incident at Bollywood star Salman Khan's house. Anmol is also alleged to be involved in this attack. Since then, the police have been looking for Anmol. 

Anmol Bishnoi settled in the United States after traveling through Nepal, Dubai, and Kenya in 2022. He is the younger brother of Lawrence Bishnoi, India's top terrorist and head of the Bishnoi gang.

Headline_English: Two judges resign over allegations of fraud in Miss Universe
Content_Enlish:
The 74th edition of the Miss Universe, one of the most prestigious beauty pageants in the world, is underway in Thailand. And this year's competition has been surrounded by controversy since the beginning. This time, there has been a stir in the international arena due to allegations of rigging in the judging process. Due to this, two judges have resigned from the main judging panel. 

The name of the new Miss Universe will be announced on November 21. Before that, the contestants are busy participating in various sessions. At this time, the official jury member, Lebanese-French musician Omar Harfush, announced his resignation from his post. 

In a post on Instagram on Tuesday (November 18), Harfush claimed that a suddenly formed secret jury panel had already selected the top 30 finalists, where no official judges were present. He alleged that this secret panel was made up of some people who have personal relationships or conflicts of interest with the contestants. However, he did not give any further details. 

Hours after Harfush's complaint, another judge, French football manager Claude Makelele, announced his resignation, citing personal reasons.

Headline_English: Bangladesh's Jessia at Miss International
Content_Enlish:
The main phase of Miss International 2025 has begun in Tokyo. The formalities of this one of the most prestigious beauty pageants in the world have been gathering since November 13 (Tuesday). And Jessia Islam is representing Bangladesh on that international stage. 

The main competition will be held in Tokyo on November 27. Where Jessia Islam will represent Bangladesh along with contestants from different countries of the world. Who has been working for a long time to ensure the rehabilitation and education of street children. The issue of social responsibility and humanity has given more depth to her journey. 

In a post on social media on Thursday, Jessia said that she wants to reach the top-20 list. For this, she hopes for everyone's love and votes. Jessia can be voted for using the official app of Miss International. 

Jannatul Naeem was announced as the winner of the final round of the "Lavelo Miss World Bangladesh-2017" held in Dhaka on September 29. Controversy began immediately after the announcement. Various speculations were going on in the media, including social media. After the final verdict, it was learned that Jannatul Naeem Avril was married. According to the rules of the competition, no married person could participate in the Miss World competition. As a result, controversy spread about the declared winner.

Headline_English: 'Taste of Cherry' actor Homayoun Ershadi is no more
Content_Enlish:
An elderly man is driving along a deserted street in the suburbs of Tehran. He has decided to commit suicide. He is looking for someone who can bury him under a cherry tree. Homayun Ershadi, the actor from the movie 'Taste of Cherry', is no more. Although he was seen on the road of life in the movie, he has now left this world for a land of no return. 

Iran's state news agency IRNA reported that architect-turned-actor Homayun Ershadi died on Monday (November 11) after a long battle with cancer. He was 78 years old at the time of his death. 

Homayun Ershadi was born in Isfahan, Iran, on March 26, 1947. His first opportunity to act on the big screen was in Abbas Kiarostami's Palme d'Or-winning film 'Taste of Cherry' (1997). This opportunity came to him by sheer coincidence - he met Kiarostami while his car was stopped at a traffic light in Tehran. Then a famous filmmaker came to him and said, 'I want to make a movie. Do you want to act?' 

After the Islamic Revolution in Iran, Ershadi moved to Vancouver in the 1980s. Where he worked for an architectural firm for more than a decade. He later returned to Iran.

Headline_English: Legendary Hollywood actor and producer Robert Redford has died
Content_Enlish:
Oscar-winning Hollywood legend and producer Robert Redford has died. He breathed his last at his home in Utah, USA, on Tuesday (September 16). He was 89 years old at the time of his death. Redford's publicist Cindy Berger confirmed the information in a statement. BBC News. 

Redford Jr. was born in 1936 in Santa Monica, California. He began studying at the American Academy of Dramatic Arts. He participated in several TV shows in the late 1950s. 

In the 1960s, he played the lead role in the play 'Barefoot in the Park'. It was made into a film in 1967. 1973's 'The Sting' earned him an Oscar nomination for best actor. 

In 1980, he won the Oscar for best director for 'Ordinary People'. In 1984, he starred in 'The Natural.' Then in 1994, he was nominated again for directing 'Quiz Show'. 

In 1985, he starred in the film 'Out of Africa'. In addition to being a box office success, the film won seven Oscars, including Best Picture. He then announced his retirement from acting after completing his last film 'The Old Man and the Gun'. 

Redford founded the Sundance Institute in the 1990s. It is known for the Sundance Film Festival. In addition, it was known for promoting independent films and filmmakers, as well as for environmental activism. 

In 1985, Redford and Van Wagenen's marriage broke up. Then in 2009, he married artist Sybil Sjaegers Redford. 

Meanwhile, in the 1980s, Redford founded the 'Institute for Resource Management'. Its goal was to bring people from different communities together to find beneficial things for the environment. In 1989, Redford organized the 'Sundance Symposium' on global climate change. In a 2015 speech to the United Nations, he called for immediate action on climate change. 

He was the co-founder of the Redford Center, a US non-profit organization that works to produce films about environmental impact. Redford was awarded the Presidential Medal of Freedom in 2016. He accepted the award from President Barack Obama.

Headline_English: Afran Nishore has torn ligaments, shooting suspended
Content_Enlish:
After a cameo in the movie 'Tandav' released on Eid, the talked-about actor Afran Nisho has not been seen in any new work for a long time. However, recently, good news has come that he is going to act in the movie 'Dum' directed by Redwan Rony. But amidst this good news, the actor himself suffered a big blow when it was learned that his leg ligaments were torn. Due to this complication, Nisho is currently on rest and is not participating in any shooting. 
On Saturday (August 9), at a program at North South University, Nisho himself spoke about his knee problem and said, 'Tunnel-2' producer Rafi knows when it will come. However, I have to be physically fit. To live a fully active life, I will have to undergo knee surgery. 
He also said, this has never been said before. Today I am sharing it here for the first time. If many people know this, they may not hire me, they will say that your leg is broken. 

Many fans and art lovers are worried about this news. Wishing Afran Nisho a speedy recovery, everyone is waiting for him to return to the screen in full force. 

Meanwhile, the series 'Aanka' directed by Vicky Zahed is going to be released on the OTT platform in September, where Masuma Rahman Nabila will also be seen with Afran Nisho.

Headline_English: 'Utsav' and 'Tandav' coming together on OTT tonight

The story of the movie is written by Tanim Noor, Ayman Asib Swadhin, Susmoy Sarkar and Samiul Bhuiyan.
