Pakistan Meteorological Department (PMD) Director General Meher Sahibzada Khan said in a press conference that the cyclone's center has formed on the Karachi-Gwadar coast. As a result, heavy rainfall may occur after hitting the western coastal areas. 

The PMD forecast said that the Sindh provincial government has been asked to prepare for the storm. It is also reported that there is heavy rainfall in various districts of Sindh. They also fear that flash floods may occur in some places in Sindh before the storm arrives due to the rainfall. 

Incidentally, a total of three cyclones were formed in the Arabian Sea between 1891-2023. However, a cyclone in the Arabian Sea in August is a rare event.

Headline_English: Tarique Rahman: Conspiracies are underway against BNP at home and abroad
Content_Enlish:
BNP Acting Chairman Tarique Rahman has called on leaders and activists to be vigilant to counter conspiracies against the party at home and abroad. 


He made these comments as the chief guest at a video conference with leaders of South, North and Metropolitan BNP at the Town Hall Auditorium in Mymensingh on Saturday (August 31) afternoon. 

Tarique Rahman said in the meeting, “After August 5, the mindset of the people has changed. BNP also has to change with this mindset of the people. It must be remembered that BNP was in the opposition party. It is still in the opposition party, until the people exercise their right to vote for us. Therefore, party leaders and activists must be vigilant in their words and actions to gain the trust of the people.” 

He further said, “People are the source of all power. This slogan of Shahid Zia should not be considered just as a slogan, but should be kept and believed in by every leader and worker. Only then will our party be able to achieve the desired results. Those who think they are clever are living in a fool’s paradise. Shahid Zia’s slogan was – People are the source of all power. This should not be considered just as a slogan, but should be kept and believed in by every leader and worker. Only then will we be able to achieve the desired results.” 

The acting chairman of BNP said, “Slander is being spread against BNP on social media. We must keep a watchful eye on this matter too. The fall of the dictatorship is a pre-test for us and gaining the trust of the people is a test for us. We must remember that there is a conspiracy against our party in different ways. They are deceiving us and infiltrating the party and creating confusion.” 

Tarique Rahman said, “Many of us have made mistakes in the changed context. The party has not hesitated to take action against them. If we were in government, we would have taken legal action against them. The slogan of the country’s leader is – Save the people, save the country. In the current situation, it is the responsibility of BNP to protect the people of the country. Therefore, every leader and worker of the party should prepare himself in such a way that the people will give their verdict in your favor. It will not be easy to score goals in an empty field, but rather it will be much more difficult to achieve our goals than in the past. Therefore, the leaders and workers of the party have to work as independent guards.” 

BNP National Executive Committee Joint Secretary General Syed Emran Saleh Prince, BNP Chairperson’s Advisor Afzal H Khan, Co-Organizer Abu Wahab Akand Wahid, Metropolitan BNP Convener Professor AKM Shafiqul Islam and other grassroots leaders and workers were present at the meeting.

Headline_English: Fire at RFL Group factory
Content_Enlish:
A fire has broken out at the PRAN-RFL Group factory in Narsingdi's Palash upazila. Four units of the fire service are working to control the fire. 


Locals said the fire broke out around 5 pm on Friday (August 30). 

The Palash Fire Service said that a total of four units, including two units from the Palash Fire Station and two from the Madhabadi Fire Station, are working to control the fire. In addition, the company's own fire brigade is working to put out the fire. 

Station Officer of the Palash Fire Station, Sadequl Bari, said, "There is no possibility of the fire spreading outside. We hope it will be brought under control in a short time. However, it is not yet possible to say how long it will take to bring it under control."

Headline_English: What Ronaldo said about retirement
Content_Enlish:
Popular Portuguese football star Cristiano Ronaldo started his professional football journey in 2003 by making his debut against Kazakhstan. He currently plays as a forward for Saudi Arabia's professional football league club Al Nassr and the Portuguese national team. The Portuguese superstar is 39 years old and still lights up the field. However, due to his advancing age, this star footballer often faces questions about his retirement. However, he said that he will not tell anyone about it in advance. 

In an interview given to the Portuguese media, the Portuguese forward said, "When I leave the national team, I will not tell anyone before that. It will be a smooth decision on my part." 

Despite playing until the quarter-finals of the recently held Euro 2016, Ronaldo remained goalless in the field. Even though he was given a penalty against Slovenia in the last sixteen, the five-time Ballon d'Or winner missed it. The topic of his retirement has been raised frequently since he was eliminated from the tournament after losing to France in the last quarter. 

Portugal coach Roberto Martinez could announce his squad for the UEFA Nations League starting next month at any time. He is waiting to be called up to this squad. 

The Al Nasr forward said, “At the moment, the only thing on my mind is helping the national team. We have the Nations League ahead of us and I really want to play (in the tournament).” 

The star, who played for Manchester United, Real Madrid and Juventus, was seen standing on the sidelines giving directions to his teammates during the 2016 Euro campaign. There has been a lot of talk about the possibility of him going into coaching after retiring from football. 

However, Ronaldo himself said that he is not thinking about it. Ronaldo said, "At the moment I am not thinking about becoming a coach of the first team or any team. It has never crossed my mind. I do not see myself as a coach in the future. I see myself doing something other than football, but God knows what will happen in the future." 

Ronaldo's Al Nasr will play against Al Fayha in the Saudi Pro League tonight at 12:00 PM. Portugal will start their journey in the Nations League against Croatia on September 5. If he gets a chance with the national team, he will return to Saudi Arabia to play against Scotland on September 8 after that match.

Headline_English: You don't need a phone number to use WhatsApp.
Content_Enlish:
Meta-owned WhatsApp has been bringing new features to its users for a few days now. This time too is no exception. WhatsApp is going to introduce the feature of keeping phone numbers hidden. 

Meta said that due to the public nature of users' phone numbers, strangers sometimes call them directly. As a result, users get annoyed. This new feature is to solve this problem. 

In the new version, users can use WhatsApp without giving their mobile number if they want. In this case, they will have to create a unique username using their email address. 

Since the number is not required for a WhatsApp account, there is no possibility of unwanted communication. Moreover, there are news of various scams in the technology world every day using numbers, which can also be avoided. 

WA Beta Info, an organization working on various features of WhatsApp, said in a report that WhatsApp is working to introduce the feature of keeping phone numbers hidden to increase user security. If this feature called “Username and PIN” is enabled, three options named “Phone Number”, “Username” and “Username with PIN” can be used. 

If the username option is selected in the account, no stranger will be able to see the phone number. Through the “Username with PIN” option, users can set a four-digit PIN number. Only other people can send messages if this PIN number is known. 

According to WABeta Info, even if the feature of keeping the phone number hidden is enabled, people already associated with the WhatsApp account will be able to see the phone number. That is, only strangers will not be able to see the phone number. As a result, the personal privacy of users will increase more than at present. 

WhatsApp is currently monitoring the functionality of the username and PIN feature on Android beta version users. Therefore, it is initially believed that this feature can only be used on phones running the Android operating system.

Headline_English: Dr. Niaz Ahmed Khan to be the Vice-Chancellor of Dhaka University
Content_Enlish:
Dr. Niaz Ahmed Khan, the Deputy Vice-Chancellor of Independent University of Bangladesh (IUB) and Professor of Development Studies at DU, is going to be appointed as the new Vice-Chancellor of Dhaka University (DU).

Meanwhile, the Chancellor of this university, President Md. Shahabuddin, has given his consent.

After the Awami League government fell on August 5 in the face of student and public agitation, the 29th Vice-Chancellor of Dhaka University, Professor Dr. Maqsud Kamal, resigned on August 10 under pressure. Dr. Niaz Ahmed Khan is going to replace him. 

Dr. Niaz has also served as the Deputy Vice-Chancellor of Independent University, Bangladesh (IUB). He received higher education from the University of Oxford, University of Wales Swansea, Asian Institute of Technology. He has contributed to the development of academic and practical development management in Bangladesh, Thailand and the UK.

Headline_English: Telegram app owner arrested in France
Content_Enlish:
French law enforcement agencies are investigating allegations that Telegram is spreading crime and lack of cooperation with the police due to the lack of moderators on the popular social media platform. French law enforcement agencies have detained Telegram founder Pavel Durov in France as part of this investigation. 


He was detained upon landing at La Bourget airport in France on Saturday (August 24), a French police source said. However, French authorities have not yet officially announced his detention. 

Telegram said in a statement that it complies with European Union (EU) law, including the Digital Services Act, and is constantly improving itself accordingly. It added that “Telegram CEO Pavel Durov has nothing to hide and travels to Europe every few days.” 

Durov, a dual citizen of France and the United Arab Emirates, is the founder of the Dubai-based Telegram app. He left Russia in 2014 after refusing to remove anti-government activists from the social media platform he founded, VK. Telegram, known as an encrypted application, has about 1 billion users. The app is particularly popular in Russia, Ukraine and former Soviet republics. It is the most popular social platform after Facebook, YouTube, WhatsApp, Instagram, TikTok and WeChat. 

Durov, who is worth $15.5 billion, according to Forbes. Last April, he said that some governments were pressuring him about the Telegram app. However, he also said that he would keep Telegram as a neutral platform and not allow it to become a “geopolitical player.” 

According to analysts, the platform has become a virtual battleground in the wake of the war in Ukraine. The Russian Foreign Ministry previously said that it had written to Paris to request a meeting with Durov.

Headline_English: Bollywood's richest man, Shahrukh Khan, owns how much wealth?
Content_Enlish:
Bollywood's biggest superstar Shah Rukh Khan. No one will disagree with this statement. Because Shah Rukh Khan's fans are spread across India and other countries of the world. Indian media outlet The Economic Times reported that for the first time, Bollywood King Shah Rukh Khan's name has topped the list of the richest people in the film industry in the 'Hurun India Rich List'. 

After a gap of a few years, Shah Rukh made history again in 2023 by returning to the big screen. He surprised everyone with three big hits. That year, the actor started the year with Pathan. Then Jawan. Then Shah Rukh Khan delighted his fans with Dunki. All three films took the box office by storm. What was the reason? There was only one reason - Shah Rukh Khan played the lead role in all three films. 

Apart from films, everyone knows how famous his huge house Mannat is in Mumbai. Every day, thousands of people stand outside his house to catch a glimpse of him. They think that maybe their favorite hero will come out and wave to them. 

On Thursday (August 29), Hurun India released the list of India's richest people. Along with Mukesh Ambani and Gautam Adani, he has also appeared on this list. This is a big deal for people in the entertainment world. 

According to the current year's calculations, Shah Rukh, who is at the top, has a wealth of 7,300 crore rupees in Indian currency. In Bangladeshi currency, which is about 10,397 crore taka. In addition to acting, his income from the production company 'Red Chillies' and the cricket team 'Kolkata Knight Riders' has made him a place on this list. 

Shah Rukh's friend Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla is in second place on the list. Her wealth is 4,600 crore rupees. In addition to acting, she is one of the leaders of Kolkata Knight Riders. Hrithik Roshan is in third place. His wealth is 2,000 crore rupees from his fashion brand HRX and income from acting. 

Bollywood Shahenshah Amitabh Bachchan is in fourth place on this list with an income of 1,600 crore rupees from various sectors. Karan Johar, the head of the production company 'Dharma Productions', is at the fifth position on the list. His wealth is Rs 1,400 crore. There are 1,539 people in the Hurun India Rich List 2024. Each of them has a wealth of more than Rs 1,000 crore. 

Shah Rukh Khan will next be seen in the film 'King' with his daughter Suhana Khan. It is reported that Abhishek Bachchan will be seen in the role of a villain in the film.

Headline_English: Putin could be arrested during Mongolia visit
Content_Enlish:
Russian President Vladimir Putin will visit Mongolia next week. However, the International Criminal Court (ICC) has said that the country is responsible for arresting Putin if he visits Mongolia. 
On Friday, the BBC reported that Putin is likely to visit Mongolia next Tuesday. If so, this will be his first visit to an ICC member state since Putin's arrest warrant was issued in March 2023. 

The International Criminal Court has indicted Putin for war crimes. It has been said that Putin is responsible for illegally taking numerous children from the country to Russia after the war with Ukraine began in February 2022. 

In this situation, Ukraine has repeatedly reminded Mongolia of the arrest of Putin in view of his possible visit. However, Putin's office, the Kremlin, says that they have no concerns about this visit. "We have excellent relations with our partners in Mongolia," Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov told reporters in Moscow. Peskov also said that Russia was taking all aspects of Putin's visit very carefully. 

The BBC approached the court to find out how Putin could visit a member state of the ICC without an arrest warrant. In this regard, the court's spokesman, Dr. Fadi Al-Abdullah, told the BBC that the court relies on other member states, including Mongolia, to implement its decisions. He said, "Mongolia, like other ICC signatories, has an obligation to cooperate. The order that was issued for Putin's arrest in 2023 is also part of this obligation." 

The International Criminal Court has also issued an arrest warrant for Putin and Russia's Commissioner for Children's Rights Maria Lvova-Belova, on charges of taking children from Ukraine to Russia. However, Moscow has previously denied the allegations and described the arrest warrant as “out of anger.” 

ICC spokesman Dr. Abdullah said that if member states fail to cooperate in any matter, the court’s judges will investigate it and inform the council of that state. 

Although it conducts international trials, the ICC does not have its own force. As a result, the court has no way to directly arrest any accused. In this case, only member states can arrest the accused and hand them over to the court. 

Regarding Putin’s visit, Ukraine’s Foreign Ministry said that they hope Mongolia is aware of the fact that Putin is a war criminal. Therefore, Ukraine has called for Putin to be arrested and handed over to the International Criminal Court in the Netherlands if he visits. 

Earlier last year, Putin canceled a summit scheduled for South Africa due to an arrest warrant.

Headline_English: Energy Ministry cancels contract with S Alam Group
Content_Enlish:
The Energy Department of the Ministry of Power, Energy and Mineral Resources has canceled the implementation proposal of the Unit-2 project of S Alam Group and Eastern Refinery Limited (ERL). 
This information was given in a notification sent by the Ministry of Power, Energy and Mineral Resources on Thursday. 

The notification said that the implementation proposal of the 'Installation of ERL Unit-2' project proposed by ERL under the public-private joint venture agreement between S Alam Group and the Group has been canceled. 

At the same time, it has been decided to send the DPP of the project to the Bangladesh Petroleum Corporation (BPC) after formulating the updated foreign exchange rate estimate and all the procurement plans as per PPR-2008 and sending it to the DPP restructured by the Planning Commission. 

Incidentally, the private group S Alam sent a letter to the government expressing its interest in implementing the second unit project of the oil refinery company ERL, owned by the government-owned BPC. Earlier, this project was supposed to be built with the financing and engineering of France's Technip. The work took about 10 years for this. The government also spent about 1500 crore taka. 

Then Technip withdrew from the project saying it would not finance it. Taking this opportunity, S Alam claimed ownership by saying that he would invest in the project. 

It is worth noting that the Financial Intelligence Unit has sought information on the bank accounts of Mohammad Saiful Alam, the owner of the controversial business group S Alam Group, his six brothers, wife and two sons, and several members of his family. At the same time, bank accounts operated in the name of their interest-related organizations and other information have also been sought.

Headline_English: Dr. Yunus seeks Switzerland's cooperation to return laundered money
Content_Enlish:
The Interim Government's Chief Advisor, Professor Dr. Muhammad Yunus, has sought Switzerland's cooperation in bringing back money laundered from Bangladesh. 
On Thursday (August 29), Swiss Ambassador Reto Rengli raised the issue with Professor Muhammad Yunus at the State Guest House Jamuna when he paid a courtesy call on him. 

Professor Yunus asked him, "Is there any way to return the money? A lot of the stolen money has been laundered abroad?" He said, "This is important." On mutual legal assistance, the Ambassador said that Switzerland has always been willing to cooperate in line with internationally accepted procedures and standards and in line with the proposals presented in recent years. 

The Ambassador said, "It was a pleasure to learn about the government's priorities from him. Switzerland will support the Interim Government in fulfilling the expectations of the people of Bangladesh, considering the opportunities and challenges ahead." 

During the meeting, Ambassador Rengli assured Dr. Yunus was handed a letter from the President of Switzerland. The ambassador said Switzerland would support the interim government and strengthen economic ties with the country. 

The ambassador said, “I really hope that the business environment in Bangladesh will improve further.” The ambassador expressed concern about the situation in Myanmar’s Rakhine State, which borders Bangladesh, according to the press wing of the chief adviser. 

Professor Yunus said his government wants to develop young leaders in the Rohingya camps.

Headline_English: We extend a helping hand to our friend and brother Bangladesh: Erdogan
Content_Enlish:
Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan has expressed his condolences for the loss of life in the floods in Bangladesh. He also wished a speedy recovery to the injured and the affected. He said, "We extend Turkey's helping hand to our friend and brother Bangladesh. They are going through a difficult time due to the flood disaster." 
Stressing the solidarity between the two countries, Erdogan said, "Through the aid program, we are not leaving our Bangladeshi brothers and sisters alone. They are facing great losses, we are trying to heal their wounds." 

The President said, "I pray to God to have mercy on those who lost their lives in this disaster. I wish a speedy recovery to the injured. We are always by their side." 

Erdogan announced the start of the distribution of a total of 16,750 aid packages, focusing on the severely affected areas in Bangladesh where road transport has been disrupted by the floods. He also mentioned that 'AFAD', 'Turkish Cooperation and Coordination Agency' and various Turkish non-governmental organizations will stand by the flood victims.

Headline_English: Murder case filed against 155 people including Sheikh Hasina, Obaidul Quader in Gazipur
Content_Enlish:
A case has been filed against 155 people, including former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina, at the Gazipur Metropolitan Basan Police Station on charges of murdering her husband. The deceased's wife, Mosha Purnima Begum, filed the case on Wednesday (August 28) in connection with the killing of Nazrul Islam (32) on July 20 during the anti-discrimination student movement. 

Two hundred more unidentified people have been named as accused in the case. Basan Police Station OC Md. Jahangir Alam confirmed the case. 

Awami League General Secretary and former minister Obaidul Quader, former Home Minister Asaduzzaman Khan Kamal, former Freedom Fighters Affairs Minister Mozammel Haque, former MP Zahid Ahsan Russell, Meher Afroz Chumki, Simin Hossain Rimi, Rumana Ali Tusi, Akhtar Uzzaman, former IGP of Police Chowdhury Abdullah Al Mamun, Metropolitan Awami League President Azmat Ullah Khan, General Secretary Ataullah Mandal, former Mayor Jahangir Alam, Awami League leaders Matiur Rahman Moti, Asadur Rahman Kiran, Afzal Hossain Sarker Ripon, Metropolitan Jubo League convener Kamrul Ahsan Sarker Russell, along with Awami League leaders and activists and some ward councilors of the City Corporation have been made accused in the case. 

The deceased has been identified as Nazrul Islam (32), son of Md. Jamal Sheikh of Baribhang area of ​​Raiganj police station in Sirajganj district. She used to live in a rented house of Shahabuddin Mandal in the Chandana intersection area of ​​Basan police station in Gazipur. 

In the statement, the plaintiff mentioned that on July 20, at around 12 noon, her husband Nazrul Islam came to the paved road of Wool Sweater Garments in the Chandana area of ​​Basan police station on the eastern side of the Dhaka-Mymensingh highway to join the student movement against discrimination and participated in the rally. During the peaceful rally there, on the orders of the first 16 accused in the case, they armed themselves with deadly country-made weapons including guns, pistols, sticks, iron rods, ramdas, chens, chapatis, and kobas, and attacked the protesting students and the crowd. They repeatedly punched, hit with sticks and iron rods, and randomly beat and slashed with sharp weapons, causing serious cuts and bloody injuries to several protesters. The named and unknown defendants in the complaint, who were carrying illegal weapons, started shooting at the student crowd indiscriminately with the intention of killing them. At that time, Nazrul Islam was shot in the right side of his back by the defendants and died on the spot. 

Later, she immediately took her husband's body to Baribagh village under Raiganj police station in Sirajganj district, her in-laws' home, and buried it. Since my family was mentally devastated by my husband's death and the current situation in the country was unusual, there was a delay in collecting the names and addresses of the accused and coming to the police station to file a complaint. 

Murder case against 57 people including former Liberation War minister in Gazipur 

Meanwhile, a case has been filed with the city's Konabari Police Station in the case of the shooting and disappearance of auto-rickshaw driver Hridoy in Gazipur. The deceased's cousin Md. Ibrahim, son of Lal Mia of Alamnagar area of ​​Gopalpur police station in Tangail, filed the case on Monday night. 

Former Liberation War Minister and District Awami League President AKM Mozammel Haque has been named as the chief and Metropolitan Awami League President Advocate Azmatullah Khan, former Mayor Md. Jahangir Alam, Konabari Thana Awami League President Abdur Rahman Master, General Secretary Khalilur Rahman, Gasik Councilor Selim Rahman, Abbas Uddin Khokon, Kausar Ahmed, Shafiqul Amin Tapan and Sanjit Sarkar have been named as accused in the case. In addition, 250-300 other people of unknown identities have been named as accused. Konabari Police Station OC Shah Alam confirmed the case. 

The plaintiff in the complaint stated that the deceased Hridoy and plaintiff Md. Ibrahim used to drive autorickshaws from a rented house in the Harinachala area of ​​Konabari Police Station of Gazipur City Corporation. On the afternoon of August 5, they were waiting at the Angel Gate area of ​​Kuddus Nagar, Konabari Police Station. At that time, students participating in the anti-discrimination student movement started chanting slogans from Konabari through Kashimpur Road towards Konabari Police Station. On the orders of senior leaders, other accused attacked the protesting students with firearms, Ram Da, rods, chapatis, sticks and sticks. Hridoy was killed in this. The next accused disappeared his body.

Headline_English: UN delegation meets IGP
Content_Enlish:
A delegation from the Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights met with IGP Md. Moinul Islam. 
A delegation from the Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights paid a courtesy call on the Police Headquarters on Wednesday (August 28) afternoon. 

A press release from the Police Headquarters said that the three-member delegation was led by Rory Mungoven, Head of the Asia-Pacific Section of the Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights. The other members of the delegation are Livia Cosenza, Human Rights Officer of the Asia-Pacific Section, and Alexander James Amir El Jundi. During the meeting, the IGP assured the delegation of all-round cooperation.

Headline_English: Politics of the future will be for the welfare of the people: Ishraq Hossain
Content_Enlish:
Engineer Ishraq Hossain, a member of the BNP's International Affairs Committee, said that the politics of the future will be only for the interest of the people, to stand by the people, to protect the sovereignty of Bangladesh's independence. He said this while distributing relief to flood-affected people in Ramganj, Lakshmipur district on Tuesday. 
At this time, Ishraq Hossain said that the Awami League has looted Bangladesh, they consider the soil of Bangladesh as their ancestral property. After the fall of the dictatorship on August 5, we are now able to breathe the breath of independent Bangladesh. We are able to live with the dignity of a citizen with self-respect. 

He said that floods have occurred in 11 districts of the eastern part of the country due to natural causes and India. This has caused extensive damage. Many people have died, many people have lost communication. Many are unable to go to their homes. A terrible identity has been created. In this situation, under the instructions and leadership of our leader Begum Khaleda Zia and our leader Tarique Rahman, BNP has undertaken a program to stand by the people. BNP is with you. 

This young BNP leader said, when the people of the country were facing natural disasters including floods, the leaders and activists of the Awami League lived a life of luxury sitting in Dhaka. In the coming days, we want to break the trend of this politics, we want to break the trend of that selfish politics. We will be by your side in any natural disaster in the coming days. 

Nazim Uddin Ahmed, BNP MP from Ramganj, Lakshmipur 1 constituency, Munshiganj district BNP member Engineer Mashruk Hossain, Gendaria Thana BNP President Maqbul Hossain Tipu, General Secretary Abdul Qadir, and Councilor of Ward No. 41 of Dhaka, Liaquat Ali were present at this relief distribution ceremony organized in the area adjacent to Ramganj College Gate in Lakshmipur.

Headline_English: Deepti Chowdhury turns down offer to become heroine
Content_Enlish:
Deepti Chowdhury, the host of the talk show 'To the Point' on a private television channel, came into the spotlight. Basically, in one episode, she caught everyone's attention by handling the situation with patience and politeness, in contrast to the arrogant behavior of former judge Manik. 

Since then, various discussions have started around this presenter. Due to which, Deepti also received an offer to become a heroine in a movie. She was offered to work in a new film by the production company Jazz Multimedia. 

Jazz Multimedia's head Abdul Aziz confirmed the matter. Deepti Chowdhury was the first on Aziz's list of choices for a new movie. However, he has rejected the offer to become a heroine. Deepti said that she is not interested in acting in any movie at the moment. 

Abdul Aziz said in the media regarding the matter, 'I am going to start working on a new movie. The story and script writing work is already finished. I am looking for a new face for the movie. We initially wanted Deepti Chowdhury as the heroine. But at this moment, she does not want to act in the film. The story of the film will reflect the reality of society. I hope the audience will like it. 

Regarding this, former Justice Shamsuddin Chowdhury Manik participated as a panelist in the talk show 'To the Point'. But at one stage of the discussion, he lost his temper and got angry with the host Deepti Chowdhury. He vented his anger on the host several times throughout the show and spoke loudly. Not only that, but before leaving the studio at the end of the show, he also commented that the host was 'the king's child'. 

The video of this incident went viral on social media with lightning speed. Where host Deepti Chowdhury caught everyone's attention by handling the situation with patience and polite behavior.

Headline_English: Air Chief visits CMH to meet Coordinator Hasnat Abdullah
Content_Enlish:
Bangladesh Air Force Chief Air Chief Marshal Hasan Mahmud Khan visited the hospital to see Hasnat Abdullah, one of the coordinators of the anti-discrimination student movement, who was injured in a clash between Ansar members and students in the capital's Secretariat area. 

He visited Dhaka CMH on Tuesday (August 27). During this, the Air Force Chief inquired about his physical condition. 

At least 40 people were injured in the attack by Ansar members last Sunday night and received treatment at Dhaka Medical College Hospital. Hasnat was also undergoing treatment there. He was later taken to Dhaka CMH.

Headline_English: Husband sets wife on fire after not getting dowry
Content_Enlish:
A housewife was set on fire by her husband in Thakurgaon after not getting dowry. The victim, Lata Begum (25), has been in pain at Thakurgaon General Hospital for three days. Almost half of her body was burned. Police have arrested her husband, Mohabbat, in this incident. 

The incident took place on Monday (July 1) morning in Barogharia village of Sakoa area of ​​Boda upazila of Panchagarh. 

It is learnt that Lata Begum married Mohabbar Ali, son of Shamsul Haque of Barogharia village of Sakoa area of ​​Boda upazila of Panchagarh, 8 years ago. The couple has a son and two daughters. Mohabbar Ali got married for the second time four months ago without informing Lata Begum. Since then, Lata was regularly tortured for dowry and divorce. Last Monday morning, Mohabbar started beating Lata for dowry. At one point, her husband, Mohabbat Ali, poured diesel from the house on her body and set her on fire in public. Mohabbat's parents, who were nearby at the time, did not come forward to save Lata. Later, locals rescued her and took her to Thakurgaon General Hospital. 

Relatives allege that Mohabbat often tortured her for marrying a second time after leaving behind his three children and wife. Relatives and locals have demanded strict punishment for his actions. 

Resident Medical Officer of Thakurgaon General Hospital, Rakibul Alam, said that the woman whose body was burned is being provided with all facilities from the hospital. However, she needs advanced treatment. Due to lack of money, the relatives are unable to get it done. 

Boda Police Station OC Mozammel Haque said that they used to argue about dowry and second marriage. It is alleged that Mohabbat used to torture her on these issues. He has been arrested and sent to jail through the court. The operation to catch the rest is ongoing.

Headline_English: Former ASP could not escape even after calling his wife a 'businesswoman'
Content_Enlish:
A retired police officer named Abul Hashem did not get away with pretending to be a boutique businessman to escape a corruption case. Although he claimed that he built a 4-storey house in Khulshi, Chittagong city with money from his wife's business, the business did not exist. 

The name of this former police officer is Abul Hashem. He was the assistant director of the Industrial Police Division of Chittagong. On Thursday afternoon, the ACC filed two separate cases against Abul Hashem and his wife Taherina Begum. The organization claims that the police officer built the house with money he earned through dishonest means while in service. 

ACC Chittagong Deputy Director Atiqul Alam told the media that former police officer Abul Hashem has been accused of concealing information about his assets worth Tk 445,000 and acquiring illegal assets worth Tk 186,000. Abul Hashem and his wife Taherina Begum have been accused in another case. In this case, the complaint alleges concealing information worth 684,000 taka and acquiring illegal assets worth 433,000 taka. 

ACC sources said that in 2018, the ACC ordered the submission of asset declarations of Abul Hashem and his wife due to allegations of bribery and irregularities in their employment. Later, when they submitted their asset declarations, information about concealing assets worth 11 lakh taka and acquiring illegal assets worth 62 lakh taka came to light. 

ACC Assistant Director Musabbir Ahmed, the plaintiff in the case, told the media that Abul Hashem built a 4-storey house in the Ruposhi Housing Society area of ​​Khulshi in the city in 2015. At that time, his wife had no income. He claimed that he had built the house with his wife's income and that he had made his wife a boutique trader and given tuition to show that he had done so. But the ACC investigation did not find any existence of his wife's boutique business.

Headline_English: Lebanon will become hell for Israel
Content_Enlish:
Iran's acting foreign minister, Ali Baqeri Qani, has said that if Israel starts an invasion of Lebanon, the battlefield will turn into hell for the Israelis. 

Ali Baqeri Qani told reporters after the weekly meeting of the Iranian cabinet on Wednesday. 

Ali Baqeri Qani said that if war starts, Lebanon will definitely turn into hell for Israel, and they will not be able to get out of it. 

Recently, the Israeli government has threatened to start an all-out war against the Lebanese armed group Hezbollah. There is a lot of tension between the two sides regarding this. 

The Iranian foreign minister called Hezbollah a powerful opponent against Israel and said that the Lebanese armed group has played a very strong role, which has created resistance in the international and diplomatic fields. 

Since the Israeli occupation began its brutal invasion of Gaza on October 7, Hezbollah fighters have been regularly attacking Israeli military and various installations. Hezbollah says that only if the invasion of Gaza stops will their attacks against Israel stop. 

Meanwhile, Hezbollah has launched more than two hundred rocket attacks targeting Israeli military positions in the past 24 hours. On Wednesday, Israel killed the organization's third-highest official and commander, Muhammad Nimah Nasser. Hezbollah responded with rocket attacks. On Wednesday, Israeli troops targeted a car in the largest city of Tyre in southern Lebanon. The Hezbollah commander was killed.

Headline_English: Child tortured by hanging from tree on accusation of sugarcane theft, 1 arrested
Content_Enlish:
A child (12) was allegedly tied to a tree and tortured in Tongibari upazila of Munshiganj on the charge of stealing sugarcane. The police have arrested the accused in the case filed in this incident. 
The arrested person is named Md. Karim Matabar (60). He is the son of the deceased Shamsul Matabar of the village. 

On Monday, a child was tied to a tree and tortured in Purba Nitira village of Arial union. The child's uncle Alamgir Sardar filed a case in this incident on Wednesday (July 3). 

The child's name is Md. Siam (12). He is the son of Tutul Sardar of Sonarang village of the upazila. After the separation of his parents, his father did not keep him with him. His mother married elsewhere and he used to live with Md. Mannan Sheikh in the house of his uncle. He is a 4th grade student of Nitira Government Primary School. 

Locals said that last Monday, three teenagers ate sugarcane from Md. Karim Matabar's field without informing him. In this incident, he accused Siam of theft and tied both hands of the same village to a tree and beat him with a stick. The torture lasted for about 4 minutes. 

Tongibari Police Station OC Molla Shoheb Ali said that a case has been filed with the police station regarding the child abuse. A person named Karim Matbar has been arrested in the case and sent to court.

Headline_English: Nepal's Prime Minister on the verge of being ousted
Content_Enlish:
Four months after forming a coalition government in Nepal, the ruling Communist Unified Marxist Leninist (UML) Party has withdrawn support from Prime Minister Pushpa Kamal Dahal's government, leaving him facing a crisis after losing his majority in parliament. The UML party says eight of its ministers nominated to the coalition will resign. 

The two largest parties in parliament, the UML and the opposition Nepali Congress Party, are set to form a new coalition to replace the government led by Dahal, sources said. 

UML top leader Pradeep Gawali told Reuters that the new alliance is for Nepal's stability. 

Nepal became a republic in 2008, ending a 239-year monarchy. Since then, the country has been plagued by factional fighting and political egos, which have hindered the formation of a stable government. 

Pushpa Kamal Dahal, 69, a former Maoist rebel chief, has changed allies three times in the coalition since the 2022 parliamentary elections. 

His party has said that Dahal will not resign. However, he will face a confidence vote in parliament within 30 days. 

Meanwhile, Nepali Congress Party spokesman Prakash Sharan Mahat said that UML chief KP Sharma Oli and Nepali Congress president Sher Bahadur Deuba will share the post of prime minister until the next election in November 2027.

Headline_English: Joy calls for registration for Joy Bangla Youth Award
Content_Enlish:
The global economic downturn has also affected Bangladesh. In the meantime, some young people are working towards changing society. It is essential to find these extraordinary achievers and spread their inspiring stories. These stories of hope and determination inspire others to dream big and achieve more. 

Joy Bangla Youth Award has emerged as one such important platform that has brought together these entrepreneurs from every corner of the country. Registration for the eighth edition of the much-awaited Joy Bangla Youth Award has officially begun. 

Prime Minister’s ICT Advisor and his son Sajeeb Wazed Joy has called for applications for the award. He posted about it on his verified Facebook page on Tuesday (July 2). 

In it, he wrote, the event is back to recognize the youth who are showing their innovative energy. It is time to come forward with all the innovative initiatives taken for the development of your area or society to inspire the nation with your incredible and indomitable activities. 

Applications for the eighth edition of the Joy Bangla Youth Award can be submitted now. 

Joy further wrote, Young Bangla started its journey almost a decade ago with the aim of rewarding and establishing a network with the successful youth of our country who tirelessly and silently contribute to the development of their communities and the country. Thank you to all the youth-based organizations for responding to our program and strengthening this platform. 

This application, which started on Friday (June 28), will continue until July 31. The application process and other information for the Joy Bangla Youth Award 2024 can be found in detail at https://jbya.youngbangla.org/ 

It is worth noting that the youth platform 'Young Bangla' has been giving the 'Joy Bangla Youth Award' since 2015 in recognition of their contribution to society through humanitarian work. Last year, this award was given to the best 12 youth organizations in the country. The award is presented in six categories by Young Bangla, a subsidiary of the Awami League's research wing, CRI, from over 750 organizations across the country.

Headline_English: 'I didn't think I would retire, but...' Rohit to Indian journalists
Content_Enlish:
The ninth edition of the T20 World Cup has ended. India won the title by defeating South Africa by 7 runs in the final. After winning the World Cup, captains Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli announced their retirement from T20. The Indian captain did not think of retiring. Rohit said goodbye to the shorter version of cricket due to the situation. 

After winning the World Cup, the Indian captain announced his retirement in a press conference. Announcing his retirement, Rohit said, 'This was my last match too. There is no better time to say goodbye. I really wanted to get this (T20 World Cup trophy). It is difficult to express the feeling in words.' 



After the press conference, Rohit faced the Indian journalists again. At that time, he said, 'I did not plan to retire from international T20. But the situation was like this... I thought this is the right situation for me. There cannot be a better situation than saying goodbye by winning the World Cup. That is why I have taken this decision.'

Headline_English: 11,450 Bangladeshis in foreign prisons: Foreign Minister
Content_Enlish:
Foreign Minister Dr. Hasan Mahmud said that 11,450 Bangladeshi expatriates are detained in prisons abroad. 
The minister said this in response to a question from government party member Farida Yasmin in Parliament on Monday (July 1). 

Hasan Mahmud said that according to information received from the missions, 2 people are detained in Portugal, 6 in Egypt, 81 in Italy, 385 in South Africa, 6 in Korea, 3 in Sri Lanka, 415 in Qatar, 9 in Libya, 19 in Spain, 122 in Hong Kong, 66 in Singapore, 16 in Brunei, 191 in China, 404 in the United Arab Emirates, 49 in Indonesia, and 5,746 in Saudi Arabia. 

In addition, 219 people are detained in Malaysia, 5 in Algeria, 4 in Thailand, 28 in Lebanon, 414 in Greece, 217 in Iraq, 508 in Turkey, 358 in Myanmar, 2 in Japan, 100 in Jordan, 1,579 in India, 420 in Oman, 4 in Mozambique, 2 in Belgium and 70 in the Maldives, the Foreign Minister said.

Headline_English: Water level rising at all points in Sylhet, fear of flooding again
Content_Enlish:
As the two floods continued, residents of Sylhet and Sunamganj are facing floods again due to heavy rains and landslides. In the last two days, Cherrapunji, India, received 499 millimeters of rain. In the last 24 hours, Sunamganj received 170 millimeters, Sylhet 69 millimeters, Kanaighat 54 millimeters and Sherpur 68 millimeters of rain. This has flooded various areas of Sylhet and Sunamganj districts. 

Heavy rains started again on Monday (July 1) afternoon. This has increased the water level. At 6 am on Monday, the water level in Kanaighat was 8 centimeters above the danger level. At 6 pm, the water level there was flowing 102 centimeters above the danger level. 

Khushi Mohan, Additional Chief Engineer of the North Eastern Region of the Water Development Board, said that heavy to very heavy rains are likely to occur in the North Eastern region of the country in the next 3 days. 

Deepak Ranjan Das, Executive Engineer of the Sylhet Water Development Board, said that the flood situation in Sylhet was improving. But it is raining continuously in Sylhet and India. At the same time, the mountain stream is coming down from India. Due to which the water level in the rivers of Sylhet is also increasing. 

Sunamganj Water Development Board Executive Engineer Mamun Hawlader said that due to the rains in Cherrapunji, the low-lying roads on the border are flooded with upstream water. Since Sunday, the water from the mountain stream has become the Jadukata River and flooded the submerged part of the Tahirpur-Sunamganj road near Anwarpur. A few kilometers later, the 100-meter submerged part of the Shaktiarkhala road is also flooded. Water has also risen in the Durgapur section. 

In Sylhet, 10,903 people have taken shelter in the shelters of 10 of the 13 upazilas as of Sunday. 653 shelters are ready in the district. Out of these, people have taken shelter in 219 shelters. However, there are no people in the shelters in Sylhet City Corporation and Sadar Upazilas.

Headline_English: 'Revenue officer' wife surpasses engineer husband in illegal income
Content_Enlish:
Kabir Ahmed, former additional chief engineer of the Roads and Highways Department (RHD). The Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC) has found evidence of illegal wealth acquisition against him. Kabir Ahmed's wife is former assistant director of the National Board of Revenue (NBR). There is also evidence of illegal wealth acquisition against her. Meanwhile, she is far ahead of her engineer husband. 

In addition, evidence of illegal wealth acquisition of 70 million 700 thousand taka, including concealing information about her assets, has been found against her. Both the husband and wife are now accused in a corruption case. On Monday (July 1), ACC Assistant Director Mohammad Jinnatul Islam filed two cases as the plaintiff at the agency's integrated district office, Dhaka-1. 

A senior ACC source confirmed the filing of the case. 

According to the statement of the first case, former additional chief engineer of the Roads and Highways Department (RHD) Kabir Ahmed declared information about the acquisition of assets of 20 million 79 lakh 96 thousand 851 taka in his asset statement. From the fiscal year 2014-15 to the fiscal year 2021-22, he spent 20 lakh 69 thousand 689 taka on family and other sectors. The amount of assets acquired in his name, including all expenses, is 3 crore 66 thousand 540 taka. Out of this, the ACC investigation found an acceptable income of 1 crore 91 lakh 75 thousand 812 taka for the accused. 

That is, Additional Chief Engineer Kabir Ahmed committed a punishable crime by acquiring a total of 1 crore 8 lakh 10 thousand 728 taka of illegal assets. 

On the other hand, the ACC has filed another case against his wife, former Assistant Director of the National Board of Revenue (Research and Statistics Wing), Badrun Nahar, on charges of providing false information about assets worth 97 thousand 663 taka and acquiring assets worth 5 crore 76 lakh 59 thousand 836 taka beyond known income. 

According to the case statement, the former NBR official concealed information about assets worth 1 crore 30 lakh 97 thousand 663 taka. The ACC summoned his asset statement on specific allegations of acquiring illegal wealth. The accused submitted his asset statement to the ACC on October 16, 2022. The investigation showed that the accused has a six-storey house built on 3.5 katha land purchased in Banasree, F Block under his ownership. The construction cost of which was shown as 80 lakh 95 thousand 600 taka. However, after measuring the house with an engineer, the construction cost was found to be 2 crore 11 lakh 93 thousand 263 taka. In this case, the accused concealed the information about the construction cost of 1 crore 30 lakh 97 thousand 663 taka. 

In addition, the accused Badrun Nahar showed assets worth 8 crore 16 lakh 32 thousand 656 taka in his asset statement. Out of which, evidence was found in favor of assets worth only 2 crore 39 lakh 72 thousand 820 taka. Therefore, the amount of assets inconsistent with his known income stands at 5 crore 76 lakh 59 thousand 836 taka. 

In total, evidence of immovable and movable assets worth 7 crore 7 lakh 57 thousand 499 taka has been found against Badrun Nahar. 

Charges have been brought against the accused under sections 26 (2) and 27 (1) of the ACC Act-2004.

Headline_English: Body of child recovered seven days after boat capsizes, another still missing
Content_Enlish:
The body of one of the two children who went missing after a boat capsized a week ago in Thanchi upazila of Bandarban has been recovered. Her name is Shanti Rani Tripura. She is the daughter of Mutijan Tripura of the remote Harishchandrapara village of Tindu union of the upazila. Her body was recovered from the mouth of the Shilajhiri river in Krangkyangpara around 4 pm today, Monday. 

The name of the other missing child who went missing after a boat capsized is Phulbani Tripura. She is the daughter of Nilapru Tripura of the same area. She was not found till this afternoon. 

According to local residents, Shanti Rani was a student of the fourth grade of Timangpara Government Primary School in the upazila. Phulbani is also a student of the third grade of the same school. The two were studying at a missionary hostel in the upazila headquarters. On July 1, the two went missing after the boat capsized while they were returning from their home to the hostel through the Purdak canal. 

Augustine Tripura, headmaster of Timongpara Government Primary School, said that local people saw Shanti Rani's body and informed the police. The police recovered the body and brought it to the police station. 

Thanchi Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Jasim Uddin said that after recovering the body, Mutijan Tripura identified the body as that of his daughter Shanti Rani Tripura. The process of handing over the body without an autopsy is underway based on the family's request.

Headline_English: 81-year-old Queen Hamid is going to Hungary to play in the Chess Olympiad
Content_Enlish:
The 45th Chess Olympiad will be held in Budapest, Hungary next September. The Bangladesh Open team for the tournament has not yet been finalized. However, the women's team has already been finalized. The top five chess players in this year's national women's chess tournament have received tickets to the Olympiad. 

However, legendary chess player Rani Hamid was not on that list. Rani Hamid and the two were equal in points in the fifth place in the national chess tournament. Rani Hamid became sixth in the play-off. But Sharmin Sultana Shirin of Narayanganj, who came second in the tournament, has withdrawn her name from the Olympiad team due to family reasons. As a result, Rani Hamid, who came sixth, is getting a chance to participate in the Olympiad. 
Chess Federation General Secretary Syed Shahabuddin Shamim said, "Shirin's baby is less than a year old. Shirin will not go to the Olympiad without her." Naturally, Rani Hamid, who is in sixth place, is getting a chance at the Olympiad.

Headline_English: Chinese electric car BYD is hitting the roads of Bangladesh
Content_Enlish:
In March, China's leading electric vehicle (EV) manufacturer BYD announced the launch of its own electric vehicle, the BYD Seal, in the domestic market. Although pre-orders for the car have been placed in Bangladesh for a long time, BYD has now started handing over the car to buyers. As a result, BYD Seal cars will soon be seen on the roads of Bangladesh. This information was given in a press release by BYD on Sunday. 

The press release said that the latest technology and safety features have been used in the BYD Seal model of the sports sedan genre. As a result, the panoramic roof-equipped car can be used to travel long distances comfortably. Car enthusiasts in Bangladesh have been eagerly waiting for the car for a long time. Finally, all the waiting is over and the pre-ordered cars are being handed over to the buyers. 

Amid Sakif Khan, Director of CG-Runner Bangladesh Limited, BYD's distributor in Bangladesh, said that BYD's goal is to ensure a better world for future generations by reducing global temperatures by 1 degree Celsius. The widespread use of electric vehicles will go a long way in achieving this goal. The journey of this initiative has also begun in Bangladesh through the BYD seal.

Headline_English: King's Zimbabwe defeated world champions India
Content_Enlish:
Zimbabweans had forgotten what it felt like to lose to India. Eight years ago, in 2016, Zimbabwe defeated Mahendra Singh Dhoni's India by 2 runs in a tense T20I in Harare. After that, Zimbabwe lost all six matches, including ODIs and T20Is. Zimbabwe defeated India again eight years later today. Sikandar Raja's team defeated the world champions by 13 runs in the first match of the T20 series in Harare. 

The world champions, however, sent a second-rate team to Zimbabwe. None of the World Cup-winning team was in this match. In this match, India's captain Shubman Gill and batsman Rinku Singh were with the Indian World Cup team as traveling reserves. 

This information, however, will remain as a footnote in the story of Zimbabwe's victory. In the end, it is the Indian national team. Zimbabwe players were overjoyed to win the 'World Cup' when Washington Sundar was caught by Blessing Mujarabani off Tendai Chatara's fifth ball of the last over. 

Batting for 116, India lost 9 wickets for 86 runs. Then, India was dreaming of a breathless victory with Sundar's bat. After the dismissal of Mukesh Kumar as the ninth batsman on the last ball of the 17th over, Sundar put on a 16-run partnership with Khalil Ahmed. However, this all-rounder did not take many singles-doubles to keep the wickets in check. In the last over, India's winning equation stood at 16 runs. Sundar could only take 2 runs off Chatara's first four balls. Jonathan Campbell's excellent fielding played a big role in that. Campbell ran a lot to the right side and saved a four. Then, Sundar, who had scored 27 runs off 34 balls, took the catch on the fifth ball. 

Man of the Match Sikandar Raja 
Man of the Match Sikandar RajaAFP 
Brian Bennett gave Zimbabwe its first wicket in the first over. Abhishek Sharma took a backward square leg catch off this pacer. Abhishek did not score a run in 4 balls on his debut for India. Gill top-scored with 31 runs for India, who lost 4 wickets for 28 runs in the powerplay. After scoring this run in 29 balls with 5 fours, the Indian captain was bowled by the opposing captain Sikandar Raja. Gill returned as the sixth batsman in the 11th over, leaving the team at 47 runs. 

Raja later dismissed Ravi Bishnoi and Mukesh Kumar. Raja, who took 3 wickets for 25 runs, also scored 17 runs with the bat earlier. The Zimbabwe captain was the man of the match for his all-round performance in the short-run match.

Headline_English: Putin wants a complete cessation of hostilities, not a ceasefire
Content_Enlish:
Russia does not want a ceasefire with Ukraine; rather, it wants to end the war in Ukraine completely. Russian President Vladimir Putin has outlined his own plan for ending the war in Ukraine. Putin said this at a joint press conference with Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orban during his visit to Russia. 

Putin also said that he had previously proposed to Ukraine to end the war. In the proposals, he had left an opportunity for Ukraine to cease hostilities and start negotiations. 

Putin said at the press conference that he does not want just a peace treaty or a temporary ceasefire agreement with Ukraine. At the same time, he will not agree to any kind of temporary truce. Because, in that case, Kiev will organize itself and take up arms again. Russia is calling for a final end to the conflict. 

Putin's conditions for ending the war have also been announced. He said, “In my speech at the Foreign Ministry, the conditions for stopping the war were outlined.” 

Putin noted that the resolution of the conflict depends on the fulfillment of several conditions. In particular, he stressed that Kiev must withdraw its forces from the Donbass. In addition, troops must also be withdrawn from Zaporizhzhia and Kherson. These regions have been formally annexed by Putin to Russia. 

The Russian president said that Kiev must meet some other conditions to stop the war. However, they will require thorough discussions during joint efforts. 

Earlier, Putin had brought up his conditions before a conference held in Switzerland last month on Ukraine’s peace efforts. Although Ukraine and its allies participated in that conference, Russia was not invited. For this reason, Russia’s ally China did not participate. The conference was not successful. Before the conference, Putin said that Ukraine must meet three conditions to stop the war. These are that Kiev must agree to give up more territory, withdraw its troops further into the country and abandon its desire to join the Western military alliance NATO. 

At the time, Ukraine rejected Putin's proposal. The United States also rejected the proposal. However, Putin said that the proposal remained open. In addition, the Kremlin called on Ukrainian leaders to consider the proposal more deeply. 

Putin said that given the position of the Ukrainian authorities and the current situation, it is clear that Kiev is not yet ready to stop the war in the hope of victory. 

Earlier, at a meeting of the heads of state of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) in Astana, Kazakhstan, Putin proposed a solution to end the war in Ukraine. He said that if Kiev and its Western supporters agree to his conditions, the war could end quickly and negotiations could begin. 

Putin expressed gratitude for the SCO members' suggestions on resolving the Ukraine conflict at the time and confirmed Moscow's readiness to consider them. Meanwhile, Russian President Vladimir Putin claimed that Russian forces had made further progress on the battlefield. According to him, Ukrainian troops had left more areas in eastern and southern Ukraine in the face of Russian operations. Kiev had basically surrendered there. Those areas are currently occupied by Russian forces. 

Zelensky's plan 
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said that he was developing a 'coordinated plan' to end the war with Russia. He said this at a press conference in the capital Kiev last week. Slovenian President Natasa Piers Musar was present at the press conference with Zelensky. At that time, the Ukrainian president said, 'It is very important for us to put forward a plan to end the war. This plan will have the support of the majority of countries in the world. We are working diplomatically to stop the war.’ 

Despite the talk of stopping the war, there are currently no talks between Ukraine and Russia on this. And recent statements by Zelensky and Russian President Vladimir Putin indicate that the two countries are now the furthest from a possible peace agreement. 

Orban’s perception 
Meanwhile, after his visit to Ukraine, his ally Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orban met with Putin in Russia. However, European Union leaders have criticized Orban, questioning the need for his visit. Putin expressed gratitude to Orban for taking this initiative to restart European talks with Russia. Orban met with Putin in Moscow last Friday. 

At a press conference after the meeting, Putin said that they had ‘openly and effectively’ discussed various issues. They also discussed the situation in Ukraine. 

At the press conference, Orban said, ‘A lot needs to be done to end the Russia-Ukraine war. "We have taken the first steps to start negotiations. Although there are still many differences between Kiev and Moscow."

Headline_English: Anderson has no worries about retirement
Content_Enlish:
James Anderson played his first Test of his career 21 years ago. The England pacer will play his last Test of his career on Wednesday at Lord's, the venue where he made his Test debut. As Anderson approaches 42, he is asked whether he will leave international cricket with a heavy heart. Will he not regret not being able to continue for a few more days? 

These questions are a great achievement for a pacer who is about to turn 42 this month. Why are you not going at this age, why are you going without hearing it, is the biggest recognition of Anderson's career. 

Anderson said that he has no worries about leaving Test cricket, he is leaving international cricket in a good mood. England's first Test against the West Indies will be Anderson's 188th Test. Only Indian legend Sachin Tendulkar has played more Tests than him. Anderson, the third bowler in history and the only pacer to take 700 Test wickets, spoke about his decision to retire at a press conference on Monday.

Anderson said he had finalised his retirement decision after meeting with the big three in England cricket in April. The three big three were England men's team managing director Rob Key, red-ball coach Brendon McCullum and Test captain Ben Stokes. They told Anderson that they were looking to rebuild England's Test team ahead of the 2025-26 Ashes. 

James Anderson, the first and only pacer to take 700 Test wickets 
James Anderson, the first and only pacer to take 700 Test wickets BCCI 
Anderson said that the Keys and McCullums knew what they wanted as soon as they called him, 'I wouldn't say it was a surprise. When the big three called me to speak at a hotel in Manchester, I didn't think it was anything out of the ordinary. I had an idea that something like this was going to happen. They were surprised to see me calm.'

Headline_English: Oppo launches Reno-12 series with powerful AI features
Content_Enlish:
As Bangladesh moves towards a prosperous future, OPPO, one of the world's leading smartphone companies, has once again brought a masterpiece. OPPO has brought the Reno 12 series with powerful AI features to the Bangladesh market. The new Reno 12 series unveiled by OPPO is a groundbreaking step in the field of artificial intelligence (AI). 
This new phone with cutting-edge technology will color the future in a new way with the touch of AI and unique imaging technology. 

The phone was unveiled in the capital on Wednesday (July 10) at a grand event. Bangladeshi smartphone users can now make ordinary moments extraordinary with this amazing phone from OPPO's latest Reno series. OPPO has unveiled this phone as part of fulfilling its commitment to bringing AI technology to all users. 

This wonderful phone has powerful AI and extraordinary imaging technology at the same time. Using the facilities of the phone's advanced AI, a user can easily control its photography. You may have taken a group picture somewhere. But in the meantime, a pedestrian was captured. The Reno12 series' AI Eraser can erase unwanted parts of the photo in just a few clicks. And so, this phone will make you a skilled photographer for any event or vacation. You can take perfect and 'clutter-free' photos with the phone, which are suitable for social media. 

If your eyes are closed in a photo, you can easily open it through the phone's AI Magic Studio feature. If you want to add a photo of a friend or child to a photo, you can do that too through the phone's AI Mapping feature. 

To overcome the problems of weak signals, network congestion and sound blocking, OPPO's AI LinkBoost full-link network data transmission engine can combine intelligent network selection and other technologies. As a result, it is possible to seamlessly switch data networks in WiFi dead zones at home, office, shopping malls and other places. Even in the elevator, you will get the benefit of fast signal recovery, as the phone will ensure uninterrupted signal while entering and exiting the elevator. 

The phone's BeaconLink feature will ensure voice calls even if there is no mobile signal anywhere. When you think of a strong and long-lasting phone, the Oppo Reno12 series comes to mind. The phone's comfortable grip will attract customers. In addition, its all-round armor protection will protect the phone even if it falls in any accident. And the phone's solid frame will provide reliable cushioning. Its water resistance certification will give you confidence in the phone's durability. In addition, the splash touch feature will keep the phone's screen fully active even if your hands are wet. 

Oppo is guaranteeing long-term use of the 5000 mAh large battery with 45 W SuperVok in the Reno12 F. Due to the high quality safety of the battery, users can use the phone for four years without worry. The phone can be used comfortably for up to 50 months after unboxing. Its 50-month Fluency Protection will give users a “new phone” feeling along with great comfort. 

Damon Yang, Managing Director of OPPO Authorized Exclusive Distributor, said, “OPPO’s industry-leading technology is revolutionizing the way users interact with their phones. We have been at the forefront of innovation with the belief that smartphones are the most important personal AI devices. With the OPPO Reno12 series, we want to inspire users to move forward by enabling them to apply the extraordinary benefits of AI in their lives.” 

Bangladeshi users can experience the extraordinary innovations of the OPPO Reno12 series through these handsets: Reno12 F (8GB+256GB) at Tk 34,990, Reno12 F 5G (12GB+256GB) at Tk 42,990, Reno12 (12GB+512GB) at Tk 59,990. 

Interested and potential buyers can visit the official Oppo Bangladesh Facebook page to know more about the Oppo Reno-12F series. 

Customers can pre-order the Oppo Reno12F (8GB+256GB) from July 10 to July 17. The phone will be available in the market from July 18. In addition to the chance to win an IoT device through a lottery, pre-order customers can also get a two-year warranty worth Tk 799 for free. 

They will also have the opportunity to get a one-year screen protection worth Tk 1299 for free. Customers can get EMI facilities for up to 30 months across 30 banks. In addition, they will get the opportunity to exchange their phone with a cash offer of Tk 5,000 with the help of swap.

Headline_English: CU students block road despite police baton charge
Content_Enlish:
Police have lathicharged students of Chittagong University (CU) and affiliated colleges who were protesting for quota reform. 

On Thursday (July 11), around 3:30 pm, students took up positions at Chittagong Battali station to block roads and railways as part of the pre-announced 'Bangla Blockade' program. Later, when they went to the city's Tiger Pass intersection, the police stopped them. 

At that time, the police lathicharged general students, including female students. Several students were injured in this. Later, the students dispersed and came to Chittagong City Gate No. 2 with a procession and blocked the road. 

The students said that they will continue the movement until their one-point demand is met. 

CMP Additional Deputy Commissioner (South) Ashraful Karim said, some students first gathered in the name of Bangla Blockade in the old railway station area of ​​Chittagong. We had no objection to them rallying there. But later they wanted to sit on the road at Tiger Pass intersection. Then I requested them to leave the area to keep the traffic flowing normally.

Headline_English: Question leak: BCS pass package for 5 million
Content_Enlish:
In the last 12 years, there have been allegations of question leaks in 30 recruitment exams, including BCS, of the Bangladesh Public Service Commission (PSC). Based on these allegations, the CID conducted a raid. 17 people were arrested on charges of question leaks. This time, some sensational information has emerged from them. 

The 17 arrested worked in two groups. According to the contract, they would take one to two lakh taka from a candidate before the preliminary exam. Similarly, one to two lakh taka had to be paid before the written and oral exams. The remaining money had to be paid when the appointment was finalized. In the case of government jobs, they would take 18 to 20 lakh taka. And the contract for BCS was for 45 to 50 lakh taka. 

The CID said that several information about question leaks was found from the WhatsApp conversations of the members of the gang. In addition, several digital evidences were found. Hundreds of photocopies of the admit cards of the two BCS exams were found from them. However, the CID did not tell anything about the admit cards of the two BCS exams in this regard. 

The gang has been leaking questions of various recruitment exams for a decade. It is believed that a group centered on BG Press is involved in this. Question papers were not given on WhatsApp or Messenger; rather, the contracted examinees were taken to a secret hideout the night before the exam. 

The Criminal Investigation Department (CID) of the police has arrested 17 people, including former driver Syed Abed Ali, from different parts of the country on charges of involvement in the PSC question leak. Among them are PSC Deputy Director Abu Zafar, Deputy Director Jahangir Alam, Assistant Director Alamgir Kabir. 

Also arrested are Despass rider Khalilur Rahman, office assistant Sajedul Islam, auditor Priyanath Roy, former army member Noman Siddiqui, former DU student and businessman Abu Solaiman Md. Sohel, businessman Zahidul Islam, Dhaka Immigration and Passport Office employee Mamunur Rashid, businessman Sakhawat Hossain and his brother Sayem Hossain, Daffodil International University student Liton Sarkar, Narayanganj Regional Passport Office security guard Shahadat Hossain, Shahid Suhrawardy Medical College Hospital technician Niyamun Hasan, and Chhatra League leader Syed Sohanur Rahman Siam, son of Abed Ali.

Headline_English: Calls for urgent session of Parliament to reform quotas
Content_Enlish:
Various university areas of the country, including the capital, have been in turmoil since the afternoon demanding quota reform. The 'Bangla Blockade' program was observed across the country for the fourth day on Thursday (July 11). Later, the protesters announced a new program around 9 pm. As the next program of the movement, a protest has been called in all educational institutions across the country on Friday (July 12) afternoon. At this time, the students have announced to continue the movement until the quota system in government jobs is reformed and a law is passed in parliament. 

They made this announcement by blocking the Shahbagh intersection in the capital from 5 pm to 4 hours on Thursday. Before ending the blockade at Shahbagh intersection at 9 pm, one of the coordinators of the movement, Nahid Islam, announced the program and said that the police have attacked students protesting in different parts of the country demanding quota reform. In addition to demanding quota reform, protest marches and rallies will be held in all campuses at 4 pm tomorrow to protest this attack. 

He also said that the movement cannot be suppressed by attacking and intimidating them. An emergency session of parliament must be called to rationally reform the quota and finally solve the quota problem. Not only first and second class jobs, but all government jobs should have a 5 percent quota for backward classes and all other positions should be filled on the basis of merit. 

Addressing the protesting students, Nahid Islam said that if the movement is obstructed anywhere, it will be dealt with collectively. The government is responsible for the suffering of the people due to the students' movement. If the government had rationally reformed the quota, they would not have needed to hold this movement. Their movement has the support of the people. 

This afternoon, a wave of students entered the Shahbag area, ignoring the police's obstruction. Some held placards in their hands, some shouted anti-quota slogans. In this way, students marched from Dhaka University towards Shahbag. The police stopped them as soon as they got close to Shahbag. But the protesters did not retreat. In a moment, the students broke through the police's iron barricades and took control of Shahbag. At one stage, the students surrounded the armored vehicles brought by the police to stop the movement. At that time, the police wrapped up everything and withdrew. 

Although the police retreated in Dhaka, there are allegations that the police were aggressive in several universities including Comilla and Chittagong. Many students were injured in the police attack at Comilla University. After these news spread, Shahbagh Square became tense. In the meantime, students of Jagannath University gathered at Shahbagh. 

Meanwhile, despite the police chase and counter-chase, students of Comilla University blocked the Dhaka-Chittagong highway for about 6 hours demanding quota reform in government jobs. 

The blockade in the Kotbari area of ​​Comilla caused a long traffic jam on both lanes of the highway for at least 25 kilometers, said Iqbal Bahar Majumdar, OC of Mainamati Highway Police Station. 

The protesting students started the protest around 4:30 pm on Thursday by throwing tree trunks and setting tires on fire. After a six-hour blockade, they left the highway at 10:30 pm.

Headline_English: Shakira to perform at Copa America final
Content_Enlish:
Pop star Shakira will grace the stage of the Copa America final. This will be the first time she will sing on the Copa stage. This has been confirmed by CONMEBOL, the continental governing body for Latin American football. 

According to a report by The New York Times, CONMEBOL announced that Shakira will perform at halftime of the final on Sunday, July 14. 

CONMEBOL president Alejandro Dominguez said in a statement, “Shakira is an extraordinary South American star who has captivated the entire world. 

Her songs are sung in every corner of the planet and have everyone dancing, transforming her art into a global phenomenon, enjoyed by millions across borders. 

We are confident that her performance at the Copa America USA 2024 will reflect the message of well-being and unity through sport.” 

The Copa final, to be held at the Hard Rock Stadium in Miami, USA, is expected to be attended by around 54,000 people. 

Her song "Punteria" featuring Cardi B is the official song for the 2024 Copa America CONMEBOL coverage. The Copa America, which will feature 16 teams from CONMEBOL and CONCACAF in the United States, will begin on June 20 and end on July 14. 

Meanwhile, Shakira released her 12th studio album, "La Mujeres y no loran" in March. It has since peaked at number 13 on the Billboard 200 and number 2 on the Top Albums chart.

Headline_English: Chanchal Chowdhury receives two awards in the United States
Content_Enlish:
Popular actor Chanchal Chowdhury received two awards while in the United States. He himself announced the good news on social media. 

On Wednesday (July 10), Chanchal Chowdhury posted two pictures of receiving the award on Facebook. The actor wrote in the caption of the picture, ‘This time’s trip to America. The first picture is from the Dhallywood Awards-2024 held in New York and the second picture is from receiving the award as the best actor at the NABC-2024 held in Chicago.’ 



Chanchal Chowdhury also wrote, ‘I have received Dhallywood Awards many times before, for which I am grateful to Alamgir Khan Alam. But this time I am especially honored and happy to receive the award for the best actor at the NABC-2024. 

The reason is that this award is the Mother of popular West Bengal actor Parambrata Chatterjee, the Shraddhaya Sunetra Ghatak Memorial Award. 



The actor wrote, "This year, NABC introduced this award in the name of this talented personality and this award was presented to me for the first time. 

I received this award from the hands of my friend actor Parambrata. It was a special pleasure for me. 

In the post, Chanchal Chowdhury introduced Sunetra Ghatak and wrote, "Shraddhaya Sunetra Ghatak was the niece of the renowned filmmaker of the subcontinent, Ritwik Kumar Ghatak." 

Finally, expressing his gratitude, the talented actor also wrote, "I express my utmost gratitude to the NABC authorities for giving me this special award. May Bengali cinema win." 

Chanchal has proven his acting skills in all mediums, be it stage, television, big screen or OTT platform. Not only that, he also impressed the audience by singing in his own voice.

Headline_English: Nationwide 'Bangla Blockade' continues on Thursday
Content_Enlish:
Students have been staging a nationwide blockade program since 3:30 pm on Thursday (July 10) demanding the abolition of the quota system in government jobs and the reinstatement of the 2018 circular. 

DU student Asif Mahmud, one of the organizers of the anti-discrimination student movement, made this announcement at Shahbagh on Wednesday (July 10) evening. 

He said that the Bangla blockade will continue in all corners of the country from 3:30 pm. The blockade will be observed at important points in the country. 

Students are observing a nationwide blockade program in the morning and evening with the same demand. 

This blockade program, called the 'Bangla Blockade', began on July 7. After the blockade lasted for half a day for the first two days, a break was given on Tuesday. 

After the movement demanding quota reform in 2018, the government canceled the entire quota system in first and second class jobs. The Ministry of Public Administration issued a circular on the abolition of quota on October 4 of that year. Later, in 2021, some sons of brave freedom fighters filed a writ petition challenging the part of the circular that abolished the freedom fighter quota. 

The verdict on June 5 removed the obstacle to appointing freedom fighter quota in grades 9 to 13. The state party appealed to the Appellate Division of the Supreme Court to stay the verdict. 

Al-Sadi Bhuiyan, a student of the Anthropology Department of Dhaka University and the President of the Dhaka University Journalists Association, and Ahnaf Saeed Khan, a student of the Urdu Department, applied to be a party to the case pending in the Appellate Division of the Supreme Court. 

Then today, the Appellate Division restored the quota in government jobs and granted a four-week stay on the High Court verdict.

Headline_English: China will stand by to resolve Rohingya issue: Foreign Minister
Content_Enlish:
China will continue to stand by Bangladesh in resolving the Rohingya issue.
