Russian forces are gradually making progress on the battlefield in Ukraine. Last Friday, they also claimed to have captured a village in the country. Currently, about 25 percent of Ukraine's territory is under Russian control. In addition, four regions of the country were included in Russia through a controversial referendum in 2022. However, Moscow does not have full control over these four regions.

Headline_English: ICC gives Rs 20 crore to champion India, BCCI gives Rohit Rs 125 crore
Content_Enlish:
The Indian Cricket Board (BCCI) has announced a huge cash prize for the Indian team for winning the T20 World Cup. Secretary Jay Shah said that a total of Rs 125 crore will be given to the players, coaches and support staff of the World Cup-winning team. 

This is more than six times the amount given by the ICC. The ICC gave $2.45 million to India, which won the World Cup by defeating South Africa on Saturday, which is about Rs 20.42 crore in Indian currency. 

Among the cricket boards, the BCCI is the richest. This has been clear from the salary and bonus expenses for players and coaching staff, TV broadcasting rights and income from the ICC. This time after the T20 World Cup final, it has become clear once again. 

A day after the Proteas won the World Cup by 7 runs in Barbados, Jay Shah made the announcement on behalf of the board on social media, saying, "I am delighted to announce a prize money of Rs 125 crore for Team India, who wins the 2024 T20 World Cup. The team has shown extraordinary talent, determination and sportsmanship throughout the tournament. Congratulations to all the players, coaches and support staff for this exceptional achievement.’ 

The ICC had set a total prize money of $1.25 crore for this World Cup, which is 132.7 crore taka in Bangladeshi currency. Out of this, the title winners India received 287.6 crore taka and the runners-up South Africa received 152.2 crore taka. Bangladesh, who failed to win a single match in the Super Eights, also received 45 million taka.

Headline_English: How three bank officials embezzled 35 million taka from the city corporation
Content_Enlish:
The check was in the name of the mayor of Chittagong City Corporation (CCC). The money was supposed to be deposited in the CCC account, but the check was not deposited in the CCC account and went to another account. In this way, 3.5 crore taka was embezzled. The act was carried out jointly by three bank officials. The embezzlement incident took place at the Agrabad corporate branch of state-owned Agrani Bank in Chittagong city. 

After a three-and-a-half-year investigation, the Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC) filed a chargesheet in the court today, Sunday, against four people, including three bank officials of Agrani Bank's Agrabad branch. 

They are Rafiq Uddin Qureshi, former officer (clear section) of Agrani Bank's Agrabad branch, Principal Officers Shubham Dewan and Gazi Arifur Rahman, and Sumon Mia, a resident of Brahmanbaria. At the same time, the ACC charge sheet recommended taking departmental action against the Chief Accounting Officer of the City Corporation, Humayun Kabir Chowdhury, Accounting Officer (Bills) Ashutosh Dey and Accounting Officer (Budget) Masudul Islam for negligence in their duties. 

The investigating officer of the case, ACC Chittagong Assistant Director Faisal Quader, told Prothom Alo that although checks issued by various institutions were supposed to be deposited in the account number of the City Corporation Mayor, they (three bank officials) did not do so. They embezzled Tk 3.45 crore by depositing it in another account number. For this, a charge sheet has been filed in the court, accusing four people, including three bank officials. It was recommended to take departmental action against the three accounting officers of the City Corporation for negligence in their duties. 

On November 17, 2021, the ACC filed a case against Rafiq Uddin Qureshi, a former officer of Agrani Bank's Agrabad branch, on charges of embezzling Tk 8.7 million by not depositing it in the City Corporation's account number. It is said that Chief Accounting Officer Humayun Kabir called the branch manager of Agrani Bank to inform him of the matter as the amount of money that was supposed to be deposited in the account number of CHC was not deposited. Later, when the branch manager Rafiq Uddin Qureshi was questioned about the money, he initially denied it. Later, he admitted to embezzling the money from CHC's check. 

The ACC charge sheet states that on March 18, 2015, a savings account was opened in the name of Suman Mia at Agrani Bank Nagar's Agrabad branch. Bank officer Rafiq Uddin Qureshi used to deposit the checks from the relevant bank account of CHC into the bank account of that person named Suman Mia instead of depositing them. In continuation of this, Rafiq Uddin did not deposit 41 checks issued from the Sonali Bank account of Japan International Development Agency-JICA in favor of the Mayor and Chittagong City Corporation on different dates into the corporation's account. These were deposited into Suman Mia's account and 2 crore 46 lakh taka was withdrawn. Apart from this, 99 lakh taka of eight more checks given by different contractors were withdrawn in the same way. From 2018 to 2021, this money was deposited in another account instead of changing the voucher and deposited in the corporation's account branch, but the corporation's account branch was negligent. They did not supervise the matter properly. For this, the ACC has recommended departmental action against them.

Headline_English: Assistant Superintendent of Police loses job due to corruption
Content_Enlish:
The government has sent an Assistant Superintendent of Police (ASP) on compulsory retirement for corruption and misconduct. The police officer is named Yakub Hossain. He was working as an Assistant Superintendent of Police (ASP) at the Sarada Police Academy. 

A notification issued by the Public Safety Division of the Ministry of Home Affairs on Sunday (June 30) announced the compulsory retirement of Yakub Hossain. The notification said that the President has given his consent to 'compulsory retirement' as allegations of misconduct and corruption against Yakub Hossain were proven. 

Yakub Hossain was previously working in Mirpur Circle of Kushtia district. The notification said that at that time he formed a team with the intention of gaining financial gain. SI Jiban Biswas, Constable Al Amin, Constable Md. Abdus Sabur, driver Constable Samiul and Constable Anik were members of this team. 

On January 19, 2019, SI Jiban Biswas and other police members went to the house of the Lipi Commissioner of Ward No. 3 of Mosharrafpur in Mirpur Municipality as planned. Md. Ashraf Hossain and Md. Shamim Reza were staying there with a woman named Maya. At that time, the police members handcuffed them and beat them severely on the charge of doing illegal work and took pictures of them in a half-naked state. Later, they released them by taking one lakh taka from the two through MSF (Mobile Phone Finance) businessman Sohel Rana of Mirpur Bazar. 

The notification of the Home Ministry said that despite being aware of the matter, he (Yakub Hossain) did not take legal action and assisted in the misdeed. 

Based on this complaint, on November 9, 2020, a charge sheet and a charge sheet were issued against Yakub Hossain for misconduct and corruption under Rules 3(b) and 3(d) of the Government Servants (Discipline and Appeal) Rules, 2018. The accused officer was issued a show cause notice. The accused officer applied for a personal hearing and his reply was reviewed. Since the allegations were proven, there was a possibility of imposing capital punishment, an investigation officer was appointed to submit an investigation report. The investigation officer duly investigated and submitted a report, in which the allegations made against Yakub Hossain were proven. 

Considering the investigation report, the gravity of the crime and relevant matters, it was decided to impose compulsory retirement, capital punishment against Yakub Hossain as per sub-rule 3(b) of rule 4 of the Government Servants (Discipline and Appeal) Rules, 2018. In this context, the order of compulsory retirement has been implemented against him.

Headline_English: Instructions to extend time if necessary while taking HSC exams
Content_Enlish:
The Dhaka Secondary and Higher Secondary Education Board has issued instructions to extend the time if necessary during the HSC and equivalent examinations this year. 

The board has issued instructions to extend the time considering the students' concerns as rainfall and waterlogging have occurred in various places including Dhaka and Chittagong due to the weather conditions. The instructions were given in an urgent notification signed by Dhaka Education Board's Examination Controller Professor Md. Abul Bashar on Sunday. 

The notification mentioned, 'It is known from the Meteorological Department that there is a possibility of heavy rainfall in the next few days. If there is rain on the examination days, if necessary, the main gate of the center will be opened before the specified time and the examinees will be allowed to enter the center. If there is a delay of half an hour or an hour in starting the examination at any center due to unavoidable reasons, the matter has been requested to be taken into utmost urgent consideration to take necessary measures to finish the examination by adjusting the time by half an hour or an hour considering the emergency situation.' 

Meanwhile, Dhaka Education Board Chairman and Inter-Board Coordination Committee President Tapan Kumar Sarkar said that the weather forecast indicates a possibility of rainfall for the next five to seven days. Many students have been suffering due to rain and traffic jams since the exams started on Sunday. Therefore, taking into account the concerns of the candidates, an instruction has been given to give them extra time during the exams. In response to a question from journalists, he said that the candidates of the technical, madrasa and Sylhet board exams, which were postponed due to the floods, will get their exam routines in a day or two. 

It is worth noting that the HSC or equivalent exams started across the country except Sylhet at 10 am on Sunday. Due to rain and traffic jams in various parts of the country including the capital Dhaka, some candidates could not reach the exam centers on time. This caused hardship to many students.

Headline_English: Three train coaches derail in Bogra, rail communication with North Bengal suspended
Content_Enlish:
Three bogies of the Bonarpara-bound 'Four Ninety College Train', which left Santahar in Bogra, derailed. The train, including the engine, derailed before it reached Gabtoli railway station in Bogra at 8:40 pm on Sunday. 

All rail connections between Dhaka and North Bengal have been closed for about an hour and a half after the incident. Meanwhile, two trains, the 'Padmarag Express', which left Lalmonirhat-bound Santahar, and the 'Karatoa Express', which left Burimari-bound Santahar, are stuck at Gabtoli and Sukhanpukur stations. Hundreds of passengers have been suffering due to the long delay. 

Railway Engineering Department officials said that a rescue train has been called from Santahar to recover the derailed bogie. In this regard, there have been three train derailments on the Dhaka-Santahar-Lalmonirhat route in the past month. 

Bogra Railway Station Master Sajedur Rahman told Prothom Alo that although a rescue train was called from Santahar to rescue the derailed coach, the possibility of rail communication returning to normal before 1 am is very low. 

Meanwhile, due to the derailment of the coach, the departure of the intercity 'Burimari Express' train plying on the Burimari-Santahar-Dhaka route on the scheduled time has become uncertain. The intercity Burimari Express train, which left Burimari at 12 am, was supposed to reach Bogra Railway Station. 

Bogra Railway Station Master Sajedur Rahman told Prothom Alo that the 'Four Ninety College Train' bound for Bonarpara left Santahar for Lalmonirhat on the scheduled time. After the scheduled stop, the train passed Bogra Railway Station at 8:20 pm. After the train reached Gabtoli Railway Station, it was supposed to cross with the Padmarag Express bound for Santahar. But at 8:40 pm, three bogies of the train, including the engine, derailed before stopping at Gabtoli station. After receiving the railway signal message, the Padmarag Express and Karatoya Express trains were stopped at Gabtoli and Sukhanpukur stations. 

Ruel Miah, a passenger of the accident-hit train, told Prothom Alo on his mobile phone that he was going to Sonatala station along with others on the 491 UP local 'College Train' bound for Bonarpara in Gaibandha that left Santahar at night. At around 8:15 pm, the train suddenly derailed at Gabtoli station from line 1 to line 2 when the engine and three bogies derailed. At that time, passengers rushed to get off the train in panic, and some were injured. 

Rokon Mahmud, a student of Government Azizul Haque College, was going to Mahimaganj on the college train. He said he has been stuck at Gabtoli railway station since 9:45 pm. He has no idea when the line will be reopened. 

A source at the Bogra railway station said that after the college train derailment incident on Sunday, there have been three cases of derailment of moving trains on the Dhaka-Santahar-Lalmonirhat railway line in the last one month. 

Earlier, at 8:30 am on June 25, three coaches of a college train derailed near Sukhanpukur railway station in Gabtoli upazila of Bogra, disrupting rail communication for about three hours. 

In addition, at 2:45 pm on May 29, a coach of the Lalmonirhat-bound North Bengal Mail train leaving Santahar in Bogra derailed near Kahalu railway station, disrupting all rail communication between Dhaka and North Bengal for about two and a half hours.

Headline_English: How to transform yourself in six months
Content_Enlish:
Why do we want to change ourselves? The answer is simple - we want to reduce our bad sides as much as possible. But can we change ourselves suddenly? Can we change ourselves when we wake up in the morning? We can never change ourselves if we only want to change in our hearts. It is possible to bring positive changes in our lives by taking some time to understand ourselves better. Find out some tips to change yourself within six months today... Decide what you want to change 
Imagine that for the next six months, you will wake up early every morning. Then write it on a piece of paper and stick it in a place where you can see it every day. You will not be able to wake up early tomorrow morning. And even if you do, the interest may disappear the day after tomorrow. Decide what you will do after waking up in the morning. You can do light exercise. You can practice reading a book or magazine. You can take your child to school. You can take care of plants or pets. 

Organize your whole day 
If you want to bring positive changes in one aspect of your life, you need to organize your whole day in that way. You may wake up in the morning, but go through the day without taking any steps. Don't do this, make a complete plan. 

Find positive people 
It is quite difficult to change yourself alone. Find like-minded people or friends. Take their help. Avoid those who talk negatively. 

Give time to where you are interested 
Give time to the work you like to do. Give time to improve the quality of your work. Pay attention to how you can surpass yourself every day. If you surpass yourself by 1 every day, you will see positive changes in yourself after six months. 

Learn 
Learn something from everyone around you every day. Try to learn from your mistakes. Never think of yourself as small. Try to learn from everyone, big and small. Keep yourself busy in positive work by learning the old and new. 

Examine your mistakes 
I want to do well at work, practice. Memory also helps. And a lot can be learned by examining why various mistakes are made while working. A group of researchers in the United States has reported this information. A research report on this was published in the journal Science Express. The study was conducted by researchers at the Johns Hopkins University School of Medicine. They say that mistakes train the human brain to perform a task better. In addition, the brain also learns how to learn from mistakes quickly. Therefore, the repetition of the same mistake is usually less.

Headline_English: Maldives travel stories
Content_Enlish:
Put Maldives at the top of your travel list. I am sure you will thank me for the advice after your trip. Reader, this is not my point. The last few lines of Muhammad Fauzul Kabir Khan's very readable and excellently informative article in the opinion column titled 'The direction that politics and development of Maldives are taking' on May 27. 

Maldives is one of the most popular vacation spots for the world's wealthy people. Maldives, which is completely dependent on imports, is not a cheap tourist destination. Just a week ago, the information revealed in another excellent article titled 'How nature and sea-dependent Maldives are ahead of us' will undoubtedly arouse the desire to travel to Maldives in the minds of all readers. 

The truth is that once upon a time, traveling to Maldives was a top name on the list of millionaires or billionaires. Perhaps because of the Corona pandemic, Maldives has become somewhat accessible to our South Asian travel enthusiasts. 

During a five-day trip to the Maldives in mid-August 2022, after the end of the Corona pandemic, I realized how a country can use the tourism industry to earn foreign exchange in a planned manner. First of all, let me say that it was not known before traveling to the Maldives that the sea water could be so clear and clean with natural beauty. In addition to the natural beauty, anyone who visits the Maldives will understand that it is difficult to find a safer and more peaceful place to travel anywhere else. 

However, let's get back to the main topic. Our trip to the Maldives was aimed at overcoming the depression of the Corona period. So I am sharing some information about my experience of traveling to the Maldives two years ago. After traveling to the Maldives with a five-day, four-night package, I learned that the Corona pandemic was not that terrible for the Maldives. But due to Corona, hundreds of hotels, motels, resorts, villas, and countless travel-related institutions faced extreme disaster. 

At the end of 2021, various organizations including their government came forward with various plans to quickly bring back the lost business of the tourism industry. Due to the government coming forward with various incentives including many discounts, their booming tourism business gradually returned. Along with this, traveling to the Maldives became much easier for tourists from our country as a private airline of the country came forward with an affordable package. 

If you purchase a return ticket, you get free hotel accommodation in the Maldives for three days and two nights with buffet breakfast. The package price for a three-star or four-star hotel on Maafushi Island was 46 thousand taka. Along with this, if someone wanted, there was also the opportunity to stay longer with the package by paying additional hotel rent according to their wishes. To my knowledge, such packages are still in operation. However, due to the increase in the value of the dollar, the price of their packages has also increased a lot. 

Usually, when traveling with packages in other countries, various complaints are heard, but I have not heard or seen any such complaints in the Maldives. I have not seen anyone fall into the clutches of brokers or anyone. For on-arrival visa, if you enter the passenger information online on the website called Imuga a couple of days before the journey, you can get through the immigration of Male International Airport within a few minutes by showing the QR code on your mobile or a printed copy. As soon as you step outside, you will see hotel and motel representatives standing there with placards waiting to welcome the tourists. 

After understanding everything in a short time, it takes a maximum of 30-35 minutes to reach the designated hotel for tourists by taking a state-of-the-art speed board from the jetty adjacent to the airport. There is even no need to worry about luggage. The luggage and goods reach the hotel before the tourists reach the hotel under their supervision. When I traveled to the Maldives with my family, the dollar was worth 104 and 112 taka in the bank and open market, respectively. The Maldivian currency is more traded in dollars than in the rufiyaa. If you have rufiyaa in your hand at the end of the trip, it is better to spend it or exchange it before arriving at the airport. Because when it comes to shopping at the airport, dollars are more expensive than rufiyaas. 

The Maldives is making great use of how to earn foreign currency from the tourism industry. There are many organizations, including various event management companies, through which you can go deep sea and swim with sharks, play with stingrays or lotus leaf fish and dolphins, see corals under the sea, parasailing, scuba diving and many other event packages, which are 100% safe and risk-free. If you are lucky, you can also see huge whales on the way to participate in these events. These events, priced at 40-45 dollars per person, include everything you need, including going to the deep sea and back, lunch. 

You can roam around equally day and night. You will not see any police. But there is no risk. Being a 100% Muslim country, the shops and shops close as soon as the call to prayer is given. 

No matter if a tourist is a VIP or influential, there is no opportunity to show off their power. Everything is done according to the law. In short, everything is as transparent as blue water. If any of the tourists are interested in drinking hard drinks, there are separate rules for that too. Hard drinks cannot be drunk while sitting in any hotel or motel on the island. For that, you have to follow the specified time and rules and go on a specific ship kept in the middle of the sea. 

It is true that the Maldives, one of the world's tourist spots including Europe and America, is not a cheap tourist destination. So here is some information about the cost of the Maldives, which I traveled to two years ago. The price of a half-liter bottle of water in three-star and four-star hotels is one to three-four dollars depending on the quality. Again, in the local shops around, you can get an affordable five-liter bottle for 15 rufiyaa or one to three dollars. 

During our trip, we saw that the price of a can was five to six dollars—although it seemed like a nightmare for us, it was a hot favorite for Europeans or Americans. So they were more attracted to coconut water instead of water. Starting from the airport, hotels, motels, restaurants and shops, Bangladeshi brothers roam freely. There are many Bangladeshi food shops and restaurants where good food is available at affordable prices. So there is no fear of falling into the clutches of thugs while shopping due to strict laws and regulations. The land area of ​​Maldives and our Sandeep is 298 and 762 square kilometers respectively. Nature and salt water of the sea are the assets of Maldives. 28 percent of their total production and 60 percent of foreign exchange earnings come from the tourism sector. The next important sector is fisheries. 

But all this is also available in our country. So if Maldives can become a country with upper middle income, high human development index and low income inequality, where is the inability of our Bangladesh—shouldn't the relevant authorities think about that?

Headline_English: ChatGPT surprised people by passing the famous Turing test
Content_Enlish:
Since the launch of OpenAI's artificial intelligence (AI) technology ChatGPT, thousands of thoughts have been generated about the intelligence of humans and machines. ChatGPT recently surprised everyone by passing the famous 'Turing' test. A group of scientists are claiming that ChatGPT's intelligence has become equal to that of humans. Scientists claim that ChatGPT-4 is the first artificial intelligence that has passed the Turing test of two. In the test, ChatGPT fooled a human 54 percent of the time while talking to him. 

Computer scientist Alan Turing predicted that computers would one day achieve the same intelligence as humans. Turing proposed a special test to find out whether computers are capable of thinking. The Turing test, which has been in use since 1950, measures how effective artificial intelligence is. 

ChatGPT is the first AI to pass this test, which is famous for measuring intelligence. This test is basically used to find out whether a device or technology is truly intelligent or not. The test allows machines to talk to humans. The test is designed to determine whether humans are talking or machines. This test was designed to see whether computers have human-like intelligence. 

Scientists at the University of California, San Diego, USA, tested the ChatGPT 4 model. In general, in this test, a human questioner asks AI and another person various questions. The questioner does not know who is human and who is machine. If the AI ​​is able to answer the questioner like a human, the test is passed. The researchers gave 500 participants the opportunity to talk to 3 AIs and a human. The test was conducted with ChatGPT-4 and ChatGPT-3.5. At the same time, a chatbot named Eliza, created in 1960, also took part in the test. 500 participants had to find out who was AI and who was human. The participants were given the opportunity to talk for five minutes. 

The test showed that the participants recognized Eliza, an AI from the 1960s, 22 percent of the time. And ChatGPT-3.5 was able to carry on a conversation about 50 percent of the time. And the ChatGPT-4 model was considered human by the participants 54 percent of the time. 

Surprisingly, the participants considered real people to be human in 67 percent of the conversations. For the first time, a machine or AI has surpassed Alan Turing's imagination and passed the Turing test. Neil Watson, a researcher at the Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers (IEEE), said that machines can also make speculations. They can speak with reasoning like humans. AI can sometimes think like humans. 

Last February, researchers at Stanford University in the United States conducted the first Turing test on ChatGPT. ChatGPT's results were good in that test too.

Headline_English: 4 arrested in IFIC Bank theft of Tk 2.9 million in Bogra
Content_Enlish:
Four people have been arrested in a case of theft of Tk 29,40,000 by breaking open a safe at an IFIC Bank branch in Bogra. Police arrested four people from the capital's Dakshinkhan area on Monday along with a motorcycle bought with the stolen money and Tk 10,86,000 in cash. Bogra Superintendent of Police Sudip Kumar Chakraborty confirmed this information at a press conference held at his office on Tuesday. 

The arrested persons are Md. Jahidul Islam (29) of Boro Tengra village in Sadar upazila of Bogra, Md. Pavel (25) of Dakshin Atkaria in Sonatala upazila, Biplob Sarkar Mithun (28) of Talshan village in Adamdighi upazila and Bimal Rajbhar (30) of Singaria village in Fulchhari upazila of Gaibandha. The investigating officer of the case applied for a five-day remand to the Bogra Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate's Court for questioning the accused. The court has fixed June 27 for the hearing. 

At the press conference, Superintendent of Police Sudip Kumar Chakraborty said that among the accused accused through information technology, Md. Pavel was first arrested. Later, based on his confession, the remaining three were arrested. During the initial interrogation, the arrested persons said that Zahidul Islam was the main mastermind in the case of stealing money by breaking the bank safe. 

Citing the confessions of the accused, the Superintendent of Police said that before breaking the safe of the Matidali sub-branch office of IFIC Bank and stealing Tk 29 lakh 40 thousand, the accused gathered near the Matidali bridge of the Karatoya river on the Second Bypass Road at around 12:15 am. After going under the bank building, one of them observed the movements of the people around. Later, the party leader Zahidul Islam and others went up to the second floor of the building. Two of them waited outside wearing masks to observe the movements of the people. The others entered the building and stole Tk 29 lakh 40 thousand 618. Later, they divided the stolen money among themselves and went into hiding. Party leader Zahidul Islam bought a red motorcycle with the money he had taken from the bank. 

The Superintendent of Police said that 10 lakh 85 thousand 940 taka was recovered from the bank safe from the four arrested people. There are cases of theft and a drug case against the arrested accused. 

The Superintendent of Police said that party leader Zahidul used to come to the bank on various pretexts for a month in the thought of stealing money. He said that after the security system at the sub-branch was confirmed to be weak, he planned to break the safe and steal the money. After the arrest, 1 lakh 1 thousand 770 taka was recovered from Pavel, 2 lakh 93 thousand 220 taka from Bimal, 1 lakh 91 thousand 250 taka from Mithun and 5 lakh taka from Zahidul, in addition to the motorcycle bought with the money taken from the bank. 

Sometime on the night of June 12, an incident occurred in which 29 lakh 40 thousand taka was stolen by breaking the safe at the IFIC Bank sub-branch office located on the second floor of a building in the Matidali area of ​​​​Bogra suburb. The next day, Nazrul Islam, the manager of the customer service department of the bank's Bogra branch, filed a case with Bogra Sadar Police Station, accusing unknown individuals.

Headline_English: Former Georgian Prime Minister announces Tk 125 crore reward for Ronaldo's defeat of Portugal
Content_Enlish:
Georgia is playing in the Euro Championship for the first time. And for the first time, the Eastern European country surprised Portugal by defeating it. The Georgian people are very excited about the 2-0 victory over a team built around superstars like Cristiano Ronaldo. The country's former prime minister and billionaire Bidzina Ivanishvili has announced a large cash prize. 

Describing Georgia's victory over former Euro champions Portugal as "historic and a dream", Ivanishvili has announced a reward of 30 million Georgian lari for the players and coaching staff, which is more than 125 million 49 million taka in Bangladeshi currency. He has also promised another 125 million taka if Georgia can beat Spain in the last 16. 

Ivanishvili, 68, is the founder of Georgia's ruling Dream Party. He became the country's prime minister the year after founding the party in 2011. However, he handed over the responsibility to his successor a year later. However, he is still widely considered influential in Georgia's ruling power. 

He became a billionaire in the 1990s by investing in the banking, computer and iron sectors in Russia. According to the business magazine Forbes, Ivanishvili is worth $4.9 billion. 

Georgia finished third in Group F after beating Portugal 2-0 in Germany on Wednesday. Georgia also qualified for the knockout stage as one of the third-best teams in the group stage. After the victory, many members of parliament from the ruling party appeared in the Georgian parliament on Thursday wearing the jerseys of the national football team, and several sang the football team's anthem. 

The Georgian Dream Party said in a statement that the party's honorary chairman Ivanishvili congratulated them on their victory over Portugal. In recognition of the historic and dream victory, the charitable foundation will provide 30 million Georgian lari to the team's players and coaching staff. The same amount will be paid even if they lose to Spain in the last 16. 

Georgia, ranked 74th in FIFA rankings, will play against Spain, ranked 8th and former Euro champions, on Sunday.

Headline_English: Presidential election in Iran
Content_Enlish:
The country is holding snap elections after Iranian President Ebrahim Raisi was killed in a helicopter crash last month. Iran was scheduled to hold presidential elections in June next year. That is, the vote would have been held at the end of the incumbent president's four-year term. Voting in Iran's presidential election began at 8 a.m. local time on Friday. Voting will continue until 6 p.m. People of all ages came to vote at polling stations. 
Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei waves his hand as he casts his vote in the presidential election in Tehran

Headline_English: A young man was shot, another suffered a cut in a dispute over a football game
Content_Enlish:
A youth was injured in a gunshot wound in a clash over a football match in Kanchihata village of Amanullahpur union in Begumganj upazila of Noakhali. Another youth had his leg cut. These incidents took place in the village's Hawladar Bari area on Friday night and Saturday afternoon. 

The youth injured in the gunshot wound is Shahadat Hossain (20). He was hit by a gunshot wound in his left leg. Belal Hossain (22) had his leg cut. His right leg was cut. 

Local residents said that Shahadat, who was injured in the gunshot wound, is a Chhatra League activist and Belal, who was injured in the leg cut, is associated with Chhatra Shibir politics. Tension has been prevailing between the leaders and activists of the two organizations in the area since the incident. 

It was learned from talking to locals that Shahadat Hossain was shot at around 10 pm yesterday due to a dispute over a football match. After this incident, Belal Hossain's house was attacked this afternoon. At one point, the attackers cut his right leg with a sharp weapon. His house was also extensively vandalized during the attack. 

Among the injured, Belal Hossain was transferred to Dhaka Medical College Hospital after receiving treatment at two local hospitals. However, it was not confirmed where Shahadat Hossain received treatment. 

Jahangir Alam, a member of Ward No. 1 of Amanullahpur Union Parishad (UP) told Prothom Alo that he went to the scene after receiving news of an attack on Belal's house. At that time, he saw 10-12 youths with firearms and tried to stop them. However, the attackers pushed him away. 

UP Chairman Baharul Alam told Prothom Alo that although they identified themselves as Shibir and Chhatra League, everyone on both sides was actually a member of a youth gang. 

Anwarul Islam, officer-in-charge of Begumganj Police Station, told Prothom Alo that a police team visited the scene after receiving news that two youths were injured in the exchange of fire. However, no one could be arrested. No one filed a written complaint with the police station in this incident.

Headline_English: Toofan is releasing in India, date announced
Content_Enlish:
'Tufan' is still running at a stormy pace in Bangladesh. The film has received a good response in the theaters. Everyone is shouting the victory of Shakib-Chanchal-Mimi-Nabilad. Now India is going to see the power of Tufan. It is going to be released in the theaters of that country on July 5. 
And this announcement was made by the country's extremely popular film critic, journalist, editor and film trade analyst Taran Adarsh. He is well known for his information and analysis on Bollywood movies. The release date of Tufan in India was known from Taran's post on social media. 
On Saturday, Taran shared the poster of the film 'Tufan' on his social handle. He wrote in the caption, Bangladesh's superhit film 'Tufan' is releasing in India on July 5. He also mentioned the names of Shakib Khan and other actors in the film in the hashtag. 
From Taran's post, it is assumed that Tufan is being released not only in West Bengal, but all over India. SVF is the distributor of the film in India. Earlier, the production company had also hinted that the film could be released in several languages ​​besides Bengali in India. 

Raihan Rafi's 'Toofan' was released in over a hundred theaters in Bangladesh during Eid. Recently, the production company and producers said that the film earned around 25 crore taka in Bangladesh within 10 days of its release! Now let's see how the highly acclaimed big-budget film Toofan is doing in India.

Headline_English: Switzerland knocks out defending champion Italy to reach quarterfinals
Content_Enlish:
Italy 0:2 Switzerland 
Since 1993, Switzerland has never beaten Italy. Italy in 2004 never stopped before the quarter-finals of the Euro. Today, two histories were written anew in Berlin, Germany. Switzerland defeated the current Euro champions Italy 2-0 and eliminated them from the last 16. 

For the first time in their football history, Switzerland reached the quarter-finals of a major tournament (World Cup and Euro) without a tiebreaker. The two goals that brought the historic victory were scored by Remo Freler and Ruben Vargas. Italy managed to put only one shot on target in the entire ninety minutes. 

Italy played a little in the second half of the match. Luciano Spalletti's team could not be found in the first 45 minutes. If Gianluigi Donnarumma had not put up a resistance in front of goal, the team could have conceded more than one goal in that time. 
In the meantime, Embolo denied Reider a goal in the 24th minute and Donnarumma denied him a goal just before the break. In the meantime, the Swiss scored their first goal in the 37th minute. Donnarumma tried to block Nottingham Forest midfielder Freler's powerful shot with his foot. The ball hit his foot, but it didn't change direction much and went into the net. 
Switzerland scored their second goal 27 seconds into the second half. The Italian goalkeeper could not stop Vargas's corner shot from outside the box despite his best efforts. 

After conceding two goals, Italy recovered somewhat and started attacking football. But Gianluca Samaka and Federico Chiesa were unable to break through Switzerland's solid defense. 

In the end, the Euro 2020 champions had to leave the field with a defeat. Switzerland beat Italy 11 matches and 31 years after losing 1-0 in a World Cup qualifier in 1993. And two decades later, Italy was eliminated before the quarter-finals of the continental tournament.

Headline_English: Former Bangladeshi-origin husband and wife face off in same seat in UK
Content_Enlish:
Apsana Begum, a Bangladeshi-origin woman, has been elected as a Labour MP in the Bangladeshi-dominated Poplar and Limehouse constituency in the upcoming UK general election. Her ex-husband Ehteshamul Haque is contesting from this seat in east London. She is running as an independent candidate. 

Apsana Begum's father is Monir Uddin Ahmed, a former councillor of Tower Hamlets Council. Apsana married Ehteshamul Haque, a former councillor of Tower Hamlets, in 2013. The couple's village is in Jagannathpur upazila of Sunamganj. They divorced in 2015, two years after their marriage. 

Apsana was first elected as a Member of Parliament in 2019. She then served as the chair of the British Parliament's All-Party Parliamentary Committee on Domestic Violence and Torture. 

Eight candidates are contesting the Poplar and Limehouse constituency. Regarding contesting the election with his ex-wife, Ehteshamul Haque told Prothom Alo, ‘I got married again about six years ago. I have no personal objections to Apsana. Even after the separation, I worked with her in the party for three years. I respect her. She (Apsana) can contest from any constituency.’ 

Although attempts were made to contact Apsana Begum, it was not possible to talk to her due to her election busyness. 

It is worth noting that the UK national election is on July 4. 34 candidates of Bangladeshi origin are contesting for the post of Member of Parliament. Nine of them are women. Among them, six women nominated by the Labour Party are far ahead in the race to become MPs.

Headline_English: Enjoy the Messi-Di Maria finale to the fullest.
Content_Enlish:
Lionel Messi or Angel Di Maria, no matter who you talk about, are they outside the cosmic laws! 

Everything has an end, there is a matter of completing the cycle—what is the other way but to accept this simple truth! The sun that shows its fierce power at midday, loses its shine again at dusk. It sets in the hollow of the evening. As the British poet John Keats wrote—even the most vigorous youth one day turns pale, becomes sick and finally perishes... Even the beauty that spreads intense light does not remain bright forever, it fades in time. 

So let's enjoy the end of the two superstars to the fullest! Which starts from tomorrow morning. The possible end of Messi-Di Maria in the Argentine jersey is starting with the match against Canada at 6 am Bangladesh time. 
Stars also fall one day. Even the mighty king has to leave the kingdom one day and go to rest one day. Messi and Di Maria will also have to accept this fate. They have ruled the football world with great power for two decades, now they are at the end of their lives. They too will have to take a break, leave the palace and say goodbye. 

The farewell bugle of the two great heroes of Argentina and world football has started to sound in the football world. Both are 36 years old, Messi will turn 37 in three days. Their careers are now in the twilight. In this twilight of their careers, are Messi and Di Maria in the same state of mind as the father of the bride! You can hear the melody of the song in your ears. The melody that simultaneously mixes the joy of the daughter's wedding and the cries of the bride's farewell. 

The question repeatedly arises in their minds - will Messi be seen in another World Cup or will Di Maria play for Argentina in the Paris Olympics? The fans hope that they will see their beloved two stars on the field for a few more days! 
Di Maria has already announced that this year's Copa America will be his last in the Argentina jersey. Messi has been asked many times after the 2022 Qatar World Cup whether he will play another World Cup in 2026. One of the best players in football history has not said anything directly in response to this question. However, he has repeatedly reminded us that age is a factor. Even if he wants to play more in the Argentina jersey, age can be an obstacle! 

As mentioned at the beginning of that article, even the sun at noon loses its shine and sets. This is the law of the world. Does this rule make Messi or Di Maria feel any pain in their hearts when they say goodbye to the decorated palace, the love of football? 
Copa America, La Finalisima, World Cup, Champions League - Messi and Di Maria's careers, which have won all the best team awards possible in one life, are complete in one word. Messi has already said that the career cycle will be completed by winning the 2022 Qatar World Cup. He has no other requests from the football god. Di Maria is the same. So they should not have any regrets or pain about leaving. 

Even if Messi and Di Maria do not have them, their fans will still have them. Is it so easy to suppress the pain of not seeing the person they love in front of their eyes? That is why the question repeatedly arises in their minds - will Messi be seen in another World Cup or will Di Maria play for Argentina in the Paris Olympics? Fans hope that their two favorite stars will be seen on the field for a few more days! 

Along with that hope, fans may be thinking about the various magical moments shown by their favorite stars on the field. Perhaps the scene of Messi celebrating with both hands to both ears in front of Netherlands coach Louis van Gaal at the Qatar World Cup is floating in the corner of their minds. Messi's double goal and Di Maria's goal against France in the Qatar World Cup final are floating in the mind. The scene of Messi celebrating his goal with both hands raised in the air and Di Maria celebrating his goal with both hands is floating. 

Argentina coach Lionel Scaloni seems to have been able to feel the fans' hearts' cries for Messi and Di Maria. That is why, at the start of another tournament, he gave a piece of advice to Messi and Di Maria's fans - do not be disappointed by the departure of the two superstars, but enjoy their magical football one last time. Enjoy the beauty of Messi-Di Maria's football to the fullest. 

Scaloni is right. These magical moments of Messi-Di Maria painted on the green canvas of the field are eternal. One day they will leave, they will no longer be seen painting dreams on the green of the field. But the dreams they have painted for two decades will remain forever. So let's enjoy the end of the two superstars to the fullest! Which starts tomorrow morning. The match against Canada at 6 am Bangladesh time marks the beginning of the possible end for Messi and Di Maria in the Argentina jersey.

Headline_English: Putin is also strengthening relations with Vietnam
Content_Enlish:
Western countries are trying to isolate Russia over the Ukraine war. In response, Russian President Vladimir Putin has begun a tour of allies. Putin arrived in ally Vietnam on a state visit on Thursday. During his visit, Vietnam and Russia pledged to further strengthen ties. 

Vietnam and Russia have had close ties since the Cold War. Putin went to Hanoi after meeting with North Korean leader Kim Jong-un, promising full support for Ukraine and signing a defense agreement. There, Vietnamese President To Lam hinted at increasing defense cooperation between the two countries. 

After talks with Putin, Lam told reporters that the two sides want to increase defense and security cooperation to address unconventional security challenges based on international law and to promote peace and security in the region and the world. 

Moscow has been Vietnam's main arms supplier for decades. From 1995 to 2023, Russia supplied 80 percent of Vietnam's weapons. But international sanctions have slowed down orders recently. 

Lam and Putin have signed more than a dozen cooperation agreements. The agreements cover a range of issues, from education to justice and civil nuclear projects. 

Putin said their talks were constructive. The two sides have similar or similar positions on key international issues. He added that they discussed the principle of building an adequate and reliable security framework in the Asia-Pacific region without the use of force and resolving differences peacefully. 

Last week, the United States, the United Kingdom and the European Union imposed new sanctions on Russia at the G-7 summit of wealthy countries. They also agreed to provide loans to Ukraine from Russia's seized assets.

Headline_English: Myanmar junta accused of violating ceasefire agreement
Content_Enlish:
The Three Brotherhood Alliance, an alliance of ethnic armed rebel groups in Myanmar, has accused the junta government of repeatedly violating the ceasefire agreement. The alliance members claim that despite a ceasefire agreement brokered by China, the military (junta) has repeatedly launched attacks in the northern part of the country this month. Many civilians have been killed in this. 

The Tang National Liberation Army (TNLA), a member of the Three Brotherhood Alliance, posted a statement on the alliance's Telegram channel. It said that junta troops carried out an airstrike on the TNLA-controlled town of Moga on Wednesday. One civilian was killed in the incident. Three others, including a 10-year-old child, were injured. 

The group also claimed that a TNLA member was killed and four others were injured in a military drone strike on Tuesday. They said that their bases were also shelled and road communications were cut off. As a result, the supply of goods to the cities controlled by the group is being disrupted. These attacks were the latest in a series of ceasefire violations by the junta military. 

On February 1, 2021, Suu Kyi's elected government was ousted in a military coup in Myanmar. Immediately after seizing power, mass protests began against the junta government in Myanmar. The junta government used military force to suppress the mass protests. This led to an armed rebellion against the junta government in Myanmar. At one stage, the country's ethnic armed groups formed an alliance. This alliance, called the Three Brotherhood Alliance, includes the Arakan Army (AA), the Myanmar National Democratic Alliance Army (MNDAA), and the Taung National Liberation Army (TNLA). 

In October 2023, this alliance launched a major operation against the military junta. They carried out surprise raids in northern Myanmar and captured several cities and some commercial centers along the border with China. They carried out this attack mainly with the aim of crippling and cornering the junta government economically. 

More than 500,000 people have been displaced by months of violence between the military junta and this alliance. In order to resolve this crisis, a ceasefire agreement was signed between the military junta and the Three Brotherhood Alliance in January of this year under the mediation of China. As a result of the agreement, the alliance was allowed to control the occupied territory in Shan State in northern Myanmar. 

Meanwhile, after the conflict in Shan State subsided somewhat, Rakhine became heated. The Arakan Army (AA) became violent in this western state. According to them, this fight is to demand more autonomy for the Rakhine people. In the meantime, they have taken control of the border areas of India and Bangladesh in Rakhine. 

China organized peace talks in the city of Kunming last month as a continuation of the ceasefire agreement between the Myanmar military and the Three Brotherhood Alliance. A source close to the MNDAA told AFP that there had been no significant progress in the talks. The two sides will meet again in the future to resolve the crisis. 

Meanwhile, the ongoing unrest in the country has had a negative impact on trade, especially in border trade. A junta-controlled media outlet reported last week that Myanmar's border trade with China fell by almost a third in April-May compared to the same period last year. 

Myanmar's border areas are home to the majority of ethnic armed groups. These rebel groups have been fighting the military junta for autonomy and rights to resources since independence from Britain in 1948.

Headline_English: Farmer dies after being bitten by Russell's viper in Faridpur, two more snakes beaten to death
Content_Enlish:
A farmer named Hossain Bepari (50) died after being bitten by a poisonous Russell's viper in a remote char in North Channel Union of Faridpur Sadar. The snake bit him around noon yesterday Thursday. He died while undergoing treatment at Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujib Medical College Hospital in Faridpur around 11 am today, Friday. In addition, villagers beat him to death after seeing two Russell's vipers in two days in the neighboring Char Union of Decree. 

Hossain Bepari, who died after being bitten by a Russell's viper, is the son of Paresh Ullah Bepari of Ward No. 2 of North Channel Union of the upazila. Helal Uddin, a former UP member of that ward, said that Hossain Bepari was bitten by a Russell's viper around noon yesterday. He was quickly taken to Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujib Medical College Hospital in Faridpur by trawler across the Padma River. As his condition did not improve, preparations were underway to take him to Dhaka. He died before that at around 11 am today. 

Meanwhile, a farmer named Murad Molla (45) saw a Russell's viper while working in the field in Char Dholai of North Channel Union around 12 noon today. He is a resident of Dangi village of Aiz Uddin Matubbar in Char Union of Decree. Later, he beat the snake and brought it to the C&B Ghat area. 

Murad Molla said, "The snake came to my attention while working in the almond field. Then I brought a stick and beat three or four houses to kill the snake." 

Apart from this, Mehedi Hasan, Chairman of Char UP of Decree, confirmed the killing of another Russell's viper in the same union. He said, yesterday afternoon, the locals beat a Russell's viper near the Padma River in the C&B Ghat area of ​​the union. 

Yesterday, District Awami League General Secretary Shah Md. At a preparatory meeting on the occasion of the founding anniversary of the Ishtiaq party, he announced a reward for killing a Russell viper, citing the concerns of the people of the Char region over the nuisance of Russell's viper. He said that if someone can kill a Russell's viper, he will be given 50,000 taka. This reward will be given for every snake killed. 
This announcement by the District Awami League General Secretary was a clear violation of the Wildlife Conservation and Safety Act enacted in 2012. The act states that killing any reptile (snake) animal is a punishable offense. 

Shah Md. Ishtiaq changed his position and told Prothom Alo this afternoon that when he made the announcement, he was not aware of the relevant law. Moreover, it was not an open public meeting, but a domestic gathering of the District Awami League executive committee. However, an embarrassing situation has been created as this matter has gone viral on social media. He also said that a press release will be issued explaining the statement. It will be stated that this reward will be given if the Russell's Viper is captured alive and handed over to the Forest Department.

Headline_English: Aamir's son's film finally released, leaving controversy behind
Content_Enlish:
Aamir Khan's son Junaid Khan was supposed to make his Bollywood debut through OTT. His web film 'Maharaj' was supposed to be released on Netflix last Friday. 

But the release of the film was ultimately stuck in legal complications. Good news for fans, the film has finally been released. According to Hindustan Times 
The film was stuck in the stay order of the Gujarat High Court. Finally, the notice of the stay has been lifted. The production company Yash Raj Films issued a statement and thanked the Gujarat High Court. 

The stay order was issued on the basis of a petition filed by an Indian religious organization. 
The organization approached the High Court fearing that this film, which is based on the Maharaj Libel Case of 1862, could create a rift in public order and even incite violence against the followers of this community. 

The petition alleged that the film contains hateful comments against Lord Krishna and devotional songs about him. The complaint also alleged that the makers are planning to release the film without doing much promotional work including a trailer. 
Junaid is seen playing the role of journalist and social reformer Karsandas Mulji in the film 'Maharaj'.

Headline_English: India-Bangladesh Bengali Film Festival begins in Kolkata
Content_Enlish:
Organized by the Bidhannagar Film Society and Fazlul Haque Mani Smriti Sangsad of West Bengal and the Purbanchal branch of the Federation of Film Societies of Kolkata, the three-day India-Bangladesh Film Festival has begun in Kolkata. 
Renowned film director Gautam Ghosh inaugurated the film festival yesterday afternoon at the Purbanchal Cultural Center auditorium in Bidhannagar, Kolkata. The opening film on Friday was Gautam Ghosh's 'Gangchil'. The film is a joint production of India and Bangladesh. Apart from this, Kolkata's Amitabh Chatterjee's film 'Manohar and I' was also screened yesterday. 
Six films from Bangladesh and India will be screened in the festival. Bangladeshi director Afzal Hossain's 'Mawa Te Hawa' and Kolkata's Devdoot Ghosh's film 'Adar' were screened on Saturday. And tomorrow, Sunday, West Bengal filmmaker Sharmistha Maiti's film 'Kalaksh' and Bangladeshi director Muhammad Qayyum's film 'Kura Pakshir Shunne Uda' will be shown. 
Inaugurating the film festival on Friday, Gautam Ghosh said, 'This film festival will further enrich the cultural arena of our two countries. We have to move forward by making more new Bengali films using the own language of cinema. Bidhannagar Film Society Secretary Ritesh Basak, film director Amitabh Chatterjee, Fazlul Haque Mani Cultural Society Secretary Professor Emanul Haque and others spoke at the opening ceremony. Music was performed at the opening ceremony by artists from Chhayanaut, Rabindranath Ghosh Bachik Shilpi Sangsad, Bahar Sur Jhanjha and Gaaner Tari Sangathan.

Headline_English: Bumrah is India's 'Reserve Bank', says Irfan Pathan
Content_Enlish:
Jasprit Bumrah has been the main weapon in India's pace bowling for a long time. He has been proving it in this T20 World Cup as well. Bumrah's bowling (3 wickets for 14 runs) helped India win against Pakistan in the group stage with a very low total. And in the Super Eights, he took 3 wickets for 7 runs against Afghanistan. In total, he has taken 10 wickets in 5 matches. 

Irfan Pathan, happy with the performance of the 30-year-old Bumrah in the World Cup, gave him a great compliment. According to the former Indian pacer, Bumrah's role in the team is a lot like the central bank. Bumrah is the 'Reserve Bank of India' of the Indian cricket team. 
Irfan Pathan explained it to Star Sports this way, 'He is a lot like the "Reserve Bank" of India. He can be used at any time. In any situation, you can close your eyes and trust his 4 overs. Bumrah sets the pace of the match with his bowling. 

Irfan's comments on Bumrah's performance in the match against Afghanistan, "Arshdeep gave 12 runs in the first over. Afghanistan's batting got momentum from that. But Bumrah came in the second over and established his authority as soon as possible. The pace of the bowling was also set with 6 slower balls. No one in world cricket can do this better than Bumrah." 
Irfan's observations on Bumrah's bowling, "Bumrah bowls great lengths. You can understand that if you watch the pitch match. He uses the slower. He uses the bouncer only when it is needed." 
Irfan is very excited about Bumrah's bowling towards the end of the innings, "Bumrah's overs towards the end of the innings are great. This is a great aspect of this T20 World Cup. If India can win the World Cup, then these overs from Bumrah will be a very important part. 

India's next match in the Super Eights is against Australia tomorrow.

Headline_English: Travel ban lifted in Tanguar Haor as flood situation improves
Content_Enlish:
As the overall flood situation has improved, tourist centers including Tanguar Haor in Tahirpur Upazila of Sunamganj have been opened to the public. Upazila Nirbahi Officer (UNO) Salma Parveen confirmed this information to Prothom Alo on Sunday. 

Flood situation has been prevailing in Sunamganj since June 16. The river water has been receding since last Friday. After that, the overall flood situation is improving. 

Due to the deterioration of the flood situation, a ban has been imposed on travel to Tanguar Haor, one of the country's tourist centers, from June 18. At the same time, it was announced that tourists will not be able to visit Shaheed Siraj (Niladri) Lake, Jadukata River and Shimul Bagan in Tahirpur Upazila of the district. 

Yesterday, Saturday afternoon, the water of the Surma River at Shologhar Point in Sunamganj Municipality has dropped below the danger level. However, there is still water in numerous houses and roads in the district. There are still people in shelters. 
According to the Water Development Board, at 3 pm today, the water level of the Surma River in the Sholaghar area of ​​​​Sunamganj Municipality was 7.54 meters. The water level of the Surma River here is now 26 centimeters below the danger level. Sunamganj has received 2 millimeters of rain in the last 24 hours. 

According to the district administration, 1,018 villages in 12 upazilas of Sunamganj were flooded due to the flood. About eight lakh people were trapped in the water. About 25,000 families took shelter in 541 shelters. About 12,000 people were in the shelters until 10 am today. Many people are leaving the shelters and returning to their homes as the water recedes.

Headline_English: Just vote for me this time: Trump
Content_Enlish:
Former US President Donald Trump urged his Christian and black supporters to vote again in two speeches in Philadelphia on Saturday. He promised black voters to fix the city devastated by bloodshed. 

Donald Trump is campaigning as the Republican Party candidate in the US presidential election in November. On Saturday, Trump told thousands of supporters at Temple University in Philadelphia that he would give police immunity for their actions and increase government budgets for cities struggling with violence. 

Trump claimed that the US FBI's report that violent crime and murders had decreased in the first three months of this year was false. He said that Democratic Party President Joe Biden is presenting false information. 

Trump also told supporters in Philadelphia, "The cities of brotherly love under Crooked Joe Biden have been devastated by bloodshed and crime." Under the Trump administration, we are going to restore order and safety to the streets. 

Trump gave a long speech in Philadelphia on crime prevention to appeal to black and Hispanic voters. Trump's campaign camp is already happy with the news that Trump is popular among black and Hispanic voters in several opinion polls. However, Trump, as always, highlighted illegal immigration as a problem in his speech. Without providing any evidence, he said that illegal immigrants are taking away jobs from black and Hispanics. For this, he blamed Joe Biden. He said that Biden has caused this disaster by opening the border. 

Philadelphia and Pennsylvania are known as swing states. Trump's supporters in Philadelphia are relatively few. Biden won here easily in the 2020 presidential election. This time Trump wants to challenge Biden here. 

Meanwhile, Trump will face Biden in a debate organized by the American media CNN in Atlanta next Thursday. Trump told reporters before the start of his campaign in Philadelphia that he had already decided who he would choose as his running mate or vice president. He could be at the debate. 

Earlier Saturday morning, Trump urged him to vote one last time at an event organized by the Faith and Freedom Coalition, a conservative Christian organization. "Christians go to church. But they don't vote as much. If you vote, you will realize your power. You have to come out to vote. Just like this time. You won't have to vote for four years."

Headline_English: Patient allegedly dies during surgery led by office assistant
Content_Enlish:
A patient named Maidan Ali (52) died during a surgery at a diagnostic center in Sribardi upazila of Sherpur. The incident took place at the Unique Diagnostic Center in the Chowrasta More area of ​​Sribardi municipality on Saturday afternoon. The deceased patient Maidan Ali's home is in Mamdamari village of Khariakajirchar union of the upazila. 

Maidan Ali's son Mostafa Kamal has filed a murder case with Sribardi police station against 7 people, including Upazila Health Complex office assistant Mehedi Hasan Shahin and 4 owners of the diagnostic center, on charges of involvement in the incident on Sunday. Sribardi police station arrested two people named Jewel and Tamim on Sunday morning. They are employees of the Unique Diagnostic Center. The two arrested were sent to the district jail on the orders of the court of Sherpur Senior Judicial Magistrate Nur-e-Zahid on Sunday afternoon. 

According to the police and the case report, on Saturday afternoon, Maidan Ali of Mamdamari village of the upazila went to the Sribardi Upazila Health Complex for treatment of a boil (tumor-shaped) on the lower part of his left armpit (next to the chest). Since the matter was complicated, the doctor on duty of the hospital's emergency department advised him (Maidan Ali) to go to Sherpur District Sadar Hospital. At that time, Mehedi Hasan, the office assistant of the Upazila Health Complex, and a gang of brokers misled Maidan Ali and took him to the Unique Diagnostic Center in the intersection area of ​​the municipal town near the hospital. 

Later, they agreed to perform surgery on Maidan Ali's boil for Tk 5,000 with the patient and his relatives. Then, Mehedi Hasan, the office assistant of the health complex, started operating on the boil of patient Maidan Ali inside the diagnostic center. At that time, Maidan Ali died. Seeing the situation as hopeless, Mehedi Hasan and the owners of the diagnostic center quickly fled. Upon receiving the news, the Sribardi Police Station went to the scene and recovered the body of the deceased Maidan Ali. Later, on Sunday morning, they prepared a post-mortem report and sent the body to the District Sadar Hospital morgue for an autopsy. The autopsy was conducted on Sunday afternoon. 

Since he is absconding, it was not possible to talk to Mehedi Hasan Shaheen, the office assistant of Sribardi Upazila Health Complex, and the people from the diagnostic center's owner about this allegation. 

Maidan Mia's cousin Abdur Rashid said that Maidan Ali had gone to the hospital for treatment. At that time, some brokers took him to the Unique Diagnostic Center. Later, he died during surgery. He demanded justice for those involved in the incident. 

Officer-in-charge of Sribardi Police Station Qayyum Khan Siddiqui told Prothom Alo on Sunday afternoon that although the Unique Diagnostic Center is a diagnostic institution, surgery was not permitted here. The police's initial investigation found the truth of the allegation. Jewel and Tamim, the accused in the case, have been arrested. Efforts are ongoing to arrest Mehedi Hasan and other accused. The police are seriously investigating the incident.

Headline_English: Italy interested in selling weapons to Bangladesh
Content_Enlish:
Italy is interested in selling various types of weapons and military equipment to Bangladesh, including fighter jets, satellites, patrol ships. The European country wants to sign a defense agreement with Bangladesh to smooth the way for weapons sales. The issue may gain importance in the foreign secretary-level talks between the two countries to be held in Dhaka on Monday. 

Foreign Ministry officials said that the second political consultative meeting of the two countries will be held at the Foreign Ministry on Monday afternoon. The meeting will be led by Foreign Secretary Masud Bin Momen on behalf of Bangladesh and Secretary General of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation Riccardo Guariglia on behalf of Italy. 

Last month, Italian Ambassador Antonio Alessandro paid a courtesy call on Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina at Ganabhaban. At that time, he told the Prime Minister that his country is interested in selling weapons and transferring technology to modernize Bangladesh's armed forces. Italy is also prepared to provide Bangladesh with a second satellite. 

Diplomatic sources said that the agenda of the meeting of the foreign secretaries of the two countries to be held in Dhaka on Monday includes issues such as political cooperation, trade, investment, defense, migration, satellite technology, information and communication technology, and cyber security. 

When asked about defense cooperation, a senior official concerned told Prothom Alo that Italy had proposed signing a memorandum of understanding (MOU) on cooperation in the defense sector several years ago. The country is quite interested in this matter. In terms of cooperation with Bangladesh, Italy has been giving special importance to the issue of defense in recent years. 

According to various sources, Italy is interested in selling various types of equipment to the Bangladesh Air Force and Navy. Thales Alenia, a joint venture of France's Thales and Italy's Leonardo, has shown interest in selling a second satellite to Bangladesh. In addition to aircraft, Leonardo, a security and aerospace manufacturer, is talking about aircraft maintenance and technology transfer. And the Italian shipbuilding company has offered to transfer technology in addition to selling coastal patrol ships. 

However, several officials of the Foreign Ministry told Prothom Alo that no new projects are being taken up at the moment due to financial reasons including the crisis in reserves. In such a situation, no final decision will be made on Italy's weapons at the moment. And since several procedural issues regarding the defense MoU are unfinished, it will not be signed right away. 

Officials in Dhaka say that the issue of safe and orderly migration in sending Bangladeshi workers will be important among various issues in this meeting between the two countries. Italy gave Bangladesh a draft of a memorandum of understanding in February this year to start safe migration between the two countries. That draft will be discussed this time. 

It is learned that the Rohingya crisis due to the deteriorating internal situation in Myanmar will be discussed during the meeting between the foreign secretaries of the two countries. A part of the Italian delegation will visit Cox's Bazar after the meeting.

Headline_English: This time 550 Hajj pilgrims die in Saudi Arabia, 323 of them are Egyptians
Content_Enlish:
More than 550 people have died from heatstroke during the holy Hajj pilgrimage. Of them, 323 are Egyptians and 60 are Jordanians. All but one of the Egyptians died from heatstroke. The other died in a stampede. Diplomats from the countries concerned have confirmed the matter. The Guardian reports. 

Meanwhile, AFP reported that the death toll had risen to 577 as of Wednesday. Diplomats said that 550 bodies had been kept at Al-Muaisem morgue, one of the largest in Mecca. This time, the temperature exceeded 51 degrees Celsius during the Hajj. Saudi Arabian authorities faced extreme challenges in completing this year's Hajj due to the intense heat wave. 

Last Sunday, Saudi authorities said that more than 2,000 pilgrims had been hospitalized. But they did not update this figure until Wednesday. At the same time, they did not provide information about the deaths. 

Temperatures are increasing dramatically due to climate change. A Saudi study published last month found that temperatures in areas where the hajj pilgrimage is held are rising by 0.4 degrees Celsius every 10 years. 

The temperature at Mecca's Grand Mosque on Monday was 51.8 degrees Celsius, according to the Saudi National Meteorological Center. 

Meanwhile, pilgrims were seen pouring water from bottles on their heads to cool off from the intense heat in Mina outside Mecca on Monday. Volunteers also distributed cold water, soft drinks and chocolate ice cream among them. 

Last year, at least 240 pilgrims from various countries died. Most of them were Indonesians.

Headline_English: Kim fully supports Russia's war in Ukraine, Putin expresses gratitude
Content_Enlish:
North Korea fully supports Russia's war in Ukraine, which has been going on for more than two years. President Kim Jong Un made this clear during Russian leader Vladimir Putin's visit to Pyongyang. Meanwhile, Putin thanked the King for supporting Moscow's war. BBC News. 

Kim and Putin held formal talks after a welcoming ceremony after arriving in Pyongyang on Wednesday morning local time. They made these remarks at the time. 

Kim said, 'North Korea fully supports Russia's campaign in Ukraine.' Earlier, Kim had said that both countries were entering a period of 'new prosperity'. 

According to a report by the Russian agency Interfax, Kim also said that North Korea wants to strengthen 'strategic cooperation with Russia'. 

Meanwhile, Putin thanked Kim for his 'unwavering' support for Ukraine. Russia's state-run TASS news agency reported that at the beginning of the talks, the Russian president said, "I appreciate your consistent and unwavering support for Russian policy." At the time, Putin told Kim that Russia is fighting against the US imperialist policy that has been imposed for decades. 

Earlier, Putin and Kim attended a welcoming ceremony at Kim Il Sung Square in Pyongyang. Putin was welcomed with various events there.

Headline_English: Master's degree at the age of 105
Content_Enlish:
Virginia Hislop. This 105-year-old woman has finally earned a master's degree. Although she graduated from Stanford University in California, USA, she could not earn a master's degree at that time because of World War II and her soldier husband's call to war. The final thesis (research paper) was left out. However, after a long 83 years, the university authorities awarded her a master's degree. NBC News reported. 

Last Sunday, the university authorities organized a convocation and awarded Virginia a master's degree in education. At that time, Virginia was wearing a black gown. This centenarian woman was seen in good spirits. Although she came to campus in a wheelchair. 

Originally, her daughter's husband contacted the university authorities about granting her a degree. Then he was informed that Virginia's final thesis, which was yet to be submitted, no longer needed to be submitted. It has been decided to grant her a degree. 

Speaking about the much-awaited achievement, Virginia said at the ceremony, "I've been trying to get this for a long time. It feels good to be recognized now." 

When the United States entered World War II in 1941, her husband was called up to fight. For this reason, Virginia moved to Oklahoma with her husband. That's why she couldn't submit her final thesis. 

Raised in Los Angeles, this woman enrolled at Stanford University in 1936. She said that she wanted to study law. However, her father refused to teach law, and even told her that he wouldn't pay for it. As a result, she enrolled in education as per her father's wishes. Later, she worked in various institutions to promote education. After the war, Virginia joined the family cattle business in Washington with her husband George. They have two children. He also got them married.

Headline_English: You can't win the Copa just by being a World Champion: Messi
Content_Enlish:
Lionel Messi has commented that to win the Copa America, we have to play better football than before. Argentina, the Copa champion last season, also won the World Cup in Qatar. As such, Argentina is the best team in the world. Messi also mentioned that this does not mean that they will win the Copa America. 

Argentina will start the Copa America against Canada at 6 am Bangladesh time next Friday. Before that match, Messi told the media, 'We can say that we are the best team in the world. Because we are world champions. But that does not mean that we will win the Copa America by walking.' 

Messi also mentioned that all the teams participating in the Copa America are almost equal, 'All the teams are competitive, it will be a very equal fight. Ecuador is a very strong team of the young generation. Their goal is clear, physically strong. Colombia and Uruguay are like them. Not to mention Brazil. That's why our team has to play the same, maybe even better, to win the title.' 

Messi said that Brazil, like Argentina, is one of the contenders to win the Copa America even without Neymar, saying, 'It's disappointing not to have Neymar, but they have millions of footballers. Brazil always has many players, they are completely different. They have a very strong and competitive team. Like Argentina, Brazil is also a contender for the title.' 

There are rumors that Messi could end his international career with the Copa America. Although he did not say anything for sure, the Inter Miami star admitted that his time with the national team is running out, 'I value the moments with the team very much. Because I know that I have very little time. I will miss these moments.'

Headline_English: 500,000 illegal immigrants in the US are set to receive citizenship
Content_Enlish:
US President Joe Biden has announced a new initiative to grant citizenship to thousands of immigrants living in the United States illegally. Under the initiative, about half a million immigrants who are married to US citizens will be granted citizenship. Biden's move in the US election year is a stark contrast to Republican rival Donald Trump's mass deportation plan. 

At a White House event, Biden criticized Trump for separating immigrant families at the US-Mexico border and for using inflammatory language about illegal immigrants. 

Biden said, "I'm not interested in politics about the border or immigration. I'm interested in fixing it." 

Officials in the country said on Tuesday that Biden's new initiative will allow about half a million immigrants to become citizens. For this, an immigrant must have lived in the United States for 10 years on June 17 and be married to a US citizen. About 50,000 non-citizen children under the age of 21 of parents married to US citizens will also have the opportunity to obtain citizenship. If the immigrant's application is approved based on this qualification, he will have three years to apply for a green card and a temporary 'work permit' or work permit. In addition, he will be exempt from deportation during this time. Reuters reports.

Headline_English: Hasan was unable to go to America, lost his life in the hands of an ignorant party
Content_Enlish:
Abul Hasan (28), who was going to the United States from Golapganj in Sylhet to visit his younger sister, was killed by an unknown party while on his way to a hospital in the city. One of his relatives was injured in the incident on Tuesday night. The unknown party members kidnapped them, locked them on a building in the city's Amberkhana area, demanded ransom and beat them up. Hasan died later that night in a private hospital in the city. He is the son of the late Ilias Ali of Purbhag Kalashahar Grarem in Bhadeshwar area of ​​Golapganj upazila. 

Hasan is a local market trader and the son of an expatriate family. He had recently made all the preparations to go to the United States. Mustafa Akmal, the husband of the deceased's younger sister, told Samakal that Abul Hasan, a relative, left for Sylhet in a CNG autorickshaw from Bhadeshwar in Golapganj at around 8 pm to see his wife. He was accompanied by a relative and a passenger. Another passenger boarded the CNG at the Kadamtali overbridge area. After that, they could not say anything more. When they regained consciousness, they found themselves on the roof of a building in the Amberkhana area of ​​Sylhet city. At that time, some youths beat them up and demanded a ransom of 5 lakh taka. They snatched their mobile phones and 8 thousand taka from them and fled. 

The relative who was with Hasan went down in his injured state and informed the locals about the incident. Later, Hasan was first admitted to the Sylhet Osmani Medical College Hospital and later to the ICU of a private hospital. Hasan died around 1 am. The body was taken to his village home on Wednesday morning. But before the burial, the relatives took it back to Osmani Hospital for an autopsy. 

Kotwali Police Station OC Moin Uddin Sipon said that the body was taken home without informing the police. Before the burial, the body was brought back to Sylhet. The body has been kept in the hospital morgue.

Headline_English: Bangladesh raises shooting incident from Myanmar to UN
Content_Enlish:
