Bangladesh has raised the incident of firing from Myanmar targeting its people and installations at the Cox's Bazar border with the United Nations. Dhaka has said that any conflict in Myanmar is their internal matter. However, it should not affect the people and resources of Bangladesh. 

The matter was informed at the dialogue held on the human rights situation of the Rohingyas at the 56th session of the UN Human Rights Council. This information was given in a press release of the Permanent Mission of Bangladesh to the UN in Geneva. 

At the dialogue, Dhaka said that despite various limitations, Bangladesh has been sheltering about 1.2 million Rohingyas for seven years. The repatriation of the Rohingyas to Myanmar is the only sustainable solution to this crisis. 

Sanchita Haque, Acting Permanent Representative of the Permanent Mission of Bangladesh to Geneva, participated in the dialogue on behalf of Bangladesh. She said that Bangladesh has continued to communicate with all parties concerned to start the repatriation of the Rohingyas. In this regard, she called on the international community to invest in improving the livelihoods of the Rohingyas in Rakhine for their assimilation. He called on all parties to the conflict in Myanmar to protect the Rohingya and ensure their safety. He called for adequate humanitarian assistance for the Rohingya who have taken refuge in Bangladesh. 

At the beginning of the dialogue, the High Commissioner for Human Rights, Volker Türk, presented a report to the Council on the human rights situation of the Rohingya Muslims in Myanmar. He expressed deep concern about the recent escalation of violence, the forced recruitment of Rohingya into the armed forces, and the heinous tactics of war in Rakhine. 

The session of the UN Human Rights Council began on June 18 and will continue until July 12.

Headline_English: Over 1,200 hospitalized after overeating during Eid
Content_Enlish:
Many people in Pakistan's Punjab and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa provinces have fallen ill after eating too much food during Eid-ul-Azha. More than 1,200 people have been admitted to hospitals so far. The Khabar Express Tribune 

reported that 1,200 people were admitted to hospitals after eating too much food, while 500 people were involved in road accidents while enjoying Eid excessively. They have also been admitted to hospitals. 

Lady Reading Hospital spokesperson Mohammad Asim said that 610 people were reported to be suffering from stomach and intestinal diseases in Peshawar alone in 24 hours. Most of them ate too much food and meat. 

And 2,200 people were admitted to six major hospitals in Punjab province during the Eid holidays. Of them, 180 came with digestive system problems, diarrhea and stomach pain. 

Similarly, more than 130 patients were treated at Jinnah Hospital in Lahore. In addition, more than 100 patients were admitted to Services Hospital, Ganga Ram and Mayo Hospital in Lahore each. 

That's why doctors there have advised people to eat extra food and not eat too much meat.

Headline_English: Israeli intelligence agents wearing burqas mingle with Gazans
Content_Enlish:
Israel came up with a dramatic plan to rescue the hostages held by Hamas in Gaza. To confirm the location of the hostages, spies were sent to the Nuseirat refugee camp in Gaza. There, they dressed up as Palestinian Muslims wearing hijabs and niqabs and charged three times the rent. At the same time, they introduced themselves as Palestinians displaced by the Israeli attack. They also claimed to the Gazans that they were members of a wealthy family in Rafah. When they rented the house, they had various household items with them, including blankets, mattresses, and mats. They also spoke in Arabic, just like the residents of Gaza. They were essentially Israeli spies. 

The Israeli media outlet The Zeus Chronicle has highlighted such a far-reaching plan before the operation. The report, titled 'The Inside Story of Israel's Hostage Rescue', published on Thursday, said that before the main operation to rescue four hostages, including a young woman, on June 6, Israeli intelligence officers spent 19 days intensively collecting and analyzing information. For this, male and female intelligence officers were assigned to disguise themselves as civilians. The Israeli Defense Forces (IDF) kept the matter strictly secret. 

Originally, on May 12, intelligence officers received information that four hostages were in the Nuseirat refugee camp. After that, the IDF planned such an operation in the War Cabinet. After receiving approval, the work of collecting intelligence information undercover began. At the same time, drone footage was collected. After that, artificial intelligence (AI) was used to analyze that information and video footage. 

The intelligence officers stayed in the camp for 19 days to confirm the location of the hostages. Meanwhile, 28 commandos from the Israeli special forces' counter-terrorism unit, Yamam, were trained to rescue hostages. However, the night before the raid on June 6, the spies were ordered to leave the area. The raid began at 11 a.m. that day.

First, a young woman named Argamani was rescued and sent to Israel by helicopter. There, the Hamas guard was killed. But when the Israeli commandos went to another building to rescue the remaining three, they came under severe attack. About 30 Hamas fighters launched a severe attack with machine guns and grenades. But about 300 innocent Palestinians from the Nuseirat camp were killed during the raid.

Meanwhile, the sophisticated technology that Israel used to make this raid successful was provided by the United States. Israel did not have the ability to analyze such data or AI technology until the war began. According to the Washington Post, the United States has increased its intelligence collection on Hamas since the Gaza war began. At the same time, the country has given Israel great advantages in analyzing drone footage, satellite images and data using advanced software. All of this was based on AI. As a result, an Israeli official believes that the hostage rescue operation was successful. 

Meanwhile, Hamas' top leader Osman Hamadan said that no one knows how many Israeli hostages are still alive. In an interview with CNN, he said that Israel must agree to a complete ceasefire before any talks on the release of the hostages. 

In such a situation, Israel has continued its attacks on Gaza, including Rafah. In addition to the attacks, many children are dying of malnutrition. Doctors said that 200 children are facing death in one hospital. And because Israel closed the Rafah crossing, 2,500 Palestinians in the West Bank could not go to Hajj. Meanwhile, the Lebanese armed group Hezbollah has attacked nine Israeli military sites.

Headline_English: Mintu cannot be called a criminal right now: Obaidul Quader
Content_Enlish:
Awami League General Secretary Obaidul Quader has requested Jhenaidah Awami League General Secretary Saidul Karim Mintu, who is on remand in the murder of MP Anwarul Azim Anar, not to call him a criminal now. He said, it is not right to call anyone a criminal before a case is filed or before the sentence is announced. This is the rule. Is there such an example of a district general secretary being on remand during the BNP and General Ershad's tenure? Awami League has the courage to stand trial. 

Obaidul Quader said these things at a press conference at Awami League President Sheikh Hasina's Dhanmondi political office on Friday. 

The Road Transport and Bridges Minister said that inflation is going on in countries around the world. This inflation is also a cause of concern in Bangladesh. The government has done nothing here by suppressing anything and hiding the truth. 

Regarding BNP's corruption, Obaidul Quader said, only the corrupt speak against corruption today! BNP is corrupt from top to bottom. The party's acting chairman Tarique Rahman is the godfather of corruption. BNP Secretary General Mirza Fakhrul Islam has issued a statement to make him look like a good person. Mirza Fakhrul has done many things under his threat. Mirza Fakhrul is now saying – Tarique cannot be punished. 

He said, Tarique Rahman has already been punished. Now he must be brought back to the country and punished – this is what the Prime Minister has said. As long as Tarique Rahman remains at the helm of BNP, it is not possible for BNP to make a political debut with independence. There is no reason to try to make Tarique Rahman look like a good person. 

Also present at the press conference were Awami League Joint General Secretary AFM Bahauddin Nasim, Organizing Secretary BM Mozammel Haque, Mirza Azam, Advocate Afzal Hossain, Sujit Roy Nandi, Publicity and Publication Secretary Dr. Abdus Sobhan Golap, Office Secretary Barrister Biplob Barua and others.

Headline_English: Putin calls loan to Ukraine from Russian assets, theft
Content_Enlish:
Russian President Vladimir Putin has called the $50 billion loan to Ukraine to help with defense and other sectors from interest on seized Russian assets theft. At the same time, he has also warned of retaliation against the Western G7 countries for making such a decision. Al Jazeera and AP reported 

The loan agreement was approved on the first day of the summit in Italy last Thursday. Putin then reacted by condemning it on Friday. In a meeting with Russian Foreign Ministry officials, the Russian leader said that Western leaders are trying to come up with 'some legal basis' for seizing assets, but despite all the tricks, theft is still theft. They will be punished for it.' 

Of course, after reaching the agreement, US President Joe Biden said, 'This agreement reminds Putin that we are not backing down.' The money is expected to reach Ukraine by the end of this year. The United States and Ukraine have signed a security agreement for the next 10 years on the sidelines of the G7 summit. 

Meanwhile, Putin has set two new conditions for starting a ceasefire dialogue in Ukraine. Ukraine must withdraw its troops from the four provinces that Russia has annexed. And the United States and its allies must announce that Kiev will no longer lobby for NATO membership. 

On the second day of the summit, Friday, the leaders discussed vigorously stopping illegal immigration. Because Italy is the main route to Europe by crossing the Mediterranean Sea. And this summit is being held there. On the other hand, the United States is also struggling to stop the flow of illegal immigrants through the Mexican border. As a result, the leaders discussed increasing investment to increase employment in Africa. 

Pope Francis joined the summit today. In addition, Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva, Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan.

Headline_English: World leaders gather in Switzerland, hoping to end war
Content_Enlish:
The ‘Ukraine Peace Conference’ began on Saturday in the Burgenstock resort of Switzerland with the aim of ending the Ukraine war. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has sought support from world leaders at the conference. The conference has raised new hopes 28 months after the start of the Russian attack on Russia. BBC News. 

More than 90 countries and global organizations are participating in the peace conference. The conference aims to reach a fundamental agreement to end the Ukraine conflict. Leaders participating in the conference believe that the conference will play a strong role in implementing a lasting peace process. And this conference is a major achievement for Ukraine. The conference will end on Sunday. 

However, important powers like China are not participating in the conference with full representation. In addition, the ultimatum that Russian President Vladimir Putin has given to Ukraine demanding its surrender is considered to be low in terms of progress in the peace process. Russia was not invited to the conference. 

The conference is being held at a time when Russia has launched a new attack in the northeast near Kharkiv. Russian missiles have destroyed homes and power plants. 

Ukrainian MP Oleksandr Marenko believes that establishing a political and legal framework for future peace is important. This peace can only come on the basis of Zelensky’s 10-point plan, which he outlined in 2022. Ukraine’s territorial integrity and sovereignty are given priority. 

Sam Green of the Center for European Policy Analysis (CEPA) said, “I think the purpose of this conference is to rally support for Ukraine’s vision.” 
US President Joe Biden is not attending the conference in person, although this decision has angered Zelensky. India and Brazil are sending low-level representatives to the conference. Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov described the conference as “meaningless.”

Headline_English: 'I did not boycott Brazilian football', Ronaldinho in new message
Content_Enlish:
Before the Copa America, Ronaldinho criticized the Brazilian national team in very harsh terms. But later, the World Cup-winning star said that he did not say anything in such harsh terms. He did not even boycott Brazilian football. 

The media claimed that Ronaldinho said, "It is a disappointing time for those who watch Brazilian football. Brazil's game is now struggling to find momentum. This is the worst team in recent times. There is no leader in this team. I have been watching the game since I was very young, and then I became a footballer; I have never seen such a bad time before. Their love and passion for the jersey is low. The biggest thing is that there is no football in their game. Which is very shameful. I am resigning as a Brazil fan, I will not watch any of their games, including the Copa America." 

Ronaldinho's words exploded like a bomb. The words also reached the ears of the current Brazilian team footballers. When Rafinha was asked about the matter, he gave a different answer. He said that a few days ago, Ronaldinho asked Vinicius for tickets to watch the Copa America. 

Then Ronaldinho spoke in a soft tone. He said that he did not boycott the Brazilian game. He also commented that it is important to be by the side of the players now, "I have never boycotted Brazilian football. I did not say the words that you see. The players are hearing these words before the match, imagine how terrible it is? They need support right now. The more confidence we show, the more courage they will have." 

Brazil lost to Argentina in the final of last season's Copa America. Fans saw Rodrigo-Marquinhos' defeat to Argentina in their last appearance. Before the Copa, they won hard against Mexico in a friendly match, and drew against the United States. The Seleção will start the Copa on June 25 against Costa Rica.

Headline_English: ISPR urges not to be misled by rumors about St. Martin's security
Content_Enlish:
In the context of the ongoing internal conflict in Myanmar, the Myanmar military is conducting a joint operation against the Arakan Army in Rakhine State. Due to the conflict between the country's military and the Arakan Army, there is an incident of unwanted firing on Bangladeshi boats in the Naf River and the estuary adjacent to the river. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Bangladesh has expressed deep concern and protested in this regard. Since the ongoing internal conflict in Myanmar is close to St. Martin, various vested interests are spreading rumors on the country's social media about the security of St. Martin. Everyone is requested not to be misled by such rumors. 

This information was given in a press release of the Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR) on Sunday. 

The release said that in continuation of this, the Myanmar Navy is targeting the Arakan Army positions in the sea border of Myanmar and the Myanmar border of the Naf River near St. Martin's Island. At the same time, the Arakan Army is also shelling Myanmar Navy ships and boats. Currently, several warships of the country's navy are conducting operations on the Myanmar border. Their navy is also informing the Bangladesh Navy about their presence in Myanmar's maritime border near St. Martin. 

The internal conflict in Myanmar is ongoing in the country's mainland and adjacent coastal areas. Several ships of the Bangladesh Navy and Coast Guard are conducting regular patrols in Bangladesh's maritime border near St. Martin's Island, including monitoring the movements of Myanmar ships.

Headline_English: Padma Bridge toll collection reaches Tk 250 crore in a week
Content_Enlish:
A total of 247.361 crore taka was collected on the Padma Bridge during the Eid pilgrimage for vehicles crossing the bridge in 7 days. This toll was collected from June 10 to 10 pm. Rajan Chandra Biswas, assistant engineer of the Padma Bridge site office, confirmed this information. 

According to bridge authority sources, the highest toll was collected during the Eid pilgrimage on June 14. The total collection on that day was 48.218 crore taka. On June 15, the toll was 43.082 thousand 900 taka. By June 16, the toll was 33.599 thousand 750 taka. 

The source further said that earlier, on June 10, the toll was 26.026 thousand 500 taka. On June 11, the toll was 28.251 thousand 500 taka. On June 12, the toll was 31.360 thousand 450 taka. On June 13, the toll was 36.822 thousand 700 taka.

Headline_English: The teaser of the movie 'Dard' came out on Eid, Shakib played with blood in every scene
Content_Enlish:
On Eid-ul-Azha, Shakib Khan's 'Toofan' was released in theaters, and on the other hand, the teaser of his first pan-Indian movie 'Dard' was released. Amid the chaos of 'Toofan', the top hero of Dhallywood seems to have surpassed himself with 'Dard'. 

Although the teaser started with a romance with Bollywood actress Sonal Chauhan, no one could have guessed how terrifying Shakib would be. Shakib's blood is playing with every action scene. 

Earlier, producer Anon Mamun wrote on Facebook this afternoon - 'Those with weak hearts, please do not watch the teaser of Dard.' The 1 minute 24 second teaser seems to have evidence of this. 

Producer Anon Mamun had been hinting at the arrival of a glimpse of 'Dard' for the past two days. Yesterday, he wrote on Facebook, 'The storm will stop, the rain will come - 'Dard' will create new history'. Finally, the teaser was released this Monday evening. 

The teaser has been garnering praise from netizens ever since it was released. For now, Anonna Mamun can only say, ‘I won then’. 

Before releasing the teaser, director Anonna Mamun told the media about the movie that ‘Dard’ will be released in the first week of September this year. Bollywood’s Sonal Chauhan has acted alongside Shakib Khan in the movie. The movie was shot in Varanasi and Allahabad, India. 

Apart from Shakib-Sonal, other actors who have acted include Payel Sarkar, Biswajit Chakraborty, Rajesh Sharma, Elena Shammi, Imtu Ratish, Rahul Dev, Alok Jain, Safa Maria, Jessia Islam, among others.

Headline_English: FRC Chairman Hamidullah Bhuiyan passes away
Content_Enlish:
Financial Reporting Council (FRC) Chairman Professor Hamidullah Bhuiyan Didar has passed away. He died while undergoing treatment at Ibrahim Cardiac Center on Monday evening. 

His first funeral will be held in Dhania tomorrow, Tuesday. After the first funeral, his body will be brought to the Dhaka University Accounting Department at 3 pm for paying respects. Later, after the second funeral after Asr, he will be buried at Azimpur graveyard. 

Dhaka University Accounting alumni have expressed deep shock at his death.

Headline_English: What will happen to the 10,000 people of Saint Martin?
Content_Enlish:
The conflict in Myanmar's Rakhine state continues. In the meantime, gunfire is also being fired from the country's border towards Bangladesh. On Wednesday and Saturday, gunfire was fired at a Bangladeshi trawler. As a result, all types of passenger and cargo traffic on the Teknaf-Saint Martin waterway have been stopped for five days. This has raised fears of a food shortage, including daily necessities, in Saint Martin. 

On Wednesday, gunfire was fired from Myanmar at a trawler carrying election equipment and officials while it was returning from Saint Martin. The trawler was damaged. On Saturday, gunfire also hit a cargo trawler in the area called Naikshangdia in the Badramokam estuary of the Naf River. Although no one was injured, the trawler was hit by seven bullets. Since then, all boats have been closed due to fear. 

About 10,000 people live on the coral island of Saint Martin. Boats are the only means of communication and supply of daily necessities. Residents of the island say that St. Martin has been cut off from Teknaf for the past five days due to the closure of boats. As boats carrying food and goods are not plying, the food items stored in the shops of St. Martin are about to run out. Taking advantage of this, some traders are charging double the price of their products. If this problem is not resolved quickly, the crisis will intensify. 

Mohammad Islam, a grocer on the island, said that due to the closure of the trawlers, we have not been able to bring any products from Teknaf for the past few days. There is nothing in the shops except rice. If this continues, the people of the island will have to starve. 

Abdur Rashid, president of the St. Martin Boat Owners Association, said that seeing open shooting on boats has created panic among trawlers and people. As a result, no one is agreeing to travel by trawler on the waterway. Apart from that, there is no alternative arrangement or route to reach St. Martin except that route. Every day, more than a hundred people used to travel on the St. Martin-Teknaf waterway in 6-7 boats, along with carrying food and daily necessities. People are in great danger due to the closure of waterways. 

St. Martin Union Parishad Chairman Mujibur Rahman said that the navigation on the Teknaf-St. Martin waterway is closed. Due to this, no goods, including food, can be brought in. Many shops are empty. This needs to be resolved quickly. 

Teknaf Upazila Nirbahi Officer Mohammad Adnan Chowdhury said in this regard, navigation on the Teknaf-St. Martin waterway is closed due to the shooting. We have proposed a jetty ghat west of Shahparir Island as an emergency route. If it can be used, navigation will proceed from there.

Headline_English: Tanzim's career-best bowling
Content_Enlish:
Tanjim Shakib bowled brilliantly for the team that came out to bat after losing the toss against South Africa. He took a wicket in his first over. He also gave a breakthrough in the second and third overs. 

South Africa lost 4 wickets for 23 runs due to his bowling. Tanjim took three of them. Despite not getting a wicket in his fourth over, Tanjim bowled the best bowling of his T20 career. 

He finished his quota of 4 overs with just 18 runs. Tanjim took 8 wickets in his 8-match international T20 career.

Headline_English: Sehwag tells Shakib to retire out of shame
Content_Enlish:
Virender Sehwag never stops making sarcastic comments when he gets a chance to talk about Bangladesh cricket. After the 4-run loss to South Africa, the World Cup-winning Indian cricketer criticized Shakib Al Hasan in harsh terms. 

He questioned Shakib's sense of shame. He commented that he should have retired earlier. He called him a mere cricketer of Bangladesh. 

The former right-handed batsman talked about Shakib's failure in the Cricbuzz podcast. There, Sehwag said, "I think Shakib is finished in T20 cricket a long time ago. Maybe it was in the last T20 World Cup. You are the senior cricketer of the team, you have been the captain for a long time, you are being taken into the team because of your experience, and if your runs are like this, then you should be ashamed of yourself for that." 

Shakib came out to bat at four today. Which is an important order in the T20 format. On the other hand, the team's target was only 114 runs. Bangladesh lost 2 wickets for 29 runs. From there, Shakib could have taken the match forward by playing slowly. But he caught the shot of the fastest pacer of the present era, Enrique Norquia, within 30 yards while playing a pull ball. Bangladesh lost 3 wickets for 37 runs and was under more pressure. 

Sehwag criticized Shakib's shot selection, "If he had been taken into the team because of his experience, we would definitely not want to see such batting from him. At least he should have spent some time on his wicket. You are not Hayden or Gilchrist, who plays a pull ball. You are a small cricketer from Bangladesh, so you will bat according to your standards. When you cannot play hook-pull, then play the shot that you have in your hand."

Headline_English: Tamim surprised by Shakib not bowling
Content_Enlish:
Bangladesh lost by 4 runs after chasing 114 runs against South Africa. Experienced Shakib, who played his ninth T20 World Cup with bat and ball, could not do well today. He was out after playing a spectacular pull shot for just 3 runs. Before that, he bowled only 1 over and gave away 6 runs. 

Although Shakib's bowling was not bad, captain Nazmul Shanto did not bring him into the attack later. With David Miller at the crease, he let Mahmudullah Riyad bowl three overs. Riyad gave away 17 runs in his 3 overs. Tamim commented that Shakib could have been bowled as South Africa lost 4 wickets for 23 runs and they were under pressure. 

Tamim said in the CleanInfo podcast, 'Tanjim Shakib took wickets even after taking four or sixes. He is a very confident cricketer. He changed the pace of the ball very well. It is true that the wicket helped him a little, but he bowled very well. He bowled according to the needs of the wicket. The pacers did their job well in the US leg. 

Regarding Shakib not bowling and Riyad bowling 3 overs, Tamim said, "I was very surprised, Mahmudullah bowled 3 overs and did well. I was a little surprised that Shakib did not bowl more (more than 1 over). Maybe thinking of Miller who was at the crease. But it was a good opportunity to bring Shakib into the attack and challenge Klaasen."

Headline_English: This time, shots were fired on a speedboat bound for St. Martin's.
Content_Enlish:
A speed boat carrying patients from Teknaf to St. Martin's was targeted by gunfire in Cox's Bazar. However, no casualties were reported. The incident occurred around 10 am today (June 11) when the speed boat reached Naikshangdia at the mouth of the Naf River. 

Secretary of the Boat Owners' Association, Syed Alam, said that some people were returning to St. Martin's by speed boat after receiving treatment from Teknaf. At that time, shots were fired at the speed boat. The shots were fired from Myanmar. Earlier, shots were fired from the Myanmar border, but today, small dinghies were fired into the river. At that time, the passengers on the speed boat panicked. However, they reached St. Martin's safely. 

Teknaf Upazila Nirbahi Officer (UNO) Mohammad Adnan Chowdhury said in this regard, "We have learned that our trawler was shot at from the Myanmar border today." I have spoken to the relevant people in charge at the border regarding this. We are working on these incidents. And I request the residents of the island not to be drawn into it.’ 

Earlier, a cargo trawler and election officials were fired upon from Naiksyangdia, on the Myanmar border, bound for St. Martin. The area is currently under the control of the Arakan Army. It is believed that members of this group fired the shots.

Headline_English: Biden's son found guilty, could face 25 years in prison
Content_Enlish:
US President Joe Biden's son Hunter Biden has been found guilty of making false statements about his drug addiction when purchasing a firearm. 

A court in the US state of Delaware on Tuesday found him guilty on all three criminal charges. 

Hunter Biden could face a maximum sentence of 25 years in prison in this case. He could face a maximum sentence of 10 years in prison for making false statements when purchasing a firearm. He could face a maximum sentence of 5 years for making false statements in a firearms dealer's records and a maximum sentence of 10 years in prison for illegally possessing a firearm while intoxicated. 

The first charge against Biden's son is that he made false statements when purchasing a firearm. The second charge is that he arranged for the firearms dealer to have false statements in his records. The third charge is that Hunter Biden illegally possessed a firearm. 

The case states that Hunter Biden bought a handgun in 2018. He lied about his drug addiction when he bought the gun. 

Hunter Biden has faced criticism for his drug addiction and personal life. He has been struggling with these issues for a long time. He admitted to being addicted to cocaine in 2018. 

Hunter's older brother Beau Biden died of cancer in 2015. Hunter Biden wrote in his autobiography 'Beautiful Things' that he became addicted to drugs after his brother's death. Hunter quit drugs in 2019. 

According to US law, citizens of the country have the right to buy weapons. But when buying a weapon, a person must mention in the application whether he is addicted to drugs or not.

Headline_English: Israel refuses to accept ceasefire in Gaza
Content_Enlish:
The United States is watching the reaction of Israel and Hamas after a ceasefire proposal announced by US President Joe Biden was unanimously passed by the UN Security Council. The Palestinian armed group says it sees the agreement as positive; it wants to move forward with it. But Israel must agree to a permanent ceasefire. The Israeli government has not commented on the matter. However, the BBC, citing an anonymous source, said that Israel did not agree to the agreement. 

In this situation, US Secretary of State Antony Blinken arrived in Qatar on Wednesday. Qatar, along with the US and Egypt, is acting as a mediator between Hamas and Israel. There, he met with Qatari Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim al-Thani. Later, at a press conference, the Qatari prime minister spoke of a “permanent solution” to the Palestinian issue. 

Blinken said on Tuesday that Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu had expressed his commitment to the deal. However, CNN reported that after the Security Council passed the deal, Israel's ambassador to the United Nations said that the war would continue until Hamas was eliminated. Netanyahu did not officially support Biden's proposal. 

The Guardian wrote that a report by the UN Commission of Inquiry (COI) found both Hamas and Israel responsible for committing war crimes. The period from October 7 to December 31 last year was considered. The report was based on victims, witnesses, satellite images and health data. Hamas was accused of deliberately targeting civilians and using hunger as a weapon against Israel. 

In the current situation, the Lebanese armed organization Hezbollah has launched the largest rocket attack on Israel ever. Hezbollah fired the rockets in retaliation for the killing of a senior commander, Taleb Abdellah, in an airstrike in the Lebanese village of Jaouia on Thursday night. Hezbollah says the rockets it fired hit an Israeli base in Ain Zaytim.

Headline_English: Russia's economy overtakes Japan's
Content_Enlish:
Russia has overtaken Japan as the world's fourth-largest economy. According to World Bank data released in early June, the Russian economy has overtaken Japan in terms of purchasing power parity (PPP). As a result, Moscow has risen to fourth place in the list of world economies. 

The West has imposed more than 16,000 sanctions on the Russian economy due to Russia's invasion of Ukraine. The aim was to cripple Russia. But the Russian economy has made an unprecedented turnaround. 

Earlier, Intellinews reported that Russia will surpass Germany in August to become the fifth-largest economy. 

To avoid sanctions, Russia has adopted two export and import strategies. Russia has started importing 'run-of-the-mill' computer chips and small components found in consumer products, which mainly come from US manufacturers, but they are again outside the export ban. Russia has also used third-party networks, which have good relations with those who produce the parts needed to make tanks, missiles, drones, etc. In addition, Russia is using shadow vessels to export oil. Russia is creating a smokescreen in this way and has advanced economically.

Headline_English: The use of drones in Myanmar's civil war
Content_Enlish:
Myanmar’s rebels have made significant progress in the past year against one of Southeast Asia’s most formidable armies, relying on a fleet of isolated drones. But drone warfare is changing. The country’s ruling junta is increasingly believed to be converting commercial drones made in China into weapons and using them against the insurgents, Reuters reports. 

Ta Yoke Gyi, 31, a rebel fighter, said the Myanmar junta had begun using armed drones since the beginning of the year. His team recently shot down a drone whose components they believe were made with Chinese components and converted for combat. 

Resistance fighters, analysts and officials from a regional country have said the junta is using commercial drones from China to drop locally made bombs. A junta spokesman has not commented on the matter. 

The Myanmar junta has acquired thousands of Chinese commercial drones and is equipping them with locally made weapons, said Mi Zhao Wu, executive director of the Myanmar Institute for Peace and Security. According to the Stockholm International Peace Research Institute’s arms transfer database, the Myanmar military has ordered 12 armed drones from China.

Headline_English: 8,000 guests to attend Modi's swearing-in ceremony, Delhi on high alert
Content_Enlish:
All arrangements have been made for the swearing-in ceremony of Narendra Modi as the Prime Minister of India for the third consecutive term. Bangladeshi Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has arrived in Delhi to attend the ceremony on Sunday. Along with her, 7 foreign leaders will attend the ceremony. And in total, the number of invited guests for the oath-taking ceremony will be 8,000. 
Indian news media, including Hindustan Times, say that the highest alert has been issued in Delhi to ensure flawless security for the oath-taking ceremony. Indian President Droupadi Murmu will administer the oath to Narendra Modi and other members of the Union Cabinet as the Prime Minister at 7.15 pm on Sunday. 

A multi-layered security system is being set up at the Rashtrapati Bhavan, the venue for Modi's oath-taking, with five companies of paramilitary forces, NSG commandos, drones and snipers in addition to the jawans. 

A no-fly zone has been declared in Delhi to prevent any criminal or terrorist threat during the oath-taking ceremony. These restrictions will be in effect on June 9 and 10. 

Special protocols and additional security measures have also been taken at hotels for foreign guests. Famous hotels like Leela, Taj, ITC Maurya, Claridges and Oberoi are under special security. Guests will travel from the hotel to the venue on a specific route. It is expected that various roads will be closed and diversions will be put in place during this time. Strict surveillance has also been started at the borders. 

Maldives President Mohammed Mujibur Rahman will attend Modi's swearing-in ceremony on Sunday as an invited guest. 

As part of India's 'Neighborhood First Policy', leaders of Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Bhutan, Nepal, Mauritius and Seychelles, besides Maldives, will be present at the ceremony. 

Narendra Modi's new cabinet is expected to have 27-30 members, of which about a third will be members of the NDA alliance. There may also be a few ministers of state. 

The first session of the 18th Lok Sabha is scheduled to begin by June 15. The first two days will be spent on the swearing-in of the newly elected members. After that, a new Speaker will be elected and the President will address a joint session of the Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha, formally inaugurating the session. The first is scheduled to end on June 22.

Headline_English: Parimoni apologizes to Mim
Content_Enlish:
Everyone knows about the rift between the two heroines Pari Mani and Vidya Sinha Mim over actor Shariful Raj. At one time, Pari had alleged that Mim and Raj were in a love relationship. In the wake of Pari's allegations, not only did the Mim-Raj pair break up, Mim also broke down mentally. Pari Mani has apologized to Mim for her actions on the stage of the 'Dhaka Fashion Day' event. 
According to the media, on Friday (June 7), arrangements were made for the popular stars who had come to participate in the 'Dhaka Fashion Day' event to stay in a separate room. 

Upon finding Mim there, Pari Mani hugged her and apologized for her previous actions. Other stars and the organizers of the event were also present at that time. 



Mim was initially completely unprepared for Pari's actions. She did not know what to say. Later, she controlled herself and spoke to Pari with a smile. After this incident, the two heroines were also seen on stage at the event, smiling. Pari even hugged Mim with delight! 



During the promotions of the movie 'Damal', a turbulent situation arose between Raj, Pari and Mim. Raj's then wife Parimani pointed fingers at Mim and Raj's relationship. Pari accused Mim of extramarital affairs. 

To avoid any trouble, Mim did not respond to Pari's allegations at that time. After this incident, the two heroines stopped seeing each other. Far from seeing each other, they used to avoid each other.

Headline_English: Myanmar fires on St. Martin-bound trawler
Content_Enlish:
Two cargo trawlers bound for St. Martin were fired upon from the Myanmar border. It is learnt that no one was injured in the incident, although 7 bullets were fired at the trawler. 
The incident took place at around 12:30 pm on Saturday (June 8) in an area called Naikshangdia in the Badramokam estuary of the Naf River. 

Abdur Rashid, president of the St. Martin Service Trawler Owners Association and owner of the trawler, confirmed the matter. 

Teknaf Upazila Executive Officer (UNO) Adnan Chowdhury said that communication between Teknaf and St. Martin has been cut off for two days due to rough seas. In the meantime, trawler owners have been asked to maintain a safe distance due to the firing incident on the service trawler from Myanmar. 

Incidentally, earlier on June 5, a trawler carrying election officials from Myanmar was fired upon while returning from the postponed upazila council elections on St. Martin Island.

Headline_English: Saudi Arabia expels over 300,000 illegal Hajj pilgrims
Content_Enlish:
In a week, the Muslim holy pilgrimage will begin in Mecca. Saudi Arabia has expelled hundreds of thousands of unregistered pilgrims from Mecca as of Saturday, Al Arabiya reported. 
Saudi authorities consider crowd management an important issue during the annual Hajj every year. Hajj is one of the five pillars of Islam. According to official data, more than 1.8 million people performed the Hajj last year. 

Of those expelled, 153,998 were foreigners. They entered Saudi Arabia on tourist visas and did not have the necessary documents to perform the Hajj. In addition, 171,587 people who came to Mecca from other cities in Saudi Arabia without Hajj permits were turned away from Mecca. 

The holy pilgrimage will begin in Mecca, Saudi Arabia, on June 14. All Muslims are required to perform the Hajj at least once in their lives. Various Hajj rituals are completed in Mecca and its surrounding areas for at least four days. Many people try to participate in these events illegally. 

Because obtaining a legal Hajj permit and related travel packages are relatively expensive in most cases. Moreover, each country has a limited quota for Hajj pilgrims. 

Mecca and Medina in Saudi Arabia are home to Islam's holiest shrines. The local administration of Mecca said in a statement posted on X that more than 1.3 million registered pilgrims had arrived in Saudi Arabia as of last Saturday.

Headline_English: Modi takes oath as Prime Minister for third consecutive term
Content_Enlish:
Narendra Modi took oath as the Prime Minister of India for the third consecutive time. The oath-taking ceremony took place in the courtyard of Rashtrapati Bhavan in New Delhi at 7:15 pm local time on Sunday. 
According to a report by Indian media NDTV, 71 members of the cabinet also took oath with Modi. Of these, 30 are cabinet ministers, five are independent charge and 36 are ministers of state. President Droupadi Murmu administered the oath to Modi and other ministers. Leaders of Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Bhutan, Nepal, Mauritius, Maldives and Seychelles were present at the oath-taking ceremony. 
Along with the Prime Minister, several ministers of the new government are also taking oath. This time, Modi is going to form a 72-member cabinet. Till the time of this report, the ministers who have taken oath include Amit Shah, S Jaishankar, Manohar Lal Khattar, Nirmala Sitharaman, Shivraj Singh Chouhan, Rajnath Singh, Nitin Gadkari, JP Nadda, JDS leader HD Kumaraswamy, Piyush Goyal, Dharmendra Pradhan. 


Three-tier security arrangements have been made at Rashtrapati Bhavan in Raisina Hills for the oath-taking ceremony. Commandos from the Delhi Police's SWAT and NSG have been deployed around the venue and strategic locations. 

The police have declared the capital a 'no-fly' zone. In addition, the flying of drones, paragliders, remote-controlled aircraft and gas-filled balloons has been banned for the next few days.

Headline_English: Actor Tutul Chowdhury appointed as director of Bangladesh Bank
Content_Enlish:
Actor Tutul Chowdhury is the director of Bangladesh Bank. Earlier, he was working as the bank's additional director (GM). On Sunday (June 9), Bangladesh Bank gave Tutul Chowdhury a promotion letter to the post of director. 
Tutul Chowdhury joined Bangladesh Bank as an assistant director in 1999. After that, he served as deputy director, joint director, additional director. Now, he has become a director after receiving his fifth promotion. 
Tutul Chowdhury said, I joined as an officer. I was associated with the theater of the late Abdullah Al Mamun Bhai since childhood. Even though I work in a bank, acting is like an addiction. I always act with permission from the office. Moreover, I have been shooting without taking rest on holidays. I had to work hard to maintain two; I am still doing it. 

Tutul Chowdhury has acted in more than five hundred dramas. In 2022, he was seen playing an important role in the film 'Agamikaal' directed by Anjan Aich. Another film of his, 'Kanamachi', is awaiting release. Currently, he is acting in several serials including 'Bakulpur', 'Probasi Parivar', 'Jadunagar' and others. In addition to his banker and actor credentials, Tutul Chowdhury is an educational entrepreneur. He is the founding principal of Sahajpathya School.

Headline_English: Odisha MLA Sophia creates history in just 30 days
Content_Enlish:
Sophia Firdous has become the first Muslim woman MLA in Odisha, defeating BJP's Purna Chandra Mohapatra by 8,01 votes in Cuttack, Odisha. Sophia is contesting on the seat of her father Mohammad Makim. Mohammad Makim was last a Congress MLA in Cuttack. 
Earlier this year, Sophia Firdous was preparing for the elections on her father's behalf. Although everything was going well, a big setback came a month before the elections. Makim's electoral validity was canceled by the country's Supreme Court order. He was found guilty in the Odisha Rural Housing Development Corporation (ORHDC) loan fraud case. 

With no alternative candidate just 30 days before the elections, the Congress decided to field Makim's daughter. The 32-year-old Sophia quit her job at a real estate company and contested the elections. And created history by winning against BJP's Purna Chandra Mohapatra. 
After winning the election, Sophia shared her experience of the election campaign with NDTV. In the interview, she said, "I am not a politician, when my father lost the legitimacy of contesting the election, 4-500 people gathered in front of our house and organized a huge rally. They requested me to come to the polling booth to continue the development that my father started through hard work in Cuttack." 

Sophia was actively involved in her father's election campaign in the 2014 and 2019 elections. For this, she had acquaintances and friendships with the grassroots workers of the party. This friendship has put her ahead in this election. 

With just a month of preparation, Sophia had to face tough challenges in the election campaign. She wanted to know from the voters whether they would replace her in the place of her father's trust. 

Sophia said, "I had only a month for the election. I was quite worried. People know my father well because he worked at the grassroots for a long time. He contested the 2014 elections. Although he did not win the election, he contested in 2019 and won. My father has been able to earn the trust of the people for a long time. So why should people trust me in such a short time?' 

She also said, 'I campaigned every day from 6 am to 2 pm in the scorching heat. Then I campaigned again from 5 pm to 9 pm. I had only a month to reach out to the people, so I tried to campaign from door to door.' 

As one of the youngest MLAs in the Odisha Assembly, Sophia is now facing a fight against seasoned politicians from the BJP and Naveen Patnaik's Biju Janata Dal (BJD). 

Taking inspiration from former Chief Minister Satpati, Sophia wants to take on the status of 'Iron Lady of Odisha'. 

When asked about her position as a 'Muslim MLA', Sophia said, "I am an Indian and a woman first and foremost. I have worked hard for women's empowerment in my career in real estate. I will continue to do so in politics as well. I have never considered myself separate as a Muslim politician."

Headline_English: Bangladesh interested in importing hydropower from Bhutan: Prime Minister
Content_Enlish:
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has reiterated Bangladesh's interest in importing hydropower from Bhutan through India. Bhutanese Prime Minister Dasho Tshering Tobgay expressed this interest when he paid a courtesy call on the Prime Minister at his current residence in New Delhi on Sunday (June 9). 
She told the Bhutanese Prime Minister, "This requires a tripartite agreement and we have already discussed the matter with India." 
Foreign Minister Dr. Hasan Mahmud said this at a press briefing after the meeting. 

She said Bhutan is eagerly waiting for the export of hydropower to Bangladesh. At the same time, both the countries reiterated their commitment to enhance the existing multifaceted relations. 

At the same time, the Bhutanese Prime Minister thanked the Bangladeshi Prime Minister for building a burn unit in his country and providing essential medicines for one year. At the same time, she highly appreciated the development of Bangladesh under the dynamic leadership of Sheikh Hasina. 

During the meeting, Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina said that Bhutan holds a special place in the heart of Bangladesh. Because Bhutan was the first to recognize Bangladesh as an independent country after the 1971 Liberation War. We are ready to provide all kinds of assistance to Bhutan. 

Present at the time were Foreign Minister Dr. Hasan Mahmud, Prime Minister's Advisor on Private Industry and Investment Salman F Rahman, State Minister for Commerce Ahsanul Islam Titu, Principal Secretary to the Prime Minister Mohammad Tofazzel Hossain Mia, Foreign Secretary (Senior Secretary) Masud Bin Momen, Secretary to the Prime Minister's Office (PMO) Mohammad Salahuddin and Press Secretary Naimul Islam Khan. 

On the other hand, Minister for Infrastructure and Transport Chandra Bahadur Gurung, Home Minister Tshering, Bhutan's Ambassador to India Major General V. Namgyel, Cabinet Secretary Kesang Deki and Foreign Secretary Pema Choden were present.

Headline_English: France is providing warplanes to Ukraine
Content_Enlish:
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has been repeatedly asking the West for weapons, ammunition and military equipment to counter Russia's attacks for more than two years. 
He has been able to obtain some weapons, albeit late, due to the ambivalence between America and Europe. Although Ukraine was promised advanced AU-16 fighter jets to counter Russian attacks in the air, they have not yet been delivered. This time, France has promised to supply Ukraine with Mirage 2000-5 fighter jets. 

Zelensky has joined world leaders in France to mark the 80th anniversary of D-Day, the day that liberated Europe from Nazi Germany. He will have the opportunity to meet US President Joe Biden and French President Emmanuel Macron. During his visit to France, Zelensky also called for more military assistance from the West. 

Macron promised to supply his country with fighter jets in a television interview on Thursday, ahead of his speech to the lower house of the French parliament on Friday. However, he did not say anything about the number of planes, the financial transaction or the timing of the transfer. The French president has offered to train Ukrainian pilots in France this summer to fly the planes. 

According to him, it usually takes five to six months to complete the training. It is worth noting that in January, the head of the Ukrainian air force said that the Mirage fighter jets would increase the strength of its forces. 

France's contribution to Ukraine in terms of military assistance is still much smaller than that of the United States and Germany. German Chancellor Olaf Scholz is calling on other European countries to be more active for Ukraine. It is not clear whether Macron is pledging additional assistance in response to such pressure and Zelensky's visit. 

He has also promised to train Ukrainian soldiers. Macron said that training soldiers has become a huge challenge for Ukraine. France therefore wants to take responsibility for training the entire brigade of 4,500 soldiers. Those soldiers will also be provided with the necessary equipment. However, Macron has indicated that the training will be provided outside Ukraine. The French president has announced that the French defense equipment manufacturer KNDS wants to open a factory to produce weapons on Ukrainian territory. Zelensky is visiting the company on the outskirts of Paris on Friday.

Headline_English: Hasina's presence at Modi's swearing-in ceremony: A new dimension to Sonali's relationship
Content_Enlish:
Narendra Damodardas Modi is taking oath as the Prime Minister of India for the third time. The presence of Bangladeshi Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina at his historic swearing-in ceremony is of particular significance. Because these two Prime Ministers have added a new dimension to bilateral relations. They have also made a huge contribution to geo-regional politics. They are working for the sake of poverty alleviation. 
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina and Prime Minister Narendra Modi have not only advocated for maintaining peace and stability, but also for the development of South Asia. Therefore, Sheikh Hasina's visit to Delhi is of particular importance for South Asia. If the relations between India and Bangladesh become stronger, everyone will benefit. According to Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina, 'Poverty is our main enemy. And it is important to spend our maximum resources on poverty alleviation'. 

Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi also gives utmost importance to development. Like Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina's 'Smart Bangladesh', Modi's dream is 'Aatmanirbhar Bharat'. Good international relations are very important in making the dreams of both heads of state a reality. The two neighboring countries are bound by spiritual ties. So after winning the Indian general election, Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina congratulated Narendra Modi on the phone. For the sake of that relationship, Modi also invited the Prime Minister of Bangladesh to attend the swearing-in ceremony. By accepting that invitation, Sheikh Hasina paved the way for further strengthening the friendship. 

Bangladesh and India are historically related to each other. India's contribution in 1971 should not be forgotten. India has always stood by Bangladesh. Even though the government in Delhi has changed, the bilateral relationship has not been affected. The relationship has become stronger after Narendra Modi became the Prime Minister. 

The Indian Prime Minister had already told Sheikh Hasina, 'India will fully cooperate to make your dream of a smart Bangladesh come true. Bangabandhu's dream of building a Golden Bangla will be successful'. In response, Sheikh Hasina said, 'I am grateful for your commitment to strengthen the bond of friendship between our two countries'. 

Diplomatic circles estimate that the two Prime Ministers will meet for a courtesy call after the swearing-in ceremony. During the courtesy call, bilateral cooperation including political and security cooperation, defense, border management, trade and communication, water resources, power and energy, development cooperation, cultural and people-to-people contacts may also be discussed. 

According to Foreign Minister Hasan Mahmud, ‘India-Bangladesh relations are incomparable to the relations that Dhaka has with any other country. We have a ‘blood relationship’ with India.’ Discussions on various important issues with India are essential for Bangladesh. 

President Mohammad Shahabuddin recently commented that India’s important role is also important in the return of Rohingya refugees. Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has sought India’s assistance in importing electricity from Bhutan. 

According to the Foreign Minister, ‘The Teesta project is very important for Bangladesh. If India provides financial and technological assistance in implementing this project, all problems will be resolved.’ India has expressed its interest in cooperating with Bangladesh in developing sustainable urbanization and planned and affordable housing. Indian High Commissioner to Bangladesh Pranay Kumar Verma expressed this interest in a recent courtesy interview with Housing and Public Works Minister A.M. Ubaidul Moktadir Chowdhury. 

Bangladesh's economic relations with India have reached a new height. Bangladeshi industrialists are more interested in investing in India. On the other hand, Bangladesh ranks first among the 62 countries to which India lends money. Bangladesh has taken a loan of US$ 8 billion from India on easy terms. India-Bangladesh trade has also increased. Imports have increased threefold in the last decade. India is now in fifth place in export trade. Exports have increased two and a half times. Whereas a decade ago, they were in 12th place. 

Indian Letter of Credit or LOC has a human face. They lend us money on very easy terms. Not only that, in many cases, loans are also converted into grants. In 2010, the first LOC of $ 1 billion was signed between India and Bangladesh. Later, India converted it into a grant of $ 140 million and provided it for the Padma Bridge project. Then in 2015, an agreement of $ 2 billion was signed under the second LOC. Two years later, in 2017, the third LoC of $4.5 billion was signed. Delhi has also waived a total of $1.49 billion from this loan as of June. 

In the three LoCs, 42 infrastructure projects including road and rail connectivity, road construction, etc. were taken up. Of these, 14 projects have been completed. Eight projects are ongoing. The remaining 20 projects are at the stage of hiring consultants, hiring contractors, and preparing project proposals. Various statistics prove that India and Bangladesh are in the best position today under the leadership of Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina and Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Both governments are working for the development of the common people and poverty alleviation. 

But as soon as the Awami League government led by Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina returned to power with huge public support in January, propaganda has started. An attempt is being made to destabilize Bangladesh in the name of boycotting India.

Headline_English: Fake money maker arrested in capital
Content_Enlish:
RAB-3 has arrested Hridoy Matbar (22), a counterfeiter, from Shyampur area of ​​the capital. RAB-3 Staff Officer (Media) Assistant Superintendent of Police Shamim Hossain confirmed this information on Friday (June 7). 
Earlier, he was arrested along with a huge amount of counterfeit notes in a raid conducted on Thursday night. In the raid, a CPU, a monitor, a printer, a router, a paper cutter, 9 fake National Identity Card (NID) cards, photocopies of three fake Indian NID cards and 60,700 taka in counterfeit notes were recovered from Hridoy. 

RAB-3 Staff Officer (Media) Assistant Superintendent of Police Shamim Hossain said, "Hridoy had planned to supply a large amount of counterfeit notes to the market targeting the upcoming Eid-ul-Azha. He used to sell fake notes of 1 lakh taka for 10 to 12 thousand taka, but due to increased demand during Eid, he was selling them for 15 thousand taka."

Headline_English: The country must be protected from those who distort the history of the Liberation War: Nasim
Content_Enlish:
Awami League Joint General Secretary AFM Bahauddin Nasim said, "We will build a non-communal and liberation war-spirited Bangladesh under the leadership of Sheikh Hasina. We have to protect the country from those who distort the history of the liberation war." 
He said this as the chief guest at the prayer and remembrance meeting in memory of the late Manu Majumdar, General Secretary of the Central Committee of the 'Resistance Fighters' Council, an organization of armed protesters of the post-1975 Bangabandhu assassination, and former MP, at the KIB Convention Hall on Friday (June 7). 

Nasim said, "We want to build Bangladesh as a developed, prosperous and corruption-free country. We will protect our thousand-year-old tradition. Now is the right time to know the identity of those who are idealistic people, who love Bangladesh, believe in the spirit of the liberation war, protest and resist against the murderers and those who call them criminals." 

He also said that the position of the resistance fighters is much higher in the eyes of the daughter of the Father of the Nation. There is a sense of responsibility, respect and love for them. Manu Majumdar went to the great National Parliament from the place where Sheikh Hasina has love for them. In the true sense, he was a representative of the resistance fighters. As long as Bangladesh exists, love and respect for the resistance fighters will remain in the hearts of the people. 

The program, chaired by Selim Talukder, President of the Resistance Fighters Council, and moderated by Shafiqul Islam Jinnah, was attended as special guests by - Mrinal Kanti Das, Secretary of the Liberation War Affairs of the Awami League, Dipankar Talukder, member of the Central Executive Council of the Awami League, Sameer Chanda, President of the Farmers League, Camellia Biswas, wife of Manu Majumdar, among others.

Headline_English: New mobile phones cannot be imported duty-free from abroad
Content_Enlish:
From now on, returning passengers will not be able to bring new phones duty-free. Returning passengers will be able to bring two used phones duty-free and one new phone duty-free. Finance Minister Abul Hasan Mahmud Ali raised this proposal in the budget for the fiscal year 2024-25 on Thursday. 
The Finance Minister said in Parliament, instead of releasing two mobile phones without paying all kinds of duties and taxes in the provision mentioned in sub-rule (5) of rule (3) of the Passenger (Unchecked) Baggage (Import) Rules, I recommend replacing the provision of releasing a maximum of two used mobile phones without paying all kinds of duties and taxes and importing 1 new mobile phone subject to paying duties and taxes. 

According to the budget proposal for the fiscal year 2024-25, money will have to be spent from now on collecting [unaccompanied] baggage that is not with passengers at the airport. 

To prevent misuse of baggage brought for business purposes, the budget proposes to release unaccompanied baggage subject to payment of duties and taxes. Under the current rules, passengers can collect their unaccompanied baggage at the airport without any charges. 

In the interest of ‘fair trade’, the Finance Minister has proposed to change this rule and allow clearance of unaccompanied baggage only after payment of duties and taxes.

Headline_English: Israeli attack on UN shelter in Gaza, death toll rises to 35
Content_Enlish:
Israeli airstrikes on a UN school in central Gaza on Thursday killed at least 35 people, local officials said. 
The Israeli military said the UN school it struck was a “Hamas compound”. 
Local journalists told the BBC that an Israeli warplane fired two missiles at an upper-floor classroom in the Nuseirat refugee camp. 

Hamas’s media office accused Israel of “senseless killing”. Ambulances and rescue teams rushed to the scene to remove the dead and wounded to nearby hospitals. 

Videos circulating on social media showed rows of bodies in destroyed classrooms and in front of a morgue. “There have been many wars! We have been displaced countless times. They killed my children while they were sleeping,” a woman injured in the attack is heard screaming in a video. 

Ismail al-Thawabta, the director of Hamas’s media office, denied Israel’s claim that the school was occupied by Hamas. 

“The occupiers are using these fabricated stories to justify the brutal crimes they have committed against countless displaced people,” he told Reuters. 

The Israel Defense Forces (IDF) said in a statement that its warplanes carried out a “precise strike on a Hamas compound behind a UN school in the Nuseirat area.” 

The statement said they killed Hamas and Islamic Jihad “terrorists” who took part in the October 7 attacks in southern Israel that killed 1,200 people and took 250 hostages. 

The Hamas-controlled Health Ministry says at least 36,580 people have been killed in Israeli attacks in Gaza since then. 

The IDF says it took sufficient precautions before the airstrikes “to avoid harming innocent civilians.” 

Earlier, the Israeli military said it had taken “operational control” of the eastern part of the Buraiz refugee camp and the city of Deir al-Balah in central Gaza, where scores of Palestinians were reported killed. 

Residents there reported heavy shelling and the charity Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) said at least 70 bodies – most of them women and children – had been brought to a local hospital since Tuesday.

MSF said its medical team described the conditions at Deir al-Balahr al-Aqsa Hospital, the only functioning healthcare facility remaining in the heart of Gaza, as "unimaginable".

Headline_English: The process of licensing corruption in the budget is unexpected
Content_Enlish:
Transparency International Bangladesh (TIB) has expressed its outrage over the proposed budget for the 2024-25 fiscal year, calling it an unexpected process of giving a license to corruption and providing an opportunity to launder black money in the guise of undisclosed funds. 
In a statement sent to the media on Thursday (June 6), TIB called for the abolition of the opportunity to launder black money. 

The statement said that such a facility to launder black money by paying only 15 percent tax will create a culture of discouraging honest and legitimate taxpayers and not allowing any authority to question the money and assets declared under it will contribute to creating an environment conducive to corruption in the country. At the same time, this facility has turned the promise of zero tolerance against corruption included in the election manifesto of the party in power, which is often repeated by the top leaders of the party, including the head of the government, into a farce. 

TIB Executive Director Dr. Iftekharuzzaman said, the legal complications in declaring undeclared money due to the introduction of the Data Verification System (DVS) and the way in which taxpayers are given ample opportunity to legalize the purchase of flats, apartments or land with 'undeclared money' on the pretext of ignorance is truly disappointing. By guaranteeing such an opportunity to whiten black money, it is as if the government is encouraging corruption and acquiring illegal wealth. Simply put, the government is in a way inviting citizens to become corrupt by guaranteeing impunity. The deep and widespread development of corruption and immorality is being normalized with the lame argument of increasing revenue. 

The statement further said that the provision of paying a maximum of 30 percent tax to honest taxpayers, as opposed to giving an opportunity to whiten black money with only 15 percent tax, is discriminatory and unconstitutional. 

Iftekharuzzaman said, the matter is discriminatory against a good citizen, and at the same time it is tantamount to showing the thumbs up to Article 20(2) of the Constitution. The dream of collecting the expected revenue by making moral compromises in this process will never be realized in the short or long term. A big example of which is that two years ago, an opportunity was given to legalize undisclosed money by paying only 10 percent tax. But there was no such response. Again, although an opportunity was given to bring back money laundered from the country, no one took that opportunity. Therefore, it is not unreasonable to raise questions about whose interest such an opportunity is being kept in the budget. 

Commenting that now is the right time to stop the long-standing unconstitutional practice of providing opportunities to launder black money, the TIB Executive Director further said, "It is hoped that the government will finally withdraw the opportunity to launder black money by showing good sense, foresight, loyalty to the constitution and the rule of law. At the same time, I urge the owners of black money to take effective and accountable steps by investigating the source of their wealth, so that the fruits of the corruption festival can be caught."

Headline_English: Metrorail fares may increase
Content_Enlish:
There is a value-added tax (VAT) waiver on metro rail tickets until June 30. Finance Minister Abul Hasan Mahmud Ali presented the budget for the 2024-25 fiscal year in the National Parliament on Thursday (June 6). There was no mention of extending the VAT waiver period. 
If no decision is made on VAT waiver on metro rail tickets by June 30, 15 percent VAT will be imposed from July 1. Then the metro rail fare may increase. 

The metro rail from Uttara to Agargaon was launched in December 2022. The metro rail has been running in full swing up to Motijheel since last year. Currently, this urban transport system transports about 250,000 passengers every day. 

The National Board of Revenue (NBR) took the initiative to impose VAT on metro rail tickets from the beginning of 2023. On January 22 of that year, Dhaka South VAT Commissionerate Commissioner Shawkat Ali wrote a letter to Dhaka Mass Transit Company Limited (Metrorail Company) calling for the imposition of VAT. 

Later, the NBR held several meetings with the Metrorail authorities. However, the NBR ultimately backed down from imposing VAT. In May 2023, the NBR issued a notification stating that VAT would be waived on Metrorail tickets until June 2024. 

There is currently a VAT waiver on Metrorail tickets, the deadline for which is until June 30. After that, Dhaka Mass Transit Company Limited requested the NBR not to impose VAT. But the NBR is not interested in continuing this waiver facility. Because all types of tax deductions have to be reduced according to the conditions of the International Monetary Fund (IMF). As a result, the NBR expressed its inability to waive VAT. On April 4, the VAT department of the NBR issued an order stating that 15 percent VAT will be levied on metro rail tickets from July 1 of this year. 

The order of the VAT department said that according to Vision-2041, various types of development activities are underway in the country with the goal of reaching the ranks of developed countries. For this, the government has to constantly provide funds, which are mainly collected through direct and indirect taxes. In order to continue providing funds for the huge development activities, the exemptions and benefits provided are being gradually withdrawn, taking into account the capabilities of various sectors, with the aim of transitioning the country to LDC status and raising the tax-GDP ratio to the desired level.

Headline_English: What to do to prevent bone loss
Content_Enlish:
With age, the body shows changes in many ways. From hair loss to skin aging, bone loss is a very common problem. Therefore, after forty-forty-five, you want to take extra precautions to maintain good bone health. 
To prevent bone loss, emphasize foods rich in calcium. Include foods like cheese, milk, soybeans, tofu, yogurt or chickpeas in your diet. Also, include green vegetables in your diet. You should also eat fish, meat, and eggs regularly. 
Keep yourself active at all times. It is better not to sit in one place for a long time. If you work in an office, consciously get up from your chair every hour and move around. Many people stop exercising as they get older. Even if you do not do heavy exercise, do light exercise regularly. 

Be careful about weight. When you gain weight, the weight of the entire body starts falling on the knees. This increases the problem of knee pain. To avoid this problem, it is important to keep your weight under control. 
If there is not enough water supply in the body, the level of fluid in the joints of the bones decreases. This makes the bones brittle. So drink enough water.

Headline_English: Government will rent 4,000 flats to low-income people
Content_Enlish:
Finance Minister Abul Hasan Mahmud Ali has said that 4,032 flats will be built for rent to slum dwellers and low-income people in the coming fiscal year 2024-25. These flats will be built in Tongi area of ​​Gazipur district. The minister said this in his budget speech on Thursday (June 6) that the government has taken such a decision to provide housing facilities to slum dwellers and low-income people.
The finance minister said that rental-based residential flats will be built in Tongi, Gazipur to provide housing facilities to slum dwellers and low-income people. In addition, the government has plans to build similar affordable housing in Shyampur-Kadamtali in Dhaka, Chanpara in Narayanganj and Haringhata in Khulna.

The finance minister said that 7,500 residential flats have been built for government employees in the last 15 years. In the current fiscal year 2023-24, the construction of 4,856 residential flats for government employees is also underway.

In addition, the Finance Minister said that initiatives have been taken to build integrated office buildings in all districts in phases to ensure proper use of land. He said that the construction of integrated office buildings in Madaripur and Manikganj districts has been completed, while it is ongoing in Gopalganj.

The Finance Minister said that plans have been made to develop Gulshan-Banani-Baridhara Lake in Dhaka Metropolitan City and to establish an eco-park in Sector 12 of Purbachal. He said that steps have been taken to invent alternative bricks to burnt bricks, conserve agricultural land and produce environment-friendly construction materials for sustainable infrastructure construction.

Headline_English: Newborn baby stolen from Dhaka Medical College
Content_Enlish:
A newborn baby was stolen from the gynecology department of Dhaka Medical College Hospital. The theft took place on Tuesday (June 4) afternoon. 
Police say that a woman named Sukhi Begum gave birth to twin girls around 7 am today. A woman stole a newborn baby on the pretext of breastfeeding and helping her. 

Inspector Bachchu Mia of Dhaka Medical College Police Outpost said that Sukhi Begum was admitted to the hospital on Monday with labor pains. This morning, the woman gave birth to twin girls. Later, a woman (wearing an orange headscarf) stole a baby from the hospital. Efforts are underway to arrest the thief after seeing the closed circuit camera (CCTV). 

Police sources said that the two newborn babies were with their grandmother Hasina Begum and father Shariful. A woman took the baby from the father on the pretext of helping her. She kept it with him for some time. In this way, she developed a relationship with the grandmother and father. Once, she escaped with a child, bypassing their security cordon and escaping. 

Shariful Islam, the father of the stolen child, said that he met a woman at the gate of the women's ward. Men are not allowed to enter that ward. Taking this opportunity, the woman took the child and fled, saying that she would breastfeed it from the mother. 

Sukhi is a resident of Banshgram in Kumarkhali upazila of Kushtia district. Her husband Shariful Islam is a truck driver's assistant. They currently live in Dhamrai Kalampur.

Headline_English: Two World Cup-winning cricketers win Indian elections
Content_Enlish:
Two World Cup-winning cricketers Kirti Azad and Yusuf Pathan have won the Lok Sabha elections in India. These two World Cup-winning cricketers have won by contesting for West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee's Trinamool Congress party. 
Yusuf Pathan is a newcomer to the political arena. Yusuf has won the Berhampur constituency by defeating five-time MP Adhir Ranjan Chowdhury. He won by more than 80,000 votes. 
On the other hand, Kirti Azad won the Burdwan-Durgapur constituency by defeating five-time MP Dilip Ghosh of the BJP by a huge margin. Kirti defeated Dilip by 1,37,564 votes. He got 7,20,667 votes. Dilip Ghosh got 5,82,686 votes. 
Kirti won the World Cup in 1883 under the leadership of Kapil Dev. And Yusuf got the taste of two World Cup victories under the leadership of Dhoni. The T20 World Cup in 2007 and the ODI World Cup in 2011.

Headline_English: BJP 228, Congress 88 in 500 seats results
Content_Enlish:
The final results of the 500 seats in the Indian Lok Sabha elections have been declared so far. Of these, the ruling party BJP has won 228. The main opposition Congress has won 88 seats. 
Among other parties, the Samajwadi Party (SP) has won 36, the Trinamool Congress 28, the DMK 16, the Janata Dal (JD-U) 12, the Telugu Desam Party (TDP) 12, the Shiv Sena (Udbh) 7, the Shiv Sena (SHS) 7, the CPI (M) 4 and the Aam Aadmi Party 3 have won. 

This information has been given on the website of the Election Commission of India. According to the information on the website, the BJP is leading in 12 seats. The Congress is leading in 11 seats. The Samajwadi Party (SP) is leading in one seat. The Trinamool Congress, the party of West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee, is leading in one seat. 

The results obtained so far confirm that the BJP is not able to come to power alone. Out of the total 543 seats in the Lok Sabha, 272 seats are required to form a government. Even if the BJP wins the seats in which it is ahead, the number of seats is less than that. 

In the last Lok Sabha elections, the BJP won 303 seats on its own. The then BJP-led alliance NDA won 352 seats. However, it is expected that even if the BJP wins this election, it will not get a single majority. In that case, the BJP will have to rely on its NDA alliance partners. 

The main NDA alliance partners are Chandrababu Naidu's Telugu Desam Party in Andhra Pradesh and Chief Minister Nitish Kumar's Janata Dal-United (JD-U) in Bihar. 

Apart from these two parties, the BJP will have to rely on several other NDA partners. These include the Shiv Sena's Sindh faction in Maharashtra, the Lok Janshakti Party in Bihar and the Rashtriya Lok Dal in Uttar Pradesh. 

In the last elections, the Congress won 52 seats on its own. And the then Congress-led UPA alliance won 94 seats.
