Headline_English: Worker dies in lightning strike in Kuakata
Content_Enlish: A worker named Zakir Fakir has died in a lightning strike in Kalapara, Patuakhali. The worker died in Khalilpur village of Nilganj UP of the upazila around 5 pm on Monday. The deceased Zakir is the son of Motaleb Fakir of Mustafapur village of the same UP. Local UP member Zahir said that Zakir was working at Rezaul's house in Khalilpur village near the highway in heavy rain. But he was injured when a sudden lightning strike struck. Later, he was rescued and taken to Kalapara Hospital, where the doctor on duty declared Zakir dead. Kalapara Police Station Officer-in-Charge Ali Ahmed said that police have been sent to the spot. Legal action will be taken later.

Headline_English: Uber driver gets angry after being asked to turn on the AC!
Content_Enlish:
Many people have strange experiences while going somewhere in Uber or Pathao. And they share those incidents on social media. Now an Indian man shared a bitter experience on social media X. In which the Uber driver behaved very angrily with him. 

Indian media outlet NDTV says that a doctor named Atharva Dawar shared a video on social media X. In it, he can be seen telling the Uber driver to turn on the AC of the car. But the driver did not turn on the AC. 

When asked why the AC was not turned on, Atharva Dawar said that the driver got angry. The Uber driver got angry and started talking to him. 

In this regard, Atharva Dawar said, 'I did not get into my friend's car because it did not have AC. Instead, I called an Uber, which has AC. But the AC was not turned on in that one either. He got angry and started speaking in Kannada.'

Headline_English: Bangladesh bats with Liton in place, Tamim out
Content_Enlish:
Bangladesh have toured the United States to play a three-match T20 series against the host nation to improve their standing ahead of the T20 World Cup. USA captain Mayank Patel won the toss and invited Bangladesh to bat first in the first match of the series at the Prairie View Cricket Complex in Houston today. 

Bangladesh previously played a five-match series against Zimbabwe. Tanjid Hasan Tamim was dropped from the playing XI for the fifth match of the series, which they won 4-1. Liton Das and Shariful Islam have returned to the playing XI. 

Liton was dismissed for 1, 23 and 12 runs respectively in the first three matches of the Zimbabwe series. He was dropped from the last two matches of the series due to poor form. The 29-year-old wicketkeeper-batsman is getting a chance to return to form before the start of the World Cup. 

Bangladesh XI: Liton Das, Soumya Sarkar, Shakib Al Hasan, Nazmul Hossain Shanto (captain), Towhid Hridoy, Mahmudullah Riyad, Zaker Ali Anik, Mehedi Hasan, Rishad Hossain, Mostafizur Rahman and Shariful Islam.

Headline_English: Data speed increased, call drops decreased: Robi
Content_Enlish:
Telecom operator Robi is investing in expanding and strengthening its network to improve service quality. This has increased data speed and voice call quality. The number of call drops has also decreased. In an interview with Independent Television, Robi's Chief Technology Officer Perihan Elhami Ahmed said that 3G services will be discontinued this year as 4G subscribers are increasing rapidly. 
Robi, the country's second largest mobile operator with 58.2 million subscribers. More than 75 percent of its customers use data, which is the highest among mobile operators. Out of Robi's nearly 45 million data subscribers, 35.5 million are using 4G. 

Robi has added 577 new 4G sites in the first quarter of this year to strengthen its network. The telecom sector company is also conducting trials of 5G technology in different areas of the country. A recent conversation with Robi's Chief Technology Officer at its headquarters revealed that they are continuing to invest in improving customer service. 

Robi's Chief Technology Officer Perihan Elhami Ahmed said, "We are continuously investing. Last year, 2,600 MHz waves were installed to increase the network's capacity for data traffic management. During this time, we added 1,000 more tower sites. Almost half of the sites now run on solar power, which has reduced carbon emissions by 3,000 tons per year." 

Despite strengthening the network, Robi's CTO said that there are still customer complaints about data services and voice calls, as people in some areas have negative perceptions about tower radiation, which poses challenges in ensuring network stability. 

Perihan Elhami Ahmed said, "There are obstacles to installing towers in some areas due to people's lack of awareness. Still, Robi is improving its customer service through innovation and new technologies. Last year, Robi's data network speed increased by 130 percent and voice call speeds improved by 50 percent. Call drops have dropped below 0.5 percent in most areas. 

In the first quarter of this year, Robi deposited Tk 1,605.5 crore into the state treasury. During this period, the company invested Tk 3.66 crore in capital equipment.

Headline_English: No domestic or foreign power controls Sheikh Hasina.
Content_Enlish:
Awami League General Secretary Obaidul Quader has commented that no domestic or foreign power controls Sheikh Hasina. He said these things at a rally in Tejgaon in the capital on Friday to mark Sheikh Hasina's Homecoming Day. 
At that time, the Awami League General Secretary said that the people of the country control the Awami League. Sheikh Hasina is the courageous figure of a changed Bangladesh. Sheikh Hasina, the daughter of Bangabandhu, has freed the country's democracy from discipline. 

Obaidul Quader also said that there is no point in threatening in the name of foreign power. Because Sheikh Hasina does not care about anyone except the people. 

Stating that there is no need for external power if we are our own enemies, Quader said, "All those who have violated party discipline will be brought under punishment."

Headline_English: Shakib will play in the World Cup and IPL in the United States.
Content_Enlish:
IPL, PSL, CPL, LPL... Shakib Al Hasan has played in almost all the franchise leagues. He did not play in the United Arab Emirates franchise league IL T20 and South Africa's SA T20, however, the timing of these two leagues, which started in two or three months last year, conflicts with the BPL, so Shakib has less opportunity to play there. 

And the remaining one was the United States' Major League Cricket (MLC), where Shakib has not played before. His wait is about to end. After the World Cup, several franchise leagues including Sri Lanka's LPL and the United States' MLC are going to start. Today, in the MLC, the 'sister concern' of IPL team Kolkata Knight Riders, Los Angeles Knight Riders, announced that Shakib is joining their team! 

Since the IPL franchises have bought teams in the leagues of the United States, South Africa and the United Arab Emirates, they are considered an extended version of the IPL. As such, Shakib, who did not play in the IPL this time, is going to the US 'IPL.' 

Shakib is currently in the United States with the team to play the T20 World Cup. Shakib will have the opportunity to play in the United States for a few more days after the T20 World Cup to be held in the United States and the West Indies next month! 

He did not enter the auction of the ongoing IPL. He was on a long break from cricket due to national elections and a finger injury. He did not enter the Pakistan PSL either. As a result, many thought that Shakib would not be seen in franchise cricket again. 

However, before the start of the World Cup, news of his joining the LA Knight Riders came today. The franchise confirmed the Bangladeshi left-handed all-rounder joining the team through their social media. 

Major League Cricket team Los Angeles Knight Riders is owned by IPL's Kolkata Knight Riders. Shakib has won two titles for Kolkata in the IPL. 

Shakib will be teamed up with Andre Russell and Sunil Narine, who played for Kolkata in the IPL. According to the schedule, Los Angeles Knight Riders will play their first match against Texas Super Kings on July 5.

Headline_English: Case against Allu Arjun
Content_Enlish:
A case has been filed against Kshini star Allu Arjun. The police filed the case against him on Saturday (May 11) for violating the election rules. 
According to a report in Hindustan Times, on May 11, actor Allu Arjun went to the house of his friend and YSRCP MLA Shilpa Ravi Chandra Reddy in Nandyal, Andhra Pradesh. People came to know that Allu Arjun had come to the MLA's house. A crowd gathered there to see him. Fans were desperate to catch a glimpse of him. 
After the actor's arrival, a large crowd gathered outside the MLA's house. Later, Allu Arjun greeted the fans by waving from the balcony. During this, they were loudly chanting slogans of Pushpa, Pushpa. 
The allegation against actor and YSRCP MLA Ravichandran Kishore Reddy is that the MLA Reddy invited Allu Arjun for a rally on Saturday without prior permission. 
As a result, a case has been filed against them for violating the election rules. The case has been registered by Deputy Tehsildar P Ramachandra Rao. He is posted in charge of the elections in Nandyal constituency of Andhra Pradesh. Allu Arjun then clarified that he had gone to Nandyal to help his friend and does not support any political party.

Headline_English: AI users have doubled in the last six months
Content_Enlish:
The time is now for artificial intelligence or AI. Since AI entered the world of technology, its use has increased in various tasks. According to the annual report of the last Microsoft and LinkedIn '2024 Work Trend Index', the number of AI users has almost doubled in the last six months. About 75 percent of workers involved in improving their skills worldwide are using AI. The report said that due to the increase in the speed and volume of work, employees have now increased their reliance on AI programs at the personal level. While company executives have recognized the importance of AI for their businesses, many feel a lack of clear understanding of how to formulate effective strategies to get results from it. 
A survey conducted by Microsoft showed that 90 percent of users who use AI tools say that this program saves them time. In addition, 85 percent of users can focus on important tasks. 

84 percent of AI users say that AI users have become more creative. In addition, 83 percent think that they enjoy their work.

Headline_English: Unable to pass, student jumps from multi-storey building
Content_Enlish: A student named Katha Saha jumped from the fourth floor of a building in Mohammadpur, Magura, after failing to pass the SSC exam. Locals rescued her and admitted her to Faridpur Medical College Hospital in serious condition. She died while undergoing treatment there. The incident took place at Rimpi Saha's house in Magura district town on Sunday (May 12) afternoon. The deceased, Katha Saha (16), is the daughter of Rajesh Saha of Binodpur village in Mohammadpur, Magura. Mohammadpur Police Station OC Borhan Ul Islam said that Katha Saha took this year's SSC exam. When the exam results were announced on Sunday afternoon, she failed in one subject. After learning about the matter, she committed suicide by jumping from the fourth floor of the building. She is a student of Binodpur Girls' School.

Headline_English: Fugitive accused in Satkhira war crimes case arrested in Comilla
Content_Enlish: War criminal Abu Bakkar Siddique (80), who was on warrant in a case of War Crimes Tribunal-1, has been arrested. A team of RAB-11, CPC-2 Comilla arrested him in a special operation in the North Rampur area of ​​Sadar Dakshin Upazila of Comilla on Sunday (May 12) night. Arrested Abu Bakkar Siddique is the son of the deceased Mandar Sardar of the North Kadamtala area of ​​Shyamnagar Upazila of Satkhira. Company Commander Lt. Commander Mahmudul Hasan gave this information at a press briefing at the RAB-11, CPC-2 Comilla office on Monday (May 13) afternoon. He also said at the press conference that Abu Bakkar Siddique, an accused in a war crime case, has been absconding for a long time. Based on a secret tip-off, he was arrested in a raid at his son-in-law's house in the North Rampur area of ​​Sadar Dakshin Upazila. It was informed at the press conference that he will be handed over to Shyamnagar Police Station.

Headline_English: Most exciting day in New York court, Trump's 'enemy' testifies
Content_Enlish:
Former US President Donald Trump and Stormy Daniels have been awaiting trial for a long time in an alleged sex scandal. Trump is being tried in a New York court on charges of paying bribes to cover up his own sex scandal. According to a live report by the BBC, today is the most exciting day in court. Trump's once close and former lawyer Michael Cohen has come to testify in court today. Currently, the relationship between the two of them is at its lowest point. The BBC says that Trump and Cohen are currently in the same courtroom. Cohen has started testifying in the courtroom. He said, "I worked directly for Trump." 
At this time, he mentioned that Trump offered him this job. Cohen said, "I solved many of Trump's problems. Trump had no email or cell phone. I spoke directly to Trump." Cohen also said that he sometimes lied for Trump. As of this writing, Cohen is still testifying in court and is being questioned by prosecutors. Prosecutors said two more witnesses will be called and the case could be settled this week. Earlier, the BBC reported that Trump faces 34 criminal charges of falsifying business records. One of them was that Cohen paid Daniels $130,000 to keep her quiet about her affair with Trump.

Headline_English: Awami League government has made radical changes in the medical field: Nanak
Content_Enlish: Textile and Apparel Minister and Awami League Presidium Member Advocate Jahangir Kabir Nanak said that after the Awami League came to power, there has been a radical change in the country's medical system. Today, health care has reached the doorsteps of the people. He said these things as the chief guest at the inauguration ceremony of 'Alliance Hospital' in Shyamoli in the capital on Monday (May 13) night. The minister said that these days, even the people of the village do not have to go to the city for treatment. It has all the facilities at the upazila level. Along with government hospitals, private hospitals have come forward as people's medical treatment. The poor and suffering people of the society are getting treatment in government hospitals. Now no one is being deprived of medical services. Another Awami League Presidium Member and Fisheries and Livestock Minister Abdur Rahman said at the ceremony that all doctors should come forward to provide medical services to the common people. Along with government hospitals, private hospitals have a responsibility. You will fulfill that responsibility. Awami League Organizing Secretary Ahmed Hossain MP also spoke at the inauguration ceremony of the hospital. Hospital doctors, officials and employees, local councilors, and ward Awami League leaders and activists were present at the event.

Headline_English: Netherlands and Bangladesh join forces to ensure healthy food
Content_Enlish:
The issue of food adulteration in Bangladesh is not unknown to anyone. In such a context, Fargo Private Limited has started a joint venture between the Netherlands and Bangladesh to produce and market healthy food products according to the standards of the World Health Organization. Hamidul H Khan, Managing Director of Fargo Private Limited, gave details about this at a press conference in Dhaka on Tuesday (May 14). Netherlands Agriculture, Food and Environment Expert Elle Jan Saf was present. On the occasion of the official inauguration, Bangladesh Ambassador to the Netherlands Riaz Hamidullah welcomed the joint venture of Fargo Private Limited in a video greeting message. It was said at the press conference that the Netherlands is the world's best in food and agricultural product production and processing technology after the United States. That is why this joint venture with the Netherlands. This initiative will accelerate the process of ensuring the supply of quality healthy food products in Bangladesh by developing food production and processing technology, ensuring traceability and compliance. This joint venture will also enrich food and agricultural product export activities in Europe and the Middle East. The entrepreneurs said that Solidarity of the Netherlands and Syngenta Foundation of Switzerland, which work in more than forty countries around the world with safe, natural and 100% chemical and poison-free farming. Fargo procures fruits and vegetables from trained Bangladeshi farmers of these organizations. In addition, it procures healthy dried fruits, spices and other safe and nutritious foods from marginal farmers and entrepreneurs trained in eco-friendly agriculture by domestic organizations PKSF and IFAD, USAID, World Bank and other international organizations. The entrepreneurs also said that Fargo is determined to play a leading role in Bangladesh and the world as a specialized and knowledge-based healthy food product production and marketing organization. Hamidul Haque said at the event that non-communicable diseases have posed a serious threat to public health in Bangladesh. These diseases have increased the medical expenses of the common people many times over. The World Health Organization (WHO) has identified five components of a healthy diet to prevent the spread of non-communicable diseases such as cancer, kidney, liver and heart diseases, type 2 diabetes, high blood pressure, overweight and obesity. These are whole grains, quality protein, plant-based oils, fruits and vegetables and safe water. Fargo is establishing local and international collaborations and partnerships to ensure the recommended food products. Fargo's goal is to ensure a quality life through healthy food. 

The program featured a PowerPoint presentation on food safety and various diseases and premature deaths caused by eating unsafe food. The organization started its activities in 2020. Hamidul Haque said that the organization is working with more than 136 food products. 

Netherlands Agriculture, Food and Environment Expert Elle Jan Saf said, "We have turned this joint organization that started in Bangladesh into a global organization. We will ensure healthy food using modern technology from Europe. "We want to bring more investment in this sector to Bangladesh. We want Bangladesh to be presented in a new way to the world."

Headline_English: No one new was hired to value Liton's experience: Shant
Content_Enlish:
Wicketkeeper-batter Liton Das has only crossed the age of thirty once after playing 6 T20 matches this year. Not only in T20s, but in the other two formats as well, this batsman is in the same situation. Nevertheless, Bangladesh has announced the World Cup squad by keeping him in it, considering his experience. Bangladesh will leave the country at 1:40 am on Thursday (May 15). Before that, an official photo session and press conference were held this afternoon. When Liton was mentioned in the press conference, Shanto said that he has been kept in the team for his experience. 
Shanto said, 'Liton is a very important cricketer for us. A few series went badly. But we did not want a new player now. We have given importance to experience. We hope he will return well.' Yesterday, the selection panel announced the 15-member T20 World Cup squad with Liton Das in it. Another wicketkeeper-batter, Enamul Haque Bijoy, was also considered instead of Liton due to his lack of form. But Liton survived in the race to the end. Chief selector Gazi Ashraf Hossain Lipu tried to explain that. ‘If Liton is to be replaced, a wicketkeeper will also have to be taken. If we only considered the opener, a different name might have come up. We have discussed the name of Enamul Haque Bijoy. Despite his lack of form, we have confidence in Liton.’ Liton has played 6 T20 matches this year. He has only managed to score more than thirty (36) runs once. In the remaining matches, Liton’s runs were 0, 7, 1, 23 and 12. After failing in the last match against Zimbabwe, Liton was out after playing one shot three times in a row. 

Shanto expects Liton to return to form quickly and do well. Whether he can do that or not remains to be seen.

Headline_English: Imran Khan to remain in jail despite being granted bail in corruption case
Content_Enlish:
Former Pakistani Prime Minister Imran Khan was granted bail on Wednesday in a land corruption case. However, even if he gets bail, he will have to remain in jail in two other cases. His lawyer said this. Reuters reports. Imran Khan and his wife have been accused of illegally accepting gifts of land. The charges say that he took the land from a real estate developer while he was in power from 2018 to 22. Imran's party lawyer Naeem Haider Panjutha confirmed the bail on social media X. He also said that he was in prison in two other cases. One of the two cases is for leaking state secrets and the other for marrying in violation of Islamic law. However, Imran Khan, the founder of the Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf, has been in jail since August last year. Although he was found guilty in a total of four cases, his sentence has been suspended in two cases. 

Imran Khan was ousted from power in a parliamentary no-confidence vote in 2022. Since then, dozens of cases have been filed against him, including charges of inciting violence against the state. 

His wife Bushra Bibo is also in jail for illegally marrying Imran Khan in 2018. 

He was granted bail on Wednesday in the Al Qadir Trust case, a non-governmental welfare organization he and his wife founded while in power. 

In a statement after the bail, Imran Khan’s party’s media wing said that the land was not used for personal gain but for a “religious and scientific” educational institution. The cases were filed primarily to keep him in prison and prevent him from contesting national elections.

Headline_English: Results of 18th teacher registration published, pass rate about 36 percent
Content_Enlish:
The results of the 18th teacher registration preliminary examination have been published. 4 lakh 79 thousand 981 people passed it at the school and college levels. The average pass rate among the participating candidates is 35.80 percent. The results were published on the website of the Non-Government Teachers Registration and Certification Authority (NTRCA) at around 7:30 pm on Wednesday (May 15). The notification regarding the publication of the results by NTRCA said that the preliminary examination for the 18th teacher registration was held on March 15. 18 lakh 65 thousand 719 people applied to participate in it. However, 13 lakh 40 thousand 833 people participated in the examination. 

4 lakh 79 thousand 981 people passed the preliminary examination by getting the prescribed marks. Of these, 29 thousand 519 people at the school-2 level, 2 lakh 21 thousand 652 people at the school level and 2 lakh 28 thousand 813 people at the college level. The average pass rate in this examination is 35.80 percent. 

By logging into the NTRCA website, candidates can check their exam results using their registration exam roll and batch number. In addition, Teletalk will send the results to the candidates' mobile numbers via SMS. 

Earlier, the 18th Teacher Registration School/Equivalent Level and School Level-2 Preliminary Examination was held on March 15.

Headline_English: Aren't you damaging your brain by being overly busy?
Content_Enlish: Are you immersed in work all day? Sitting at home, thinking about office work, what to do at home while sitting at the office? Have you ever thought that this busyness or excessive work thinking is actually a symptom of a disease. According to experts, it is good to be busy. However, if you are thinking about work all the time, it is called 'time famine'. Such busyness is a threat to your mental health. You will start losing yourself by missing out on chatting, spending time with friends, and attending various social events. However, make some changes in your life to handle this complex situation. If you only leave out sleep time, you will be doing some work all the time, forgetting to eat and drink. Although it may sound good, this habit is not good for the brain. According to psychiatrists, no one likes monotonous work. Therefore, it is necessary to take breaks in between work. As it is good for the body, the quality of work also improves. So, manage your time properly in the rush of various tasks at home and outside. Not a single work outside the specified time. Learn to enjoy yourself by taking out a little time in the rush of thousands of busyness. Take a break from work sometimes and go somewhere. If you don't have time at all, go to the movies or eat somewhere after office hours. Don't get caught up in housework right after office work. Give yourself some time every now and then. Give yourself a gift. After a good job or a hard day's work, buy your favorite food. Or if you want, sit in a parlor or salon and give yourself a little rest. One day, instead of buying a bus or train ticket, call a car. Above all, take care of yourself. Ultimately, the responsibility of keeping yourself well is yours.

Headline_English: Bangladesh won the series with two matches to spare
Content_Enlish:
Two consecutive wins. So Bangladesh had a chance to win the series in the third match. That's what the Tigers did. Bangladesh defeated Zimbabwe by 9 runs in the third match of the five-match T20 series. With this, Nazmul Hasan Shanto's team won the series with two matches in hand. On Tuesday (May 7), Zimbabwe captain Sikandar Raja won the toss and sent Bangladesh to bat at the Zahur Ahmed Chowdhury Stadium in Chittagong. Coming out to bat, the Tigers were under pressure at the beginning. However, Bangladesh lost 5 wickets to the bat of Towhid Hridoy and Zaker Ali and scored 165 runs. 
Hridoy scored 57 runs off 38 balls and Zaker Ali scored 44 runs off 34 balls. Blessing Muzarbani took 3 wickets for Zimbabwe. 
Batting at a target of 166 runs, Zimbabwe lost the wicket of Joylord Gambhir at the beginning. He was out for 9 runs off 8 balls for the team's 16 runs. Mohammad Saifuddin brought back the Zimbabwean opener. 

Then Brian Bennett returned to the crease. The batsman was dismissed by Tanjim Shakib for 5 runs off 8 balls. After his departure, Craig Ervine was dismissed. 

Ervine was dismissed for 7 runs off 7 balls for 33 runs. Zimbabwe lost three wickets in the beginning and was under pressure. The visitors kept losing wickets at regular intervals due to the bowling of the Tiger bowlers. Zimbabwe lost another 5 wickets to collect 58 runs and were eliminated from the match. 

In the end, Faraz Akram's innings of 34 runs off 19 balls sealed the match. However, Zimbabwe was able to collect 156 runs for the loss of 9 wickets in 20 overs with the controlled bowling of the Tiger bowlers. Saifuddin took 3 wickets for Bangladesh.

Headline_English: RU student dies after being bitten by Russell Viper snake
Content_Enlish:
A student of Rajshahi University has died after being bitten by a venomous 'Russell Viper' snake. He was bitten by the snake on the banks of the Padma on Monday (May 6) evening. He died that night while undergoing treatment at the Intensive Care Unit (ICU) of Rajshahi Medical College Hospital. The deceased student's name is Shakinur Rahman Sabbir. He is a student of the university's Department of Psychology for the 2016-17 academic year. His village is in Charghat Upazila of Rajshahi. Sabbir's friend Rakibul Islam told reporters in this regard, "After Maghrib prayers, some friends were sitting and chatting on the banks of the Padma adjacent to Moktar Bazar. We were all eating jilapi there. After eating jilapi, one of us threw away the paper packet. When Sabbir picked up the paper from the packet to wipe his hands, the venomous Russell Viper bit him. Then we killed the snake and took him to the hospital within half an hour. But in the end, he could not be saved. 

Brigadier General Shamim Ahmed, director of Rajshahi Medical College Hospital, said that the cause of death of the Rajshahi University student who died was the bite of a Russell viper snake. If someone is bitten by this snake, the chances of survival are very low. He was kept in the ICU. However, it was not possible to save him. 

Professor of the Department of Psychology at RU, Dr. Enamul Haque, said that Sabbir came from Charghat and used to attend classes at the university and tutor on the banks of the Padma. That is where he was bitten by a poisonous snake.

Headline_English: Biden cautious about Rafah operation due to Israeli hostages
Content_Enlish:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is under international pressure to launch an operation in Rafah, the last refuge of besieged Gazans. Israeli hostages are believed to be held in the area. Therefore, Netanyahu has to think about the safety of his own prisoners if he is to launch an operation to defeat Hamas. In addition to international pressure, Netanyahu has to deal with domestic pressure in the country. According to a Reuters report, the families of 130 Israelis held by Hamas and their supporters have taken to the streets. They have been protesting against Netanyahu's government and demanding a ceasefire with Hamas to return the hostages. 

Others are demanding that the government and the Israel Defense Forces put pressure on the remaining Hamas positions around the city in addition to the Rafah operation. The demand began after rocket attacks and fighting this week. 

The name of the group representing the families of Israeli military personnel who want to pressure Hamas to surrender is Mothers of IDF Soldiers. “We applaud the Israeli government and the IDF for going to Rafah. We think this is how negotiations should be conducted in the Middle East,” said Mirit Hoffman, a spokeswoman for the group. 

The United States, Israel’s main ally and arms supplier, recently announced a halt to supplies. The concern has divided Israel’s centrist ministers and religious nationalist hardliners determined to eliminate Hamas from Gaza. 

Hamas, however, assured Netanyahu this week that it had accepted a ceasefire proposal involving an exchange of Israeli prisoners for Palestinian prisoners. It is progressing under Egyptian mediation. 

But Israeli officials have rejected the proposal. They have accused Hamas of changing the terms of the deal. But neither side has stopped talks and diplomacy continues.

Headline_English: One dies of dengue, 22 hospitalized
Content_Enlish: One person has died of dengue fever in the country in the last 24 hours. In addition, 22 more people have been admitted to various hospitals across the country due to dengue. This information was given in a dengue press release sent by the Health Emergency Operation Center and Control Room of the Directorate General of Health Services on Wednesday (May 8). It said that 22 people have been admitted to hospitals in the country due to dengue in the last 24 hours. Of them, seven are in Barisal division, five in Chittagong division, two in Dhaka division, two in Dhaka North City Corporation, three in Dhaka South City Corporation, one in Mymensingh division and two in Rajshahi division. A total of 19 dengue patients have been discharged from hospitals across the country in the last 24 hours. A total of 2,205 patients have been discharged this year.

Headline_English: No one can separate me from the people: Prime Minister
Content_Enlish:
Prime Minister and Leader of Parliament Sheikh Hasina said in Parliament that no one can separate her from the people. My only strength is the people. I move with their strength. A trust has been created among the people that, 'I work for them. Therefore, this trust and faith is my only resource. And I move with this resource. That is why I do not care about anyone. As long as my countrymen are by my side, I do not care about anyone.' Prime Minister and Leader of Parliament Sheikh Hasina said this in the concluding speech of the second session of the 12th National Parliament today. At that time, Speaker Dr. Shirin Sharmin Chaudhury presided over the session. The Prime Minister said, we work for the welfare of the people of the country. The countrymen are getting the benefits of the work we have done, she admits that. But if every work is (attempted) to question it, then what can you do about it, you cannot distance me from the people. The Prime Minister said, 'Yes, I know, the same thing happened to my father too. In just three and a half years, from giving the constitution to the establishment of the government, there is no sector for which he has not laid the foundation. Even then, attempts have been made to isolate him from the people by criticizing him, writing various things against him, and doing many things. When he could not, he was killed. 

Sheikh Hasina said, there have been repeated attempts to kill me. But I survived because my people and party leaders and activists have always surrounded me. They have saved my life with their lives. Now I want to continue working for the people and I am working. 

The Prime Minister said that the amount of work that her government has done in the past 15 years, others have not been able to do even in 29 years. They cannot because they earn money by giving projects first. And we leave after completing the projects, there is no opportunity to earn money. This is the reality. 

At that time, referring to the withdrawal of World Bank money on false corruption allegations at the beginning of the construction of the Padma Bridge, she said that she had challenged their allegations that there was no corruption here and the World Bank could not prove the allegations of corruption either. 

He pointed to the opposition leader's statement regarding the relatively higher expenditure on various mega projects in the country compared to other countries, saying, "This is our delta. Since the land here is soft, more money is spent on any infrastructure project. 

Some things that you have created (have been left behind). A culture has been created and left behind since the time of Ziaur Rahman, there is a little of that, we are trying to overcome that," he said.

Headline_English: State Minister for Power hints at load shedding in Dhaka
Content_Enlish:
State Minister for Power, Energy and Mineral Resources Nasrul Hamid has said that load shedding will be provided in Dhaka and surrounding areas if necessary. He said this at a briefing at his residence in Baridhara in the capital on Friday (May 10). The State Minister for Power said that the price of oil will decrease or increase every month. In line with this, the price of electricity will also decrease or increase four times a year. This is because the government is planning to gradually exit the electricity subsidy. Nasrul Hamid also said that preparations are in place for the upcoming heatwave. If funds are provided on time, there will be no problem. If necessary, load shedding will be provided in Dhaka and surrounding areas. 

He also said that there is a plan to renovate the old Titas line. If this renovation is done, the suffering due to gas will be reduced. Besides, electricity will be available from the two nuclear plants by the end of next year. 

Regarding the increase in the price of the dollar, he said that increasing the price of the dollar will create additional pressure on electricity and fuel. The matter will be discussed with the Governor of Bangladesh Bank.

Headline_English: Police chase 35-year-old job seekers during program, 15 arrested
Content_Enlish: The protesters faced police obstruction while marching from Dhaka University towards Ganabhaban demanding that the age limit for entering government jobs be raised to 35. At one stage, they blocked Shahbagh intersection. After staying there for half an hour, the protesters dispersed in a police chase. The incident took place on Saturday (May 11) at around 4 pm. At that time, the protesters claimed that at least 15 people were detained from the blockade. Joint convener of the Students' Coordination Council expecting the age limit to be 35 for applying for jobs, Md. Harun said, "The police have detained several of our comrades. In addition, the police have lathi-charged several people. We have called on the police administration and demand the immediate release of our comrades. At the same time, we are still adamant in our demands. We will not return home until our demands are implemented. The detainees are - Nur Mohammad Nur of Government Bangla College, Humayun Kabir of Jagannath University, Manik Das of Shaheed Suhrawardy College, Md. Russell, Sheikh Farid of Begum Rokeya University, Azam Mohammad of Pabna Science and Technology University, Abdul Hakim of Dhaka University, Mamunur Rashid and Saddam Hossain of Dhaka College, Rima Akhter of Narsingdi Government College, Brishti of Rajshahi University, Al Amin and Sultana Siddiqui of Sonargaon University. In addition, two more people were arrested later. Ramna Zone ADC Shah Alam Mohammad Akhtarul Islam said that despite the ban, they were creating a chaotic environment by stopping their cars. Some people have been arrested in this incident. If they are found involved in the incident during interrogation, legal action will be taken against them.

Headline_English: 'The government will take all kinds of steps to advance the country's cinema'
Content_Enlish:
State Minister for Information and Broadcasting Mohammad Ali Arafat has said that the government will take all kinds of steps to advance the country's cinema. The State Minister said this while speaking as the chief guest at the BFDA Award ceremony at the Hall of Fame of the Bangabandhu International Conference Center in the capital on Saturday (May 11) evening. The Bangladesh Film Directors Association (BFDA) has presented this award for the first time for contribution and excellence in various fields in recognition of the production of full-length Bengali films released in theaters and web films released through domestic OTT in 2022-2023. The State Minister for Information and Broadcasting said that cinema is a very powerful medium. The government will do everything on the basis of discussions with stakeholders and taking their opinions into account to create an environment to take this medium forward with more strength in Bangladesh. It is possible to showcase Bangladesh on the face of the world through cinema. He said, the FDC (Film Development Corporation) was established on the initiative of the Father of the Nation Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman and through FDC, our artistes and directors who were involved in films have repaid him. Our films played a huge role in the path of progress in the Liberation War. Our films played a role in various stages after the Liberation War. He further said, with the development of technology, many changes have occurred in society, which are positive changes. These changes have become challenges for us in many areas. In the case of our films, these changes have seemingly become challenges. We have to work on how we can change this challenge into an opportunity. 

The State Minister said, if the country's cinema halls are not economically profitable, films will face problems. If the cinema halls remain operational and people can be brought in, then it is possible to solve the problems of films. Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has given instructions on the construction of cineplexes and multipurpose cinema halls in different places across Bangladesh and how to make them economically profitable. The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting is working on this. 

98048f7c-9661-4796-a408-ae2f43c5939b 

Good quality films made in the country are beating Hollywood or other countries' films in the country's theaters. This country's films have that ability. While making films in Bangladesh, producers often go abroad and take modern technological facilities. Because these facilities are not available in the country. If we can provide these facilities in the country, modernize FDC and other related institutions, then FDC and other institutions will be commercially profitable. For this, he said, the government is working on making FDC or other such institutions commercially profitable. 

Senior Secretary of the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting Md. Humayun Kabir Khondoker was present as a special guest at the program presided over by Bangladesh Film Directors Association President Kazi Hayat. The welcoming remarks were delivered by Nuzhat Yasmin, Managing Director of Bangladesh Film Development Corporation, Masud Ur Rashid, Managing Director of private organization Swapnadhara, and Dr. Mahfuzur Rahman, Chairman of private satellite televisions ATN Bangla and ATN News. Headline_English: ACC files case against 7 people including chairman for embezzlement
Content_Enlish:
The ACC has filed a case against UP Chairman Badal and Project Implementation Officer Humayun Kabir, including seven others, in Jamalpur's Sarishabari on charges of embezzling Tk 6.5 million without completing government projects. Deputy Director of the ACC's Jamalpur branch office, Malay Kumar Saha, confirmed the matter on Wednesday (May 1) afternoon. The accused in the case are Borhan Uddin Badal (60), Chairman of Bhatara Union Parishad No. 6 of the upazila, UP members Moyna Mia, Rabiul Islam, Atiqur Rahman Dulal, female UP member Jahanara Begum, Upazila Assistant Education Officer Moniruzzaman and former Sarishabari Upazila Project Implementation Officer Humayun Kabir. 

In the case, they have been accused of embezzling Tk 6.5 million, 82,023 by colluding with each other by showing false payment of wages to workers in 15 projects in Bhatara Union of the upazila without completing any work. Punishable offense under Section 5 (2) of the Act of 1947. 

It is learned that in the financial year 2020-2021, the government allocated 65 lakh 82 thousand 23 taka for the implementation of 15 projects under the Social Safety Net Program (ESPP) and Rural Infrastructure Reform (KABITA) in Bhatara Union of the upazila. Without doing any work with the money allocated for the 15 projects, they embezzled 65 lakh 82 thousand 23 taka from the government through criminal breach of trust, fraud, forgery and misconduct in collusion with each other. As the investigation proved the embezzlement of money against them, Jihadul Islam, Deputy Assistant Director of the Jamalpur Joint Office of the ACC, filed a case with the Jamalpur Senior Special Judge Court on April 28. 

Deputy Director of the ACC's Jamalpur branch office, Malay Kumar Saha, said that the ACC has filed a case against seven people, including Chairman Badal, as the investigation by the ACC proved that money was embezzled by not working on government projects.

Headline_English: Legal notice seeking resignation of Education Minister
Content_Enlish:
A Supreme Court lawyer has sent a legal notice seeking the introduction of online education during the heat wave and the resignation of Education Minister Mohibul Hasan Chowdhury. On Thursday (May 2), Supreme Court lawyer Khandaker Hasan Shaharia sent the legal notice in the public interest. The notice has been sent by registered post to Education Minister Mohibul Hasan Chowdhury, Cabinet Secretary Md. Mahbub Hossain, Secretary of the Ministry of Primary and Mass Education, Secretary of the Secondary and Higher Education Division, and Secretary of the Technical and Madrasa Education Division. The notice asks to take necessary measures to reduce the syllabus of all educational institutions and start online education programs from May to July. It also says that if educational institutions have to be opened, then the morning shift should be kept open from 6 am to 8 am and the day shift from 8:30 am to 10:30 am during the heat wave from May to July. 

Earlier, the country's lower secondary and secondary educational institutions were closed from March 26, combining the Ramadan month, Independence Day, and Eid-ul-Fitr holidays. Regular classes were supposed to start in educational institutions from April 21. However, due to the increase in temperature across the country, the Ministry of Education announced an extension of the holiday by one week on April 20. 

Dr. 
Education Minister Mohibul Hasan Chowdhury 

After the holidays, teaching activities in educational institutions started from April 28. However, after one day of classes, educational institutions were declared closed in five districts for Monday due to the heat wave. Then, on Tuesday, the Ministry of Education announced the closure of all secondary schools, colleges, madrasas and technical educational institutions in several districts of the country, including all districts of two divisions. All primary schools in the country were declared closed until Thursday. 

After this holiday, classes will start in primary schools from May 5 and in secondary schools from May 4. The Ministry of Education has decided that classes will continue in secondary level educational institutions on Saturdays for the time being to meet the learning deficit.

Headline_English: A day at the resort during summer vacation
Content_Enlish:
Everyone is in a bad mood in the heat. Traveling there is nothing but luxury. Again, the discomfort of the heat and the monotony of life are quite unbearable. However, traveling far away is not a good decision now. So why can't anyone go traveling? You can visit the resort. A resort can be a wonderful place to spend time with the family from morning to evening in this summer. There is no shortage of resorts to visit around Dhaka. Which are also beautiful and affordable. This vacation center, built in a rural atmosphere adjacent to Bhawal National Park in Gazipur, has facilities for boat trips and camping in a protected tree forest. There are also thatched houses, cottages, fishing facilities, bird houses, herb gardens, fruit, vegetable and flower gardens, modern restaurants, two picnic spots, rural pitha facilities, two playgrounds and a kids zone. The chirping of birds, the chirping of foxes, bats, fireflies and the buzzing of crickets at the Chuti Resort will remind you of the village night at every moment. And if you come to Chuti Resort on a full moon, you will be able to fully appreciate the glow in the pitch black darkness. Because no electric lights are turned on at Chuti Resort on a full moon night. If you want to enjoy the wonderful days of childhood, the full moon and the monsoon, Chuti Resort is an ideal place. Various types of seasonal fruits are gifted to the guests arriving at Chuti Resort, and rice roti, chitai pitha, dal bhuna, vegetables and chicken are served for breakfast in the morning. 

Fishing facilities have increased the attraction of the holiday resort to the guests. You can fish as much as you want in the resort's 3 large lakes by paying a fixed fee. There are facilities for playing football, cricket, badminton for the arriving guests. 21 AC and non-AC cottages have been built in the holiday resort for accommodation. This resort, which is a mix of rural and urban settings, also has a swimming pool and two conference rooms. Headline_English: China's state-of-the-art warship sets sail for first time to counter US presence
Content_Enlish:
China's third and most advanced new aircraft carrier, the Fujian, has embarked on its first sea trial, state media reported on Wednesday. Beijing is seeking to bolster its military presence in the disputed South China Sea and around the Taiwan Strait, The Diplomat reported. The Fujian is China's largest warship to date. The Fujian set sail from Shanghai's Jiangnan Shipyard at around 8am on May 1 for its first sea trial, Xinhua reported, citing the People's Liberation Army Navy. The voyage is intended to test the vessel's navigational skills and electrical power system. 

Xinhua did not provide details such as the schedule or planned location. 

But ahead of the trial, the Shanghai Maritime Safety Administration plans to set up a military exercise zone 100km east of Shanghai on April 30. The Navigational Hazard Safety Notice was issued by China's Ministry of Transport. 

Fujian, launched in June 2022, is China's first aircraft carrier. It is equipped with advanced electromagnetic catapults and arresting devices for launching and landing warplanes. 

Fujian can not only operate multiple fighter-bombers at the same time, but also has a much higher payload capacity than the alternative short takeoff system of the Navy's operating aircraft carriers. 

Fujian has a displacement of more than 80,000 tons and a length of about 316 meters. There are no details yet on how many jets the ship can carry. However, a defense specification released by the Japanese Ministry of Defense in July 2023 said that Fujian can carry 60 to 70 aircraft, including J-15 fighters and KJ-600s. 

Fujian was named after Fujian province. Xi Jinping served in the province for many years before becoming president. 

Beijing aims to strengthen anti-access/area denial capabilities in the South and East China Seas and the western Pacific Ocean. The goal is to prevent US aircraft carriers and other aircraft from approaching. Once Fujian is deployed, China's naval defenses in the Indo-Pacific region will be greatly enhanced.

Headline_English: Bangladesh wants UK to support in ending Gaza war: Foreign Minister in London
Content_Enlish:
Foreign Minister Dr. Hasan Mahmud has called on the UK government to support Bangladesh in establishing a peaceful and conflict-free world and ending the ongoing wars in Gaza and Ukraine. Foreign Minister Hasan Mahmud made the call while addressing the guest of honour at a diplomatic reception organized by the Bangladesh High Commission in London on Wednesday evening, London local time, to mark Bangladesh's 54th Independence and National Day. 

Stressing the need for an immediate ceasefire in conflict zones around the world, including Gaza and Ukraine, he said that stopping the killing of innocent people is crucial for restoring normal life and establishing peace. 

The event, held at the historic Churchill Hall near the British Parliament, was graced by the presence of Sir Lindsay Hoyle, Speaker of the UK Parliament, as the chief guest and Penny Mordaunt, Leader of the House of Commons, Lord Tariq Ahmed, UK Minister for the Middle East, North Africa, South Asia and the United Nations FCDO, Steve Reid, Shadow Secretary of State for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs, and Rushanara Ali MP, Chairman of the All-Party Parliamentary Group on Bangladesh. 

Advisor to the Prime Minister on International Affairs Dr. Gowhar Rizvi, former Foreign Minister and Chairman of the Parliamentary Committee on Foreign Affairs Dr. AK Abdul Momen, and Minister of State for Expatriates' Welfare and Overseas Employment Shafiqur Rahman Chowdhury, among others. Bangladesh High Commissioner to the UK Saida Muna Tasnim delivered the welcome address at the event. 

In her speech, Foreign Minister Dr. Hasan paid deep tribute to the Father of the Nation and all the martyred freedom fighters. He expressed his gratitude to the UK government, its citizens and the British-Bangladeshi diaspora for their support during Bangladesh's war of independence and pledged to elevate the historic Bangladesh-UK relations to new heights under the unique leadership of Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina. 

Foreign Minister Hasan Mahmud today unveiled the cover of the publication 'Mujib and Britain' along with the UK Speaker, High Commissioner and distinguished guests. At the same time, he presented the Bangabandhu-Edward Heath Friendship Award and the Bangabandhu-Harold Wilson Award to two great friends of Bangladesh, Lord Marland and Lord Swaraj Paul, respectively. 

The event, which featured a special exhibition on Bangabandhu, a colourful cultural performance by British-Bangladeshi artists and a traditional Bangladeshi saree exhibition, was attended by UK MPs, government officials, prominent British politicians, High Commissioners and Ambassadors, senior representatives of the Commonwealth and International Maritime Organization (IMO), diplomats, think tanks, media, academia and members of the Bangladeshi community in the UK.

Headline_English: Police remove pro-Palestinian students from Paris university
Content_Enlish:
Police removed dozens of pro-Gaza students from Sciences Po University in the French capital, Paris. AFP journalists witnessed the incident on Friday. One student told reporters that “about 50 students were still inside the campus when the police entered.” Bastien, 22, told AFP that he and 10 other protesters were removed peacefully by officers. 

“Some students were dragged. Others were taken out by the head or shoulders.” 

Authorities closed the university’s main building on Friday in response to the pro-Palestinian protests. They also called for online classes. 

Authorities said between 70 and 80 people had occupied the central Paris building. 

French Prime Minister Gabriel Atal’s office said such protests would be dealt with “with the utmost severity.” 23 parts of the university were evacuated on Thursday. 

Students from the university's Palestine Committee had earlier told reporters that they had received a disproportionate response from the police. They were stopped before they could enter the scene. 

They also alleged that seven students who had begun a hunger strike in solidarity with the affected Palestinians had not been provided with adequate medical care.

Headline_English: Bangladesh beat Shanto after two spells of rain
Content_Enlish:
Bangladesh is batting against a target of 125 runs set by Zimbabwe. Bangladesh lost the wicket of opener Liton Das at the beginning. Then the game was stopped twice due to rain. When the game resumed after the rain stopped, Bangladesh lost the wicket of captain Nazmul Hasan Shanto. Batting against a target of 125 runs, Bangladesh lost wickets early on. In the second over of the innings, Liton Das returned to the dressing room after the team scored 5 runs and 1 run off 3 balls. Then captain Nazmul Hossain Shanto came to the crease. After the third over of the engraving, rain hit and the game was stopped. 

When the game resumed after the rain stopped, debutant Tanjid Hasan Tamim started batting aggressively. However, the game was stopped again due to rain. When the game resumed after the rain, Shanto returned to the dressing room. He was out for 21 runs off 24 balls for the team's 57 runs. 

After Shanto's departure, Towhid Hridoy came to the crease. Tanjid Tamim continued to bat aggressively with Hridoy. Bangladesh scored 67 runs for the loss of 2 wickets after 10 overs.

Headline_English: Netanyahu not interested in making a deal: Hamas
Content_Enlish:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is not interested in reaching an agreement to end the war in Gaza. He is only provoking the war, a senior Hamas official said on Friday. AFP reports. Hamas leader Hossam Badran told AFP that Hamas leaders were holding internal talks with its allies before the meeting in Cairo. 

However, he warned that Netanyahu's repeated statements that he would not stop the Rafah operation mean he is not interested in reaching an agreement. 

In a telephone interview, he said, "Netanyahu has blocked all previous talks. It is also clear that he is still trying. He is not interested in reaching an agreement. That is why he is making these statements in the media to block the ongoing efforts." 

A deal brokered by Egypt, Qatar and the United States was in the works. The deal was said to include a 40-day ceasefire and the release of Israeli hostages in exchange for the release of thousands of Palestinian prisoners. 

Hamas leader Badran said Hamas's goal is a permanent ceasefire and a complete withdrawal of the occupying forces from the Gaza Strip. 

However, Netanyahu's speech was the exact opposite of Hamas's goal. He promised that the Israeli army would continue fighting Hamas in Rafah and other areas. About 1.5 million Palestinians have taken refuge in Rafah. It is their last refuge. 

But after months of negotiations, Ismail Haniyeh, head of Hamas's Qatar-based political bureau, said on Thursday that Hamas would soon send a delegation to Egypt to negotiate an agreement. The agreement would outline the demands of the Palestinian people. 

Israel's brutal campaign has killed 34,600 Palestinians in the besieged Gaza Strip, most of whom are women and children.

Headline_English: Gold prices rise after 8 consecutive declines
Content_Enlish:

The price of the best quality or 22-carat bhori (11.664 grams) gold has been increased by Tk 1,050. The price of a good quality bhori gold has become Tk 1,10,213. The Bangladesh Jewelers' Association (BAJUS) has said that this price will be implemented from Sunday (May 5). The decision to increase the price again was taken at the BAJUS Standing Committee on Pricing and Price Monitoring Committee meeting on Saturday (May 4). 
It said that the price of acidic gold has increased in the local market. Therefore, considering the overall situation, BAJUS has fixed the new price of gold, which will be effective from Sunday. According to the new price, the price of a best quality or 22-carat bhori gold has been increased by Tk 1,050 to Tk 1,10,213. The price of a 21-carat bhori gold has been increased by Tk 1,03 to Tk 1,5,198. 
In addition, the price of one 18-carat gold has been increased by 863 taka to 90,174 taka. And the price of one 18-carat gold in the traditional method has been increased by 712 taka to 74,988 taka. 

However, buyers will have to pay more to buy gold jewelry. Because gold jewelry is sold by adding 5 percent VAT to the price set by the government. Along with this, the minimum wage per 1000 taka is 3,499 taka. As a result, buyers will have to pay 1 lakh 19 thousand 223 taka to buy one 22-carat gold jewelry from tomorrow. 

Urinu
