Headline_English: Districts where storms with speeds of 60 kilometers per hour are possible
Content_Enlish:
The Meteorological Department has said that a maximum speed of 60 kmph is possible over four districts of the country. This forecast was given in a revised warning issued for river ports on Monday (April 15) evening. 

It said that temporary gusty or squally winds with a speed of 45 to 60 kmph from the west or northwest may occur over Pabna, Kushtia, Sirajganj and Faridpur regions by 1 am. River ports in these areas have been asked to display warning signal number 1. 

In the next 24-hour forecast, Meteorological Department meteorologist Md. Monowar Hossain said that the weather may remain mainly dry across the country with temporarily partly cloudy skies. However, there may be temporary gusty or squally winds or rain with thunder in one or two places in Sylhet division. Along with this, there may be scattered hailstorms at some places. 

Md. Monowar Hossain further said that a mild to moderate heat wave is blowing over Rangpur, Rajshahi, Dhaka, Khulna, Barisal, Chittagong and Sylhet divisions and it is likely to continue. Apart from this, day and night temperatures across the country are likely to remain almost unchanged.

Headline_English: India's foreign exchange reserves rise to all-time high
Content_Enlish: India's foreign exchange reserves increased by $2.98 billion or $2.98 billion in the first week of the 2024-25 financial year. As a result, the country's central bank, the Reserve Bank of India (RBI), increased its reserves to $648.56 billion or $648.56 billion on April 5, which is the highest ever. News Business Line: The foreign exchange reserves have increased mainly due to the increase in gold reserves ($2.398 billion) and foreign exchange assets ($549 million). Apart from this, two other components of the reserves have also increased. They are Special Drawing Rights and the reserve position with the International Monetary Fund (IMF). Overall, India's foreign exchange reserves have increased. Currently, India is in fourth place in the world in terms of foreign exchange reserves. In this regard, only China, Switzerland and Japan are ahead of them. Among them, China has almost five times more reserves than India, which is $322,581 billion. Japan is in second place with reserves of $129 billion. And Switzerland, which is in third place, has $868,630 million. Meanwhile, according to the International Monetary Fund (IMF) accounting method BPM-6, on April 8, Bangladesh's foreign exchange reserves increased by 20.11 billion or $20.11 billion. On the same day, the total reserves were $25.39 billion. However, the total reserves at this time last year were much higher, 31.20 billion or $31.20 billion.

Headline_English: BNP is misleading with fictional information about disappearances and torture: Obaidul Quader

Awami League General Secretary Obaidul Quader has accused BNP of misleading the public with fictitious information about disappearances and torture. He said that BNP leaders are continuously spreading anti-government propaganda in the hope of getting mercy and political support from foreign masters on the number of so-called disappearances, murders and cases. Obaidul Quader said these things in a statement sent to the media today, Saturday. Md. Akram Hossain, member secretary of Haripur Upazila Jubo Dal in Thakurgaon, died in police custody on April 8. His family and BNP have alleged that Akram Hossain, the member secretary of the Jubo Dal, died on Friday. BNP Secretary General Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir visited the grave of this Jubo Dal leader and exchanged Eid-ul-Fitr greetings with his family members. 

At a rally there, Mirza Fakhrul alleged that incidents of deaths like Akram's in police custody are not new. 30 leaders and activists have been killed during the movement. About 6 million false cases have been filed against BNP. 700 to 800 leaders and activists have been disappeared. 27,000 leaders and activists have been arrested in the few days since October 28. 

Obaidul Quader condemned BNP Secretary General Mirza Fakhrul's statement in a statement, calling it 'false, fabricated and misleading'. He said that after all the conspiracies of BNP to obstruct democracy and the electoral process failed, they are now lying with fabricated information. 

The statement demanded that if there is any incident of political persecution and torture, the complete list of victims along with specific information should be made public, instead of spreading misinformation against the BNP Secretary General. 

Obaidul Quader, accusing the Jubo Dal leader who died in Thakurgaon of being an 'identified drug addict', said that several cases are pending against him on charges of various terrorist activities including drug trafficking. The government will look into the matter seriously if there is any violation of the law. 

Claiming that the death of the Jubo Dal leader who died in Thakurgaon was 'natural', Obaidul Quader said in a statement that Mirza Fakhrul is trying to gain political advantage by spreading false propaganda accusing the natural death of a criminal like a drug addict and drug dealer of 'government oppression of the opposition party'.

Headline_English: No threat of militant attack on New Year's Day: RAB DG
Content_Enlish:
RAB Director General (DG) M Khurshid Hossain has said that there is no threat of militant attacks in the country on the day of Bengali New Year. Even so, RAB's special commando team is ready to deal with any kind of sabotage and attack. 

M Khurshid Hossain told reporters after inspecting the overall security arrangements for the New Year's Eve ceremony at Ramna Batamul in the capital on Saturday. He said, "RAB has taken special security measures this year as well to ensure security centered around Poyala Boishakh. RAB has increased intelligence surveillance across the country." RAB battalions across the country have deployed sufficient members in their respective areas of responsibility to strengthen security until the New Year celebrations are over. 

The RAB Director General said, "To ensure security at places where public gatherings will be held on the occasion of the Bengali New Year celebrations, including TSC, Shahbagh, Suhrawardy Udyan, Ramna Batamul, Hatirjheel, Purbachal 300 feet, we have deployed our members with sufficient number of patrols, observation posts and plainclothes. In addition, RAB's bomb recovery and decontamination team and dog squad will work at important places in the capital." 

The RAB chief said that all kinds of preparations have been made to ensure security during the New Year celebrations across the country, "Our Striking Reserve Force will always be ready to deal with any situation." We have also kept the RAB Special Commando Team (Special Commando Team) ready round the clock to deal with any kind of sabotage and attack.’ 

M Khurshid Hossain said, ‘After analyzing intelligence information, cyber monitoring and other information, no specific information has been found about any kind of militant attack centered on the Bengali New Year. However, we are not complacent. RAB is always ready to destroy any sabotage plan of the militants by increasing intelligence and cyber monitoring.’ 

The RAB DG also said, ‘To prevent anyone from spreading any kind of rumors or false information in the virtual world centered on the New Year and creating an undesirable situation, RAB’s cyber monitoring team is continuing round the clock surveillance online. Necessary measures, including mobile courts, will be taken to prevent harassment of women at the venue. If anyone is a victim of harassment, they must report it. We will take strict action against those involved. 

Khurshid Hossain expressed hope that like other years, this year too, the Bangla New Year will be celebrated with enthusiasm and enthusiasm across the country.

Headline_English: Baisakhi Alpana being painted on Manik Mia Avenue

After that, the festival will also start simultaneously on Saturday at Shibbari More in Khulna and Manik Mia Avenue in Dhaka. The organizers said that Alpana will be painted on a two-kilometer road on Manik Mia Avenue.

Headline_English: Farmers and women engaged in rural games in Kurigram
Content_Enlish:
Some are trying to climb up oiled banana trees, some are throwing balls into baskets, some are breaking pots by hitting them with sticks. Farmers and women farmers were engaged in various traditional rural games. On the occasion of Eid, a sports event was organized at the ground of Uttar Baravita Government Primary School in Phulbari Upazila of Kurigram on Friday. 

Several hundred people gathered at the school ground to watch this sports event called ‘Farmers’ Eid Festival’. This unique game was organized by a private organization named ‘Phul’ to share the joy of Eid with farmers. After the game, the guests presented prizes to the 35 winners. 

Aynal Haque, who came to watch the game from Baravita village, said, ‘These rural sports are disappearing day by day. Such sports were organized once in Phulbari Upazila about 10 years ago. I was a teenager then. It was great to be able to participate in that childhood sport again after so long. The farmers' pot-breaking, bicycle riding and the farmers' needle-thread and pillow games were quite enjoyable.' 

Farmer Md. Nur Islam said, 'I really liked such an exceptional arrangement with the farmers. We have participated in more than a hundred farmer-farmer rural games here. I received gifts in the pot-breaking game. This time my Eid joy has doubled.' 

Yesterday, Friday, various games including pot-breaking, pillow games, needle-thread games, swimming competitions, climbing up oiled banana trees, throwing balls in baskets, and pillow games were organized at the North Baravita Government Primary School ground. 
Yesterday, Friday, various games including pot-breaking, pillow games, needle-thread games, swimming competitions, climbing up oiled banana trees, throwing balls in baskets, and pillow games were organized at the North Baravita Government Primary School ground. Apart from this, a 'Dress as you like' competition was also organized to entertain the visitors. 

Guests distributing prizes among the winners of a sports event organized with farmers in Phulbari Upazila of Kurigram 
Guests distributing prizes among the winners of a sports event organized with farmers in Phulbari Upazila of Kurigram Photo: Prothom Alo 
The guests at the farmers' Eid festival were Jagannath University's Economics Department Professor Md. Ainul Islam, journalist Safi Khan, Rangpur Divisional Accountant Md. Saidul Haque, Phul's Executive Director Md. Abdul Quader, among others. 

Phul's Executive Director Md. Abdul Quader said, 22 types of games were organized yesterday with the theme 'When farmers laugh, Bangladesh laughs'. More than a hundred farmers participated throughout the day. We have tried to raise awareness in the society to stop child marriage through these sports. Apart from this, this game has been organized to inform the new generation about traditional rural sports. 

Shyamol Bhowmik, convener of the District Combined Cultural Alliance, said, "This exceptional sports event of flowers with farmers has really touched the hearts of the audience. The government should come forward to keep this rural sport alive."

Headline_English: Putin's sarcasm at upcoming Ukraine summit in Switzerland
Content_Enlish:
Russian President Vladimir Putin has expressed his anger over not being invited to the international conference on Ukraine to be held in Switzerland in June. 

In the last two years, there have been several initiatives to resolve the Ukraine crisis through dialogue outside the battlefield. But direct talks between Russia and Ukraine have not yet taken place. In such a context, Switzerland is organizing a high-level international conference in June. Although it is assumed that about 100 countries, including Ukraine, will participate in it, no invitation has been sent to Russia. 

Russian President Vladimir Putin has criticized such initiatives. 

During talks with Belarusian President Alexander Lukashenko on Thursday, he said that whatever decision is taken at the proposed conference, it will not be possible to implement it without Russia. 

Putin described the idea that Russia does not want peace talks as “erroneous”. According to him, Russia is definitely ready for dialogue based on reality. 

The Russian Embassy in Switzerland said on Wednesday that Russia would not participate in an international conference on Ukraine even if invited. The Russian Foreign Ministry has also questioned Switzerland's neutrality in this regard. 

Switzerland is organizing the international conference based on Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky's peace formula. The Ukrainian president wants the withdrawal of Russian troops from recognized territory in Ukraine, financial compensation from Moscow, and the establishment of a special tribunal to try Russian officials. 

Russia's continuous attacks on Ukraine's energy infrastructure are disrupting electricity and water supplies in different parts of the country. Putin has highlighted the need for such measures in the interests of the 'civilization' of Ukraine. According to him, this is how the country's military-industrial sector can be influenced. Apart from this, the way Ukraine is attacking Russia's energy infrastructure is also being responded to. 

Meanwhile, the Ukrainian government has decided to rescue children from the city of Kharkiv in eastern Ukraine in the context of continuous attacks. At the same time, families with children are being evacuated to a safe distance from 47 villages near the border. Shelling and bombs are being fired from the other side of the border nearby. Ukraine is still unable to repel those attacks. 

However, Ukraine is assuring that the Russian army will not be able to occupy Kharkiv and adjacent areas by land. President Zelensky has asked Western countries for weapons and ammunition quickly. According to him, such assistance is needed now instead of long negotiations. In particular, air defense systems are being given the highest priority. 

On Thursday, Zelensky took the initiative to provide more military assistance during a visit to the Lithuanian capital Vilnius. There, he participated in a conference with the leaders of 13 European Union (EU) countries under the initiative called the 'Three Seas Initiative'.

Headline_English: Known as an actor, he also made films like 'Tere Naama'
Content_Enlish:
‘I was woken up by this terrible news. You were my biggest cheerleader. Your direction in the film “Emergency” has won my heart. Satish Kaushik was a very kind-hearted and genuine person. I will miss him.’ Exactly a year ago, Bollywood actress Kangana Ranaut reacted this way on Twitter. On the morning of March 9 last year, the news spread on social media that Bollywood’s well-known director and actor Satish Kaushik was no more. The star died of a heart attack at the age of just 67. Today is the actor’s birthday. 
Many may not know this, but Satish was not only an actor or comedian, but also a director and producer. His life began on April 13, 1956, in Mahendragarh, Haryana. He completed his primary education in Haryana. From there, he went to Delhi, India for his education. 

He graduated from Kirori Mal College, Delhi in 1972. Then he joined the famous National School of Drama and Film and Television Institute. He started working on stage in 1980. 

Satish played a significant role in the Hindi play 'Willy Loman' on stage. He also worked in the play 'Salesman Ramlal', an adaptation of Arthur Miller's Death of a Salesman. He also worked as a screenwriter. In 1983, Satish Kaushik wrote the dialogues for Kundan Shah's comedy classic 'Jaane Bhi Do Yaaro'. He started working in front of the screen at some point. This talented actor caught the attention of the audience with the role of Calendar in the film 'Mr. India'. The role of Pappu Pager in the film 'Deewana' and Chanu Ahmed in the British film 'Brick Lane' are notable. Satish Kaushik won the Filmfare Award twice for 'Ram Laxman' in 1990 and 'Saajan Chale Shashural' in 1997. He became known as a comedian in a short time. Source: Hindustan Times 

Satish Kaushik once worked as a director along with acting. His first film directed was 'Roop Ki Rani Choro Ka Raja' starring Sridevi. 

The film was released in 1993. The film was a hit. Satish Kaushik's reputation as a director increased. His second film 'Prem' was released in 1995. Actress Tabu became famous in Bollywood by acting in this film. Although it was a flop film, Satish did not give up. In 1999, he released 'Hum Aapke Dil Mein Raahte Hai'. This time it became a superhit. In 2005, he directed the film 'Bada' starring Arjun Rampal, Ameesha Patel and Zayed Khan. He also made programs on the small screen from time to time. Satish Kaushik was the writer and host of the show 'Philips Top Ten'. Satish was cast in the role of Nawab Jung Bahadur in 'The Great Indian Family Drama'. He directed Salman Khan's superduper hit film 'Tere Naam'.

Headline_English: Collecting additional fares from commuters heading to work after Eid
Content_Enlish:
After Eid, it is time to return to work with loved ones. There have been allegations that bus owners are charging extra fares from passengers in Barguna. On Sunday, buses on Barguna-Dhaka, Gazipur, and Chittagong routes charged an extra Tk 300 to 400 per ticket. 

Some passengers said that the bus fare from Barguna to Dhaka before Eid was Tk 700, now it is Tk 1,000. Labbabi Paribahan used to charge Tk 800 (up to Gazipur), now it is Tk 1,200. Sonartari Paribahan used to charge Tk 500, now it is charging Tk 900. Saudia Paribahan used to charge Tk 1,200 to go from Barguna to Chittagong, now it is Tk 1,600. Green View Paribahan used to charge Tk 600, now it is charging Tk 1,000. Sakura Paribahan used to charge Tk 650 from Barguna to Sayedabad, now it is charging Tk 730. Dakshin Bangla Paribahan used to charge Tk 600. Now, they are charging 1,000 taka to go from Barguna to Sayedabad in Dhaka. Diganta Paribahan is charging 1,300 taka instead of 800 taka. 

Bus transport workers say that 60 to 65 buses are now leaving Barguna for various places including Dhaka. However, about 40 buses ply on this route during normal times. 

On Sunday afternoon, when I went to the Barguna municipal bus terminal, I saw that many people were sitting without getting tickets. Garment worker Shahidul Islam said, "I came home after getting a six-day leave to celebrate Eid with my relatives. The factory was open yesterday. So I have to return to Dhaka. Bus tickets are not available. I bought a ticket for 1,000 taka on Green View Paribahan and am going to Dhaka. They charged 400 taka more than usual." 

Saiful Islam, who is in charge of the Barguna ticket counter of Sonartori Paribahan, said that the bus owners have increased the fare for special Eid services. That is why they are charging 900 taka. Earlier, the fare was 500 taka due to the passenger shortage. 

Nazrul Islam, in-charge of the local ticket counter of two transport companies, Diganta and Roma, said, “The company has increased the fare, so we are selling tickets at an additional cost. This is only on the occasion of Eid.” 

Chhagir Hossain, general secretary of the Barguna Bus and Minibus Owners Association and owner of Sraboni Transport, said, “We are now transporting passengers at the fare set by the government. Earlier, we used to transport passengers at a deficit of 600 taka.”

Headline_English: "Mom, we are free now, we will return to you soon."
Content_Enlish:
After being released from captivity after a long 1 month and 2 days, Tarequl Islam (29) made his first call to his mother. He told his mother Hasina Begum, ‘Mom, we are free now, we will return to you soon.’ 

Tarequl Islam, the third engineer of the Bangladeshi ship MV Abdullah, which was released from captivity by Somali pirates, is a resident of Chakrikandi village in Raipur union of Madhukhali upazila of Faridpur. He is the son of Md. Delwar Hossain and Hasina Begum. Tarequl is the youngest of three siblings. 

On Sunday evening, at around 7 pm, Tarequl’s mother said on her mobile phone, ‘When I heard this news from my son that the boy has been released after being held hostage for a month, my chest was filled with joy. The boy has not come to me yet, but my heart is filled with joy after hearing the news of his release. I don’t know how happy I will be on the day my son returns to me. Allah has heard my heart's desire.' 

Hasina Begum said that after her son was released, she called her father's WhatsApp number to inform him of his release. Tarekul told them that it would take eight days to reach Dubai from there. Then, as decided, they would return home via Chittagong port by plane or on the same ship from Dubai. Tarekul's father, Delwar Hossain, said that when he occasionally contacted his family after his son was taken hostage, it was good to know that his son was alive. But thinking about his son being held hostage and held by bandits would make him cry. Now his son is free. It feels like a big stone buried in his chest has been removed. 

Family members said that Tarekul completed his primary education at the Chakarikandi Government Primary School next to his house and moved to Dhaka in 2004. He passed his SSC and HSC in 2009 and 2011 respectively and was admitted to the Chittagong Marine Academy. After completing his studies, he got a job on a ship of a Chinese company in 2017. After visiting several other companies, he took a job on this ship of the KSRM Group at the end of last year. Tarekul is married in the Gurdaspur area of ​​Natore. His wife's name is Nusrat Jahan (21). They have a one-year-old daughter named Tanjiha Islam.

Headline_English: Attack on Israel more successful than expected: IRGC chief
Content_Enlish:
Iran has achieved more success than expected in its attacks on Israel, the head of Iran's Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), Major General Hossein Salami, said on Sunday. He said that some of the missiles and drones fired at Israeli-occupied territory had hit their targets directly. 
More than 300 missiles and drones were fired from Iran at Israel on Saturday night. Israel claims that 99 percent of them were destroyed in the air. Tehran said that the attack was carried out yesterday in response to Israel's attack on the Iranian consulate in the Syrian capital Damascus on April 1. 
Hossein Salami said that information about all the missiles and drones that hit Israel was not known. However, some of them hit their targets accurately. Evidence from the field suggests that the strikes on Israel have been more successful than expected. 
The Iranian military official said that Iran has the capability to launch a larger-scale attack on Israel. However, Tehran did not follow that path. The attacks targeted only the facilities that Israel used to launch an airstrike on the Iranian consulate in Damascus earlier this month. 
Advising Israel to apologize for its past actions, Hossein Salami said that Israel should learn from Iran's attacks. Now, if Israel retaliates against Iran's attacks, Tehran will launch a stronger attack. 
Iranian military official reveals next plan for Israel 
Major General Hossein Salami said that Iran has entered a new phase in the conflict with Israel. He said that any Israeli attack on Iranian interests, assets, prominent individuals and citizens anywhere in the world will be responded to from Iranian soil.

Headline_English: First Baisakh celebrated with various events in Kolkata
Content_Enlish:
Bengali New Year-1431 was celebrated in Kolkata, India, including the entire West Bengal. On the occasion of the New Year, various organizations took out a Mangal Shobhajatra in Kolkata. This showed the traditional Bengali tradition. 

Meanwhile, the West Bengal government has observed this day as Bengali Day. The state government decided to observe Poyala Boishakh as Bengali Day every year since last year. 

On the occasion of Poyala Boishakh, the Bhasha O Chetna Samiti has been painting alpana on the road of the Academy of Fine Arts premises in Kolkata since yesterday afternoon. Pantavat, Shutki and Ampora Sharbat were organized yesterday evening and this morning. There was also provision for fish, rice, dal and posto. 

Today at 8 am, the colorful New Year procession started from in front of the Government Art College on Park Street. The procession ended at the Academy of Fine Arts premises. The common people, including the eminent people of Kolkata, joined it. Eminent artists of Kolkata performed music at the event. 

New Year celebrations in Kolkata are sometimes celebrated a day before and sometimes on the same day in Bangladesh. In 2016, Bengali New Year was celebrated in both countries on the same day. This time, that day has returned. 
A Mangal Shobhajatra, modeled after Dhaka's Mangal Shobhajatra, has been taken out in Kolkata to mark the Bengali New Year. Processions were also held in 13 districts of the state. Organizers have said that Mangal Shobhajatra will be taken out simultaneously from 23 districts of West Bengal next year. 

Today, Mangal Shobhajatra took out from different parts of Kolkata. The big procession started from Ganguly Bagan in South Kolkata and ended at Sukanta Setu in Jadavpur. 

This Mangal Shobhajatra was inaugurated by the nearly extinct Hapu singer Tara Sundari. Professor Badiur Rahman, president of the Udichi Shilpi Gosthi of Bangladesh, eminent educationist Professor Pavitra Sarkar and other prominent figures of Kolkata were present. 

The second Mangal Shobhajatra started from Sukanta Setu and ended at Jodhpur Park. This procession was organized by the cultural workers of the government party. Apart from this, several Mangal Shobhajatras were taken out in Kolkata today. 

Various programs were organized in Kolkata on the occasion of Poyala Boishakh. Kolkata, India, April 14 
Various programs were organized in Kolkata on the occasion of Poyala Boishakh. Kolkata, India, April 14 Photo: Bhaskar Mukherjee 
Buddhadev Ghosh, editor of the ‘Mangal Shobhajatra Research and Extension Center’ in Kolkata, told Prothom Alo, ‘In 2017, we first took out the Mangal Shobhajatra in Kolkata, inspired by Bangladesh. This time, we have taken it out in 13 districts of the state. Next year, this Mangal Shobhajatra will be taken out in 23 districts of the state.’ 

This time, there were elephants, horses, owls, peacocks, tigers, lions; masks of Basumari from Purulia and South Dinajpur, patachitra, fans, Bengali sara, kulo and many more. There were boats, dotara, flutes, Bengali dhol. There were various colors and various writings on the streets. 

Children danced on the streets today. They sang songs. They recited. They wore various masks. They carried various patachitras and symbols of Bengali tradition. The procession also included the Jari song of Murshidabad, the Hapu song of Burdwan, the Bolan song, the Baul song, and the Bulbuli song.

Headline_English: More vehicles crossed Bangabandhu Bridge during Eid pilgrimage on April 9
Content_Enlish:
People in the northern region started returning to their villages from their workplaces in Dhaka on April 4 to share Eid joy with their loved ones. Again, after Eid, they started rushing towards their workplaces in Dhaka. This time, a maximum of 47,755 vehicles crossed the Bangabandhu Bridge over the Jamuna River on April 9 during the Eid pilgrimage. The maximum toll collected on that day was 3 crore 30 lakh 99 thousand 400 taka. 

According to Bangabandhu Bridge Authority sources, 15 to 18 thousand vehicles cross the bridge every 24 hours during normal times. The pressure of vehicles increased from April 4, focusing on Eid-ul-Fitr. On that day, from 12 midnight to 12 midnight on April 5, 24 thousand 18 vehicles crossed in 24 hours. Tolls collected were 2 crore 11 lakh 11 thousand 550 taka. 28 thousand 710 vehicles crossed on April 5. Tolls collected were 2 crore 35 lakh 49 thousand 800 taka. 25 thousand 84 vehicles crossed the bridge on April 6. Toll collected 2 crore 17 lakh 86 thousand 850 taka. On April 7, 29 thousand 780 vehicles crossed the bridge. Toll collected 2 crore 50 lakh 89 thousand 200 taka. 

From 12 midnight on April 8 to 12 midnight on April 9, 43 thousand 427 vehicles crossed the Bangabandhu Bridge in 24 hours. Toll collected 3 crore 3 lakh 66 thousand 850 taka. On April 9, the maximum number of 47 thousand 755 vehicles crossed. The maximum toll collected on this day was 3 crore 30 lakh 99 thousand 400 taka. On April 10, 19 thousand 273 vehicles crossed the bridge. Toll collected 1 crore 35 lakh 50 thousand 650 taka. On April 11, Eid day, 14 thousand 852 vehicles crossed the bridge. Toll collected 6 million 50 thousand taka. On April 12, 17 thousand 7 vehicles crossed the Bangabandhu Bridge. Toll collected 95 lakh 85 thousand 450 taka. And on April 13, 19,825 vehicles crossed the bridge. Tolls of 1 crore 23 lakh 53 thousand 850 taka were collected. 

Sirajganj Police Superintendent Arifur Rahman Mandal told Prothom Alo that various important points on the Bangabandhu Bridge West Connection Highway have been identified keeping in mind the additional pressure of vehicles during the Eid pilgrimage. An additional 703 members of the district police and 150 members of the highway police are on duty at the identified points. Due to this, there is no traffic jam even though the pressure of vehicles increases on the Bangabandhu Bridge West Connection Highway during the Eid pilgrimage.

Headline_English: Leader of teenage gang accused in murder case arrested in Chittagong
Content_Enlish:
RAB-7 has arrested a teenage gang leader named Rubel (35) in connection with the murder of restaurant worker Mohammad Riyad in Chandgaon area of ​​Chittagong. He was arrested in a raid in Juidandi area of ​​Anwara upazila on Saturday afternoon. 

Arrested Rubel is from Hamidchar area of ​​Chandgaon in Nagar. Earlier, RAB had arrested another accused named Md. Saiful (38) in the same incident on March 25. 

On March 13, two parties clashed in front of Hamidchar Karnaphuli Riverview Restaurant under Chandgaon Police Station in Nagar over dominance. Mohammad Riyad, the restaurant manager, was stabbed to death. 

According to city police sources, the clash took place between the owner of the restaurant, local Swechchhasebak League leader Mohammad Iqbal, and followers of a local man named Mohammad Babul. Police conducted a raid that night and arrested Babul along with an accomplice. 

Restaurant owner Mohammad Iqbal filed a case with Chandgaon Police Station in this incident. 

RAB said that earlier arrested Md. Saiful is a follower of local Mohammad Babul. The attack was carried out under his leadership. And arrested Rubel is one of the accused in a murder case. Police said that five people have been arrested in this incident so far. 

It was learned from talking to locals that clashes have been taking place at various times in the Hamidchar Beribandh area of ​​the city. Due to one such incident, Babul brought his followers to the Hamidchar area on the night of March 13. Upon receiving the news, Iqbal's people came forward to resist them. Later, a clash broke out between the two parties. 

RAB-7 Assistant Director (Media) Md. Nurul Absar said that Rubel, the leader of the Kishore gang and the accused in the murder case, was arrested from Anwara based on a secret tip-off. He has been handed over to Chandgaon Police Station in Chittagong City.

Headline_English: Arsenal lose after Liverpool, Manchester City remain at the top
Content_Enlish:
Arsenal 0:2 Aston Villa 
In any other league, two incidents could have been called in one day. But the English Premier League is the most competitive league in the world. It is difficult to say in advance when and which team will win here. 

Nevertheless, Liverpool and Arsenal were absolute favorites today at home. They had a chance to return to the top after leaving Manchester City, who had risen to the top last night. But in this 'cat-and-mouse' game for the top spot, both teams lost on the same day, perhaps due to psychological pressure. 

Two and a half hours after Liverpool lost 1-0 to Crystal Palace at Anfield, Arsenal lost 2-0 to Aston Villa at the Emirates in London. With Liverpool and Arsenal's unexpected losses, the current champion Manchester City remained at the top. 

Pep Guardiola's City have 73 points from 32 matches. Arsenal and Liverpool have 71 points after playing the same number of matches. However, Mikel Arteta's team is second and Jurgen Klopp's team is third due to the lead in goal difference. Villa, who are fourth with 63 points, have further strengthened their chances of playing in the Champions League next season.

Team Matches Wins Losses Draws Points 
Manchester City 32 22 3 7 73 
Arsenal 32 22 5 5 71 
Liverpool 32 21 3 8 71 
Aston Villa 33 19 8 6 63 
Tottenham 32 18 8 6 60 
Arsenal was ahead in possession of the ball, shots on goal, shots on target - everything. But Jesus, Saka, Havertz were unable to break down Villa's solid defense. 

However, Villa made the most of the opportunity at the end of the match. In the 84th minute, Jamaican winger Leon Bailey gave Villa the lead after receiving the ball from Lucas Digne. Arsenal were desperate to equalize with a few minutes left in the match. So the team's defenders also came up and played. But far from returning to the match, they conceded another goal. 
Georginio mistakenly passed to Villa's Youri Tielemans. Seeing the Arsenal defense, Tielemans raised the pass to Ollie Watkins. Emil Smith, who was alone, could not challenge Ro Watkins. Watkins ran into the box with the ball at high speed. Then he sent the ball over the head of Arsenal goalkeeper David Raya and into the net. 

The Liverpool fans who came to watch the game at Anfield were still waiting for a goal until the end, but the Arsenal fans could not wait any longer. Arteta's team left the stadium in anger and frustration after conceding two goals in the space of three minutes.

Headline_English: Temperatures may rise further from tomorrow
Content_Enlish:
The temperature was fairly bearable in almost all parts of the country, including the capital, on Thursday morning. But the temperature started rising in the afternoon. The Meteorological Department had already said that the temperature would start rising after noon. Today, the country's highest temperature record has increased compared to yesterday. The temperature has also increased in the capital. A mild to moderate heat wave has swept through various parts of the country, including Dhaka. The Meteorological Department says that the temperature may increase further from tomorrow, Friday. And there is a possibility of a severe heat wave in the country at the beginning of Baishakh. 

Today, the country's highest temperature was recorded in Rangamati, 40 degrees Celsius. Yesterday, the country's highest temperature was also recorded in Rangamati, 39 degrees Celsius. Today, the capital's highest temperature was 36 degrees Celsius. Yesterday, this temperature was recorded at 35.4 degrees Celsius. 

The Meteorological Department will give the weather forecast for the next 24 hours at 7 pm today. It is said that a mild to moderate heat wave has swept over Dhaka, Faridpur, Madaripur, Moulvibazar, Chittagong, Rangamati, Feni, Bandarban and Barisal divisions. It may spread further. 

If the temperature is 36 to 37.9 degrees Celsius, it is called a mild heat wave. If it is 38 to 39.9, it is a moderate heat wave. And a temperature of 40 to 41.9 degrees Celsius is called a severe heat wave. 

Meteorologist of the Meteorological Department Md. Toriful Newaz Kabir told Prothom Alo this evening that the temperature will continue to increase from tomorrow. Now the possibility of the heat decreasing is low. And after the 14th, the temperature may increase a little more. 

Meteorological Department sources said that there is a possibility of severe heat wave in different parts of the country in the early part of Baishakh.

Headline_English: Five arrested in Sadarghat passenger death case, including four drivers of two launches
Content_Enlish:
The Naval Police have arrested five people in connection with the death of five passengers, including three from the same family, after a rope from a launch broke off in the capital's Sadarghat. They were arrested on Thursday afternoon. Four of the five arrested are drivers of two launches. 

The arrest of the five people was confirmed to Prothom Alo by Naval Police Superintendent of Police (Crime and Operation) Ashiq Saeed. He said that five people, including four drivers of MV Tashrif-4 and MV Farhan-6 launches, have been arrested in connection with the death of the five passengers. 

Earlier, the Fire Service said about the cause of the incident that two launches named MV Tashrif-4 and MV Pubali-1 were tied with ropes at pontoon number 11 in Sadarghat. Shortly before 3 pm, another launch named Farhan was tried to enter the pontoon between these two launches. At that time, the MV Tashrif's rope broke and hit five passengers waiting on the pontoon to board the launch. They fell into the pontoon and were seriously injured. Later, they were admitted to Sir Salimullah Medical College and Mitford Hospital in Old Dhaka. The doctors declared them dead there, said Superintendent of Police Ashiq Saeed. 
Three people from a family were among the deceased. They are Md. Belal (30), his wife Mukta (24) and their 4-year-old daughter Maisha from Mathbaria in Pirojpur. Belal worked in a garment factory in Gazipur. He lived there with his wife and daughter. He was returning to his village home for Eid holidays. The other two deceased are Rabiul (19) from Thakurgaon and Ripon Howlader (38) from Patuakhali. 

Incidentally, the MV Tashrif-4 and MV Farhan-6 launches travel from Sadarghat in Dhaka to Betua in Bhola.

Headline_English: 4 riders killed, 2 injured in head-on collision between two motorcycles in Panchagarh
Content_Enlish:
Four riders were killed in a head-on collision between two motorcycles while out for a ride on Eid in Debiganj Upazila of Panchagarh. Two more were injured in the incident. The accident took place on the Debiganj-Sonahar road in the Notunbandar area of ​​Debiganj Municipality of the upazila on Thursday afternoon. 

The four deceased were Kausar Ali (15), son of Bacher Ali of Lohagara-Suparitala area of ​​Dandpal Union of the upazila, Sabbir Ali (16), son of Yakub Ali of the same area, Sabbir Hossain (20), son of Md. Majnu of Hajir More-Kha Para area of ​​Debiganj Sadar Union of the same upazila, and Md. Barkat Ali (20), son of Hazrat Ali of Battali-Kha Para area of ​​the same union. 
Three riders of a motorcycle lost control while taking a bend and were killed. 
Zakaria (15), son of Jasim Uddin of Lohagara-Suparitala area of ​​Dandpal Union, and Md. Muslim's son Sohel (19) is currently undergoing treatment at Rangpur Medical College Hospital. 

Police and local sources said that on Thursday afternoon, Sabbir Ali was going from Debiganj upazila town towards Sonahar area on his motorcycle with his neighbors Kausar Ali and Zakaria. At that time, Sabbir Hossain was coming towards Debiganj upazila town from the opposite direction on a motorcycle with Barkat and Sohel. Their two motorcycles collided head-on in the New Port area on the Debiganj-Sonahar road. As a result, six riders on both motorcycles were thrown onto the road. Kausar Ali died on the spot. Local people rescued the other five and took them to Debiganj Upazila Health Complex. 

When their condition deteriorated there, they were shifted to Rangpur Medical College and Hospital. Later, Sabbir Ali from Lohagara-Suparitala area died on the way to Rangpur. Meanwhile, Sabbir Hossain died in the evening while undergoing treatment at Rangpur Medical College Hospital. Barkat Ali died at the same hospital at night. 

Dandpal Union Parishad Ward No. 7 member Md. Momtaz Ali confirmed the deaths of Kausar Ali and Sabbir Ali from his area. Debiganj Sadar UP Chairman Ashraful Alam also confirmed the deaths of Sabbir Hossain and Barkat Ali from his area. 

Debiganj Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Sarkar Iftekharul Mokaddem said that the deaths of the three people were confirmed after evening. Later that night, he received news of the death of another person named Barkat Ali at Rangpur Medical College Hospital.

Headline_English: Cox's Bazar beach is bustling again on the second day of Eid
Content_Enlish:
A few days ago, the world's longest beach, Cox's Bazar, was largely empty. There was no noise or hustle and bustle. But on the second day of Eid, the scene has changed. The number of tourists has increased here to enjoy the beautiful beauty of the sea. Many have gone into the sea to cool off in the scorching heat. 

On the second day of Eid, Friday, at least 60,000 tourists have come to the beach. Another 40-50,000 locals have gone into the sea. In total, about one lakh people have gone into the brackish water of the sea today to bathe. 

After wandering around the beach, a large number of tourists are rushing to Cox's Bazar-Teknaf Marine Drive, Dariyanagar, Himchhari's Jharna, the rocky beaches of Inani and Patowartek, Teknaf Beach, Mathinkoop, Ramur Buddhist Village, Dulahazara Safari Park in Chakaria and Adinath Temple in Maheshkhali. Cox's Bazar hotel and motel owners are expecting at least one lakh more tourists to visit the beach on Saturday, the third day of Eid. 

Hotel owners said that at least four lakh tourists will visit Cox's Bazar beach during the four days of the Eid holiday until April 16. At that time, tourism-related organizations including hotels and restaurants can do business worth at least Tk 700 crore. Sales have increased in businesses and food shops around the beach since Friday morning. Already, 90 percent of the rooms in the city's more than 500 hotels, motels, guesthouses, resorts and cottages have been booked in advance. Although a maximum discount of 60 percent is given to tourists traveling for a month of Ramadan against hotel room rent, no discount is being given to those traveling during the Eid holiday. More than 500 hotels and guesthouses have a daily capacity of 128,000. 

Selim Newaz, general secretary of the Cox's Bazar Hotel and Guesthouse Owners Association, told Prothom Alo that on Thursday, the first day of Eid, about 1,500 tourists stayed in the city. The number of tourists started increasing from Friday morning on the second day of Eid. At least 60,000 tourists have come to the beach till 6 pm. Over 500 hotels have been fully booked tomorrow, Saturday. In that case, another 100,000 tourists will visit the beach that day. The next day, Sunday, another 100,000 tourists will also gather. In total, more than 400,000 tourists will visit the beach during the four days of the Eid holiday. 

Tourists bathing in brackish water 
Today, Friday, at 9:30 am, at Sugandha Point on the beach, it was seen that five to six thousand tourists were bathing in waist-deep brackish water. Some were going into the deep sea on high-speed boats called ZDXI. Some were trying to keep up with the waves of the sea by floating in tubes. 
Golam Mostafa, a businessman from Dhaka's Ramna area, went to the beach with his wife and two children to bathe. Then, he came up to the sand and sat on a kitkat (chair and umbrella) and enjoyed the beautiful beauty of the sea. Golam Mostafa (52) said, "The fun of soaking your body in the salty sea water in the scorching heat is different. It is a great pleasure to float in the water with the waves." Golam Mostafa arrived at Cox's Bazar by plane in the morning and checked into a star hotel on the beach. Then he quickly went down to the beach. He will wander around the Cox's Bazar-Teknaf Marine Drive road tomorrow morning. He will return to Dhaka by plane on Sunday afternoon. 

It has been seen on the ground that people are enjoying themselves on the four-kilometer beaches of Seagull, Laboni in the north and Kalatoli in the south, as well as Sugandha Point. In addition to bathing in the sea, tourists are riding horses or riding beach bikes on the sand and roaming from one end of the beach to the other. They are taking pictures on their mobile phones as they please. Many are recording videos and sharing them on various social media platforms including Facebook, YouTube, TikTok. 

26 employees of the private lifeguard organization Sea Safe are working on the beach to rescue missing tourists who went swimming in the sea. Sifat Saifullah, supervisor of Sea Safe Lifeguard, said that they are struggling to handle the large number of people, saying, "At least one lakh people went to the beach from Friday morning to 6 pm. Of these, at least 60 thousand are tourists, the rest are locals. Although almost all of them got wet in the salty water of the sea, there was no accident. However, when a few teenagers were swept away by the waves, the lifeguards rescued them. 

Business and commerce are booming 
From 8 am to 12 noon today, 80 percent of the rooms in more than 50 hotels, resorts and guesthouses on the beach were occupied by guests. The remaining rooms will also be filled the next day, Saturday. 

At least 60 hotels, guesthouses, resorts and cottages in Kalatali, including five-star Hotel Seagull, Ocean Paradise, Saiman Beach Resort, Hotel Cox Today, Hotel Kallol, Mermaid Beach Resort, and others, have 80-90 percent of their rooms booked from Saturday to Monday. 

Sheikh Imrul Islam Siddiqui, CEO of Hotel Seagull, said that most of the rooms were empty during the month of Ramadan. The hotel will be full of guests for several days from the second day of Eid. There are a total of 179 rooms in this hotel. 

Rashedul Islam, general secretary of the Cox's Bazar Restaurant Owners' Association, said that more than 500 restaurants that were closed during the month of Ramadan had opened before noon on Saturday. Thousands of tourists had breakfast and lunch at the restaurants. They are monitoring whether tourists visiting the beach are being charged extra for food. Price lists are kept on the dining tables. Tourists should order food after looking at the list. 

Selim Newaz, general secretary of the Cox's Bazar Hotel Guesthouse Owners Association, said that although there is no discount on room rent for tourists traveling during this Eid holiday, the association is strictly monitoring whether they are being charged more than the prescribed rent. 

Abu Morshed Chowdhury, president of the Cox's Bazar Chamber of Commerce and Industry, said that the business of restaurants, dried fish, snails and oysters has increased due to the arrival of tourists. More than four lakh tourists may gather on the beach in the first five days of this Eid holiday. This may generate a business of 600-700 crore taka in various tourism-related sectors including hotels, guesthouses and restaurants. Last year, about 800 crore taka was generated when 600,000 tourists came. 

Deputy Commissioner Muhammad Shaheen Imran said that to ensure the overall safety of tourists and prevent harassment, and to monitor whether additional hotel rent and food prices are being charged, multiple mobile courts have been deployed under the leadership of magistrates. Multiple complaint and service centers have been opened in the beach area to report complaints. Strict action will be taken if allegations of tourist harassment are proven.

Headline_English: Lineker calls for direct penalties in Champions League instead of extra time
Content_Enlish:
If you can't win the match at the opponent's ground, draw it, or if you can't do that, score at least one goal - this was the goal of some teams in the Champions League until the 2020-21 season. The away goal advantage changed the scenario of many matches. However, the away goal rule has been abolished from the 2021-22 season. Now, even if the opponent scores a goal, the teams do not get this additional advantage. 

English legend Gary Lineker, who was once in favor of canceling away goals, has now demanded a change in the changed rules. According to him, giving an extra 30 minutes in the second leg after a match is drawn in two legs is 'unfair'. 
He also commented that it gives the home team a special advantage in front of their familiar environment and audience. For example, Real Madrid-Manchester City and Arsenal-Bayern Munich finished the first leg of the last eight of this year's Champions League in a draw. Now, if the next leg is also drawn, the match will go to extra time. 

Lineker, who is against extra time after two legs being tied, said: "I've been campaigning for many years to get rid of the away goals rule. I was heavily criticised a few years ago when it was on the verge of coming to fruition. Because I said, 'It's good for the game.'" 

Lineker said that the match should go straight to a penalty shootout instead of extra time, saying: "I think if the goals are equal in both legs, the match shouldn't go to extra time. It should go straight to a penalty shootout." 

Explaining why the match shouldn't go to extra time, Lineker added: "The moment you add 30 minutes to the second leg, the home team gets an extra advantage. No team should be given that advantage in a stage like the quarter-finals of the Champions League." 

Lineker added: "A team in the last 16 gets the chance to play the second leg (the return leg) at home. Because they've earned it. "It's determined by where they finish in the group stage. But that's not the case in the quarter-finals. For example, if Arsenal draw at the Allianz (Bayern Munich's stadium) in the next leg, Bayern Munich will get an extra half hour at home. That doesn't seem fair to me."

Headline_English: Tech entrepreneurs are ahead in the world, but lagging behind in Japan
Content_Enlish:
A large portion of the world's top billionaires and centenarians are entrepreneurs in the technology sector. This trend has been observed in the list prepared by the world-famous Forbes magazine of the United States for many years. In their report titled 'Richest in 2024' or 'The Richest of 2024' published last month, it can be seen that 9 of the top 20 billionaires or centenarians are from the technology sector. Although this is a global trend, the only exception is Japan. 

In the world's fourth largest economy, only 1 of the top 10 billionaires in Japan, and 2 of the top 20 billionaires, are from the technology sector. What is more surprising is that only 6 individuals and families from the technology sector have made it to the top 50. 

Usually, when talking about the Japanese economy, the first thing that comes to mind is the improved image of the automobile, electric and electronics technology sector. In this case, Toyota, Sony, Mitsubishi, Honda, Nissan, Yamaha, Nintendo, SoftBank, Hitachi, Panasonic—these are considered the most well-known and popular Japanese companies in the world. However, Japanese fashion and retailers are the ones who have won the Forbes list of millionaires or billionaires. Fashion and retailers occupy 5 of the top 10, 9 of the top 20 and 14 of the top 50 spots on the list. 
Fashion and retailer businessman Tadashi Yanai and family are now Japan's top billionaires or billionaires with a net worth of 35.4 billion or 35.4 billion US dollars. It is the parent company of global clothing brand Uniqlo. 

Among fashion and retailers, Takahisa Takahara is fifth with a net worth of 7.5 billion dollars, the Ito siblings (sons of the late chairman of Seven & I Holdings Masatoshi Ito) are sixth with a net worth of 4.7 billion dollars, Akio Nitori is eighth with a net worth of 4 billion dollars and Mosahiro Miki is tenth with a net worth of 3.85 billion dollars. Bernard Arnault and his family, who ranked first in the Forbes global list, also have businesses in fashion and retail. Their wealth is worth $22.4 billion. 

Takemitsu Takazaki

Hideyuki Busujima and his family, who came in seventh, have a net worth of $4.1 billion. They are involved in the gambling and casino business. 

Masayoshi Son

Masahiro Noda, chairman and CEO of computer systems integrator and custom software maker Obic, ranked ninth on the list with a net worth of $3.9 billion. He is the richest person in Japan's tech industry. 

The reopening of borders after the COVID-19 pandemic has led to a surge in tourism and consumer spending. These two trends have helped revive Japan's economy in the first quarter of 2023. At the same time, the country's stock market has grown by 11 percent in a year. As a result, the combined wealth of Japan's top 50 richest people has doubled to $192 billion, or $192 billion.

Headline_English: Three people, including an Awami League leader, were shot while chatting at a tea shop in Abhaynagar.
Content_Enlish:
Three people, including an Awami League leader from Khulna, were shot dead by helmet-clad miscreants in Abhaynagar upazila of Jessore. The incident took place at a tea shop in Rajghat area of ​​the upazila around 8:15 pm on Friday. The three injured have been admitted to Khulna Medical College Hospital. 

The three injured people are Awami League leader Mollah Hedayet Hossain alias Litu (50), Jubo League leader Khairuzzaman Sabuj (32) and Jubo League activist Nasim Bhuiyan (28). Hedayet Hossain is a resident of Tajpur village in Fultala. He is a former member of ward number 4 of Fultala Union Parishad (UP). Khairuzzaman is a resident of Damodar village. Nasim Bhuiyan's house is also in the same village. 

Police and witnesses said that Hedayet Hossain was shot in the upper abdomen, Khairuzzaman in the face and lower abdomen, and Nasim Bhuiyan in the right hand. 

Inspector (Investigation) of Abhaynagar Police Station, Shuvro Prakash Das, said that three people were shot at a tea shop in Rajghat. No details are known about the reason and who fired the shots. They are at the scene. 

Some eyewitnesses said that around 7:30 pm today, Hedayet Hossain, Khairuzzaman and Nasim came to Rajghat in neighboring Abhaynagar upazila from Fultala on a motorcycle. They drank chai at a tea shop near the Rajghat bus stand. Then they were chatting. At around 8:15 pm, two men came there on a motorcycle. They were wearing helmets. As soon as they arrived, they fired several rounds at the three and fled. 

The bullets hit Hedayet Hossain in the upper left side of the stomach, Khairuzzaman in the face and lower abdomen, and Nasim Bhuiyan in the right hand. Local people came there on hearing the gunshots. Then the three were rescued and taken to Khulna.

Headline_English: Meta is updating its policies on creating content with artificial intelligence
Content_Enlish:
Meta is updating its policy for content created using artificial intelligence (AI) technology. As a result of these updates, starting next month, AI-generated content will be labeled with a ‘Made with AI’ label. This policy will be followed for content on Meta-owned Facebook, Instagram and Threads. Meta announced this in a blog post. 

According to the existing policy, AI content is labeled. However, this policy is working to a very limited extent. For this reason, Meta is working to add labels to more videos, audio and images created with AI. AI-generated content will be labeled in two ways. If the user provides information about the content created with AI and identifies it through the AI ​​image indicator, Meta will add the label. However, Meta did not provide any further information about the entire process of identifying and adding labels to AI-generated content. 

In addition, Meta is making changes to the way it controls AI-generated content. Starting next July, Meta will stop deleting content created with AI unless it violates other community guidelines. However, Meta will delete content that is likely to cause bullying, voter control, and harassment. 

Earlier, in February, Meta announced that it would automatically add watermarks to photos created with artificial intelligence on Facebook and Instagram when they are published. As a result, other users will be able to understand that the photo was created using artificial intelligence. 

It is worth noting that a group of fraudsters are deceiving people by creating fake photos or videos of a specific person with the help of artificial intelligence technology and also by imitating their voices. Later, they use these fake photos, videos, or artificial voices to extort money through various techniques. In addition, rumors are being spread through content created with AI. There are even allegations that AI is used to spread misinformation by making election or political campaign advertisements. Some words are created in videos or audio created with AI or scenes are shown that did not happen. Sometimes, artificial videos of an event are even created. These fake or fake audio, video or images are used to spread false information and mislead.
