Headline_English: Death-row militant Nur Mohammad arrested after returning from Saudi Arabia
Content_Enlish:
Police have arrested Nur Mohammad alias Shamim, a fugitive accused sentenced to death in the murder case of writer and professor Humayun Azad. He was arrested from Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport in Dhaka on Tuesday. 

Police Superintendent of Anti-Terrorism Unit Mahfuzul Alam Russell confirmed this information to Prothom Alo. He said that Nur Mohammad alias Shamim, a death row accused in the murder case of Professor Humayun Azad, was arrested after he arrived at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport from abroad. Later, he was handed over to the Chief Metropolitan Magistrate (CMM) Court in Dhaka. The court ordered him to be sent to prison. 

According to relevant police sources, Nur Mohammad was in hiding in Naogaon for three years after the attack on Dhaka University professor Humayun Azad in 2004. Later, he went to Saudi Arabia in 2008 with a passport under a different name. He returned to the country once in 2017. Then, he got married in the country and went to Saudi Arabia again with his wife. Today, he returned to the country with a changed name and identity. He was arrested from the airport based on intelligence information. During initial interrogation, he admitted that he is a JMB member, Nur Mohammad alias Shamim. 

Earlier, on April 13, 2022, the court sentenced four militants of the militant organization Jama'atul Mujahideen Bangladesh (JMB) to death in the Professor Humayun Azad murder case. The four militants who were sentenced to death are Mizanur Rahman alias Minhaj, Anwarul Alam alias Bhagne Shahid, Salehin alias Salahuddin, and Nur Mohammad alias Shamim. 

Out of the four, JMB Shura members Mizanur and Anwarul are in prison. Salehin and Nur Mohammad were absconding. 

On the night of February 27, 2004, Humayun Azad was hacked to death by militants on his way back from the Amar Ekushey Book Fair and left in a bloody state. The next day, his brother Manjur Kabir filed a case at the Ramna Police Station on charges of attempted murder. After recovering somewhat after receiving advanced medical treatment abroad, Professor Humayun Azad died in Germany on August 12 of the same year. The case was then converted into a murder case. 

After three years of investigation, the police filed a charge sheet against the five accused in the court on January 14, 2007. The trial of the case began on October 7, 2009 with the framing of charges against the accused. 

According to the case documents, the order to kill Professor Humayun Azad was given by JMB top leaders Shaikh Abdur Rahman and Siddiqul Islam alias Bangla Bhai. On the orders of these two militant leaders, Mizanur Rahman alias Minhaj, Anwarul Alam alias Bhagne Shaheed, Nur Mohammad alias Shamim, Hafiz Mahmud and others, led by Ataur Rahman Sunny, stabbed and injured Humayun Azad with sharp weapons. 

This information is known from the case documents, charge sheet and the confessional statements of the two accused. The two accused who gave confessional statements are Mizanur and Anwarul. 

In his statement to the court, Mizanur said, "We learned that Humayun Azad walks home from the book fair every night at around 8:00 or 8:30. Based on this information, I and others went to the Bangla Academy that day. When Humayun Azad was returning home after the book fair at 9:15 at night, we followed him." 

In his statement, Mizanur also said, "Noor Mohammad and I hit Humayun Azad with sharp weapons. When people who were far away came running, Anwarul detonated a bomb. Then people started running away in disarray. We also ran away. At around 11:00 at night, I informed Shaikh Abdur Rahman about the incident on my mobile phone."

Headline_English: Foreign Minister optimistic about the soon release of hostage sailors
Content_Enlish:
Foreign Minister Hasan Mahmud has said that a lot of progress has been made in a short time in rescuing the hostage sailors from Somali pirates. Expressing hope for their early release, he said that the concern that was there a few days ago is not there at the moment. 

The Foreign Minister said these things in response to a question from journalists about the Bangladeshi ship MV Abdullah and the sailors held hostage by pirates. The Foreign Minister exchanged views with journalists at the YNT Center in Dewanji Pukur Lane in Chittagong city on Wednesday. 

Stating the progress in rescuing the hostage sailors, Hasan Mahmud said, “I hope we can free them soon. However, it is difficult to say the date of the rescue.” 

The Foreign Minister said, “We want to assure the families of the sailors that the government is making all-out efforts. First, discussions are underway with those who kidnapped them through various parties. Secondly, psychological pressure has been created on them (pirates). The sailors are fine, are in regular contact with their families, and are even talking on video calls. The concern that was there a few days ago is not there at the moment. 

In response to a question from reporters about the increase in the activity of the Kishor gang in Chittagong and the death of a person in their attack today, the Foreign Minister said that the Kishor gang was discussed in an informal discussion in the last cabinet meeting. These gangs are being formed in various district towns. The Prime Minister has instructed the law enforcement agencies to take appropriate action against them. 

The Foreign Minister said that this is a new problem in the country, the government is working to eliminate it. Whoever is behind the Kishor gang, no matter which party they belong to, strict action will be taken and is being taken against them. 

In response to a question from journalists regarding BNP Secretary General Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir's statement that the Awami League has destroyed democracy in the country and that it is being propagated against the Awami League all over the world, Awami League Joint General Secretary Hasan Mahmud said, "Those who are born undemocratic and constantly try to destroy democracy, now talk about democracy. This is what is sad. It is like the loud voice of a thief's mother." 

Wishing the countrymen a happy Eid-ul-Fitr through journalists, Hasan Mahmud said, "Before and during Ramadan, an unscrupulous group and some hoarders are always active to increase the prices of goods in the country. This time too, there was no exception. BNP's call to boycott Indian products was newly added to it. Their aim was to destabilize the market so that the prices of goods would increase. But in view of the government's taking various steps, the market was stable during Ramadan and the prices of many goods decreased."

Headline_English: Israel kills three sons of Hamas leader Ismail Haniyeh on Eid
Content_Enlish:
Three sons and several grandchildren of Hamas leader Ismail Haniyeh have been killed in an Israeli airstrike on the Palestinian enclave of Gaza on Eid, the day of Eid al-Fitr. Haniyeh, the head of the political wing of the Hamas ruling group in Gaza, confirmed the news to Al Jazeera on Thursday. 

A Hamas-affiliated news agency in Gaza said the attack took place in a refugee camp west of Gaza City. The three sons of Hamas leader Haniyeh, Hazem, Amir and Muhammad Ismail Haniyeh, and at least three of his grandchildren were killed. 

Haniyeh, who is in Qatar, later told Al Jazeera in a telephone interview that his son was in Gaza during the fighting. 

Images published by the Gaza-based news agency showed several bodies covered in rubble. 

This is not the first time that members of Haniyeh's family have been killed in an Israeli attack that has lasted more than six months. Another son was killed in February, and a brother and nephew in October. Then, in November, a grandson was killed. 

Ismail Haniyeh was informed of the deaths of his relatives when he went to visit Palestinians receiving treatment at a hospital in Doha, Qatar, on Monday. Local media in Gaza reported that Ismail Haniyeh's son and grandchildren were on their way to a relative's house in a civilian vehicle on Eid when the vehicle was targeted by Israeli warplanes. 

Ismail Haniyeh said that the deaths of his relatives would not change Hamas's position in the ongoing ceasefire talks with Israel. "Our demands are clear and specific and we will not compromise on them," he said. "If the enemies think that targeting my sons will change Hamas's position when the talks are moving forward and Hamas makes its position known, then they are in a fantasy world." The blood of our people is no less precious to me than the blood of my sons.’ 

In the ongoing talks, Hamas has demanded a permanent ceasefire and the withdrawal of all Israeli troops from Gaza. They have also demanded that displaced people from the northern Palestinian region be allowed to return there without any obstacles. On the other hand, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu says that the war will continue until Hamas is eliminated and the hostages held by it are freed. 

Who is Ismail Haniyeh? 
Although Ismail Haniyeh is the head of Hamas’s political wing, he is considered the group’s top leader. Ismail Haniyeh was at the forefront of this political and military movement of Palestinian Sunni Muslims during the rise of Hamas in the 1980s. In 1989, Israel sentenced him to three years in prison. Then, in 1992, Israeli authorities released Haniyeh along with several other Hamas leaders on the zero line on the Israel-Lebanon border. 

After a year in exile, Ismail Haniyeh returned to Gaza. In 1997, he was appointed head of the office of Hamas's ideological leader, a position that increased his status in Hamas. 

President Mahmoud Abbas appointed Ismail Haniyeh as prime minister in 2006 after Hamas won a majority of seats in the Palestinian national elections. However, after weeks of bloody clashes, Mahmoud Abbas's Fatah party was banned from Gaza, and Haniyeh was removed from the post of prime minister. 

However, Haniyeh called the decision "unconstitutional". He said that his government would not deviate from its national responsibility to the Palestinian people and that he would continue to govern Gaza. 

Later, in 2017, Ismail Haniyeh was elected head of Hamas's political bureau. The following year, the US State Department designated Ismail Haniyeh a "terrorist". Ismail Haniyeh has been living in Qatar for several years.

Headline_English: Eid-ul-Fitr celebrated with enthusiasm in the UK
Content_Enlish:
After a month of fasting, the holy Eid-ul-Fitr, one of the biggest religious festivals of Muslims, is being celebrated across the UK on Wednesday local time. Eid congregations were held in various mosques and open fields in the UK. 

British Prime Minister Rishi Sunak extended Eid greetings to everyone on social media on the occasion of Eid-ul-Fitr. Opposition Leader in Parliament and Labour Party leader Keir Starmer also extended his greetings in a separate message. 

London's largest Eid congregation was held at Regent's Park Central Mosque. Starting at 7 am, 6 congregations were held here every hour. Four Eid prayer congregations were also held at the East London Mosque and Bricklane Mosque in Bangladeshi-dominated Tower Hamlets. 

Although Eid congregations were not held in open fields at London's Mile End Stadium and Valentine's Park due to cold weather, Eid congregations were held in open fields in other cities in the UK. Apart from London, other cities in the UK with a Bangladeshi population, including Luton, Birmingham, Oldham, Manchester, Sunderland, Bradford, Newcastle, Cardiff, Glasgow and Edinburgh, are celebrating Eid with great enthusiasm at each Eid congregation. At various places, free food of various kinds was provided for the devotees and entertainment was provided for the children. 

In a video message, Prime Minister Rishi Sunak extended Eid greetings, saying, “Eid Mubarak to all Muslims in the UK! May Eid bring happiness, peace and prosperity to everyone after a long month of fasting. I know that this year everyone is thinking especially of Gaza in Palestine. The bloodshed and suffering there is unbearable. I want to let you know that we are doing everything we can to end this conflict. We are trying to ensure the release of the hostages, life-saving food shelter and medical assistance to the civilians in Gaza.”

Headline_English: Brazil wants to supply beef to Bangladesh at Tk 495 per kg
Content_Enlish:
Brazil has been showing interest in exporting beef to Bangladesh for several years. The Latin American country wants to provide Bangladesh with beef at four and a half US dollars (495 taka) per kilogram. Brazilian Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira will arrive in Dhaka on a two-day visit next Sunday. Diplomatic sources said that the issue will be important in the discussions then. 

Brazil exported beef to 126 countries around the world last year. That year, Brazil was the world's largest beef exporter. 

Diplomatic sources in Dhaka and Brazil told Prothom Alo that ahead of Mauro Vieira's visit, Brazilian Ambassador to Dhaka Paulo Fernando Dias Ferres held discussions with Foreign Secretary Masud Bin Momen on Tuesday. During this time, he raised the issue of beef exports. Several senior representatives of the Brazilian Beef Exporters' Association are scheduled to arrive in Dhaka as part of the Brazilian Foreign Minister's tour. During the two-day visit, Mauro Vieira will hold a bilateral meeting with Foreign Minister Hasan Mahmud at the Jamuna State Guest House on Sunday afternoon. The next day, he will pay a courtesy call on Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina. 

This is the first time a Brazilian foreign minister is visiting Dhaka. Foreign Minister Hasan Mahmud described the visit to journalists at his office on Tuesday as very significant. In response to journalists' questions, he said, "We import edible oil and other products from Brazil. Much of our exports to South America still remain unexplored. Brazil is a big country, their purchasing power is also high. As a result, there is a huge opportunity to increase trade relations with them." 

According to some, if Brazil takes into account the issue of duty exemption on Bangladeshi ready-made garments, then the issue of importing beef from the country can be considered. 
This correspondent spoke to four-five officials of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs on Thursday. Some of them think that it would not be right to buy beef from the country without any conditions. Because, at the moment, imported meat of very high quality is available in many elite areas of Dhaka. Besides, Brazil always follows a protectionist policy. In that case, if Brazil takes into account the issue of giving duty exemption to Bangladeshi ready-made garments, then the issue of importing beef from the country can be considered. 

Meanwhile, a company named 'Dutch Dairy' in Munshiganj is importing cows from Brazil for the first time in Bangladesh. They are importing 500 cows from Brazil. When asked, the company's manager Asif Mridha told Prothom Alo that last year the company got approval to import cows from Brazil. Now, those 500 cows will be brought to the country at a convenient time. 

Beef is being cut and prepared for sale. Santana de Parnaiba city, Brazil 
Beef is being cut and prepared for sale. Santana de Parnaiba city, Brazil File photo: Reuters 
A framework agreement on cooperation may be signed 
After the foreign minister-level meeting, a framework agreement on technical cooperation and a memorandum of understanding on cooperation in the sports sector, especially the development of football, will be signed. 

Brazil has so far signed a framework agreement with 118 countries of the world on cooperation in various sectors. The framework agreement on technical cooperation will be signed with Bangladesh during this visit. Explaining the agreement, an official of the Foreign Ministry said that this agreement identifies the sectors in which cooperation will be provided. Later, projects are implemented under specific sectors. The framework agreement on technical cooperation between Brazil and Bangladesh includes issues in the agriculture, energy, water resources, forestry, education, and fisheries sectors. 

Sources in the Foreign Ministry said that the issues of increasing trade and commerce between the two countries will mainly dominate during the Brazilian Foreign Minister's first visit to Dhaka. Bangladesh's trade with Brazil has increased from $1.5 billion in three years to $2.7 billion at present. A large part of this has been spent on edible oil, sugar and cotton imported from Brazil. From the Brazilian side, ethanol exports, increasing cotton exports, poultry and fish feed sales will be important during this visit. Along with this, there is the issue of beef exports. 

From the Bangladesh side, emphasis will be placed on exporting medicines and ready-made garments, importing ethanol or establishing support for ethanol production in the country, as well as supporting the blue economy, especially deep-sea fishing and marine tourism.

Headline_English: DMP Commissioner's 13 instructions for citizens' safety during Eid holidays
Content_Enlish:
Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) Commissioner Habibur Rahman is requesting the residents of the capital to follow 13 instructions before going home for the Eid holidays. Imams have disseminated these instructions of the DMP Commissioner at various mosques in Dhaka before the Friday prayer sermon today. DMP officials said that these instructions have been given to ensure the safety of homes and citizens. 

The instructions given by the DMP Commissioner are— 

1. Gas cylinders or gas lines, water lines, all types of lights, fan switches, and electrical plugs must be turned off before leaving. To prevent fire accidents in homes, after returning home after the holidays, open the doors and windows and do not light gas stoves or turn on electrical switches under any circumstances until the accumulated gas in the house is released. 

2. CCTV (closed circuit) cameras should be installed in the houses. It should be checked whether the previously installed CCTV cameras are operational or not. 

3. Electric lighting should be installed around the house. 

4. Cash or gold jewelry should be kept safe with the bank or close relatives. 

5. The movements of unknown suspicious people wearing masks and caps at night or during the day should be monitored. If necessary, call 999. 

6. An alarm should be installed to prevent motorcycle theft. This will sound the alarm if someone touches the motorcycle. A marine anchor chain made of steel should be used for locking. A GPS tracker should be installed on the motorcycle and high-quality disc locks should be used on the wheels. 

7. If you accept a friend request sent on Facebook by an IPS or BCS officer, army officer, etc. from the country or abroad, you may be deceived or blackmailed. Therefore, you should not accept such friend requests. 

8. Do not accept video calls from strangers whose name and address you do not know. They can record obscene pictures or videos sent in such video calls and blackmail you by extorting money. 

9. No one can close your bank account or bKash or Nagad account. They may repeatedly ask you for your account password or PIN number using various methods, threatening to close these accounts. Under no circumstances should you give your password or PIN code when receiving such a phone call. 

10. If you receive a phone call that money has been transferred to your bKash account by mistake, do not believe it without verifying it. Do not believe a mobile phone call that you have won the lottery or that expensive gifts or dollars will be sent from abroad. Fraudsters extort millions of taka by saying that you have to pay money at the airport customs or at the NBR or Bangladesh Bank. Do not fall for such greed under any circumstances. 

11. Do not believe the temptation that you can earn crores of taka by investing in border pillars made of very precious metals. Fraudsters extort crores of taka by showing fake pillars. In reality, there is no such pillar. 

12. If you receive a request to send urgent money to a relative, friend or acquaintance in danger on Facebook, Messenger, WhatsApp, Imo, etc. ID, do not send any money without contacting that person's mobile phone number or the mobile phone number of his family members. Such requests are sent by stealing mobile phones or hacking various IDs. 

13. Do not believe any Facebook account or app that offers cheap hotel rentals, plane tickets or sending money to Europe, Canada or America at low cost. 

DMP Deputy Commissioner (Crime) Muhammad Alamgir Hossain told Prothom Alo that criminals and fraudsters try to snatch everything from citizens by setting various traps throughout the year. They try to be more active in empty Dhaka during the Eid holidays. The police always work to ensure the safety of citizens. The instructions have been given to the citizens to be vigilant about these issues along with the police. Imams have disseminated these instructions before the Friday sermons in various mosques.

Headline_English: TSM gets rights to ICC tournament, games will be shown on Nagorik TV
Content_Enlish:
TSM (Total Sports Management) has acquired the broadcasting rights for ICC tournaments in Bangladesh. The ICC confirmed the matter in a press release today. TSM will broadcast the games through Nagorik TV, while the games will be available on digital platforms on Banglalink. The ICC said that the agreement with TSM has been signed until 2025. 

This agreement will cover six ICC tournaments in the next two years. There are two ICC tournaments this year. The T20 World Cup to be held in the United States and the West Indies in June and the Women's T20 World Cup to be hosted by Bangladesh in October. TSM has also acquired the rights for next year's Women's Under-19 T20 World Cup, ICC Champions Trophy, ICC Test Championship and Women's One-Day World Cup. 

Regarding the agreement, ICC Chief Executive Geoff Allardyce said, "We are delighted to be able to give TSM the ICC cricket rights in the Bangladesh region. The number of cricket-mad fans there is huge. The ICC Women’s T20 World Cup will be held in Bangladesh later this year. This is a great opportunity to take women’s cricket forward and engage new fans with broadcasters.’ 

Mainul Haque Chowdhury, CEO and MD of TSM, is thrilled to have acquired the rights for the Bangladesh region. In an ICC press release, he said, ‘We are thrilled to have secured the broadcast and digital rights for the next two years. It is a great achievement for us to acquire the rights for ICC tournaments, along with other international cricket, in the Bangladesh region. We look forward to broadcasting the games for the cricket-mad fans of Bangladesh with Nagorik TV and Banglalink.’

Headline_English: Announcement of siege on factory owner's house if Eid bonus is not paid
Content_Enlish:
The leaders and activists of the National Garments Workers Federation have announced to surround the houses of the factory owners concerned if the Eid bonus is not paid to the workers of the ready-made garment industry. 

The National Garments Workers Federation made this announcement at a flag rally and gathering at Hemayetpur bus stand in Savar on Friday afternoon. The leaders and activists of the labor organization have demanded that the garment workers be given an amount equivalent to one month's wages as Eid bonus before Eid. 

The meeting was presided over by the Federation's President Amirul Haque. The Federation's General Secretary Rafiqul Islam, Joint General Secretary Md. Kabir Hossain, Organizing Secretary Faridul Islam, Vice President Jasmine Akhter and others spoke. The matter was informed in a press release sent by the labor organization. 

The labor leaders complained that many garment factories have not yet paid the Eid bonus and salaries and allowances. Many factory owners have taken the strategy of not paying the wages of the month of March or paying half of it before Eid. Similarly, many are planning to give a nominal Eid bonus.

When asked about the announcement of the owners' houses being surrounded, Federation President Amirul Haque told Prothom Alo, "Many owners of the ready-made garment industry are talking about paying salaries and Eid bonuses on the day before the holiday. In the past, we have seen incidents where the owners locked the factory on the day before the holiday and disappeared. We do not want to see such scenes again. As a result, if the workers of a factory do not get the Eid bonus, the houses of the owners of the factory concerned will be surrounded."

Headline_English: Robbery case filed in Rampal Thermal Power Plant attack, 12 arrested
Content_Enlish:
A case has been filed over the theft of goods from the Rampal Thermal Power Plant in Bagerhat and the attack on security personnel. On Thursday night, Ansar Battalion Havildar Md. Shahidul Islam filed a robbery case with the police station, naming 20 people and accusing 30 to 40 unknown people. 

Immediately after the incident, law enforcement agencies launched a drive to arrest the people involved. Yesterday morning, police arrested a total of 12 people, including 11 people from different areas of Rampal Upazila adjacent to the power plant and 1 person who was undergoing treatment at Khulna Medical College Hospital after being shot. All of them have been arrested in the case. 

Last Wednesday night, security personnel stopped them from stealing goods including iron pipes from Tower No. 3 of the B-Block Material Yard of PDB under the power plant, and they were attacked. Five people, including four private security personnel, were injured in the incident. At that time, Ansar members fired 30 blank bullets. 

The brief statement of the case states that Pushpen Dewan and Akram Ali of the private company Sentry Security Service Limited (SSSL) were on duty at Tower No. 3 on Wednesday at around 10 pm. At 10:15 pm, Pushpen shouted after seeing 50 to 60 active members of the robber gang entering from the northwest side of the tower with country-made weapons. When other security personnel came forward to stop them, the accused attacked them with country-made weapons. When the Ansar members went there at 10:40 pm on receiving the information, the accused attacked them in an ambush and tried to snatch the firearms they were carrying. Then, after firing 30 shots to protect the weapons and state property, the accused robbed 1,500 kg of iron rods of various sizes. 

The arrested persons in this incident are Md. Manik Sheikh (35), Md. Fazlu Gazi (55), Md. Salam Sheikh (30), Md. Moni Gazi (40), Md. Noor Nabi Sheikh (19), Md. Asad Molla (33), Md. Abdullah (33), Md. Bayozid (37), Md. Rubel Sheikh (26), Md. Manjur Gazi (28), Md. Achabur Gazi (29). All of them live in Rampal. Among them, except Achabur Gazi, the remaining 11 people were sent to jail through the court on Friday afternoon. Achabur Gazi is undergoing treatment at Khulna Medical College Hospital under police guard. 

Rampal Police Station Officer-in-Charge Soumen Das told Prothom Alo that 11 people named in the case filed by Ansar members in connection with robbery, assault and looting of goods have been sent to jail through the court. One of the arrested accused is undergoing treatment at Khulna Medical. Police operations are underway to arrest the other accused involved in the incident.

Headline_English: 600 Israeli soldiers killed in 6 months
Content_Enlish:
An Israeli soldier has been killed in the Gaza Strip, the Palestinian enclave. The Israeli army said on Monday. This brings the total number of Israeli soldiers killed in the six-month conflict to 600. 

The latest Israeli soldier to be killed in the Gaza war is Nadav Cohen, 20. 

New talks are starting in Cairo to end the Gaza truce 
The Israeli army did not provide information on when, where or how Nadav was killed. 

On October 7 last year, the Palestinian militant group Hamas attacked Israel. Based on information from Israeli authorities, AFP reported that about 1,160 people were killed in the attack. Hamas took about 250 hostages at that time. 

In response, Israel began attacking Gaza that day. According to the Hamas-run Health Ministry in Gaza, more than 32,700 Palestinians have been killed in Israeli attacks, with nearly 75,000 injured.

Headline_English: Why OpenAI is not launching its voice-imitation AI tool despite creating it
Content_Enlish:
OpenAI, the maker of ChatGPT, has created an artificial intelligence (AI) voice assistant tool that can listen to any person's recorded audio message and speak in that person's voice in just 15 seconds. Last Friday, the company also unveiled the 'voice engine' technology used in the AI ​​tool. However, the voice assistant tool has not yet been opened to everyone. The company has cited the fear of disruption of online security through the AI ​​tool as the reason. 

OpenAI said that after listening to the recording of any person's voice, the voice assistant tool can imitate that person's voice exactly. Currently, a certain number of users are able to use the tool. However, the tool will not be opened to everyone right now due to the fear of committing crimes by imitating the voice of a known or unknown person online. There are terrible risks in using technology capable of imitating that person's voice exactly. We are aware of this. The risk of this tool is especially high in an election year. 

Recently, fake news was spread before the New Hampshire primary election by imitating the voice of US President Joe Biden. In the meantime, the country's law enforcement agencies have identified the company involved in spreading false information. Not only that, the US Federal Communications Commission (FCC) has also banned phone calls using fake voices based on artificial intelligence technology.

Headline_English: Conditions for receiving widow's allowance are being relaxed
Content_Enlish:
The government has decided to relax the existing conditions for receiving widow and husband abuse allowance. According to the new decision, women whose annual income is below 15 thousand taka will get this allowance. Until now, if they had an income below 12 thousand taka, they would have been able to get this allowance. 

The cabinet gave in-principle approval to the draft 'Widow and Husband Abused Allowance Program Implementation Policy 2024' in its regular cabinet meeting on Monday. The condition has been relaxed. 

The cabinet meeting was held at the Prime Minister's Office under the chairmanship of Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina. Later in the afternoon, Cabinet Secretary Md. Mahbub Hossain announced the decision of the meeting at a press conference at the Secretariat. 

Currently, 25 lakh 75 thousand women across the country are given 550 taka per month under the widow allowance. 

The Cabinet Secretary said that according to the previous policy, the eligibility for this allowance was that their personal annual income should be below 12 thousand taka. Now, those with an income of less than 15 thousand taka can come under it. However, the amount of the allowance will remain the same (550 taka per month). 

The Cabinet Secretary said that now it has been made mandatory to pay this allowance through the G2P (Government to Person) method through mobile financial services. And the issue of online application and selection has also been institutionalized. 
The draft of the Import and Export Act 2004 was given in-principle approval in the cabinet meeting. This was basically done in light of the Import and Export (Control) Act 1950. That act only talked about goods. The proposed law is also adding services to it. 

Apart from this, the draft of three more laws has been approved by the cabinet. These were approved by the cabinet last year. But since the bill was not passed in the National Parliament, the cabinet has to get approval again to maintain the rules. The three proposed laws are the Payment and Settlement System Act 2024, the Foreign Voluntary Organizations (Control of Acquisition of Immovable Property) Act 2024 and the Bangladesh Trade and Tariff Commission (Amendment) Act, 2024.

Eid holiday to remain for three days 
The cabinet meeting was informed that, as per the previous announcement, offices will be open on April 8 and 9 before the holy Eid-ul-Fitr. That means that the Eid holiday will be for three days as per the previous announcement. 

A source in the cabinet has informed that the cabinet has not decided to extend the government holiday on April 9 by one day on the occasion of the upcoming holy Eid-ul-Fitr. As a result, this time the Eid holiday will be for three days from April 10 to 12 as per the previous announcement. Although in reality, government employees will enjoy more holidays. Because, Saturday, April 13 is a weekly holiday. The next day, Sunday, is the Poyla Baishakh holiday. That means, there will be an opportunity for five consecutive days of holidays. 

Since government institutions are closed, private institutions will also have holidays in practice. 

As per the previous announcement, the government holiday on the occasion of the upcoming holy Eid-ul-Fitr (subject to moon sighting) is from April 10 to 12. However, the meeting of the Cabinet Committee on Law and Order held at the Secretariat yesterday, Sunday, recommended extending the holiday on April 9 by one day. Meanwhile, the day after the holy Shab-e-Qadr, April 7, is a public holiday. Before that, April 5 and 6 are two days, Friday and Saturday, which are weekly holidays.

Headline_English: Biden wants to capitalize on Trump's aggressive rhetoric
Content_Enlish:
Former US President Donald Trump's aggressive rhetoric has always been effective in his election campaign. But now it could become a danger for him. His trial in the porn star bribery case is going to begin on April 15. The US presidential election is next November. In this, he will fight against current President Biden for the Republican party. His aggressive rhetoric has created a tense political atmosphere at this time. 

Last Friday, Trump shared a video, which shows US President Joe Biden being tied to the back of a truck. This issue has caused anger among Democrats. Meanwhile, Trump attacked a New York court judge in a bribery case, Juan Marcan, in a speech. He pointed to the judge's daughter and said that she is involved in the Democratic Party's campaign camp. 

Retired California Superior Court Judge LaDoris Cordell said, "I have had thousands of hearings in my two-decade judicial career. But I have never seen a defendant in my court show such disrespect for the court system as Trump. 

However, Trump's Republican party has always avoided or excused Trump's behavior. This is because of his influence in the party. If someone goes against him, his political career can be ruined. On the other hand, many grassroots voters like Trump for this behavior. His supporters believe that his criticism of the legal system is justified because he is a victim of political persecution by Democrats including Biden. 

Meanwhile, Biden is trying to capitalize on Trump's aggressive statements before the election. His campaign is presenting Trump's such statements as a threat to democracy. In addition, judges have also expressed concern about Trump's continued aggressive statements. Last week, a New York court issued a 'gag order' in the bribery case. Judge Juan Marchan issued the 'gag order' last Tuesday at the request of Manhattan District Attorney Alvin Bragg. 

The gag order on the case means that Trump or anyone in the Trump camp cannot make any public comments or release any information about the case, the court staff, jurors, witnesses, any lawyers in the district attorney's office, or their families. 

On Thursday, U.S. District Judge Reggie Walton of Washington warned of the dangers of Trump's aggressive rhetoric against judges and the courts, saying that such comments are problematic when they are threatening, especially when they are directed at someone's family.

Headline_English: Aaron's message on rumors and propaganda
Content_Enlish:
The fashion and lifestyle brand has said that a group is running a false campaign against Aarong ahead of Eid. This was announced in a press release from Aarong sent to the media on Monday. 

The release said that Aarong's entrepreneurs prepare all year round for festivals like Eid and Poyala Baishakh, which are the main seasons for their business. It is very unfortunate that a group is running a false campaign to tarnish Aarong's reputation during this festival, so that people have a negative perception about Aarong and have a negative impact on sales. 

Aarong, a BRAC subsidiary, said in this regard that the organization was born 46 years ago with the aim of creating employment for the poor and alleviating poverty. 75,000 artisans and their families' income are associated with Aarong through 29 outlets across the country and an online platform for international markets. In addition, about 5,000 employees work directly with Aarong. Since its inception, Aarong has popularized Bangladeshi handicrafts in the mainstream. It has also created huge commercial potential for local products at home and abroad. Half of the profits are spent on BRAC's development programs for poverty-stricken people. 

The release further said that relying on the extraordinary craftsmanship of Bangladeshi artisans, the love of buyers for local handicrafts and BRAC's continuous efforts, Aarong has become a popular brand in Bangladesh, which showcases the beauty, potential and unique identity of Bangladesh to the world.

Headline_English: Manchester City has the most expensive squad, Real Madrid third
Content_Enlish:
European club football is back on the field after the international break. The two most expensive squads in the world faced off last night. Surely you are not thinking about which two teams. If you look at the European arena last night and have a fair knowledge of the teams' squads, you should already understand. 

Real Madrid from La Liga took the field, and two or three big teams from the French Ligue 1 and Germany's Bundesliga also took the field. But in terms of squad value, two teams that could be close rivals faced each other only in the English Premier League. You guessed it, the goalless draw between Manchester City and Arsenal at the Etihad. TransferMarket reported that the squads of these two teams are the most expensive in the world. TransferMarket has compiled this list based on the market value of the players in the middle of the season. 

Opponent defender on blocking Messi, 'I hope he stays on the other side of the field' 
Transfermarket has prepared this list by checking the current market value of more than 500 players. Let's find out the five most expensive squads— 

Manchester City: 1.27 billion euros 

Transfermarket, after checking the market value of players in the Premier League during the season, said that the price of City's squad increased by 0.6 percent. Through this, City also retained its place as the most expensive football squad in the world. The current market value of three players of the Etihad club is more than 100 million euros—Erling Holland, Phil Foden and Rodri. For example, Foden's price, which has played well this season, has increased by 20 million euros to 130 million euros. However, the prices of Jack Grealish, Yosco Guardiola and Mathias Nunes have decreased. 

Arsenal: 1.12 billion euros 

Arsenal's squad is worth 1.12 billion euros, up 0.8 percent from 1.11 billion euros. Mikel Arteta's team has been playing well since the winter break. Arsenal is still in the fight for the league title. Arsenal is 2 points behind Liverpool, who are at the top with 67 points from 29 matches. Bukayo Saka, William Saliba and Gabriel have increased in value. Thomas Partey, Eddie Nketiah and Gabriel Martinelli have decreased in value. 

Real Madrid: 1.04 billion euros 

Real Madrid's squad is the most valuable in Spanish football. Although the current market value of Real's squad has decreased by 0.1 percent according to the updated market value of La Liga players. However, Real is on track to win the La Liga title. The team has 67 points from 30 matches, 8 points behind second-placed Barcelona. The market values ​​of Brahim Diaz and Andrey Lunin have increased. The prices of seven players, including Luka Modric, David Alaba, and Toni Kroos, have decreased.

Headline_English: Salman got 100 crores, Anushka got only 7 crores!
Content_Enlish:
The film 'Sultan' directed by Ali Zafar Abbas was released in 2016. The film starring Salman Khan and Anushka Sharma was highly praised by the audience and critics. However, almost eight years after its release, Indian media com.ed.com has published news about the film's remuneration disparity. 

Salman Khan announced the news of the next film after 'Tiger 3' 
'Sultan' was one of the most successful films at the box office in 2016. Salman worked hard to change his physical structure for this film. Because, he played the role of a wrestler in the film. His heroine in the film was Anushka. It is known that there was a huge difference in the remuneration received by the two for this film. 

Sources claim that the production company Yash Raj Films had allocated 90 crore rupees as the budget for the production of 'Sultan'. 

However, the film did business of more than 300 crore rupees at the Indian box office. The film's income exceeded 500 crore rupees worldwide. But the remuneration of Salman and Anushka in this film has surprised many. 

Salman did not take a fixed fee for the film. He demanded remuneration from the profits of the film. On the other hand, Anushka received a remuneration of between 6 and 7 crore rupees for the film. 

After the film became a hit, Salman was allegedly paid 100 crore rupees by Yash Raj. That is, he received only 6-7 percent of the film's budget. In comparison, the remuneration that came into Salman's pocket is many times more! 

The disparity in remuneration between male and female actors in Hindi cinema is nothing new. Stars have opened up about the issue many times.

Headline_English: BRAC University donates Tk 3.7 million to Palestinians
Content_Enlish:
BRAC University teachers and staff have stood by the Palestinians in their difficult times. They donated 3.7 million taka to the Palestinians from their Eid bonus. 

This donation was handed over to the Palestinian Ambassador to Dhaka, Yusuf S. Y. Ramadan, on Wednesday. The donation check and the solidarity letter were handed over by BRAC University Vice Chancellor (Acting) Syed Mahfuzul Aziz. Deans of various faculties of the university, department chairpersons, teachers and other senior officials were present at the time. 

Ambassador Yusuf S. Y. Ramadan expressed gratitude to BRAC University on behalf of Palestine for the donation. He said, "More than the amount of money you have donated for the Palestinian people, what you have thought of us is a big achievement for us. Through this, the Palestinian people will know that they are no longer alone." 

Earlier, an Iftar was organized on the BRAC University campus yesterday, Tuesday. Solidarity with Palestine was expressed there. In his welcome speech at the event, Vice-Chancellor Mahfuzul Aziz said, as an institution dedicated to social justice, compassion and the protection of human rights, BRAC University stands by the Palestinians. 

The Vice-Chancellor also said, ‘Most people in the world believe that what is happening in Palestine is a crime against humanity. We support the struggle of the Palestinian people for freedom, self-respect and a peaceful life and strongly condemn the oppression and crimes of the Palestinians.’ 

The keynote address was presented by M. Sanjeeb Hossain, Director (Research) of the Center for Peace and Justice, BRAC University. The solidarity letter was read by Registrar David Dowland. The event was moderated by Khairul Bashar, Director of Communications, BRAC University.

Headline_English: Temperatures will rise further, warning issued
Content_Enlish:
A mild to moderate heat wave has been blowing over four divisions of the country, including Dhaka, for three days. The Meteorological Department has said that the temperature may increase further in these areas in the next two to three days. Therefore, the Meteorological Department has issued a heat wave warning or heat alert in these areas. 

The warning was issued through a notification signed by the department's meteorologist Md. Bazlur Rashid on Wednesday. It said that the ongoing heat wave blowing over Dhaka, Rajshahi, Khulna and Barisal divisions may continue for the next 72 hours. It may spread further in the surrounding areas. 

According to the Meteorological Department, if the temperature is 36 to 37.9 degrees Celsius, it is called a mild heat wave. Temperatures of 38 to 39.9 degrees Celsius are called moderate heat waves. Severe heat waves are called when the temperature is between 40 and 41.9 degrees Celsius. And extremely severe is when it is 42 degrees or more. 

Meteorological Department sources said that there is a possibility of a slight decrease in temperature on April 8 and 9. There may be a little rain. 

Meteorologist Md. Bazlur Rashid told Prothom Alo that the current heat will not reduce the heat with ordinary drizzle. For this, heavy rain is needed. Its possibility is not very high. 

On Wednesday, the highest temperature in the country was recorded at 38.5 degrees Celsius in Chuadanga and Ishwardi. 

What to do to get relief from the heat 
Doctors have given some advice to get some relief from this heat. They think that it is better not to go out unnecessarily. Do not be in places where direct sunlight falls. If you go out, you should move in shaded places. You should wear comfortable clothes both indoors and outdoors. 

On April 2, the highest temperature in Dhaka district was 37.7 degrees Celsius. That day, Prothom Alo spoke to Fahmida Hashem, a nutritionist at LabAid's Wellness Center, in this regard. He gave some advice, saying that a woman should drink two to two and a half liters of water a day and a man should drink two and a half to three liters of water. Since it is the month of Ramadan, water should be drunk from after iftar to sahur. 

In extreme heat, the body's electrolyte balance is often lost. Therefore, homemade syrups and saline made from coconut water, sugarcane molasses, salt and lemon should be drunk. Sometimes, there is also difficulty in digesting food, and the stomach becomes hot. Therefore, you can make matha or labang with betel leaf syrup, watermelon syrup, sour curd and eat it. However, do not add excess sugar or salt to any syrup. Plain water should be given more priority. 

Apart from this, the nutritionist emphasized some foods that retain water in the body. Such as isabgol, chia seeds, tokmadana, watermelon, pears. And for breakfast, a light, spicy, thin broth curry made with gourd, chichinga, shrimp, papaya, pumpkin, patol, dhundul or cucumber.

Headline_English: Foreign reserves at the central bank have decreased as banks withdraw dollar deposits
Content_Enlish:
After the introduction of the taka-dollar swap facility, the foreign exchange reserves of Bangladesh Bank were increasing. But now they have started decreasing again. On March 20, while the total reserves of Bangladesh Bank were $25.24 billion, on March 27, they decreased to $24.81 billion. 

Regarding the reason for this, central bank officials say that banks that had deposited dollars for a period of one month have deposited the money and taken those dollars. Many of them could not withdraw the dollars after the expiry of the period as they did not have the money. These dollar deposits have been renewed. The reserves were increasing due to the dollars provided by the banks. 

The central bank's taka-dollar swap facility was introduced with commercial banks on February 19. After that, banks deposited about $1.5 billion with Bangladesh Bank and took the money. Both Bangladesh Bank and commercial banks benefited from the introduction of the swap facility. Because, the banks' funding cost in taking money by depositing dollars is a maximum of 2.5 percent. Banks can invest that money in government treasury bills at an interest rate of up to 11.5 percent. They can also lend at an interest rate of 13.11 percent with this money. As a result, treasury managers of commercial banks are getting more income from low-cost funds. In addition, the central bank's reserves have increased due to the introduction of the facility. 

According to Bangladesh Bank, last Wednesday, according to the International Monetary Fund's (IMF) accounting system BPM 6, the reserves were $19.45 billion, which was $19.98 billion the previous week. The reserves have decreased by $530 million in a week. 

Meanwhile, the dollar crisis that has been going on for two years has already eased somewhat. The central bank is selling dollars from reserves as before to meet the government's import liabilities. As a result, the price of the dollar has not increased, but is now falling. Banks used to buy dollars from expatriate income at a price of more than 120 taka, which has now fallen to 114-115 taka. As a result, importers are also getting dollars at a lower price than before. In addition, expatriate and export income increased last month. 

Meanwhile, Bangladesh Bank announced the introduction of a 'crawling peg' method to determine the price of the dollar. However, the financial sector regulator has not yet decided exactly how this method will work. As a result, the decision on when this method will be introduced has not been finalized.

Headline_English: Man sentenced to 6 years in prison in Russia for criticizing Ukraine war online
Content_Enlish:
A Russian court sentenced a man to six years in prison on Wednesday for criticizing the war in Ukraine in an online message. Russian authorities have imposed restrictions on publicly criticizing the war in Ukraine. 

The convicted man is Nikolai Farafonov. He is 35 years old. According to local media, he was found guilty of “inciting the public to commit terrorist acts” in a military court in the Komi region of northern Russia. 

Prosecutors said that Nikolai had published messages and videos online criticizing the war in Ukraine. In these messages and videos, he called for the burning of Russian military recruitment offices. 

Two years have passed since the Russian military began its offensive in Ukraine. During this time, dozens of Russian military recruitment offices have been attacked or attempted to be attacked. 

Nikolai was previously fined once in October 2022. At the time, he was accused of ‘disrespecting’ the Russian military. It was said that in an online video, Nikolai said, ‘Russian soldiers are killing Ukrainian children with bayonets.’ 

Two Russian ships have been attacked in Crimea, Ukraine claims 
Despite fines and warnings, Nikolai continued to publish critical messages and videos online about the ongoing war. He was then arrested last September on charges of ‘calling for terrorism.’ 

In February 2022, Russia launched an attack on neighboring Ukraine. Since then, thousands of people in Russia, like in other countries around the world, have been opposing the war. Thousands of people in Russia have been fined and hundreds have been imprisoned for this.

Headline_English: Meeting between the Chief Justice of Bangladesh and the Chief Justice of the United States
Content_Enlish:
Chief Justice of Bangladesh Obaidul Hasan met with US Chief Justice John G. Roberts. The meeting discussed bilateral cooperation between the judiciary of the two countries. 

This information was given in a special notice sent by the Registrar of the Appellate Division Mohammad Saifur Rahman on Thursday. It said that the meeting began at 9 am on March 27, local time in the United States, and lasted for more than 20 minutes. 

This is the first meeting between a Bangladeshi chief justice and the country's chief justice in the US Supreme Court, according to the relevant people. 

The notice said that when Chief Justice of Bangladesh Obaidul Hasan emphasized the bilateral and mutual cooperation between the judiciary of both countries, the US chief justice expressed his unwavering support and commitment to it. It was hoped that close relations between the judiciary of the two countries would develop through fruitful communication. 

The notice said that when the Chief Justice of Bangladesh invited him to visit Bangladesh, the US chief justice responded positively. He informed Chief Justice Obaidul Hasan that he would visit Bangladesh at a convenient time. At that time, the Chief Justice of Bangladesh was accompanied by Justice Sheikh Hasan Arif of the High Court Division of the Supreme Court of Bangladesh. 

Later, the Chief Justice of Bangladesh observed the proceedings of the US Chief Justice's court. At the beginning of the trial, the US Chief Justice introduced the Chief Justice of Bangladesh, Obaidul Hasan, and Justice Sheikh Hasan Arif to the other judges and lawyers present and welcomed them.

Headline_English: Youth shot while asking for money owed to friend in Teknaf
Content_Enlish:
A young man was shot dead by a friend while demanding money in Teknaf, Cox's Bazar. The young man's name is Mohammad Jobair (24). His condition is critical. The incident took place at 7:30 pm on Friday in Nazirpara area of ​​Sadar Union. 
The shot Jobair is the son of the deceased Abdul Khalek of Nazirpara. Mohammad Enamul Haque, a member of Ward No. 8 of Teknaf Sadar Union Parishad (UP), confirmed that he was shot by a friend. 

According to local residents and police sources, football player and shopkeeper Mohammad Jobair has a shop in Nazirpara area. He received 800 taka from his friend and football player Najibullah, a resident of the same area. The two friends had an argument over the matter today. After a while, Najibullah, his brother and some others went to Jobair's house and opened fire. At that time, Jobair was shot in the head when he tried to come out of the house and fell to the ground. When people in the area heard the gunshots, the attackers fled. Later, Jobair was rescued and taken to Teknaf Upazila Health Complex. From there, he was sent to Cox's Bazar Sadar Hospital. 

Khan Alam, a doctor at the emergency department of the Upazila Health Complex, said that a person was brought to the hospital after evening with a bullet wound to the head above the forehead. His condition is critical. He has been sent to Cox's Bazar Sadar Hospital for advanced treatment. 

Teknaf Model Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Muhammad Osman Gani said, "I have heard that a young man was shot by a friend, but no one has filed any complaint so far. A team of police has been sent to the spot."

Headline_English: Will artificial intelligence predict how long you will live?
Content_Enlish:
People have always been interested in life and death. Many are also interested in how long a person can live. Many people also seek help from astrologers according to astrology. However, the real results are not always known. Now, scientists have come up with a special computer tool through which they can predict how long a person is likely to live. 

The project created by Danish scientists is called LifeToVec. Professor Sune Lehmann of the Technical University of Denmark said that if sufficient information is given, their project can predict how long a person is likely to live. The tool can also predict whether a person will develop cancer or other health problems. It can even determine how skilled a person is in managing money. The tool is based on artificial intelligence like ChatGPT. However, unlike ChatGPT, this tool does not allow chatting; rather, various basic information including a person's birth and education are required in this tool. 

The tool, which is based on data from about 6 million people in Denmark, was developed under the Life2Vec project. It provides basic information about people other than their names. It was found that in 78 percent of cases, the tool was able to accurately predict whether a person had health complications. In 73 percent of cases, it was able to predict whether a person was planning to settle in another country or city. 

The tool can typically predict a person's relationship over the next four years by analyzing the past eight years of data.

Headline_English: BCB will not trade, says Nazmul Hasan
Content_Enlish:
Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) has no chance of becoming a commercial organization. There are no plans to sell or buy shares. Board President Nazmul Hasan said this today at a press conference held at Hotel Sonargaon after the annual meeting of the BCB general council. 

Two changes were made to the BCB constitution at the annual meeting. The two amendment proposals to Article 6, Sub-Article 6.17 and Sub-Article 6.20 of the constitution had sparked curiosity - is BCB going commercial to become a profitable organization? There were even rumors that BCB was going to the stock market. 

After the meeting, BCB President Nazmul Hasan announced the approval of the two amendment proposals at the press conference, the company's CEO Nizamuddin Chowdhury said in response to a question, "BCB has no chance of becoming a commercial organization. This is misleading information. This (amendment) has been made in accordance with legal advice to bring dynamism to banking activities. BCB will have to come within the legal framework due to the plan to make BCB TV. That is why these two amendments are important. The BCB amendment states that it is a risk-free investment. We must always keep this in mind.’ 

At that time, the board president refuted the rumors of BCB going to the stock market and asked a counter question, ‘Who will buy shares? Why will we go to buy shares?’ He said, ‘There are many things written in the law, since the law applies to everyone. But we will not do everything. We will do only what is applicable to us. Do we trade shares? We are the cricket board!’ He also clarified that BCB has no plans to sell shares or buy shares. 

Explaining the purpose of launching BCB Television, Nazmul Hasan said, ‘The purpose is to show any type of game (cricket). We have two channels here, T Sports and Gazi TV, they show games. We will show all the games that they do not or cannot show. 

BCB's annual general council meeting was held at the capital's Sonargaon Hotel 
BCB's annual general council meeting was held at the capital's Sonargaon Hotel Photo: BCB 
He cited women's cricket as an example, saying, "Now boys' games are being played. No one is able to show the girls' game. Now if anyone wants to watch, we need an option. I want our domestic cricket to be shown as well. If domestic cricket is shown, the quality of the game will be better." 

The BCB president also answered questions about regional cricket organizations at the press conference. He said, "All of them have become regional cricket organizations except Barisal." He said that the BCB director elected from Barisal, Alamgir Khan, is ill, so there is a delay in setting up a regional cricket organization in Barisal. 

The BCB president said that as part of the activities of the regional cricket organization, each region has been asked to organize a T20 tournament on an experimental basis. The regional cricket organization will run the tournament with a grant of Tk 2 million from the BCB. 

The budget from July 1, 2023 to June 30, 2024 was approved in the meeting. During this period, the BCB's potential income has been estimated at Tk 446 crore, and the potential expenditure at Tk 407 crore.

Headline_English: Mustafiz shines in milestone match
Content_Enlish:
Since the Chennai pitch is similar to Mirpur, Mustafizur Rahman is a kind of 'auto choice' there. But other pitches in India are not very Mustafiz-friendly. There were doubts about whether the left-arm pacer from Bangladesh would be played by Chennai Super Kings today. 

Finally, the doubts have been cleared as Chennai kept Mustafiz in their XI in the match in Visakhapatnam. Playing against his former team Delhi Capitals, 'The Fizz' has also reached a milestone. In total, he is the 26th and second Bangladeshi after Shakib Al Hasan to take 300 wickets in recognized T20Is. 

However, his time with the ball has not been good. He gave away 47 runs in 4 overs and took 1 wicket. Today, he is the most expensive bowler in Chennai, conceding runs at an economy rate of 11.80. 

Mustafiz went to play against Delhi with 299 wickets in recognized T20Is. The wicket-taker who reached the milestone of 300 wickets is also David Warner, a former teammate of Fizz. 

In 2016, Sunrisers Hyderabad won the IPL under Warner's leadership; that year, Mustafiz was recognized as the best emerging player of the tournament. Although Warner and Mustafiz are 9 years apart in age, the two have been friends since then. 

Of course, the way Mustafiz dismissed Warner goes entirely to Patirana. The catch that the Sri Lankan pacer, who was standing at short third man, jumped to his right and took with one hand is being called the best catch of not only this season of the IPL, but also of 2024. 

When Shakib played for Kolkata Knight Riders and Mustafiz played for Rajasthan Royals, 
The over in which Warner was dismissed was the 10th over of Delhi's innings. Mustafiz gave away 4 runs in that over alone. He gave away 18, 13 and 12 runs in the remaining 3 overs. 

Shakib currently has 482 wickets in sanctioned T20Is, while Mustafiz has exactly 300. Dwayne Bravo, who is Mustafiz's bowling coach in Chennai, is on top with 625 wickets. 
Mustafiz has surpassed Shakib in two ways today. Mustafiz is the fastest and youngest Bangladeshi to take 300 T20I wickets. It took Shakib 261 matches to reach this milestone, when he was 31 years and 31 days old. It took Mustafiz 243 matches, today he is 28 years and 207 days old.

Headline_English: Hailstorm with Kalbaisakhi in Sylhet
Content_Enlish:
There was sudden hailstorm with Kalbaisakhi in Sylhet. The large hailstones falling from the sky broke the windows of many houses in the city. Vehicles were also damaged. The storm lasted for about 15 minutes at around 10:30 pm today, Sunday. 

Assistant Meteorologist of the Sylhet Meteorological Department Shah Md. Sajeeb Hossain said that at this time of the year, rain with storms is called Kalbaisakhi. Hailstorm occurs during Kalbaisakhi. 

Abul Kalam Azad, a tea seller in the Jail Road area of ​​Sylhet city, said that he is 64 years old. He has never seen such big rocks in his life. The tin roof of his shop was damaged due to the hailstorm. 
Imran Rezaul Karim, a resident of the Majortila area of ​​Sylhet city, told Prothom Alo that he had gone out in his private car at night. At around 10:30 pm, he parked his car on the side of the road and went to a shop to shop in the Nayasak area of ​​the city. He came out of the shop and found the front and rear windows of his private car broken. 

Nabil Hossain, a journalist with a private television station, is a resident of Nayasadrak area of ​​Sylhet city. Before the rain, he had kept his used motorcycle on the balcony. After the rain, he found his motorcycle's tank flattened and the mirror broken. 

According to the Meteorological Department, Kalbaisakhi occurs in the end of Chaitra and the beginning of Baishakh due to the influence of the southwest monsoon. During this time, when the raindrops fall, they often fall under the upward pressure of the air in the middle. As a result, as the raindrops fall down, some of them start rising again and get colder. The condensed water droplets become heavier and start falling down again and again under the upward pressure of the warm air, some of them rise again. After rising and falling several times, some of the water droplets turn into small ice cubes. These are too heavy and cannot rise any higher. They come down with the rain. This is hail. The main condition for hail is extreme heat. It is hot in the months of Chaitra-Baishakh. As a result, hail occurs during Kalbaisakhi.

Headline_English: 6 signs to be aware of a heart attack if you see them
Content_Enlish:
Heart attack is a type of medical emergency; if not treated or hospitalized at the right time, there may be a risk of death. For this reason, it is important to be aware of heart attacks. You should know some early signs or danger signs, which should be consulted by a doctor if they appear. 
Heart attack is a type of medical emergency; if not treated or hospitalized at the right time, there may be a risk of death 
Heart attack is a type of medical emergency; if not treated or hospitalized at the right time, there may be a risk of death Photo: Prothom Alo 
1. Chest pain 
A recent study found that about 40 percent of heart attack patients participating in the study had mild pain for a long time and 68 percent for a few days before. Therefore, there is no room to take chest pain lightly. 
2. Chest heaviness 
The same study found that 44 percent of patients had a feeling of heaviness in the chest. Patients express heaviness in the chest in various ways, and there may also be a feeling of pressure or discomfort in the chest. Many people may feel heaviness in the chest after doing heavy work or after walking quickly or climbing stairs. 

3. Chest palpitations 
In the same study, 42 percent of patients had symptoms of chest palpitations before. So this is also an important warning sign. In this case, the patient feels that the heart is beating very fast. Many also talk about missing heartbeats sometimes. 

4. Shortness of breath or panting 
This is also an important warning sign. Many people say that they feel short of breath while doing heavy work, which should not be taken lightly. Many people can also experience this while resting. 

5. Heartburn 
When they hear about heartburn, many people think of gastric problems and take gas medicines day after day. In most cases, even if it is a gas problem, if the medicine is not working, then you must consult a doctor. 

6. Weakness or fatigue 
Weakness or fatigue are early signs of many problems or diseases. Studies have shown that many heart attack patients experience this kind of fatigue at the beginning. So this can also be a warning sign. 

In addition, there are some other symptoms or warning signs to keep in mind. Such as dizziness, swollen or heavy legs, nausea, insomnia, anxiety. These are not as common as the first six. So far, it has been seen that women have more early symptoms or warning signs than men. However, more research is needed to confirm this. 

Many patients suddenly have a heart attack without any warning signs. Many of them do not understand or ignore these warning signs. Since heart attacks are fatal, these things must be taken into account.

Headline_English: Nagad partners with Asia's leading tech company Silverlake
Content_Enlish:
Southeast Asia's first tech billionaire Goh Peng Wee wants to partner with mobile financial services company Nagad through his Silverlake Group. This will be the first partnership of Silverlake Group in South Asia. 

Goh Peng Wee recently invited Nagad founder and CEO Tanvir A Mishuk for dinner at his home in Malaysia. He immediately expressed interest after seeing Nagad's customer-friendly innovations, acquisition of more than 90 million customers and business model. This information was given in a press release. 

In a meeting with Tanvir A Mishuk, Goh Peng Wee said that although they had previously received several proposals from other South Asian countries besides Bangladesh and India, they could not find enough reasons to include Silverlake there. However, they felt that Nagad was a different type of organization. 

According to the proposal, Silverlake Group will provide Nagad with the opportunity to use their modern banking technology. In this regard, Tanvir A Mishuk, CEO of Nagad, said, "I think this is good news not only for Nagad, but for the entire Bangladesh. Because, this has created the possibility of radical changes in the banking sector of Bangladesh. We think it will play a positive role for billions of people in the country." 

Currently, more than four hundred banks in more than a hundred countries of the world are operating based on the technology of Silverlake Group, which started in 1989. On the other hand, Nagad's journey in Bangladesh began in 2019 as a mobile financial service.

Headline_English: Mahi plays the role of Shakib Khan's mother!
Content_Enlish:
Dhakai cinema hero Shakib Khan's movie 'Rajkumar' is waiting to be released on the upcoming Eid-ul-Fitr. One after another, surprising news is coming around the movie. There have been rumors for quite some time that another popular Dhallywood heroine, Mahiya Mahi, will be in Rajkumar. However, she is not the heroine, she will be appearing in front of the audience in the film as Shakib Khan's mother. On the other hand, Tariq Anam Khan will be playing the role of Shakib's father. 

However, neither the film's production company nor the heroine Mahiya Mahi has opened up about the matter yet. Those involved in the film are also protecting the secret. However, director Himel Ashraf had said from the beginning that there will be new surprises in this movie. It is believed that Mahi has been presented as Shakib's mother to surprise the audience in the theaters. That is, this heroine has been kept as a special surprise in the movie. In this regard, Mahiya Mahi told Prothom Alo, 'I don't want to say anything about the matter right now. There is still time to say it. Wait, there is a surprise.

Shakib Khan and Mahiya Mahi at the shooting of the song 'Believe Me—Ami Tor Hot Chai' from the film 'Nawab LLB'

Headline_English: What to do when you can't sleep
Content_Enlish:
The problem of sleep has become evident during the Corona pandemic. Studies have also shown that people's sleep has decreased during the Corona period. In 2023, a research article on the sleep of people in Bangladesh was published in the Scientific Reports of the world-famous Nature magazine. In April 2020, sleep data from 9,730 people was collected. It was found that the number of people sleeping less has increased. However, there is no alternative to adequate sleep to lead a normal life. Find out what you can do to sleep well— 

1. Bedroom 
It is very important to arrange the bedroom properly for sleeping. You want silence, peace and darkness in the bedroom. You should take care that there is no outside light and that all the lights in the room are turned off. Along with light and sound, the cleanliness of the bedroom is also very important. The bed, pillow and sleeping clothes should be as clean and comfortable as possible. 

2. Sleep routine 
Actually, to fix a sleep routine, you have to follow the routine of the whole day properly. Even then, no matter how the day goes, it is very important to get into the habit of going to bed at the same time every night. Besides, it is better to create a specific habit like reading, listening to light music or something like that before going to bed every night. These preparations for sleep start sending signals to the brain to sleep. 

3. Quit addiction, stay cool 
To prepare the body for going to sleep, you should avoid things that cause excitement like alcohol and even caffeine. Because you cannot sleep without overcoming their effects. And to sleep, it is important to be able to control your body temperature like the room temperature. Sleep is better in a slightly cold room. And to keep the body cool, it is better to eat low-calorie foods at night. 

4. Exercise and Bath 
Doing light exercise every day reduces stress and brings peace to the body. It is good for sleep. However, since exercise increases the body temperature, it is better to exercise during the day instead of at night. And it is very good to take a bath in lukewarm water three to four hours before going to bed at night. Although this increases the body temperature a little at first, when the heat gradually decreases, the body comes to peace and it helps to sleep. 

Some more things 
Along with following these habits regularly, try to learn more about your body and mind. You can practice some yoga, meditation, and deep breathing. If necessary, take refuge in tips like using eyeshades to protect your eyes from light, earplugs to protect your ears from excessive noise. And the most important thing is to think positively about life while going to bed. Reminisce about happy and joyful memories. Start your morning beautifully and prepare yourself mentally to have a good day.

Headline_English: IPL: Kohli-Karthi's first win for Bangalore
Content_Enlish:
Virat Kohli got off to a good start against Chennai Super Kings in the opening match of the IPL. But he was dismissed for 21 runs off 20 balls. Kohli's bat went wide against Punjab Kings today at the Chinnaswamy Stadium in Bengaluru. Such a form of Kohli's bat when chasing runs is not unfamiliar. His bat played a big role in Royal Challengers Bangalore's victory today. 

Kohli played a role in the first 77 runs off 49 balls, then Dinesh Karthik ensured the team's victory. Bengaluru won by 4 wickets with 4 balls in hand after batting for the target of 177 runs thrown by Punjab. This time Bengaluru won its first match in its second match in the IPL.

Kohli overcame the pressure by putting on 43 runs off 35 balls for the third wicket with Rajat Patidar. Along the way, Kohli also set a record by taking a single off Rabada's ball in 9.3 overs to reach his fifty. This is Kohli's 100th fifty-plus innings in T20Is.
