Headline_English: Google warns iPhone and Android users
Content_Enlish:
Tech giant Google has warned all Android and iPhone users about the security and privacy risks of using artificial intelligence in smartphone apps. This information has been revealed in a report by Indian media NDTV. 

Through Google's Gemini App Privacy Hub blog, Google has urged customers to refrain from giving their confidential information during any conversation on the Gemini app. 

Gemini apps are like a supercharged Google Assistant. The blog tells customers, please do not write your confidential information in your conversations or any data that you do not want a reviewer to see or Google to use to improve its products, services and machine learning technology. 

Google also explained why one should avoid giving their personal information to the Gemini app. The tech giant said that once a conversation is reviewed, it remains there for a certain period of time. Even if the user deletes their Gemini app activity, they are not removed for a specified period of time. Because these conversations are stored separately and are not connected to a user's Google account. 

User conversations are not deleted for up to three years. And those conversations may also contain user private information, Google said. 

Customers have also been told that your conversations and necessary information, such as your language, device type, your location or feedback reviewed by a human reviewer, are not deleted even if you delete your Gemini app activity. 

Even after the Gemini app activity is closed, user conversations are stored in their account for up to 72 hours. Because this helps Google provide its services and create any responses. However, this activity will not be visible to the user in their Gemini apps activity. 

Moreover, Gemini can be activated without your knowledge through voice activation. Google explained in a blog post that Gemini could be activated without your knowledge by a word like "Hey Google."

Headline_English: Bangladeshi youth killed in road accident in Greece while buying meat
Content_Enlish:
A Bangladeshi youth named Sajib Khan (22) who was riding a motorcycle lost his life in a road accident in Greece. Another Bangladeshi youth who was with him was injured in the incident. 

When the news of his death came out on Sunday (February 11), a shadow of grief fell on the Bangladeshi community. Earlier, the accident took place in the Metarsugia area of ​​Athens on Saturday (February 10) night local time. 

The deceased Sajib Khan is the son of Mafuz Khan of Dhantalia area of ​​Nasirnagar upazila of Brahmanbaria district. The injured Fahim Hossain's house is in Munshiganj Sadar. 

It is learned that the deceased Sajib Khan entered the European country of Greece four years ago. Sajib was the eldest of two brothers and four sisters. He lived in the Epirus area of ​​Athens. 

He worked as a seasonal worker at an island restaurant. Currently, he had no work as the restaurant on the island is closed. 

Sajib's roommates said that on Saturday night, he and his friend Fahim left for Omonia area on a motorcycle to buy meat. On the way, the motorcycle met with an accident in Metasogia area of ​​Athens. Sajib died on the spot. The injured Fahim is undergoing treatment at a hospital in Athens. 

In this regard, Anwar Hossain, president of Bangladesh Community in Greece, said that the incident happened at a traffic signal. When he tried to ignore the signal, a private car coming from the green signal hit the motorcycle. Sajib and his friend Fahim were thrown to the side of the road in a heap. He advised Bangladeshis living in Greece to follow traffic signals and traffic laws. 

Bishwajit Kumar Pal, First Secretary (Labor) of the Bangladesh Embassy in Athens, said that his body will be sent to Bangladesh as soon as possible after completing all legal procedures.

Headline_English: Runaway marriage, five years later, the bride and groom with their children
Content_Enlish:
Five years after the eloping marriage, the young man went to his in-laws' house again with a wedding party because his in-laws accepted him. And the middle of the wedding party was his 4-year-old son Md. Sami Matubbar. The father and son were dressed the same in the wedding party. There were 163 wedding guests with them. The picture of that wedding party is now viral on social media. 

This unique incident took place on February 8 in Goalpara village of Atghar union in Saltha upazila of Faridpur. 

It is known that due to disagreements between the families, Md. Enayet Hossain (30) eloped and married his beloved Khadija Akhter Setu. 

Enayet is the son of Motaleb Matubbar of Goalpara village of Atghar union in Saltha, Faridpur. And his wife's house is also in the same village. She is the daughter of Kuddus Matubbar of the village. At the time of marriage, she was a student of the neighboring Sadukdia High School. 

On Monday (February 12) morning, Salthar Atghar Union Parishad (UP) Chairman Md. Shahidul Hasan Khan Sohag said that even though the marriage was done, the in-laws did not accept it. On October 10, 2018, the couple's son Md. Sami was born. Still, the anger of the in-laws did not melt. On the contrary, Enayet had to serve 25 days in jail in 2022 in a case filed by his wife's family. He was later granted bail. 

In the meantime, Enayet got a job as a manager at a private hospital called 'New Life' in Faridpur city. He also bought the ownership of the hospital and became its director. 

Chairman Sohag also said that after five years of this, a solution was reached with the in-laws through my mediation. The girl's family accepted the marriage. Finally, with the consent of both families, the couple's wedding ceremony was organized with great fanfare. 

Md. Enayeter Hossain said, "Actually, after a lot of hardship, my in-laws have accepted our marriage. I am very happy that they have recognized our love, which was built through a lot of hardship and hard work." 

He said, "I wanted to prove to people that if you are patient, love will eventually win. I am really proud to be able to show that evidence today." They wished.

Headline_English: Khaleda Zia's new appearance date set in 11 cases
Content_Enlish:
The court has fixed a new date for the appearance of Khaleda Zia in 11 cases filed against her on charges of sabotage and treason. She has been asked to appear in court on April 22. 

Khaleda Zia was scheduled to appear in court today (February 14) but could not appear in court due to illness. Later, when a new date was sought, Faisal Atiq Bin Quader, acting judge of the Dhaka Metropolitan Sessions Judge's Court, fixed April 22. Additional Public Prosecutor of the Dhaka Metropolitan Sessions Judge's Court, Tapas Kumar Pal, confirmed the matter. 

Out of the 11 cases filed against Khaleda Zia, 8 cases of sabotage were filed in the capital's Darussalam Police Station. Besides, two cases were filed in Jatrabari Police Station and one case of treason. 

The treason case was filed in the court on January 25, 2016, for making controversial comments about the number of martyrs in the Liberation War. And from the complaint filed by Jatrabari Police Station, it is known that on the night of January 23, 2015, a petrol bomb was fired at a Glory Paribahan passenger bus in the Katherpul area of ​​Jatrabari. In this, 29 passengers of the bus were burnt. 

Later, when they were admitted to Dhaka Medical College Hospital, a passenger named Nur Alam (60) died while undergoing treatment on February 1. In that incident, on January 24, 2015, the Sub-Inspector (SI) of the police station, KM Nuruzzaman, filed a case with Jatrabari Police Station accusing Khaleda Zia of ordering. 

On the other hand, in 2015, 8 cases were filed in the Darussalam Police Station area on charges of sabotage. BNP Chairperson Khaleda Zia was made an accused in these eight cases.

Headline_English: Some homemade hair care packs, how to use them
Content_Enlish:
See below how to make a homemade hair pack to get thick, black and strong hair and take care of your hair- 

Amla Hair Pack 
Amla or amla powder is very effective. Mix sour curd, amla powder, egg yolk and a few drops of pure coconut oil together to make a paste. Apply it well on the scalp and all the hair and wash it off after 30 minutes. 

Be sure to use a mild shampoo. Applying this pack once or twice a week will accelerate hair growth and prevent split ends. 

Egg Pack 
Mix egg, olive oil, aloe vera gel and a little milk together and apply it to your hair. Now comb your hair with a wide-tooth comb. Leave it like this for 30 minutes and wash it with shampoo. Using this hair pack will make your hair naturally straight, silky and shiny. Problems that long hair has, such as hair turning red, lifeless or rough; This pack works like magic to fix these problems. 

Jawa Flower Pack 
Make a paste with Jawa flower powder, sour curd and ripe banana. Now apply this hair pack all over your hair and leave it for 30 minutes. Then shampoo and wash it thoroughly. For good results, apply the pack once or twice a week. Your hair will be moisturized and shiny.

Headline_English: Get rid of unnecessary emails in Gmail with one click!
Content_Enlish:
When you open Gmail, it is filled with only unnecessary emails? As a result, it becomes a little difficult to find useful emails. Again, when the storage is full, no emails want to come. Google has taken steps to get rid of this problem. Now if someone wants to send bulk or spam emails, he will have to follow Google's new guidelines. That is, very soon you will get rid of spam emails. 

Google's new policy… 
From various companies to various people who send a large number of emails, they will no longer be able to send that much email. Under Google's new policy, they will first have to authenticate their messages. In addition, emails will be sent only to those people who allow those emails. That is, from now on you will be able to decide whether you want spam emails or not. 

Get rid of unwanted emails… 
Last year, Google announced in a blog post that you only need to click one button to stop unwanted emails. For this, the unsubscribe button will be available in the email. If you do not like someone's email, you can click on this button. After this, you will not receive the email. Bulk or spam email senders must accept the unsubscribe request within two days. 

Google will start taking action from this month. If a bulk email sender does not follow the company's policy, then he will not be able to use Gmail in the future. Or he will have problems using it. In addition, those who do not follow the company's policy, their Gmail will be closed from next April.

Headline_English: 2.25 million students are sitting for the SSC exam today
Content_Enlish:
This year's Secondary School Certificate (SSC) and equivalent examinations are starting today. This time, 20 lakh 24 thousand 192 students from 29 thousand 735 educational institutions are participating in the examination at 3 thousand 700 centers across the country. 

The first day of the SSC examination will begin with the Bengali first paper. The written examination will end on Tuesday, March 12. The practical examination will be held from March 13 to 20. 

This time, a total of 20 lakh 24 thousand 192 candidates are appearing in the examination in 11 boards of the country. Out of these, 9 lakh 92 thousand 878 are male students and 1 lakh 31 thousand 314 are female students. There are a total of 3 thousand 700 centers. The number of educational institutions is 29 thousand 735. 

2 lakh 90 thousand 940 are participating in the Dakhil examination under the Madrasa Board. Out of them, 94 thousand 841 are male students and 31 thousand 532 are female students. And the number of candidates in the technical board is 1 lakh 26 thousand 373. Of these, 94,841 are male and 31,532 are female. 

9 general education boards are responsible for organizing SSC, Madrasa Education Board Dakhil and Technical Education Board SSC and Dakhil Vocational examinations. 

President of the Inter-Education Board Coordination Committee and Chairman of the Dhaka Board, Professor Tapan Kumar Sarkar said that all preparations for the SSC equivalent examination are complete. There is no chance of question leaks. 

He said that we have delivered the question papers to the districts. This time, we hope that the SSC and equivalent examinations will be held in a completely cheating-free environment. Members of the law enforcement agencies are completing their work so that the examination can be conducted in a cheating-free environment. 

Tapan Kumar said that strict action will be taken if rumors of question leaks are spread, he said that they are fulfilling their duty to prevent any rumors of question paper leaks from spreading. If anyone spreads rumors, the law enforcement agencies will take action. 

He said that Education Minister Mohibul Hasan Chowdhury is not going to inspect the SSC examination centers this time in the interest of the students. All coaching centers in the country will remain closed until March 12.

Headline_English: Decision on Mirza Fakhrul's trial is a matter for the court: Quader
Content_Enlish:
Awami League General Secretary Obaidul Quader said that all decisions on BNP Secretary General Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir's bail or trial are a matter for the court, not the government. 

He said these things at the Awami League President's political office in Dhanmondi on Thursday (February 15) afternoon.

At that time, Awami League General Secretary Obaidul Quader said that the nominations for the reserved seats have been given according to the decision of the parliamentary board.

Headline_English: Young man's body found with throat slit a day after wedding
Content_Enlish:
Police recovered the body of a young man named Omar Ali (25) with his throat slit just a day after his wedding. His body was recovered from a pepper field near his house in Taher Pur village of Latachapoli union at 9 am on Tuesday (February 6). The incident took place in Mahipur, Patuakhali. 

The deceased Omar is the son of Shahjahan Faraji of the area. 

According to police and local sources, Omar Ali got married to Ruqaiya (18), the daughter of Shah Alam of Tajepara village of the same union, last Sunday. After the wedding ceremony at the bride's house yesterday, Ruqaiya was brought to Omar Ali's house along with her family members. Omar left the house to offer prayers in the early hours of the morning. Later, around 7 am, locals found his throat slit in a pepper field. 

Newlywed Ruqaiya said, "After the Fajr call to prayer, we both went to the pond to perform ablution. He was going to the mosque to offer prayers and I returned home." Later, I heard that his body was lying there. 

Omar Ali's father Shahjahan Faraji said, "I went to the mosque after seeing my son and wife on the bank of the pond during Fajr. Later, when I returned after the congregational prayer, I saw them lying in the pepper field." 

Mahipur Police Station OC Anwar Hossain Talukder said that an investigation is underway into the matter. A country-made knife has been recovered from the scene.

Headline_English: Teletalk, BTCL and Tesis going to private sector
Content_Enlish:
State Minister for Posts, Telecommunications and Information Technology Junaid Ahmed Palak has said that government-owned companies Teletalk, Bangladesh Telecommunications Company Limited (BTCL) and Telephone Industry Corporation (Tessis), which have been in losses for years, are being privatized. 

State Minister Junaid Ahmed Palak has given an ultimatum to these companies to return to profit by June 30. He said that the government believes that privatization is the most appropriate way to save the industries that have fallen into a loss-making cycle at this time. 

He made these remarks while talking to media personnel during a recent visit to Tessis. In this regard, State Minister for Posts, Telecommunications and Information Technology Junaid Ahmed Palak said that companies whose source of income is not profitable; there is only loss. They will be closed. 

Teletalk started its journey in 2004 by responding to customers with affordable packages. As an operator, this company was the first to launch 3G and 5G services in the country. 

Teletalk and Bangladesh Telecommunication Regulatory Commission (BTRC) sources say that Teletalk, which failed to capitalize on the opportunity, has incurred losses of Tk 1,337 crore in the last 20 years. BTRC receives Tk 1,848.63 crore from the company for spectrum and license fees. In addition, Teletalk's total expenses in the 2022-23 fiscal year were Tk 749 crore and they incurred losses of Tk 247 crore. 

According to BTCL's audit report, BTCL has incurred losses for 15 consecutive years before the 2021-22 fiscal year. The loss trend is still continuing. Their total expenses in the 2022-23 fiscal year are about Tk 888 crore and their losses are Tk 146 crore. Currently, the company's total dues to customers are Tk 2,150 crore. These may not be recovered. Currently, BTRC receives Tk 1,100 crore from BTCL as a share of income and various fees. 

Read more: France-Bangladesh economic diplomacy has come a long way: Palak 

In 1973, the Telephone Industry Company was established in Tongi, Gazipur, on 14 acres of land. Siemens jointly produced technology products here until 2008. In 2004, Samsung came up with a large investment proposal. However, both brands have left due to mismanagement and commission trading at Tesis. Even the State Minister himself was cheated by officials while visiting Tesis recently. 

Regarding the mismanagement of Tesis, State Minister for Posts, Telecommunications and Information Technology Junaid Ahmed Palak said that there was no monitoring and accountability at Tesis. After that, Tesis's profits gradually decreased and they started breaking the FDR and earning salaries. 

The government does not want to invest in any institution that is making losses due to mismanagement and irregularities. That is why the State Minister for Posts, Telecommunications and Information Technology announced the release of Teletalk, BTCL and Tesis to the private sector. 

He said, Teletalk, BTCL and Tesis - these three companies need to be valued. I have instructed the secretary of the ministry to raise this issue in the next board meeting. To turn these companies into profitable companies, we want to attract domestic investment on the one hand; as well as foreign investment.

Headline_English: Private car driver killed in road accident in Munshiganj
Content_Enlish:
A private car driver was killed and a passenger was injured in a road accident in the Baluakandi area of ​​the Gazaria section of the Dhaka-Chittagong highway in Munshiganj. 

The deceased private car driver is named Abdur Rahim (50). He is the son of Surat Ali of Rezzakpur village in Chatkhil upazila of Noakhali district. The injured private car passenger is an unidentified male (45). 

It was learned from some eyewitnesses to the incident that on Wednesday (February 7), around 11 am, a private car heading to Dhaka from Noakhali came in front of the Baluakandi Saddam Highway Hotel and Restaurant in the Gazaria section of the Dhaka-Chittagong highway and the driver lost control. 

At that time, the car lost control and hit the road divider and overturned, killing the driver on the spot. A passenger in the car was seriously injured. The injured were rescued and sent to Dhaka Medical College Hospital by locals. 

Regarding the matter, SI Riyad Hossain of Gazaria Highway Police Outpost said, "The body of the deceased is currently at the Gazaria Bhaberchar Highway Police Outpost. The car involved in the accident has been removed from the highway. Traffic is normal."

Headline_English: CU professor Matin dismissed over attempted rape allegations, demands for permanent expulsion
Content_Enlish:
Professor Mahbubul Matin of the Department of Chemistry of Chittagong University has been temporarily suspended on charges of attempted rape. However, the protesting students have announced that the movement will continue until they are permanently expelled; if necessary, they will be more strict. 

This time, teachers have also joined the ongoing movement called by the students. They stood hand in hand on Wednesday. They want exemplary punishment for those involved. The teachers allege that one incident after another is happening due to the indifference of the university administration. The vice-chancellor is also remaining silent. 

This movement has been going on for several days, demanding exemplary punishment for Matin on charges of attempted rape. On the fifth day of the continuous movement, the university administration informed the accused teacher of the decision to be dismissed by military service. The university administration called on the students to return to class, stating that their demands have been accepted. 

The university authorities have also expressed anger that the university authorities have not filed a case against the teacher of the Department of Chemistry.

Headline_English: New information revealed about Mbappe's move to Real Madrid
Content_Enlish:
The news of French star Mbappe leaving PSG for Real Madrid is constantly adding new twists. Although the matter of Mbappe's move to Real Madrid has not yet been finalized. 

Spanish and French media outlets are announcing that Mbappe himself has decided to leave PSG for Real Madrid as a free agent in the summer transfer window. But it is believed that PSG will continue to try to keep Mbappe until the end. 

Read more: Inter Miami lost in Messi's comeback match 

Spanish media outlet Cadena SER has provided some new information about the financial agreement between Real and Mbappe. They said that even though Mbappe joined Real as a free agent, Mbappe has demanded a high salary and a very large signing bonus. Mbappe could even become the highest-paid player in Europe. In addition to a salary of 50 million euros per season, Mbappe wants to receive a signing bonus of 120 million euros from Real. 

Football Espana claimed on its Twitter handle that Mbappe could complete his contract with Real Madrid for 125 million pounds. However, there is a significant gap between Mbappe's demands and Real Madrid's offer. Real Madrid wants to pay Mbappe 15 million euros in salary as well as a 60 million euro signing bonus. 

It is worth noting that Mbappe left Monaco in 2017 and joined French club PSG. But Mbappe always dreamed of playing for Real Madrid. Although information about Mbappe's move to Real Madrid had spread several times before, it was later revealed to be a rumor.

Headline_English: Schools will remain open for the first 15 days of Ramadan
Content_Enlish:
Schools will remain open for 15 days in the upcoming month of Ramadan. The holiday list and syllabus for the 2024 academic year of government and private secondary and lower secondary schools have been partially revised. According to the new decision, class activities will continue in government and private secondary and lower secondary schools for 15 days from March 11 to March 25. This information was given in a press release sent by the Ministry of Education's Information and Public Relations Officer Mohammad Abul Khair on Thursday (February 8). 
The annual holiday list published at the beginning of the year had a holiday from March 11 to April 18. Classes were supposed to be closed for a long period, combining several public holidays including the Holy Ramadan, Eid-ul-Fitr, summer vacation, National Children's Day, Independence Day, Easter Sunday. 
However, the Ministry of Education has deviated from that and announced a new decision. 
It is known that Ramadan may begin in Bangladesh on March 11 or 12 this year.

Headline_English: If you are the mother of a child, you will receive 82 lakh taka.
Content_Enlish:
South Korea is one of the countries with the lowest birth rate in the world. If the fertility rate continues to decline in South Korea, our country may face an existential crisis in the next 20 years. 

Therefore, in addition to government initiatives, private initiatives are trying to increase the birth rate in the country. Seoul-based company Buyong. This company is of international standard. The market in Europe is good. This company announced last Wednesday that if you give birth to a child, you will receive 75 thousand dollars, which is more than 82 lakh taka in Bangladeshi currency. 

Seoul-based company Buyong announced at a ceremony last Wednesday that a total of 5.25 million or 5.25 lakh thousand dollars will be awarded to women working in their company from 2021 for giving birth to 70 children. 

Lee Jung-kyun, chairman of Buyong Company, said that if the fertility rate continues to decline in South Korea, our country may face an existential crisis in the next 20 years. 

He said that the number of children a family will have often depends on the financial stability of that family. Many times, it is seen that many people do not want to have more children because they cannot provide money to raise children and think about their future. So we have thought about giving bonuses to employees. Source, Outlook. 

In South Korea, one of the countries with the lowest birth rates in the world, the birth rate was 0.78 percent in 2023. In 2022, it was 0.81 percent. 

In Busan, South Korea's second largest city, mothers of multiple children are separately being given additional support ranging from $377 to $7,552. 

In rural areas of South Jeolla Province in the country's southwest, a mother is being given $453 per month for 7 years for each child. 

However, many experts believe that it is unclear whether this cash payment for new mothers will have a positive effect on the South Korean population. 

Cho Ju-yeon, a 39-year-old interpreter, told the media that she got married about 10 years ago. But, she is not thinking about having children. The amount of money the government is giving is not a consideration for him. 
Like thieves, many South Koreans are reluctant to get married. And many are not interested in having children even if they do. 

A government survey found that 36.7 percent of people aged 19 to 34 in the country have not expressed interest in having children. 

According to a survey by the Korean Association for Social Studies, only 4 percent of young women in South Korea think that marriage and children are necessary.

Headline_English: Branding of the country is essential to advance the tourism industry: Mayor Atiq
Content_Enlish:
Dhaka North City Corporation Mayor Atiqul Islam said that branding Bangladesh in the world is essential to take Bangladesh's tourism industry forward. And this branding will have to start from Dhaka. 

He said this at the inauguration ceremony of the three-day international tourism fair titled 'Biman-Dhaka Travel Mart 2024' that began at the ballroom of Sonargaon Hotel on Thursday (February 8) afternoon. 

Civil Aviation and Tourism Ministry Secretary Md. Mokammel Hossain, Biman Bangladesh Airlines Managing Director and CEO Shafiul Azim, FBCCI President Mahbubul Alam, Bangladesh Tourism Corporation Chairman AKM Aftab Hossain Pramanik, and Bangladesh Tourism Board CEO Abu Tahir Mohammad Jabir spoke at the inauguration ceremony. 

During this time, the speakers called on everyone to come forward to develop the tourism industry.

Headline_English: How to speed up a slow phone
Content_Enlish:
It is always annoying when the phone becomes slow. It takes a long time to multitask (use many apps at the same time) on the device. Many Android phone users almost face these problems. If you know some ways, you can easily get rid of these problems. 

The main reason for the slow speed of the Android phone is its digital trash. Deleting these will make the Android phone run faster. You can try some of the following methods to speed up the Android device. 

Delete browsing data 
Browser data occupies the internal space of the phone and slows down the phone. To speed up the Android device, you must first delete the browser's cache files or browsing data. No matter which browser you use, like Google Chrome or Samsung web browser, you need to delete their cache files or browsing data from time to time. For this, follow the steps below— 

1. Tap on the three dots at the top right of the web browser. Tapping will show a menu. 
2. Then scroll down the menu and select the Settings option. 
3. Tap on the Privacy & Security option. Then tap on ‘Clear Browsing Data’. 
4. Tap on the ‘Down’ icon. This will give you a time frame of the saved data. Then select the options by checking the empty boxes next to Browsing history, cookies, site data and image and file cache files. 
5. Then tap on the ‘Clear’ button at the bottom right of the screen. 

Delete app cache files 
Cache and temporary files of Android apps like browsers slow down the phone. So it is important to delete them too. 

1. Go to the settings of your Android phone and tap on the App Storage option. 
2. Tap on each app installed on your device. Depending on the type of app, there will be a button to clear storage and cache. Tap on one or both buttons to delete unwanted data. As a result, uninstalling the app will only delete its unwanted data. 

> Deleting temporary files and cache every few days will not slow down the phone. 

Disable unnecessary apps and games 
Uninstalling the app completely deletes it from the device. And ‘disabling’ the app removes it from the list of active (running) apps and stops the app from running in the background. If you do not use the disabled apps, no notifications about them will be displayed on the device. How to disable apps— 

1. Enter the phone's settings. 
2. Scroll down and tap on the app option. 
3. Tap on the apps you want to disable. 
4. Tap the disable button at the bottom of the screen. 

>Avoid installing apps that claim to clean the phone's RAM and data storage. They can steal phone information. 

Turn off phone animation settings 
You can increase the phone's performance by changing some animation settings on Android phones. Turning off several screen features like zooming, spinning, and fading will improve the phone's battery health. 

The default animation settings of a slow phone can further slow down the device. For this, you need to change some of the settings. 

1. Go to your phone's settings. 
2. Scroll down and tap the System button. Then tap Developer Options inside the System menu. If you don't find Developer Options, follow step 3. And find the option and follow step 4 directly. 
3. Enter the Settings page again. 

a. Scroll down and tap the 'About Phone' option. 
b. Scroll down to the bottom of the screen and tap the 'Build Number' option seven times. 
c. Enter the phone's lock screen password. (If the device asks for it) 
d. Go back to Settings and tap the System option. Tap on Developer Options inside the system menu. 

4. Tap on Developer Options and enable it. 
5. Tap on the ‘Drawing’ option in the Developer menu. 
6. Find these three options – Windows Animation Scale, Transition Animation Scale and Animator Duration Scale. 
7. Tap on the scale line of these three settings and select the speed option. Now select the desired speed or speed by dragging it with your finger. 
8. Select these settings according to your needs. As the scales change, different speeds will be seen on the phone. 

Apart from these, follow the following methods to increase the speed of your Android phone 

1. Update Android apps regularly. Many of these apps update very frequently. Older app versions slow down the phone, introduce malware and increase the risk of hack attacks. 
2. Restart the phone every few days. This can clear the accumulated digital trash and free up internal storage and memory. 
3. Stop using widgets excessively. Widgets use system resources, which can damage RAM and battery health. 
3. Change the refresh rate. Android's refresh rate controls how quickly images or animations on the screen respond to updates. The higher the rate, the faster the screen refreshes. The refresh rate can be changed from the Display option in Settings.

Headline_English: Meta removes Khamenei from Facebook and Instagram
Content_Enlish:
Meta has removed the accounts of Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Khamenei from social media platforms Facebook and Instagram. NDTV reported this news in a report citing the AFP news agency. 

The company said that Khamenei has been banned from Facebook and Instagram for violating the policies. 

Read more: The number of Palestinians killed in Gaza has reached 28,000 

A spokesperson for the company told AFP that we have removed these accounts for repeated violations of our company's policies. Although the Hamas-Israel conflict was cited as the reason for banning the Iranian Supreme Leader's accounts on the two popular social media platforms, the Meta spokesperson did not mention anything in this regard. 

However, Meta has been under pressure since the start of the Israel-Hamas war on October 7. Khamenei has sided with Hamas in this war. Although Iran has denied its involvement in the war.

Headline_English: Possible time for publishing medical admission test results known
Content_Enlish:
The MBBS admission test for the 2023-24 academic year was held on Friday (February 9) morning. The test was held simultaneously at 44 venues in 19 test centers across the country. 

Director (Medical Education) of the Directorate of Health Education, Professor Dr. Mohiuddin Matubbar, told the media that the results of the MBBS admission test may be published next Sunday (February 11). 

He said that this time 1 lakh 4 thousand 374 students have participated in the test. Everything related to the results will be prepared on Saturday. 

Out of the 19 centers for this year's MBBS admission test, five centers were in Dhaka and 14 outside Dhaka. This time, 1 lakh 4 thousand 374 candidates have applied for admission against 5 thousand 380 seats in 37 government medical colleges and a total of 6 thousand 295 seats in 67 medical colleges approved at the private level. 

According to the Directorate of Health Education, there are a total of 5 thousand 380 seats in the 2023-24 session in the government medical colleges of the country. Accordingly, about 19 people will fight for each seat. And there are 6,168 seats in private medical. In total, students participated in the admission battle for 11,548 seats. In that case, about 9 students are fighting for each seat. 

The minimum score (pass score) in the MBBS and BDS admission test has been kept at 40 like last time. Students will get three times for migration. All colleges have been kept open for admission to private medical. That is, students can give their choice to all colleges at once, the same rule is valid in government medical colleges. 

In addition, 10 marks will be deducted from the students who are admitted to government and private medical and dental colleges for the second time. District quota has been canceled in the admission test this academic year. If the seats in the freedom fighter quota cannot be filled within the stipulated time, general students will get the opportunity to get admission in those seats.

Headline_English: Artificial intelligence-based government brain to be created: Palak
Content_Enlish:
State Minister for Posts, Telecommunications and Information Technology Junaid Ahmed Palak said that an artificial intelligence-based government brain will be created. He said this at the inauguration of the Job Fair for Persons with Disabilities-2024 organized by the Bangladesh Computer Council (BCC) at the office building of the NGO Affairs Bureau in Agargaon, Dhaka on Saturday (February 10) morning. The Center for Services and Information on Disability and the NGO Affairs Bureau have cooperated in organizing the event. 

He said that the ICT Ministry has provided jobs for about 1,000 disabled people. If the other ministries also come forward, it will reach 50,000. 

Secretary of the Information and Communication Technology Department Md. Shamsul Arefin, Director General of the NGO Affairs Bureau of the Prime Minister's Office (Grade-1) Md. Saidur Rahman and Executive Director of CSID Khandaker Zahurul Alam were present as special guests at the event. 

Director of the Training and Development Department of the BCC Md. Golam Sarwar. 
The event was presided over by BCC Executive Director (Grade-1) Ranjit Kumar. 

48 ICT-based organizations and job seekers with disabilities participated in the fair. 

Earlier, more than 500 disabled people from all over the country submitted their CVs online. In addition, disabled job seekers got the opportunity to submit their CVs or resumes by attending the fair in person. The organizations participating in the fair conducted interviews with the aim of hiring those who have IT skills. The next recruitment process will be started after the job fair by including disabled job seekers in the shortlist for various positions including call center agents, data entry, graphics design, web design, digital marketing, animation, programming. This time, the organizing authorities are hoping that it will be possible to provide jobs to about 50 people through this fair. 

Free ICT training for disabled people has been introduced through BCC since 2011. Later, job fairs have been organized since 2015 with the participation of job seekers and employer organizations to provide employment to disabled people who have undergone ICT training. Headline_English: Naeem Nizam's new book at the book fair
Content_Enlish:
Journalist and columnist Naeem Nizam's new book 'Apanjonder Beimaanite Patan Sirajuddaulaar' has arrived at the Amar Ekushey Book Fair. A total of 31 works have been included in this book. Various topics of contemporary politics, economics, history and socio-culture have been brought up. There are many unknown chapters of the history of Bangladesh before and after independence. The book has been published by Anbesha Prakashan. 

Anbesha publisher Md. Shahadat Hossain said, 'This year, we have published more than 50 new books from Anbesha. Among them, the book 'Apanjonder Beimaanite Patan Sirajuddaulaar' is leading in reader demand. This book has been arranged with selected writings from the popular columns of the country's renowned journalist Naeem Nizam. The story of political upheavals and the rise and fall of human life is the special attraction of this book.' 

The cover of the book is by Shakir Ehsanullah. Price 470 taka. Available at the book fair at Anvesha Prakashan Pavilion No. 27.

Headline_English: The reason why Mark Zuckerberg publicly apologized
Content_Enlish:
In a few days, the popular social media platform Facebook will be turning 20. But before such a joyful moment, the company's CEO Mark Zuckerberg had to publicly apologize. He apologized to everyone in a US Senate hearing about the negative impact of social media on children. 

According to a BBC report on Thursday, five CEOs were questioned in the US Congress on Wednesday in a hearing titled 'Big Tech and the Online Child Sexual Exploitation Crisis'. They are Mark Zuckerberg of Meta, Linda Iaccarino of X (formerly Twitter), Show Ji Chiu of TikTok, Evan Spiegel of Snap and Jason Citron of Discord. 

Many people brought pictures of children who died due to sexual abuse or harassment on social media to the hearing. 

At that time, Zuckerberg said to them, "I am sorry for what you have gone through. The loss that your family has suffered should not be like this." And that's why we invest so much. So that this doesn't happen to anyone else. And we will continue to try for this. 

US lawmakers complain that big tech companies are not doing enough to protect children from online sexual harassment. They want stricter laws. At the same time, US lawmakers want an explanation from executives about the steps taken so far. 

A statement from the US Senate Judiciary Committee said that this hearing has been called to investigate allegations of online child sexual abuse or harassment.

Headline_English: Sagar-Runi murder: Investigation is taking time because the real culprit cannot be caught
Content_Enlish:
Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs Minister Anisul Haque has said that the investigation into the Sagar-Runi murders is taking time because the police are unable to catch the real culprit. 

The Law Minister made this comment in response to questions from local media personnel regarding the murder case of journalist couple Sagar-Runi. 

The Minister arrived at Akhaura Railway Junction Station in Brahmanbaria on Friday (February 2) morning by the morning train from Dhaka and met with journalists. 

He arrived in his constituency on a two-day visit to inaugurate various development projects, including a public reception organized by the Kasba Upazila Awami League in Brahmanbaria on Friday afternoon and a public meeting organized by the Akhaura Upazila Awami League tomorrow. 

In response to journalists' questions, Anisul Haque said, "The investigation is taking time because the police are unable to catch the real culprit in the Sagar-Runi murder. That day, the United Kingdom also caught the culprit in a murder case after 42 years. A few days ago, the mystery of a murder case was solved in the United States of America after 24 years. What I mean is - the police here are trying. They are unable to catch the real culprit yet, that is why the investigation is taking time. Do you want the investigation to stop, the investigation will continue until the culprit is caught." 

The Law Minister further said, "I have said that even if it takes time to catch those who really committed this crime, and relatively speaking, I have said that even if it takes 50 years, we will catch them. By saying this, you have thought that it will take 50 years. What I am saying is - there should be a fair investigation, the real culprit should be caught. Our legal framework says - those who are not criminals cannot be harassed. The real culprit should be caught - that is why I have said this." 

Secretary of the Law Ministry Golam Sarwar, Additional Superintendent of Police (Special Branch) of Brahmanbaria Joynal Abedin, Mayor of Akhaura Municipality Takzil Khalifa Kajal, Akhaura Upazila Awami League President Mohammad Ali Chowdhury and others were present with the Law Minister. 

Later, the Law Minister left for his own upazila Kasba by road.

Headline_English: A lemon was sold for almost two lakh taka!
Content_Enlish:
Recently, a man went to an auction house to sell a very old cupboard. At that time, he said, it was bought in the 19th century, which later came into the ownership of my uncle. He later died. Anyway, the company bought the cupboard. Later, when preparations were being made to take a picture of it for auction, a lemon was found in the back drawer. Anyone's eyes are bound to be glazed when they hear the price that was raised after the fruit was put up for auction. 

The 285-year-old lemon fetched $1,780 (196,000 taka). It was sold at auction by Brittles Auctioneers in Shropshire, England. BBC News. 

The auction house said that a message could be seen written on the lemon. It read, 'The lemon was given to Miss E. Baxter on November 4, 1739, by Mr. P. Lu Franchini.' That is, they calculated that the lemon had been lying in the cupboard drawer for a long time. Then the family decided to auction the old lemon. 

There was a lot of interest in the 285-year-old lemon. However, there was not much interest in the cupboard. As a result, its price was only 4,400 taka ($40)!

Headline_English: No application required for health cadre promotion
Content_Enlish:
BCS (Health) cadre officials will get automatic promotion according to BCS batch, merit and qualification after updating HRM. As a result, no application is required from now on. This announcement was made in a notification signed by Md. Aminul Islam, Deputy Secretary of the Health Services Division, Part-2 Branch, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. 

The notification said that instead of accepting applications from BCS (Health) cadre employees, the authorities have decided to give promotions through a list automatically prepared according to BCS batch, merit and other qualifications after updating the Human Resource Information System. 

The notification also said that for the promotion of employees, a request has been made to send the list automatically prepared according to BCS batch, merit and other qualifications after updating the Human Resource Information System to the Health Services Department.

Headline_English: Argentina drew 3-3 with Uruguay
Content_Enlish:
Despite losing a point in the last match, the Argentina U-23 team has confirmed its place in the final South American qualifiers for the Paris Olympics. After stumbling in the first match, the Albiceleste turned around with two consecutive wins. This time, despite losing a point to Uruguay in the last match, the 2008 Olympic gold medalists have confirmed their place in the next round by becoming group champions. 

Messi's successors drew 3-3 with Uruguay at the Estadio Misael Delgado Stadium on Saturday (February 3). Luis Gallego Rodriguez, Aaron Facundo Queiroz and Francisco Agustin Gonzalez scored for the azure-blue camp. On the other hand, Luciano Rodriguez, Cesar Araujo and Matias Abaldo scored for Uruguay. 

Uruguay dominated the match from the start. They had 9 of their 23 shots on target. On the other hand, 6 of the Argentines' 18 shots were on target. 

The Albiceleste took a double lead within 11 minutes of the match. After Rodriguez, they went 2-0 up in the 11th minute with a goal by Aaron Facundo. 

However, Uruguay's Luciano Rodriguez scored in the 19th minute of the match to reduce the gap. 

Then, Argentina's Gonzalez made it 3-1 in the 25th minute of the match. However, just before the break, Argentina's Araujo put the ball in the net. 

Both teams returned from the break in search of victory. In the 61st minute of the match, Uruguay's Matias scored to make the scoreline 3-3. In the end, if there were no more goals, the match ended in a draw. 

It is worth noting that the group stage of the CONMEBOL pre-Olympic tournament was held in two groups. Each group had five teams. Two teams from two groups each got a chance to advance to the final round of Olympic qualifying. The top two teams from there will qualify for the Olympics. 

Along with Brazil, Argentina and Paraguay also qualified for the final round of Olympic qualifying. Venezuela qualified as the fourth team in this round. The top two teams from here will play in the Paris Olympics. 

Argentina will play Venezuela in the final round of qualifying on February 5. Paraguay will face Brazil on the same day. Then on February 8, Venezuela will face Brazil and Argentina will face Paraguay. In the last match of the group stage, Venezuela and Paraguay and Brazil and Argentina will face each other on February 11. From there, the top two teams in the points table will play in the 2024 Paris Olympics.

Headline_English: Students form human chain demanding half-pass on Metrorail
Content_Enlish:
Ordinary students have formed a human chain demanding half-pass for students on the metro rail. They demanded that the minimum fare be set at 10 taka by taking a stand in front of the metro rail station in the capital's Farmgate this Saturday morning. 

At that time, the students said that when they protested demanding half-fare during the operation of the metro rail from Uttara to Agargaon, the metro authorities assured them of reducing the fare by talking to the government. 

Read more: What the Meteorological Office said about the rain and cold wave 

They complained that the metro fare in Bangladesh is already much higher than in other countries. In this situation, the metro fare is a lot for a student. Although the government has promised to make the transportation system easier for students, it has not kept in mind the issue of discounting the fare. Therefore, it was informed that the students' program demanding half-pass for students on the metro rail will continue.

Headline_English: Husband and wife burned in gas line explosion in Rupganj
Content_Enlish:
A husband and wife were burnt in a gas line explosion in Rupganj, Narayanganj. Locals admitted them to the Sheikh Hasina National Burn Unit in Dhaka for treatment. 

The incident took place in the early hours of Saturday (February 3) in the Kawarchar Nayapara area of ​​Golakandail Union of the upazila. 

The burnt victims are Jahanara from Sylhet district and her husband Shamim Mia from Barisal district. They lived as tenants in the house of local Abu Musa Mia. 

Locals and eyewitnesses said that they were woken up by a loud noise early on Saturday night. Later, they went ahead and saw that the tenant's house of Abu Musa Mia was on fire. Later, the fire was brought under control with the help of locals. However, by then, many parts of the bodies of husband Shamim Mia and wife Jahanara, who were in the house, were burnt. Later, they were rescued and taken to a local private hospital, where the doctors on duty sent them to Dhaka. They are currently undergoing treatment at the Sheikh Hasina National Burn Unit. 

In this regard, Inspector Mostafizur Rahman of Bhulta Police Outpost said, "Police were sent to the scene early in the morning after receiving information about the explosion. The burnt husband and wife were rescued with the help of locals and sent to the Sheikh Hasina National Burn Unit in Dhaka. Initially, it is believed that the fire started from a gas line explosion."

Headline_English: 530 migrants, including 94 Bangladeshis, detained in Malaysia
Content_Enlish:
The country's immigration department has arrested 530 illegal immigrants in Malaysia. Among them, 94 are Bangladeshi citizens. The Star reported that the operation began late on Friday (February 2) at the Serikem Bangan wholesale market in Selangor state. It ended at 6 am on Saturday (February 3). 530 people were arrested in the three-hour operation. 

Selangor Immigration Department Director Khairul Aminus Kamar Uddin, who participated in the operation, said that out of the 530 people arrested in the operation, 504 were men and 26 were women. Among them, 94 are Bangladeshis. 

In addition, 277 are Myanmar citizens, 72 are Indian, 39 are Indonesian, 15 are Nepalese, 9 are Sri Lankan, 6 are Pakistani and 1 is Vietnamese. Khairul Aminus said that the detained immigrants will be checked for valid documents. 

The General Operations Force (PGA), Royal Malaysia Police, Malaysian Civil Defence Force (APM), Selangor National Registration Department (JPN) and Subang City Council also participated in the operation.

Headline_English: BCSIR Science and Industry-Technology Fair concludes
Content_Enlish:
The 'BCSIR Science and Industrial Technology Fair 2024' organized by the Bangladesh Council for Scientific and Industrial Research (BCSIR) has come to an end. The three-day fair ended at the Dhanmondi campus of BCSIR on Saturday afternoon. 

Dhaka South City Corporation Mayor Barrister Sheikh Fazle Noor Taposh was present as the chief guest at the closing ceremony of this gathering of young scientists and distributed prizes and certificates among the competitors. 

Paying tribute to BCSIR scientist Dr. Amin Uddin and other deceased scientists who were killed on Martyr Intellectuals Day, the Mayor addressed the current young scientists, saying that science is a subject that is applicable to all aspects of life. There is no alternative to interest and attraction to focus on science. 

According to the Mayor, among today's children, there are unknown famous scientists and technologists of the future. He urged the scientists of the council to pay special attention to doing everything that BCSIR can do to make these children proficient in science research. 

Among the young scientists, Dhaka-10 MP Ferdous Ahmed, a film star, was present as a special guest. He said that the resources devoted to scientific practice never end, but rather increase at a geometric rate. The more our children become science-minded, the more Bangladesh will move forward in a prosperous manner. 

Quoting the Prime Minister's speech, he also said that there is no alternative to scientific research in building a smart Bangladesh. 

Dr. Senjuji Saha, Director of the Child Health Research Foundation and renowned microbiologist, was present as the 'Guest of Honor' at the closing ceremony. He said that our ancestors have snatched the independence of this country by shedding their blood. The time has come to repay their blood debt. I believe that by fulfilling the responsibilities and duties entrusted to us, we can repay their blood debt to some extent by building a prosperous Bangladesh. 

In the president's speech, the chairman of the council, Professor Dr. Md. Aftab Ali Sheikh told the young scientists, "You cannot become a science researcher if you participate in the three-day science fair and stay away from science for the remaining 362 days. You are the only ones who can show the nation the path of new light. For that, you have to be prepared. You will move forward by overcoming all obstacles on your way. BCSIR is always by your side to make your journey more beautiful and smooth."

Headline_English: Neela, the champion of 'Miss World Bangladesh'
Content_Enlish:
The 'Miss World Bangladesh-2023' pageant has been held. The final round of the competition was held at Mana Bay Water Park in Munshiganj on January 28. Fashion influencer, model and TikToker Shammi Islam Neela has been crowned the winner of this year's 'Miss World Bangladesh-2023'. 

First runner-up was Aklima Atika Kanika and second runner-up was Shakira Tamanna. 

Five judges selected this year's 'Miss World Bangladesh-2023' from 20 contestants. 

Winner Neela will represent Bangladesh in the 71st Miss World pageant. This year's main event will be in India. Winners from various countries, including Neela, will travel to Delhi on February 18 to attend this pageant. The 'Miss World-2023' pageant will be held in India on March 9. 

'Miss World Bangladesh' champion Shammi Islam Neela was born and raised in Dhaka. 23-year-old Neela is the elder of two siblings. She is studying BBA at North South University in the capital. Since childhood, she had wanted to participate in the 'Miss World' competition. She has been modeling for three years. She regularly works as an influencer with several Bangladeshi brands in the field of fashion and beauty. Popular on all three social media platforms - Facebook, Instagram and TikTok, Neela said that she wants to model and act in the future. She will also work to protect the rights of animals. 

After winning 'Miss World Bangladesh', she told the media that she wants to be a good person and a person everyone likes first. 

The organizing organization, Aristocrat Events, said that the contestants started registering for this year's edition from September 2023. About three thousand contestants registered for the competition. From there, 500 contestants were selected. Another 200 contestants were eliminated in the second round of selection. They were brought to Dhaka for auditions. Later, a camp started with 20 contestants selected from 300. After that, the grand finale was held on January 28.

Read more: What Nayak Riaz said about Shabnur 

The judges present at this year's grand finale were renowned actor Afzal Hossain, actress Tania Ahmed, beauty expert Kaniz Almas Khan, director Raihan Rafi and photographer Rafiqul Islam Raf.

Headline_English: It may rain, it may get colder.
Content_Enlish:
The Meteorological Department has forecast rain again at the end of this week. The Meteorological Office has informed that there may be light rain in the southern regions including Dhaka on Tuesday and Wednesday. 

The Meteorological Department's forecast for today, Sunday (February 4), says that the weather may remain dry with partly cloudy skies today. In addition, dense to moderate fog may fall in the river basins from late night to morning and light to moderate fog may fall elsewhere. 

According to the forecast, the night temperature may increase by 1 to 2 degrees Celsius until February 6. However, the extended five-day forecast says that the night temperature may decrease. 

According to the Meteorological Office, there is a possibility of light rain on the 6th and 7th. This rain may occur in the southern regions including Dhaka. After the rain, the temperature is likely to decrease slightly at night. 

Meanwhile, the lowest temperature in the country yesterday, Saturday, was 9.5 degrees Celsius in Dinajpur. Besides, the highest temperature was 29 degrees in Sitakunda.

Headline_English: Six educational institutions in Bandarban announced to close
Content_Enlish:
Six educational institutions along the border have been closed due to security concerns following the increase in firing in the Ghumdhum border area of ​​Naikshongchhari in Bandarban. 
The administration announced the closure of educational institutions along the border in Ghumdhum Union on Sunday. 

On Sunday (February 4), District Secondary Education Officer Md. Faridul Alam Hossaini said that since the morning, Bais Phari Government Primary School, Bhaja Bonia Government Primary School, Tumbru Government Primary School, Paschim Kul Tumbru Government Primary School and Dakshin Ghumdhum Government Primary School in the border area have been temporarily closed due to the increase in firing inside the Myanmar border area. In addition, a madrasa has also been closed. 

Naikshongchhari Primary Education Officer Tri Ratan Chakma said that teachers, students and guardians in the border area have been asked to stay safe. Tensions have increased in Myanmar along with the firing for the past few days. For this reason, teachers and students of educational institutions adjacent to the border are in panic. These educational institutions have been closed due to security concerns. 
Police Inspector (IC) of the Ghumdhum Investigation Center, Mahfuz Imtiaz Bhuiyan, confirmed that firing was going on at the Ghumdhum-Tumbru border from Saturday night to 11 am on Sunday (February 4).

Headline_English: Australia beat West Indies by 83 runs to win series
Content_Enlish:
Australia defeated West Indies by 83 runs at the Sydney Cricket Ground to win the three-match ODI series 2-0. 

West Indies won the toss and elected to bowl first on Sunday (February 4). Australia scored 258 runs for the loss of 9 wickets after the stipulated 50 overs. Gudakesh Moti took the highest three wickets for the West Indies. Romario Shepherd and Alzarri Joseph took 2 wickets each. 

However, chasing the target of 258 runs, the Indies innings was bundled out for 175 runs with 39 balls remaining. For the Australian bowlers, Shaun Abbott and Josh Hazlewood took 3 wickets each. Australia's Shaun Abbott, who scored 69 runs off 63 balls and 3 wickets for 40 runs in 10 overs with the ball, was named man of the match.

Headline_English: Guidelines for digitization of cable services to be prepared soon: State Minister for Information
Content_Enlish:
State Minister for Information and Broadcasting Mohammad Ali Arafat said that guidelines will be prepared soon for the digitization of cable services. 

The State Minister said these things during an exchange of views with the leaders of the Cable Operators Association of Bangladesh at the meeting room of the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting at the Secretariat on Sunday afternoon. 

The State Minister said that discipline will be brought in all areas including cable television broadcasting and OTT platforms. Guidelines for the digitization of cable services will be prepared in a short time. In addition, swift action will be taken to stop violations and deviations in cable television broadcasting. In this regard, the issue of national security will also be considered. 

He also said that every stakeholder involved in cable television broadcasting is in favor of digitization. There is no obstacle in this regard. Therefore, the government will try to do the work quickly. If digitization happens, the government will get more revenue, and there will be much more transparency. 

In response to a question from journalists regarding the OTT platform, the State Minister said that the government welcomes any advancement in technology, including the OTT platform. But action will be taken where laws and rules are violated. At the same time, national interests and security will be ensured. With the advancement of technology, a kind of risk is also created, and those places will also be considered quickly. 

He also said that technology must be welcomed. There must be a mindset to accept the changes that technology is bringing about. It is also important to have a positive mindset to adopt technology. 

The State Minister for Information and Broadcasting said that we cannot allow any violation of the existing laws in the country. Law and national security will receive the highest priority for the government. The ministry will take a decision based on that. The State Minister also emphasized inter-ministerial coordination and communication in this regard. 

Cable Operators Association of Bangladesh President ABM Saiful Hossain, General Secretary Mosharraf Ali Chanchal, members Nizam Uddin Masud, Rashid Malik, Farid Uddin and Habib Ali were present. 

The State Minister exchanged views with the leaders of the Bangladesh Film Exhibitors Association in the afternoon.

Headline_English: Bangladesh beat Pakistan to reach final
Content_Enlish:
Bangladesh U-19 women's team is performing well in the tri-nation series at home. The hosts have secured the final after winning a hat-trick. The red-green representatives continued their winning streak by defeating Pakistan by 4 wickets in the fourth match. 

Bangladesh won the toss and invited Pakistan to bat at the Sheikh Kamal International Cricket Stadium in Cox's Bazar on Wednesday (January 31). 

Batting, the visitors gave the hosts an easy target of 96 runs. In reply, Sumaiya Bahini reached the port of victory with 18 balls and 4 wickets in hand. 

Bangladesh lost wickets early while chasing an easy target. Sumaiya Akhter Suborna fell into the trap of leg-before-four after scoring zero runs off 5 balls. 

Then another opener Eva returned to the dressing room with a personal score of 14 runs. However, captain Sumaiya Akhter showed the way to victory by scoring 38 runs off 40 balls. In addition, Ira played an innings of 16 runs. In the end, Bangladesh won with 18 balls and 4 wickets in hand.

Earlier, Pakistan lost the toss and elected to bat, but the opening pair was broken by the team's 15 runs, but turned around for the second wicket. However, the run rate was like that of Test cricket. 

In the meantime, the visitors lost four more wickets after adding just four runs to the scoreboard from the team's 88. Out of which, three were run outs. In the end, the Pakistani women scored 95 runs for the loss of 5 wickets in the stipulated 20 overs. 

Samia Afsar played the highest innings of 48 runs off 58 balls for the visitors. In addition, Aresha Ansari scored 26 runs off 41 balls. Rabeya Khatun took two wickets for Bangladesh. 

Bangladesh will face Sri Lankan women in the title match on February 2.

Headline_English: Two sentenced to death in Anwara murder case
Content_Enlish:
The court has sentenced two people to death in a 33-year-old murder case of Anwara Police Station in Chittagong. Judge Mohammad Halim Ullah Chowdhury of the Chittagong Divisional Speedy Trial Tribunal gave the verdict on Monday (January 29). 

The death sentences are Md. Osman and Nuruzzaman. 

According to the case records, Azizur Rahman was stabbed to death by entering a house in Haripara, Gahira village of Anwara Police Station on June 24, 1991. 

The deceased's brother Abdul Nabi filed a case with Anwara Police Station as the plaintiff in this incident. After the investigation of the case, the charge sheet was submitted to the court and the court framed charges against the accused on July 10, 1993 and started the trial. 

Government prosecutor of the tribunal Ashok Kumar Das said that the charges against the accused were proven based on the testimony of 9 witnesses, so the court ordered the death penalty and a fine of Tk 50,000 each for Md. Osman and Nuruzzaman. The two accused were absconding at the time of the verdict. Later, the court issued arrest warrants against them based on the original sentence warrant.

Headline_English: Prices of commodities will soon be under control: Salman F. Rahman
Content_Enlish:
Prime Minister's Private Industry and Investment Advisor Salman F. Rahman said, "The prices of some products in the country's market have increased unreasonably. The prices of some products have already decreased due to the government's intervention. The Ministry of Finance and Commerce is working in coordination with other ministries and organizations to control prices of goods. I hope that prices of goods will come under control soon." 

He said these things while talking to reporters at the Bangladesh Investment Development Authority building in Agargaon in the capital on Monday (January 30). 

The Prime Minister's advisor said, "If remittances and exports can be increased at this time, it will be easier to control prices of goods." He said, "Various initiatives have been taken by the government in this regard. I hope that the dollar crisis will end." 

The advisor said that a decision has been made to increase the facilities in these two sectors by giving importance to the export of leather and jute products. I believe that exports will increase if other sectors like the garment industry are given the same facilities. 

Regarding the gas crisis, he said, "What has happened now is temporary. LNG was purchased a few days ago. And the good news for the future is that many new gas discoveries have been made. First we got gas in Bhola, now Chevron has got it, Petrobangla has got it too. 

The advisor said, "The export of garment products started on a small scale at first. Furniture, refrigerators, air conditioners are also being exported abroad now. We never imagined that Bangladesh would be able to export so much. Our exports have become diversified, but the amount is not increasing. The Prime Minister said, if the same facilities that have been given to garments are also given to other sectors, then it will be easy to diversify exports."

Headline_English: Rohit Shetty will not make any more films with Shah Rukh!
Content_Enlish:
After popular film series like 'Golmaal' and 'Singham', Bollywood director Rohit Shetty has recently appeared on the OTT screen with a web series called 'Indian Police Force'. Although his relationship equation with all the stars of the Hindi film industry is good, there are whispers that Rohit does not have a good relationship with the 'Badshah' of Bollywood, Shah Rukh Khan. 

In 2013, Shah Rukh played the lead role in the film 'Chennai Express' directed by Rohit. This was his first time working with Rohit. Bollywood actress Deepika Padukone acted opposite Shah Rukh in this film. 

In an old interview, Rohit said, ''Chennai Express' is more of a Shah Rukh film than a Deepika film.'' After the release of 'Chennai Express', it did business of more than 400 crore rupees at the box office worldwide. 

Within two years of the success of 'Chennai Express', Rohit teamed up with Shah Rukh again. Shah Rukh played the lead role in Rohit's 'Dilwale'. 

Apart from Shah Rukh, the main surprise of 'Dilwale' was the Shah Rukh-Kajal pair. After 'My Name Is Khan' released in 2010, Shah Rukh and Kajol acted together on the big screen again. 

'Baazigar', 'Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge', 'Kuch Kuch Hota Hai', 'Kavi Khushi Kavi Gham' and 'My Name Is Khan' - all the films in which Shah Rukh and Kajol acted together did well at the box office. 

Read more: How much did 'Fighter' earn at the box office on the fourth day 

There were rumors in the Bollywood industry that Shah Rukh and Kajol were returning to the big screen together after five years, so Rohit hoped that the film would be a hit. Along with Shah Rukh and Kajol, Varun Dhawan and Kriti Sanon were also seen acting in this film.

Despite the presence of Shah Rukh and Kajol, romance and action, 'Dilwale' failed to see success at the box office. There are whispers in the Bollywood industry that after the failure of 'Dilwale', Rohit's relationship with Shah Rukh fell apart. 

Rohit has not been seen working with Shah Rukh in any other film after 'Dilwale'. A section of the Bollywood industry speculates that there was some kind of tension between the two stars after the film 'Dilwale'. That is why Rohit has not been seen working with Shah Rukh. 

A section of the Bollywood industry claims that the film 'Dilwale' did not succeed at the box office, which created a distance between Rohit and Shah Rukh. However, despite discussions and criticisms in the Bollywood industry about the relationship between the two stars, no one has ever commented on this matter. 

In a recent interview, when Rohit was asked about his relationship with Shah Rukh, the director finally opened up. Rohit was asked why he is not working with Shah Rukh, whether he is having any problems with the actor. 

Rohit, however, later claimed that he did not have any differences with Shah Rukh. Rather, the director said that he is waiting for a new script to offer Shah Rukh to act. 

Read more: Ranbir-Alia both received Filmfare awards 

Rohit said, "There is no reason not to want to work with Shah Rukh. I am waiting for a good script." However, the director has set a condition for that too. 

In the interview, Rohit said, "I want the film I work with Shah Rukh after this to be bigger than 'Chennai Express'." So, did the director indicate that he will not offer Shah Rukh to act without a big film? 

Rohit said, "If we get a good script and both Shah Rukh and I are interested, then we will definitely work together. "But the picture has to be very large."

Headline_English: Elon Musk's Neuralink installs first wireless chip in the brain
Content_Enlish:
Elon Musk wrote on social media X on Tuesday, ‘Yesterday (Monday) the first Neuralink implant was placed in a human body and now he is doing well.’ He also said, ‘The initial results have detected extraordinary neuron responses.’ 

AFP reported that the Neuralink startup implanted such a chip in the brain of a human patient for the first time on Tuesday, citing a statement from Elon Musk, and its initial results are promising. Source, DigiBangla. 
The AFP report said that Musk’s company, Neuralink, founded in 2016, aimed to create a direct communication channel between the brain and computers. Moreover, the company’s journey began with the ambition of creating technology to supercharge human capabilities and treat neurological diseases such as ALS or Parkinson’s.

Headline_English: Bangladeshi college student dies in New York road accident
Content_Enlish:
Bangladeshi college student Debpreeta De Brati (18) died in a road accident on Long Island Southern State Park Highway in New York early Sunday (January 28). She is the younger daughter of Debashish De Basu and Varshati De, a well-known face of the Central Pharmacy family and a drug dealer in Sylhet. 

Debpreeta De was a passenger in an Infiniti car on Exit 35 of Long Island Southern State Park Highway. Her friend Jeevan Laken (19) was driving. On the way out, the Infiniti car collided with another Jeep, causing the car to veer off the road and hit a tree. Police arrived at the scene around 5:45 a.m. and found both passengers in the Infiniti dead. The driver of the other car was taken to a nearby hospital with injuries. The cause of the accident is unknown. Multiple departments of the New York Police Department have launched an investigation into the incident. 
Debpreeta, a student at Manhattan Community College, lived with her family in the Corona area of ​​Jackson Heights, Queens. Her parents were in the country at the time of the accident. 

Family sources said that Debpreeta's funeral will be held at Chalibandar in Sylhet city on Thursday. Debpreeta's parents, who are in the country, have been informed of the accident. After the news of the accident spread in New York, a shadow of grief fell on the community.

Headline_English: The economy will turn around once the new government starts working.
Content_Enlish:
Dr. Zayed Bakht, an economist with a distinguished career, has worked in various branches of economics at the national and international levels. 

Recently, he gave an interview. He spoke about the country's banking sector, inflation, the dollar crisis, the national pre-election economic situation, and the new government's assumption of office after the election. He also expressed his opinion on what the government should do at this moment. Interviewed by Zafar Ahmed. Photos taken by Senior Photo Correspondent GM Mujibur. 

Question: The new government took office with many challenges in mind. What can the government do now? 
Dr. Zayed Bakht: The macroeconomics was quite challenging. High inflation and the exchange rate of the rupee were a challenge. Although efforts were made from the policy-making stage to control these, there were limitations due to the election. Now the election has been held smoothly. For the government to succeed, it is necessary to reduce inflation, make the exchange rate market-oriented, and put more emphasis on foreign exchange supply or reserve management, as well as reforms in the banking and financial sectors. 

The pre-election situation has been overcome in the post-election period. The limitations that existed in policy-making are no longer there. This will further accelerate the economy. There was uncertainty locally and internationally. Due to fair elections in the country, that uncertainty has also been eliminated. In the meantime, the stock market has started to turn around. Now the government's slow steps will also increase in speed. As soon as the new government takes office, the situation will normalize. Everyone will come forward to invest. This will give momentum to the economy. Now investment, international trade will all accelerate. All things considered, we are moving into a favorable situation. There will be some improvement due to the revision of the government's policies. The government will move forward by setting priorities with new enthusiasm. The government has formed a new cabinet after much thought. From there, it can be understood that the wheels of the economy will be set in motion. As a result, the macroeconomics, inflation, and exchange rate will come under control to a large extent. 

There are some structural problems. For example, reforms in the banking sector, money laundering, these cannot be solved overnight. They have to be solved through policies. Corrective action will have to be taken for this. 

Question: Inflation is still a big problem, what kind of steps can be taken to control it? 

Dr. Zayed Bakht: Initially, the inflation rate may increase a little more, but it is temporary. Later, it will decrease in a short time. No production sector in the country has been disrupted. The industrial sector has been under a little pressure due to the high dollar rate. On the other hand, their production costs have increased due to the increase in electricity and fuel prices. This is global. Although the economy is under pressure due to this, there has been no disaster. Its pressure has also fallen on the banks. Because businessmen could not repay their loan installments properly. As a result, defaulted loans have increased. 

Before the Covid-19 pandemic, the country's economy was at an unprecedented height. Although many countries faced problems due to Covid, we did not face those problems due to our various positive policies. Due to the interest rate being 9 percent, businessmen did not face major losses. When the economy started to turn around after overcoming Covid, the Russia-Ukraine war started. As a result, instability began in the global dollar market. But many of those shocks have also been overcome. 

The current situation of the dollar in the international market is slightly lower than the value of other currencies (dollar). This has also reduced the inflation rate in the global economy. Therefore, if the global economy stabilizes, it will have an impact on our economy. As fuel oil prices have started falling in the global market, inflation is on the decline. Along with this, the trend of global inflation decreasing will also affect the country's economy in the new year. 

Question: Do you think the dollar crisis has stabilized or decreased to some extent? 
Dr. Zayed Bakht: It has not stabilized so far. We have controlled the current account balance efficiently, there is a surplus. But the financial account deficit is still there. As a result, reserves are decreasing. Investment has also decreased due to the dollar crisis. All in all, the financial account is under pressure. There is not much to be done here. However, after the elections, we are in a good position; it will be possible to overcome this. The dollar rate should be brought closer to the market rate. If the exchange rate is market-oriented, the pressure on foreign currencies will also decrease. This will play a role in increasing remittances and export earnings. 

With the elections in sight, the issue of capital laundering has come to the fore. The hundi market was there before and still is there. In the 2022-23 fiscal year, a gap was seen in the dollar market. A difference of 7/8 taka was seen. Which has never happened before. That means that there has been a large capital laundering. Especially when money laundering started through under and over invoicing, Bangladesh Bank was able to control it. Money laundering has also been prevented to some extent in mobile banking. But in the last one or two years, the hundi market could not be controlled administratively. Those who would launder money are collecting it from expatriates abroad at an increased price. And they are giving it to their relatives in the country. 

The rate is not an issue for hundi traders there. For this reason, it is not possible to fix the rate in Bangladesh. There is an administrative system. In this case, the previous governor was somewhat successful. Remittances were brought using unauthorized mobile banking. It was stopped through punitive measures. 

Many economists have said that the dollar rate should be left to the market to prevent hundi. But I do not agree with them. Because the difference with the market rate is due to capital laundering. If left to the market, the common people will be affected. 

Question: What is the future plan for Agrani Bank? 
Dr. Zayed Bakht: Agrani's position in major indicators such as deposits, loans, imports, exports, remittances is at the top level. Agrani is in the first position among state-owned banks in imports and exports. Overall, our position in remittances is always second, after Islamic banks. But due to the exchange rate problem, a private bank has collected more remittances than us. Bangladesh Bank is also surprised to see this. As a government bank, there is no scope to give out the dollar rate beyond what Bangladesh Bank sets. 

Defaulted loans have increased. Due to interest waiver and rescheduling facilities, defaulted loans had decreased a few years ago. But due to the current state of the economy, it has increased again.
