He is touring the field to get nomination in the second round. Apart from this, Awami League Central Executive Committee member Marufa Akhter Popy, Jamalpur District Awami League President and District Council Chairman Muhammad Baki Billah, District Awami League Senior Vice President Faruk Ahmed Chowdhury, District Awami League former Organizing Secretary Rezaul Karim Reznu, former Organizing Secretary ABM Zafar Iqbal Zafu and HR Zahid Anwar are party nomination hopefuls. Several BNP candidates are ready to contest elections in Jamalpur Sadar. They are Mymensingh Division Joint Organizing Secretary and Jamalpur District BNP General Secretary Shah Md. Wares Ali Mamun, women's party leader and former reserved seat MP Nilofar Chowdhury Moni and former deputy health minister Sirajul Haque. Jamalpur District Jatiya Party General Secretary Md. Zakir Hossain Khan will seek party nomination as a sole candidate from the Jatiya Party. Jamalpur district branch leader of the Islamic Movement Dr. Yunus Ali is in the field as the sole candidate of the party.

Headline_English: China's new Prime Minister Li Keqiang
Content_Enlish: Communist Party leader Li Qiang (63) has taken over as China's new premier. He was elected as the new premier in the country's parliament yesterday morning. Source: Al Jazeera. Xi Jinping has chosen Li as the prime minister after becoming president for the third term. Li became the prime minister after receiving 2,900 votes in China's National People's Congress. The country's previous prime minister was Li Keqiang. The prime minister's position is second in the country in terms of state rank. Xi Jinping was the general secretary of the Communist Party of China in the eastern province of Zhejiang. During this time, Li Qiang was his chief of staff from 2004 to 2007. This is how he met and became close to President Xi. After that, Li also served as the leader of the Communist Party of Shanghai. The newly appointed prime minister is now responsible for restarting the wheels of China's economy, which has been slowing down after the pandemic. In addition, he will have to deal with problems such as a decrease in global demand for exports and increasing US tariffs on Chinese products.

Headline_English: 107,102 Hajj pilgrims arrive in Saudi Arabia
Content_Enlish:
So far this year (2:59 pm on June 21), 107,102 pilgrims from Bangladesh have arrived in Saudi Arabia. Of these, 9,798 are government-managed and 97,304 are privately managed. 

So far, 123,150 visas have been issued. Of these, 100 percent are government-managed pilgrim visas and 100 percent are privately managed pilgrim visas. 

This information was given in the latest bulletin related to Hajj on Wednesday (June 21). The IT Helpdesk reported this information from the airlines, Civil Aviation Authority of Bangladesh, Bangladesh Hajj Office Dhaka and Saudi Arabia. 

Meanwhile, 23 pilgrims have died so far. Of these, 20 are men and three are women. Of them, 19 died in Mecca and four in Medina. The last person to die is Md. Abdul Aziz (53). 

Hajj flights started on May 21. The last Hajj flight is on June 22. The first return flight for Hajj pilgrims is on July 2 and the last return flight is on August 2.

Headline_English: Intermittent traffic jam on Dhaka-Tangail highway
Content_Enlish:
Traffic jams were created intermittently in the Chandra area of ​​Kaliakoir in Gazipur on Tuesday afternoon. According to passenger sources, a 10-kilometer traffic jam has been created around Chandra in the Chanda area of ​​the Dhaka-Tangail highway, causing hardship to commuters heading home. This traffic jam has been created since the factories were closed simultaneously since Tuesday afternoon. Vehicles on the Dhaka-Tangail highway and Kaliakoir Nabinagar road have to cross through Chandra. Vehicles on two routes have to enter one route. This has created pressure on vehicles and created traffic jams. 

Sharifa Akhter, a passenger going to Rangpur, said that I reached Chandra after two hours from Ashulia. I do not know how long it will take to go home. 
SP of the Highway Police of Gazipur Region Mostafizur Rahman said that the police are working on the highway to resolve the traffic jam on the highway. So that commuters can reach home without any problems.

Headline_English: Take a look at all the past budgets of Bangladesh at a glance
Content_Enlish:
Finance Minister AHM Mustafa Kamal will present the national budget for the fiscal year 2023-24 in the National Parliament today, Thursday. This will be the 52nd national budget for the country and the 24th budget of the five terms of the Awami League government. 

Tajuddin Ahmed presented the country's first budget as the Finance Minister of the Bangabandhu government after independence in 1972. The current Finance Minister AHM Mustafa Kamal will present the budget for the fiscal year 2023-24 for the fifth time. 

The sequence of the country's national budget, budget size and annual development program (in crores) are presented: 

AMA Muhith and Saifur Rahman presented budgets a maximum of 12 times each during their respective governments' different terms. 

However, Muhith was the first Finance Minister of the country to present budgets for 10 consecutive fiscal years until he retired from the last parliament in 2009.

Headline_English: One killed, 11 arrested in attack by cow vigilantes in India
Content_Enlish:
Two Muslims were beaten up by so-called cow vigilantes in India on suspicion that their car contained beef. One person was seriously injured and the other died. The incident took place in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. The car was on its way to Mumbai from the city in Gujarat. But the local cow vigilantes stopped the car on the road and started torturing the two people inside. Police have already arrested 11 people for their involvement in the murder. According to the Hindustan Times, the workers at the toll plaza on the road informed the cow vigilantes that the car contained beef. After that, a group of cow vigilantes stopped the car on the road. The two people in the car were beaten up severely. One of them died. The deceased has been identified as Afan Abdul Majeed Ansari. He is 31 years old. He is a resident of Kurla in the neighboring state of Maharashtra, Gujarat. Meanwhile, the other passenger in the car, Nasir Hussain Sheikh. He was also injured. However, his condition is now stable. 

In India, such attacks, ranging from beatings to murders, are often carried out in the name of these so-called cow protectors. Despite many attempts, the administration is unable to stop the excesses of the cow protectors. Earlier, on June 8, a man was killed on charges of cow smuggling. At that time, the police had filed a case against 6 members of the Rashtriya Bajrang Dal.

Headline_English: Himel Ashraf announces new movie after 'Priyatama'
Content_Enlish:
Playwright Himel Ashraf has made a name for himself with his first film 'Priyatama'. And in his first film, this director got Dhakai cinema superstar Shakib Khan. Kolkata actress Idhika Pal has paired him on screen. The storm of 'Priyatama' is still raging across the country. And in the midst of this, Himel Ashraf announced a new film. 

Himel also revealed the name of the film. The name of his new film is 'Rajkumar'. Along with producing it, he is writing the story, screenplay and dialogues himself. 

On Monday, Himel Ashraf made a post on his Facebook stating this information.

Headline_English: Imran Khan could face 14 years in prison: Pakistan's Law Minister
Content_Enlish:
Former Pakistani Prime Minister Imran Khan could face 14 years in prison, said Law Minister Azam Nazir Tarar. He said that Imran Khan is accused of endangering national security by revealing government documents for political purposes. If the matter is proven, he will be imprisoned. Geo TV reported. 

The Pakistani Law Minister said this while addressing a press conference in Islamabad on Thursday. He also said that the cipher is a government classified document, which can never be published or shared with anyone. Imran Khan used it for his own benefit. He was summoned by the Pakistan Federal Investigation Agency (FIA) in this regard. 

The Law Minister said that Imran Khan had threatened national security by indiscriminately using the cipher; which was made clear from the confessional statement of former Chief Secretary Azam Khan. The PTI chairman used it for his own political purposes. 

He further claimed that when he discussed the document with Imran, Imran Khan was excited. He called it a mistake of the US. If the secret document is released and its contents are leaked for his own benefit, Imran Khan could face up to 14 years in prison.

Headline_English: 10 injured in clash between two parties in Brahmanbaria
Content_Enlish:
A clash broke out between two parties in Bara Haran village of Natai Dakshin Union in Brahmanbaria over a trivial incident. The incident took place around 2 pm on Saturday. At least 10 people from both sides were injured in the hour-long clash. After receiving information about the incident, Brahmanbaria Sadar Police reached the spot and brought the situation under control. 

Police and locals said that Malai Mia and Ramzan Mia of the same area were in a dispute over the ownership of a shop owned by Islamia Dakhil Madrasa in Bara Haran village. The dispute led to a lawsuit. One of the parties received news that Malai Mia's people were trying to seize the shop before the dispute was resolved. Upon receiving such news, Ramzan Mia's people went to Bara Haran market around 1 pm and asked the people of Malai Mia's party about the attempt to seize the shop. Later, Malai Mia's party and Ramzan Mia's people got into an argument over this. Later, the two parties clashed on the railway line with local weapons. At least 10 people from both sides were injured when they threw stones from the railway track at each other. However, the names of the injured were not immediately known. 

Kamrul Islam, a supporter of Ramzan Mia, said that a case is ongoing in the court between the two parties regarding the shop. The court has granted status quo. Even then, people from the other side were trying to take possession of the shop. When our people went to the market, they had an argument with Malai Mia's people. They attacked our people. 
Babul Mia, a supporter of Malai Mia, said that local elders including people from the market committee were sitting to resolve the ongoing dispute over the shop. They suddenly attacked our people. 

Brahmanbaria Sadar Model Police Station Sub-Inspector Md. Safayet Ullah said that the situation is calm. Police have been deployed in the area to avoid clashes.

Headline_English: Concerns over Australia-South Africa semi-final
Content_Enlish:
This time, the two semi-finals of the World Cup are hot with revenge. India will face New Zealand in the first semi-final at the Wankhede Stadium in Mumbai on the Arabian Sea. Australia will play South Africa in the second semi-final at the Eden Gardens in Kolkata. 

Reserve days have been kept for the two semi-finals of the World Cup and the final. If the match is not played or is partially played due to rain or any other unforeseen reason, the rest will be played on the reserve day. Although there is no doubt about the India-New Zealand match to be held in Mumbai tomorrow, doubts have arisen around the semi-final between Australia and South Africa at Eden. There is a possibility of light rain in Kolkata due to the low pressure in the Bay of Bengal. 

According to the weather report, there is a 40% chance of rainfall in Kolkata on the day of the semi-final. However, reserve day means that there is no escape from rain on the next day, Friday. There is a 50 percent chance of more rain that day. 

However, the umpires will try to complete the match on the semi-final day. They will try to reduce the overs to a minimum of 20 overs per side. If that is not possible, the game will be played on the reserve day. If it is not possible to finish the game on the reserve day, then the best team according to the group stage points table will be declared the finalists. If that is the case, then Australia will be in trouble and the Proteas will be blessed. South Africa will go to the final with the advantage of being ahead in the points table. 

South Africa reached the semi-finals with 14 points from 7 wins in 9 matches in the round robin league stage of the World Cup. Australia also has the same points. However, South Africa is second in the points table due to the lead in run rate. Australia is third.

Headline_English: Care for rough hair in summer
Content_Enlish:
Is your hair damaged by the scorching sun? Is the smoothness of your hair fading while being in the sun? Home treatments will bring your hair back to life. Here are some home remedies to reduce roughness. 

Clean your hair regularly. Don't take a bath every day when you have to go to the office. This will damage your hair. External pollution, dust, and sweat all accumulate dirt on your scalp. So wash them off with water every day. Your hair will remain shiny. Shampoo three to four days a week. During this time, dirt accumulates more on the scalp, so you need to shampoo regularly. 

Roughness usually occurs more in dry hair. So use a mild shampoo when shampooing. Although it removes excess oiliness from your hair, it will not make your hair rough. Both your hair and scalp will remain clean. Your hair will not lose its shine. This is exactly why deep conditioning is very necessary. Along with that, use a hair mask. Regular hair care will reduce hair roughness.

Extract and squeeze some aloe vera gel. Mix one tablespoon of green tea, one tablespoon of fenugreek powder in it to make a mixture. Apply the mixture from the roots to the ends of the hair and wash it off with clean cold water after half an hour. 

You can mix two eggs and two tablespoons of olive oil together and apply it to the hair. Leave it for half an hour and wash it off with clean water. This will restore the health of the hair and make it look smooth. 

Coconut milk is very beneficial for keeping the hair soft and smooth. Mix one cup of coconut milk with curry powder and two tablespoons of orange juice to make the mixture. Leave the mixture for half an hour and wash it off with clean water. Curry leaves are very beneficial for the hair. It helps in thickening the hair. 

Mix one egg, one tablespoon of castor oil, one lemon juice and one tablespoon of aloe vera gel. Apply the mixture all over the hair and scalp and wait for a while. Then wash your hair with clean water or mild shampoo. 

Mix two egg whites, four tablespoons of milk, three tablespoons of honey and one banana. Now apply the creamy mixture little by little from the roots to the ends of the hair with a brush. Keep it for half an hour. Wash it with mild shampoo.

Headline_English: Messi gave a 'different' message by winning the match
Content_Enlish:
Argentina's World Cup-winning captain Lionel Messi has started his United States chapter with a dramatic victory. He secured the team's victory with a great free-kick in the final minutes of the match. Messi's team won the League Cup match against Cruz Azul 2-1 on Saturday morning. 

After the match, Messi's voice was also heard in his voice, "It was a great match for us. We wanted a start like this, to give our fans a victory." 

"We want to thank everyone here. It was necessary for us to start this competition with a victory. And we are very happy about that," added Messi. 

The Argentine is also excited about scoring the winning goal on his debut match. "As always, I tried. Luckily, it went through the defense and into the net. And the goalkeeper couldn't get there in time. With the way our time was going, it gave us an occasion for joy after a long time. We need to start winning to regain our confidence.’ 

After the match, the new Inter Miami captain dedicated the victory to his young teammate Ian Frei, ‘I want to dedicate this victory to Ian, who is in the locker room due to injury. He is a very young boy but has suffered two serious injuries. And I hope he recovers very quickly.’

Headline_English: 8 more people test positive for COVID-19 in the country
Content_Enlish:
In the last 24 hours, 8 people have been identified as corona patients in the country. With this, the total number of infected patients has increased to 20,045,706. 

No one died due to corona in the last 24 hours. As a result, the total number of deaths due to corona in the country remained at 29,477. 

This information was given in the regular press release on corona sent by the Directorate General of Health Services on Thursday. 

The release said that 6 people have recovered from corona in the last 24 hours. With this, a total of 20,13,321 people have recovered. 

885 samples were collected in the last 24 hours. 806 samples were tested. The detection rate against the test is 0.99 percent. The total detection rate since the beginning of the epidemic is 13.13 percent.

Headline_English: Umpire did not give wide to Kohli to 'make a century'!
Content_Enlish:
When Nasum Ahmed came to bowl in the 42nd over of the India-Bangladesh match, India needed two runs to win. And Virat Kohli had three runs left for his century. Virat was playing on 97. 

Nasum bowled the first ball well outside the leg side. Virat moved away a little. Despite this, it was clearly wide. Virat even expressed his disappointment thinking it was wide. He looked at Nasum in annoyance. But on-field umpire Richard Kettleborough did not give a wide. 

Although it was not such that it would have affected the victory or defeat of the team. However, if a wide was given, the scores of the two teams would have been equal. Later, Kohli completed his century by hitting a six on long-on off Nasum's third ball. He was unbeaten on 103 runs off 97 balls. 

Meanwhile, a discussion has started on social media that the umpire did not give a wide after Kohli 'got a century'. Many have raised the question, could the umpire have made such a decision in the case of any other country? 

It is worth noting that Rohit Sharma's team surpassed the target of 257 runs set by Bangladesh with 51 balls and 7 wickets in hand.

Headline_English: 9 new cases identified on COVID-19-free day
Content_Enlish:
No one has died from coronavirus in the country in the last 24 hours. However, 9 more people have been diagnosed with corona during the same period. 

This information was given in the regular press release on corona sent by the Directorate General of Health Services on Sunday. 

The total death toll from corona in the country so far has remained unchanged at 29,477. In addition, the number of identified patients has stood at 20,045,603. 

The release said that 18 people have recovered from corona in the last 24 hours. A total of 20,13,154 people have recovered so far. At the same time, 849 samples have been tested. So far, 1 crore 55,70,823 samples have been tested. 

The detection rate in sample tests is 1.04 percent. So far, the detection rate considering sample tests is 13.14 percent. The recovery rate considering detection is 98.41 percent. The death rate considering detection is 1.44 percent.

Headline_English: 6 Shibir leaders and activists arrested in Gopalganj
Content_Enlish:
Gopalganj Sadar Police Station has arrested 6 Shibir leaders and activists in Gopalganj. Four of the arrested are students of Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman Science and Technology University. 

The arrested are - Sadar Thana Islami Chhatra Shibir President Al Imran Musa (24), a third-year law student of Bashemur University, Abu Kalam (21), a second-year management student of Bashemur University, Muaz Billah (22), a third-year honors student of the political science department, Selim Reza (25), an honors third-year student of the chemical engineering department, Md. Alauddin (32), an imam of Purba Miapara Bismillah Jame Mosque, and Md. Shariful Islam (15), a madrasa student. 

One of the arrested people lives in Gopalganj district. The rest live in different districts of the country. 

Sadar Thana Police Station arrested them from Purba Miapara and S. S. Alia Madrasa in the district town on Wednesday afternoon.

Gopalganj Sadar Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Jabed Masud confirmed the incident and said that all the detainees are Shibir leaders and activists. In addition, during the raid on Maulana Jamal Uddin's house in Purba Miapara, four people were arrested along with various books, magazines, pamphlets and special forms of Islami Chhatra Shibir. The remaining two were arrested from S.S. Alia Madrasa. 

The detainees were brought to the police station and during interrogation, they confessed to being members of Islami Chhatra Shibir. Police said that legal action will be taken against them after interrogation.

Headline_English: National University Honors first year results announced
Content_Enlish:
The results of the 2024 Honors First Year Examination held under the National University have been published. The results were published on Tuesday (December 23) at 3 pm with the approval of the Academic Council and Syndicate. 

The average pass rate in the examination this year is 87.04 percent. Examination Controller Enamul Karim confirmed this information. 

He said that a total of 4 lakh 43 thousand 729 students, including regular, irregular and quality improvement students from 877 colleges, participated in the 2024 Honors First Year Examination in 343 centers across the country. 

The published results will be available on the National University website http://www.nu.ac.bd and http://result.nu.ac.bd. Students can check the results using their respective roll and registration numbers. 

He also said that if any inconsistency or mistake is noticed in the published results, the authorities reserve the right to correct it or cancel the entire results if necessary.

Headline_English: Turkey's state-of-the-art ship Abdulhamid is embarking on an oil exploration mission in the Mediterranean Sea
Content_Enlish:
Turkey's state-of-the-art ship Abdulhamid Han is set to explore for hydrocarbons, including oil, in the Mediterranean Sea. The country's Energy Minister Fatih Donmez said on Tuesday that the ship named Abdulhamid Han will set sail from the port city of Mersin. 

The 780-foot-long and 137-foot-wide Abdulhamid Han is named after a sultan of the Ottoman Caliphate. 

In a television interview, Fatih Donmez said the ship will be sent on its first mission from Mersin on August 9. It will join a fleet of three ships searching for hydrocarbons. 

Donmez visited the ship's anchorage earlier this month. He described the ship as one of the world's five seventh-generation ships.

Headline_English: After 21 years, Tejgaon College announces Chhatra Dal committee
Content_Enlish:
After a long 21 years, the Tejgaon College Hall branch of the Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal, under Tejgaon College, has announced a 13-member partial committee. 

Md. Al Mamun (Malatia) has been made the president. And Md. Sujan Khan has been made the general secretary. 

In addition, senior vice-president Zillur Rahman, vice-presidents Mahmudul Hasan Rabbi and Nur Mohammad Chowdhury (Kanan), senior joint secretary Md. Hasan, joint secretary Md. Shahab Uddin, Rezaur Rahman Joni, organizing secretary Md. Mahdi Hasan, joint organizing secretary Sayedul Islam Sourav, Md. Al-Amin, publicity secretary Rifat Mia, and office secretary Naeem Islam have been appointed. 

In a press release sent to the media last Thursday night, it was announced that Tejgaon College Chhatra Dal president Md. Faisal Dewan and general secretary Md. Belal Hossain Khan approved this committee. 

The newly elected leaders have been instructed to complete the announced committee within the next 15 days and submit it to the president and general secretary of Tejgaon College Chhatra Dal.

Headline_English: Indian companies hit by US sanctions for buying oil from Iran
Content_Enlish:
The United States has imposed sanctions on Indian companies for allegedly buying petroleum and petrochemicals from Iran. 

The United States has imposed sanctions on India-based company Tibalji Petrochem Private Limited. The Joe Biden administration has also imposed sanctions on several companies in Hong Kong and the United Arab Emirates. 

The US Treasury Department said that Tibalji imported millions of dollars in oil, including methanol, from Iran. The Biden administration also said that the oil was sold to China. 

The US statement said, “Today, the US Treasury Department’s Office of Foreign Assets Control is imposing sanctions on an international company that is buying millions of dollars in petroleum products from Iran and supplying them to South and East Asia.”

Headline_English: What kind of nuclear weapons does North Korea have?
Content_Enlish:
North Korea has been launching missiles one after another recently. A few days ago, US Vice President Kamala Harris visited neighboring South Korea. North Korea launched ballistic missiles on the occasion of her visit. The country last fired a ballistic missile over Japan on Tuesday. 

This year, North Korea has tested more than 30 missiles equipped with nuclear weapons. Several of these missiles were capable of hitting US soil. These North Korean missiles are in the ballistic, cruise and hypersonic categories. 

Hypersonic is a type of missile that flies several times faster than sound and at low altitudes, avoiding radar. 

The latest missile tested over Japan is believed to be the medium-range Hwasong-12, which has a range of 4,500 kilometers. It is capable of hitting the US island of Guam from North Korea. 

What kind of nuclear weapons does North Korea have? 

North Korea last tested a nuclear bomb in 2017. The test was conducted at a site called Punggye-ri and produced a yield of 100 to 370 kilotons. 

A 100 kiloton bomb is six times more powerful than the atomic bomb dropped by the United States on Hiroshima, Japan in 1945. 

North Korea claims that this is their first thermonuclear weapon, which is more powerful than any other nuclear weapon. 

What missiles does North Korea have? 

The high-range or long-range missiles that North Korea has are: 

Nodong, which has a tested range of 1,500 kilometers. 

Pukguksong-, which has a tested range of 1,900 kilometers. 

Pukguksong-2, which has a range of 2,000 kilometers. 

Musudan, which has a range of 4,000 kilometers. 

Hwasong-12, which has a range of 4,500 kilometers. 

Hwasong-14, with a range of 10,400 kilometers. 

Hwasong-15, with a range of 13,000 kilometers. 

Hwasong-17, with a range of over 15,000 kilometers. 

It should be noted that North Korea also has short-range missiles, which are not covered in this report.

Headline_English: Pakistan may be eliminated in the first round of the World Cup: Shoaib Akhtar
Content_Enlish:
Moeen Ali's England have had the last laugh in the seven-match series. The score was tied 3-3 before the seventh match of the series. On Sunday (October 2), the English batted first and set Pakistan a target of 210 runs in the series-winning match in Lahore. Pakistan were restricted to 142 runs in 20 overs, thanks to Shan's 56 runs. As a result, the English won the series with a big win of 67 runs. After such a defeat, Pakistan's legendary pacer Shoaib Akhtar has expressed his concerns about the Pakistan team. 

Shoaib Akhtar criticized the Pakistan team's batting lineup on his own YouTube channel and said, "I am afraid that the Pakistan team may be eliminated in the first round of the World Cup. The condition of the team's middle order is not good. If the openers cannot perform, the middle order is under pressure. This is not how you play the World Cup if you want to win it. It's very sad. 

Criticizing the team selection at this time, he added, "The problem was with the middle order but the selectors didn't pay attention to that area. They didn't make any changes there."

Headline_English: Saudi Arabia celebrates Halloween
Content_Enlish:
Halloween is not celebrated in the Gulf countries. However, an exception has been seen in Saudi Arabia. Halloween has been celebrated there with great fanfare. Many of the festival participants have been seen in all kinds of different costumes. 

Arab News reported that those who come to the festival in exceptional costumes have been allowed to enter for free. 

Festival attendees wear costumes designed by Saudis and local residents. Many join the festival that lasts for Thursday and Friday. Its main purpose is to create an atmosphere full of fun, thrill and excitement. 

Abdulrahman dressed up in exceptional costumes for the festival. He said, this festival is great. The main purpose is joy. When it comes to discussing haram and halal, I don't know. We are just celebrating it for fun. Nothing else. We don't believe in anything. 

A visitor named Khaled Alharbi said, everything has a purpose. I am here just to have fun. 

Many people in Saudi Arabia expressed their excitement at being able to enjoy this event for the first time, including their families. The festival also included fireworks. The theme of the Halloween festival is "facing the power of death with humor and mockery." This festival is quite popular in Western countries.

Headline_English: The record Kohli broke Sachin's record
Content_Enlish:
The strong-armed Virat Kohli led the country to victory by taking the helm of the collapsed Indian camp. Chasing Australia's 199 runs, India lost 3 wickets for 2 runs early on. Kohli was the team's ally and also set a record. 

Sachin Tendulkar had the record for the most runs among Indians in ICC competitions for a long time. Virat broke that record on Sunday. Sachin scored 2719 runs in 58 innings in ICC competitions. Virat is playing his 64th innings today. Kohli surpassed Sachin in that innings. Apart from Sachin and Kohli, Rohit Sharma is the only Indian to have crossed the 2000-run mark in ICC competitions. 

However, Kohli broke Anil Kumble's record as soon as he entered the field. He took a catch at slips while Australia was batting. He immediately set the record for taking the most catches among Indians in a one-day World Cup. He surpassed Anil Kumble. 

Kumble had the record of taking the most catches in the One-Day World Cup so far. He took 14 catches. Virat took the 15th catch. That is the record of taking the most catches among Indians in this competition. However, Ricky Ponting is at the top of all countries. Australia's World Cup-winning captain took 28 catches. England's Joe Root has a chance to surpass him in this year's World Cup. He has taken 20 catches in the One-Day World Cup so far. Kohli is at number five in this list. Virat has taken 16 catches in the One-Day World Cup till Sunday's match.

Headline_English: BNP to hold nationwide morning and evening blockades tomorrow
Content_Enlish:
The three-day long leaflet distribution and mass contact by BNP and like-minded parties across the country, including Dhaka, calling for a boycott of the elections and non-cooperation with the government, is ending today (Saturday). BNP will observe a morning-evening blockade program across the country tomorrow, Sunday. 

BNP Senior Joint Secretary General Ruhul Kabir Rizvi recently announced this program in a virtual press conference. 

BNP Senior Joint Secretary General said, the resignation of the current government, the re-establishment of the caretaker government system; free, fair, credible and participatory elections and our ongoing movement against corruption. In the context of this movement, this program is in favor of the election boycott and non-cooperation movement.

Headline_English: Sachin Tendulkar gets a big responsibility in the World Cup
Content_Enlish:
Former Indian batsman Sachin Tendulkar has been appointed as the 'Global Ambassador' of the 2023 ODI World Cup. 

He will enter the field with the trophy before the opening match of the 13th edition of the World Cup at the Narendra Modi Stadium in Ahmedabad on October 5. The World Cup winner will also announce the opening of the World Cup. In a press release on Tuesday (October 4), the highest governing body of world cricket, the ICC, confirmed the appointment of Sachin as the 'Global Ambassador'. 

Sachin, who holds the record of playing six World Cups, said on receiving the honour of becoming the 'Global Ambassador', 'Starting as a ball boy in 1987 and representing the country in six editions - the World Cup has always held a special place in my heart. Winning the World Cup in 2011 is the proudest moment of my cricket career.' 

The only cricketer to score a century on the international stage said, "I am also looking forward to this great tournament with a special team and players who are ready to compete fiercely in the 2023 ICC Cricket World Cup for boys in India." 

Sachin hopes that this World Cup will be inspiring, "Famous events like the World Cup sow the seeds of dreams in the minds of the youth. I hope that this tournament will also inspire young girls and boys to take up sports and represent their country at the highest level."

Headline_English: 45 arrested in anti-drug operation in capital
Content_Enlish:
Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) has arrested 45 people on charges of selling and consuming drugs in various areas of the capital during an anti-drug drive. 

They were arrested in a drive conducted in the capital from 6 am on Friday (December 15) to 6 am on Saturday (December 16). 

Additional Deputy Commissioner (ADC) of the DMP's Media and Public Relations Department KN Roy Niyoti said that 3,726 Yaba tablets, 200 grams of heroin, 34 kg 100 grams of marijuana, 35 bottles and 40 liters of country-made liquor were seized from the accused. 36 cases have been filed against them under the Narcotics Control Act at the DMP police station.

Headline_English: DU's 53rd convocation tomorrow, 30,000 students to participate
Content_Enlish:
The 53rd convocation of Dhaka University will be held tomorrow, Saturday, at the university's central playground. President and Dhaka University Chancellor Md. Abdul Hamid will preside over the convocation. Nobel laureate French economist Professor Dr. Jean Tirol will be present as the convocation speaker. 30,348 graduates have registered to participate in the convocation. 

Meanwhile, the university authorities have completed all preparations ahead of the convocation. The stage and pandal have already been prepared at the university's central playground. A festive atmosphere prevails on the campus surrounding the convocation. Graduates are roaming around the campus wearing black gowns and square hats. They are taking pictures at different places on the campus that are full of long-standing memories. They are taking pictures of the concluding phase of their university life in various styles, alone or in groups. Some of them have been joined by their parents. 

According to university sources, 131 distinguished teachers, researchers and students will be awarded 153 gold medals, 97 PhDs, two DBAs and 35 M Phil degrees at the convocation ceremony. Convocation speaker Dr. Jean Tirol will be awarded the honorary Doctor of Laws (Honors Ca'ja) degree. 

Among the registered Dhaka University graduates, 22,287 will participate in the convocation at the central playground and 7,796 graduates from seven affiliated colleges will participate in the convocation through digital technology from Dhaka College and Eden Women's College venues. 

The convocation ceremony will begin at 11:55 am with the Chancellor's procession from Curzon Hall. Before this, the invited guests and graduates will take their respective seats. Then, the convocation speaker will read the citation and award the degree, the Chancellor will be given the crest, PhD, degree, MPhil, undergraduate-postgraduate degrees and gold medals will be awarded. Then, the program will end with the speeches of the convocation speaker, the Vice-Chancellor of the World University, the Vice-Chancellor and the Chancellor. 

On the day of the convocation, the university has requested to stop the road construction activities from Shahbagh to the High Court intersection via TSC-Doyel Chattar for security reasons. At the same time, the cooperation of the law enforcement agencies has been sought to stop the movement of public transport in the relevant areas. For the convenience of the graduates, they have been asked to use the various grounds of the university instead of parking their cars on the campus roads.

Headline_English: Elections should be stopped at all levels of universities: Muntasir Mamun
Content_Enlish:
Chittagong University (CU) celebrated its birthday. CU Bangabandhu Chair Professor Dr. Muntasir Mamun spoke at the event. Vice-Chancellor Professor Dr. Shirin Akhtar presided over the event, with Information and Broadcasting Minister Dr. Hasan Mahmud as the chief guest. 

As the main discussant, Dr. Muntasir Mamun said in his speech that Dhaka University and the Bangladesh Movement have developed together. The then ruler was afraid that if the universities also got involved in the movement, politics would no longer be under the control of the rulers. People from all parties would come to the university and develop themselves through logic. The university invites different views. 

He said that if the university is controlled by the government, it is no longer a university. Bangabandhu understood this. Therefore, after the country became independent, he gave autonomy to the university. After giving it, he said to Professor Abdur Razzak, Sir, I have given autonomy, can you protect it? I have been associated with the university for fifty years. I want to say from the inside that we could not protect it. 

He said, the university has been given autonomy to set an ideal. Other autonomous institutions will run on this ideal. 

He also said, the university should take some decisions with courage. There will be decentralization at all levels of the university but elections at all levels should be stopped. Because, when a dean stands for election, he has to ask for votes from a newly appointed lecturer. He has to beg that he vote for me. Later, this lecturer does not want to obey this dean in that way anymore. An invisible hierarchy that exists between senior and junior teachers is lost. Therefore, the previous practice, which was done by seniority, is good and necessary.

Headline_English: The record Kohli broke Sachin's record
Content_Enlish:
The strong-armed Virat Kohli led the country to victory by taking the helm of the collapsed Indian camp. Chasing Australia's 199 runs, India lost 3 wickets for 2 runs early on. Kohli was the team's ally and also set a record. 

Sachin Tendulkar had the record for the most runs among Indians in ICC competitions for a long time. Virat broke that record on Sunday. Sachin scored 2719 runs in 58 innings in ICC competitions. Virat is playing his 64th innings today. Kohli surpassed Sachin in that innings. Apart from Sachin and Kohli, Rohit Sharma is the only Indian to have crossed the 2000-run mark in ICC competitions. 

However, Kohli broke Anil Kumble's record as soon as he entered the field. He took a catch at slips while Australia was batting. He immediately set the record for taking the most catches among Indians in a one-day World Cup. He surpassed Anil Kumble. 

Kumble had the record of taking the most catches in the One-Day World Cup so far. He took 14 catches. Virat took the 15th catch. That is the record of taking the most catches among Indians in this competition. However, Ricky Ponting is at the top of all countries. Australia's World Cup-winning captain took 28 catches. England's Joe Root has a chance to surpass him in this year's World Cup. He has taken 20 catches in the One-Day World Cup so far. Kohli is at number five in this list. Virat has taken 16 catches in the One-Day World Cup till Sunday's match.

Headline_English: Messi sleeps with the World Cup trophy; starts the day with the trophy!
Content_Enlish:
Lionel Messi has made up for all the shortcomings by winning the trophy in the Qatar World Cup. He has also set many records on the field. Lionel Messi has become one of the current football superstars. Argentina's title drought has ended with his hand. First, the Copa America title. Then the World Cup. Messi's face was also wide with a smile on his face after winning the trophy that he worked so hard to win. 

Argentina ended its 36-year title drought by defeating France in a tiebreaker. The atmosphere of celebrating this historic victory is now all over Argentina. Football superstar Messi is no exception. This time he was seen sleeping with the World Cup trophy and starting the morning with the trophy in his hand. 

This is what was seen in three pictures posted by Messi on his Instagram. In one picture, Messi fell asleep hugging the World Cup trophy. In another picture, Messi woke up smiling in the morning with the trophy in his hand. In the other, the star is having a 'bed tea' with the trophy next to him. 

Messi posted three of these pictures and wrote in the caption, Good morning! These pictures have gone viral on social media as soon as they were posted. As of writing this report, it can be seen that Messi's fans have given more than 1.18 crore likes to this post. Along with this, Messi's fans are excited with more than 2.5 lakh comments.

Headline_English: Teaser trailer for 'Avatar: The Way of Water' released
Content_Enlish:
The teaser trailer for the film 'Avatar: The Way of Water' has been released. This science fiction film is directed by James Cameron. The film will be released on December 16. This is the second film in Cameron's Avatar franchise. The film Avatar was released in 2009. 

The film tells the story of the Sully family, the problems they face and their efforts and tragedies to keep each other safe. 

The film stars Zoe Saldana, Sam Worthington, Sigourney Weaver, Stephen Lang, Cliff Curtis, Joel David Moore, CCH Pounder, Edie Falco, Jimaine Clement and Kate Winslet. 

It is worth noting that three more sequels to the film Avatar will be released in 2024, 2026 and 2028 respectively.

Headline_English: 70 more dengue patients admitted to hospital in 24 hours
Content_Enlish:
In the last 24 hours, 70 new dengue patients have been admitted to hospitals across the country. The total number of dengue patients admitted to hospitals has increased to 244. This information was given in the regular dengue report of the Health Emergency Operation Center and Control Room of the Directorate General of Health Services on Wednesday. 

The report said that 56 of the newly admitted dengue patients are residents of Dhaka. During this period, 14 new dengue patients have been admitted to hospitals outside Dhaka. With the new 70 patients, the total number of dengue patients currently admitted in various government and private hospitals in the country has reached 244. 

A total of 1,910 patients have been admitted to hospitals from January 1 of this year to today (July 20). Of these, 1,629 are in Dhaka and 281 are in various districts outside Dhaka. Of the total dengue patients, 1,661 have recovered and left the hospital so far. 5 people have died of dengue so far this year.

Headline_English: Money laundering case of Tk 310 crore against Evaly's Russell and Shamima
Content_Enlish:
The CID has filed a case under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act against Md. Russell and his wife Shamima Nasrin, the owners of one of the most talked-about and controversial e-commerce platforms, Evaly, on charges of embezzling Tk 310 crore 19 lakh 13 thousand 407 in the name of selling products online and not delivering the products. 

This information was given in a press release signed by CID Special Police Superintendent (Media) Jasim Uddin Khan on Monday. 

‎The CID filed this money laundering case at Kafrul Police Station in Dhaka on March 29 after the allegations of embezzlement against them were proven. 

‎The CID said that Md. Russell and Shamima Nasrin, along with their unidentified associates, opened an e-commerce company named Evaly.com Limited in Kafrul, Dhaka, and accepted online orders for the sale and delivery of products from numerous customers at various times from December 16, 2018 to December 31, 2021. The money was collected from customers by promising to not deliver the products within the specified time. 

At the same time, the investigation revealed that they embezzled the money by purchasing large amounts of products from various merchant institutions without paying the price. They spent the embezzled money on luxury purchases, acquiring various assets, and traveling abroad with their husbands and wives. Although the customers were repeatedly assured with new delivery dates, the products were not delivered in the end, which is a clear case of fraud. 

The CID further said that the initial investigation also revealed that thousands of customers and merchants have been cheated through the activities of the institution. The CID is continuing the investigation of the case to identify the whereabouts of the embezzled money and the accomplices by conducting a deeper investigation into the incident. 

Thousands of customers and merchants have been cheated by Evaly.com Limited. The CID said that the CID is continuing the investigation of the case to recover the embezzled money and identify the accomplices.

Headline_English: Israeli airstrikes on Syrian port
Content_Enlish:
Israel launched airstrikes on Syria's Latakia port on Tuesday, Syrian state media reported. 

Citing military sources, the state-run SANA news agency reported that Israeli forces launched several missile strikes at 1:23 a.m. local time on Monday. 

The defense forces responded to the attack in Latakia, the SANA news agency reported. 

The attack targeted the port's container yard, the news agency added. Some containers caught fire, but there were no casualties. 

Meanwhile, Israel has repeatedly said that it will not allow neighboring Syria to become an ally of its enemy Iran. 

It is worth noting that Israel has carried out hundreds of airstrikes in Syria since the civil war began in 2011.

Headline_English: Two women raped and murdered, two accused hanged on Monday
Content_Enlish:
Azizul alias Azid alias Aziz (50) and Mintu alias Kalur (50), who were sentenced to death for raping and murdering two women, will be hanged next Monday. 

The prison authorities have made all preparations for their execution at Jessore Central Jail. 

Tuhin Kanti Khan, the jailer of Jessore Central Jail, confirmed the matter. 

All legal work has already been completed. Sources have confirmed that the death sentence of the two convicts will be executed at 10:45 pm on Monday. 

A source at Jessore Prison says that training of several people, including the prison's executioner Moshiar and Ketu Kamal, is underway for the execution. Apart from this, all preparations, including the preparation of the gallows, have already been completed. 

Aziz, who was sentenced to death, is the son of Badar Ghatak of Rayalakshmipur village in Khaskarra union of Alamdanga upazila. Mintu is the son of Ali Him of the same village. 

Incidentally, the rape and murder took place in Alamdanga, Chuadanga, on September 27, 2003.

Headline_English: Building and garage inaugurated at Barisal University
Content_Enlish:
The newly constructed classroom building and car garage have been inaugurated at Barisal University. On Sunday afternoon, Barisal University Vice Chancellor Professor Dr. Md. Sadekul Arefin inaugurated the two buildings by unveiling plaques and offering prayers. 

Among others, the acting registrar of the university, deans of various faculties, heads of departments, proctors, provosts, directors, executive engineers, heads of departments, teachers, the university's teachers' association, officers' association, the president and general secretary of the grades 11-16 and 17-20 welfare council, and the employees of the engineering branch were present. 

After the inauguration, the vice-chancellor said that the construction of the classroom building will alleviate the classroom crisis of the students to some extent. The construction of the garage will be very helpful in maintaining the vehicles of the transport pool.

Headline_English: Income tax law being formulated in Bengal
Content_Enlish:
The Income Tax Act is being formulated in Bengali soon. If everything goes well, the draft of the act will be published for public opinion next month for the convenience of taxpayers. 

National Board of Revenue Member (Tax Policy) Md. Alamgir Hossain said this while inaugurating the DigiTax app at the Economic Reporters Forum (ERF) office in Paltan, Dhaka on Saturday. 

He said, the Income Tax Act is being formulated in Bengali soon. If everything goes well, the draft of the act will be published for public opinion next month. If the rate is not reduced and the process is not simplified, the tax coverage will not increase. Tax rates have been reduced continuously for several years. The tax payment process is being simplified, of which we have got positive results. 61 lakh people have already registered for e-TIN. 

Stating that people have developed interest in paying taxes, Alamgir Hossain said, it is not possible to provide tax services to a large number of taxpayers through the conventional method. There is no alternative to doing everything online and filing returns automatically to provide services to taxpayers. NBR has taken this initiative long ago. 

He said, we are introducing a return form filling, submission and payment system online. With the private DigiTax coming forward, the initiative to digitize tax services will be easier. 

The Institute of Chartered Accountants of Bangladesh (ICAB) President Mahmudul Hasan Khosru, Dhaka Taxes Bar Association President AKM Azizur Rahman, Bangladesh Cricket Board Director Khaled Mahmud Sujan, DigiTax Director Golam Shahriar Ranju and others were present at the event. 

To make income tax return filing easier, an organization called Desh Universal has come up with a web app called 'DigiTax'. Through this, personal income tax return forms and asset accounting can now be filled online. Income tax payment and return file submission can be done from home. Any income tax related services can also be taken from home.

Headline_English: Shahjalal Airport to remain closed at night
Content_Enlish:
All types of flights will be closed at Shahjalal International Airport from midnight to 8 am for the construction of the third terminal. 

Night flights at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport will be closed for about six months from December 10. 

The chairman of the Civil Aviation Authority (CAA) announced this decision on Wednesday. 

A new high-speed connecting taxiway is being built to facilitate the construction of the airport's third terminal, the construction of which will continue at night. The runway will be closed during the renovation.

Headline_English: Heartburn and chest pain: Why it happens and what to do to prevent it
Content_Enlish:
Many patients often come to us and say that they experience occasional sour belching or a bitter taste, burning in the throat, difficulty swallowing food, food often comes up, some also say that something feels stuck in the throat, and sometimes even a sore throat along with heartburn. People are often seen suffering from these symptoms of heartburn and it disrupts a person's normal quality of life. In these cases, we, the ENT doctors, examine the throat and when we do not find any pathology (lesions) or inflammation, we diagnose it as GERD (Gastro Oesophageal Reflux Disorder). 

Since 1999, GERD (Gastro Oesophageal Reflux Disorder) Awareness Week has been celebrated every November around the world. In continuation of this, in 2021, from November 21 to November 27, Heartburn Prevention Awareness Week is being celebrated in Bangladesh along with other countries of the world. 

According to scientific data, 15 out of every 100 people in the world suffer from this problem. The prevalence of this disease is high in Europe and America. The prevalence of this disease is increasing alarmingly day by day in various Asian countries. Due to less knowledge about prevention, many suffer from various complications and have to take more and more medicines. Therefore, the main purpose of celebrating this week around the world is to create awareness by informing the general public about the symptoms/signs and causes of this problem. 

Why does heartburn occur? 

When we say gastro, we understand the stomach and esophagus is the food pipe. Our food intake system is one-way. That is, food goes to the stomach through the food pipe. If for some reason there is an abnormality, the food does not go down but goes up. And then the problem of heartburn and heartburn arises due to the digestive juice or acid coming up from the stomach. There are some wrong lifestyle and some health reasons due to which this disease is caused or has the potential to increase. So for prevention, let's know who is most at risk of suffering from this throat and chest burning problem- 

(1) Those who are overweight or obese. (2) Those who smoke. (3) Those who eat large amounts of food frequently. (4) Those who lie down immediately after eating. (5) Those who eat large amounts of fried food in burnt oil (it should be said here that we Bengalis love to eat a lot of fried and spicy food). (6) Those who drink large amounts of soft drinks and coffee at untimely times. (7) Pregnant women. 

However, it should be remembered here that throat or chest burning should not be taken lightly in the case of the elderly in the family. Because sometimes heart disease can also cause chest burning. If heartburn is caused by reflux disease GERD, the patient will have an uncomfortable burning sensation or pain in the chest, which can go to the patient's throat. But on the other hand, if you have a burning sensation in your throat and chest due to a heart attack, it will be accompanied by pain in your left arm, left neck and jaw, along with shortness of breath, sweating, nausea, extreme fatigue, anxiety, etc. 

What can you do to prevent burning sensation in your throat and chest? 

> When you are hungry, it is our nature to eat a lot at once. Do not eat a lot at once. Eat small amounts of food throughout the day. 

> You should chew your food well. If you do not chew it well in a hurry, the food is not digested properly. This increases the tendency of gastric acidity. 

> You should make it a habit to eat dinner at least two hours before going to bed at night. Otherwise, if you eat food just before going to bed, the full stomach will push the acid up through the esophagus. This will cause heartburn. 

> Since the secretion of acid in the stomach increases due to mental stress, you should try to stay as worry-free as possible. 

> When going to bed at night, relax your waist, that is, sleep in loose clothes. 

> Never exercise on a full stomach, especially exercises that put pressure on the stomach. However, there is no substitute for exercising at the right time and in the right way to reduce excess body weight. 

> Some medications can increase the problem of heartburn, such as aspirin/painkillers. Ask your doctor when and how to take them. 

> Those who suffer from this problem should keep the head higher than the feet when sleeping after eating. For this, you can sleep with an extra pillow under your head. 

> Drink enough pure water according to the body's needs. 

Treatment 

If this problem occurs repeatedly and interferes with normal daily activities or if someone has this problem of burning in the throat and chest for more than 3 weeks, then you must consult a doctor. Your doctor will prescribe medication according to the dose if necessary. In this treatment, various types of proton pump inhibitors (PPIs) are initially given. In most cases, the treatment of this disease takes a few days, it can be months or years. GERD or this heartburn usually does not cause any serious complications, but if someone does not take proper treatment, then this disease can be serious and dangerous. So, not panic or negligence, but awareness is needed to stay healthy. Stay well - keep well.

Headline_English: Taiwan is building a defense system to counter China
Content_Enlish:
Taiwan said it is building a defense system in the face of military threats. 

Tensions between China and Taiwan have increased recently. Taiwan has accused China of trying to seize Taiwan by showing military power and influencing public opinion. 

On Tuesday, Taiwan said that Beijing has adopted a 'gray zone' strategy. The 'gray zone' strategy is a state between peace and war, where two countries are in conflict with each other. 

A report by the Taiwanese Ministry of Defense said that China has adopted a 'gray zone' policy to put pressure on Taiwan's military. 

China claims that Taiwan is its territory. 

The report by the Taiwanese military is 200 pages long. In its proposal, the defense minister said that China has not said to give up the path of showing force against Taiwan. Beijing is steadily increasing its military power. They have become a source of danger for Taiwan. 

Taiwan said that they are also building appropriate defense systems. Chinese warplanes are repeatedly entering Taiwan's air defense zone. China is also waging cyberwar. 

Taiwan has said it is rapidly transforming its military into a combat force. It is also revamping its national security. It is buying state-of-the-art fighter jets. It is building submarines using domestic technology. 

The report says that from September 2020 to August 2021, Chinese fighter jets entered Taiwan's air defense zone 554 times. 

China is repeatedly conducting military exercises near Taiwan. It is sending fighter jets. Last October, during China's National Day, 149 Chinese fighter jets flew to southwest Taiwan. They formed a strike group formation. This caused panic in Taiwan. Taiwan activated its air defense missile system. 

Taiwan is completely dependent on America for military aid. Despite this, the country's government has now emphasized making weapons using domestic technology. They are also building powerful submarines.

Headline_English: Boat symbol wins in all 9 unions of Bandarban
Content_Enlish:
In the results of the 9 unions in 2 upazilas of Bandarban, the candidates nominated with the boat symbol have won in all. After continuous voting from 8 am to 4 pm on Thursday, the counting work began. The candidates with the boat symbol for the post of chairman were unofficially declared the winners in the results announced later. 

In the second phase of the UP elections, voting was held in 7 unions in Lama upazila and for the posts of chairman, general ward member and reserved women member of Baishari and Dochhari unions in Naikxyangchhari upazila. 

The returning officer announced unofficial results on Thursday night, including Bathoy Ching Marma, the boat symbol candidate in Ghazalia Union of Lama Upazila, Mintu Kumar Sen in Lama Sadar Union, Md. Nurul Hossain in Phansiakhali Union, Mohammad Jasim Uddin in Azijnagar Union, Mohammad Idris in Sarai Union, Chhachingpru Marma in Rupsipara Union and Md. Omar Faruk, the boat symbol candidate in Phaitong Union. 

On the other hand, Md. Nurul Alam, the boat symbol candidate in Baishari Union of Naikshongchhari Upazila, and Mohammad Imran, the boat symbol candidate in Dochhari Union, were unofficially elected.

Headline_English: Obaidul Quader is ill, seeks prayers from countrymen
Content_Enlish:
Awami League General Secretary and Road Transport and Bridges Minister Obaidul Quader has been admitted to Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujib Medical University (BSMMU) after falling ill. Prayers have been sought from the countrymen for his recovery. 

On Tuesday, Awami League Office Secretary Barrister Biplob Barua said in a status on Facebook, ‘Obaidul Quader MP was admitted to Bangabandhu Medical University in the capital Dhaka this morning due to a mild physical illness and for some regular checkups.’ 

‘The party is seeking prayers from the countrymen for his recovery. It is requested not to crowd unnecessarily when going to the hospital.’ 

Earlier, Quader was admitted to BSMMU after falling seriously ill on March 3, 2019. Later, he was taken to Singapore for treatment. He was undergoing treatment there for more than two months.

Headline_English: Pakistani Taliban threaten journalists for calling them 'terrorists'
Content_Enlish:
The banned Tehreek-e-Taliban Pakistan (TTP) has threatened journalists for calling them ‘terrorists’. The TTP has also said that it will consider journalists as enemies if they are called terrorists. The Wall reports. 

In a statement on social media on Monday (August 6), the banned organization’s spokesman Mohammad Khorasani said that the media is promoting the TTP as ‘terrorists and extremists’. But the use of such terms by the media and journalists only reveals the party’s role. 

He said that by giving such a title to the TTP, the journalists are showing dishonesty towards their duties and increasing their hostility for themselves. The media should call us Tehreek-e-Taliban Pakistan. 

The TTP was founded in 2007. The Pakistani government declared the organization illegal the following year in the context of attacks on civilians. In 2009, the organization's first leader, Baitullah Massoud, was killed in a drone strike by US forces. 

Meanwhile, the Taliban have formed an interim government in Afghanistan. They have also declared the country an Islamic Emirate. The head of the government has been Mullah Mohammad Hassan Akhund, who is on the UN blacklist and one of the founders of the Taliban.

Headline_English: New law on birth and death registration
Content_Enlish:
The government has made a new law on birth and death registration. Birth and death must be registered within 45 days. According to the law, from now on, this registration is mandatory at the union level. This information was revealed from the cabinet meeting held today, Monday (August 9). 

From now on, October 6 of every year will be observed as National Birth and Death Registration Day. Earlier, this day was observed only as Birth Registration Day. 

In this regard, Cabinet Division Secretary Khandaker Anwarul Islam said that according to the SDG, a target has been set to bring 80 percent of the population under registration by 2030. Under the new law, everyone will have to complete the registration within one and a half months of birth and death. 

Currently, a fee of 75 taka is charged at the union parishad for this registration. The government has been working on this for the last 5/6 months. Many people hide their age due to lack of proper registration. The secretary also said that this will not be possible under the new law.

Headline_English: The results of 20 years of US war in Afghanistan: Taliban to Taliban
Content_Enlish:
The Taliban took control of Afghanistan by capturing the capital Kabul on August 15. Through this, the rebel group came to power in the country for a long 20 years. 

The US chapter in Afghanistan finally ended on Monday, 15 days after the capture of Kabul. Although the deadline was until August 31, the last US aircraft left Kabul airport at 3:30 pm local time on August 30 (Monday). As a result, the US officially announced the end of the Afghanistan campaign ahead of schedule. This ended America's 20-year-long military campaign in the country. 

The US launched an attack on Afghanistan on October 7, 2001, under the pretext of fighting terrorism. A few hours after the attack began, then-President George W. Bush appeared at the Pentagon. Addressing military officials, he said, "Patience will be one of our strengths in the coming months—patience with long waits for tough security; patience and understanding to achieve our goals; patience with all the sacrifices that will bring the desired results." 

Twenty years have passed since President Bush Jr.'s speech. In the last two decades, America has been patient and has made sacrifices. However, the desired results have not come. They had to leave Afghanistan empty-handed. 

Three months after the attack, the Taliban government fell. The Western-backed government of Hamid Karzai came to power in Afghanistan. Bush Jr., overjoyed at the capture of Kabul, announced the reconstruction of Afghanistan in April 2002. He expressed his determination to make Afghanistan the best place to live. The following year, he announced that the mission of eliminating the Taliban had been achieved. However, to prove that Bush Jr.'s declaration was completely false, the Taliban began attacking remote areas of Afghanistan a few years later. 

By 2010, 100,000 US troops were present on Afghan soil to suppress the Taliban. Various surveys began to reveal that anti-war sentiment had developed among American citizens due to the casualties of US troops over the years. The US administration has also begun to realize that they may not be able to benefit from Afghanistan. 

In 2011, President Barack Obama announced the withdrawal of 30,000 US troops. As the days pass, the burden of America's losses is increasing. In 2014, Obama announced a plan to withdraw all troops. However, it was not as easy for the US to enter Afghanistan as it was to exit. As the political and security situation in Afghanistan became increasingly complex, Obama's plan was ultimately not implemented. However, US troops were gradually withdrawn from the country during the Obama administration. 

In 2018, the Taliban made their full presence known. 115 people were killed in an attack by the group in Kabul. President Donald Trump stopped security assistance to long-time ally Pakistan, accusing it of harboring the Taliban. That same year, the Taliban held talks with US representatives in Doha on the condition of withdrawing US troops. In the meantime, a large number of US troops have been withdrawn from Afghanistan in several phases. 

In May 2021, new President Joe Biden announced that all US troops would be withdrawn by September 1. By June, about 90 percent of the troops had returned to the United States. Since then, the Taliban have intensified attacks in various provinces of Afghanistan. Finally, Kabul fell to the Taliban on August 15. 

According to the Brown University Cost of War Project, the United States has spent $2.26 trillion on the Afghan war in the past two decades. Of this, $800 billion was spent directly on the war effort, $85 billion went to training the Afghan army, and $750 million was spent annually on the salaries of this force. The United States has spent an average of $300 million per day to fight the so-called terrorism. 

That's the direct cost. Now let's look at the indirect cost. In 20 years, 2,400 US soldiers have been killed in Afghanistan. In addition, about 4,000 US military contractors have been killed in Taliban attacks. Another 20,000 soldiers have been injured in the war. The United States will have to count another $300 billion in the coming days as medical and retirement benefits for these wounded soldiers. 

What did the United States get from Afghanistan after a huge number of deaths and spending mountains of money? Probably, only criticism and criticism! 

Two decades ago, the then US President George W. Bush started the war against the Taliban. And in 2021, the current President Joe Biden left Afghanistan with power in the hands of the Taliban. So it can be said that the result of the 20-year long war in Afghanistan; Taliban to Taliban.

Headline_English: The son of Mullah Omar, who led the Taliban
Content_Enlish:
Two and a half decades ago, the Taliban took power in Afghanistan under the leadership of Mullah Omar. But the Taliban lost power within five years due to the attack of foreign troops. After 20 years, the new leadership of the Taliban is going to take power in Afghanistan again. The Taliban forces have taken control of the entire Afghanistan by capturing the capital Kabul on Sunday night. 

Among the new top leaders of the Taliban, the names of Mullah Yaqub, the son of the late Mullah Omar, and several others have been published in the media. 

Mullah Yaqub, the son of the founder of the Taliban, is currently the deputy leader of the Taliban. He is approximately 30 years old. 

He also serves as the head of the military wing of the force. Part of his job is to decide on war strategies and conduct operations. 

Mullah Yaqub is a respected figure in the force, largely because of his late father. That is why he became a symbol of unity in times of division or conflict in the party. 

After the Soviet troops left Afghanistan, the Taliban seized power in 1996 under the leadership of Mullah Omar amid tribal conflicts in Afghanistan. Mullah Omar, who lost one eye, later brought danger to himself by sheltering Al Qaeda leader Osama bin Laden. 

After the attack on the Twin Towers in the United States in 2001, NATO-led multinational forces began attacking Afghanistan. As a result, the group lost power and became stagnant. During this time, news of their existence was only available through suicide or surprise attacks. Even though Mullah Omar died in 2013, it was kept secret for two years.

Headline_English: Dinosaurs began to go extinct 50 million years ago!
Content_Enlish:
There is still no shortage of interest in dinosaurs. Many movies have been made about this giant animal. Scientists have been researching for a long time about when the extinction of dinosaurs began. 

Scientists say that the process of their extinction began at least 50 million years ago, when it was thought that dinosaurs became extinct due to a meteorite or asteroid strike. 

It is believed that dinosaurs became extinct from the earth 66 million years ago due to the impact of an asteroid at least 10 kilometers in size. But scientists from the University of Reading in America, after examining dinosaur fossils, say that this extinction process began long before that. It was only ended by the asteroid strike. 

They believe that dinosaurs were becoming extinct due to their inability to adapt to the changing world. According to this new information, the process of dinosaur extinction began about 120 million years ago. 

Manabu Sakamoto, one of the researchers, says, 'We did not expect this result. Although they eventually became extinct due to a meteorite or asteroid impact, this extinction process began long ago.' 

Scientists claim that when dinosaurs were born 230 years ago, the world was warm. But day by day, the world started to cool down. The sea level also started to drop. As a result, dinosaurs started to become extinct. Although mammals were born at about the same time as dinosaurs, mammals adapted to the cold world.

Headline_English: Floating market in Pirojpur
Content_Enlish:
All the shops are floating on the water. These shops are all in boats, forming a market-floating market. The scene is not from Thailand, but the scene of the floating market located on the Belua River adjacent to Baithakata Bazar in Nazirpur Upazila of Pirojpur district. This market is located on boats on the riverbed as soon as the dawn breaks. The market is broken up before noon. This floating market is held two days a week, Saturday and Tuesday. The Belua River is 18 kilometers away from the Nazirpur Upazila headquarters. The Belua River flows past Baithakata Bazar and Belua Mugarjhor villages in Nazirpur Upazila. The Belua River is on the border of Nazirpur, Nesarabad and Banaripara Upazilas of Barisal. For about 70 years, farmers from 20 to 25 local villages have been buying and selling vegetables, paddy and rice from their fields at this floating market. After investigating, it was learned that after sunrise, farmers bring vegetables to the market in small dinghies along the canals around the Belua River. The market becomes bustling by 6 am. Traders from different areas come to this market with trawlers and small and large boats to buy agricultural products from farmers. Although the name of the river is Belua, the locals know this river as Baithakata. Thousands of farmers live around the Baithakata river. This floating market is the only place to sell their various agricultural products. Various types of vegetables are sold in the market depending on the season. On one side of the market is a market for paddy, rice, muri and coconut. Local farmers said that every farming family in their village cultivates various types of vegetables. They sell these vegetables they produce at the floating market. Farmers from nearby villages also come here to sell their products because they get fair prices for their agricultural products in this market. Wholesalers buy agricultural products from here and sell them in various markets in the capital and surrounding districts and upazilas. 

Local senior farmers said that in the early 1950s, some people named Sekandar Ali Sardar, Keramat Ali, Dalil Uddin Sardar and Abul Kashem Talukdar of Mugarjhor village started the Baithakata floating market. The market has been expanding day by day. Farmers from Kalardowania, Mugarjhor, Manoharpur, Gaonkhali, Chandkathi, Dumuria, Sachia, Lora, Boibunia, Penakhali in Nazirpur upazila, Baldia, Gagan, Maluhar, Katakhali, Uluhar, Janata in Nesarabad upazila, Bisharkandi, Umarer Par, Udaykathi, Kadambari, Baishari, Chaumohana in Banaripara upazila of Barisal and nearby villages sell their agricultural products in this market. Wholesale traders buy agricultural products from here and take them to the capital and other big cities of the country. The agricultural products of this market are also exported to the European market. The leaders of the Baithakata Market Committee said that at one time, boats were the main means of transportation for the people of this region. Every farming family has a boat. After the establishment of the market, farmers from the surrounding villages used to bring their agricultural produce to the market by boat. Buyers used to come to the market by boat to buy agricultural produce. Buying and selling used to take place on boats in the Belua River adjacent to Baithakata Market. In this way, the floating market started by selling and buying goods from boat to boat. Boats are still one of the means of transportation for the people of these villages. Hasnat Dalim, chairman of Kalardonia Union Parishad (UP) of Nazirpur Upazila, said that 80 percent of the people of this region are farmers. The produce of local farmers is sold retail and wholesale at the Baithakata Floating Market. Although the floating market is open all year round, the market is busiest during the winter season.

Headline_English: Instructions to stop all types of examinations in private universities
Content_Enlish:
The University Grants Commission (UGC) has directed the authorities of private universities to keep all types of examinations of students closed till May 23. The instructions in this regard were issued on Monday. 

A copy of the relevant instructions has been sent to the vice-chancellors and registrars of all private universities.
