Headline_English: Mamata doesn't have a house or car.
Content_Enlish:
West Bengal Chief Minister and Trinamool leader Mamata Banerjee filed her nomination papers in Haldia on Wednesday as a candidate for Nandigram. The amount of her assets has been revealed in the affidavit filed with it. The Trinamool leader has less than one lakh rupees in cash. She does not have any immovable property or house in her name. Nor does she have any car. 

The affidavit states that Mamata's annual income in the 2019-20 financial year was 10 lakh 34 thousand 370 taka. In the 2018-19 financial year, her annual income was 20 lakh 71 thousand 10 taka. The income of the previous three financial years is also given in the affidavit. However, the highest income among them is in the 2018-19 financial year. 

Mamata has 69 thousand 255 taka in cash. She has 16 lakh 72 thousand 352 taka and 71 paisa in movable assets, including a few bank accounts and National Savings Certificates. Among the movable assets are some gold ornaments, weighing 9 grams and 750 milligrams. 

She does not have any car in her name. She does not have any cultivable land or any place for commercial use. She does not own any property through her ancestral line. She is not burdened with loans from banks or any other institution. 

She does not have any arrears of income tax, goods and services tax (GST), municipal property tax. Mamata does not have any immovable property in her name. She also does not have any self-acquired property. 

The affidavit states that she graduated in law from Yogesh Chandra Chowdhury College, affiliated to the University of Calcutta, in 1982. Before that, she received a master's degree from the University of Calcutta. 

Mamata returned to Nandigram after submitting her nomination papers in Haldia. She was supposed to spend the night in Nandigram. In the afternoon, she attended the Harinam Sankirtan ceremony at a temple in the Girir Bazar area of ​​Ranichowk. She collapsed while leaving there. Mamata claims that she was pushed by four or five people. The incident has created a stir across the state.

Headline_English: Khaled Masud reveals the secret behind his name 'Pilot'
Content_Enlish:
Bangladesh suffered their third consecutive defeat in the Road Safety World Series. Bangladesh Legends lost to Sri Lanka Legends by 42 runs in Raipur, India on Wednesday (March 10) night. Batting first, Bangladesh scored 138 runs in response to the 180 runs scored by the Sri Lankans. 

During the match, when Mehrab Hossain Opie and Nazimuddin were batting during Bangladesh's innings, the commentators joined Khaled Masud's Pilot. At that time, the former wicketkeeper-batsman of the Bangladesh team revealed the secret of his name 'Pilot'. 

When the commentators asked Khaled Masud to know the secret of his name 'Pilot', he said, "My nickname is Pilot. My uncle gave me this name when I was a child. My uncle wanted me to grow up to be a pilot. That's why I have this name. But I did not become a pilot, I became a cricketer."

Headline_English: Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant
Content_Enlish:
The Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant will change the country's energy future. Its construction is in full swing. It is a planned nuclear power plant with a capacity of 2.4 gigawatts. It is being built in Rooppur, Ishwardi Upazila of Pabna district. It is the first nuclear power plant in Bangladesh. The power plant is being built by Russia's Rosatom State Atomic Energy Corporation. On the initiative of the current government, on May 21, 2010, a Memorandum of Understanding on the Peaceful Use of Atomic Energy was signed between Bangladesh and the Russian Federation in Moscow for the implementation of the nuclear power plant. As a result, on December 25, 2015, the Bangladesh government signed an agreement with a Russian company called Atomstroy Export to build a nuclear power plant with a capacity of 2,400 megawatts of electricity in Rooppur, Pabna. The implementation period of the agreement has been set for seven years. The deadline for the production of the first unit of the power plant is set for 2023 and the second unit in October 2024. The power plant will have a lifespan of 60 years. 

All domestic and international obligations and international standards are being followed in the construction of the Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant. The nuclear reactor of this power plant will have five levels of safety features- 

Fuel Pellet: The first of the five levels of safety features of a nuclear reactor is the fuel pellet, which can maintain its fuel properties at very high temperatures. The fuel pellet is made through a specific process, as a result of which the radioactive fission products are located inside the pellet. 

Fuel Cladding: The fuel pellets are surrounded by a fuel cladding made of zirconium alloy. Even if a small amount of fission products escape from the fuel pellet for some reason, it will not be able to penetrate this cladding. 

Reactor Pressure Vessel: A thick steel pressure vessel is manufactured with great care in a special quality control process for nuclear power plants, which lasts a long time even in highly radioactive conditions. 

First Containment Building: The first containment building is made of reinforced concrete with a thickness of 1.2 meters, which prevents the spread of radioactivity into the environment under any circumstances. 

Second Containment Building: To further strengthen the safety system, another containment building of 0.5 meters thick is added after the first containment building in modern nuclear power plants, which protects the plant from various natural disasters, aircraft accidents, etc. Due to these five levels of safety features, this nuclear reactor will be able to withstand the effects of man-made incidents/accidents or natural disasters such as powerful cyclones, earthquakes, floods, etc. 

In addition to these five levels of safety features, the design of this plant has been done in such a way that the plant will be safe even in an earthquake of magnitude 8. In addition, it will remain intact even if it is hit by an aircraft weighing up to 5.7 tons.

Headline_English: Sheikh Rahman, the first Bangladeshi senator in America
Content_Enlish:
Sheikh Mujahedur Rahman, a son of Bajitpur in Kishoreganj, made history in the United States. On May 22, 2018, in the mid-term elections of the United States, Sheikh Rahman, an American citizen of Bangladeshi origin, was elected as a State Senator from District-5 of the State of Georgia on the nomination of the Democratic Party. He is the first Muslim senator in the General Assembly of Georgia. He was most recently elected as a senator for a second term in the 2020 elections. He spent his childhood and adolescence in Bangladesh. The son of a freedom fighter and government official father, Sheikh Mujahedur Rahman immigrated to the United States after completing his secondary education in Bangladesh. He believes that when hard work and perseverance can be combined at one point, success will be achieved. He comes to the country whenever he gets the time, drawn to his homeland. 

It is known that Sheikh Rahman enrolled in Central Piedmont Community College in the United States. Out of his indomitable desire to stand on his own feet, he did not take any expenses from his father. When many of his friends were giving up after trying to find work in one restaurant after another, he started his journey with renewed enthusiasm. After failing in more than 50 restaurants, he got a job as a dishwasher in a North Carolina restaurant. He also drove a taxi cab. This indomitable soldier who did not give up in the fight for life is now known to the whole world as Bangladeshi-American Sheikh Rahman, a senator from the US state of Georgia. He was elected as a state senator by the Democratic Party. Sheikh Rahman's victory is a big answer to the anti-immigration reality of the Donald Trump administration. Sheikh Rahman spoke in favor of immigration policy during the election campaign. He did not forget his immigrant identity. He fearlessly and loudly presented his immigrant identity to everyone. He said, "Ultimately, everyone is an immigrant. I may have gone 40 years ago. Other descendants may have gone 50 years or 100/200 years ago.

Headline_English: Onion prices increase by Tk 20 per kg
Content_Enlish:
Suddenly, the price of a kilogram of onion has increased by 20 taka in the markets of the capital. Traders claim that this price has increased because the stock of domestic onions has run out. They said that the stock of domestic onions has almost run out. Due to this, the price of onions is now higher. However, onions cut into strips (including leaves) have started arriving. Therefore, the price of onions is unlikely to increase much this time. 

This information was obtained after visiting various markets in the capital on Thursday. It was seen that traders are selling domestic onions at 70 to 80 taka per kilogram according to the standard. Which was 55 to 60 taka two days ago. 

Along with domestic onions, the price of imported Indian onions has increased. Two days ago, imported onions were sold at 45 to 50 taka per kilogram, now they are being sold at 60 to 65 taka. 

Regarding this price of onions, a trader from Malibagh Hajipara Boubazar said, two days ago, I sold a kilogram of domestic onions at 60 taka. Now I have to sell that onion at 75 taka per kilogram. Suddenly, the price of onions has increased in wholesale. So we are forced to sell onions at a higher price. 

Another trader said, we think that even if the price of onions increases now, it will not increase much this time. Because the market has already started receiving cut onions. New onions will come to the market in a few days. Karwan Bazar trader Lokman Hossain said, the import (supply) of onions in the market is now low, which is why the price has increased.

Headline_English: Why didn't anyone heed the advance warning of the 9/11 attacks?
Content_Enlish:
On September 11, 2001, a terrible terrorist attack took place in the United States. On that day, Al-Qaeda terrorists hijacked four airplanes. Two of the planes were hit by the Twin Towers of the World Trade Center in New York, one hit the Pentagon in Washington, and the other crashed into a field. 

This was the largest terrorist attack in the United States, killing about 3,000 people. 

This terrible attack shocked the whole world. The event was unimaginable, and no one could imagine how such an attack could happen without anyone's knowledge. 

But the reality is that some people could have foreseen the attack in advance. 

There were warnings long ago: a 'major attack' was going to happen 

Long before that, US authorities had been repeatedly warned throughout the year that a terrorist attack could occur in America at any moment. 

The CIA, the FBI, the US Congressional Commission - everyone was worried about this. There were even warnings that high-rise buildings could be hit by flying planes. 

A congressional commission had been trying to convince the government to take action. The commission was then headed by Senator Gary Hart. 

Mr Hart told the BBC's Luis Hidalgo. 

The warnings had been coming throughout the summer of 2001. A major terrorist attack was likely to happen, and it could happen on US soil. 

"I don't think I or anyone else could have predicted it from any direction, but we were absolutely certain that we were going to be attacked and that it was going to happen very soon." 

Gary Hart was a former Democratic senator at the time and the head of a congressional committee on security. He was also in the running for the Democratic nomination for president in 1988. 

Security Risks Report 

Eight months before the September 11 attacks, Gary Hart and Republican Warren Rudman released a report—the title of which was ‘What Will America’s National Security Risks Be in the New Century’—and the report was the result of two and a half years of investigation. 

The commission took testimony from more than 200 people from 20 countries and was the most comprehensive review of American security since World War II. The commission brought together America’s best experts on foreign policy and security. The conclusions they reached were very serious. 

“The 11 members of the commission analyzed all the information and concluded that Americans face a clear and present risk that we will die on our own soil, and probably in large numbers.” 

‘Nothing like that will happen’ 

How was this warning met? Luis Hidalgo asked Mr. Hart. 

“We held a press conference to present the report. In the middle of our presentation, a reporter stood up and walked out. He was asked why he was leaving. The reporter replied, “None of that is going to happen.” 

“He was a senior reporter for the New York Times. So, you could say, we barely got any coverage.” 

The White House’s response was no better. 

“This commission was set up by President Clinton. But by the time the report came out in January 2001, there was a new president in the White House—Republican George W. Bush, who had taken office just 11 days earlier.” 

The Garry Harts probably thought that the new president would receive their report almost immediately after he took office. 

“Yes, that’s right. Our mandate was to deliver the report to the new president. Unfortunately, he didn’t meet with us. We tried to meet with Vice President Richard Cheney, but that didn’t work out. 

"But we were able to meet with Secretary of State Colin Powell, Secretary of Defense Donald Rumsfeld, and President Bush's national security adviser Condoleezza Rice." 

"I think the two ministers took the report very seriously, and they asked us some questions. Donald Rumsfeld took out a yellow notebook and took some notes. But no action was taken on it." 

The Bush administration later said that it was difficult to act on a warning because it was too vague. 

‘Some people from the Middle East came to learn how to fly’ 

The commission gave no indication that the plane might be hijacked and used for attacks. 

But there were warnings that summer. But there was talk of planes. 

In July 2001, an FBI official in Phoenix, Arizona, sent a memo that has become a famous document. 

In it, he listed a number of incidents and asked for an investigation. 

He said that some people from the Middle East had joined local pilot training programs. 

The following month, two thousand miles away, in Minnesota, local FBI agents arrested a French citizen named Zacharias Moussaoui. 

He had come to a local flying school to learn how to fly a Boeing 747. Although his plane He had no experience in driving. 

FBI lawyer Colin Rowley was called late at night to inform him of the arrest. 

“One of our active supervisors called and said he wanted to talk to us about some information he had just received.” 

He was told that officials needed permission to search Mousavi’s belongings and computers and that he would be willing to help. 

FBI officials put the request on hold. 

‘Hitting a high-rise building with a flying plane?’ 

In a 2005 interview with the BBC, Colin Rowley described what happened. 

“One of our supervisors said, in a discussion with the officer at FBI headquarters, ‘Don’t you know that this is the kind of guy who could hit the World Trade Center with a flying plane?’ 

The answer was: ‘That’s not going to happen.’ 

This Zachariah Mousavi later pleaded guilty to plotting to kill American citizens on September 11. 

‘Something no one could have imagined could happen’ 

Colin Rowley said that one reason their warnings were ignored was that before the 9/11 attacks, no one, from the president to the president, could have imagined that a terrorist attack of this magnitude could happen in America. 

But the alarm bells had rung inside the CIA. 

In 2001, George Tenet was the head of the CIA. And Cofer Black was the head of counterterrorism. In a rare interview with CBS TV’s Showtime 14 years after the September 11 attacks, George Tenet said that during that summer they had all the strong and new evidence that al-Qaeda would attack America very soon. 

“It wasn’t just the red flags, but the actual plans were being made.” 

This was said by Rich Bly, the head of the CIA's al-Qaeda unit. 

"We were sitting in a conference room in late July. We were just thinking about these things, trying to figure out exactly how this attack could be carried out." 

"Rich Bly looked at all of us and said: They're coming right here. We went completely silent for a few moments, you could hear a pin drop in the room. 

'Al-Qaeda wants to destroy America.' 

George Tenet and Cofer Black said on the TV show that they called Condoleezza Rice at the White House. 

"I said, Condoleezza, I'm coming to see you. I'll be right there. 

"This attack is going to be what they call spectacular - something that will shock people and it's not just one attack, it's going to be multiple attacks. Al-Qaeda wants to destroy America." 

“I said, we have to go into combat mode now.” 

Condoleezza Rice later said that she had not received any reports that suggested that aircraft could be used as a weapon of attack. And the US administration was receiving warnings every day. 

US President George W. Bush said that he had not seen any intelligence documents that specifically predicted an attack on American soil. 

However, the White House later confirmed that the headline of the daily briefing given to the president on August 6, 2001 was “Bin Laden Determined to Strike Inside the United States.” 

Even after the commission was dissolved, Gary Hart and his associates continued to issue warnings that summer. 

“We felt that the danger was getting closer. I was deeply worried. I was speaking at various civic organizations and universities, giving interviews.” 

But it is also true that they could not say specifically where or when such an attack would take place, or whether aircraft would be used.

“We had no way of knowing that at the time. But I spoke at an international air traffic control conference in Montreal, Canada. The next day, the headline in the Canadian newspaper was, ‘Terrorist attack on America is coming, says Hart.’ 

Within a couple of days, Gary Hart had another meeting with Condoleezza Rice. What did he tell her? 

“I said, please take action for homeland security. We are going to be attacked. It was September 6th. We already knew each other. Condoleezza Rice said, OK, I’ll talk to the Vice President. Let’s see if we can speed up our plans. Five days later, the attack happened – 3,000 people died. 

A year after the September 11 attacks, a bipartisan commission was formed to investigate. In their 2004 report, they said that there were failures of policy, management capacity and thinking in preventing the attacks. They also recommended major changes in the way US intelligence agencies operate. 

CIA Director George Tenet resigned a month before the report was released.

Headline_English: 265 people rescued alive from Mediterranean Sea
Content_Enlish:
The Spanish rescue ship Open Arms has rescued 265 people alive from the Mediterranean Sea in a few days of operation. 

The volunteer organization said in a Twitter post that they found a dilapidated wooden boat in international waters on Saturday. There were about 96 people on board, all of whom were Eritrean citizens. Among them, two women and 17 children were seriously ill. 

Earlier on Thursday, another 169 migrants were rescued from the Libyan coast. However, neither Italy nor Malta is allowing the rescue ship to dock in their seaports. Instead, the countries have called on other European countries to take in the migrants.

Headline_English: South Korea experiences record coldest weather in 35 years
Content_Enlish:
South Korea is shivering in extreme cold. The country experienced its coldest day in 35 years on Friday. Cold winds from the North Pole have battered South Korea with cold weather. As a result, a weather warning has been issued. The Korea Herald reported. 

The weather office said that precautions are being taken to ensure the safety of traffic and pedestrians in this severe cold. Because the cold will make roads and sidewalks slippery in the interior and make it difficult to move everywhere. 

On Friday, a mountain in Gangwon Province recorded a temperature of minus 29.1 degrees Celsius and a northwestern Seoul recorded a temperature of minus 21.7 degrees Celsius. 

In addition, the lowest overnight temperature of minus 18.6 degrees Celsius was recorded in Jongno-gu, which is the lowest since January 5, 1986, according to the weather office. 

South Korea has never seen such cold before in its 35-year history. The water in the river has turned into ice blocks due to this severe cold. Snow covered trees, houses, cars and roads. 

Minus 29.1 degrees Celsius was recorded at Hyangbobong Mountain, minus 28.6 degrees Celsius at Seoraksan Mountain, minus 21.8 degrees Celsius in Chuncheon, minus 14.8 degrees Celsius in Wonju and minus 15.1 degrees Celsius in Gangneung. 

At one point, minus 44.1 degrees Celsius was recorded in Hyangbobong and minus 27.8 degrees Celsius in Chuncheon. It is reported that the coldest temperatures may be felt due to strong winds. 

Meanwhile, weather warnings have been issued for the remaining 13 cities and counties in Gangwon Province, including cities on the country's east coast. 

The Korea Meteorological Administration said that temperatures will rise slightly on Saturday as the flow of cold air from the north weakens. However, the winter season will continue for some time. However, snow is expected to continue falling in parts of Jeolla Province, Jeju, Wollongongdo and the Dokdo Islands through Sunday. 

The Korea Meteorological Administration has advised outdoor workers, as well as senior citizens and people with health problems, to take extra precautions to avoid the severe cold. 

The weather office said that water pipes could freeze and burst in the extreme cold. It has also issued a high alert warning that vinyl greenhouses and fish farms could be damaged.

Headline_English: Russia is building new nuclear-powered submarines, Putin announces
Content_Enlish:
Russia is building new nuclear-powered submarines. The country's President Vladimir Putin made this announcement at the opening ceremony of the International Technical Forum outside Moscow. He said that Russia will build several vehicles for the navy, including nuclear-powered submarines. 

This exhibition has all the necessary equipment for Russian weapons and the army. Russia wants foreign buyers to come to this exhibition and place orders to buy weapons. Jordan's King Abdullah II watched the exhibition. 

Putin said in a video, "For a strong and sovereign Russia, we need a strong navy. The Russian navy must be kept strong. We must see that they can build their own bases, that they have state-of-the-art infrastructure. Especially state-of-the-art weapons. 

Putin said, "All warships of our navy will be equipped with the latest weapons, communication systems and modern devices for navigation. We saw how effective our technology was during the conflict in Syria." 

He said that an order has been issued to build three types of vessels. Among them are two nuclear-powered submarines carrying intercontinental ballistic missiles. 

Putin has also ordered the construction of two diesel-powered submarines and other vessels. 

The Kremlin is now focusing on modernizing Russia's navy, a move that has come as relations with the West have soured. "We want the Russian flag to continue flying in strategic areas of the sea," Putin said on Monday. 

The Russian president said work is also underway on new weapons, including the new hypersonic Dagger, nuclear-powered air-launched ballistic missiles and the Sukhoi S-70 Hunter.

Headline_English: Omoda 9 PHEV, an environmentally friendly car, is launched in the domestic market
Content_Enlish:
Asian Distributions Limited has introduced the plug-in hybrid SUV Omoda 9 PHEV in the country's market. The company is the sole distributor of global car brands Omoda and Jaico in Bangladesh. This car, which combines cutting-edge design, powerful performance and eco-friendly technology, will add a new dimension to the market. 

The car was officially unveiled at an inauguration ceremony held at a showroom in Dhaka. Asian Distributions Limited's Managing Director Dewan Sajedur Rahman, Director Dewan Saidur Rahman and Executive Director Sadiqul Mushtaq were present at the ceremony. Other high-ranking officials of the company were also present at the ceremony. 

Dewan Sajedur Rahman said, "This is not just a matter of bringing a new car. Omoda 9 Plug-in Hybrid is a reflection of our future journey. Combining powerful performance with eco-friendly technology is the big demand of the future." Through this vehicle, we want to offer world-class innovations that will play a practical role in building a sustainable transportation system in the country. 

The Omoda 9 PHEV has 440 kW (590 bhp) of power and 915 Newton meters of torque. Which enables the car to accelerate from 0 to 100 km in just 4.9 seconds. It uses all-wheel drive technology and a 1.5 liter turbo petrol engine. Which, combined with the hybrid system, provides a maximum range of up to 1200 km. 

Inside the car, there are premium Nappa leather seats, heating and cooling facilities, Sony's 14-speaker high-fidelity surround sound system and a 12.3-inch Liquid HD Crystal Display. A sliding panoramic roof and advanced safety technologies. Such as adaptive cruise control. Lane Keep Assist and Blind Spot Detection-enhance the driving experience.

Headline_English: iPhone Pocket arrives, storm of criticism over price
Content_Enlish:
Apple has unveiled a new product. And there is a storm of criticism on social media about it. The company has created a knitted strap called 'iPhone Pocket'. 

In a statement on Tuesday, Apple said that the product, created in collaboration with Japanese fashion brand Issey Miyake, has been created for iPhone users. The pocket, which is made to fit any iPhone, will be available from next Friday. The product will be available in different colors and versions. 

Will the iPhone 18 series feature a 2-nanometer chip? Will the iPhone 18 series feature a 2-nanometer chip? 
Apple's vice president of industrial design, Molly Anderson, said, 'Apple and Issey Miyake, both brands emphasize simple design. And that's why everyone likes it. This pocket complements that idea.' She added, 'The design and color of the product have been created in such a way that it fits any iPhone model.' 
However, after the price announcement, there was a stir among users. The short strap costs $149.95, while the long version costs $229.95. The price tag has also been the subject of mockery on social media. 
One user wrote on the handle X (formerly Twitter), “$230 socks! Only Apple can make people buy everything.” Others compared it to the neon-green mankini worn by Sacha Baron Cohen’s character Barat. Another user posted a picture of Barat’s outfit with a lime-green iPhone pocket and wrote, “Same thing.” 

Why is the ‘iPhone Air’ model in low demand? Why is the ‘iPhone Air’ model in low demand? 
Tech analyst MG Sigler called the product “overpriced socks” in his Spyglass newsletter, but didn’t completely dismiss the idea. According to him, Issey Miyake, who died in 2022. He was one of Steve Jobs’ favorite designers. 

Sigler writes that this product is making the iPhone more wearable. He reminds us that the armband that was once a running accessory has now become a daily strap. Earlier this year, Apple introduced the iPhone Crossbody Strap, which costs $59.

Headline_English: Robot sets world record for walking 106 kilometers continuously
Content_Enlish:
Unbelievable but true—not a human, but a human-like robot has walked 106 kilometers for 3 days without a break. The robot named A-2, made by a Chinese company, is like a new chapter in future technology. It has already set a Guinness World Record by walking the longest distance continuously. 

This silver-black humanoid robot has walked for 3 days without a break. It has covered 106 kilometers. Shanghai-based technology company Ajibot has created the state-of-the-art robot, which is called A-2. 

The 5-foot-2-inch-tall robot is capable of obeying traffic laws. So, like pedestrians, it can move steadily through signals, crowds, narrow roads and various obstacles. Every step of the entire journey has caught the attention of technology experts. 
In the meantime, the robot has made it to the Guinness World Records. Authorities said that the robot started its journey from the eastern Chinese city of Suzhou on the evening of November 10. After a long walk, it reached Shanghai's historic waterfront Bund area on November 13. 

The robot is powered by Ajibot's advanced hot-swap battery technology. It also has dual GPS, lidar, and infrared depth sensors. With the help of these technologies, A-2 can navigate safely by understanding the environment day and night.

Headline_English: Apple refuses to comply with Indian government's order
Content_Enlish:
Every smartphone sold in India must have the state-run cybersecurity app 'Sanchar Saathi'. The Indian government has recently secretly ordered phone makers like Apple, Samsung and Xiaomi to implement such a requirement. But, citing sources, Reuters reported today that iPhone maker Apple is reluctant to follow this directive. 

Citing three different sources, Reuters reports that Apple has decided to inform the Indian government of its concerns about the government's directive, citing concerns about surveillance and political controversy surrounding this directive. 

It is worth noting that, according to the directive of the Indian Ministry of Telecommunications, phone manufacturers must pre-install the 'Sanchar Saathi' app on every smartphone they make. Only then will they be considered suitable for sale in the Indian market. 

This does not end here, even after purchase, the user will not be able to remove or delete the app from the phone even if he wants. And the companies have been given 90 days to comply with this directive. 

However, in the face of criticism, Indian Telecom Minister Jyotiraditya Scindia said on Tuesday that the app is an “optional and democratic system” and that users can “easily delete it from their phones at any time.” 

See more 
Social media promotion 
Job notification service 
Stock market tips 
The ‘Sanchar Saathi’ app aims to track, block and prevent misuse of stolen phones. According to a report by the Indian central government, 7 lakh stolen phones have been recovered with the help of this app so far. Out of this, 50,000 phones were recovered in October alone. 

Overall, Apple has no plans to comply with the government’s mandatory order. A source familiar with the company’s concerns said that Apple will inform the Indian government that it does not follow such mandatory orders of the government in any other country in the world, as it creates multiple privacy and security issues for its iOS ecosystem. 

However, Apple has no plans to approach the court over the matter. They will not take a public position on the matter right now. In this case, Apple will only inform the government that they are unable to comply with this order due to security weaknesses. In addition, other manufacturers, including Samsung, are also reviewing the government's order. 

Meanwhile, Prime Minister Narendra Modi's political opponents and personal privacy experts have already criticized the government's move.

Headline_English: Robot performs surgery following doctor's instructions from thousands of kilometers away
Content_Enlish:
A doctor from Scotland has successfully performed robotic stroke surgery on a pig's brain in Paris, thousands of kilometers away. This breakthrough in remote robotic technology shows the potential for a new era in stroke treatment. 
A doctor from Scotland has ushered in a new era in remote robotic brain surgery. He successfully performed stroke surgery on a pig's brain using a robot in Paris, thousands of kilometers away. A special robot system developed by a Lithuanian medtech company was used to conduct the surgery. 

According to Reuters, Scottish neuro-radiologist Iris Grunwald has successfully removed a blood clot from a pig's brain with a robot. She performed the procedure in Paris using a digital network. 

This successful operation shows that it is possible to expand stroke treatment outside the hospital. Instead of taking the patient to a specialist, it will be possible to bring the specialist to the patient through robots, which shows the potential for a revolution in treatment. 

Professor Iris Grunwald of the University of Dundee said, “This is the first time we have used such a robot. Through it, blockages in blood vessels in the brain can be removed remotely. This operation is possible even if the specialist is not present at the patient.” 

The specially designed robot uses ordinary operating theatre equipment and gives the surgeon a real-time tactile experience. It provides precise control and feedback, which is very important for sensitive brain treatments. 

Iris Grunwald added, “I used the same tubes, wires and equipment. The only difference is that I am sitting here and controlling them remotely via the internet. And the computer on the other side of the world is carrying out the procedure according to those instructions.” 

The robotic system has been approved by the US Food and Drug Administration. The company aims to bring it to market in 2026. However, the system still needs to undergo clinical trials and full regulatory approval before it can be used to treat patients.

Headline_English: Musk's ex took action against those who fined him
Content_Enlish:
The X platform, which was fined two days ago, is now not allowing the European Commission to advertise. Photo: Reuters 
The X platform, which was fined two days ago, is now not allowing the European Commission to advertise. Photo: Reuters 
The Elon Musk-owned social media company has been barred by the European Commission from advertising on the X platform (formerly Twitter). The European Commission fined the X platform 120 million euros last Friday over the Blue Tick badge issue. Less than two days later, the Commission lost the opportunity to advertise on X. 

Nikita Beer, a senior official at X, alleged that the European Union (EU) regulator tried to take advantage of a “flaw” in its advertising system to promote posts related to Friday’s fine. 

“It seems that you (the European Commission) believe that the advertising rules do not apply to your account. Your ad account has been suspended.’ 

A European Commission spokesman told BBC News that the commission ‘always uses all social media platforms in good faith.’ 

Friday’s fine on X Platform is the first punitive measure under the EU’s Digital Services Act. 

The EU regulator said X Platform’s blue tick system was ‘deceptive’ because the company was ‘not genuinely verifying users.’ Accounts with a blue tick are considered trustworthy by ordinary users. 

The EU said the scheme exposed users to various types of fraud, including impersonation fraud, and left them vulnerable to fraudsters. 

The agency also claimed that X Platform had failed to demonstrate transparency in its advertising and was not giving researchers access to public data. 

It is worth noting that the Commission has given X 60 days to respond to various questions related to the Blue Tickmark. If it fails to respond within this time, Max's X platform will face even greater penalties. 

After announcing the 120 million euro fine, Elon Musk posted on X that 'the EU should be abolished'. In addition, Max also retweeted a post that compared the EU's activities and behavior to fascism. 

US Secretary of State Marco Rubio has reacted strongly to the fine on X platform. The US Federal Communications Commission (FCC) has spoken in the same tone. They allege that the EU regulatory body is attacking and censoring US companies. It has also been said that 'the days of censoring Americans online are over.'

Headline_English: AI platform 'Kagaz.AI' launched in Bengali language
Content_Enlish:
Artificial intelligence or AI technology is gaining momentum around the world. In line with this, the artificial intelligence (AI) technology-based platform ‘Kagoj.ai’ (kagoj.ai) has been launched in Bangladesh. Along with this, the new Bengali font ‘Julai’ has been unveiled. 

This information was given in a press release signed by Muhammad Jasim Uddin, Public Relations Officer of the Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Information Technology on Monday. The release said that the first artificial intelligence or AI technology-based platform in the Bengali language is ‘Kagoj.ai’. 

Today, at a function organized by the Information and Communication Technology Department at the Hotel Intercontinental in the capital, ‘Kagoj.ai’ and ‘Julai’ fonts were officially inaugurated by Faiz Ahmed Tayyab, Special Assistant to the Principal Advisor in charge of the Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Information Technology. 

The function was presided over by Shish Haider Chowdhury, NDC, Secretary of the Information and Communication Technology Department. 

In his speech as the chief guest, Faiz Ahmed Tayyab said that 4,000 people have used it experimentally in the last 2 weeks. They have got good results. Its API (Application Programming Interface) is being made open to make the Bengali language open to everyone. The source code will also be made open by ensuring cyber security. 

He also said that to keep the local cultural flow of the language intact, 10,000 oral minutes of each ethnic group's language (in the country) will be collected soon. A Bengali LLM (Large Language Model) will be created. If we can bring it into the development journey and this ecosystem, it will be possible to keep the languages ​​alive in cyberspace. 

Urging to increase the use of API, Faiz Ahmed Tayyab also said that you will ask us for APIs for the tools that we are currently working on. Start using these tools. The more users there are, the more problems will be identified, resulting in more development and the faster the development speed will be. 

It was informed at the event that ‘Kagaz.AI’ will ensure the use of artificial intelligence in Bangla language-based writing, official document preparation, language processing and content creation, which is an important milestone in the digital advancement of the Bengali language. Such a complete AI platform has not been launched for the Bengali language before. 

On the other hand, the new Bengali font ‘Julai’ has been created for official and institutional use. This font will be helpful in removing various limitations existing in computer-based Bengali writing, said the concerned people. 

The event was presided over by the Secretary of the Information and Communication Technology Department, Sheesh Haider Chowdhury, Director General of Bangla Academy, Professor Dr. Mohammad Azam, Additional Secretary of the Posts and Telecommunications Department, Zahirul Islam, along with officials from various government and private departments, technology experts and invited guests were present. 

It is worth noting that both the services unveiled have been developed under the 'Enrichment of Bangla Language in Information Technology through Research and Development' project implemented by the Bangladesh Computer Council (BCC) under the Department of Information and Communication Technology.

Headline_English: The journey of domestic freelancing platform 'Bizmaker' begins
Content_Enlish:

Bizmaker is working to evaluate the talent of local skilled freelancers by reducing the complexity of global platforms. Headline_English: Xiaomi recognized as the country's top handset brand
Content_Enlish:
Xiaomi has been recognized as the number one mobile handset brand in the country. The technology brand won this honor for the second consecutive time in the mobile handset category at the 17th 'Best Brand Award 2025' organized by the Bangladesh Brand Forum. The company's Deputy Country Manager Liu Chang and Marketing Director Md. Asaduzzaman accepted the award on behalf of Xiaomi at a grand ceremony held in the capital on Saturday. 

At that time, Md. Asaduzzaman said, 'The trust and love of Xiaomi fans in Bangladesh is the main strength of this achievement. Not just as a smartphone brand but as a complete technology brand, Xiaomi is working to bring more innovative IoT products to Bangladesh. This recognition by the Bangladesh Brand Forum will provide further inspiration on that path.' 

In a press release, the company said that since its inception in this country, the company has been bringing modern feature-rich smartphones to the market at affordable prices. The brand gained popularity among buyers by expanding its official retail network and ensuring reliable after-sales service. The brand has been playing an important role in bringing cutting-edge technology to the people of the country with the aim of making technology accessible to everyone. 

The Best Brand Award was launched by the Bangladesh Brand Forum to recognize and encourage the success of domestic and international brands. Every year, a survey is conducted to select the best brands in the country by research firm Nsearch Limited. Headline_English: What China is saying about TikTok's deal with America
Content_Enlish:
A binding agreement was signed last week (December 18) to transfer control of the US operations of popular video-sharing app TikTok. According to the agreement, a group of US investors, including technology company Oracle, are going to take control of all operations of the platform in the US. However, the Chinese government's position on the TikTok deal is very different. 

On the issue of transferring TikTok's US operations, the Chinese government says that companies like ByteDance should find a solution that complies with Chinese laws and regulations and protects the interests of all parties. He Yongqian, a spokesman for the country's Ministry of Commerce, made this comment on Thursday (December 25). 

He said, 'It is hoped that the US side will work with China to achieve the same goal, sincerely fulfill its commitments, and ensure a fair, open, transparent and non-discriminatory business environment for Chinese companies to operate continuously and stably in the US.' 

It is worth noting that the short-length video-sharing platform TikTok has been under sanctions in the US since last year. The Trump administration has extended the ban several times this year, allowing TikTok’s 170 million users to continue operating in the country. 

Then last week, the app avoided the risk of a ban thanks to a binding agreement signed between ByteDance and its US investors, ending a long period of uncertainty. However, the deal will need Chinese government approval to go into effect, as ByteDance is a technology company registered in China.

Headline_English: ChatGPT maker OpenAI opens office in India
Content_Enlish:
OpenAI, the maker of popular AI chatbot ChatGPT, is opening an office in India. The AI ​​startup will open an office in the capital New Delhi this year. In a statement to Reuters on Friday, OpenAI said that it has already formed a legal entity in India and has started hiring local staff. 

In a statement shared with Reuters, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said, “We are committed to making advanced AI technology more accessible in India and building AI technology for India, with India. Opening our first office in the country and building a local workforce is an important first step.” 

By opening an office in New Delhi, OpenAI is looking to further consolidate its position in India. It is worth noting that India is currently second in terms of the number of ChatGPT users. And Indians are the largest users of ChatGPT among students. 

Not only that, the number of weekly active users of ChatGPT in India has increased fourfold in the last one year. The significance of the Indian market for OpenAI goes without saying. The latest proof that they understand this is that OpenAI has launched ChatGPT's most affordable monthly subscription plan ($4.60 per month) in the Indian market this week. 

The New Delhi office is going to be OpenAI's first office not only in the Indian market, but also in the entire South Asian region. So far, OpenAI has its own offices in two countries in the Asian continent - Singapore and Tokyo, Japan. In Europe, they have offices in four cities: London in England, Dublin in Ireland, Paris in France, and Brussels in Belgium.

Stock market tips 
Environmental awareness tools 
Environmental awareness 
It is worth noting that in addition to the head office in California, OpenAI has offices in Seattle and New York City in the US. 

While ChatGPT’s usage and popularity in India is constantly increasing, there are also several legal challenges for OpenAI. The country’s media and book publishers have alleged that OpenAI has used their content without permission to train their AI chatbot ChatGPT. 

Competition in the AI ​​sector in the Indian market is intensifying. In particular, Google’s Gemini and AI startup Perplexity are both coming up with new offers for Indian users. They are offering many advanced AI features for free to attract customers. As a result, it will not be easy for OpenAI to establish a monopoly in India.

Headline_English: Instagram Reels' new feature is 'Picture-in-Picture'
Content_Enlish:
A brand new feature has been experimentally launched on Instagram Reels. This feature called ‘Picture-in-Picture Playback’ has been initially launched by Instagram for a small number of users. Recently, social media app expert Radu Onsescu came across this new tool on Instagram, about which he posted a picture on Threads, another platform owned by Meta, on August 27. 

With the help of the ‘Picture-in-Picture Playback’ tool, users will now be able to do other things while watching Reels on Instagram. It can be in the Instagram app, or it can be outside the app. That is, users will get the benefit of multitasking while enjoying Reels. 

It is worth noting that this Picture-in-Picture feature has already been launched on Instagram’s rival platforms TikTok and YouTube. The feature has already gained quite a lot of popularity among their users. 

In this context, Instagram head Adam Mosseri was asked last March whether there was any possibility of bringing the Picture-in-Picture option to Instagram Reels. In response, Mosseri said that he would look into the matter. The proof that he took the matter seriously was found in the experimental arrival of the picture-in-picture function. 
Note that picture-in-picture is a video playback function that allows multitasking on the device while the video is playing. Let's say, you are watching a video on TikTok. At that moment, you feel the need to check messages on WhatsApp, or search for something on Google. Well, this is where the picture-in-picture playback function will come in handy. 
3 ways to increase reach on Instagram 3 ways to increase reach on Instagram 
Using this function, it is possible to convert a specific video into a small floating window. This small window floats on top of other apps or content on the device's screen (or display). If you swipe down from the top of a video running on YouTube, the video becomes a floating window. It is possible to set it anywhere on the screen by tapping and holding on this floating window. In this state, the user can do any other work on the device while keeping the video on the screen.

It would not be an exaggeration to say that the 'picture-in-picture playback' feature on Instagram is the demand of the time. New 'Map' feature has arrived on InstagramNew 'Map' feature has arrived on Instagram 
The picture-in-picture function, which was experimentally launched on Instagram, is basically an option for video playback, not a tool for video creation. It is worth noting that picture-in-picture has been available for video creation on Instagram for a long time. The picture-in-picture tool is widely used in reaction videos, where multiple videos are displayed on the screen within a single video. For example, video creators use picture-in-picture to show the reactions of one or more viewers to a movie clip. 

Although currently available to a small number of users, the picture-in-picture playback option will soon be available to all Instagram users. In that case, they will be able to multitask while enjoying Reels, just like YouTube and TikTok users can do.

Headline_English: Apple faces copyright lawsuit
Content_Enlish:
Apple faces lawsuit. Several authors have filed a lawsuit against the iPhone maker. In a lawsuit filed on Friday (September 5), the authors have accused Apple of illegally using their copyrighted books to train its AI system. This information was revealed in a report published in the news agency Reuters yesterday (Friday). 

It is worth noting that the lawsuit is the latest addition to the growing legal battle over intellectual property protection in this era of AI technology. 

The proposed class action lawsuit was filed in the Northern District of California federal court on Friday. It states that the US tech giant Apple copied or imitated the content written by the authors without their permission and without giving them any recognition or compensation. 

The authors, Grady Hendricks and Jennifer Roberson, who filed the lawsuit, say, “Apple has not sought to pay the authors for their contributions to this potentially lucrative project.” 

Apple did not immediately respond to a request for comment. The plaintiffs’ lawyers also did not speak to the media on Friday. 

In this age of AI technology, authors, media outlets, and others are often suing big tech companies under copyright law to protect their intellectual property. They all have the same complaint—that their writings or content they create is being used illegally, without their permission. 

In settling such cases, tech companies have also been seen paying large sums of money. For example, on Friday, AI startup Anthropic announced that it had agreed to pay $1.5 billion to settle a copyright lawsuit filed by a group of authors. 

The authors accused Anthropic of illegally using their books to train their AI chatbot Claude without permission. However, Anthropic did not admit liability in this regard, but told a California court that they were going to pay $1.5 billion in damages to settle the case. The plaintiffs' lawyers have called the matter the largest copyright damages in history to come to light. 
Previously, major technology companies like Microsoft, Meta, and OpenAI have also faced copyright law cases in court. 

This time, the lawsuit filed against Apple alleges that the company used a collection of pirated books to train its 'OpenELM' Large Language Model (LLM). According to the claims of the authors, Hendrix and Roberson, this collection included their books.

Headline_English: YouTube to pay Tk 3 billion to settle Trump lawsuit
Content_Enlish:
Popular video sharing platform YouTube has agreed to pay $24.5 million to settle the case of Donald Trump's account suspension. The amount in Bangladeshi currency is more than 29.8 million taka. This information was mentioned in the documents filed in the court yesterday, Monday. 

It is worth noting that YouTube suspended the account of the newly defeated US President Donald Trump in the context of the US Capitol riot in January 2021. In view of this, in July of that year, Trump filed a lawsuit against YouTube in court for illegally suppressing the opinions of conservatives. 

This time, the social media platform YouTube, owned by Alphabet, has agreed to pay $24.5 million to settle this case. 

It is worth noting that after the Capitol Hill riot in January 2021, Trump's account was suspended from two other popular social media platforms, Facebook and Twitter (now X), along with YouTube. He was banned from Facebook, owned by Meta, for 2 years and from Twitter permanently. 

In this context, in July 2021, Trump filed a lawsuit against YouTube, Meta, and Twitter (now X), alleging that they unfairly promote conservative views. The companies' CEOs and executives were also accused in the case. Earlier this year, Meta and X agreed to pay a settlement to the lawsuit. 

This time, YouTube has agreed to settle the case. Of the $24.5 million promised in the settlement agreement, $22 million will be paid by Trump to the Trust for the National Mall. According to court documents, the nonprofit is working on a $200 million ballroom at the White House that Trump is building. 

The 90,000-square-foot facility is expected to be completed during Trump's presidency. The remaining money promised by YouTube will go to other plaintiffs in the case, including the American Conservative Union and American author Naomi Wolf. It is worth noting that the Conservative Political Action Conference is sponsored by the American Conservative Union. 

Although YouTube agreed to pay the settlement, it did not admit any wrongdoing in the settlement agreement. In addition, under this agreement, they will not change any of their products or policies. 

It is worth noting that after the Capitol riot in 2021, Trump's YouTube account was not completely closed, only a ban on uploading new videos was imposed. YouTube later lifted this ban in 2023. 

In a similar case involving Trump, Meta agreed to pay $25 million in January of this year and X (formerly Twitter) agreed to pay $10 million in February. Of the promised money from Meta, $22 million was allocated to fund Trump's upcoming presidential library in Miami, Florida.

Headline_English: Microsoft is issuing a warning message to Windows users
Content_Enlish:
Software maker Microsoft has given a new message to Windows users. The company is ending support for the Windows 10 operating system from October 14. And that is why Microsoft is encouraging Windows 10 users to upgrade to the Windows 11 operating system. 

Microsoft's end of support means that Windows 10 devices will no longer receive security updates from next Tuesday (October 14). As a result, Windows 10 devices will be at risk of security. In particular, the possibility of being subjected to cyber attacks will increase. 

In this context, Microsoft is urging its users to upgrade to Windows 11 for free. However, this will not be possible on all computers. 

Nathan Proctor, senior director of the American consumer group PIRG, said that the end of support for Windows 10 will not only harm consumers but also cause disaster for the Windows ecosystem. 

It is worth noting that Windows is the most popular computer operating system in the world. According to Microsoft, this operating system is used on more than 1.4 billion devices worldwide. 

According to data from StatCounter, as of July 2025, 43 percent of Windows users were using Windows 10. This shows how popular the Windows 10 operating system is among Windows users. 

A survey conducted in September showed that about a quarter of Windows 10 users plan to continue using it even after Microsoft's official support ends. Another important information in this context is that about one in seven people are planning to buy a new computer. 

What users can do 
Microsoft has left a path open for those who do not want to go to Windows 11 right away. And that is, to sign up to receive extended security updates for the next 12 months. 

That is, if the user wants, the Windows 10 operating system will receive security updates for another year. For this, of course, you have to go to the 'Privacy and Security' section in the settings and sign up for this service. 

By signing up for this scheme, customers will only receive security updates until October next year, and no other technical support. Residents of the European Economic Area will get this benefit for free by signing up. 

Other users who want to get this benefit for free must be using the latest (updated) version of Windows 10, have a Microsoft account and back up their PC settings. Otherwise, they will have to pay a one-time fee of $ 30 for Extended Security Updates (ESU), or have 1,000 Microsoft Rewards points. 

Commercial organizations using Windows 10 will have to spend $ 61 per device to get Extended Security Updates. The cost may vary by region. 

However, Microsoft wants customers to upgrade to Windows 11 for free now. That is, Microsoft is discouraging users from using Windows 10 on devices that are suitable for using Windows 11. However, considering the widespread use and popularity of Windows 10, the company has kept the path of Extended Security Updates open. 
It is worth noting that Microsoft released the Windows 10 operating system in 2015. Since then, users have received regular and frequent software updates for Windows 10. Through new updates, Microsoft has offered users new features, made necessary changes, and fixed security flaws and bugs that arose from time to time.

Headline_English: Why Google will invest $15 billion in India
Content_Enlish:
To meet the demand for AI technology, there is a competition to build data centers around the world, led by the world's top technology companies like Meta, Google, and Microsoft. This time, it has been learned that search engine giant Google is going to build a data center in Andhra Pradesh, India at a cost of $15 billion. The company informed the media about this on Tuesday. 

It is worth noting that the investment amount in Bangladeshi currency is more than 1 lakh 82 thousand crore taka. This is going to be Google's largest investment in the Indian market. However, the significance of this investment is not limited to this. Google's announcement of this investment in India comes in the context of the ongoing tension between Delhi and Washington over Donald Trump's counter-tariffs on India. 

In response to Trump's counter-tariffs, Narendra Modi has called for a boycott of foreign products in India. The issue is so serious that Delhi and Beijing have come closer to each other in the context of the deterioration of Delhi-Washington relations! 

At an event organized in New Delhi, India, Google Cloud CEO Thomas Kurian said that the planned data center in Andhra Pradesh will be their 'largest AI hub' outside the US. 

In this context, Kurian also said, 'Our long-term plan aims to accelerate India's own AI mission.' 

It is worth noting that the ministers of the Indian Ministry of Information Technology and Finance were present at the event. The initial capacity of this data center to be built in Visakhapatnam, the port city of Andhra Pradesh, will be 1 gigawatt. 

Earlier, Google said that this year they will spend $ 85 billion on building data center capacity. AI companies are competing to increase their data center capacity to meet the high demand for AI services worldwide. Announcements and promises of billions of dollars in investment have also come in the meantime. In this situation, why should Google be left behind. 

India is a huge market for technology companies. Microsoft and Amazon have already invested heavily in this country of nearly a billion internet users. Even India's two richest businessmen, Gautam Adani and Mukesh Ambani, have taken the initiative to build data centers.

Headline_English: Meta's investment in data centers continues, this time to 18 thousand crore taka!
Content_Enlish:
Mark Zuckerberg's company Meta has announced the construction of another data center in Texas, USA. On Wednesday (October 15), the company that owns Facebook and Instagram said that they will invest $ 1.5 billion in building a new data center in El Paso, Texas. In Bangladeshi currency, the amount is more than 18 thousand crore taka. 

This is going to be Meta's 29th data center worldwide, and the third in Texas. Meta is investing billions of dollars in building data centers as part of its infrastructure development to meet the growing demand in the artificial intelligence or AI technology sector. Just like leading AI companies like Microsoft, Amazon, and OpenAI are doing. 

As AI technology develops worldwide, its scope of use is also increasing. Naturally, its demand is increasing. To meet this growing demand, large technology companies are investing huge amounts of money in this sector to increase their data center capacity. 

Meta expects the new data center to be built in El Paso, Texas to be launched in 2028. They said the center will be able to use up to 1 gigawatt of electricity. This amount of electricity is enough to power a city like San Francisco for a day. Overall, it is going to be one of the largest data centers in America. 

According to the claims of Amazon, Alphabet, Meta and Microsoft, they will spend more than $ 360 billion in the AI ​​sector in 2025. The companies will spend the bulk of this investment on increasing data center capacity.

In a statement, Meta said that the new data center to be built in El Paso will employ 100 workers when it opens and more than 1,800 construction workers will work here when its construction is in full swing. The statement mentioned that El Paso was chosen as the location for the data center due to its strong electrical grid and the availability of skilled workers. 

It is worth noting that Meta has invested more than $ 10 billion in Texas so far, including recent investments. In addition to the investment, the California-based company has already hired more than 2,500 people in the state. 

Keeping in mind the negative impact of data centers on the environment, Meta said that the El Paso data center will use 100% renewable electricity. Its closed-loop, liquid cooling system will continuously recycle water. 

According to Meta's commitment, they will return to the reservoirs twice as much water as the data center uses from local sources. It is worth noting that Meta's long-term goal is to return more water to the environment than the amount of water used in its data centers worldwide by 2030.

Headline_English: Samsung family to sell shares worth Tk 14,000 crore
Content_Enlish:
Three members of Samsung Electronics Chairman J.Y. Lee's family are reportedly selling off their large stakes in the company. Lee's mother and two sisters have decided to sell 17.7 million (17.7 million) of their shares, which currently have a market value of $1.22 billion. In Bangladeshi currency, the figure is more than 14,656 crore taka. 

The South Korea-based company mentioned the share sale in a document filed with the country's stock exchange on Friday. The sale of 17.7 million shares means that they are going to lose 0.3 percent ownership of Samsung. The document mentions the reason for the share sale to cover tax and debt repayment costs. 

Experts believe that Samsung chief Lee Kun-hee's two daughters, Lee Bu-jin and Lee Seo-hyun, and his mother Hong Ra-hee are selling these shares to raise money to pay inheritance taxes after his death in 2020. It is worth noting that their combined inheritance tax is about 12 trillion won (more than 8.4 billion US dollars) in Korean local currency. 

The filed document also mentions that the share sale will be completed by April under a trust agreement with Shinhan Bank. 

Samsung signed a chip supply agreement with US company Tesla in July. Since then, the Korean company's share price has increased by 48 percent. Samsung has also signed chip supply agreements with several other large companies, including ChatGPT maker OpenAI. 

Samsung is also said to be selling its new high-bandwidth memory product to Nvidia. Overall, Samsung's market value has increased by 84 percent so far this year.

Headline_English: Amazon is showing that it is not lagging behind with a contract worth 463,000 crore taka.
Content_Enlish:
Recently, a fault in Amazon's cloud server caused disruptions in the services of numerous organizations worldwide, disrupting their normal activities. There has been widespread discussion and criticism about this. However, on Monday, Amazon announced the signing of a $ 38 billion cloud agreement with ChatGPT maker OpenAI, stating that they are not far behind in cloud services in the AI ​​sector. 

Amazon Web Services (AWS), a company owned by Amazon, has been at the top of the cloud computing sector for a long time. However, after the cloud outage due to a fault in the cloud server, the company has lost some market share to rival companies Microsoft's Azure and Google Cloud. 

But e-commerce giant Amazon did not take any time to overcome this recent setback. Jeff Bezos' company has further consolidated its position in the market thanks to the $ 38 billion agreement signed with OpenAI on Monday. The multi-year agreement is worth over 463,000 crore taka in Bangladeshi currency. 

Under this agreement, OpenAI will take infrastructure support for its AI activities through Amazon's world-class cloud services. It is worth noting that leading companies like OpenAI in the AI ​​sector are either building their own data centers for strong infrastructure, or are approaching cloud computing companies like Amazon, Google, Microsoft, and Oracle. 

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is still in a leading position in the cloud computing market, but they have had to face fierce competition in recent years. According to Synergy Research Group, Amazon's share in the cloud services market was 35 percent even a few months before ChatGPT entered the market in November 2022, which stood at 29 percent in September this year. 

Many investors thought that Amazon had fallen behind in the AI ​​race. Because on the one hand, they have been late in launching their own large language model, and on the other hand, they have failed to create consumer-focused chatbots like ChatGPT. 

But recently, they have significantly increased their investment in the AI ​​sector. Last month, Amazon launched a data center called Project Rainier in the state of Indiana. This data center is where the new AI models of AI startup Anthropic are being trained. It is worth noting that Amazon's own Trenium chips are being used in this training of AI models. 

With the recent signing of a deal with OpenAI and strong financial results in the last quarter, analysts and investors believe that Amazon is regaining momentum again.

Headline_English: Indian government orders blocking of 8,000 X accounts
Content_Enlish:
The Indian government has issued an executive order to block more than 8,000 accounts of Elon Musk-owned social media company X (formerly Twitter). Despite disagreeing with the order, the platform has started complying with the central government's order. X said this on Thursday (May 8). 

The accounts include international media outlets as well as well-known figures on the X platform. The government says that these accounts have violated local laws. However, in most cases, the government order does not mention which posts violated the law. 

A post shared by X's Global Government Affairs department said that, "We have not found any evidence or justification to block these accounts in the case of a significant number of accounts." 

X also said that the executive order issued by the government also mentions taking punitive measures such as jail and fines against X's local employees if they fail to comply with the central government's order. 

In recent times, several journalists and news organizations have had their X accounts suspended in response to legal demands from the Indian government. In this context, the Indian government has ordered the blocking of this large number of accounts. 

X says, ‘We do not agree with the demands of the Indian government.’ However, they are going to suspend the mentioned accounts as part of complying with the Indian government’s orders. 

The post shared by X also says, ‘Blocking the entire account is not only unnecessary, but it also amounts to censorship of current and future content and is against the fundamental right to freedom of speech. Such a decision is not easy to take, but keeping the platform operational is very important for the ability of Indians to access information. 

X believes that in the interest of maintaining transparency, government orders such as blocking accounts should be made public. However, considering the issue of ‘legal impediments’, they are not publishing the executive order of the Modi government. 

The company is examining what legal action can be taken regarding the government order to block accounts. Not only that, X has also advised users affected by the blocking to approach the courts to get relief. 

The company is exploring legal action against the government order to block accounts. Not only that, X has also advised users affected by the blocking to seek legal redress.

Headline_English: Artificial intelligence poses a greater threat to women's jobs than men's
Content_Enlish:
There has been and is still a lot of discussion and criticism about whether people will lose their jobs due to the impact of artificial intelligence or AI (Artificial Intelligence) technology. Based on this discussion, various arguments have been presented for and against AI technology. This time, it has been learned that the advancement of AI technology is putting women's jobs at greater risk than men's jobs. 

This information was revealed in a report released by the United Nations International Labor Organization (ILO) on Tuesday. The report says that the types of work that women usually do are more likely to be affected by AI technology than men's work. This possibility is especially strong in high-income countries. 

This research report also shows that 9.6 percent of women's traditional jobs are likely to be replaced by AI. However, this rate is only 3.5 percent for men. It is worth noting that the use of AI in administrative work has increased significantly in recent times, and the presence of AI technology in various clerical tasks such as secretarial work has also increased compared to before. 

However, the report also notes that AI will not completely eliminate human needs. Rather, in many jobs, AI will be needed alongside humans. The report says that the traditional role of humans in various jobs will not be eliminated but will undergo radical changes. There is a possibility of such changes in various jobs, especially in the media, software and finance sectors, as the scope and capabilities of generative AI technology are constantly increasing. 

The report also says, ‘We emphasize that such an impact does not mean the immediate automation of an entire profession, but rather the possibility of a large part of current work being performed using this technology.’ 

The report calls on governments, employers and labor organizations to think about how AI technology can be used to increase productivity and the quality of work.

Headline_English: After Apple, Trump threatens Samsung with 25 percent tariff
Content_Enlish:
US President Donald Trump threatened Apple yesterday (Friday) morning that he would impose a 25 percent tariff on all imported iPhones if they are not made in America. In the afternoon, he made the same threat to another popular smartphone manufacturer, Samsung. He made the morning threat on his social media platform Truth Social. And in the afternoon, he made the one in front of reporters at the White House. 

He told reporters present at the White House yesterday afternoon that he would impose a 25 percent tariff on Samsung and any other smartphone manufacturer unless their smartphones are made in America. He expects that every smartphone sold in the American market should be made in America. 

Trump said, "If they (manufacturers) set up factories here (in America), they will not have to pay any tariffs. So they will build factories here." He believes that it would be unfair if a 25 percent tariff is not imposed on imports of iPhones made in any country outside America. 

iPhones made in 'India or elsewhere' to face 25 percent tariff: Trump iPhones made in 'India or elsewhere' to face 25 percent tariff: Trump 
Earlier, in a post shared targeting Apple, Trump said that if iPhones made in India or elsewhere are sold in the US market, at least a 25 percent tariff will be imposed. After this announcement, Apple's shares fell by 2.6 percent and the company's $70 billion capital has disappeared from the market. Overall, their market capitalization has also fallen below $3 trillion. 

Last month, Apple decided to shift iPhone production from China to India in the context of the China-US tariff war. In this context, the US tech giant plans to increase iPhone production in India. It has also been heard recently that Apple is planning to invest a large amount in India to increase production. 

Not only that, the company plans to import the entire iPhone demand in the US market from India. This month, Apple CEO Tim Cook announced at their financial results event that all iPhones sold in the US in the April-June quarter were made in India. 

It is worth noting that until the Sino-US tariff war began, 90 percent of Apple's smartphones were made in various factories in China. The largest market for iPhones is the US, where more than 60 million or 60 million iPhones are sold annually. 

Although the Trump administration has threatened smartphone manufacturers including Samsung and Apple with a 25 percent tariff, no official announcement has been made in this regard yet. 

Technology analysts have said that if premium smartphones like Samsung Galaxy and Apple iPhone are produced in America, the production cost could increase by up to three times. In that case, manufacturers will have to bear the additional cost by reducing their profit margin, otherwise ordinary consumers will have to pay three times more for flagship phones like Galaxy and iPhone. 

It remains to be seen whether Trump's threat of a 25 percent tariff targeting Apple and Samsung will be implemented in the form of an official announcement.

Headline_English: Elon Musk's Starship rocket crashes again
Content_Enlish:
Elon Musk's SpaceX spacecraft has crashed in space again. After its ninth test launch from the Starbase facility in Texas on Tuesday (May 27), the Starship spacecraft lost contact with the ground station in Earth's orbit due to a mechanical failure. The spacecraft later crashed over the Indian Ocean. SpaceX reported the recent accident on its official social media page. 

According to information provided by SpaceX, the Starship rocket successfully took off from the launch pad of the Starbase facility in Texas. The spacecraft reached low Earth orbit as planned. But trouble struck shortly after reaching orbit. The spacecraft's altitude control system suddenly failed. 

As a result, the Starship rocket went out of control after orbiting once and began to re-enter the Earth's atmosphere. Then at some point, the spacecraft disintegrated over the Indian Ocean. 

In an official statement, SpaceX said that just 10 minutes after launch, all communication with the ground station was lost. As a result, SpaceX engineers failed to make a controlled landing of the rocket on the northwest coast of Australia as planned. 

Successes and failures of SpaceX's second-generation Starship rocketSuccesses and failures of SpaceX's second-generation Starship rocket 
SpaceX experts are investigating the accident and trying to find the root cause of the error. SpaceX has promised to provide detailed information about this soon. 

For the first time, a reusable (recycled) booster, which is the first stage (lower part) of the spacecraft, has been used in this mission. Like the upper part, the lower part (booster) has also crashed this time. Shortly after the launch, the booster separated from the upper part as planned, and ground engineers lost control of it and it was destroyed in the Gulf of Mexico. 

Finally successful SpaceX, booster lands safely on the launch pad Finally successful SpaceX, booster lands safely on the launch pad 
However, another mechanical fault has been reported in the Starship rocket. In this mission, the spacecraft was supposed to place 8 dummy satellites (satellite simulators) of Starlink in Earth's orbit. But it was not possible to do so as planned, because due to a mechanical fault, the special hatch or door of the rocket did not open. As a result, all of the dummy satellites were inside the spacecraft when it crashed. 

This launch was the ninth test mission of the Starship rocket in SpaceX's history. While 4 of the previous 8 missions were successful, 2 ended in failure. And two other missions have also seen mechanical failures. 

How will Mars be inhabited, says Elon Musk How will Mars be inhabited, says Elon Musk 
The world's top billionaire Elon Musk has spent billions of dollars on SpaceX's Starship project so far. He has ambitious plans for the Starship rocket. This project is part of Musk's long-term plan to colonize Mars. Not only that, SpaceX wants to send people to the moon using the Starship rocket under NASA's Artemis mission. If this happens, people will set foot on the moon after more than 50 years.

While the failure of this year's Starship mission is disappointing, it is unlikely that Elon Musk will back down from his long-term plan. Musk has instead called each failure a step towards future success. Experts in the field also echo Musk's sentiments. According to them, it is normal to encounter mechanical failures in the construction of large and complex vehicles like Starship, and any new technology becomes perfect through repeated testing.
