Headline_English: An Indian in space again after 41 years
Content_Enlish:
Not one, two years, or one, two decades. After a long 41 years or more than 4 decades, an Indian astronaut has once again gone into space. His name is Subhanshu Shukla. Four astronauts from four countries left for the International Space Station (ISS) on Wednesday (June 25) on a commercial spaceflight mission called Axiom-4 (AX-4). And Subhanshu Shukla has made history as part of this mission. 

The Axiom-4 (AX-4) commercial spaceflight is being operated by Axiom Space, a Texas-based commercial spaceflight operator in the United States. This private mission is being supported by Elon Musk's spacecraft manufacturing company SpaceX and the US space research agency NASA. 

SpaceX's Falcon 9 rocket launched with astronauts from the Kennedy Space Center in Florida, USA, at 2:31 am local time (12:31 pm Bangladesh time) today (June 25). The rocket was launched from Complex-39A of the Kennedy Space Center. 

It is worth noting that this time, a brand new version of SpaceX's spacecraft Dragon Crew Capsule is carrying 4 astronauts in this mission, which the astronauts have named 'Grace' after reaching Earth's orbit. The Dragon Crew Capsule, which has a crew capacity of four, is expected to reach the International Space Station (ISS) within 26 hours of its departure from Earth. 

Indian Pilot Group Captain Subhanshu Shukla is playing the role of pilot in this 4-person spaceflight. He is accompanied by two mission specialists - Szyaw Wojnarowski of Poland and Tibor Kapu of Hungary. Wisniewski works for the European Space Agency (ESA) and Tibor Kapu is associated with the Hungarian Space Research Office (HSO). 

This is the first space mission for the Indian, Polish and Hungarian astronaut trio. However, they are led by experienced American astronaut Peggy Annette Whitson, who has previously participated in four space missions for NASA. 

It is worth noting that Peggy Annette Whitson holds the record for the longest (676 days) and the most number of times (4) in space missions as an American and as a woman. 

However, the most talked about spaceflight by Axiom Space is Indian astronaut Subhanshu Shukla. 41 years ago, in April 1984, retired Wing Commander Rakesh Sharma became the first Indian astronaut to go into space. He participated in the space mission aboard the former Soviet Union's Soyuz spacecraft. 

This time, after more than four decades, 39-year-old Shubhangshu Shukla went on a space mission as Rakesh Sharma's successor. Within minutes of leaving for space, Group Captain Shukla sent a message. Shukla said in his message, 'We are back in space after 41 years and it was an extraordinary journey.' 

Although it took India four decades to send its second astronaut into space, it is expected that the third astronaut will reach space within the next two years. The country's space research agency ISRO is planning to conduct its first spaceflight program 'Gaganyaan' (or Gaganyaan) in 2027. Not only that, India is moving ahead with plans to set up its own space station in space by 2035 and send astronauts to the moon by 2024. 

It is worth noting that 4 Indian Air Force officers were enlisted last year for the 'Gaganyaan' spaceflight mission, in which Shubhangshu Shukla was also included. He was sent on this commercial spaceflight by Axiom Space as part of the preparations for the 'Gaganyaan' program. For this, ISRO had to spend 59 million US dollars (5 billion rupees in Indian currency).

Headline_English: Musk's AI company now aims for $200 billion
Content_Enlish:
Elon Musk's AI startup XAI is planning to raise more money from investors. XAI is looking to value its next round of investment at between $170 billion and $200 billion, The Financial Times reported on Friday, citing people familiar with the company's internal discussions. 

It is worth noting that XAI raised $10 billion at the end of last month. Of this, $5 billion was in term and mortgage loans and $5 billion in new investments through the transfer of ownership of shares. 

The Financial Times report says that Saudi Arabia's PIF sovereign wealth fund (PIF Sovereign Wealth Fund) could play an important role in XAI's new investment deal. It is worth noting that PIF already has an indirect investment in Musk's AI company. Kingdom Holdings Company, of which PIF owns 17 percent of the shares, has invested $800 million in XAI. 

The report also says that PIF's investment in Musk's startup is still under discussion and that the deal may change in the coming days. 

Meanwhile, Elon Musk has denied the new investment and said that they have no plans to raise money at the moment. After the publication of the Financial Times report, Elon Musk wrote on his X platform, "XAI is not looking to raise money at the moment. We have plenty of capital." 

Reuters contacted PIF for comment. However, the company did not immediately respond. 

Although there is uncertainty about whether XAI really has plans to raise new money after raising $10 billion in recent investments, it can be said with certainty that the startup is going to invest a large amount of money in building the infrastructure for AI technology. XAI is focused on expanding its data center capabilities to build a strong position in the competitive AI market. 

Musk’s AI startup recently acquired Musk’s social media platform X for $33 billion in cash. The deal, which was completed in March, values ​​XAI at $80 billion. 

Elon Musk founded XAI in July 2023 as an alternative to OpenAI’s ChatGPT. Their Grok AI chatbot has already created quite a stir. ChatGPT maker OpenAI announced in March that it would soon raise $40 billion in new funding, giving it a market value of $300 billion. 

XAI has set a target of reaching $13 billion in annual revenue by 2029, according to Morgan Stanley, the company’s bank. This was revealed in a Bloomberg News report last June. They are aiming to reach $1 billion in revenue this year and are looking to invest $18 billion in the data center sector.

Headline_English: Huawei tops Gartner Magic Quadrant list
Content_Enlish:

Huawei has maintained this position for three consecutive years. The company made this information in a press release on July 15. 

The release said that Gartner Magic Quadrant evaluates technology suppliers using its own standardized methodology. This evaluation is mainly based on two axes. One is mature vision and the other is the ability to complete the task. Here, many factors such as industry knowledge, innovation, quality and value of products and services, customer experience, sales process are considered. Therefore, this recognition is a matter of its long-term commitment to innovation and customer-centric network solutions, as well as its advanced products, global service support and rapid adoption. 
In the current era, artificial intelligence is changing the connectivity of various organizations. In this context, Huawei is adding artificial intelligence to campus networks to improve wireless connectivity, security, applications, and management and maintenance experiences. This advancement is contributing to the creation of 10 Gbps wired and wireless networks with a focus on user experience. It will support the development of smart campuses, mobile financial services, and digital healthcare. 

Huawei introduced the first five-radio Wi-Fi 7 access point (AP) in this sector in 2025. It integrates Intelligent Digital Pre-Distortion (DPD) and Intelligent Coordinated Scheduling and Spatial Reuse (ICSSR) technologies, adding Wi-Fi 8 innovations to Wi-Fi 7. This results in more advanced wireless services. By combining Wi-Fi, IoT, and sensing technologies, Huawei has ensured blind-spot-free connectivity and reduced the overall cost of this service by up to 50 percent.

Headline_English: US nuclear agency attacked due to Microsoft flaw
Content_Enlish:
The government agency responsible for the design and management of America's nuclear weapons has been the victim of a cyber attack. The attack was caused by a recent bug or security flaw found in Microsoft's SharePoint server software. This was mentioned in a report by the American media Bloomberg today (July 23). 

It is worth noting that a bug called Zero-Day was found in Microsoft's SharePoint software last Saturday, due to which about 400 organizations around the world have already been subjected to cyber attacks. 

Although hackers carried out a cyber attack on the American nuclear agency, no sensitive or confidential information was lost, according to a Bloomberg report, citing a source familiar with the matter. Bloomberg did not reveal the name of this source. 

This cyber attack was carried out on the American National Nuclear Security Administration. This agency is a branch of the country's Department of Energy, whose main responsibility is to produce and deactivate nuclear weapons. 

New Microsoft bug, 10,000 organizations at risk of securityNew Microsoft bug, 10,000 organizations at risk of security 
A company spokesperson told Bloomberg that on Friday (July 18), Microsoft's SharePoint zero-day security vulnerability began to affect the energy department. However, only a few systems were affected and all of the affected systems were able to be restored, the spokesperson said. 

Due to this bug or security flaw, only self-hosted SharePoint servers were attacked by hackers. That is, servers hosted in the Microsoft cloud were not affected by this zero-day bug. And therefore, the US Department of Energy also suffered little damage. Because they widely use Microsoft's M365 cloud service. 

However, Microsoft sees this cyber attack on the American nuclear agency as a hacking operation sponsored by the Chinese state. Hackers were able to enter the system by exploiting a security vulnerability in the SharePoint document management software and took control of it. In this way, they have seized several security information (credentials) and tokens. 

Google's Threat Intelligence Group says about the zero-day bug in SharePoint software, "This (bug or flaw) is like a dream for ransomware operators." They also said that it is possible to gain permanent unauthorized access to a system by exploiting this flaw, which is also capable of avoiding future security patches (software updates or programs released to fix errors). 

It is worth noting that cyber attackers have also been able to access the systems of the US Department of Education and the Florida Department of Revenue by taking advantage of Microsoft's zero-day security flaw. In addition, government systems in the Middle East and Europe, including other countries, have also been hacked due to this SharePoint software bug. 

The zero-day bug or security flaw in Microsoft's SharePoint server software was first noticed by European cybersecurity company iSecurity. After discovering the bug on Saturday, iSecurity said in a blog post that the bug, or security vulnerability, allows hackers to gain access to SharePoint servers and impersonate fake users and services. 

However, Microsoft announced on Monday that it has released a new security patch to mitigate attacks on self-hosted (on-premise) SharePoint servers.

Headline_English: ChatGPT creator joins Zuckerberg's Meta
Content_Enlish:
Shengya Zhao, co-creator of the popular AI chatbot ChatGPT, has been appointed as the chief scientist of Meta's Superintelligence Lab. Her joining Meta was announced by the company's CEO (CEO) Mark Zuckerberg on Friday (July 25). 

Shengya Zhao has been appointed as the 'chief scientist' of the superintelligence team as part of Meta's recent extensive initiative to further accelerate its progress in artificial intelligence or AI technology. 

It is worth noting that Shengya Zhao, a familiar face in AI technology, previously worked for a long time at the leading AI company OpenAI, where she made significant contributions to the creation of the generative AI-based chatbot ChatGPT. 

Mark Zuckerberg also explained what specific responsibilities Shengya Zhao will perform at Meta. In a post shared on Meta’s social media platform Threads on Friday, Zuckerberg wrote, “In her role as (Chief Scientist), Shengjia will set the research agenda and provide scientific direction for our new lab….” 

In the Threads post, he also said that Meta’s new superintelligence lab will work directly with him and Alex Wang. Alex Wang is Meta’s chief AI officer who also heads the superintelligence lab. 

Zuckerberg’s Meta recently made a large investment in Alex Wang’s AI data labeling startup Scale AI. As part of the deal, she took over as head of Meta’s superintelligence lab. 

While working at OpenAI as a researcher and scientist, Shengjia Zhao contributed to several models and tools that later became widely popular. In addition to ChatGPT and GPT-4, he has worked as a co-creator in creating several mini AI models of OpenAI - such as 4.1 and 03 (O3). 

It is worth noting that Zuckerberg has taken the initiative to create a superintelligence team of about 50 people to further consolidate Meta's position in the AI ​​sector. Zuckerberg is working to form a superintelligence team by bringing together the world's most skilled and best researchers and scientists in the AI ​​sector. He has also taken the responsibility of hiring for this team on his shoulders. 

Three OpenAI researchers are joining Zuckerberg's MetaThree OpenAI researchers are joining Zuckerberg's Meta 
Several top AI researchers from Sam Altman's organization OpenAI have already joined Meta's superintelligence lab. At the end of last month (June), OpenAI's top three AI researchers - Lucas Baer, ​​Alexander Kolesnikov and Shahua Jai ​​- joined Meta. Shengya Zhao has joined the team. 

After Meta's Llama 4 AI model failed to achieve the expected success recently, Zuckerberg, frustrated, decided to revamp Meta's AI plan. And that is why he has taken the initiative to create a superintelligence lab. The Meta head is also offering the most attractive packages to attract top researchers in the AI ​​sector. 

In addition, Meta is also signing contracts with promising startups in the AI ​​sector, so that their advanced technology can be accessed and top researchers can be attracted to work at Meta. It is worth noting that Meta's main objective behind creating the superintelligence lab is to achieve its long-term goal of artificial general intelligence by combining Llama AI models. 

The post shared on Threads mentions Shengya Zhao as the co-founder of the superintelligence lab. The superintelligence lab is run independently, rather than under the umbrella of Meta’s AI research division, Fair. Fair is led by deep learning pioneer Ian Lakun. 

Zuckerberg has said that Meta’s goal is to achieve “full general intelligence” and make the technology open source for everyone to use. His strategy has been met with both criticism and praise from the global AI community.

Headline_English: I wrote a job application using ChatGPT, and then what happened?
Content_Enlish:
The use of artificial intelligence or AI technology is increasing day by day. In particular, many people are now using various chatbots based on generative AI (such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot). From answering emails to writing class assignments, from editing simple documents to creating job applications - everything is now being done with AI chatbots. 

But Ananya Narang, CEO of Indian startup Onturaj, recently shared an example of how important it is to be careful when using chatbots on social media. Sharing a screenshot of a job candidate's application from her X (formerly Twitter) account, she wrote, 'No wonder our unemployment is so high today.' 

After creating the application with ChatGPT, the job candidate sent it without any editing. As a result, it is seen that in several places where 'personalization' was required, it was not done. For example, the job candidate was supposed to mention his skills, experience and preferences in specific places on the application, but the candidate did not do so.
Ananya Narang also shared a screenshot of the application on her LinkedIn account. She added a question, ‘Can we please refrain from blindly using AI?’ She also said from her own experience in recruitment that one in five job seekers’ applications show such excessive AI reliance. 

It is worth noting that since its inception in 2023, Delhi-based startup Onturaj has been hiring a large number of employees. Recently, CEO Ananya Narang came across an application built with ChatGPT while recruiting more employees. 
There has been a lot of discussion and criticism about the use of AI-based chatbots like ChatGPT. Therefore, technologists advise not to be overly dependent on chatbots. Technologists emphasize the importance of giving a ‘human touch’ or ‘personalizing’ something after generating it with a chatbot. 

An important document like a job application, after being generated by a chatbot, must be edited. It should be linguistically modified according to the job description. Relevant personal information (skills, experience, qualifications) should also be mentioned. Some words and sentences should be changed so that the language used in the application does not sound overly formal or 'robotic'. Above all, after writing the application, it should be proofread at least twice to check for any errors.

Headline_English: Features of Tesla's 'CyberCab' robotaxi
Content_Enlish:
Tesla's much-awaited self-driving car, the robotaxi, was unveiled on October 10. At a grand event called 'We, Robots', the company's CEO Elon Musk himself unveiled the robotaxi called 'Cybercab'. Elon Musk said that commercial production of the robotaxi could begin in 2026 and its price would be kept below $30,000. 

At the beginning of the 'We, Robots' event held at Warner Bros. Studios in California, USA, Elon Musk, wearing a leather jacket, came on stage riding the 'Cybercab' robotaxi. Robotaxi has been in the discussion in the technology world for a long time. The robotaxi project is an important part of Musk's long-term plan to build autonomous electric cars. 

It is worth noting that Elon Musk presented two more hotly discussed products to the audience at the Tesla robotaxi unveiling event. One is a large self-driving car with a capacity of 20 passengers, which Musk has introduced as ‘Robovan’. In addition, he also presented Tesla’s humanoid robot Optimus to everyone. 

Features that will be in the ‘Cybercab’ robotaxi 
‘Cybercab’ robotaxi is an autonomous electric vehicle. That is, it will not require a driver to drive it. As a result, there will be no steering wheel or pedals in the ‘Cybercab’. However, there are gull-wing doors (or falcon-wing doors). 

Robotaxi Cybercab_02 Elon Musk’s ambitions for ‘Cybercab’ are reflected in every word he said on stage. Musk claims that autonomous vehicles are 10 times safer than regular human-driven cars and can drive 5 to 10 times longer than humans. 

Musk said, “We are now moving from fully supervised fully autonomous cars to fully unsupervised fully autonomous cars – where you fall asleep in the car and wake up when you reach your destination.” 

Musk also said that in cities where it costs $1 per mile to drive a bus, the cost of running a cybercab could eventually come down to a fifth – 20 cents. In addition, the robotaxi will have the benefit of ‘inductive charging’. As a result, the car will not need to be plugged into anything to charge. The car will be charged even if it is just placed on an inductive charger. 

Elon Musk has presented the cybercab robotaxi as ‘individualized mass transit’. As a result, users can also get the benefit of customizing it as they wish. 

Elon Musk_Robotaxi Cybercab Musk also said, ‘Autonomous vehicles are the future. With the help of autonomous vehicles, you will get your time back.’ That is, since there is no need to drive, passengers can do their own work or rest during the journey. 

Robotaxi mainly relies on artificial intelligence or AI technology and cameras. It does not use any of the expensive hardware used in the cars of competing companies. However, many investors and analysts have expressed concerns about robotaxi becoming overly dependent on AI and cameras. The electric car may face various technical and regulatory problems. 

Musk's long-term plan 
Elon Musk's long-term plan for fully autonomous (self-driving) cars is to operate a passenger service of autonomous (self-driving) Tesla taxis, where passengers can rent self-driving Tesla taxis through an app. Not only that, but robotaxi owners can also list their cars on the app and let them drive for rent. This will also create an opportunity for them to earn money. 

Since it is dependent on AI technology, the production cost of robotaxi will be relatively low. In addition, being fully autonomous (self-driving) will save passengers time. According to Musk's claim, it will be much safer than ordinary cars, so the insurance cost of the car should also be much lower. In addition, its operating costs are also known to be much lower. 

Overall, considering these factors, there is no doubt that fully autonomous (self-driving) cars like robotaxi will gradually become popular all over the world. But it should be remembered that the road from autonomous vehicles to fully autonomous cars is not that easy. Passenger safety is especially important here. Naturally, many regulatory steps will have to be passed before such vehicles can go into commercial production. So the road to robotaxis like Cybercab is still quite long.

Headline_English: Bitcoin price rises on hopes of Donald Trump winning

trump

Headline_English: This satellite is made of wood!
Content_Enlish:
For the first time in the world, a satellite made of wood has been sent into space. The satellite was built by Japanese researchers. Japan launched a new chapter in space exploration on November 5. This information was reported by the British news agency Reuters. 

The wooden satellite was sent into space as part of an important test. This test will help to understand whether it is possible to make satellites for future missions to the Moon and Mars using wood instead of metal. 

The satellite named 'Lignosat' was jointly built by researchers from Kyoto University and Sumitomo Forestry in Japan using honoki wood. The word 'Lignosat' comes from the Latin 'wood'. It is a small satellite about the size of a palm. 

Kyoto University researcher and astronaut Takao Doi said, "We hope to be able to build houses in space with wood and live and research for a lifetime." 

Doi and his team have a 50-year plan to plant trees and build wooden houses on the moon and Mars. And to prove whether it is possible to use wood in space, it was decided to build a NASA-approved wooden satellite. 

Koji Murata, a professor of forest science at Kyoto University, said, "Airplanes in the early 1900s were made of wood. So a wooden satellite is not impossible. Wood will be more durable in space than on Earth, because there is no water or oxygen there. As a result, the wood will not deteriorate." 

According to these Japanese researchers, ordinary metal satellites create aluminum oxide particles when they enter the atmosphere, which pollute the environment. But a wooden satellite will burn easily and create less pollution.

Headline_English: The geo-observation technology market is growing
Content_Enlish:
The demand for Earth observation technology is increasing all over the world. Not only large countries, but also emerging countries are increasing their investments in this sector. The market for this technology has already reached 5 billion US dollars. It will exceed 8 billion dollars by 2033, according to space technology consulting firm Novaspace. 

In a recently published report, Novaspace says that the current market for Earth observation technology is worth 5 billion dollars. This market will quickly exceed 8 billion dollars. For this, however, Novaspace has mentioned 2033 as a possible time. However, other similar companies say that the size of this market could reach 150 billion dollars by this time. 

According to a report by the news agency Reuters, Earth observation (EO) technology is becoming increasingly popular. This technology is used for various purposes, especially border security, climate change. Its most likely use is in defense departments. 

'Yellow brick road' under the sea? What researchers say 'Yellow brick road' under the ocean? What researchers say 
Air quality, chemical composition of the atmosphere, changes in the terrain, taking pictures of the earth's surface, its 3D modeling, almost everything is covered by this earth observation technology. It has major applications in the agricultural sector. Currently, various security-related issues are also associated with it. It can be said that this advanced technology will greatly expand the eyes and ears of powerful countries. 

This technology is getting better. Especially in the defense sector, its demand is increasing gradually. And in the research sector too, the addition of high-quality images and 3D modeling has created the possibility of adding a new dimension to earth observation. In addition, there is the possibility of commercializing space technology. 

Gold-filled asteroid found in space, if you get it, you will also become a billionaireGold-filled asteroid found in space, if you get it, you will also become a billionaire 
Novaspace says that in 2023, 44 percent of the Earth observation technology market will be occupied by America. Europe is next in line, with a market share of 22 percent. It is expected that Asia will occupy 23 percent of this market by 2033. Southeast Asia and the Middle East will be ahead in this regard.

Headline_English: Now you can buy cars on Amazon
Content_Enlish:
Amazon, the world's leading e-commerce marketplace, is now offering cars for sale. On Tuesday (October 10), the company officially launched 'Amazon Autos', where customers can start searching for new cars and place orders for them from dealers. 

Amazon is going to start this new initiative with Hyundai cars. Currently, cars can be purchased through 'Amazon Autos' in 48 cities in the US, including Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Los Angeles and New York. Amazon has announced that it will add several more car manufacturers in 2025. They also plan to take 'Amazon Autos' to several new cities next year. 

It is worth noting that Amazon announced its plans to sell cars online last year. According to the plan, the online car sales initiative was supposed to start in the second half of 2024. This time too, the same has happened. 

'Amazon Autos' will work like other parts of Amazon's larger ecosystem. Customers can find their preferred car based on model, color and other features. However, in this case, they will have to find the preferred model from among the cars available at the dealers on the platform. 

Amazon Autos In addition, buyers can also get the necessary financing and e-signing paperwork done through the ‘Amazon Autos’ platform. After paying the price, the buyer will indicate when he wants to receive his car from the dealer. If you join Amazon to sell a car of a brand, the local dealer of that brand will play the role of the e-seller. 

There is no shortage of platforms in the online car sales market. However, marketplaces like AutoTrader, Carvana and CarMax mainly sell old and used cars. However, Amazon Autos will only have the opportunity to buy new cars. The company said that they plan to bring leasing facilities to customers next year. In addition, Amazon is going to add several more financing options for buying cars. 

Amazon is the world's most popular e-commerce marketplace. They ship to more than 190 countries around the world. So naturally, car manufacturers like Hyundai will be interested in joining Amazon Autos. As a result, it can now be said that global brands in the car market will be seen on Amazon one by one. 

Amazon promises that consumers will be able to buy cars at a fair price from their platform. In this case, there will be no need to haggle. The buyer will have to pay the price that he sees when selecting the car of his choice and checking out. This will include all kinds of taxes and fees. 

It is worth noting that Amazon, which started its journey as an online bookstore in 1994, is now going to sell cars online. This is undoubtedly a big success for Amazon. But apart from this, it is also highlighting the progress of the e-commerce industry as a whole. Especially in the past few decades, with online shops replacing traditional offline shops, 'Amazon Autos' is once again demonstrating that e-commerce is becoming the mainstream business medium.

Headline_English: The message Musk's 'Xmail' is sending to Google and Apple
Content_Enlish:
Elon Musk will bring his own e-mail service 'Xmail' - this news has been circulating in the technology world for quite some time. Especially in February this year, Musk himself gave such a hint about Xmail on his social media platform X. After that, nothing more was heard from him. As a result, all the discussions about Xmail were being continued as rumors or gossip. But this time, that is no longer possible. 

In response to a post published on the X platform on December 15, he said that Xmail is part of his future vibration. Not only that, the very next day, he again replied to a post on the X platform and gave a 'yes' hint about what Xmail could be like. 

As a result, it is no longer possible to 'tag' Xmail as a rumor, rumor, or imaginary idea. It can now be said with great certainty that Xmail is coming. If so, nothing has been known from Elon Musk or the X platform about when it will come to the market. 

However, a lot of writing has already started about the possible features of Xmail. Elon Musk himself has given some hints about one of its features. Although no details are known about the feature, we can at least guess about the possible features of Xmail based on Musk's comments about Gmail and other e-mail services at different times and the opinions of people who have an idea about Musk's technology. 

The issue of personal privacy and security may prevail in Xmail, as a result of which there may be an end-to-end encryption feature, as seen in WhatsApp. In addition, users can get rid of 'targeted advertising' in the subscription-based model. In addition, there may be a user interface like Direct Messaging (DM) in Musk's e-mail service, especially since Musk himself has responded positively to this feature. As a result, the emails may appear in the inbox as short chat messages instead of long threads of long emails. 

New users will easily get used to the simple interface. Besides, being easy to use, Xmail can be used relatively quickly. In addition, the use of AI technology will make mail categorization, smart replies, and spam detection tasks much easier. It goes without saying that Xmail will be integrated with the X platform. Another notable feature could be the opportunity to access Xmail from multiple devices. 

These are some of the possible features of Xmail. Now the question is, what impact will the arrival of Xmail have on the global e-mail market. Almost all of Musk's products and services are 'disruptive'. That is, they disrupt the conventional system, or the status quo (status quo), of the technology market. Is the same going to happen with Xmail? Will the impact of Musk's new e-mail service be limited to the e-mail market? This discussion began with an attempt to find the answers to these questions. 

The message that Xmail is giving 

Currently, Google's Gmail and Apple's 'Apple Mail' dominate the global e-mail market. According to data available as of September 2024, Apple's share in the email market is 53.67 percent and Gmail's share is 30.70 percent. That is, 9 out of every 10 people use one of these two for email services. But after the arrival of Xmail, many in the technology world believe that there is a strong possibility of disrupting this long-standing status quo in the global email market. 

The number of users of the Google ecosystem around the world is currently 4.91 billion. This number is more than 90 percent of the world's total internet users. Google, owned by Alphabet, has been able to integrate its various products and services into an ecosystem. And the Gmail account is the key to this ecosystem. Apple is also always trying to create ecosystem-centric customers. 

It would not be surprising if Elon Musk wants to build a similar ecosystem around his social media platform X. Yes, in terms of the number of users, X's 600 million seems insignificant compared to Google's nearly 5 billion. But in this case, Elon Musk's personal popularity and the types of products and services he plans to add to the X ecosystem in the future must be taken into account. 

More than 200 million people follow Elon Musk on social media X. In addition, Musk is quite vocal and active on his platform. He will also fulfill the important responsibility of the newly formed 'Department of Government Efficiency' in the upcoming Trump administration. As a result, Musk's presence on both social and mainstream media will increase in the coming days, and the book will not decrease. 

Meanwhile, several hotly discussed products from Elon Musk's various companies are expected to come to the market in the next 2 years. Tesla's autonomous technology driverless electric car 'Cybercab' and Robovan and humanoid robot 'Optimus' are expected to come to the market commercially in 2026. 

Meanwhile, Musk wants to send SpaceX's Starship rocket to Mars by 2026. He also has detailed plans for the global expansion of the satellite internet service Starlink. For example, Musk has already come a long way in bringing Starlink to India. 

Elon Musk is also quite ambitious with his AI startup 'XAI'. He recently opened the company's much-discussed chatbot Grok 2 to all X users (premium and non-premium). Grok 2 has recently added a new text-to-image AI model 'Aurora'. 

To further accelerate the development of the Grok chatbot, Musk last month called on X users to upload their medical data to the Grok chatbot. Musk wants to use documents such as users' X-rays, MRIs and CT scans to train Grok, so that the chatbot becomes more efficient and its capabilities increase than before. 

Last month, Elon Musk also expressed his intention to create a game studio from XAI. Meanwhile, Neuralink, Musk's initiative to install chips in the human brain, is also progressing at a rapid pace. Musk's interest in Bitcoin is also nothing new. 

Now the question is how Elon Musk's future ambitious projects relate to the plan to build an ecosystem centered on the X platform with the arrival of Xmail. To create an ecosystem, various products and services are needed. Looking at the existing popular ecosystems, it can be seen that Google, Apple and Microsoft have been able to successfully integrate multiple tools, features and services in their ecosystems. 

Even if an ecosystem is built around X, it must contain products and services that people need in their daily lives. Although the products and services born from Musk's brainchild are interesting, they have not yet become as visible as the ecosystem at Google. In particular, technologies like autonomous cars and humanoid robots are still considered futuristic. That is, Musk's upcoming products and services have not yet become realistic products in the daily lives of ordinary users. 

But there is no room to say that they are 'unrealistic'. As a result, the possibility of a strong ecosystem like Google's being built around X in the next 2-3 years cannot be completely ruled out. In this case, Musk's current products and services will speak for him. In addition, even if Musk's futuristic projects cannot touch the reality of everyday life of ordinary people, they are very strongly present in their minds - there is no room to underestimate this either. 

Elon Musk has hinted at creating an ecosystem by integrating his products on various platforms at various times, if not directly, then indirectly. For example, Elon Musk has talked about operating and controlling various devices with the Neuralink chip installed in the human brain and its role in implementing autonomous technology. At least, these are part of his ambitious plans. 

Now the question is, what will happen if Musk is really able to create an ecosystem centered on X and Xmail. Will Google disappear from the market if another new ecosystem is created with the arrival of a new mail service in the market? Not at all. Even Musk's most loyal followers probably do not think that a huge platform with about 5 billion users will disappear. 

However, if Musk's planned projects see the light of day in the next few years, an ecosystem centered on X will definitely share the dominance of Google and Apple. Now it remains to be seen how successful Musk's promised products and services are.

Headline_English: This 'Iron Man' robot helps people walk!
Content_Enlish:
There was a time when it was thought that robots would do human work. That fantasy has become a reality a long time ago. Starting from industries, today robots and automated technologies like robots are being used in various sectors, along with artificial intelligence or AI. This is like a perfect match. 

In the continuation of the evolution of robot technology, a group of researchers from South Korea has created a wearable robot that can be used on the body, which can be very helpful for people suffering from paraplegia (numbness in the lower part of the body) in walking. The research team recently displayed a prototype or initial version of this robot. 

Researchers from the Exoskeleton Laboratory team of the Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KIST) have created this robot. Their goal is to create a robot that can be helpful in the daily movement of specially abled people. It can be said that this robot can become an important part of their daily lives. 

It is worth noting that people with physical problems such as paraplegia can wear this robot on their body and walk up and down stairs in addition to normal walking, and can even avoid obstacles in their path. 

One of the research team members, Kim Seung-Hon, is also a paraplegic. Kim himself wore the prototype of the robot they created. With the help of this robot, made with wearable technology, Kim walked at a speed of 3.2 kilometers (2 miles) per hour, climbed stairs, and was able to sit on a bench by moving sideways. 

The most interesting and unique feature of this robot is that it can come to the user and attach itself to his body on its own. As a result, the user will not have to face any problems in wearing the robot. 

Regarding his experience using the robot, Kim said, “It (the robot) can follow me wherever I am, even when I am in a wheelchair. Its most interesting feature is that it automatically comes to me and clings to my body and helps me stand up.” 

The exoskeleton used in this strange robot created by researchers is called the ‘WalkOn Suit F1’. An exoskeleton is a strong outer shell worn on the body that provides protection to the body and helps people walk through wearable devices. 

The exoskeleton, called the ‘WalkOn Suit F1’, is made of aluminum and titanium, and weighs 50 kg or 110 pounds. It also uses 12 electronic motors. These motors are capable of imitating the movements of human leg joints while walking. 

Park Jeong-su, another member of the Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KIST) team, said he was inspired to create this robot from the famous Hollywood movie ‘Iron Man’. ‘After watching Iron Man, I thought it would be great if I could create such a robot in real life and help people.’ 

To maintain the balance of the users, the robot has several sensors on the sole and upper part that monitor the movements of the users by monitoring 1000 signals per second. As a result, this robot is also able to predict what their next movement step might be. 

The lenses attached to the front of the robot act as its eyes. Using these lenses, the robot can analyze what is around it. The robot does things like measuring the height of stairs and identifying obstacles in front of it through these lenses. Since people who are completely paralyzed lack sensory capabilities, the robot's lenses can be of great help in this regard. 

Kim Seung-hoon won the gold medal in the exoskeleton category at the Cyberathlon 2024 competition by wearing the 'WalkOn Suit F1' on his body. It is worth noting that in this competition, several robots that assist people created by developers with various physical disabilities were displayed in 8 different categories. 

Kim, who won the gold medal, said emotionally, 'I wanted to tell my son... that I can walk now too. I wanted to share various experiences with him.'

Headline_English: Internet speed record of 402 terabits per second!
Content_Enlish:
Japan has set a data transmission record at 402 terabits per second. Researchers led by the Photonic Network Laboratory of the country's National Institute of Information and Communications Technology (NICT) set a record for data transfer speed. This information was reported by the technology news outlet Tech Times. 

The speed of internet data transfer is so fast that 12,500 movies can be downloaded in just 1 second, the researchers claim. The team used conventional commercially used optical fibers in the research. However, a new method has been adopted to strengthen the signal. 

The researchers' new method for using unused wavelength bands is very important for future telecommunications networks, NICT said. The new method will help meet the growing demand for future data services and further increase the communication capacity of existing optical fiber-based infrastructure. 

This newly invented internet speed in Japan is about 1.6 million times faster than the average broadband internet speed in America. Currently, the country's average broadband internet download speed is 248.27 Mbps and upload speed is 34.23 Mbps.

Headline_English: The train that will run at a speed of 1,000 kilometers
Content_Enlish:
The train will run at a speed of 1,000 kilometers. Although it may sound surprising, such a train is being launched in China. Its test activities have already been completed. 

It is called the Ultra High-Speed ​​Magnetic Levitation (Maglev) train. This train will be run from inside a long pipe line. 

This train is being tested at the China Aerospace Science and Industry Corporation Limited (CSIC) in Shaanxi Province. It is run by creating a vacuum inside a long pipe line. 

CSIC scientist Li Ping said that the Maglev train has been successful in initial tests. Currently, issues such as its design, speed and navigation are being tested. 
The train runs at a speed of 623 kilometers without creating a vacuum. And if a vacuum is created, its speed will be 1,000 kilometers per hour.

Headline_English: Tesla's 5G patent case dismissed by UK High Court
Content_Enlish:
US electric car maker Tesla has suffered a major setback in the UK. The country's High Court dismissed their case seeking a 5G patent license yesterday (Monday). Tesla plans to launch state-of-the-art 5G electric vehicles (EVs) in the UK market soon. And that is why they need a 5G patent license. It is worth noting that the case was filed in the High Court in London in 2023. 

Tesla's case was against Interdigital, one of the 5G patent holders, and patent licensing platform operator Avancy. Elon Musk's automobile company had hoped that the High Court would consider the matter in light of fair, reasonable and non-discriminatory (FRAND) terms in granting the license. 

But the High Court ruled in favor of Interdigital and Avancy. However, accepting another claim by Tesla, the court also ordered the hearing to continue on the issue of the removal of 3 patents of Interdigital. 

During a hearing in May, Tesla's lawyers said the company plans to launch 5G electric cars in the UK market soon. Now that the issue of obtaining a 5G patent license is no longer available for hearing in the High Court, Tesla will have to reach an agreement with Interdigital and Avancy outside the court. Only then may Tesla be able to bring 5G electric cars to the UK market on time as planned. 

It is worth noting that in April, Tesla announced that they would launch the much-discussed robotaxi (Robot Traxie) in August this year. However, yesterday (Monday), Musk indicated that the unveiling of the robotaxi may be delayed due to design changes.

In the context of discussions on the potential of the fourth industrial revolution, cloud technology in Bangladesh and South Asia, as well as recent technologies such as AI and big data, came up at the conference. In addition, high-ranking Huawei officials who participated in the conference mentioned the immense potential of cloud technology in Bangladesh and expressed their interest in working to develop cloud technology in the country. 

Keeping in mind the theme of "Leap into Intelligence with Better Cloud", the speakers presented various applications and successes of cloud technology at the global and regional levels. The conference also discussed new strategies and plans for economic progress with the help of artificial intelligence, emphasizing the use of cloud systems. In this regard, the role of the government and the expansion of opportunities for digitalization were also highlighted. They also emphasized the importance of implementing a ‘cloud first’ strategy to ensure long-term benefits through new and revised policies. 

Among the dignitaries present at the conference were Pan Junfeng, President of Huawei South Asia and CEO of Huawei Bangladesh, Zhen Xinxian, President of Huawei’s Cloud Division in Asia Pacific, Yuhang Wang, Consulting Analyst of Frost & Sullivan, James Chu, International Consulting Director of Huawei Cloud, Eng. Rinko Kabiraj, National Data Center Server and Cloud Security Analyst of Bangladesh Computer Council, Eric Yang, CTO of Nuxnet, Dr. Upendra Pieris, CEO of Aurel IT, and John Leo, CTO of International Business of Huawei Hybrid Cloud. Zhen Xinxian, President of Huawei Cloud Asia Pacific, highlighted Huawei’s success in cloud technology. Headline_English: 6 Apple Intelligence Features You Can Use Right Now
Content_Enlish:
Recently, there has been a stir around artificial intelligence or AI all over the world. There are various speculations going on. New AI-based tools and features are constantly coming out. Some of them are rising to the top of popularity, while some are disappearing into oblivion. Tech giants are also announcing big investments in AI almost regularly. 

In this situation, last June (June 10), at the annual developer conference 2024, iPhone maker Apple announced the launch of its much-awaited AI platform 'Apple Intelligence'. At the conference, the focus of discussion was on various features and tools based on artificial intelligence or AI. Undoubtedly, Apple Intelligence occupied the biggest place in the discussion. 

In addition, some other important announcements related to new hardware and software also came from the developer conference. Of particular note are the three new operating systems - iOS 18 for iPhone, iPadOS 18 for iPad, and macOS Sequoia for MacBook. The AI-based features of the Apple Intelligence Platform can be used from all three operating systems. 

It is worth noting that the iPhone 16 and iOS 18 are scheduled to be unveiled next September, but the AI ​​features of Apple Intelligence will officially start coming to the iPhone by October. However, on July 29 (Monday), Apple opened their iOS 18 developer beta version 18.1 for use. As a result, iPhone lovers can taste the taste of iOS 18 now. 

It is true that the AI ​​features of Apple Intelligence are not officially coming before October. But iPhone 15 series Pro and Pro Max users can try out 6 AI features now if they want with the iOS 18.1 developer beta version. The features are: 

You can easily rewrite, proofread, and summarize using the writing tools. Writing tools will also help you bring the right 'tone' to any text. This interesting feature will naturally be available in Apple apps. In addition, this tool will also be available in third-party apps that use Apple's standard text controls. 

Siri 
Siri, which is rich in Apple intelligence, can now be used by iOS 18.1 users if they want. This popular digital assistant can now be seen in a new form. Naturally, several advanced features will also be available in the newly designed Siri that have a touch of AI technology. In particular, if the user makes a mistake in giving an instruction (instruction), Siri is able to correct it on its own and follow the instructions accordingly. In addition, this new version of Siri can maintain context from one instruction to another when working according to instructions. 

Mail App 
Apple intelligence can also be used in the Mail application to use some great AI features. These include - summaries of messages received in the inbox, smart reply features (various suggestions and recommendations for replying to emails) and on-device categorization (mails will be automatically divided into different categories). 

Notification summary 
Another feature based on AI technology is the automatic summary of notifications (auto-summarized summary). That is, summaries of text messages and emails will be automatically created. 

Natural language search in the Photos app 
You no longer have to waste time and effort scrolling through thousands of photos in the Photos application to find a specific image. With the power of AI, it is now possible to easily find a specific image using natural language. 

The call recording feature is finally coming to iOS 18.1, ending a 17-year wait for iPhone lovers. As a result, users will now be able to record calls on their iPhone. 

How to enable Apple Intelligence 
After installing the iOS 18.1 beta version on your iPhone, you will need to go to the ‘Apple Intelligence & Siri’ option from the settings. From there, you will need to be added to the Apple Intelligence waitlist. This time, after a few hours (approximate) of waiting, the user will get access to Apple Intelligence.

Headline_English: Astronauts stranded in space will return next year: NASA

The US space agency NASA has announced the return of two American astronauts stranded on the International Space Station to Earth. The agency said this at a press conference on Saturday local time. This information was reported by the Indian media NDTV. 

The two stranded astronauts are Indian-origin Sunita Williams and Barry Butch Wilmore. 

NASA said that they will be brought back next year on Elon Musk's SpaceX spacecraft.

Headline_English: X is banned in Brazil
Content_Enlish:
The popular social media platform X has been banned in Brazil for failing to appoint legal representatives within the stipulated time despite a court order. The BBC reported this information on Saturday local time. 

The court has ordered an “immediate and complete suspension”. The ban will remain in effect until X authorities comply with all court orders and pay the stipulated fine. 

In response to the court’s decision, X owner Elon Musk said that freedom is the foundation of democracy. An unelected impersonator judge in Brazil is destroying it for political purposes. 

The country’s court gave the microblogging platform X 24 hours to send legal representatives to Brazil. X did not send representatives even after this time expired. 

According to the news agency Reuters, the conflict with X in Brazil over account closures began last April. At that time, Supreme Court Judge Alexandre de Moraes ordered the closure of several of X’s accounts, accusing them of spreading misinformation. But Elon Musk did not comply. 

Later, billionaire Elon Musk was asked to send a legal representative in this regard. This order was given last Wednesday. That time ended at 8:07 pm local time on Thursday in Brazil. Then Musk said that he would not send a representative. For this reason, this microblogging platform was closed in Brazil. 

According to the British media Guardian, Brazilian President Lula da Silva's comments also hinted at a ban on X. In an interview with a radio channel in the country on Friday, Lula said, "He (Elon Musk) cannot disrespect us because he has a lot of money. What does he think of himself?" 

Recently, Elon Musk announced the closure of X's activities in Brazil. He called the order of Supreme Court Judge Alexandre de Moraes "censorship." Since then, X has had no legal representative in Brazil since August 17.

Headline_English: Three foldable phones are coming to the market, with the following features
Content_Enlish:
The teaser of Huawei's much-awaited tri-folding smartphone, the Mate XT, was released on Thursday (September 5). The Chinese tech giant has followed the "show me a little, not the whole thing" approach in the teaser released by Huawei's official account on China's popular social media platform Weibo. 

The 39-second teaser of the Mate XT phone features popular Chinese actor and singer Andy Lau in a large part. At the beginning of the teaser, Lau is seen taking out old movie reels in a movie archive room. At the end of the teaser, Lau is seen on the beach, where the teaser ends with a countdown on a movie projector. 

The teaser shows the smartphone folded for a few seconds, and then unfolded for a few seconds. However, only a part of the phone is shown when it is open, not the whole thing. When it is folded, only the back side or rear part of the phone is shown, not the front. 

As a result, there is no way to say that the design of the Mate XT is very attractive from the teaser. When folded, this Huawei phone looks like a standard tablet. Since it is a tri-fold handset, its thickness is quite important here. Especially how thick the phone will be when folded is a big question - because users will want the phone to be folded and carried comfortably in their pockets. 

From the teaser, it can be assumed that the phone will be quite thin, but as a tri-folding set, it will be a little thicker than a normal smartphone. In addition, it is said that the display size of the phone when opened may be 10 inches horizontally, although there has been no official announcement about the specifications and features yet. 

CEO Richard E. with Huawei's foldable phone in his hand last August. Photo source: Whitelab Weibo account. 

From the countdown shown in the teaser, it is understood that Huawei is going to launch the phone in the market soon. Huawei is playing a game of light and dark on this issue too - perhaps intentionally. On September 2, Huawei's consumer device head Yu Chengdong announced on his official Weibo account that they are going to organize an event on September 10 where Huawei will unveil their most exciting and innovative product - one that will change the prevailing market trend. 

Although Huawei has not said anything explicitly, it is believed that they will launch the Mate XT phone through this event. The date of September 10 is even more significant here because the day before that, i.e. on September 9, Apple's much-awaited iPhone 16 is coming to the market. In fact, Huawei's event will be held within a few hours of the end of Apple's event. 

Is this just a coincidence? You answer the question.

Headline_English: The most powerful electromagnet is now in China
Content_Enlish:
Chinese scientists have created the world's most powerful resistive magnet, with a magnetic field strength of 42.02 Tesla. It is eight hundred thousand times stronger than the Earth's magnetic field. Until now, the United States owned this record, and in 2017, the magnetic field strength of the resistive magnet they created was 41.4 Tesla. 

This resistive magnet was created by the High Magnetic Field Laboratory of the Hefei Institute of Physical Sciences under the Chinese Academy of Sciences. It is expected to play a role in China's future discoveries and research. 

A powerful electric magnet used to create the extreme environment necessary for research on various objects. For decades, scientists around the world have made significant discoveries using such magnets. Such magnets have even been behind more than 10 Nobel Prizes. 

A reluctance magnet is a type of electric or electromagnet. There are three types of electric or electromagnets in the world: reluctance magnets or water-cooled magnets, superconducting magnets, and hybrid magnets made from a combination of the two. It is worth noting that scientists have been using reluctance magnets in research for a long time. 

Earlier, in 2022, the world's most powerful hybrid magnet was created in the same laboratory in China - with a magnetic field strength of 45.22 Tesla.

Headline_English: The world will see a new 'moon' from Sunday
Content_Enlish:
The world is going to get a new 'moon' for about two months. It may sound surprising, but it is true. This 'mini moon' will be visible from tomorrow, Sunday (September 29). Scientists say that a small asteroid will start orbiting our planet. And then it will look like the moon. 

This moon has been named 'mini moon' because it cannot be seen without a space station, researchers said. 

According to a report by the US media CBS News, a small 'moon' will appear in the sky of the Earth from September 29 to November 25. 

According to a report published by the 'American Astronomical Society', an asteroid named 2024 Ptfive will pass by the Earth in late September. The existence of this asteroid was discovered last month. 

Scientists say that while passing by the Earth, a part of the asteroid will enter its orbit due to the force of gravity. It will orbit the Earth for the next 2 months. After that, it will gradually overcome the attraction and go back on its own path. And scientists consider this orbiting asteroid part as a satellite. It is being compared with a small part of the moon. 

Carlos de la Fuente Marcos, the lead author of the study, said that the mini-moon will be too small to see with a normal telescope or binoculars. However, professional astronomers with powerful equipment will be able to detect it.

Headline_English: Mission to return astronauts Sunita and Butch to Earth begins
Content_Enlish:
NASA and Elon Musk's SpaceX have launched an operation to return astronauts Sunita Williams and Butch Wilmore to Earth. On Saturday night, local time, the SpaceX vehicle carrying two astronauts left for space from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida, USA. 

The two astronauts are scheduled to conduct some research at the International Space Station (ISS) on a mission called 'Crew-9'. They are then scheduled to return to Earth in February next year with Sunita and Butch. 

Sunita and Butch have been stuck at the ISS since last June after the spacecraft they traveled to space broke down. Now the operation to return them to Earth has begun. 

Sunita and Butch have been stuck at the ISS since last June. They were supposed to return to Earth after eight days, but they could not. They could not return due to some technical problems with the Boeing Starliner spacecraft they traveled on. Starliner returned to Earth from space on September 6 without Sunita. 

NASA has informed that the 'Falcon 9' rocket and the Dragon spacecraft are being used for this important mission. The 'Crew-9' mission is being led by astronaut Nick Hogg. Alexandra Gorbunov is accompanying her as a specialist. They will conduct about 200 research studies on the ISS for five months. 

SpaceX is going on its ninth mission under NASA's commercial program. If all goes well, the SpaceX spacecraft will land on the ISS late at night on September 30. This spacecraft has a capacity of four people. After completing its work, the spacecraft will leave for Earth in February 2025 with four astronauts.

Headline_English: Apple is bringing a smart display with a 'robot hand'!
Content_Enlish:
The excitement of the iPhone 16 series has not yet subsided. In the meantime, important information has been revealed about another innovative product of Apple. This time, the product is Apple's much-awaited 'Smart Display'. This device, rich in Apple intelligence features, will have innovative features like 'robot hands' and a new operating system 'HomeOS'. It is believed that Apple's smart display may come to the market in 2025. 

Apple lovers must be wondering what this smart display will look like. Those who have seen Apple's HomePod, just imagine a display with the device. Well, you will see a version close to the smart display on your mind's screen. 

Although Apple has not officially said anything special about the smart display, Bloomberg reporter Mark Garman recently gave some important information about the device. And it is a little difficult to accept that Garman's information about Apple's product will be wrong. 

Garman had previously said that a robotic hand will be attached to Apple's smart display. With the help of this robotic hand, users will be able to tilt and rotate the display for their viewing convenience. Now, in his recent report published in Bloomberg, he has said that Apple is working on two versions of the smart display. Among them, there will be an opportunity to access the video telephony app FaceTime and various smart home control features through the low-end display. 

On the other hand, the high-end version will have the robotic arm feature. Naturally, the device will also be more expensive. While the low-end version costs around $ 1,000, the price of the high-end display with a robotic arm will start at over $ 1,000. 

According to Garman, a relatively low-cost device will come to the market first, most likely sometime next year (2025). Apple intelligence will also be at the heart of both versions. In addition, Garman's report also revealed that the new 'HomeOS' operating system is going to be based on the Apple TV's tvOS operating system. 

Apple decided to create a smart display in 2022. However, the development of smart displays has gained momentum since Apple canceled its much-discussed multi-billion dollar car project earlier this year. It is said that hundreds of Apple employees are currently involved in the development of this device, led by Apple Vice President Kevin Lynch. It is worth noting that Kevin Lynch was also in charge of Apple's car project. 

Along with Apple Intelligence and Siri, Apple's smart display may also use 'proximity' technology. Overall, this smart display is an important part of Apple's personal robotics plan. 

Apple is no stranger to creating innovative products. Among the smart products that Apple is currently working on are smart displays, smart glasses, AirPods with built-in cameras, and foldable iPhones and iPads.

Headline_English: ChatGPT maker's market value now at $157 billion after record investment
Content_Enlish:
ChatGPT maker OpenAI has raised a record $6.6 billion ($6.6 billion). The new funding round takes the company's market value to $157 billion ($157 billion). As a result, OpenAI is now one of the world's most valuable private companies. 

Yesterday (October 2), OpenAI officially announced the new investment in a post on its website. The US AI research firm said the new investment will be used to accelerate research on AI technology, increase computing power, and create AI tools that are good at solving various problems. 

For about a month, it has been rumored that OpenAI is going to raise $6.5 billion in a new venture capital (VC) round. It was also widely expected that the popular startup's market value would cross the $100 billion mark with this new investment. Later, the market value reached $150 billion in the pre-raising round. 

Although the list of candidates interested in investing in OpenAI is long, the main obstacle is the company's non-profit corporate structure. Many investors are discouraged, especially since the profit cap or profit limit is limited. However, the company has already taken the initiative to change its internal structure. It is also being ensured that the non-profit board does not have control over the company's profitable (for-profit) business. 

As a result, there are practically no obstacles in front of OpenAI in attracting new investment. However, OpenAI, which started its journey as a non-profit organization in 2015, also stated that although it depends on its own profitable business to finance expensive projects such as AI research, the non-profit structure at the heart of the company is not changing. 

Among the investors, Thrive Capital, an old investor in OpenAI, has invested the most, at $1.2 billion ($1.2 billion). In addition, Microsoft, the company's largest investment partner, has also participated in this round of fundraising. Their investment amount is slightly less than $1 billion. 

In addition, Nvidia, a leading AI chip maker, has joined the list of OpenAI partners by investing $100 million. However, another tech giant, Apple, has refrained from investing after a long discussion. 

Another old investor, Khosla Capital, has also increased its investment in OpenAI by investing again in this VC round. In addition, ARK Venture Fund of well-known investor in the AI ​​world, Kathy Wood, has also invested $250 million in the world's most popular AI company. 

Another prominent investor in this round of fundraising is Japan-based investment company SoftBank - whose investment is $500 million. It is worth noting that SoftBank has made significant investments in the AI ​​sector in recent times. ARM, a well-known UK-based AI chip design company, is a subsidiary of SoftBank. In addition, Abu Dhabi-based state-backed investment firm MGX also participated in this round of fundraising. 

Sarah Freer, Chief Financial Officer (CFO) of OpenAI, told employees on Wednesday that after this recent investment, OpenAI will now give them the opportunity to sell their shares through a tender offer. However, the timing of this tender and the details related to it have not yet been finalized, the source said. 

It is worth noting that OpenAI launched the generative AI-based chatbot ‘ChatGPT’ in November 2022. Currently, more than 250 million (250 million) users use ChatGPT per week. 

After receiving a new investment of $6.6 billion (over 79 thousand crore taka in Bangladeshi currency), OpenAI's market value has almost doubled compared to the previous funding round ($86 billion). With a market value of $157 billion (over 18 lakh 80 thousand crore taka), OpenAI is now next to companies like Uber and AT&T. 

In the context of internal structural changes at OpenAI, several high-ranking executives, including Chief Technology Officer (CTO) Mira Murati, have recently left the company. Although the popularity of ChatGPT has skyrocketed, the AI ​​company is facing challenges in growing revenue. 

While the potential profit figure for the current year is $3.6 billion or 3.6 billion, OpenAI's loss is more than $5 billion or 5 billion. However, co-founder and CEO Sam Altman assures investors that his company is going to earn $11.6 billion or 116 billion next year. 

It is worth noting that if OpenAI is able to achieve certain revenue targets next year, Thrive Capital has agreed to invest another $1 billion, or $1 billion at the current market price, in the company.

Headline_English: Foxconn's record revenue on the power of artificial intelligence
Content_Enlish:
It goes without saying that the demand for artificial intelligence or AI technology is constantly increasing. Since the introduction of ChatGPT, a chatbot built on generative AI technology, interest in AI has increased, as has investment and research in the AI ​​sector. This year, the revenues of top companies associated with AI technology have exceeded their own expectations. The Taiwanese company Foxconn has recently been added to this list. 

Foxconn, the world's largest contract electronics manufacturer, has earned more than expected in the third quarter of the year (July-September). This success has come thanks to the high demand for AI servers around the world. 

Foxconn's revenue from July to September increased by 20.2 percent compared to the same period last year to reach $57.3 billion. In Taiwanese currency, the figure is 1.85 trillion New Taiwan dollars (more than 6 lakh 87 thousand crore taka). This is Foxconn's highest revenue record in the third quarter. 

It is worth noting that the Taiwan-based company is the largest assembler of Apple's flagship iPhone. 

In a statement on Saturday (October 5), Foxconn said, "This (financial) result has exceeded the company's initial high revenue expectations." 

Although Apple's iPhone 16 series has recently been launched, the catalyst behind Foxconn's recent success was the growing demand for powerful servers required for AI technology around the world. And relying on the skyrocketing demand for AI servers, Foxconn has seen extraordinary success in their cloud and networking products. It is worth noting that Nvidia, a leading AI chip maker, is among Foxconn's customers. 

Taiwanese electronics manufacturers have a busy time in the third quarter of the year. Because they have to deliver various technology products including smartphones and tablets to Western tech giants like Apple as per the contract before the end of the year's 'holiday season' begins. 

Foxconn's statement on its expectations for the current quarter said, "We expect our operations to gradually accelerate during the peak season in the second half of the year. The fourth-quarter financial results are expected to be broadly in line with current market expectations." 

However, Foxconn did not provide any details about their expected revenue target for the fourth quarter. It is worth noting that the company's share price has increased by 86 percent so far this year - while the Taiwanese market has increased by 24 percent. 

Although the company initially released its third-quarter financial results, it said that it will release a detailed report on November 14. 

It is worth noting that Foxconn's annual 'Tech Day' event will be held on October 8 and 9 this year. At the 'Tech Day' event, they highlight their new products as well as provide important information about new partnerships.

Headline_English: World's first desktop microcomputer sold at auction
Content_Enlish:
The world's first desktop microcomputer has been sold at auction. However, the auctioneers said that the expected price was not obtained. The computer was sold for 37 thousand 179 pounds. The auction house had expected the price to go up even higher. 

On May 24, the 'Q One Model' computer was auctioned at the Heritage Auctions in the UK. This important computer was found by cleaning workers in the storage of Kingston University in London. 

Last February, two Q One Model desktop microcomputers were found in the storage of Kingston University. Then, the university displayed them in an exhibition titled Creating the Everything Device. The exhibition highlighted the evolution of computing from the seventies to the nineties. 

The Q One model has a light orange screen and a built-in keyboard. The computer used Intel's 8008 processor and transistor-based logic circuits. Due to the use of a microprocessor, the Q One was more portable than larger systems, providing better performance. The Q1 model showed the potential of microcomputers to revolutionize professional and personal computing.

Headline_English: More than half of smartphones will have AI by 2028
Content_Enlish:
Smartphone manufacturers are working to incorporate artificial intelligence, or AI, into their devices to stay ahead of the competition in the technology market. By 2028, more than half of the world's smartphones will have AI features. This information has emerged in a recent report by market research firm Canalys. 

Technology media outlet GizmoChina reports that only 16 percent of smartphones sold worldwide currently have special AI features. This figure is expected to reach 54 percent by 2028. And the market for AI-enabled smartphones is growing at an annual rate of 63 percent. 

Initially, advanced AI models will only be available in high-end flagship smartphones. However, over time, AI capabilities will also be added to mid-range budget smartphones. 

According to the Canalys report, the rise of generative AI in smartphones will bring a major transformational change for the industry. AI will completely change the user's smartphone experience in the next three to five years. 

AI-powered features have already been added to recent flagships from Google and Samsung, while Chinese companies like Huawei, Oppo, and Xiaomi are trying to bring AI capabilities to high-end devices.

Headline_English: 5G smartphone sales to increase by 16 percent this year
Content_Enlish:
The demand for 5G networks is increasing worldwide. In view of this, sales of 5G smartphones may increase by 16 percent this year. This prediction was made in a report published by the market research firm International Data Corporation (IDC). 

According to the report, global smartphone sales will increase by 4 percent in 2024 to reach 1.21 billion units. Which is 16 percent more than in 2023. This trend may continue in 2025 as well. As a result, the global smartphone market will grow by 2.3 percent. 

IDC market analysts have cited Android smartphone sales as one of the reasons behind this growth. The Android smartphone market will grow by 4.8 percent in 2024. While the iPhone market will grow by only 0.7 percent. 

The demand for next-generation 5G technology among general consumers worldwide is increasing day by day. IDC has predicted that the expansion of 5G networks in different regions and ease of availability of devices will act as one of the driving forces for the recovery of the smartphone market. 

"The smartphone market has been going through a very difficult time in the past few years. However, the smartphone sector is expected to be in a good position in the future," said Rayar Reith, vice president of IDC's Worldwide Mobility and Consumer Device Trackers division. 
According to IDC, the growth of 5G smartphones will reach 13.2 percent by 2025. The market share of 5G smartphones will increase from 67.2 percent this year to 74.4 percent.

Headline_English: Tesla robots will work in factories from next year
Content_Enlish:
Tesla's Optimus humanoid robot will start working in factories next year. Tesla CEO Elon Musk has announced this. Recently, in a meeting with the company's shareholders, Elon Musk announced the use of 1,000 units of Optimus robots. 

Musk said, "The use of robots in factories is capable of bringing revolutionary changes. There will be a demand for 1 billion humanoid robots annually in the future market. Tesla will be able to supply at least 10 percent of the robots in this market. Tesla will be able to build each Optimus robot for $10,000 and sell it for $20,000." Although Musk announced plans to use 1,000 Optimus robots in the factory, he did not say in which areas they would work. 

The Tesla CEO also said, "In 2026, more changes will be made to the Optimus humanoid robot. The robot's software will be completely customized. This will allow the robot to be used according to specific needs.’ 

Earlier in April, Elon Musk said that the Optimus humanoid robot would start selling by the end of next year. He also said that Tesla is in a better position than any humanoid robot manufacturer. 

Tesla released the first-generation Optimus robot in September 2022. This year, the company posted a video of a second-generation humanoid robot. In the video, the robot is seen folding a T-shirt. Earlier, in December, another video showed a robot exercising and frying an egg.

Headline_English: Second submarine cable re-opened, internet speed will increase
Content_Enlish:
The country's second submarine cable (SMW-5) has been re-established two months after it was severed. On April 19, the country's second submarine cable under the Bangladesh Submarine Cables PLC (BSCPLC) suddenly severed in Indonesian waters west of Singapore. 

In a press release, BSCPLC announced the reconnection of the submarine cable. This information was revealed in a press release signed by Saidur Rahman, General Manager of the company's Operation and Maintenance Department. 

The press release said that Bangladesh Submarine Cables PLC (BSCPLC) would like to inform all concerned that on Friday, April 19, at midnight, the country's second submarine cable (SMW-5) under the BSCPLC suddenly severed in Indonesian waters west of Singapore. 

The repair work of the cable was completed smoothly by the SMW5 Consortium on June 28 at 10:40 am. In the meantime, the circuits connected through BSCPLC's SMW5 have been put into operation. 

The government organization also expressed regret for the inconvenience caused to customers due to the slow internet in the country for a long time.

Headline_English: Chinese rocket crashes shortly after launch
Content_Enlish:
A commercial Chinese rocket has crashed during a test launch. It caught fire shortly after launch. The incident took place in Gongyi, central China's Henan Province, on Sunday. 

The Tianlong-3 rocket is said to have been designed for space missions. 
The rocket's manufacturer, Beijing Tianbing, said the crash may have been caused by a communication problem between the test stand and the rocket. The rocket later exploded in a nearby mountainous area. 
A video of the incident has since gone viral on social media. It shows the rocket being launched into the sky as normal. It then caught fire. The rocket crashed after falling. No casualties were reported.

Headline_English: 34 people died of COVID-19 in the country in a single day, 1,988 were identified
Content_Enlish:
The death and detection rate of corona in the country has increased again. 34 more people have died of corona in the last 24 hours. With this, the total death toll in the country has reached 12,694. The detection rate of corona in the last 24 hours is 9.81 percent. 20,259 samples have been tested in the last 24 hours. This information was given in a press release by the Directorate General of Health Services on Wednesday (June 2). 

The release said that 1,988 more people have been newly identified with corona in the country. According to the estimate, a total of 8 lakh 4 thousand 293 people have been identified with corona in the country so far. 

The release also said that 1,914 people have recovered in the last 24 hours. With this, a total of 7 lakh 42 thousand 151 people have recovered. 

It is worth noting that the first infection of corona in the country was detected on March 8 last year. The first death was reported on March 18, 10 days later.

Headline_English: BNP is the main architect of destroying the political environment in the country: Quader
Content_Enlish:
BNP is the main mastermind and mastermind behind the destruction of the country's democratic, natural and political environment. Awami League General Secretary Obaidul Quader made this comment.
