Listening to the speeches of BNP leaders, it seems that the people of Bangladesh are in hellish pain. 
At this time, he said that if the revenge-prone BNP comes to power, the country will again plunge into darkness and a flood of blood will flow in the country. Therefore, Obaidul Quader also said that the country and its people are not safe in the hands of BNP, which is a sponsor of communal and violence. 

This wise Obaidul Quader commented that BNP's politics is more dangerous than the virus.

Headline_English: Human chain demanding urgent renovation of Brahmanbaria railway station
Content_Enlish:
Brahmanbaria Citizens Forum has formed a human chain demanding the immediate renovation of the railway station in Brahmanbaria and the resumption of rail services. A human chain has been formed demanding the immediate renovation of the Brahmanbaria railway station, which was damaged by the violence carried out by Hefazat-e-Islam activists and supporters, and the resumption of rail services. The program was organized by the District Citizens Forum at the Brahmanbaria Press Club premises at 11 am on Saturday (June 12). 

People from various classes and professions participated in the human chain. The organization has warned of a strong movement if rail services are not resumed in Brahmanbaria by June 20. 
The human chain held under the chairmanship of District Citizen Forum President Piyush Kanti Acharya was addressed by District JSD President Bir Muktijoddha Akhter Hossain Sayeed, Bir Muktijoddha Wasel Siddiqui, Brahmanbaria Press Club President Riaz Uddin Jami and General Publisher Javed Rahim Bijon, Journalists Union Convener Md. Monir Hossain, Press Club Former Senior Vice President Al Amin Shahin, and District Citizen Forum General Secretary Ratan Kanti Dutta among others. 

The speakers at the human chain said that the Brahmanbaria Railway Station, an important railway station on the Eastern Railway, has been closed for the past two and a half months. No train service is being stopped at this station. Due to this, thousands of people who travel through this station every day are suffering.

Headline_English: Awami League is not a party to run away from: Quader
Content_Enlish:
The address of trust of the soil and people is not the Awami League, the roots of the Awami League are deep in the soil of this country. Awami League General Secretary Obaidul Quader said this in response to a comment by the BNP Secretary General. 

Addressing the BNP at a briefing at the Secretariat on Monday morning, he said that the BNP's face has been exposed because the people have awakened and the BNP has suffered a crushing defeat in the recent elections. The Awami League General Secretary also commented that the BNP's apolitical policies have now become clear to the people, so the people of the country no longer trust them.

Headline_English: Swiss bank reveals the amount of money held by Bangladeshis
Content_Enlish:
The country's central bank has released updated statistics on money held by Bangladeshi individuals and institutions in Swiss banks. 

At the end of 2020, there were 573 million Swiss francs in the name of Bangladesh in various banks in Switzerland. The amount in Bangladeshi currency is about 5,400 crore taka. In 2019, it was 610 million Swiss francs or about 5,800 crore taka. As a result, the money held in Bangladesh's name has decreased slightly compared to the previous year. It is believed that a part of the money held in Swiss banks is laundered. However, no specific information is available about this. It is not even known how much money someone has as a deposit. 
Switzerland's central bank, the Swiss National Bank, has said that the customer information related to these statistics will be kept confidential. In the interest of confidentiality, all the data has been published collectively. If any Bangladeshi citizen or institution has deposited money in the name of another country instead of itself, it has not been included in this calculation. Similarly, the financial value of valuable works of art, gold or rare items deposited in Swiss banks has not been included here.

Headline_English: Fruits that help you lose weight quickly
Content_Enlish:
There is no alternative to eating fruits to maintain nutritional balance in the body. Along with vitamins, minerals, antioxidants, fruits contain various beneficial ingredients. Some fruits also help in weight loss. Eating fruits four times a day reduces the level of excess calorie intake. And this is how fruits help in weight loss. Let's know which fruits help in weight loss quickly- 

* Banana: Due to its high calorie and sugar content, many people avoid eating bananas while trying to lose weight. However, despite being high in calories, this fruit also contains potassium, magnesium, manganese, fiber, various antioxidants and vitamins A, B-six and C. The sugar in this fruit is also absorbed slowly in the body. Therefore, bananas, which are rich in various nutrients, help in keeping the body weight low. 
* Watermelon: Known as a mineral-rich fruit. Its calorie content is also low. Only 46 to 61 calories will be obtained from one cup i.e. 150 to 160 grams of watermelon. It contains high levels of iron, potassium and antioxidants such as vitamin C, beta-carotene and lycopene. And its sugar is slowly absorbed into the blood. As a result, it reduces the need to eat other foods. 

* Apple: Apples are rich in high fiber and flavonoid polymers, which help in weight control. Apples should be eaten with the peel to get fiber and antioxidants. It keeps blood sugar under control. If blood sugar is under control, it keeps hunger under control and prevents diabetes. 

* Orange: Like other sour fruits, oranges are rich in vitamin C and low in calories. And it helps in keeping the stomach full for a long time. 

* Pear: Pear helps in weight control because it contains flavonoid polymers. Every 138 mg. Additional flavonoid polymers increase weight at a lower rate. 

* Strawberry: Blueberries or strawberries are low in calories but have many other nutrients. Although blueberries are not easily available in our country, strawberries are available. One cup or 152 grams of strawberries contains less than 50 calories.

Headline_English: Bangladesh provides 650 million taka to alleviate poverty in Sudan
Content_Enlish:
Responding to the call of the International Monetary Fund (IMF), the Bangladesh government has provided about 650 million taka in Bangladeshi taka on June 15, 2021, for debt relief to Sudan, a debt-ridden poor country and a friendly country of the OIC member. This assistance was announced in a press release of the Ministry of Finance on Wednesday (June 16). The release also expressed the hope that this cooperation of the Bangladesh government will further strengthen Sudan's struggle to eradicate poverty. 
It is worth noting that last year, as part of the IMF's initiative, Bangladesh had provided more than 80 million taka to the African country of Somalia to eradicate poverty.

Headline_English: Biden-Putin give positive message in first meeting
Content_Enlish:
Although the Biden-Putin meeting in Geneva was positive, both presidents expressed their differences of opinion. They also praised each other. President Joe Biden and President Vladimir Putin met face-to-face on Wednesday amid Russia-US tensions. This heavyweight meeting was held at the 18th century Villa 'La Grazie' in Geneva. The talks began at 1 pm local time amid tight security. 
The two heads of state were accompanied by Foreign Ministers Antony Blinken and Sergey Lavrov. The two countries' mutual relations were the most important issue in the nearly three-hour talks. The two leaders agreed to start talks on nuclear arms control. In addition, their meeting ended ahead of schedule.

Headline_English: From Bangladesh Awami League to Baksal; Bangabandhu's second revolution
Content_Enlish:
Aditya Nandi: Bangladesh Awami League; On the 72nd founding anniversary of the organization under whose leadership an independent state called Bangladesh was established, under whose leadership the Bengali nation broke the chain of long-standing exploitation and oppression, the organization that is synonymous with the name Bangladesh, I respectfully remember the Father of the Nation Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman. A car cannot take you to your destination unless a skilled driver sits in the driving seat and drives it. It was Bangabandhu who, through his skilled leadership, made the exploited Bengalis passengers in the vehicle called Awami League and snatched the independence of Bengal and Bengalis. Therefore, on the day of the organization's establishment or whenever the topic of establishing the Bangladesh state arises, we must respectfully remember the Father of the Bengali Nation Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman, who snatched the independence of Bengal by turning that organization into the only organization of the masses. This is only natural for Bengalis. 

Just as the establishment of the 'East Pakistan Awami Muslim League' after the creation of Pakistan was right in view of the time, it was also right to stand against the exploitation of West Pakistanis and change the name to 'East Pakistan Awami League' by dropping the word Muslim and moving forward on the path of a friend of non-communal consciousness. A leader who does not understand MPT (Manner, Place, Time) can never lead his followers to the desired goal. It was because of Bangabandhu's correct observation of MPT and leadership accordingly that the 'East Pakistan Awami League' with non-communal consciousness was able to snatch away the freedom desired by the Bengali nation for many years and transform into the name 'Bangladesh Awami League'. After bringing independence to this country and nation, Bangabandhu brought most Bengalis under the umbrella of the Awami League in 1971 with the aim of making Bangladesh a developed state by bringing economic freedom. In the same way, the Bangladesh Awami League changed its name and brought all the political parties and politicians who supported the liberation war under the banner of 'Baksal' (Bangladesh Farmers, Workers Awami League), and although it seemed to be a one-party state in the language of the vested interests, in reality it wanted to establish a Bangladesh of equality through a multi-party system of governance. 

If the Father of the Nation had not embraced death through the Fourth Amendment, the second revolution that the Father of the Nation had called for, and the allies of the defeated forces of '71, Mostaq, and Zia, had not embraced death in the direct conspiracy of the Ziaites, today Bangladesh would have been a developed and prosperous country like China under the leadership of Baksal, and we, according to the needs of the time, started our journey as 'East Pakistan Awami Muslim League' and later removed 'Muslim' from the name and became 'East Pakistan Awami League', after independence, 'Bangladesh Awami League' and today, as a partner in the second revolution, we would be proud to identify ourselves as workers or supporters of 'Baksal'. Respect to all the sacrificed and dedicated leaders and workers of the Bangladesh Awami League on the anniversary of its establishment.

Headline_English: Historic Six Points Day today
Content_Enlish:
Today, June 7 (Monday), is the historic Six-Point Day. On this day in 1966, an intense mass movement began across the country in support of the 6-point charter of liberation of the Bengali nation declared by the Father of the Nation Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman. The outline of independence was written. In the continuation of the 6-point-based movement and struggle, the Bengali freedom movement took the form of a freedom struggle. Awami League Advisory Council member Amir Hossain Amu said about the 6-points, Bangabandhu presented the six-points as a charter of liberation for the people of Bengal before the people. The historic six-points showed the way for the liberation of the Bengalis and united everyone under the leadership of Bangabandhu in the struggle to establish their rights. Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman raised the six-points in the subject committee of the conference held in Lahore on February 5, 1966, focusing on the Tashkent Agreement, and the next day, he requested the concerned to take necessary measures to include the six-points in the agenda of the conference. The organizers of the conference ignored Bangabandhu's request and rejected the 6-points. In protest, Bangabandhu did not attend the conference. However, Bangabandhu raised the 6-points while he was in Lahore.

As a result, West Pakistan newspapers published news about Bangabandhu as a separatist leader. Later, Bangabandhu returned to Dhaka and got the 6-points and other detailed programs of the party passed by the party's executive committee on March 13.

The Awami League movement began to achieve the 6-point demands. A strike was also called. During the strike, the police and the then EPR opened fire on the unarmed crowd. In this, 11 people including Manu Mia, Shafiq and Shamsul Haque were martyred in Dhaka and Narayanganj.

Gradually, widespread public support for the 6-points was created. The popularity of Bangabandhu's leadership increased. Fearing Bangabandhu's popularity, the autocratic government led by the military junta Ayub Khan arrested Bangabandhu on May 8, 1966 and sent him to prison.

The 6-point movement announced by the Father of the Nation Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman gained a new dimension on June 7, 1966.

The 11-point movement based on the 6-point movement began the mass uprising of 1969. After all, the people of Bengal gave an exclusive verdict to the Awami League nominated candidates in the 1970 general elections. Although the people won, the autocratic Pakistani rulers did not allow the winning party to form the government, so Bangabandhu united the nation and started a movement for independence. In continuation of this, under the leadership of Bangabandhu, an independent sovereign Bangladesh emerged in 1971 through an armed liberation war.

The main point of the 6-point movement was that all power except for defense and foreign affairs would be in the hands of the provincial government. There will be two separate and easily convertible currencies in East Bengal and West Pakistan. The provincial government will be responsible for levying and collecting taxes and duties, and there will be separate accounts for the foreign exchange earned by the two regions, and a demand has been made for the formation of a paramilitary force and the establishment of a naval headquarters here to reduce the defense risk of East Bengal.

The Awami League has been observing the day with due dignity. But due to the crisis caused by the coronavirus pandemic, the party will observe the day's program on a limited scale with due dignity, avoiding large public gatherings on this historic day and adhering to health safety rules.

A press release sent from the party office said that the program includes - hoisting the national and party flags at Bangabandhu Bhaban, the central office and all party offices of the Awami League at sunrise on Monday, and paying homage to the portrait of the Father of the Nation Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman in the premises of Bangabandhu Bhaban at 9 am.

Headline_English: All gates of Teesta Barrage have been opened; water level is above the danger level
Content_Enlish:
The opening of all the gates of the Ghazoldoba Barrage in India has caused the upstream water to flood the Dalia Barrage Point on the Teesta in Bangladesh. The Water Development Board has opened 44 gates of the barrage to deal with the situation. At 11 pm on Thursday (July 8), the water was flowing 30 centimeters above the danger level at Dalia Point. People in the char and low-lying areas of the 516-kilometer Teesta basin have been waterlogged due to the floodwaters. They are in trouble due to the sudden waterlogging in the dark. 

Jyoti Prasad Ghosh, Chief Engineer of the Northern Region of the Water Development Board, said that at 6 pm on Thursday, the water of the Teesta River was flowing 6 centimeters below the danger level at the Teesta Barrage Point located in Doani in Lalmonirhat district. The water flow started increasing soon after this. By 11 pm, it reached 52.90 centimeters, which continued to flow 30 centimeters above the danger level. 
After that, 44 gates have been opened to protect the barrage. Due to this, water has risen in the lower reaches of the Teesta basin in 14 upazilas of five districts downstream. Earlier, the water level of the Teesta river was 25 centimeters below the danger level on Tuesday (July 6) and 30 centimeters below it on Wednesday (July 7). 

According to sources from the district and upazila administrations and union parishad chairmen of the Teesta basin, the downstream area is being submerged due to the alarming increase in water. Meanwhile, water has entered the lower reaches of the 516-kilometer-long char area of ​​the Teesta basin. About 50,000 people have been waterlogged.

Headline_English: City residents will be able to get free dengue tests: Atiq
Content_Enlish: City residents can get free dengue tests at 42 centers of Dhaka North City Corporation if they have a fever. North City Corporation Mayor Atiqul Islam gave this information while inspecting public awareness activities to prevent dengue and chikungunya. City residents can get detailed information from the DNCC website. DNCC has continued its awareness campaign to prevent the spread of dengue and chikungunya. As part of this, an awareness campaign was conducted from Moghbazar intersection today. Joining the campaign, Mayor Atiq said that along with the City Corporation, city residents should also come forward for the health and safety of city residents. He called for destroying stagnant water and Aedes mosquito breeding sources around their homes, even for 10 minutes every Saturday. Public representatives are urged to

Headline_English: Various quarters are in mourning over the death of renowned artist Fakir Alamgir.
Content_Enlish:
Famous Ekushey Padak-winning folk singer Fakir Alamgir has passed away after succumbing to Corona. His death has cast a shadow of grief over all quarters, including the music industry. The President, the Prime Minister and other figures from various circles have expressed their condolences. 

Railway Minister Md. Nurul Islam Sujan MP, Planning Minister M.A. Mannan MP have expressed deep grief over the death of this legendary artist. State Minister for Cultural Affairs KM Khalid MP, State Minister for Shipping Khalid Mahmud Chowdhury MP, State Minister for Youth and Sports Zahid Ahsan Russell MP, State Minister for Planning Dr. Shamsul Alam have expressed their condolences. 

Also, Bangladesh Awami League Presidium Member Advocate Jahangir Kabir Nanak has expressed deep grief and sorrow over the death of Ekushey Padak-winning folk singer Fakir Alamgir. 

Jatiya Party Chairman and Deputy Leader of the Opposition Janabandhu Golam Mohammad Quader MP expressed deep shock and sorrow over the death of Fakir Alamgir. 

In their condolence message, they prayed for the eternal peace of the departed soul and expressed their condolences to the bereaved family members. 

Popular folk singer Fakir Alamgir breathed his last at 10:56 pm on Friday (July 23) at the capital's United Hospital after contracting COVID-19. His son Mashuk Alamgir Rajib confirmed the news of his death. Fakir Alamgir was 71 years old at the time of his death. He is survived by his wife and three sons. 

Earlier, Fakir Alamgir, who had been undergoing treatment at the Intensive Care Unit (ICU) of the capital's United Hospital since July 15, was put on life support on July 19 after his physical condition deteriorated.

Headline_English: SSC exam in November and HSC exam in December
Content_Enlish:
Once the coronavirus situation is under control, the SSC and equivalent exams will be held in the second week of November and the HSC and equivalent exams in the first week of December, Education Minister Dr. Dipu Moni has said. 
He made this announcement in a virtual meeting with officials of the ministry and other concerned parties that began at around 11 am on Thursday. 

The Education Minister said that the exams will be conducted on a short syllabus on only three non-fiction subjects. In this case, the exam time will be one and a half hours. If it is not possible to take the exam, the SSC or HSC results will be announced based on the results of the previous exam. 

He also said that the SSC assignments will start from July 18 and the HSC from July 26. Two 24-hour SSC assignments and 30-hour HSC assignments will be taken every week.

Headline_English: Afghan forces vs. Taliban, who is ahead in military power?
Content_Enlish:
Despite the sophisticated weapons and US training, the Afghan defense system has collapsed like a house of cards in front of the Taliban. The United States has spent about six billion dollars to rebuild the Afghan army. Commando units and an air force have been created. However, in contrast to the abundant money, training, and state-of-the-art technology, the Taliban is creating terror with relatively old military equipment. 

Last month, the surrender of Afghan soldiers to the Taliban caused a stir. Many fled to neighboring Tajikistan, fearing Taliban attacks. 
The Afghan military is cornered in the face of the Taliban's imminent attacks. In almost every region, the Afghan defense system is collapsing like a house of cards. As a result, a significant part of the country is now under the control of the Taliban. 

The Afghan army currently has three hundred thousand members. It has medium and long-range artillery, armored vehicles, and UAVs. The Afghan army uses the same military equipment used by the United States. There are also commando units. In addition, the Afghan army has 167 aircraft, including fighter jets and helicopters. 

Over the past few years, the Afghan military has been under US leadership to rebuild. The Afghan military was newly formed, consisting of the army, police and intelligence agencies, and the US armed forces were primarily responsible for training it. A large part of the reconstruction of Afghanistan is spent on reorganizing the country's military. Last year, about six billion dollars were spent on this sector. 

On the other hand, the Taliban has about 85,000 members. The group's annual expenditure is about one and a half billion dollars. The Taliban is mainly run through drug trafficking, extortion, as well as financial assistance from various countries. In addition to Soviet-era tanks, the group also has various armored vehicles captured from the Afghan forces. The group also has short-range artillery. 
Despite training and modern weapons, the Afghan forces' helpless surrender to the Taliban is mainly seen as a lack of coordination and corruption. Analysts say that in addition to the morale crisis among Afghan troops, there are ethnic divisions and conflicts.

Headline_English: Parimoni granted bail on a bond of 50,000 taka
Content_Enlish:
The court has granted bail to the popular actress of Dhaka cinema, Parimoni, until the police file a charge sheet in a drug case on a bond of 50,000 taka. Dhaka Metropolitan Sessions Judge KM Imrul Kayes gave the order on Tuesday (August 31) afternoon. 
During the bail hearing, Parimoni's lawyer Mujibur Rahman said that the law enforcement agencies could not uncover any information after the 7-day remand. There was no evidence to prove whether the items recovered from Parimoni's house were drugs. She is physically ill. Her physical condition has deteriorated due to being on remand. 

He also said that we told the court that women will get a privilege under Section 47 of the Narcotics Control Act. Since the accused Parimoni is a woman and she is known and has a name in the country and abroad, her work schedule is being ruined. She has already been in jail for 26 days in this case, due to which she has been remanded three times but no factual evidence has been found against her. For this reason, we had informed the learned court about granting Parimani bail. The learned court has granted it. 

State lawyer Abdullah Abu opposed the bail application and said, Parimani could not prove the legality of the drugs recovered from the house. The dangerous drug LSD was found there. A lot of empty bottles were seized. Parimani opened the door after wasting an hour in the operation. During this time, many liquor bottles were emptied. Everyone is equal in the eyes of the law. That is why the state opposed the bail. 
On August 22, Parimani's lawyer applied for bail in the Dhaka Metropolitan Sessions Judge's Court. The court fixed September 13 for the hearing. Parimani's lawyer went to the High Court on this matter. On the orders of the High Court, the judge fixed August 31 for the hearing of Parimani's bail. 

Earlier, the Metropolitan Sessions Judge's Court had fixed September 13 for the hearing of Parimani's bail application, which was arrested in a drug case, after 21 days. The High Court issued a rule on Thursday asking why the order should not be declared null and void. At the same time, the rule also asked why the hearing of the bail application should not be brought forward (before September 13) and ordered to do so within two days. 

On August 4, RAB arrested actress Porimani from her Banani house with foreign liquor. After that, the police took Porimani on three remands for seven days and interrogated her.

Headline_English: Vaccine sales are being investigated
Content_Enlish: The issue of vaccine sales is being investigated. If anyone from the Directorate General of Health Services is involved in this, action will be taken against them. Director General of the Directorate General of Health Services, Professor Dr. Abul Bashar Muhammad Khurshid Alam, said this. After visiting various hospitals in the capital (Sunday, August 22), the Director General also said that people's interest in getting vaccinated has increased, which has created a bottleneck in vaccination. The number of booths at the centers will be increased to clear the bottleneck. He said that the number of vaccination centers will also be increased if necessary.

Headline_English: The conversation with Shakib where Mahmudullah dreamed of winning
Content_Enlish:
Bangladesh shamed Australia into losing the series by winning a breathtaking match. Bangladesh cricketers took control of the match, which had repeatedly slipped away due to team performance. Many did not think that Bangladesh would win the match with a low run target. However, Shakib Mahmudullah had the dream. The Bangladesh captain spoke about that conversation after the match. Mahmudullah said, Bangladesh captain Mahmudullah said, we were confident before we went to bowl. I spoke to Shakib before going to the field. He and I believed that defending this run was not a problem for us. We just have to take wickets in time. I think the boys did that and turned around in time. 
Tiger captain Mahmudullah Riyad expressed his excitement after the match after winning three consecutive matches and an incredible series win against Australia. The captain gave credit to the cricketers for taking control in time when the match needed it. The captain gave special credit to Mustafizur Rahman, one of the heroes of the match. He said, Mustafiz was unstoppable tonight. He bowled well today. 

Although Bangladesh's ranking in T20 is not good, Bangladesh is a balanced team, Mahmudullah said, Bangladesh is good as a team but the ranking is not good. We played this series with courage from that thought. We had planned to do well in T20 from the beginning. We won by using our skills and experience. 

Earlier, in the third T20 of the five-match series with Australia at the Sher-e-Bangla National Cricket Stadium in Mirpur, Bangladesh won the toss and batted and scored 127 runs for 9 wickets. Chasing the target, Australia was bowled out for 117 runs after losing 4 wickets. With this, Bangladesh created history by winning a series with Australia for the first time with a 10-run win.

Headline_English: Fuel prices rise amid severe crisis in Lebanon
Content_Enlish:
Amid the ongoing fuel crisis in Lebanon, the country's government has announced a price hike. The decision came after the government reduced subsidies in the fuel sector. Last Saturday (August 21), the country's authorities confirmed a 66 percent increase in the price of essential fuel. Following this announcement, the army has been deployed at petrol pumps to maintain order. 
Meanwhile, miles upon miles of roads in the capital Beirut have been blocked by thousands of vehicles. The same is true in surrounding areas. This impasse has been created due to a lack of fuel. The Middle Eastern country has been facing a severe fuel crisis for some time due to the impact of US sanctions and the black market.

Headline_English: Sylhet Agricultural University starts graduation exams from September
Content_Enlish:
Sylhet Agricultural University's undergraduate examinations are going to start from September. On August 1, the 'Proposed Policy for Conducting Examinations in Online Mode' was presented to the 38th Academic Council online and was unanimously passed. As a result, undergraduate examinations are going to start from September at the university. However, internship examinations and postgraduate examinations can be taken according to the university's existing policies or in the proposed online method in compliance with health regulations. 

The council was held under the chairmanship of the university's Vice-Chancellor Professor Dr. Md. Matiar Rahman Howlader. At the beginning of the council, the university's Vice-Chancellor offered prayers for all those who died in the tragic August, including Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman, and expressed condolences to his family. 

It is worth noting that due to the Corona pandemic, educational institutions have been closed across the country for about a year and a half as per the government decision. Even though teachers continued classes online, it was not possible to conduct examinations. Therefore, the university's Academic Council formulated this policy for conducting examinations online.

Headline_English: Corona vaccine can be inhaled through the nose! Trial to be held in Bangladesh
Content_Enlish:
Scientists in Sweden are in the process of discovering a corona vaccine that does not require a syringe needle to be inserted, but can be pulled through the nose. They claim that this vaccine will protect against all variants of the coronavirus. If approved, this innovative vaccine will also be trialed in Bangladesh. An agreement has been reached for this purpose. 

This vaccine has already been applied to animals in Sweden. Scientists have said that it has been 100 percent successful there. Now the last step is waiting for application in humans. For this, the researchers have chosen Bangladesh as a partner. Two renowned doctors from this country, Professor Dr. ABM Abdullah and Professor Dr. Ahmedul Kabir, will be the main researchers to conduct this groundbreaking research. 
Jamuna News spoke to these two doctors. UGC Professor Dr. ABM Abdullah said that it is still in the initial stage. Subject to approval, we will move forward later. Expatriate doctors are supporting us in this process. 

Calling this research a 'game changer', Professor of Medicine and Principal of Mugda Medical College, Professor Dr. Ahmedul Kabir told Jamuna News, "If we get permission from the Bangladesh Medical Research Council (BMRC), we will conduct human trials. We are hopeful that it will be very effective. If such a vaccine is successful, it will be a big step in combating Corona." 

He said, the vaccine recipients will be able to take it very easily themselves. They will not have to go to the center and stand in long lines. Many measures have to be taken to preserve the conventional vaccine. It does not cost much. It can be preserved very easily. 

Sweden's Karolinska University has researched and discovered this vaccine. Stating that the matter has not been disclosed for the last 3 months due to a 'non-disclosure agreement', Dr. Ahmedul Kabir said, "This is a very big discovery. We will apply for the trial this month itself. All the research protocols and preparations have been completed from our side. Now we are waiting for the approval of the BMRC." Once it is received, it will be applied to volunteers.

Headline_English: Appeal for emergency food supplies and assistance in Afghanistan
Content_Enlish:
The World Food Programme (WFP) has appealed for $200 million in emergency assistance to provide food to Afghanistan. 

The UN Food and Agriculture Organisation (FAO) warned on Tuesday (August 24) of a looming food crisis in the country. It said food is currently being delivered to Afghanistan through four alternative routes due to restrictions at Kabul International Airport. However, the stockpiled food will start to run out next month. 

The WFP is currently using border crossings in Uzbekistan, Pakistan and Turkmenistan to deliver food to various parts of Afghanistan. However, only 50 percent of the food is being taken to Afghanistan. The WFP fears that 20 million people in the country will soon need emergency assistance. 

About 18.5 million people in Afghanistan are already dependent on foreign aid. And the number will increase due to the ongoing drought in the country. 

"The Afghan people currently need 20,000 metric tons of food," said Andrew Patterson, the World Food Programme's (WFP) deputy regional director. "But only 7,000 metric tons are on the way. We need another 54,000 metric tons of food for the Afghan people by December. The food stockpiles could start running out by September. Therefore, I am appealing to the international community to approve an emergency food assistance fund of $200 million on an urgent basis."

Headline_English: US weapons in Taliban hands
Content_Enlish:
A month ago, the Afghan Defense Ministry posted pictures of seven new helicopters on social media, which it said were from the United States. With the political change, not only those helicopters, but also American guns, fighter jets, night-vision goggles, and even bulletproof vests are now in the hands of the Taliban. After sending the helicopters, US Defense Secretary Lloyd Austin told Reuters from the Pentagon that more such assistance would be provided to the Afghan forces. 

Now, in a matter of weeks, the Taliban have seized all the US weapons that Afghan soldiers abandoned and fled. 

A video shows Taliban members standing in front of a convoy of armored vehicles after the fall of the Kabul government, checking out new weapons. They also included drones. 

A US military official said that all the weapons that were not destroyed are now in the hands of the Taliban. 

Several former and current US military officials have expressed concern that these weapons could fall into the hands of the Taliban. They said that these weapons could be used on innocent and civilian people. In addition, they commented that the United States could also be attacked if these weapons fall into the hands of organizations like the Islamic State. They said that the Biden administration is working to control the issue. 

Another military official said that they do not know the exact number of these weapons. However, the United States has provided the Afghan military with weapons worth 28 billion taka. These include guns, rockets, night vision goggles, drones for intelligence surveillance. Along with this, there are more than 40 US-60 Black Hawk helicopters, Scout attack helicopters and Sky Eagle military drones. 

Michael McCaul, a member of the US House of Representatives Foreign Affairs Committee, said that we have already seen American weapons snatched from Afghan forces by Taliban fighters. This is a major threat to us and our allies 

Retired US General Joseph Votel said that the weapons that have fallen into the hands of the Taliban do not contain sensitive technology. So in most cases, it can be said that they are now worth displaying as trophies. 

However, General Votel and other officials say that the weapons that the Taliban have obtained, such as machine guns and mortars, will be useful in their fight.

Headline_English: National poet Kazi Nazrul's 45th death anniversary today
Content_Enlish:
Today is Bhadra 12. The 45th death anniversary of Bangladesh's national poet Kazi Nazrul Islam. The childhood pain of Miai became a famous rebel poet of the subcontinent in his youth. In his only 22-year writing career, he has occupied a unique place in Bengali literature with 3,000 songs, countless poems, short stories and novels. 

The name of a unique creative talent is Kazi Nazrul Islam. He is a poet, writer, lyricist, playwright and film actor at the same time. He roamed freely in various branches of art. 

This short-lived talent was born on the 11th of the 1306th day of the Bengali calendar in the village of Churulia in Asansol, Burdwan district, West Bengal, India. He struggled in every aspect of his life during his childhood, adolescence and youth. He was involved in various professions. He joined the army in 1917. He participated in the First World War. In 1922, he published the Dhumketu magazine. Nazrul was given one year of rigorous imprisonment for the poem 'Anandamayir Agamne'. The poet also acted in the film 'Dhruv', which he directed. 

Nazrul lost his speech in 1942. In 1972, Bangabandhu poet Nazrul was brought to independent Bangladesh with his family. He was given the status of National Poet. 

On 12 Bhadra, 1383 B.E., the late Kazi Nazrul Islam died at the then PG Hospital.

Headline_English: 7 people burnt in gas line explosion in Mirpur
Content_Enlish:
Seven people, including a woman and a child, were burnt in a gas line explosion in the capital's Mirpur. They have been admitted to the Sheikh Hasina National Burn and Plastic Surgery Institute. The condition of four of the burnt people is said to be critical. 

At 11:30 pm on Wednesday, a fire suddenly broke out in the riser of the gas line on the ground floor of a 5-storey building in Section 11 of Mirpur. Before anyone knew it, an explosion occurred. Later, three units of the fire service reached the spot and brought the fire under control. 
In an instant, the main door of the building was twisted. The glass of the door and window broke and the wall of the ground floor room collapsed. In an instant, the neatly arranged house was burnt to ashes. Seven people, including a 5-year-old child, Nausheen, were burnt. 

The owner of the house said that there was a problem with the building's gas line for several days. Although it was repaired by a mechanic several times, it was not completely fixed. After 11 pm on Wednesday, the mechanic came again to repair the gas connection. After finishing the work, the mechanic lit a match to check for any leakage, when the explosion occurred. 

It is learned that three of the burned people are from the same family. They were quickly rescued and taken to the Sheikh Hasina Burn Institute. All four of the injured are in the ICU. 

Pallabi Police Station SI Nasir Uddin said that there was no gas in the house for a few days. Tonight, the gas pressure in the line suddenly increased. At that time, the owner of the house and himself were cleaning the gas riser. Suddenly, it exploded and caught fire. Seven people were burned. Later, the fire service was informed and brought the fire under control. 

The fire service says that although the explosion was said to have occurred due to a gas leakage, the real cause will be known only after an investigation. 

Eyewitnesses and police said that the fire service quickly reached the spot after receiving the news of the accident, but no one from the Titas gas line was immediately found. Two hours later, a Titas Gas employee went to the spot.

Headline_English: Movement of people and vehicles increases in the capital on the 12th day of lockdown
Content_Enlish:
After the opening of industries and factories, the movement of people and vehicles has increased in the capital. Along with the increase in the pressure of private cars on the main roads of the capital on Tuesday morning, rickshaws have become the rule. Most of those who used public transport are now using rickshaws to reach their destinations. As usual, there are police check posts at every intersection. 
Law enforcement officials say that those who have gone out without urgent need are being questioned. If they cannot show a logical reason, fines and cases are being filed. 

Meanwhile, the movement of people heading towards Dhaka has also increased at the entrances of the capital. They are coming to Dhaka in small vehicles and pick-ups.

Headline_English: Fearsome August 21: Candles lit 'We are the children of freedom fighters'
Content_Enlish:
Today, on August 21, leaders and activists of the 'Amra Muktijoddhaar Suntan' organization lit candles in the first hour in memory of the victims. 

A 24-minute silence was observed in front of the Awami League central office on Bangabandhu Avenue from 12:01 am to 1:25 am. 
At this time, the leaders and activists demanded the speedy implementation of the verdict in the grenade attack case. They said that the attack was carried out with the support of the then government. They demanded speedy trial of the accused.

Headline_English: Notification issued canceling the state titles of 4 killers of Bangabandhu
Content_Enlish:
The Ministry of Liberation War Affairs issued a notification in this regard on Sunday. 
The four whose titles and medals have been canceled are Shariful Haque Dalim, Nur Chowdhury, Rashed Chowdhury and Mosleh Uddin. 

Earlier on Wednesday, the Liberation War Affairs Minister said that the decision to cancel the state titles and medals of the four murderers of Bangabandhu has been finalized. You will get the information when the gazette is published in this regard. I do not want to comment before that. 

On February 9, the 72nd meeting of the National Freedom Fighters Council (JAMUKA) recommended the cancellation of the state titles of the four self-confessed murderers of BNP founder Ziaur Rahman and Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman. 

After independence, Ziaur Rahman was given the state title of 'Bir Uttam' for his contribution to the Liberation War. Besides, Shariful Haque Dalim was awarded the title of 'Bir Uttam', Noor Chowdhury 'Bir Bikram', Rashed Chowdhury 'Bir Protik' and Mosleh Uddin 'Bir Protik'. The Awami League is claiming that Ziaur Rahman is behind this murder.

Headline_English: Allegations of Chhatra League attack on Chhatra Dal procession on Dhaka University campus
Content_Enlish:
A clash broke out between Chhatra Dal and Chhatra League on the Dhaka University campus. The clash took place near the DU Student-Teacher Center. During this, the Chhatra League is accused of snatching the Chhatra Dal banner and setting it on fire.

The organization claims that Chhatra League attacked a pre-announced program of Chhatra Dal on Sunday (August 29). However, Chhatra League has denied this allegation, saying it has no connection with the incident.

Chhatra Dal took out a protest procession from the Central Shahid Minar demanding the release of recently arrested Chhatra Dal leaders Saif Mahmud Jewel and Mashiur Rahman Rony. The attack occurred when the procession reached the TSC of Dhaka University.

Dhaka University Chhatra Dal convener Rakibul Islam Rakib said that they could not initially identify anyone as they were wearing helmets. However, the attackers were people from the Metropolitan Chhatra League and Awami League. They were about 50 people. However, he also said that Chhatra Dal has the capacity to resist them and give a befitting reply.

Several Chhatra Dal leaders and activists were reportedly injured in the clash. Among the injured was Dhaka University Chhatra Dal member secretary Md. Aman Ullah Aman.

Headline_English: There is no precedent of Zia firing on Pakistani forces: PM
Content_Enlish:
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has said that there is no precedent for Ziaur Rahman firing on Pakistani forces during the Liberation War. 

She made the remarks while virtually joining a discussion meeting of the Chhatra League on the occasion of National Mourning Day on Tuesday (August 31). 

The Prime Minister said that Ziaur Rahman was the main source of strength for Bangabandhu's killers. He was in constant contact with the killers. Zia betrayed Bangabandhu. He knew about the conspiracy to kill Bangabandhu in advance. After coming to power, the BNP wanted to erase the name of the Father of the Nation.

Headline_English: Courtesy call by Indian Lok Sabha Speaker to Bangladesh Speaker
Content_Enlish: Speaker of the National Assembly of Bangladesh Dr. Shirin Sharmin Chowdhury MP and Speaker of the Lok Sabha of India Om Birla held a courtesy call on each other today at the Inter-Parliamentary Union (IPU) venue in Vienna, the capital of Austria. During the meeting, they discussed issues related to bilateral interests, including the development of inter-country relations, parliamentary diplomacy of the two countries, the prevailing Covid-19 situation, the expansion of trade and commerce, and the expansion of mutual cooperative broadcasting of Lok Sabha TV and Sangsad TV. Speaker Dr. Shirin Sharmin Chowdhury said that India and Bangladesh are genuine friends. The cooperation and support that the Government of India and the people of India provided to Bangladesh in the great Liberation War of 1971 is heartwarming. Bangladesh-India bilateral relations have always been exceptional due to the cooperation during the Liberation War. Honorable Prime Minister Narendra Modi of India visited Bangladesh on the Golden Jubilee of Independence and the birth centenary of Father of the Nation Sheikh Mujibur Rahman, which will be memorable. Dr. Shirin Sharmin Chowdhury further said that India and Bangladesh are genuine friends in every field of business, trade, communication, culture, etc. The officials of the Bangladesh National Parliament receive training in the Indian Lok Sabha, which has been disrupted due to the Covid-19 situation. Dr. Shirin Sharmin Chowdhury mentioned that the Parliament Television of Bangladesh and the Lok Sabha Television of India can enrich themselves further by exchanging mutual experiences. The Speaker of the Lok Sabha of India, Mr. Om Birla, said that under the leadership of Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina, Bangladesh has achieved unprecedented socio-economic progress. The economic capacity of women in Bangladesh, including women's empowerment, has increased manifold. At this time, the Speaker of the Lok Sabha expressed his intention to work together on any issue in the future. When Om Birla invited him on the occasion of the 100th anniversary of the Government Accounts Committee of India, Speaker Dr. Shirin Sharmin Chowdhury thanked him. If it is not possible to participate as there is an International Peace Conference in Bangladesh on the same day, the Speaker of Bangladesh expressed his hope to visit India at a convenient time in the future.

Headline_English: Recommendation to suspend Khaleda Zia's sentence for another 6 months
Content_Enlish:
The Law Ministry has recommended a six-month suspension of BNP Chairperson Khaleda Zia's sentence. Law Minister Anisul Islam told Jamuna Television on Saturday (September 11) night. 
Khaleda Zia's suspension of sentence ends on September 24. A few days ago, her elder brother Shamim Iskandar applied to the Home Ministry for release. In that context, the Home Ministry was asked to seek the opinion of the Law Ministry. The Law Ministry sent its opinion last Tuesday. 

Khaleda Zia is serving a prison sentence in the case of embezzlement of funds from Zia Orphanage and Zia Charitable Trust. After being convicted on February 8, 2018, she was treated under prison conditions several times. Last year, she was granted conditional bail amid the coronavirus pandemic.

Headline_English: Metrorail goods theft, 5 arrested
Content_Enlish: Pallabi police have arrested five members of an organized gang in connection with the theft of goods used in the metro rail. According to information provided by the metro rail project authority, they were arrested in a raid in the Pallabi police station area. 1 ton 354 kg of stolen goods and 3 trucks were seized in the raid. The arrested are Dulal Hossain, Delwar Hossain, Hasmat Bepari, Robin and Anwar Hossain. During interrogation, they said that they had been stealing various materials from the under-construction line of the metro rail project. According to the police, they used to supply these materials to an iron factory for conversion.

Headline_English: Everyone should have a picture of Father of the Nation Bangabandhu in their home: State Minister for Information
Content_Enlish: State Minister for Information and Broadcasting Dr. Murad Hasan has requested that everyone keep a picture of Father of the Nation Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman in their homes. He spoke about this in his room at the Secretariat on Tuesday (September 14) afternoon. Out of respect for the Father of the Nation Mahatma Gandhi, the citizens of that country keep his picture. The picture of the Father of the Nation Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman, the architect of independent Bangladesh, should also be in everyone's home. The State Minister for Information said that everyone who lives in Bangladesh, who is a Bengali, should have a picture of Father of the Nation Bangabandhu in their home. Not as a minister, not as an MP, but as a citizen, as a Bengali, my call, my request is that everyone should have a picture of the Father of the Nation in their home. The State Minister also said that there has been no such announcement by issuing a state notification or by making a law in the National Parliament, but I personally want Bangabandhu's picture to be in everyone's home, regardless of party affiliation.

Headline_English: Army Chief to pay official visit to US at invitation of US Army
Content_Enlish: Army Chief General SM Shafiuddin Ahmed will leave Dhaka for the United States on an official visit on Saturday (September 11) at 1:40 am. He is going to the United States at the invitation of the US Army to attend the 'Indo-Pacific Army Chiefs Conference (IPACC)-2021' to be held in Hawaii, USA. This year's IPACC is being held jointly by the US Indo-Pacific Command and the Papua New Guinea Defense Force, where senior leaders from 17 countries in the Indo-Pacific region will participate. This year's IPACC will discuss the future operational environment. General SM Shafiuddin Ahmed will also participate in bilateral meetings with army chiefs of different countries at the conference. It is expected that the relations between the Indo-Pacific countries and the Bangladesh Army will be further strengthened and the potential for mutual cooperation will increase through this visit of the Army Chief. After the visit, he will return to the country on September 18, 2021.

Headline_English: Rabindranath Tagore's painting sold for 5 crores
Content_Enlish:
A painting by Rabindranath Tagore was auctioned by Christie's auction house. The painting was sold for five crore taka. News Anandabazar. 

The painting is mentioned as 'Couple' on the Christie's auction house website. However, who bought it was not revealed. 

The auction house had earlier informed that they expected the painting to sell for between 88 lakhs and 13 crore taka. According to the company's website, this painting, measuring 22.8 inches long and 20 inches wide, is slightly larger in size than most of Rabindranath's paintings. The world poet painted this painting in 1930 or a few days before that. Rabindranath brought several of his paintings with him during his trip to Europe in 1930. They were exhibited at the 'Gallery Pigalle' in Paris. The painting was bought from Rabindranath by a German couple, Friedrich and Edith Andre. Their descendants gave the painting to the auction house. The painting was included in the most recent auction of Christie's New York branch's 'South Asian Modern and Contemporary Art' section.

Headline_English: Human lifespan is actually 150 years, not 60-70, says research
Content_Enlish:
We start counting down the days until we reach 60. Although people usually live up to 60-70 years, that is not the end of human life, a study published in the 'Royal Society Open Science Journal' claims. The American science magazine 'Scientific American' has also published a report on this. 
The main subject of this study was to find out how long humans can live the most. In order to find the answer to this question, researchers examined the data of more than 1,000 men and women aged 105-110 years in 13 countries. They also reached this conclusion by looking at all the information related to the life expectancy of different ages in the last 60 years. 
Research says that if we do not die due to any accident and can keep our lifestyle healthy and normal, then it is very easy to live up to 130-150 years. Basically, anyone can live a long life if they are aware of their health from the age of 30-40. However, in reality, there is no limit to human life expectancy. 

In fact, as we age, our body cells start to weaken. Along with this, due to unhealthy lifestyle, we are plagued by diabetes and various heart-related diseases. In addition, there is currently polluted air or environmental pollution. Even in this, if healthy eating habits and a healthy lifestyle can be developed, then this research believes that our life expectancy will increase due to fewer diseases. 
There are also examples of this. Compared to other parts of the world, the life expectancy of people in Japan is relatively longer. This is because of their lifestyle. The French woman who lived the longest in modern human history was Jeanne Calment. She died in 1997 at the age of 122. The character of the second incident is Kane Tanaka from Japan. Who is now 118 years old and still looks fresh. So you can also live a hundred years if you want.

Headline_English: Changes coming to DU first-year admission test distribution
Content_Enlish:
The schedule for the Dhaka University admission test, which has been repeatedly postponed due to the Corona pandemic, has been set. The test will be held in eight centers across the country, including Dhaka University, on October 1. Earlier, the test was held only at DU, but this time such a decision has been taken due to Corona. There has also been a change in the distribution of the test results. Until now, the merit list of students was determined based on a total of 200 marks. Of these, 120 admission test marks and the sum of the marks obtained out of 80 marks based on the SSC and HC GPA were used to prepare the merit list. 
However, this time the standard set for evaluating students has been set at 100. Of these, 20 marks will be taken from the SSC and HSC GPA results. The remaining 80 marks will be tested. Out of that, 50 marks will be written and 30 marks will be MCQ tests. 

For the first time, the DU admission test is going to be held outside Dhaka. Only the Dhaka Division students will be in the Dhaka University area. The centers for other departments are Rajshahi University for students of Rajshahi division, Chittagong University for students of Chittagong division, Khulna University for students of Khulna division, Begum Rokeya University for students of Rangpur division, Shahjalal University of Science and Technology for students of Sylhet division, Barisal University for students of Barisal division and students of Mymensingh division will take the admission test at the Bangladesh Agricultural University center.

Headline_English: Prime Minister calls for urgent action to address climate change threats
Content_Enlish:
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has called on world leaders to take bold and strong steps to address the threat of climate change. 
She made this call at a closed-door meeting of heads of state and government on the issue of climate change at the UN headquarters. The Prime Minister also presented six proposals to world leaders to overcome the crisis. She said that the Paris Agreement must be strictly implemented to keep global temperature increase below 1.5 degrees Celsius. Sheikh Hasina also urged developed countries to raise $100 billion annually. The Prime Minister also highlighted the importance of transferring environmentally friendly green technology to developing countries. The Prime Minister urged rich countries to come forward to help displaced people. 

Meanwhile, Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina received a special honor at the 9th International Conference on Sustainable Development. The SDG honor certificate was presented to the Prime Minister at the Permanent Office of Bangladesh to the UN in New York. The Prime Minister dedicated this achievement to the people of Bangladesh. 

The Prime Minister said that the success of the Sustainable Development Goals depends on overcoming the pandemic situation. The Prime Minister emphasized on ensuring vaccines for all in the current situation. He said that many poor countries do not have the ability to afford vaccines. Vaccines must be made readily available in those countries.

Headline_English: India and Pakistan engaged in a war of words at the UN session
Content_Enlish:
The Indian representative responded. He said that Pakistan has been providing support, shelter and financial assistance to terrorism worldwide. Pakistani Prime Minister Imran Khan did not attend the 76th session of the United Nations in person. His recorded speech was played. In his speech, there were various allegations against the eternal enemy India. Imran said that New Delhi is carrying out extrajudicial killings including repression against Muslims in Kashmir. The Pakistani Prime Minister called on the world community to take initiative to protect peace in Kashmir and the human rights of the Kashmiris. 

Pakistani Prime Minister Imran Khan said that the ruling party of India, BJP, is spreading Islamophobia and hateful Hindutva ideology. They have become a cause of terror for 20 million Muslims in India. The peace of Kashmir is being constantly destroyed, and the freedom of the Kashmiris is being interfered with. 

The Indian representative to the United Nations immediately reacted to Imran Khan's speech. Islamabad has been repeatedly misusing the UN General Assembly to spread false and hateful propaganda against India. 

Sneha Dubey, India's UN representative, said that Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh are an integral part of India. These regions were, are and will remain the same. Pakistan is a country that not only shelters and finances terrorists, but also openly supports them. Sneha alleged that Pakistan is trying in vain to divert the world's attention from its own miseries, including terrorism.

Headline_English: South Korea to ban eating dog meat
Content_Enlish:
Eating dog meat is an old custom in South Korea. At least one million dogs are eaten there every year. But President Moon Jae-in has suggested stopping this custom. The British news outlet The Guardian recently confirmed this news. 
President Moon Jae-in asked South Korean Prime Minister Kim Boo-kyum during a weekly meeting on Monday (September 27) whether the time has not come to ban the consumption of dog meat in the country. 
Animal rights activists in the country have been demanding a ban on the consumption of dog meat for a long time. For this, they have been pressuring the country's government. Now, after the president's statement, the demand to stop the consumption of dog meat in the country has become stronger. Incidentally, animal husbandry has been increasing in South Korea recently. Many people keep dogs at home. President Moon is among them. He also loves dogs. There are several dogs in the presidential palace.

Headline_English: Writ filed against 14 students who had their hair cut, seeking compensation of Tk 2 million each
Content_Enlish:
A writ petition has been filed in the High Court seeking directions as to why each victim should not be given Tk 20 lakh in compensation for the incident of 14 students being cut off by a Rabindra University teacher. The writ petition was filed by the 'Law and Life Foundation' on Wednesday (September 29). Lawyers Barrister Mohammad Humayon Kabir Pallab and Barrister Mohammad Kausar filed the writ on behalf of the foundation. The hearing is likely to be held tomorrow (September 30) on Thursday before the bench of Justice Md. Mujibur Rahman Mia and Justice Md. Kamrul Hossain Mollah. The writ petition states that the punishment meted out to 14 students by cutting their hair is not only illegal but also extremely humiliating for the students. Unable to bear this humiliation, one of them chose to commit suicide. Fortunately, he is still alive. 

The 'Law and Life Foundation' has filed a writ petition seeking directions on why such punishment of 14 students should not be imposed without authority, why departmental action should not be taken against the three accused teachers, why the officer-in-charge of the concerned police station and the District Superintendent of Police should not be ordered to investigate the matter and take legal action, and why compensation of Tk 20 lakh should not be given to each of the said students. 

A student is in critical condition in the hospital after an assistant proctor of Rabindra University in Sirajganj tried to commit suicide after cutting the hair of 14 students with scissors. The incident of cutting the hair of a citizen is extremely shameful, illegal and against fundamental rights.

Headline_English: 4.75 million people have died from coronavirus worldwide
Content_Enlish: The global death toll from the coronavirus pandemic has surpassed 4.75 million. Another 8,300 people died on Friday. Nearly 500,000 new cases of coronavirus have been identified. So far, more than 231,859,000 people have been infected with the coronavirus in the world. The United States is still at the top of the list of infections and deaths. The country has lost nearly 2,000 lives in the past 24 hours. More than 126,000 new cases of coronavirus have been identified. Another 828 people have died in Russia. On Friday, 750 people died in Mexico. Brazil also reported close to 700 deaths. South Africa saw more than 300 deaths today. Nearly 300 people died in India and Iran.

Headline_English: Campaign to stop buses and minibuses without route permits in Dhaka
Content_Enlish:
A drive is underway to stop the movement of buses and minibuses without route permits in the capital Dhaka. This drive is being carried out under the joint initiative of BRTA and Dhaka South City Corporation. 
The drive started from Gulistan area at 11 am on Sunday (October 3). The drive is being carried out in light of the decision of the 17th meeting of the Bus Route Rationalization Program to stop the movement of buses and minibuses without route permits. The mobile court and the joint drive are being led by DSCC Executive Magistrate Tanjila Kabir. At this time, transport without route permits is being fined. BRTA, DMP and DSCC officials are participating in the drive.

Headline_English: Japan's new Prime Minister Fumio Kishida
Content_Enlish: Fumio Kishida has been elected as Japan's new prime minister. The country's head of government has changed hands after just one year. Lawmakers voted him in as prime minister in a special session of parliament on Monday (October 4). The 60-year-old politician was foreign minister in the previous government. The new government will be sworn in today. Earlier, Yoshihide Suga resigned as prime minister last month amid criticism over his failure to deal with the pandemic, economic slowdown, unemployment and other issues. At the same time, he also resigned as head of the Liberal Democratic Party. Kishida took over last week. He is known as a reformist.

Headline_English: AL announces to be on the ground to prevent ongoing communal terrorism
Content_Enlish:
The ruling Awami League has announced to be on the ground to prevent the ongoing communal terrorism. The party's General Secretary Obaidul Quader said that these conspiracies will be prevented by taking the common people along with them. The announcement was made at the 'Harmony Rally and Peace Procession' program against communalism on Bangabandhu Avenue in the capital on Tuesday (October 19) morning. 
At that time, Awami League leaders said that a group is trying to disrupt the development and progress of the country. The leaders also warned that their attempt will not succeed. The party's associate organizations are also organizing the same program in all districts, metropolises and upazilas of the country. 

Chief guest Obaidul Quader at the program in Dhaka said that the law enforcement agencies are vigilant. Awami League General Secretary Obaidul Quader also warned that no one will be spared on this issue.

Headline_English: What the US said about the first meeting with the Taliban
Content_Enlish:
The United States has held its first meeting with the Taliban since Afghanistan fell under their control in August. The meeting of the US delegation with the Taliban in Doha ended on Sunday. The United States said that there were frank and professional discussions. However, the Taliban will be judged not by words, but by their actions. CNN reported. The US State Department released a statement about the meeting. It said that security, concerns about terrorism, and ensuring the safe return of citizens of other countries, including the United States, dominated the meeting. 
At the same time, human rights, including the participation and due dignity of women in all spheres of society, were also discussed. However, in this case, the United States once again stated that it will not be satisfied with words. The Taliban will have to prove themselves with deeds.

Headline_English: Eating milk and banana together has adverse effects on the body
Content_Enlish:
Milk and banana can be a great afternoon snack with a smoothie. Many people eat milk and bananas with milkshakes or oats. However, many experts now say that it is not right to eat milk and bananas together. Milk and bananas are two very nutritious foods separately. Bananas contain a lot of calcium and potassium. Bananas provide a lot of energy. Therefore, eating bananas keeps the stomach full for a long time. It is better to eat most fruits before evening. But many people eat bananas with dinner. Milk is a very important food. Protein and calcium are abundant in milk. But if milk and bananas are eaten together, it can create obstacles in the digestive process. Eating them together can also destroy all the nutrients of the two foods. 

Some people recommend mixing bananas with milk and drinking a shake. Others are against it. Some health experts are not at all in favor of eating bananas and milk together. If you want to eat them, you should drink milk first. After 20 minutes, you can eat a banana. However, drinking a milkshake of banana and milk can also affect your sleep. 

On the other hand, according to another group of health experts, a mixture of banana and milk is very beneficial for those who want to gain weight and do regular physical labor. However, if a person has a problem with phlegm accumulation or breathing problems due to asthma or any allergy, they should never eat banana and milk together.

Headline_English: Administration gave rotten relief during Puja, recipients returned it in anger
Content_Enlish:
The upazila administration has distributed relief to poor Hindus on the occasion of Durga Puja in Chilmari Upazila of Kurigram. However, among these relief items, rotten potatoes and rice and other items were of very poor quality. As a result, the recipients returned these relief items to the UNO office in anger. It is known that Durga Puja is being celebrated in 32 mandap of the upazila. As per the decision of the authorities, on the occasion of Durga Puja, food items including 10 kg rice, 3 kg potatoes, 1 kg chira and half kg pulses, sugar, oil were given to the extremely poor Hindu families on the basis of their applications by spending money from the revenue sector. On Monday (October 11), the upazila administration started distributing these food items to 160 families. 

However, the beneficiaries could not be happy despite receiving the assistance. They expressed their anger over the rotten relief items. They returned these relief items to the UNO office. 

Beneficiary Mukul Chandra said, "Are we not human beings just because we are poor?" Low-quality rice and rotten potatoes, palm oil was given instead of soybean oil. Rice and pulses were mixed together because the packets were not properly packaged. 

Upazila Parishad Chairman Shawkat Ali Sarkar Bir Bikram said that relief distribution has been stopped after finding out that there is low-quality rice and rotten potatoes. The quality of the relief will be checked and distributed to the rest. Upazila Nirbahi Officer Mahbubur Rahman said that there should not be low-quality rice and other items in the relief. However, he assured that he would look into the matter and take action.

Headline_English: DU admission test being held at Rajshahi University
Content_Enlish:
The admission test for the new academic year of Dhaka University (DU) is being held at Rajshahi University (RU). The exam for the Commerce Faculty of 'G' Unit will start at 11 am on Friday (October 22) and will continue till 12:30 pm. 1,577 candidates are participating in this exam. 

The authorities have banned all electronic devices except for the admit card and exam-related materials and documents in the exam room. During the exam, the entire campus including the exam room is being guarded by a four-tier security system and a mobile court is being operated. 

It is worth noting that DU's admission test is being held at RU for the fourth day. The 'G' Unit exam will be held here on October 23.

Headline_English: Gold in damaged mobile phones, a business worth 4.5 billion taka!
Content_Enlish:
All mobile phones contain gold. Not only gold, silver and copper are also used to make mobile phones. Gold is a good conductor of electricity. It does not corrode or rust. This is why gold is used in the small connectors of the integrated circuit (IC) board of mobile phones. 

However, it is true that there is very little gold in each mobile phone. But a lot of gold is collected from many discarded phones little by little. And a business worth crores of taka is run with it. 
Gold is used to make all kinds of mobile phones, from ordinary mobile phones to smartphones or iPhones. 

As per one estimate, each phone contains 34 to 50 milligrams of gold. You can hardly say how much gold is in a phone. But now, the rate at which the number of waste mobile phones is increasing, the amount of gold collected is huge. Focusing on this, the business of extracting precious metals like gold from waste mobile phones is going on in full swing. 

Where one gram of gold can be obtained from tons of garbage to collect gold from mines, one gram of gold can be obtained from 41 mobile phones. The average value of which in Bangladeshi currency is now six and a half thousand taka. According to that calculation, four and a half thousand crore taka of gold is obtained from discarded mobile phones every year in the world. 

The main reason for using gold in mobile phones is that this metal is a good conductor of electricity. Apart from gold, two other metals are good conductors of electricity. Silver and copper. Gold connectors in phones are also used for fast and accurate transfer of digital data. Like mobile phones, gold is also used in the ICs of computers and laptops. And in this way, a large amount of business is done with discarded mobile phones, laptops, etc.

Headline_English: Facebook service resumes after nearly 7 hours
Content_Enlish:
Finally, the social media platform Facebook has been launched. At the same time, the services of Facebook-owned Instagram and WhatsApp have also been resumed. 

On Monday (October 4), after 9:45 pm, suddenly, like other countries in the world, social media platforms Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp could not be accessed from Bangladesh through mobile and computer. After users entered Facebook, an error or browser connection error appeared on their device screens. Later, around 5 am, the sites started coming back. 

In this regard, a report by the British news media BBC said that these media have been down due to a long-term problem with the server. The platforms have not been working for several hours. Experts have also commented that it is quite rare for these three social media platforms to be down for such a long time. 

Meanwhile, Facebook tweeted on its Twitter account immediately after the service was launched. There, Facebook said, countless people and businesses around the world rely on us. We are sorry for this. We have tried to reactivate our apps and services and are happy to say that they are back up. Thank you for being with us. 

https://twitter.com/Facebook/status/1445155265360416773?s=20 

After the service was previously down, Facebook said on Twitter, "We know some of our customers are experiencing some issues using apps and other products. We're working to get everything back to normal as soon as possible. We apologize for the inconvenience." 

On the other hand, shortly after Instagram was launched, Head of Instagram Adam Moshari posted a photo on one of his Instagram IDs. The photo read, "Hello, is it back up?" 

And the caption of the post said, "We apologize for the service disruption today. We didn't mean to start the week like this. Instagram will be back slowly now."

Headline_English: 15 killed in military operation in Pakistan
Content_Enlish:
Fifteen members of the separatist organization have been killed in an army operation in Pakistan. Among them is a commander of the separatist organization Balochistan Liberation Army (BLA). This information has emerged in a report by the Indian media India News on Sunday (October 24). 

According to a report by the Indian media India News, the security forces had confirmed information about the location of foreign-funded and supported separatist terrorists. After surrounding those areas during the operation, the separatists started firing indiscriminately to escape. The security forces returned fire. 

Six people were killed in the operation in Harnai, Balochistan in the firing of the military. Among them is the commander of the separatist organization Balochistan Liberation Army (BLA), Tariq alias Nasir. The military recovered a huge amount of arms and ammunition from the scene. 

Separately, the provincial Counter Terrorism Department (CTD) conducted a separate anti-separatist operation in Mastung district of Balochistan, killing at least nine terrorists. All the killed in the two areas belonged to two banned outfits.

Headline_English: Attempted murder case filed against Cox's Bazar mayor, road blockade in protest
Content_Enlish:
A case of attempted murder has been filed against 15 people, including Cox's Bazar District Awami League General Secretary and Municipal Mayor Mujibur Rahman, at the police station. In protest, his supporters have blocked roads at various points in Cox's Bazar city since the evening. 
The case was filed on Sunday (October 31) afternoon. Sadar Model Police Station Case Number 53, Dated October 31, 2021. 

Cox's Bazar Sadar Model Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Sheikh Munir Ul Gias confirmed the filing of the case. He said that a case has been filed against 15 people, including Cox's Bazar Municipal Mayor and District Awami League General Secretary Mujibur Rahman, District Awami League Organizing Secretary Naznin Sarwar Kaberi, in the shooting of Munaf Sikder, former vice-president of Cox's Bazar District Chhatra League. 

Munaf Sikder's elder brother Md. Shahjahan filed the case as the plaintiff. 

It is worth mentioning that on Wednesday (October 27), around 9:30 pm, miscreants shot and killed former district Chhatra League vice-president Munaf Sikder and two others in the Sugandha area of ​​Cox's Bazar town and fled. Munaf Sikder's condition is critical and he has been sent to Chittagong Medical College Hospital.

Headline_English: Torch procession at DU against communal attacks
Content_Enlish:
General students of Dhaka University have taken out a torchlight procession against the ongoing communal attacks, violence and looting across the country. This torchlight procession program started from Dhaka University's TSC on Monday (October 18) evening. The procession, which started from TSC, circled various important roads of the campus and ended with a short rally at Raju Bhaskarya. 

At the rally, former DUCSU member and Chhatra League's Deputy Secretary for Social Service Tanvir Hasan Saikat said, Dhaka University students have come forward as saviors in any crisis and national disaster in the country. Therefore, during the ongoing communal violence, we, the students of Dhaka University, are taking out a torchlight procession to protest against the communal attacks. 

He also said, we demand the government to identify the masterminds, conspirators and attackers behind and in front of the communal violence as soon as possible and bring them to justice. We, the students of Dhaka University, will wear black badges for the next two days as a silent protest against the communal attacks. If strong action is not taken against the attackers as soon as possible, we will take to the field again.

Headline_English: Stock market unable to sustain foreign investment
Content_Enlish:
Foreign investment in the country's stock market is not being retained. Foreign investors are withdrawing much more than the amount of new investment they are making. This information is from the updated balance of payments report of Bangladesh Bank. Similar information was also found in the share transactions of last October. 
Net foreign investment in the stock market was withdrawn by 61 million dollars in the last July-September quarter. In those three months, expatriate Bangladeshis made a net investment of 32 million dollars, which was 70 million dollars in the same period of the last fiscal year. That is, the tendency of foreigners to withdraw investment is higher than that of expatriates. Shares of foreigners and expatriates increased in 32 companies listed last October, with a potential market value of 610 million taka. On the contrary, shares of 37 companies decreased, with a potential market value of about 250 million taka. 

Until 2019, the Dhaka Stock Exchange used to publish how much taka of shares foreigners bought and sold in each month.

Headline_English: Bank recruitment exam question leaked, 10 arrested
Content_Enlish:
Recently, candidates alleged that questions were leaked in the exams of five state-owned banks. But the Bankers Selection Committee and Bangladesh Bank had repeatedly denied it. However, the Dhaka Metropolitan Detective Police's initial investigation revealed the truth about the question leaks. In the meantime, the Dhaka Metropolitan Detective Police has arrested 10 people involved in the question leak ring. 

On Wednesday (November 10), Dhaka Metropolitan Police's Detective North Joint Commissioner Mohammad Harun-or-Rashid confirmed the matter to the media.
