He said that the detective police has started an investigation into the allegations of question leaks in the recruitment exams of some state-owned banks. A total of 10 people, including bank officials, university officials and students, have been arrested on charges of involvement in the question leaks. 

The recruitment exams for Sonali, Rupali, Janata, Agrani and Bangladesh Development Bank were held on November 6. One lakh 16 thousand 427 job seekers participated in the recruitment exams for 1 thousand 511 posts in those five banks. The preliminary examination for the recruitment of officers (cash) of five banks under the Bangladesh Bankers Selection Committee was held that day. It was on that day that the question paper was alleged to have been leaked. 

Many of the candidates have claimed that some of them had the question paper in advance. Some of them have also posted this information on social media and demanded to take the exam again.

Headline_English: Verdict in Abrar Fahad murder case tomorrow
Content_Enlish:
The verdict in the murder case of BUET student Abrar Fahad will be delivered tomorrow. Judge Abu Zafar Md. Kamruzzaman of Dhaka's Speedy Trial Tribunal-1 will announce the verdict tomorrow, Sunday (November 28). The testimony of 46 out of 60 witnesses in the case ended on March 4. Of the 25 accused, 22 who are in prison have testified in their defense. Claiming that the murder charges brought against the accused have been proven, Abrar's family and lawyers hope that the maximum punishment will be given. 
Abrar, while studying in the second year of the Department of Electrical Engineering, was tortured to death in the room of a Chhatra League leader on the night of October 6, 2019. Abrar Fahad's body was recovered from BUET's Sher-e-Bangla Hall in the early hours of October 7. The incident of beating a student to death in one of the country's leading educational institutions was widely criticized. After that, students and ordinary people from all over the country took to the field demanding punishment for the accused involved in this incident. After the student movement after Abrar's murder, BUET banned student politics on campus. 
On November 13, 2019, the police filed a charge sheet against 25 people. The court took it into account on January 21. On September 15, charges were framed against 25 accused. However, the trial has been repeatedly delayed due to the impasse created by the Corona pandemic, the re-framing of charges due to the state's mistake, and the defendant's distrust of the judge. 

The testimony of 46 out of 60 witnesses ended on March 4. And 22 accused in prison claimed their innocence and gave their defense testimony. As they were absconding, 3 accused did not get the opportunity to defend themselves. The trial ended on November 14. Abrar was supposed to graduate in April 2022. Therefore, the parents want that the classmates and older brothers who committed such a heinous act in school should be punished appropriately. Abrar's mother Rokeya Khatun said, "My appeal to everyone is that everyone should be given the maximum punishment." No other mother should have to suffer the pain of losing her child in the near future. 

Abrar's father Md. Barkat Ullah said, he would have passed in April 2022. But his hope was not fulfilled. Therefore, I would like this verdict to ensure the maximum punishment for all the accused. 

The state's lawyers claimed that they were able to prove all three charges of murder, premeditated murder, and participation in murder. State's lawyer Abu Abdullah Bhuiyan said, our demand from the state is to set an example by sentencing everyone to death as the maximum punishment. 

However, the defense lawyers expect justice from the court. Defense lawyer Faruk Ahmed said, there are often outsiders in the case. Therefore, the possibility of an outsider being responsible for this incident is very high. 
The charge sheet of the case states that the accused, in collusion with each other, made false, fabricated, and baseless allegations against Abrar, suspecting him of being a Shibir member, and brutally beat him to death. The chargesheet identifies Abrar's roommate Mizanur Rahman alias Mizan as the mastermind of the murder. Out of the 25 accused in the chargesheet, 19 are listed in the complaint and six are under investigation. In addition, eight of the accused have confessed to their guilt in court and given statements. Three accused in the case are absconding. They are BUET students Morsheduzzaman Jisan, Ehteshamul Rabbi Tanim and Mostaba Rafid. The rest are in jail.

Headline_English: Zika virus is increasing at an alarming rate in India
Content_Enlish:
The Zika virus outbreak is increasing at an alarming rate in the Indian city of Kanpur. So far, doctors have identified 79 people, including two children. On Saturday (November 7), the presence of the virus was found in the bodies of 13 people. In the meantime, the Uttar Pradesh administration has opened a separate department for Zika patients. Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath has expressed deep concern in this regard. He has ordered to intensify the extermination campaign in the areas identified as the origin of mosquitoes. 
Zika virus is mainly spread by Aedes mosquitoes. The infected patient has high fever, severe pain in the muscles of the head and body and a rash on the skin. In addition, the virus disrupts the brain and physical growth of the child, and children are born with deformed shapes. 

This year, a Zika outbreak occurred in the southern Indian state of Kerala.

Headline_English: Hasan Azizul Haque spent 67 years before writing his first novel, 'Agunpakhi'.
Content_Enlish:
Hasan Azizul Haque, one of the great figures of Bengali literature, has passed away. Although he was widely known as the prince of Bengali short stories, he also had a free rein in other fields of literature. However, he waited 67 years before publishing his first novel, 'Agunpakhi'.
Before that, he was asked in numerous interviews and conversations why he did not write a novel. That wait ended with the publication of 'Agunpakhi' in 2006. Half of the novel was published in the Eid issue of Prothom Alo in 2005 under the title 'Ap-Roopkatha'. The novel was published in 224 pages by Sandhani Publishing in February of the following year with a cover drawn by Qayyum Chowdhury. Due to the overwhelming response, the second printing of the book was published within four months. 'Agunpakhi' received the Ananda Award in 2008 along with the recognition of Prothom Alo as the best book of the year.

The novel is written in the narrative of a village woman of good character. The woman is the daughter of a conservative Muslim family, and the housewife of a large family of fifty-one. Like ten other village women, her life is confined within four walls. Her husbands are five brothers, their wives, sons, daughters, and a young widowed sister, and the large family of her in-laws. The heat of the family there torments her, but also the joy of prosperity overwhelms her. In the meantime, the sudden impact of the World War creates tension in their lives. The relationship of harmony and friendship begins to change. Then life begins to revolve around communalism and the turmoil of partition. In an interview given about this novel, this fiction writer said that he wrote the novel inspired by his mother's life. The influence of his family was noticeable throughout the novel. In this context, Hasan Azizul Haque said, 'I don't know whether the rest of our family, let alone most of our historians, have understood the way my mother logically expressed her regret about the meaninglessness of partition and the waste caused by it.'

Headline_English: Admission tests for seven colleges begin today
Content_Enlish:
Admission tests are starting today in seven government colleges affiliated to Dhaka University. The exams are being held for admission to the commerce unit in Dhaka College, Eden Women's College, Government Shaheed Suhrawardy College, Kabi Nazrul Government College, Begum Badrunnesa Government Women's College, Mirpur Bangla College and Government Titumir College for the academic year 2020-2021. The exams will start at 10 am and will continue till 11 am. This time the exam will be of 120 marks. There will be 100 marks in the main multiple-choice exam and a total of 20 marks based on the results of the SSC and HSC exams. 
This year, 95,622 candidates have applied for 26,160 seats in seven colleges. At least four candidates will compete for each seat this time. 

Then, the admission tests of the seven colleges will end with the admission tests of the science unit tomorrow, and the admission tests of the arts and social sciences unit on November 13.

Headline_English: US donates 18 freezer trucks to transport Covid vaccines
Content_Enlish:
The United States has donated 18 specialized trucks equipped with cold-chain systems to Bangladesh to safely and easily transport COVID-19 vaccines across the country. The total amount of COVID-19 assistance provided by the United States government to Bangladesh has exceeded 1,280 million taka ($121 million). Acting Deputy Chief of Mission (DCM) William Dowers and Mission Director of the United States Agency for International Development (USAID) Catherine Stevens handed over the trucks to the Minister of Health and Family Welfare of the Government of Bangladesh, Zahid Malek, on Monday, November 15. The initiative was fully funded by USAID. 
USAID has purchased four trucks from the local market and 14 more trucks will arrive in Dhaka in the coming months. USAID will be supported in this effort by the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (IFRC) and the Bangladesh Red Crescent Society. The agencies will oversee the procurement of vehicles as well as assist the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare in administering COVID-19 vaccines across the country. 
Acting DCM Dowers said, “The United States is pleased to be able to donate these new freezer trucks and continue our partnership with Bangladesh to overcome the COVID-19 pandemic. We hope that the impressive momentum that Bangladesh has achieved in curbing the spread of the pandemic will be sustained, as people protect themselves and their loved ones by getting vaccinated, so that everyone can return to a more normal life together. 

See more 
Kitchenware 
Online newspaper subscriptions 
Investigative reporting books 
The United States government, through USAID, the Department of Defense, the State Department, and the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, has provided 15 million doses of COVID-19 vaccines and more than Tk 10.28 billion to help Bangladesh combat the pandemic. 

This assistance has helped treat and save lives for people with COVID-19, as well as support national vaccination campaigns, strengthen testing capacity and monitoring, improve disease management, infection prevention and control practices, and improve and enhance supply chains and logistics management systems. U.S. assistance has also protected frontline workers and increased public knowledge and awareness about the disease, including ways to protect themselves from COVID-19. 

The United States has provided $4 billion or 3400 crore to support the global COVAX effort; including support for ultra-cold chain storage, transportation, and safe management of COVID-19 vaccines. This makes the United States the world’s largest donor to equitably deliver COVID-19 vaccines to people around the world.

Headline_English: Cancer patient's medicine is being used as a drug
Content_Enlish:
Narco-drugs Oxy-morphone. Morphone-like drugs are used to reduce patient pain before and after surgery. The company also has to account for the use of the raw materials of the drug to the government. Not only that, but a separate license is also required to sell this drug. There are strict restrictions on the import of the raw materials of the drug, production, purchase and sale. It is not allowed to be sold in any pharmacy. The Drug Administration and the Narcotics Control Department are responsible for supervising these. Ignoring all this, the drug is now being sold in the open market. Because, Oxy-morphone is now being used as a drug. The detective police have arrested two members of an organized gang with twenty thousand Oxy-morphone tablets during an investigation. Although the price of twenty tablets is four hundred taka, they were selling them for two to two and a half thousand taka. 
In Bangladesh, only one pharmaceutical company has permission to produce the drug. The drug is not sold without a specialist doctor's prescription in 120 shops in 15 districts of the country. Of these, 50 shops are in Barisal district. Investigations have found that oxy-morphone is coming to the open market from these pharmacies in Barisal. 

Rajib Al Masud, Deputy Commissioner of DB's Lalbagh Division, said that this drug gives a feeling of pleasure and does not feel pain. It is especially popular among students. We have already received the names of some universities. 

DMP Additional Commissioner M Hafiz Akhter said that this drug is given to cancer patients who are in the last stage. So that they can get temporary relief from pain. Only the Drug Administration and Narcotics Control Department can tell why this drug is available in such large quantities in Barisal. 

Those concerned with pharmaceutical technology have expressed concern after receiving news of this drug being used as a drug. The Police and experts have advised the Drug Administration and Narcotics Control Department to be more vigilant in this regard.

Headline_English: India warns China after receiving powerful warships
Content_Enlish:
A powerful missile destroyer warship has been added to the Indian Navy. The ship named INS Visakhapatnam is capable of destroying enemy warplanes, drones and even missiles. Delhi claims that the addition of this warship has given them more power to confront enemies on the sea route. After receiving the ship, Indian Defense Minister Rajnath Singh warned China and urged it to comply with the law of the sea. 

India has started the journey of this new missile destroyer warship to protect its maritime borders from the enemy. This ship, weighing about 7,500 tons, has all the latest defense systems. 
The Indian Navy says that the short-range ramjet supersonic cruise missile launched from it is capable of directly hitting any target in the sky. It can destroy missiles, drones and warplanes launched by the enemy. 

Navy Chief Admiral Karambir Singh says that out of their 41 ships and submarines, 39 are being built in their own shipyards. He also commented that this development is being seen by the whole world. As the Indian Navy, it will be a witness to our collective motivation. The Navy official also mentioned that today's achievement is the biggest example of this. 

The Indian Defense Minister inaugurated the ship equipped with 16 Brahmos missiles on Sunday. At the time, he pointed at China and said that the days of interpreting the law of the sea as he pleases are over. Now India is ready to respond to any threat. He said that some irresponsible countries are misinterpreting the law of the sea for their own interests. The most worrying thing is that many are watered down the definition of the law by exerting dominance. But as a responsible country, India always supports the consensus principle, peaceful, open and stable maritime system. 

This 136-meter-long warship has four gas turbine engines. Its speed is more than 55 kilometers per hour. The ship can operate continuously for up to one and a half months.

Headline_English: Meftaul impresses by becoming the first person to graduate from BUET
Content_Enlish:
Meftaul Alam Siam, who came first in the BUET admission test, has surprised everyone. He had already come first in the K Unit admission test at Dhaka University. He also came third in the cluster admission test of three engineering and technology universities in the country, first in the Islamic University of Technology (IUT) admission test, and 59th in the medical admission test. This time, Meftaul also came first in the Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology (BUET) admission test. 

On Thursday night, the results of the first-year undergraduate admission test for the 2020-21 academic year showed that Meftaul, who passed his higher secondary from Government Azizul Haque College in Bogra, came first. 
According to media reports, Meftaul's roll number in the fifth grade was 252. However, he focused on his studies after getting admitted to high school. His roll number in the sixth grade was 20. Then he started coming first from the eighth grade. Meftaul got GPA 5 in both secondary and higher secondary. He got GPA 5 in the fifth grade final exam. He got GPA 5 and general scholarship in 8th grade and GPA 5 and talent pool scholarship in SSC. 

Meftaul Alam Siam is the eldest of the three sons of Khorshed Alam, a retired NGO official from Bogra. His mother Munjila Alam is a housewife. He said that he achieved success due to their inspiration.

Headline_English: Joynab becomes the first Bangladeshi woman to summit Nepal's Lebuche mountain
Content_Enlish:
Bangladeshi mountaineer Joynab Binte Hossain Shantu has become the first Bangladeshi woman to conquer the 6,119-meter or 20,070-foot high 'Lebuche' mountain near the Everest Base Camp in the Khumbu Himalayas. Joynab achieved this feat at 9:50 am on Monday, November 1. Joynab completed her Honors-Masters in Bengali from Dhaka University and is working as an assistant professor at Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujib Science and Technology University in Gopalganj. Joynab left for Nepal on October 11 and started trekking in the Khumbu region via Lukla on October 26. Initially, her goal was the 'Pharchamo' mountain, which is still elusive for Bangladeshi mountaineers. But despite reaching 5,900 meters of that mountain, she could not succeed due to 36 hours of continuous heavy snowfall and even making two 'summit pushes' within a week due to the adverse behavior of nature. The Sherpas failed to fix the rope twice due to snowstorms. 
Then, on the advice of the guides, they took permission to go to the 'Lebuche' mountain located next to the Everest Base Camp. After that, they 'stopped' and climbed continuously from 'Thamo' to Pangboche, from Pangboche to Base Camp, from Base Camp to High Camp for the next three days, and on Monday, November 1, Zainab conquered the 'Lebuche' mountain (6119 meters). 

Zainab Binte Hossain Shantu is the first woman in Bangladesh to conquer the 'Lebuche' mountain. On the occasion of the 50th anniversary of independence, she dedicated the summit to the 3 million martyrs of the Liberation War and 2 million oppressed women.

Headline_English: Modi's 4-hour visit costs Rs 23 crore!
Content_Enlish:
India's National People's Pride Day will be held in Bhopal on November 15. The festival will continue throughout the week in memory of tribal freedom fighter Bhagwan Birsa Munda and other tribal freedom fighters. The Indian government has decided to organize various programs on this occasion from November 15 to 22. The main program of the day has been organized at the famous Jamboree Maidan in Bhopal. It is known that although Modi's visit is for 4 hours, he will be on the stage for only 1 hour and 15 minutes. However, the surprising thing is that out of the 23 crore rupees allocated for the visit, 13 crore rupees will be spent on bringing people to the Jamboree Maidan from different places. NDTV reported that at least two lakh tribals from different parts of Madhya Pradesh will come to the Jamboree Maidan on the day of the festival. In addition, many more people will come from 52 districts, on this occasion the Jamboree Maidan is being decorated with pictures of tribal legendary leaders and tribal artwork. More than 300 workers have been working for the past week to make the event a success. Huge pandals have been set up in the maidan.

The cost of accommodation, food and travel for the guests at the event has been estimated at more than Rs 12 crore. And the cost of construction of the five domes, tents, decorations and publicity is more than Rs 9 crore.

Headline_English: Bangladesh Bank is providing subsidies to four new sectors
Content_Enlish: Bangladesh Bank has issued a policy for providing export subsidies for four sectors - bicycles and their parts, cement sheets, MS steel and tea, new products. Last September, the government announced a 4 percent export subsidy for these four sectors. On Wednesday (November 10), the conditions and mandatory requirements for obtaining export subsidies for these four sectors were issued in the form of instructions. The instructions state that to get 4 percent cash assistance, the local value added in the production of these products must be at least 30 percent. If the value added is below this, local entrepreneurs will not receive cash assistance. This cash assistance will be effective from July 1 of the current fiscal year. In the current fiscal year, cash assistance at the rate of 4 percent will be provided to individual freelancers. Aluminum engineering products will be considered for export subsidy under the light engineering sector. The circular also says that entrepreneurs in specialized areas will receive such assistance.

Headline_English: Cash crisis in banks
Content_Enlish:
A sudden cash crisis in some banks. This has made the interbank money market or call money market unstable. Interest rates have doubled in a week. Economists are blaming the wrong policies of bankers for this instability. However, Bangladesh Bank says that this cash crisis is temporary. After overcoming the corona crisis, economic activities have regained some momentum, and the demand for loans in the private sector has also increased. Several banks are facing a cash crisis to cope with the pressure. 

When a cash crisis occurs, one bank borrows money from another bank for a day. This is known as call money. There has also been instability there. Due to the increase in demand for loans, interest rates have almost doubled in a week. Bankers say that the non-return of stimulus money and the purchase of dollars to repay LC liabilities have put a strain on cash. 

Several private sector banks have approached Bangladesh Bank after not getting money in the call money market. Analysts say that many banks have taken loans from the money market at low interest rates instead of taking deposits in the hope of higher profits. Now they are the most in danger. If the deposit situation does not improve, the crisis will worsen in the coming days. 

Bangladesh Bank says that many people have reduced their deposits due to the adjustment of deposit interest rates in line with inflation. This has had an impact on liquidity. Although there is temporary instability in the call money market, Bangladesh Bank believes that it will pass very quickly.

Headline_English: 'AL didn't lose in UP elections, nomination business was defeated'
Content_Enlish:
Former State Minister for Posts and Telecommunications Tarana Halim has commented that the Awami League did not lose in the Union Parishad elections this time, but the nomination business was defeated. On Tuesday (November 16), she said this in a post titled 'UP Election Idea - Who Won?' on her verified Facebook page. UP Election Idea - Who Won? 

Violence in the UP elections, a lifelong boat marker worker against the boat marker but winning as a rebel candidate without getting the boat marker in the election - does it seem confusing? There is no confusion. The idea has been reflected in the vote this time. 

Why would a strong party like the Awami League lose to a rebel candidate from its own party in the 206 UP elections? The meaning is clear - that rebel candidate did not have a lot of money but he was popular in the area. He did not go into the pockets of any leader or MP, he loved the people and made Bangabandhu's Awami League. So, those who do business with the party should know that this time the Awami League lost to the Awami League. Because of you. 

Popularity has lost to commerce in many places during the nomination process. On the other hand, at the end of the day, the popular man of the Awami League has won. The Awami League has not lost. The nomination business has been defeated (a member of parliament from the reserved seat of the Awami League has said the same thing). I am not talking about everyone, but the cronies and great leaders who sold the boat to money have also betrayed Bangabandhu. May the nomination business be defeated in this way. 
Joy Bangla. Thank you to those who made the popular candidate who sacrificed his life for the Awami League win. The nomination business will be stopped only by you. 

I apologize to you, Bangabandhu. The party that you left the ministry to strengthen (to strengthen the boat), today the commerce of some leaders has ruined your ideals. It has embarrassed your party. I love the party, I cherish the ideals of Bangabandhu with all my heart, so I cannot remain silent. I cannot pretend not to see it even if I see it. 

Those of you who insulted the party in this way will not be forgiven. You sold your candidacy to money! The party's victory is defeat! Whatever you are, don't say that you ever loved the party and Bangabandhu.

Headline_English: 2.3 million income tax returns have been filed this year
Content_Enlish:
2.3 million income tax returns have been submitted across all tax regions of the country. Revenue collected is Tk 3,200 crore. Out of more than 7 million TIN-holding taxpayers in the country, 4.7 million taxpayers have not submitted their returns in the current fiscal year. NBR says that more income tax returns will be submitted from taxpayers who applied for time. 

The deadline for submitting returns ended last Sunday (January 2). For the convenience of taxpayers, the opportunity to submit returns was available until 8 pm on the last day. Due to Corona, an income tax fair was not organized this time. However, returns were submitted in a festive atmosphere like a fair in 649 circles of the 31 tax regions of the National Board of Revenue. 

November 30 was the last day for filing returns for individual taxpayers for the 2021-22 tax year. However, considering the Corona situation, the NBR extended that deadline by one month. But since December 31 and January 1 are public holidays, the deadline for submitting returns was extended to January 2.

Headline_English: Elon Musk overtakes Bezos as world's richest man
Content_Enlish:
Elon Musk, the founder and CEO of rocket company SpaceX, has overtaken Amazon founder and CEO Jeff Bezos to become the world's richest person. Musk's net worth has crossed $185 billion. The BBC reported that the Tesla and SpaceX chief has risen to the top spot as Tesla's share price rose on Thursday (January 7). 
It is worth noting that Amazon chief Jeff Bezos had held the title of the world's richest person since 2017.

Headline_English: Attack on Capitol Hill proves the weak foundations of Western democracy: Rouhani
Content_Enlish:
Iranian President Hassan Rouhani has said that the attack on Capitol Hill proves that the foundation of Western democracy is weak. He also expressed his anger that Donald Trump has brought the world to the brink of destruction in the past four years. 
Hassan Rouhani said, the violence and violence that we have seen are clear how fragile and weak Western democracy is. A public representative has led his country to disaster in the past four years. I hope the whole world and the next officials in the White House will learn from this.

Headline_English: Fourth phase of elections in 56 municipalities on February 14
Content_Enlish:
In the fourth phase, 56 out of the country's more than 300 municipalities will go to polls on February 14. On Sunday, EC Senior Secretary Md. Alamgir announced the schedule. 
According to the schedule, the submission of nomination papers to the returning officer will begin on January 17. Selection will be on January 19. The last date for withdrawal is January 26. Before that, voting will be held in 25 municipalities in the first phase schedule using EVMs on December 28. Elections in 61 municipalities in the second phase will be held on January 16. And in the third phase, elections will be held in 64 municipalities on January 30. There are a total of 329 municipalities in the country. According to the law, voting in this local government institution has to be done within 90 days before the end of the term. After the amendment to the Local Government Act, the first party symbol was used in the municipality in 2015. 20 parties participated in the elections.

Headline_English: 5 Jamaat leaders jailed for assaulting police
Content_Enlish:
Five current and former leaders of Jamaat-e-Islami have been sent to jail in a case of beating up policemen and vandalizing and setting fire to a police vehicle in Brahmanbaria. 
On Sunday, Brahmanbaria Chief Judicial Magistrate Court Judge Md. Masud Parvez ordered them to be sent to jail. They are - Kazi Nazrul Islam Khadem, Golam Faruk, Md. Zahidul Islam, Rustum Ali and Md. Jahangir Alam Iqbal. 

This information was revealed in a press release sent by the District Police Special Branch (DSB) on Sunday afternoon. The release said that on the morning of December 4, 2012, a district police truck was going to Kautli from Police Lines with breakfast for police members. On the way, miscreants beat up, vandalized and set fire to the police members in the vehicle in the Pirbari area of ​​the city. A case was filed with Brahmanbaria Sadar Police Station on the same day in this incident. 
On October 10, Brahmanbaria Chief Judicial Magistrate Court Judge Md. Masud Parvez sentenced each of the accused named in the complaint and the absconding accused involved in the incident to two years of rigorous imprisonment and another one month of non-compulsory imprisonment in default of payment of a fine of two thousand taka. 

The notice further said that today (Sunday) the accused in the case Kazi Nazrul Islam Khadem, Golam Faruk, Md. Zahidul Islam, Rustum Ali and Md. Jahangir Alam Iqbal surrendered to the court and the judge ordered them to be sent to jail. 

It is to be noted that 16 of the 21 accused in the case had already surrendered to the court and the judge had sent them to jail.

Headline_English: Kazakhstan abolishes the death penalty
Content_Enlish:
Kazakhstan has passed a law abolishing the death penalty. President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev signed a bill on Saturday to abolish the death penalty after nearly two decades of moratorium. 
The president signed the law after parliament ratified the Second Optional Protocol to the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights. Al Jazeera reports. 
The death penalty has been suspended in dictatorial Kazakhstan since 2003. But courts have been handing down death sentences. The new law will no longer carry out executions.

Headline_English: India, Pakistan exchange information on nuclear installations
Content_Enlish:
India and Pakistan exchange lists of nuclear installations and prisoners with each other 
The two neighboring countries on Saturday exchanged lists of civilian prisoners, fishermen and their nuclear installations in their custody. The Hindu reported. The Indian Ministry of External Affairs said in a statement that the lists of civilian prisoners and fishermen were exchanged through diplomatic channels as per the provisions of the 2008 agreement. 

Under the bilateral agreement, India has handed over to Pakistan a list of 263 Pakistani civilian prisoners and 77 prisoners in that country's custody. 

On the other hand, Pakistan has handed over to India a list of 49 civilian prisoners and 270 prisoners in its custody. 

Both countries had called on their respective sides for the immediate release and repatriation of their civilian prisoners and fishermen along with their boats. However, India and Pakistan exchanged lists of nuclear installations under the bilateral agreement, which prohibits both countries from attacking each other's nuclear installations. 

The Indian Ministry of External Affairs said in a separate statement that New Delhi and Islamabad exchanged the lists simultaneously through diplomatic channels. It said that under the agreement, India and Pakistan are to inform each other about their nuclear installations on the first day of January of each year. The agreement, signed on December 31, 1988, came into force on January 27, 1991. 
This is the 30th exchange of views between the two countries after such a list was first held on January 1, 1992. The exchange of lists of nuclear installations comes amid chilly relations between the two countries over the Kashmir issue and cross-border terrorism.

Headline_English: Shakib and Mushfiqur will play 52 international matches this year
Content_Enlish:
Although the events have disappeared from the 2020 sports calendar due to the grip of Corona, that will not happen again in 2021. All games will be held at the right time. 
This year, the Asia Cup-T20 Cricket will be held, along with the Cricket World Cup. Shakib-Tamim will play 52 international matches in 365 days. The busyness of international football will begin with the African Nations Cup. Star players will fill the field at the Tennis World Cup. The biggest event in the world sports arena, the Tokyo Olympics, is scheduled to be held this year. The biggest good news for Tiger fans this year is that the busy cricket schedule of Tiger cricketers will start with the Windies series. Bangladesh will play a total of 52 international matches this year. After this, Shakib Mushfiqur and his team will fly to play a series with New Zealand. After 3 ODIs and 3 T20Is with the Kiwis, the Tigers may have to go to Sri Lanka. In the June-July session, they will tour the dangerous friend Zimbabwe to play a full series. And England may come to Bangladesh to play cricket in September. 
Also, the Tigers will play two Tests with Sri Lanka in a home match in December. Australia is scheduled to come to play in between. There may be another series with New Zealand. 

The Asia Cup T20 will be held in Sri Lanka in June this year and the Tigers will participate in the mega event of the T20 World Cup held in India in October. 

Like cricket, world football is busy. This month, the busy time of international football will start with the African Nations Cup. After that, the FIFA Club World Cup, Champions League finals. Copa America and Euro Championship. Tennis will start in February with the Australian Open. However, all eyes will be on the Biggest Show on Earth Olympics. The Tokyo Olympics, which was held due to Corona, is scheduled to be held in July-August. 

Even if the game finally returns to the field after overcoming the burden of Corona, the big question now is when the audience will return to the field. However, the sooner the Corona vaccine reaches the people, the better.

Headline_English: Book Festival-2021 begins across the country today
Content_Enlish:
The Book Festival-2021 has started across the country, including Dhaka, from today. Books will be distributed from 8 am to 12 pm today. These new books will be distributed over a total of 12 days. 
The book distribution program started in various schools in the capital from the morning. However, books were distributed to guardians, not students. The presence of guardians was also noticeable on the first day of the new year. 

The educational institutions encouraged guardians to come to educational institutions to collect books. Even then, the students who collected books were also overjoyed. On the first day, books for three subjects of the second and eighth grades were distributed. The guardians also welcomed the decision to close educational institutions until the situation improves.

Headline_English: Two Al Qaeda members arrested in Sarai
Content_Enlish:
Members of RAB-14's Bhairab Camp have arrested two members of the banned militant organization Al Qaeda in Sarail, Brahmanbaria. 
Based on a secret information, they were arrested late on Thursday night from the house of Md. Gias Uddin of Shahbazpur village of the upazila. At that time, 2 extremist books, two photocopies of extremist books, 4 leaflets, two mobile phones and 3 photocopies of mobile messages were recovered from them. 

The arrested are Hafez Md. Yahia (22), son of Md. Gias Uddin of Shahbazpur village, and Md. Huzaifa Saad (20), son of Md. Alauddin of the same village. 

A press release sent from RAB Bhairab Camp on Friday afternoon said that based on a secret information, RAB members led by RAB Bhairab Camp Company Commander, Additional Superintendent of Police Rafiuddin Mohammad Jobayer and Squad Commander Assistant Superintendent of Police Mohammad Belayet Hossain conducted a raid on the house of Gias Uddin, a resident of Dighi Uttarpar, Shahbazpur village, on Thursday night and arrested them. 

RAB said that the arrested are members of the banned militant organization Al-Qaeda. They were staying in this area in disguise and were spreading extremist ideology through extremist books and leaflets related to extremist propaganda and mobile phones, along with the intention of carrying out sabotage and anti-state activities in civilian and important establishments. 

RAB said that initially during interrogation, they identified themselves as active members of Al-Qaeda. They had been recruiting members from different areas using various tactics.

Headline_English: The World Health Organization has approved Pfizer BioNTech's vaccine to prevent coronavirus.
Content_Enlish:
The World Health Organization has approved Pfizer BioNTech's vaccine to prevent Corona. The organization announced this decision in a statement on Thursday. This is the first time that any vaccine has received approval from the World Health Organization since the spread of the Corona pandemic. 

As a result, the way has been paved for the approval of the vaccine in underdeveloped and developing countries. In addition, various organizations including UNICEF will be able to take steps to deliver the vaccine to the underprivileged population as needed. The United Kingdom was the first country in the world to approve the use of the Pfizer vaccine a month ago. The vaccine began to be used in the country on December 8. After that, it was approved for use in many other countries, including the United States, Canada. 

The vaccine developed by the American company Pfizer and Germany's BioNTech has been proven to be 95 percent effective in trials.

Headline_English: Police find truth in Nancy's case against Asif Akbar
Content_Enlish:
Nazmun Munira Nancy. A popular singer of the country. Nancy has been captivating the audience with the magic of her melodious voice for more than a decade. In recognition, she won the 'National Film Award' for the first time in 2011. However, now she is in a different discussion. She has filed a case against singer Asif. It is alleged that Asif Akbar made defamatory statements about her in various media. Police say that the initial investigation has found the truth of the allegations. Asif Akbar received a court summons in this case on December 31. 

In Nancy's video clip given to the police, Asif Akbar can be heard saying that Nancy is mentally unbalanced. 6 months are good and 6 months are bad. Nancy is unhappy with such comments made by singer Asif Akbar in various media about singer Nancy. The dispute escalated to the court. 

Nazmun Monira Nancy said, various objectionable comments have been made about me which have hurt me. That is why I have approached the court. 

Nancy filed a written complaint against Asif Akbar at the Mymensingh Kotwali Police Station on July 10 last year. It is said that Asif Akbar has made statements that defame her in various media. As a result, she and her family have been humiliated. 

Nazmun Monira Nancy said that we work in the same industry. He is my senior. It is unacceptable that he would personally attack me like this. Nancy says that she does not see an alternative to a legal solution. 

Meanwhile, singer Asif Akbar received a summons in this case last Thursday. Then Asif Akbar posted a status on his verified Facebook page claiming his innocence. 

Yesterday, Asif Akbar wrote on Facebook regarding the case, 'I received a court summons on the last day of the year. A renowned singer has filed a case. I have not yet obtained a copy of the case, so I cannot give any accurate information. This much I know, I have to go to Mymensingh to face the case. I have some time. Meanwhile, I am fascinated by the magic of the Copyright Office. Their misguided guidance has now become a public nuisance. I am also getting involved in unwanted trouble there. I never wanted these troubles, I don't want them. For now, I am a victim, but victory is certain, InshaAllah.

Headline_English: Woman's killer identified based on shop visiting card
Content_Enlish:
Based on the visiting card of a mobile phone shop, the police have arrested the woman's husband Ansar Sheikh on suspicion of involvement in the incident, including the identification of the body of an unidentified woman recovered from the railway line of Patikabari village under Lalpur police station on January 13 (Wednesday). 

The arrested Ansar Sheikh was presented before journalists at the Natore Police Superintendent's office on Sunday and this information was given at a press briefing. He was arrested from Chanchkoir Bazar area of ​​Gurudaspur upazila yesterday, Saturday. The arrested Ansar Sheikh is the son of the deceased Bhanu Sheikh of Chakbarera area of ​​Pabna district. 

Superintendent of Police Liton Kumar Saha said that the body of an unidentified woman was recovered from the railway line of Patikabari village under Lalpur police station on January 13. The Lalpur police station filed a case against unknown accused in this incident. After that, the district police got the visiting card of a mobile phone shop in Dhaka near the body and went to the field to identify the body. Through extensive operations at various places and modern information technology and the continuation of the investigation, the police came to know that the body was that of Shampa Khatun, daughter of Abdur Rahman of Narayanpur Mohalla in Pangsha Municipality area of ​​Rajbari district. After further investigation, the police identified Shampa Khatun's husband, accused Ansar Sheikh. He was arrested from Chanchkoir Bazar area of ​​Gurudaspur upazila on Saturday and the mobile phone used by Shampa Khatun was recovered. 

The police came to know that Shampa Khatun left home due to a family dispute. On January 13, during an argument between the husband and wife, Ansar Sheikh strangled his wife Shampa Khatun to death and fled.

Headline_English: A group of Nepali Sherpas set a record for conquering the dangerous mountain peak 'K-2' in winter for the first time
Content_Enlish:
A group of Nepalese Sherpas have set a record for the first time in winter by conquering the world's second highest and most dangerous mountain peak 'K-2'. They reached the peak of the mountain at 5 pm local time on Saturday. 

The organizing company 'Seven Summit Treks' said that a group of 10 people reached the peak together. Team member Nimsdai Purja also sent a photo of their success. 

The height of 'K-2', the second highest mountain peak after Mount Everest, is 8,611 meters above sea level. However, climbing the mountain on the China-Pakistan border in winter becomes almost impossible due to the weather and ups and downs. This time, several people started the expedition to conquer 'K-2' in winter. Among them, a Spanish explorer died.

Headline_English: Dutch Prime Minister leaves office on bicycle, announces resignation
Content_Enlish:
Dutch Prime Minister Mark Rutte rode his bicycle out of office after announcing his resignation. 

His government resigned over allegations of fraud with child welfare funds. He did not use a government car or a police car after announcing his resignation on Friday. 
Between 2012 and 2019, Dutch tax authorities accused about 26,000 families of defrauding money from child welfare funds. As a result, those families had to return the money. This put many families in financial crisis. As a result, the Dutch government resigned.

Headline_English: Hrithik-Deepika's new action movie has a budget of 250 crores
Content_Enlish:
Hrithik Roshan and Deepika Padukone's new movie 'Fighter' is going to be the biggest budget action thriller in Bollywood. The budget of the movie has been estimated at 250 crores. 

This is going to be the biggest budget action thriller movie in Bollywood in terms of budget. This is what is being heard about Hrithik Roshan, Deepika Padukone's upcoming movie. 

Anandabazar reports that Hrithik is going to work with director Siddharth Anand for the third time. Earlier, he worked in the films 'Bang Bang' and 'War' under Siddharth's direction. And if all goes well, this will be his first film with Deepika. 

Hrithik is going to play the role of a pilot in the movie. Action scenes will be shot in various countries. Along with that, there will be several action scenes in the middle of the sky. And that is going to cost a huge amount of money. 

Meanwhile, Siddharth Anand is busy working on the film 'Pathan' with Shah Rukh and John Abraham. Deepika is also playing the female lead. It is learnt that Siddharth will start working on his next film after completing this film. And in that film, he will not only be the director but also the producer.

Headline_English: 8 people, including children, die in fire at residential building in Russia
Content_Enlish:
At least 8 people, including children, have died in a fire at a residential building in Russia. Several others have fallen ill from the smoke. 
The country's fire service authorities said that the fire was quickly brought under control with the efforts of a 30-member rescue team. During this time, 19 people, including 9 children, were rescued alive. An investigation committee has been formed to find out the cause of the incident. 
Meanwhile, 4 army personnel were killed in a road accident near the capital Moscow. At least 20 people were injured. 

The administration said that a truck lost control and hit an army bus. This led to a collision. The injured are being rescued and being treated at various local hospitals.

Headline_English: PSC announces dates for 41st-42nd BCS preliminary exams
Content_Enlish:
The Bangladesh Public Service Commission (PSC) has fixed the dates for the preliminary examinations of the 41st and 42nd BCS. The dates were fixed in a meeting of the Bangladesh Public Service Commission on Wednesday. 
The meeting said that the preliminary examination of the 41st BCS will be held on March 19 and February 26 this year. The preliminary examination of the 42nd BCS will be held simultaneously in Dhaka, Chittagong, Khulna, Rajshahi, Sylhet, Barisal, Rangpur and Mymensingh on Friday, March 19 from 10 am to 12 noon. The preliminary examination of the 42nd BCS will also be held from 3 pm to 5 pm. 

In addition, the seats and detailed information for the two BCS examinations will be announced later on the PSC website. 4 lakh 75 thousand people applied for the 41st BCS. 2 thousand 166 people will be appointed in this BCS. 

More than 31 thousand applications have been submitted for doctors in the special 42nd BCS. The application for this BCS started on December 7 last year and ended on the evening of December 27. 2,000 people will be appointed as assistant surgeons in the 42nd BCS. 
The 42nd BCS notification mentioned that the MCQ type written examination of the 42nd Special BCS (Special) may be held in February. The specific date and time will be published on the commission's website and the media in due course. 

Distribution of marks for the 42nd BCS exam- 

The PSC said in the notification that the examination for the 42nd Special BCS will be of 300 marks. Out of this, 200 marks will be for the preliminary examination (MCQ type). And 100 marks will be for the oral examination. Candidates will get two hours for the 200 marks examination. In the preliminary, there will be tests on Medical Science (100), Bengali (20), English (20), Bangladesh Affairs (20), International Affairs (20), Mental Ability (10) and Mathematical Reasoning (10). The candidate will get 1 mark for each correct answer in the examination. However, if you answer incorrectly, 50 decimal points will be deducted from the total marks obtained for each incorrect answer.

Headline_English: This time a gorilla is infected with Corona
Content_Enlish:
Several gorillas at a zoo in the United States have been infected with the novel coronavirus (COVID-19). The incident occurred at the San Diego Zoo's Safari Park. Anandabazar Patrika reported. 

Earlier, coronavirus was detected in animals such as cats, tigers, and lions in several countries. However, this is the first case in the case of gorillas. 

Park Executive Director Lisa Peterson told the AP on Monday that eight gorillas living together in the park are believed to have contracted the coronavirus, and some of them are showing symptoms. 

Of these, three gorillas tested positive for coronavirus in the US Department of Agriculture's veterinary laboratory. The remaining gorillas are now being tested. 

It is believed that the gorillas were infected with coronavirus from a member of the park's animal care team. That person was also tested and diagnosed with coronavirus. However, he did not have symptoms but always wore a mask in front of the gorillas. 

The zoo has been closed to visitors since December 6 following the coronavirus outbreak in California.

Headline_English: Supporters of two councilor candidates open fire in violence surrounding CHC elections; 1 killed
Content_Enlish:
Supporters of two councilor candidates engaged in violence over the Chittagong City elections. One person was shot dead. 
The incident took place in the Magpukurpar area of ​​Mogaltuli around 8:30 pm on Tuesday. 
Police said that supporters of Awami League-backed councilor candidate Nazrul Islam Bahadur of Ward 28 of the city and rebel candidate Abdul Quader were campaigning in the same area. At one stage of the argument, a clash broke out. Gunfire broke out. Babul Sardar, a supporter of Nazrul, was shot and died on the spot. Another person who was shot has been admitted to the hospital. 

After this incident, houses of Quader supporters were attacked. The situation is tense in the area. Additional police have also been deployed.

Headline_English: Trump declares state of emergency in Washington, DC
Content_Enlish:
President Donald Trump has declared a state of emergency in Washington, DC, to prevent any disruption to the inauguration of the newly elected president of the United States. He has ordered the Department of Homeland Security and the Federal Emergency Management Agency to work in coordination with local authorities. 
President Donald Trump declared a state of emergency in the capital after US law enforcement agencies warned of possible violence and threats of attack surrounding the inauguration of newly elected President Joe Biden. 

On Monday, local time, the White House press office said in a statement that federal forces will be deployed in the city until January 24 to ensure security for the inauguration. All measures will be taken to implement the state of emergency. 

On January 6, Trump supporters violently attacked lawmakers during a session on Capitol Hill, the US parliament building, which is being criticized around the world. That is why Trump declared a state of emergency in the District of Columbia to ensure the security of the new president's inauguration.

Headline_English: High Court orders DU to inform about PhD research preservation process
Content_Enlish:
The High Court has sought to know the process by which PhD research is saved and whether there is any software for this. The court has asked Dhaka University to submit a report on the matter within the next two months. 

A bench comprising Justice JBM Hasan and Justice Md. Khairul Alam of the High Court issued the order on Monday. 
The University Grants Commission-UGC and DU submitted their inquiry reports today in light of the High Court's directive to find out how PhD and equivalent degrees are approved by all government and private universities in the country and whether they are done in accordance with the appropriate law.

Headline_English: Any election seems rigged to BNP because it has stolen votes: Nanak
Content_Enlish:
Awami League Presidium Member Jahangir Kabir Nanak has said that any election now seems rigged to them because BNP rigged and robbed the elections. He said this at a discussion meeting on Bangabandhu's Homecoming Day on Monday afternoon. 
Commenting on the fact that BNP has been making various complaints about the elections, Nanak said, they are demanding the resignation of the Election Commission but they have forgotten that BNP has destroyed the elections and the democratic system. While the whole world is praising the development and progress of Bangladesh, BNP does not see any development in the country.

Headline_English: Sonam's tweet on Bangladeshi fan's birthday
Content_Enlish:
Bollywood star Sonam Kapoor has wished a Bangladeshi fan a happy birthday. On Monday, Sonam tweeted to wish a fan named Sabrina Ella. 
Ella, a student of the capital's Ahsanullah University of Science and Technology, runs a fan club called 'Sonam Kapoor Ahuja Cafe' on Twitter and Instagram. That is how her friendship with Sonam Kapoor was formed. Overwhelmed by the wishes of her beloved actress, Ella wrote on Twitter, 'You don't know how happy I am. I am the luckiest! I love you.'

Headline_English: 'KGF Chapter 2' sets record with teaser
Content_Enlish:
The biggest budget movie of the Kannada film industry, 'KGF: Chapter 2', is being released in the new year. The shooting of the movie has already been completed. The director had announced that the teaser of the movie would be released on Friday, January 8th morning on the occasion of actor Yash's birthday. But instead of that, the teaser of the movie KGF: Chapter 2 was released on Thursday night, January 7th, ahead of schedule. The teaser of this movie was released in advance as a surprise to meet the demands of the fans. After that, it has been setting one record after another. 
After its release, this teaser has set a world record. It is now the most viewed teaser on YouTube in 24 hours. It is also in fifth place in the list of most viewed videos in a day. This teaser is also at the top of YouTube trends. 

Yash is playing the central role in the movie 'KGF 2'. Also playing various roles are - Sanjay Dutt, Srinidhi Shetty, Achyut Kumar, Nasser, Anant Nag, Raveena Tandon, etc.

Headline_English: Trump impeachment motion introduced in House of Representatives
Content_Enlish:
A resolution to remove US President Donald Trump from power has been introduced in the House of Representatives. The resolution was introduced in Congress on Monday local time. 
At that time, House Speaker Nancy Pelosi proposed to remove Trump from power by invoking the 25th Amendment to the Constitution to Vice President Mike Pence. If Trump is not removed by invoking the 25th Amendment, impeachment was threatened. 
Meanwhile, Republican leaders have also demanded the president's resignation over allegations of inciting an attack on Capitol Hill.

Headline_English: Lucy the Elephant: Architectural Sculpture Elephant House
Content_Enlish:
Lucy the Elephant is the oldest tourist attraction in the United States. Lucy is a unique architectural structure located in Margate City, New Jersey. It is both a sculpture and an architectural structure. 

It is a six-story building in the shape of an elephant. It was built in 1881. It is made of wood and tin sheets. It is listed as the 12th tallest sculpture in the United States. 

A man named James V. Lafferty built this architectural sculpture about five miles (8 kilometers) south of Atlantic City. Its original name was Elephant Bazaar. Lucy was built to sell real estate, promote, and attract tourists. Lucy was built in the style of the famous elephant Jumbo from Barnum & Bailey's Greatest Show on Earth. 

In 1881, the United States Patent Office granted James V. Lafferty a patent giving him the exclusive right to build, use, or sell buildings in the shape of the animal for seventeen years. Lafferty financed the design and construction of his first elephant-shaped building in South Atlantic City, now Margate City. James V. Lafferty hired Philadelphia architects William Free and J. Mason Kirby to design it. 

Lucy cost between $25,000 and $38,000 in current currency. The structure was 65 feet (19.7 m) high, 60 feet (18.3 m) long, and 18 feet (5.5 m) wide. It weighed about 90 tons. Lucy required about one million pieces of lumber, 200 kg of nails, 4 tons of bolts, and iron bars to build. 

Its exterior was clad in 12,000 square feet of tin sheeting. The structure had 22 windows throughout. 

Lafferty originally showed potential real estate clients plots of land from Lucy's howitzer. The Howda offers a magnificent view of Margate, the Atlantic City skyline, the beach, and the Atlantic Ocean. It serves as an observation deck for modern visitors during their travels. 

In 1887, the structure was sold to Anton Hartzen of Philadelphia. It remained in his family until 1970. Anton's daughter-in-law, Sophia Hartzen, named the structure "Lucy the Elephant" in 1902. Lucy's head is shaped like an Asian elephant. 

She has long tusks like a male elephant. Therefore, the elephant was initially referred to as a male elephant. But eventually she became known as a female elephant. 

Until the first half of the 20th century, Lucy was used as a restaurant, business office, cottage, and inn. It is depicted on many souvenirs and postcards. It is also known as "The Elephant Hotel of Atlantic City." However, the hotel was not inside the elephant, but in a nearby building.

By the 1960s, Lucy had fallen into disrepair and was due to be removed. In 1969, Edwin T. Carpenter and a group of Margate citizens formed the Margate Civic Association. This later became the Save Lucy Committee, led by Josephine Harron and Sylvia Carpenter. 

They were given 30 days to either remove the building or pay for its removal. Various fundraising events were held to help. Finally, volunteers went door-to-door to collect the money. 

On July 20, 1970, Lucy was moved to a site owned by the City about 100 yards west-southwest and was completely renovated. It took about seven hours to move Lucy to its new location. It was not opened to the public until structural repairs and improvements were completed, in 1974. 

The original wooden frame of the building was reinforced with new steel, and the old howitzer was replaced with a new replica. A green glass plug was set into the howitzer platform, which reflects light into Lucy. 

Lucy was designated a National Historic Landmark in 1976 during the United States Bicentennial. 

Lucy's birthday is celebrated every July 20 with children's games and much fanfare. 

In 2006, Lucy's teeth were slightly blackened by lightning. In October 2012, Hurricane Sandy hit near Margate. Lucy remained unharmed, although the storm surge reached Lucy's feet and blew away a small parking lot. 

On July 23, 2016, Lucy's staff jokingly declared Lucy a candidate for President of the United States to mark her 135th birthday. In 2016, Lucy's site attracted 135,000 visitors. Of these, 35,000 were guided tours. 

On February 27, 2020, Lucy became the first and only National Historic Landmark to be allowed to stay overnight. Lucy was listed on Airbnb for $138 per night on March 17, 18, and 19, 2020. This was the first time that Lucy had been allowed to be occupied since it was rented as a house in the early 1900s.

Headline_English: SSC candidates protest and form human chain demanding auto pass
Content_Enlish:
More than two hundred candidates from 15 educational institutions have staged a protest and formed a human chain demanding autopass in SSC. The protest and human chain were held in front of the Narsingdi Press Club on Tuesday (February 2) afternoon. 
The procession started from the city's Jailkhana intersection and ended in front of the Press Club. The students took a position on the road in front of the Press Club and chanted various slogans for two hours. 

The students in the human chain said that our studies have been severely affected due to the closure of schools since March 17 last year. We have not benefited much from the classes that have been held online. The SSC examination has also been delayed due to the ongoing Corona situation. Due to this, we will have to face session jams. Besides, there is a possibility of getting infected with coronavirus if you go to the examination center and participate in the SSC examination at this time. Considering these issues, we appeal to the Prime Minister to postpone this year's SSC examination and arrange autopass for the candidates. 

Sadar Upazila Executive Officer Taslima Akhter, Additional Superintendent of Police (Sadar) Belal Hossain, President of Narsingdi College Teachers' Association Mashiur Rahman Mridha, Officer-in-Charge (OC) of Narsingdi Model Police Station Biplab Kumar Dutta Chowdhury and Inspector (Investigation) Ataur Rahman, among others, arrived at the spot to explain to the protesting examinees and manage the situation. 

Inspector (Investigation) of Narsingdi Model Police Station Ataur Rahman said that these students had gathered in front of the Press Club demanding autopasses. We listened to their statements attentively. Later, they returned to their homes after handing over an application for autopasses to us.

Headline_English: Tigers take to the field in Chittagong this morning after 344 days
Content_Enlish:
Bangladesh is playing a Test match after 344 days. The Tigers played their last Test match against Zimbabwe in Dhaka on February 22 last year. The team led by Mominul Haque is playing in the elite format of cricket again after a long time due to Corona. Host Bangladesh will take the field against the West Indies in the first Test of the two-match series on Wednesday. The match will start at 9:30 am on Wednesday (February 03) at the Chowdhury Zahur Ahmed Stadium in Chittagong. Bangladesh News 
Bangladesh is playing Test cricket after more than 11 months. So the challenge for Domingo's team is to adapt to this format. The head coach has indicated that there will be no much experimentation with batting. However, there is uncertainty about who will be Tamim's partner in the opening. Although there is some lack of fitness, it is almost certain that Shakib will play. And considering the condition, the management has hinted that the team will rely on spin instead of pace attack. 

On the other hand, West Indies, despite finishing the ODI series badly, want to turn around in the Tests. Especially since several of their tested cricketers are ready for this format, coach Phil Simmons is confident. On top of that, the Caribbeans played series against New Zealand and England last year. In that respect, the Windies will be slightly ahead of Bangladesh. Bangladesh News 

Bangladesh's probable XI: Tamim Iqbal Khan, Mominul Haque Sourav (captain), Shakib Al Hasan, Mushfiqur Rahim, Yasir Ali Chowdhury, Mohammad Mithun, Mehedi Hasan Miraj, Taijul Islam, Mostafizur Rahman, Taskin Ahmed and Abu Zayed Chowdhury Rahi. 

West Indies probable playing XI: Kraigg Brathwaite, Jermaine Blackwood, John Campbell, Saini Mosley, Raheem Cornwall, Kyle Myers, Raymond Reifer, Joshua de Silva, Shannon Gabriel, Kemar Roach and Jomal Warrick.

Headline_English: Case filed over death due to alcohol consumption at resort
Content_Enlish:
A case has been filed against unidentified persons at Sreepur Police Station in Gazipur after three people died and 13 others fell ill after drinking alcohol while on vacation at Sarah Resort in Sreepur. Sreepur Police Station SI Nayan Bhuiyan filed the case on the night of February 1.

Sreepur Police Station OC Khondaker Imam Hossain said that on January 28, 40 people led by Anushka Gazi from Dhaka's Forththought PR and Asia Tex Farm went to a forest feast at Sarah Resort in Pabur Chala area of ​​Sreepur Upazila in Gazipur. Later, while staying at Sarah Resort, unknown persons from outside negligently collected their adulterated liquor and various types of food.

Later, they consumed the food and liquor and enjoyed themselves. The resort authorities provided them with services during their stay at the resort. Later, on January 30, after the banquet, everyone left the resort together on the London Express bus of Forthought PR and Asia Tex Farm. On the way, 12/13 of them fell seriously ill and were sent to various hospitals in Dhaka. Later, one of them, Md. Shihab Zahir, died while undergoing treatment at Suhrawardy Hospital.

Apart from Shihab Zahir, two more people have been reported to have died among the sick. Investigation and arrest operations are underway to find and arrest those involved.

The case states that some of the people who came to the banquet, due to the negligence of Sarah Resort with the help of unknown accused, fell ill and died after returning to Dhaka.

Headline_English: Five BIWTA committees to oversee Sadarghat passenger launches
Content_Enlish:
The Bangladesh Inland Water Transport Authority (BIWTA) has formed five committees to prevent such accidents after the fire of the MV Abhiyan-10 launch from Dhaka to Barguna in the Sugandha River in Jhalokati.
These committees will visit Sadarghat in the capital at least twice a week. During this time, BIWTA executive magistrates will be present with them. If irregularities and negligence are found during the inspection, the committee will run a mobile court.

The heads of the five committees are BIWTA Director Kazi Wakil Nawaz, Director Md. Shahjahan, Chief Engineer Md. Mohidul Islam, Director Muhammad Rafiqul Islam and Engineer Md. Atahar Ali Sardar.

BIWTA Public Relations Officer Mizanur Rahman confirmed to Prothom Alo on Tuesday that these committees have been formed to ensure greater supervision to ensure the safety of passengers and vessels.

Mizanur Rahman said that these committees will monitor the general and technical aspects of all passenger launches leaving Sadarghat. If they find any defects, they will cancel the journey of that launch.

Headline_English: Bangladesh secure historic Test win in New Zealand
Content_Enlish:
Although it may seem unbelievable, Bangladesh made history before our eyes. Victory in all formats on New Zealand soil was elusive, but Bangladesh achieved a memorable victory. 

Mominul Haque's team defeated World Test Championship champion New Zealand by 8 wickets in the Mount Maunganui Test today. This is the best victory in Bangladesh's Test history. At Bay Oval, Bangladesh fans chanted 'Bangladesh! Bangladesh!' Mominul and Mushfiqur left the field after lifting the stumps as a memento of the victory. 

New Zealand ended the fourth day's play at 147 for 5. On the fifth and final day today, Tom Latham's team was all out for 169 runs after scoring only 22 runs in 10.4 overs in the morning session. Bangladesh were given a target of only 40 runs to win. 

Mominul was on his way to victory along with Nazmul Hossain despite losing Sadman Islam (3) in the second over. Kyle Jamieson removed Nazmul (17) for 34 runs. Ross Taylor took a great catch at slip. Then Mominul brought victory to Mushfiqur Rahim. 

Even though Sadman was out quickly, Bangladesh did not have any difficulty in winning 
Even though Sadman was out quickly, Bangladesh did not have any difficulty in winning Photo: Twitter 
This is Bangladesh's sixth Test victory on foreign soil. Earlier, they won in the West Indies, Sri Lanka and Zimbabwe, but lost all nine Tests in New Zealand. The victory in the tenth attempt is undoubtedly Bangladesh's best victory on foreign soil in this edition. 

New Zealand is a very difficult place for big teams. The victory against the current world champions of Tests in the last four days will be memorable. With this, New Zealand's streak of 17 consecutive Tests unbeaten at home also came to an end. 

This is Bangladesh's first victory against New Zealand in Tests both at home and abroad. Mominul Haque's team also ended a streak of 32 consecutive losses in all editions on New Zealand soil. 

Nazmul Hossain opened with Sadman Islam after Mahmudul Hasan was injured. Tim Southee picked Sadman up in the second over and gave him a scare. Sadman took a catch behind the wicket. Mominul put on a 31-run partnership with Nazmul off 75 balls. Mushfiqur brought the victory by hitting four. 

The Bangladesh captain left the field unbeaten on 13 runs. Mushfiqur was unbeaten on 5 runs. With two sessions to spare on the last day, Bangladesh reached the target of victory in 16.5 overs in their second innings in the morning session. 

Ibadat takes 6 wickets in New Zealand's second innings 
Ibadat takes 6 wickets in New Zealand's second innings Photo: Twitter 
However, the Mount Maunganui Test will be remembered for the extraordinary performance of the bowlers in New Zealand's second innings after the determination of the batsmen in their first innings. Especially Ibadat Hossain, Ibadat set a record for the best performance among Bangladeshi pacers in a Test by taking 6 wickets in New Zealand's second innings. 

In this morning's session, he took 2 wickets in his two consecutive overs. He also got a 5-wicket haul in his first innings in his Test career. 

The contribution of Taskin, who took 3 wickets for 36 runs, and Miraj, who took 1 wicket, should not be forgotten. Before that, Bangladesh scored 458 runs in their first innings, including four half-centuries. 

Bangladesh got a lead of 130 runs after New Zealand were all out for 328 runs in the first innings. After that, Bangladesh's bowlers pressed New Zealand in their second innings. 

Shariful Islam and Miraj took 3 wickets each in New Zealand's first innings. Ibadat's match figures, who took 1 wicket in this innings, are 39-9--121-7. 

With this win, Bangladesh took a 1-0 lead in the two-match Test series. The second and final Test of the series will start at Hagley Oval on January 9. With this win, Bangladesh moved up to fifth in the Test Championship table with 12 points.

Headline_English: Mominul wants to forget this historic victory
Content_Enlish:
Bangladesh has just made history. A historic event like a Test win on New Zealand soil has happened, but captain Mominul Haque's body language does not show much excitement. 

The captain reminded the Bangladesh team that the victory at Mount Maunganui should not let the victory float in the air. 

Before the celebration of the history-making Test victory began, he shared his thoughts on the Christchurch Test on January 9. At the award ceremony after the match, the Bangladesh captain said, 'Today I want to forget this victory. I want to look forward to the next Test match in Christchurch.' 

However, the determination that Mominul had to make history by defeating the Kiwis was revealed to some extent in his words, 'We were not doing well in Test cricket. We lost the last two matches. To move forward, we needed a victory to create a tradition for the Test team. From that point of view, it is very important.' 

Mushfiqur hugs Mominul after victory 
Mushfiqur hugs Mominul after victory Photo: Twitter 
Bangladesh team did not let New Zealand's innings, which started the day at 147 for 5 in the first session of the fifth day, last long. The hosts were all out for 169 runs after scoring only 22 runs in 10.4 overs in the morning session, losing the remaining 5 wickets. Ibadat Hossain, Taskin Ahmed and Mehedi Hasan Miraj did not let Bangladesh's victory target go beyond 40 runs after sharing 5 wickets. 

Despite losing Sadman Islam and Nazmul Hossain to get that run, captain Mominul went with the experienced Mushfiqur Rahim. Mushfiqur's winning cut shot off Kyle Jamieson will surely be one of the best pictures in Bangladesh cricket history. 

Mominul was saying, 'This is a team success. Everyone was eager to win. Batting, bowling, fielding – everyone has come forward.' 

Mominul praises Ibadat 
Mominul praises Ibadat Photo: Twitter 
However, Bangladesh won the match that was heading towards a draw due to the performance of the bowlers in the first and second innings, 'We won mainly because of our bowlers. In one word, they were excellent in both the first and second innings. They worked hard. They bowled in the right places. They kept New Zealand under pressure.' 

Regarding the bowlers, the Test captain spoke separately about Ibadat Hossain. With a career-best 46 runs, the brilliant Ibadat was the hero of the Test victory. 

That is why Mominul praised Ibadat after the match, 'Ibadat bowled incredibly. In one word, he bowled brilliantly.' 

Mominul also unexpectedly benefited from the conditions. Especially since the first day of the Test, it was hot in Mount Maunganui. Because of this, the green grass turned gray very quickly. Bangladesh's spinners benefited from that. As Mominul said, 'As the sun started to heat up, the wicket also became dry. We tried to take advantage of that.'

Headline_English: Applications for the US Global UGrade Scholarships close on Thursday
Content_Enlish:
The deadline for applications for Bangladeshi undergraduate students to study in the United States for one semester in the 2022-23 academic year under the Global UGrade Program is January 6. 

An embassy statement said that interested students will have the opportunity to study in the undergraduate exchange program at educational institutions in that country under the auspices of the US Department of State. This is a fully free scholarship. The duration of this program is one semester. Applications for this scholarship can be made until midnight on January 6. 

The Global UGrade Program aims to introduce students from different countries to the US education system, exchange American values ​​and culture, and provide community-based work experience. In the last 16 years, 76 students from Bangladesh have participated in the Global UGrade Program. 

Students will study full-time for one semester at a university or college in the US in the undergraduate program. 
Students will study full-time for one semester at a US university or college in the undergraduate program. Photo: Global UGrade Program website 
Scholarship Benefits 

Students will study full-time for one semester at a US university or college in the undergraduate program. 

They will be able to enhance their leadership skills by participating in service work in the local US community. 

They will have the opportunity to do an internship in a US-based organization, which will enhance their professional skills. 

Under this program, students will gain knowledge about US society and culture. Later, they will be able to work as Youth Ambassadors in Bangladesh. 

Photo: Global UGrade Program website 
Eligibility 

Applicants must be over 18 years of age. 

Must have completed high school education in their home country. 

Must have completed at least one semester of undergraduate study in their home country. 

Must be proficient in English. 

Must comply with US J-1 visa policies. 

Must be committed to returning to Bangladesh at the end of the program.

You can access the online application form by logging into this website. You must fill out the form correctly and apply with the required documents to this website. You can find out more about the Global UGrade scholarship on the same website or this link.
