Headline_English: Infections increase one and a half times in a day in Chittagong
Content_Enlish:
In the last 24 hours, 53 new cases of corona have been detected in Chittagong. The detection rate is about 3.5 percent. However, no one has died from coronavirus in the same period. Earlier, 35 new cases of corona were detected yesterday, Tuesday. The detection rate was 3 percent. 

This information was given in the latest corona-related report sent to the media from the Chittagong District Civil Surgeon's Office on Wednesday. 

According to the Civil Surgeon's Office, 1,581 samples were tested in Chittagong in the last 24 hours. Of these, 53 tested positive for corona. The detection rate is 3.35. Of the people detected in the last 24 hours, 49 are from the city and 4 are from various upazilas outside the city. 

According to government figures, 1,322 people have died from corona in Chittagong so far. A total of 1,2769 people have been detected with corona in the district. 

The first corona patient was detected in Chittagong on April 3 last year. Then on April 9, the first person died from the virus. After that, the last time there was zero corona infection in this district was on December 4.

Headline_English: Kidnapped as a child, finds family three decades later by drawing pictures
Content_Enlish:
In 1988, Li Jingwei, a Chinese citizen, was abducted at the age of four from her village in southwestern Yunnan province. The kidnapper was an acquaintance of Li's family. The man, named Tisi, handed Li over to another family. Since then, Li started living with that family in a central area of ​​Henan province. However, her mind kept wandering to her hometown. More than 30 years have passed since she was born. Finally, thanks to social media, online publicity, and a draft map drawn from her own memories, Li recently met her parents. In an interview with a Chinese media outlet, the US media outlet CNN published Li's description of that experience. 

Although she was young at the time of the abduction, Li realized that she had been taken far away from her family. Even after growing up, she had no way of returning to her hometown. Because Li could not remember the name she was given at birth, the names of her parents, or the name of her village. But he could remember what the village house looked like. There were trees, grazing cows, winding roads, and a flowing river. He remembers that there were rice fields and ponds next to the house. Bamboo groves grew on the nearby hills. Whenever he remembered his home as a child, he would draw pictures of his village. He would draw at least once a day. 

Child abduction has become a long-standing problem in China. Experts say that this crisis is caused by the one-child policy that has been in force in China for a long time. Under this policy, couples who gave birth to more than one child in China had to pay a huge fine. If they had a second child, they were forced to have an abortion. However, this policy has now been relaxed. 

Many Chinese families, especially those living in rural areas, traditionally give importance to sons. They believe that sons carry on the family line. On the one hand, the low birth rate and on the other hand, the demand for boys have led to the illegal sale and purchase of them. Many families are adopting their daughters. 
In recent years, thanks to technology, social media and the efforts of the police, several abductees have been reunited with their families. These children are now adults. Last summer, a man named Guo Xinzhen was returned to his family. He was kidnapped in 1997 at the age of two. His birth parents searched desperately for him across the country. The story of Guo’s abduction, his parents’ efforts and their reunion has been made into a film in China. 

After the incident, Li himself was inspired to find his parents. Thinking back to his childhood memories, he drew a rough map of his village. He sketched out the village’s streets and showed where everything was. He then shared the image on social media. 

A video of Li’s speech was posted on the Chinese video platform Dayin. In it, Li said, “Many years have passed. I don’t know if anyone in the family is looking for me,” Li said in the video, expressing his strong desire to be reunited with his family. 

The drawing was widely shared on social media. It caught the attention of the Ministry of Public Security, which investigates cases of abductions in childhood. Authorities quickly identified Li’s possible birth mother in Zhaotong, Yunnan province. DNA samples were collected to confirm their relationship. The results, obtained on December 28, showed that their DNA matched. 

After the DNA match, Li spoke to his mother on a video call. He immediately recognized her. “My mother and I have the same lips. Even our teeth are the same,” Li said. 

The video was widely shared on state media and social media. It shows Li touching his mother’s feet and receiving blessings, and they embrace each other while crying. Other members of Li’s family and supporters were also seen there. "I finally found my son," his mother told The Paper. 

After several days of video calls, the mother and son were reunited at a police station in Henan province on the morning of January 1. They thanked the public security department for its investigation. Volunteers and online users helped find the village after seeing the map Li drew. 

Li is planning to celebrate the Lunar New Year with his mother in February. He wants to return to Yunnan to visit his father's grave.

Headline_English: Parimoni's trial begins in drug case
Content_Enlish:
The court has framed charges against actress Parimani and three others in a case under the Narcotics Control Act. The court has set February 1 as the date for the start of testimony in the case. 

Judge Mohammad Nazrul Islam of Dhaka's Special Judge's Court-10 issued the order on Wednesday. Parimani's lawyer Nilanjana Rifat confirmed this information to Prothom Alo. 

According to court sources, Parimani and three other accused were present in the court during the hearing of the charge sheet in the case. They claimed their innocence. They want justice from the court. 

The accused had applied for exemption from the case. The court rejected this application. The trial of the case began with the court's charge sheet order. 

The other two accused in the case are Ashraful Islam and Kabir Hossain. 

On August 4 last year, RAB conducted a raid on Parimani's house in Banani, the capital. Later, he was arrested in a Narcotics Control Act case filed at the capital's Gulshan Police Station. 

Two months into the case, the Criminal Investigation Department (CID) of the police filed a chargesheet against Parimoni and three others in the court on October 4 last year. 19 people have been made witnesses in the chargesheet. 

The chargesheet submitted by the police was taken into consideration by the Dhaka Metropolitan Sessions Judge's Court on November 15 last year. Later, the case was transferred to Dhaka Special Judge's Court-10 for trial. 

The chargesheet states that there were no valid documents for the drugs seized from Parimoni's house. The Narcotics Control Department informed the CID in writing that a license to consume alcoholic beverages was issued in Parimoni's name in the 2019-2020 fiscal year. The validity of that license expired on June 30 last year. Parimoni had collected illegal drugs from different places through the two accused in the case, Ashraful and Kabir, and kept them in his house. He could not give any satisfactory answer about keeping the drugs. Parimoni used his car to transport drugs.

Headline_English: Police inspector's wife arrested for cheating to get love trap
Content_Enlish:
The police have arrested the wife of a police inspector in Rangpur on charges of being involved in a gang that defrauded millions of taka by trapping them in love. She was arrested from the Banani Para area of ​​College Road in the city on Tuesday evening.

The woman's name is Kanij Fatima (36). She is the wife of Inspector Habibur Rahman of the Rangpur District Police Superintendent's Office. Rangpur Kotwali Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Abdur Rashid confirmed the matter to Prothom Alo.

Earlier, RAB arrested the head of the gang, Shahrukh Karim (34) and his wife Asmani Akhter (24), on Sunday night. The gang is accused of taking hostages and extorting money by trapping them in love and taking them to a torture cell.

OC Abdur Rashid said that on December 23, a person named Ashraful Islam filed a case against the Shahrukh-Asmani couple on the charge of being a victim of fraud. The couple gave a confessional statement under Section 164 in the court on Monday night. In this, the name of Kaniz Fatima, who was involved in their gang, came up.

After confirming the matter, the police arrested Kaniz Fatima last night. Police said that Kaniz Fatima will be sent to jail through the court on Wednesday afternoon.

Although attempts were made to contact Kaniz Fatima's husband Habibur Rahman on his mobile phone several times in this regard, his number was found to be switched off.

Headline_English: Former SP Babul's bail denied in wife murder case
Content_Enlish:
The court has rejected the bail application of former Superintendent of Police (SP) Babul Akhter in the murder case of his wife Mahmuda Khanam alias Mitu. Chittagong Metropolitan Sessions Judge Sheikh Ashfaqur Rahman gave the order after the hearing on Wednesday afternoon.

Chittagong Metropolitan Government Prosecutor Fakhruddin Chowdhury told Prothom Alo that his lawyer had applied for bail for Babul Akhter, who was detained in jail. The state opposed the bail. After hearing from both sides, the court rejected Babul's bail application.

On June 5, 2016, Mahmuda was hacked and shot dead in the GEC intersection area of ​​Chittagong city while he was going to drop his eldest son to the school bus. The only witness to the incident was Mahmuda's 12-year-old son. After the murder, Babul filed a case with Panchlaish Police Station. He mentioned in the complaint that militants could have killed his wife.

Initially, the DB police were investigating the case. The Mahmuda murder case took a turn after Babul Akhter was questioned at the DB office on June 24, 2016. At that time, news spread that Babul Akhter was involved in the murder. On September 6 of that year, a notification from the Home Ministry said that Babul was dismissed from service following his application.

Later, the Police Bureau of Investigation (PBI) started investigating the case. On May 12 of last year, the PBI submitted its final report to the court in this case. It said that Babul had his wife killed for three lakh taka. On that day, Babul's father-in-law Mosharraf Hossain filed a case with Panchlaish Police Station, accusing eight people including Babul. After being remanded for five days in this case, Babul was produced in court and questioned, but he refused to give a statement. Babul has been in jail since May 17 of last year. He is currently in Feni Jail.

The PBI is investigating the case filed by Babul and his father-in-law.

Headline_English: Youth killed in clash between supporters of 2 member candidates in Anwara
Content_Enlish:

According to police and local sources, a clash broke out between workers and supporters of UP candidate Raghunath Sarkar and another candidate Nazim Uddin about 200 yards away from the Singhara Government Primary School in the union. Anwara Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Didarul Islam Sikder said that a youth was killed during the clash near the polling station. His body has been sent to Chittagong Medical College Hospital for autopsy.

Headline_English: Mercantile Bank to remain closed for 5 days

Headline_English: More than 3 billion email passwords leaked online
Content_Enlish:
It is reported that more than 3.2 billion or 3 billion emails and passwords have been leaked in an online hacking forum. 

This COMB (Compilation of Many Breaches) data includes usernames, emails and passwords of several apps including Netflix, LinkedIn, Bitcoin. An investigation has already been started to deal with the situation. A committee has also been formed by the cyber department. It is reported that the concerned committee will submit a detailed report on this within the next one month. 

According to a report published in CyberNews, the recently leaked database contains multiple online scripts. The scripts are count-total.sh, query.sh and sorter.sh. This COMB data is also arranged in alphabetical order. In total, the database contains a total of 3.27 billion emails and passwords. 

According to technology experts, users can face big problems in this case. There are many users who keep the same password for all sites, apps, and social media. That is, the login password for Google is the same as the password for Netflix.

According to experts, to avoid such dangers, one should keep as many different and different passwords as possible. It should be seen whether each password is strong or not. If possible, two-factor authentication should be enabled. In this case, one can be quite safe.

Headline_English: Chief Justice urges countrymen to get vaccinated
Content_Enlish:
We have been vaccinated, came to court today, there was no problem - Chief Justice. Syed Mahmud Hossain has urged all citizens of the country to get vaccinated. 
Earlier, 55 Supreme Court judges took the vaccine against coronavirus (COVID-19) yesterday. Among them, there are 7 judges of the Appellate Division, including the Chief Justice, and 48 judges of the High Court Division. 

On Sunday at 3 pm, the Chief Justice's wife received the vaccine at Shaheed Suhrawardy Medical College Hospital. However, earlier yesterday morning, several judges including Justice M. Enayetur Rahim of the High Court Division got vaccinated at Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujib Medical University Hospital. 

After getting vaccinated, the Chief Justice said, I have been vaccinated. My wife has also been vaccinated. So far, I have not had any problem. Headline_English: Threat of severe water shortages worldwide
Content_Enlish:
The Himalayan ice is melting at twice the rate of the last century. Environmental scientists have made this observation after observing satellite images of the last 40 years of 2,000 kilometers of about 6.5 billion glaciers in India, China, and Nepal-Bhutan. 

Frequent floods are seen in areas adjacent to the Himalayas. Scientists are also afraid that rivers will dry up after a few decades of melting glaciers. This could lead to a severe water crisis across the world. Researchers have blamed global warming as the main cause. Environmental scientists have given this important information in an article in the Science Advances journal of Columbia University in the United States. 
More than one and a half feet of ice has melted every year since 2000 due to global warming. 

The article says that smoke and other chemicals emitted from fuel accumulate on the snow-covered mountains of the Himalayas. Which absorbs the sun's heat and accelerates the process of melting glaciers. This has an impact on the flow of rivers in Asia. GeographicReference 
Frequent floods are occurring due to untimely melting glaciers. Even if all the glaciers melt, all the rivers may dry up after a few decades. Scientists have warned that about a quarter of the Himalayan glaciers have melted due to global warming in the last 4 decades. 

The main rivers in Asia originate in the Himalayas. The livelihoods of about 800 million people in these regions depend on these rivers. If the glaciers melt at twice the speed, scientists fear that a terrible disaster will come to this densely populated region due to severe water shortage. 

Therefore, environmental scientists have called for reducing global warming and greenhouse gases as much as possible while there is still time. Humans have a lot to play in making the world habitable.

Headline_English: Youth stabbed to death for stopping drug use in Noakhali
Content_Enlish:
A young man named Omar Faruk was hacked to death by some drug addicts at the Choumuhoni intersection in Begumganj, Noakhali. He was allegedly hacked to death around 9 am on Monday for stopping him from consuming drugs recently. 
The injured Omar Faruk is the son of Abdul Gafur of Madhyam Nazirpur village in the upazila. He is the vice-president of the local social organization Jubo Kalyan Sangha and works as a volunteer in collecting coronavirus samples at the Sonaimuri Upazila Health Complex. 

The injured person and locals said that recently some mischievous youths from the area entered the Jubo Kalyan Sangha and consumed yaba. When they stopped them in this incident, they got angry with Omar Faruk. They also threatened him in various ways. On Monday, when Omar Faruk was on his way to the Sonaimuri Health Complex, some youths blocked his path at the intersection Janani bus stand area and hacked him to death before he could understand anything. 

Later, locals rescued him and first took him to the Begumganj 10-bed health complex, then the doctors sent him to the General Hospital. Later, after smuggling weapons into his body, he was admitted to the 250-bed hospital. 

When asked, Begumganj Police Station OC Kamruzzaman Sheikh said that the police have visited the scene and the hospital. He also said that efforts are being made to arrest the accused. He also said that preparations are underway to file a case in this incident.

Headline_English: Students will get money to buy clothes and shoes once schools reopen
Content_Enlish:
When government primary schools open, students will be given money to buy clothes and shoes. This money will be sent to the mobile numbers of guardians through the mobile banking service 'Nagad'. Each student will be given 1,000 taka as kids allowance, said State Minister for Primary and Mass Education Md. Zakir Hossain.

State Minister Zakir Hossain said that due to the closure of educational institutions due to the Corona situation, it was not possible to give 1,000 taka as kids allowance to students to buy clothes and shoes. We have added the information of all the students. This money will be delivered to the students through Nagad when the schools open. 

The minister said that from now on, stipend money will be given to government primary school students through Nagad. The program was inaugurated on Monday by providing stipends for the last three months to 86,052 people from eight upazilas. The stipend money will be sent to all districts of the country through Nagad in phases. 

The State Minister said that each student will be given 450 taka for the last three months. More than 3 crore 64 lakhs will be distributed to eight upazilas for this. 

Regarding the distribution of stipend programs through Nagad, the State Minister said that earlier, although stipend money was given through Sure Cash, various complications arose because there was no birth registration of the students and national identity cards of the guardians. In addition, we will be able to deliver this money to the students through Nagad at a much lower cost than before. Considering these issues, an agreement has been made with Nagad in this regard. 

Present at the time were - Secretary of the Ministry of Primary and Mass Education GM Hasibul Alam, Director General of the Department of Primary Education AM Mansurul Alam, etc.

Headline_English: Is Messi going to PSG?
Content_Enlish:
Lionel Messi's contract with Barcelona ends at the end of this season. He can stay at Barcelona now, or join any other club without a transfer fee if he wants. 

At the end of last season, when Messi wanted to leave Barcelona, ​​English club Manchester City showed interest in taking him.

Messi himself wants to go to PSG now because of his relationship with Neymar. Such is the news of the European media. PSG also wants to welcome Messi with due respect. If two or four are combined, Messi and Neymar will be seen playing shoulder to shoulder at the Parc de France.

Not only that, Neymar has already signed a new four-year contract with PSG. Analysts say that the Brazilian star signed a long-term contract with PSG because of the increased possibility of Messi's arrival.

Content_Enlish:

Headline_English: Rail communication not normal; people are collecting oil
Content_Enlish:
Seven coaches of an oil-laden train derailed in Fenchuganj, Sylhet, but rail communication has not been restored even after 18 hours. Railway authorities are working to recover the coaches and repair the lines. 
Local people spent the day collecting the oil spilled around the railway line in the accident on Thursday night. The Railways has formed a 5-member committee to investigate the incident. 

Seven coaches of an oil-laden train derailed in the Gutigaon area between Maijgaon and Biyalibazar in Fenchuganj around 12 midnight on Thursday. 

As a result, the fuel oil in the train wagons spread to the surrounding area. Locals started collecting oil with pots, pans, buckets, drums and other containers since last night. 

Railway Police Station OC Abdus Sattar said that additional police have been deployed at the scene due to the fear of an accident. 

Locals are blaming the lack of sleepers on the railway line and lack of regular maintenance as the reasons for the accident. 

Railway authorities started rescue operations since last night to recover the derailed coach of the oil-laden train. 

Meanwhile, a five-member investigation committee headed by Railway Divisional Transport Officer Khairul Islam has been formed to investigate the incident. They have also been ordered to submit an investigation report within three days.

Headline_English: 4 Bangladeshis injured in random shooting at Canadian park
Content_Enlish:
Four Bangladeshis were shot in a random shooting in the Regent Park area of ​​Toronto, Canada. One of them is in critical condition, police said. The injured are being treated at a hospital. Bangladesh News 
The incident took place at around 12:15 am on Tuesday night in the parking lot of Oak Street adjacent to Regent Park Boulevard and Dundas Street. 

Jalalabad Association of Toronto President Debabrata De Tamal said in a post on Facebook that Golapganj Foundation Vice President Anai Mia, Marhaba Grocery's Mumin Mia, Sultan Mia and Chattar Mia were injured in random shooting. Among them, Anai Mia is in critical condition. The other three are out of danger. 

Police said that they went to the scene after receiving reports of random shooting in the parking lot of Oak Street adjacent to Regent Park Boulevard and Dundas Street. They saw a Honda Accord car with numerous bullet holes there. They later rescued the three and sent them to the hospital. Police also said that they have collected video footage from the scene. They are looking for two suspects. The suspects are believed to be using a 2014 Toyota Rav 4. 
The incident has sparked outrage, condemnation and demands for the immediate arrest and trial of the culprits among the Jalalabad Association of Toronto and expatriates living in Canada.

Headline_English: Everyone must remain united to confront evil forces: Bridge Minister
Content_Enlish:
Awami League General Secretary and Road Transport and Bridges Minister Obaidul Quader said that BNP's undemocratic behavior and politics of conspiracy are the main obstacles to the development of democracy in Bangladesh. 
He said that anti-democracy and anti-development forces are still active at home and abroad. Everyone must remain united to strengthen Sheikh Hasina's hand in confronting these forces. 

He said these things at a press conference organized on contemporary issues at his official residence this Thursday morning. 
The Democracy Index 2020 report published by the Economist Intelligence Unit said that Bangladesh's democracy has advanced four more steps in the past one year. Bangladesh News 

Obaidul Quader said that while the scope of democracy has narrowed in different countries of the world due to the Corona pandemic, this progress in Bangladesh is a global recognition of the Sheikh Hasina government's progress in advancing democracy. By putting a smile on the faces of critics, this report highlights to the world the continuous progress of the country's democratic system during the Corona period. 

Obaidul Quader also said that this recognition will further accelerate the pace of Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina's progress on the path of democracy. Stating that the role of the opposition party along with the government is very important in the country's democratic journey, the Road Transport Minister said that BNP often says that the government wants to make the country devoid of opposition parties. In fact, the people want to see BNP as a responsible and strong opposition party. 

He said that even though the BNP Secretary General is abroad for medical treatment, he is criticizing the government in apolitical language and throwing stones in the dark. The statement made by Mirza Fakhrul while sitting abroad is nothing but a trick of words containing lies and fabricated allegations. 

Stating that BNP is criticizing the government by forgetting its past, the Awami League General Secretary said that BNP itself is now crazy. They are now talking nonsense to escape the wrath of the workers after failing to find a way out in the dark. 

He said that BNP is alleging that the government has planned to make corruption, disappearances, murders and occupation a part of political culture. Regarding such unrealistic statements by BNP leaders, Obaidul Quader said that everything that is anti-people and harmful in politics in this country has been done by BNP. 

The Bridge Minister instructed to start the process of forming expired committees in organizational areas outside the areas where the ongoing fourth and fifth phase of municipal elections will be held or are being held, and said that initiatives should be taken to form committees through conferences in all districts, upazilas, unions, and wards where the committee term has expired. The union council elections will start after the municipal elections. Therefore, everyone should take organizational preparations from now on.

Headline_English: New Zealand quakes three times, tsunami warning issued again
Content_Enlish:
New Zealand hit by three powerful earthquakes in one day. Another earthquake measuring 8.1 on the Richter scale struck off the coast of New Zealand on Friday morning, prompting tsunami warnings in some areas and residents being asked to evacuate. 

German media Deutsche Welle reported that the powerful earthquake struck the northeastern Kermadec Islands just before 9am local time. The BBC reported that the third earthquake struck New Zealand at 8.30am on Friday. 

The latest 8.1-magnitude earthquake was felt on the Kermadec Islands in the northwestern part of the country's North Island. The 8.1-magnitude earthquake struck shortly after a 7.4-magnitude earthquake struck in the same area. Earlier in the day, a 7.2-magnitude earthquake struck about 900km (560 miles) off the North Island. 

New Zealand's National Emergency Management Agency (NEMA) said the first tsunami wave was expected to hit the north coast at around 9:45 a.m. (local time). The coasts of Whangarei, Matata, Tolaga Island, as well as Whakatane, Apotiki and Great Barrier Island are at risk. Warnings have also been issued for Tonga, American Samoa, Fiji, Vanuatu, Hawaii and other Pacific islands. 

According to various reports, the BBC reported that people in several New Zealand cities rushed to higher ground after the third strongest earthquake struck. People are running in panic. 

New Zealand's Minister for Civil Defence Kiri Allan said, "The situation is changing rapidly. We urge those who have taken shelter in higher and safer places to remain in their places until further notice. 

New Zealand authorities have warned that the tsunami could cause waves of up to three meters (10 feet) to hit the coast. In addition, some South American countries, including Peru, Ecuador and Chile, have been warned of waves of up to one meter high.

Headline_English: What Janhvi Kapoor said about being compared to Priyanka Chopra

Headline_English: There are 7 instructions in DU admission test
Content_Enlish:
Dhaka University (DU) admission test is starting after about 6 months of normal time due to Corona situation. The application process for admission to the 1st year undergraduate (honors) class of the 2020-21 academic year is starting from Monday (March 8). This information was published on the university website on Friday (March 5). 

This application can be made by visiting the university's own admission website from 4 pm on March 8. The application will continue until 11:59 pm on March 31. 

In addition, 7 urgent instructions have been given for applicants on the admission website. 

1. For the admission application, the student will have to provide higher secondary and secondary information, current address and mobile phone number, and parents' national identity card number (optional). 

2. The student will have to select any 1 of the 8 divisional cities as his admission center. 

3. A scanned photograph (Format: jpg, Size: 30–200KB, Width: 360-540px, Height: 540-720px) will be required. 

4. To send SMS, the student must have a mobile phone number of any one of the Teletalk, Robi, Airtel or Banglalink operators. 

5. The admission application fee can be submitted immediately online (VISA /Mastercard / American Express debit or credit card, mobile banking, internet banking) or at four state-owned banks (Sonali, Janata, Agrani and Rupali) within the specified time period. 

6. To determine the equivalence of A-Level / O-Level / equivalent foreign curriculum or open university, students must go to the admission.eis.du.ac.bd website and apply under the ‘Equivalence Application’ menu and submit the prescribed fee immediately online. 

7. After determining the equivalence, they can log in to the same website like ordinary students and apply for the admission test. 

It is noteworthy that earlier, the schedule for the first-year admission test for the 2020-2021 academic year of DU was published on February 18. According to the schedule, this test will be conducted under five units from May 21 to June 5.

Headline_English: 1 terabyte of storage on the iPhone!
Content_Enlish:
Apple fans are eagerly awaiting the new iPhone. But the good news for Apple fans is that although Apple did not initially emphasize increasing the built-in storage on the iPhone, it has increased it significantly in recent times. Despite this, the iPhone is still lagging behind its rival premium Android phones. Many models of these phones now support up to 1 terabyte of storage.

Of course, since cloud storage has become readily available, there is no need for much built-in storage on ordinary phones. Many people can continue working with only 32 GB of storage. However, this is undoubtedly good news for those who work with high-resolution videos. 

The iPhone 13 is expected to be unveiled in September-November. In the meantime, various rumors have started circulating in the market. Notable features in this version may include an always-on display, which will again have a refresh rate of 120 Hz. Apple may bring 4 more new iPhones this year. These 4 models are iPhone 12 mini, iPhone 12, iPhone 12 Pro, iPhone 12 Max Pro. Each phone will have 5G network support. The size of the iPhones will be between 5.4 inches and 6.7 inches.

Headline_English: Tamima's ex-husband Rakib files writ in High Court

Headline_English: Anushka raped and murdered: Report against Dihan postponed
Content_Enlish:
The date for submitting the report against Fardin Iftefar Dihan, accused of raping and murdering Anushka Nur Amin, an 'O' level' student of Mastermind School in the capital's Kalabagan, has been postponed again. 
The date for submitting the report in the case was set for Tuesday (March 2). But as the investigation officer, Kalabagan Police Station Inspector (Investigation) AFM Asaduzzaman, was unable to submit the report, Dhaka Metropolitan Magistrate Begum Yasmin Ara fixed March 21 for the report. 
The investigation officer, Police Inspector AFM Asaduzzaman, had earlier said that a DNA test was conducted on the accused Dihan, but the report was not available. The forensic department of Dhaka Medical College has been urged to submit the DNA and autopsy reports. Once the report is received, a charge sheet will be filed soon after reviewing it. 

On the morning of January 7, Anushka Nur Amin, an 'O' level' student of Mastermind School in Dhanmondi in the capital, left her house after receiving a mobile call from her friend Dihan. Dihan then took Anushka to his house in Dolphin Goli, Kalabagan. When the girl fell ill after having physical intercourse in the empty house, Dihan and four friends took her to Anwar Khan Modern Medical College Hospital in Dhanmondi. The doctor on duty there declared the girl dead. The doctors said that she died of excessive bleeding after being raped. 

The father of the deceased filed a case with Kalabagan Police Station on the night of January 7, making Fardin Iftefar Dihan the sole accused in the rape and murder of the schoolgirl. 

On January 8, Dihan voluntarily confessed to the crime in the court of Dhaka Metropolitan Magistrate Mamunur Rashid.

Headline_English: Home remedies for hair care
Content_Enlish:
Hair falls out more or less for everyone. Some people may lose less, some more. It is normal to lose 50 to 100 hairs a day. However, it becomes a cause for concern if it is more. Again, even if you worry about hair loss more, you will still lose more hair. To avoid this hair loss problem, you must first know what is causing your hair to fall. 

Find out the reason and then solve that problem. Then your hair will stop falling out on its own. But not only that, you also need to take regular care to stop hair fall and keep the hair roots strong. 

Taking care of your hair does not have to be time-consuming or expensive. At a low cost, some simple household items can also become your hair care tools. Let's find out which household ingredients work like magic to prevent hair loss- 

Amalaki 

Amalaki contains a lot of vitamin C, anti-oxidants and anti-inflammatory ingredients, which work great to stop hair fall. To keep the scalp healthy and grow hair fast, use a mixture of amla and jaggery. 

How to use 

Boil 4 to 5 dried amla in a cup of coconut oil. Boil the oil until it turns black. Then drain it and let it cool. Now massage your head with the oil and leave it for 30 minutes. Then wash it off with shampoo and water. Use it twice a week for good results. 

Aloe Vera 

Just as aloe vera is good for the skin, it is also beneficial for the hair. It stops hair fall and helps in growing new hair. It also relieves itching of the scalp and helps in maintaining the natural pH level of this skin. And it is also good for removing dandruff. 

How to use 

Take a large aloe vera leaf and remove its inner shell. Then apply the shell well on the scalp and leave it for 45 minutes. Then wash it off with cold water. Use it 3 to 4 days a week for good results. 
Fenugreek 

Fenugreek works very well in preventing hair fall. The protein and nicotinic acid in it help strengthen the hair roots and make the hair shiny and long. 

How to use 

Soak a cup of fenugreek in water overnight and grind it the next morning to make a paste. Then apply the paste on your hair and scalp and leave it for 30 minutes. If possible, cover your head with a shower cap. After that, wash it with water. There is no need to use shampoo. If you use it 2 days a week for 1 month, you will get shiny, thick, long hair.

Headline_English: 29 districts on high-risk list for coronavirus infection
Content_Enlish:
The global corona pandemic is not stopping in any way. The second wave is underway. In the meantime, the number of deaths due to corona in the world has exceeded 2.796 million and 127.7 million infected. And in Bangladesh, the number of deaths has increased to 8,949 as of yesterday. The total number of corona patients in the country has now reached 595,714. Meanwhile, there were 6 high-risk districts in the country 12 days ago. But this number has increased to 29. 

The districts include Dhaka, Chittagong, Narayanganj, Munshiganj, Feni, Chandpur, Nilphamari, Sylhet, Tangail, Gazipur, Comilla, Rajbari, Shariatpur, Kurigram, Narsingdi, Noakhali, Laxmipur, Madaripur, Naogaon and Rajshahi. 

Additional Director General Professor Dr. Meerjadi Sabrina Flora told reporters this information in a virtual press conference of the Directorate General of Health Services on Monday (March 29).

Flora said that they identify high-risk districts by looking at the trend of coronavirus infection every week. During the analysis of data on March 13, they found only six high-risk districts. Later, in a week, on March 20, this number increased to 20 and on March 24, this number increased to 29. 

In response to the question whether measures to control the infection in high-risk districts will be taken centrally or locally, Dr. Flora said that the local district administration, police administration and health department will jointly review the local infection situation and take all possible measures. 

It is worth noting that the first coronavirus infection was detected in the country on March 8 last year. After November 30, the infection continued to decrease continuously until mid-February. But since the beginning of March, the number of daily detected patients and deaths has been increasing continuously. On Monday, 5,181 people were diagnosed with corona in a single day, which is the highest since the start of the pandemic.

Headline_English: Iran will stop enriching uranium to 20% if sanctions are lifted
Content_Enlish:

Yesterday (Monday) evening, the Iranian official told Press TV that uranium enrichment to 20 levels is underway in accordance with Article 36 of the nuclear deal and that this program can only be stopped after the sanctions are lifted from Iran. 

He stressed that Iran will not stop its current nuclear activities until all sanctions are lifted from Iran. 

The Iranian official also said, “The Biden administration is wasting time. If they do not lift sanctions on Iran soon, Tehran will take further steps that will further reduce the implementation of the commitments made in the nuclear deal.” 

The American Politico magazine reported in a report that the Biden administration is coming up with new proposals to resolve the ongoing impasse on the nuclear issue. Then the Iranian official told Press TV.

Headline_English: The first 'supermoon' of the year will be visible at midnight tonight
Content_Enlish:
The first 'supermoon' of the year will be seen in the midnight sky today. The moon looks bigger than usual, which is why it is called a 'supermoon'. 

NASA's statement said that the moon will come closest to the Earth while orbiting in orbit at 12:48 am on Sunday. That is why it will appear large to our eyes. At that time, the moon and the sun will be exactly opposite each other according to the longitude of the Earth. 

NASA's statement said that a very large moon will be seen in the night sky for 3 consecutive days. 

The media also said that in 1979, such a large moon was given the name 'supermoon'. Meanwhile, a section of NASA astronomers said that there will be 4 'supermoons' this year. They will be seen between March and June. Some are saying that 3 'supermoons' will be in April and May.

Headline_English: The greatest success in the 50 years of independence has been in the economy.
Content_Enlish:
Bangladesh's economy has achieved the most success in the 50 years of independence. The bottomless basket is now a developing country. One record after another is being set in exports and remittances due to the sweat of workers, while per capita income has exceeded two thousand dollars. Bangladesh News 

GDP growth has exceeded five percent even amid Corona. Experts say that if mega projects are implemented quickly and employment is created, it is possible to take this achievement to unprecedented heights. 

Nine months after the announcement of the Father of the Nation, that great moment, great independence, came. However, economic liberation was elusive. In 1972, the then US Secretary of State Henry Kissinger did not hesitate to compare Bangladesh with a bottomless basket. However, in fifty years, that picture has completely reversed. 

The movement of such expensive cars on the roads of the capital Dhaka shows how much Sonar Bangla has developed. Despite being a small country, Bangladesh is the second in the world in garment exports. Remittances are also being recorded thanks to the sweat of one crore workers. GeographicReference 

Reserves have exceeded 44 billion. Per capita income stands at $2064. And GDP growth is above five percent even amid Corona. Bangladesh is self-sufficient in food due to incredible success in agriculture. 

The dream Padma Bridge is being built with its own financing. In addition, the construction of the Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant, Metrorail, Elevated Expressway, and Karnaphuli Tunnel will change the economy of the entire country. Along with this, the government wants to create employment for one crore people by implementing one hundred economic zones. 
Experts say that Bangladesh will have to take on the challenge of implementing infrastructure and increasing the speed of exports. Everyone expects that Bangladesh, which is among the developing countries, will become a developed country before the desired time.

Headline_English: Two sentenced to death, 13 others to life in Sunamganj murder case
Content_Enlish:
The court has sentenced two people to death and 13 others to life imprisonment in the case of shooting dead two people over a past enmity in Sunamganj. 

Sunamganj Additional Sessions Judge Nurul Alam Mohammad Nipu gave the verdict on Thursday afternoon. 

The court's Assistant Public Prosecutor (APP) Advocate Syed Ziaul Islam confirmed the verdict in the case. The sentenced persons are from Kamdevpur village of Sreepur Dakshin Union of Tahirpur Upazila of the district. 

The two who were sentenced to death are Abdul Hannan alias Jatra Mia and Shassuddin alias Shamsu Mia. The life convicts are Abdul Mannan, Inu Mia, Renu Mia, Hamdu Mia, Afzal Mia, Jalal Uddin, Abdul Nur, Sabuj Mia, Babul Mia, Alkas Mia, Badal Mia, Rahmat Ali and Manu Mia. 
According to the case source, there was a previous dispute between the two sides over dominance in Kamdevpur village of Tahirpur upazila. As a result, on March 18, 2000, a member of one side was beaten up by people from the other side. The next morning, a mediation was scheduled to be held in the village. On the way to the mediation, Arpan Ali and Matiur Rahman were seriously injured by the opposing party's gunfire. They died after being taken to the Tahirpur Upazila Health Complex. 


The victim's relative, Ataur Rahman, filed a murder case with Tahirpur police station on the same day, accusing 28 people. After investigating the case, the police filed a chargesheet against 37 people in the court on March 31, 2001. Nine accused died during the trial of the case. The court gave its verdict on Thursday after a long hearing in the case.

Headline_English: Bangladesh will move forward under Sheikh Hasina's leadership to fulfill Bangabandhu's dream: Amu
Content_Enlish:
Awami League Advisory Council member, Central 14-party coordinator and spokesperson Amir Hossain Amu said that Bangabandhu was able to stir the Bengali nation towards the spirit of nationalism step by step through movement and struggle. Bangladesh News 
He said that for almost four thousand years, Bengalis were under the rule of different nations in various ways. Their dream of independence was a long-standing one. By germinating the seeds of that dream of independence desired for thousands of years, Bangabandhu was able to convince Bengalis that the only way to survive was independence. 

Amir Hossain Amu said that on the one hand, Bangabandhu, through his political foresight and organizational activities, organized his party Awami League and mobilized people against Pakistani rule, exploitation, torture and oppression, and on the other hand, he united them in the struggle for independence through the party's propaganda and movement struggle. Bangabandhu has proven through his political sacrifices that he was the only address of trust and faith of the Bengalis. 

Expressing gratitude to the great creator for celebrating the golden jubilee of independence when the Awami League, the organization that led the liberation war, was in power, Amir Hossain Amu said, Bangabandhu's lifelong dream was a self-reliant, prosperous nation. To fulfill that dream, his worthy daughter, Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina, is moving forward on the path indicated by Bangabandhu, ignoring all adversities. And that is why today, the Bangladesh of Bangabandhu's dream has transformed into a Bangladesh of development, has entered a developing country. Bangladesh will move forward with this success.

Headline_English: Explosion in residential building in Narayanganj, 11 including children burnt
Content_Enlish:
Eleven people from two families, including a three-month-old baby, were burnt in an explosion in a flat in the West Tower area of ​​Narayanganj city. The accident occurred early on Friday (April 23). 

The explosion blew two walls of the third-floor flat and fell on the roof of the neighboring building, breaking the glass of the building's doors and windows. The kitchen wall collapsed in the explosion. Hearing a loud noise, locals gathered. They rescued the injured and took them to the hospital. 

Five of the burnt people, including baby Mahira, have been admitted to the capital's Sheikh Hasina National Burn and Plastic Surgery Institute in a serious condition. The rest have been sent to Narayanganj General Hospital. 
The burnt people admitted to the Sheikh Hasina National Burn and Plastic Surgery Institute are - Md. Habibur (40), his wife Aleya Begum (38), his son Limon (17), daughter Mim (18), three-month-old baby Mahira. The other burnt people are Md. Sonahar (40), Shanti Akter (30), Samiul (25), Monowara (22) and Sathi (25). The name of the other person is not known. Most of the injured people are garment factory workers. 

Narayanganj Fire Service Deputy Assistant Director Abdullah Al Arefin said that initially it is believed that gas was accumulated in the house due to leakage in the stove or gas line, which exploded when it came into contact with fire. However, the matter is being investigated.

Headline_English: Oxygen produced on Mars for the first time by machine
Content_Enlish:
NASA's Perseverance rover has used a small device to produce oxygen from Martian carbon dioxide. The device is called the Mars Oxygen In-Situ Resource Utilization Experiment, or MOXI for short. 
This is the second such technological achievement in NASA's Mars mission. Previously, a mini helicopter from Perseverance flew over Mars. 

The device used to produce oxygen on Mars is the size of a toaster. This device produced five grams of gas - enough for an astronaut to breathe for about ten minutes on Mars. 

NASA believes that in the future, instead of carrying the oxygen they will need for their entire time on Mars from Earth, a larger version of this device called MOXI could be carried with them. 

The rockets used to go into space also need oxygen to power the rockets. The rocket gains forward momentum by burning fuel in the presence of an oxidizer. Ordinary oxygen can also be used as this oxidizer. 
The atmosphere of Mars is mostly carbon dioxide, about 96 percent. There is only 0.13 percent oxygen. However, the atmosphere of Earth has 21 percent oxygen. 

The device called MOXI can extract oxygen from Martian carbon dioxide molecules. Each molecule of carbon dioxide contains one carbon and two oxygen atoms. And after extracting this oxygen, the carbon monoxide that remains as a residue is released into the Martian atmosphere. 

"MOXI is not only the first device to produce oxygen on an alien planet, it is the first technology of its kind that will help future missions survive on other planets using the elements of that planet's environment," said Trudy Cortese, director of technology for NASA's Space Technology Mission Directorate.

The movement of ordinary people around the Chief Metropolitan Magistrate's Court in Dhaka has been monitored and searched since morning. Lawyers and trial seekers have also been kept under search in the court. 
Mohammadpur Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Abdul Latif said that Mamunul will be produced in court in the morning after a seven-day remand in a case filed by Mohammadpur Police Station.

Headline_English: Bangladeshis banned from entering Italy again
Content_Enlish:
Travelers from Bangladesh have been banned from entering Italy. The Italian Health Ministry said in a statement on Wednesday (April 28). Bangladesh News 
The Italian Health Ministry said that an executive order has been signed banning the entry of anyone who has been in Bangladesh or traveled through the country in the last 14 days into Italy through any border point. 

The European country had previously closed its borders to travelers from Bangladesh due to concerns about COVID-19 transmission.

Headline_English: The first flying vehicle flew in the skies of Mars
Content_Enlish:
The American space agency NASA has announced that it has successfully flown a small drone from the surface of Mars for the first time. This drone, named Ingenuity, flew in the Martian sky for less than a minute. 

However, NASA is happy with this success of flying a machine-driven and controlled vehicle in the sky of another planet for the first time. They said that this success paves the way for more adventurous flights in the coming days. 

This drone, weighing only one.8 kg, rose about 3 meters above the surface of Mars, the drone's wings were seen rotating, the drone moved from side to side, and after about 40 seconds, the drone successfully landed on the Martian ground again. 

Scientists say that after testing the limitations of the Ingenuity drone's technology, they now want to fly it higher and farther 

It is very difficult to fly any aircraft from the ground of Mars into the sky of the planet. The atmosphere of Mars is very thin. The planet's atmosphere is only 1% as dense as Earth's atmosphere.

Headline_English: SM Mohsin is having to be given 15 liters of oxygen per hour
Content_Enlish:
Actor SM Mohsin, who is undergoing treatment at the intensive care unit (ICU) of BIRDEM General Hospital, has deteriorated. 

He was given a bag of positive plasma on Thursday and will need more. 

Doctors have said that his condition is critical. 

Meanwhile, his son Rezwan Mohsin is worried about his father SM Mohsin's condition. 

He said, "My father's condition suddenly started deteriorating after he tested positive for COVID-19. He was taken from Holy Family Hospital to a hospital in Tejgaon to receive ICU care. When the situation deteriorated further, he was admitted to BIRDEM Hospital in Dhaka on the night of April 7. My father has a serious lung infection. I am more worried about this. 

"My father is now being given 15 liters of oxygen per hour. But the oxygen saturation is occasionally dropping below 90. Everyone should pray for my father."

Headline_English: Real Sociedad are Copa del Rey champions after 34 years
Content_Enlish:
Real Sociedad have won the Copa del Rey again after 34 years, defeating Athletic Bilbao. They last won the second-best competition in Spain in the 1986-87 season. This is Sociedad's third title in this competition known as the Spanish Cup. They first won the trophy in 1909. 
Sociedad won the final 1-0 at the La Cartuja Stadium in Seville. Sociedad dominated the match from the beginning. Athletic Bilbao suffered a double blow in the 58th minute. Spanish defender Martinez was sent off for a foul on the opponent's forward Porto in the D-box. Sociedad got a penalty. Oyarzabal made the difference from that. 

Bilbao is the second most successful club in the competition after Barcelona, ​​​​they have won 23 times. However, their last title was in the 1983-84 season. After that, they played in the final four times, but each time they were disappointed. 

They will get another chance to end their title drought in two weeks. Bilbao will face Barcelona in the 2020-21 final on April 17. 
The match against Athletic Bilbao was originally scheduled to take place in May last year. However, it was postponed due to the coronavirus outbreak.

The Department of Health Education officially published the results this evening. 

1,16,792 candidates appeared in this year's admission test. Of them, 4,350 were selected for government medical colleges. Of these, 2,09 were male and 2,341 were female. 3,937 from the current academic year. 413 from the previous academic year. That is, 48,975 people. 

It is learned that after the announcement of the results of the medical admission test, it was given on the relevant website of the department (https://result.dghs.gov.bd/mbbs/). After that, the candidates will be able to see the results from there. 

Meanwhile, Mishori Munmun came first in the merit list in this year's admission test. His roll number is 2500238 

He participated in the examination from Pabna Medical College Center. Out of 100 marks in the admission test, he got 87.25 marks.

Headline_English: New Dhaka Metropolitan BNP committee coming, who will be discussed
Content_Enlish:
The new committee of Dhaka Metropolitan BNP will be formed very soon, said the party's Secretary General Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir. GeographicReference 
And BNP standing committee member Iqbal Hasan Mahmud Tuku said that the process of forming a committee with a combination of experienced and new members is underway. At least a dozen leaders aspiring for the post have started running after the news of the committee announcement. They said that if the party gives them the responsibility, they will unite the Metropolitan South BNP with maximum effort. 

On April 18, 2017, the new committee of the Metropolitan South BNP was formed by dividing Dhaka Metropolitan into two, with Habib Un Nabi Khan Sohel as the president and Kazi Abul Bashar as the general secretary. Immediately after taking the responsibility, they got into a controversy when they took the initiative to form a police station committee to strengthen the South BNP. 

In the latest Dhaka City Corporation elections, questions were raised about the organizational capacity of the Metropolitan BNP. As a result, the high command wants to reshape Dhaka Metropolitan. Although the General Secretary of the Metropolitan South BNP claims that they are 100% successful. 

Candidates have already started vying for the new committee. Current president Habib Un Nabi Khan Sohel, general secretary Kazi Abul Bashar, joint general secretary Rabiul Alam Robi and former VP of DUCSU Aman Ullah Aman want to be the convener of the new committee. 

Current committee senior joint general secretary Habibur Rashid Habib, Jubo Dal South president Rafiqul Islam Majnu, former councilor Harun-ur Rashid and South mayoral candidate Ishraq Hossain are in discussion for the position of member secretary. 

BNP standing committee member Iqbal Hasan Mahmud Tuku said that the party's acting chairman has already taken the work of forming the committee a long way forward. He is taking advice from senior party leaders to form a strong committee. 

Responsible BNP leaders said that a new South committee could be formed by the end of this year.

Headline_English: Plasma found for COVID-19 patient Abul Hayat
Content_Enlish:
The plasma needed by Abul Ayat, who was hospitalized with COVID-19, has been found. On Thursday (April 1) evening, Abul Hayat's eldest daughter Bipasha Hayat and younger daughter Natasha confirmed this information. 
First, Bipasha Hayat said in a Facebook post from the United States that her father is infected with COVID-19 and urgently needs plasma for treatment. 

Then Natasha Hayat said that plasma has been found. She wrote in the Facebook post, "My sincere thanks and gratitude to those of you who shared the post and contacted us for the donor. A donor has been found for the father's plasma for now. His condition is stable. However, those of the 'A positive' blood group who are willing to donate plasma should contact me or my mother Shiri Hayat." 
76-year-old actor Abul Hayat has been acting in TV dramas since 1969. In his long career, he has acted in several films including 'Aguner Parashmani', 'Joyjatra', 'Gahine Shabd', 'Agnyatnama', along with numerous dramas. 

Abul Hayat received the National Film Award in 2007 for his performance in the film 'Daruchini Dweep'.

Headline_English: Bengali women get test status
Content_Enlish:
Bangladesh women's cricket team gets Test status. The board and committee meeting of the International Cricket Council (ICC) decided to grant Test status to the Bangladesh women's team, Afghanistan women's team and Zimbabwe women's team. Bangladesh News 

In a statement on Friday (April 2), the ICC said that it has been decided to grant ODI and Test status to the full ICC women's team members in the board meeting. As a result, the Bangladesh, Afghanistan and Zimbabwe women's cricket teams will now be able to play Test matches. 

Previously, 10 women's teams have played Tests. Australia, England, India, South Africa, New Zealand, Pakistan, West Indies and Sri Lanka played as the main teams. In addition, the Netherlands and Ireland women's teams have played Tests as ICC associate countries.

Headline_English: Market manipulation on the rise ahead of Ramadan
Content_Enlish:
Buyers are demanding increased monitoring to prevent anyone from manipulating the prices of daily necessities ahead of the month of Ramadan. In various markets in the capital, it can be seen that the prices of some products have already started increasing. However, the prices of several products including chicken and vegetables have decreased this week. On the other hand, the prices of TCB's open market products have increased. 
Ignoring the fear of Corona, ordinary people are buying daily necessities by standing in long lines. Buyers are happy to get a little less than the market price. TCB trucks are getting soybean oil, onions, sugar, chickpeas, but in package form. 

However, there is no new discomfort in the capital's grocery market. The increased prices of some products have not decreased yet. Potatoes are being sold at 15/16 taka per kg. Apart from this, the prices of chickpeas, buckwheat, and sugar, which are essential for Ramadan, remain unchanged. The price of fine rice is stable, but coarse rice has increased by 2/3 taka per kg. 

Some relief has started to return to the meat market. Beef is being sold at 580 taka per kg. Broiler chicken has decreased by 10 taka per kg and Pakistani chicken by 50 taka per kg. 

Vendors claim that the prices of vegetables and fish have remained unchanged. Buyers say that the prices of daily necessities should be brought under control before Ramadan. Buyers are urging the sale of daily necessities to low-income people with subsidies if necessary.

Headline_English: Army dominates Bangabandhu Olympic Games
Content_Enlish:
Army dominates athletics on the second day of the Games. All three medals in the men's marathon went to the army.

Ansar came second and Chittagong Divisional Sports Association came third. And Rakibul Hasan won the gold in the men's category of individual road time trial.
