Headline_English: Haji Selim's 10-year prison sentence upheld
Content_Enlish:
The High Court has observed that if constitutionally elected officials are involved in corruption, they should be brought to justice and rooted out. The High Court made this observation in the full verdict of Haji Selim's corruption case. 

The High Court has upheld Haji Selim's 10-year prison sentence in this case and ordered him to surrender to the judicial court within 30 days. 

The observation of the verdict given by Justice Mainul Islam Chowdhury and Justice AKM Zahirul Haque said that one has to rely only on media reports regarding assets beyond known income; which is unfortunate. 

The High Court has asked the ACC to make more efforts to eradicate corruption at all levels, including constitutional positions. 

At the same time, the state has been ordered to confiscate all of Haji Selim's properties that are in dispute. 

ACC lawyers believe that Haji Selim will not have the position of a member of parliament due to his conviction. 

According to the constitution and election law, anyone convicted of a criminal offense and sentenced to at least two years in prison loses the right to become or remain a member of parliament. One cannot vote until five years have passed since his release. 

In this case brought by the Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC), the trial court sentenced him to 13 years in prison. Later, the High Court acquitted him of that sentence. But the case was re-heard in the High Court on the orders of the Appellate Division. 

During the caretaker government, the ACC filed a case against Haji Selim at Lalbagh Police Station on October 24, 2007, on charges of illegally acquiring wealth and concealing information about his wealth. On April 27, 2008, the trial court sentenced him to 13 years in prison. 

Later, on October 25, 2009, Haji Selim appealed against this verdict to the High Court. On January 2, 2011, the High Court overturned the 13-year sentence. 

The ACC appealed against the High Court's verdict to the Supreme Court. After hearing the appeal, the High Court's verdict was quashed on January 12, 2015. 

At the same time, the Appellate Division of the Supreme Court ordered a re-hearing of Haji Selim's appeal in the High Court. After the hearing, the High Court gave its verdict.

Headline_English: No one can stop the Awami League's victory
Content_Enlish:
No opponent can stop the victory of the Awami League if we are united, said party General Secretary Obaidul Quader. He said this while joining the Pabna conference virtually from his residence in the capital this morning. At this time, Obaidul Quader called on the leaders and activists to prepare in view of the national elections. 

On the morning of Saturday, February 19, while joining the Pabna district Awami League's triennial conference virtually, Obaidul Quader said that we must remain united against all conspiracies. We must move forward with new challenges in the next elections. The party must be made more modern and stronger. 

Calling on leaders and activists from all walks of life to prepare now in view of the next national elections, Obaidul Quader said that no one can defeat the Awami League unless they defeat themselves. Therefore, everyone must remain united. 

Obaidul Quader warned the party leaders and activists that the party will become weak if the leaders are made of spring cuckoos instead of the traitors, saying that bad people cannot be made leaders in any way. He mentioned that the party cannot shelter or patronize spring cuckoos in any way.

Headline_English: Fire at shoe factory in Ashulia, 3 workers die
Content_Enlish:
Three workers have died in a fire at a shoe factory in Ashulia, Savar. Two men and one woman are among the dead. At least 10 others were injured. 

Senior Station Officer of DEPZ Fire Service, Zahirul Islam, said that a fire broke out at a shoe factory called Uni World 2 on Bangabandhu Road in Ashulia on Wednesday evening. The fire spread throughout the factory within moments. 

Upon receiving the information, 7 units of the fire service tried to control the fire in about half an hour. Later, three bodies were recovered after searching the factory. Two men and one woman are among the dead. Their identities were not immediately known. The injured have been sent to a local hospital. 

Fire service members are searching the factory to confirm whether there are more bodies. 

Eyewitnesses said that a fire broke out at a shoe factory called 'Uni World' around 5:30 pm. When the factory workers first tried to put out the fire but failed, they informed the fire service. Upon receiving the information, three units of the DEPZ Fire Service reached the spot and joined the firefighting operation. The cause of the fire and the extent of the damage were initially unknown.

Headline_English: Lata Mangeshkar's last recording of her life
Content_Enlish:
Legendary singer Lata Mangeshkar made her last recording in 2018. However, not for a movie, she recited the Gayatri Mantra. And the last patriotic song she sang was released in 2019. The last full-length album of the queen of music Lata's life was the film Veer Zara. 

Lata Mangeshkar, the Nightingale of India in the land of no return. She has sung many songs in her lifetime. She has left behind superhit songs from patriotic to romantic, one after another, which will remain immortal. 

This empress of the Sur empire stopped recording long ago. However, three years ago, this legend recited the Gayatri Mantra as a wedding gift for Isha, the daughter of industrialists Mukesh-Nita Ambani. Despite giving a special message, she did not attend the wedding ceremony due to illness. 

As a song, 'Saugandh Mujhe Is Mitti Ki' is Lata's last record. The song, composed by Mayuresh Pai, was released on March 30, 2019. Lata, who has a magical voice, dedicated it to the Indian Army. 

And her full-length album was the film Veer Zara directed by Yash Chopra. In it, Tere Liye, Aisa Desh Haye Mera, Yeh Hum A Gaye Haye Kaha, Hum To Bhai Jayasa Haye, Do Pal were quite popular. The film was released in 2004. 

Meanwhile, on the occasion of Lata's 92nd birthday, the unreleased song Tik Nahi Lagata, sung by her two decades ago, was released in 2021. 

In 1974, Bharat Ratna Lata was recognized by the Guinness Book of World Records for singing the most songs. It is said that from 1948 to 1974, she recorded 25 thousand solo, duet and chorus songs in 20 Indian languages. However, her rival Mohammed Rafi objected to this. 

He claimed that he has more songs than Lata, that is, 28 thousand. Later, after Rafi's death in 1984, Lata gained recognition. At that time, it was said that she had sung 30,000 songs.

Headline_English: Paracetamol increases the risk of heart attack and stroke
Content_Enlish:
A group of researchers from the University of Edinburgh have warned that the use of paracetamol increases the risk of heart attack and stroke in patients suffering from high blood pressure. They said that doctors need to be more careful when advising patients to take paracetamol on prescription for a long time. 

Many people have the habit of taking paracetamol whenever they have a fever, cold, cough, headache or any pain. However, studies have shown that people suffering from high blood pressure increase the risk of heart attack and stroke if they take paracetamol every day. 

Therefore, researchers have asked doctors to be careful before giving paracetamol to people at risk of heart attack and stroke. 

Experts from the University of Edinburgh conducted a study on 110 patients suffering from high blood pressure. Of these, two-thirds of the patients were taking high blood pressure or medication for high blood pressure. One in three of them showed adverse effects of paracetamol on their bodies. 

The study shows that the blood pressure of patients given paracetamol increased significantly within four days. Because of this, the chances of heart attack or stroke increase many times. 

However, they also said that there is no problem in using the medicine in some cases for headaches including fever. But they emphasized that before taking any medicine, it is necessary to consult a doctor. 

It is important to read the label of the medicine before buying paracetamol-like medicines. Experts have advised avoiding medicines that contain a mixture or combination of paracetamol and D-L methionine. 

There is no reason to worry about taking paracetamol occasionally. However, experts have warned that taking paracetamol regularly in the long term can be fatal. 

In addition, researchers said that those who need paracetamol for chronic pain should use separate medicines to control their blood pressure. 

75,000 patients in Britain and 500,000 patients in the United States die from heart attacks and strokes every year due to high blood pressure.

Headline_English: Per capita income increased to $2,591
Content_Enlish:
Bangladesh's per capita income has increased from $2,554 to $2,591 in the fiscal year 2020-21 amid the COVID-19 pandemic, Planning Minister MA Mannan said. 

The Executive Committee of the National Economic Council (ECNEC) meeting was held at the NEC Conference Room in Sher-e-Bangla Nagar on Tuesday afternoon. ECNEC Chairperson and Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina presided over the meeting virtually from Ganabhaban. 

At the briefing after the meeting, the Planning Minister said that the final GDP in the fiscal year 2020-21 was $416 billion. The GDP growth rate was 6.94 percent. And the final per capita income increased from $2,554 to $2,591. 

Planning Minister MA Mannan said that the GDP growth rate in the last fiscal year was 6.94 percent, which is much higher than the provisional estimate of 5.43 percent. 

He also said that the GDP size finally stood at 416 billion US dollars, which is higher than the provisional estimate of 411 billion US dollars. 

The minister said that the per capita income was 2,591 US dollars, which was 2,554 US dollars in the provisional estimate. 

Due to the impact of the Corona pandemic, the country's GDP growth in the last fiscal year was provisionally 5.43 percent. The per capita income was 2,554 US dollars. The GDP size was 411 billion US dollars in the provisional estimate. These economic indicators have reached a better position in the final estimate. Due to good exports, the growth in the industrial sector was 10.29 percent. The service sector also grew by 5.73 percent. 

In the 2019-20 fiscal year, the GDP growth rate was 3.45 percent, while the GDP size was 374 billion US dollars. 

In addition, in the 2020-21 fiscal year, the growth rate in the agriculture sector was 3.17 percent, in the industrial sector 10.29 percent, and in the services sector 5.73 percent, which were 3.42 percent, 3.61 percent, and 3.93 percent, respectively, in the 2019-20 fiscal year.

Headline_English: Book fair filled with visitors on Mother Language Day
Content_Enlish:
The Amar Ekushey Book Fair is bustling with buyers and visitors on International Mother Language Day. Buyers and visitors came to the book fair from the morning to pay homage to the Shaheed Minar. As the day progressed, the fair turned into a festival of Bengali life with people of all ages walking. 

A large number of people flocked to the book fair on Ekushey February. Publishers are also happy that book sales are good. 

However, despite the crowd, the fair authorities were strict in following the health rules. Most people were seen wearing masks. 

The book fair was bright sunny on the morning of Ekushey. Although the Amar Ekushey Book Fair started in the middle of the month, despite the various uncertainties of the pandemic, its full form was seen on Monday. Buyers, readers and visitors of all ages flocked to the Bangla Academy premises and Suhrawardy Udyan on the occasion of Ekushey February. 

The atmosphere of Ekushey was also seen in the clothes of those who came to the fair. Parents have come to the fair with their small children to introduce them to the spirit of Ekushey. They are conveying the importance of the mother tongue to the next generation. 

Although the sales have been good since the beginning of the book fair, the expectations of the publishers have been fully met on Ekushey February. 

This crowd of people, the tide of life, proves that the spirit of Ekushey will never fade. This sense of unity will defeat communalism and division. May the immortal spirit of Ekushey spread from generation to generation.

Headline_English: Munim included in T20 squad against Afghanistan
Content_Enlish:
Young opening batsman Munim Shahriar has been called up to Bangladesh's T20I team against Afghanistan. Batsman Yasir Ali, who is waiting to make his debut in this edition, has also been called up to the 14-man squad. 

This BPL has introduced Munim Shahriar, this opener from Fortune Barisal has fulfilled his T20I appeal. His bold use of batting and power play was eye-catching, and his strike rate of over 150 is proof of his aggression. 

The selectors are trying to solve the opener crisis in the shorter format with Munim. This hard hitter has been called up to the national team for the first time. Although the BPL went badly, Mohammad Naim has survived, and Liton Das is the third opener with Munim and Naim. Liton, who was not in the last Pakistan series, and experienced Mushfiqur have returned to the T20I team. This is also Shakib's first series after returning from his World Cup injury. 

The BPL performance has had an impact on the team formation. This time Nazmul Shanto, Nurul Hasan Sohan and Shamim Patoiri were off-form. Although he got a place in the ODIs, Shanto is not in the T20 team. Sohan and Shamim have been cut. 

Pace attack with Mustafiz-Shariful-Taskin and Shahidul, Shakib's partners in spin are Nasum and Sheikh Mahedi. 

Bangladesh's Tamim Iqbal Khan and Afghan Hasmatullah Shahidi. Both are top-order batters; these two cricketers are leading the team. Tamim is far ahead in terms of experience. Although he has the advantage of extra time in the home series, the Tiger captain will have a plan to keep opener Hasmatullah's innings short. 

This Afghanistan series is special for Tamim, he is returning to international cricket after seven months. He last went into hiding after scoring a century in the Zimbabwe tour. A colorful comeback is expected in the Afghan series for Dashing Tamim, his first Test under leadership against Rashid-Nabid.

After struggling with injuries, he has once again shone in the BPL in a familiar form at 22 yards. He has scored 407 runs at an average of 59 with a century and 4 fifties. The ODI captain's form is a relief for Bangladesh. 

Afghan captain Hasmatullah is also in rhythm. In the last Netherlands series, he scored two fifties in three matches, the highest being 73. If that consistency continues, the Tigers will face a tough test. 

In fact, Hasmatullah is the best of the Afghans in ODIs against Bangladesh. He has 226 runs at an average of 38 in six matches. He is ranked fifth in the statistics of the two teams. 

Hasmatullah got the captaincy after the retirement of Asghar Afghan, Afghanistan has played in only one series under his leadership. Confidence has increased after the whitewash in the Netherlands. Tamim is ahead in experience, Bangladesh has won 7 out of 15 ODIs under his leadership since 2019. He is ranked second in the ICC Super League. 

Afghanistan is undoubtedly one of Tamim's favorite opponents. He is the Tigers' only ODI century against them. His 273 runs at an average of about 55 are the highest in the duel between the two teams. 

Waiting for another series win under Tamim's leadership, if the Afghans can be whitewashed, the Tigers will surpass England to top the ICC Super League. 
These two matches will be held in Dhaka on March 3 and 5. 

T20 squad against Afghanistan: Mahmudullah (captain), Liton Das, Munim Shahriar, Shakib Al Hasan, Mushfiqur Rahim, Afif Hossain, Mehedi Hasan, Yasir Ali, Mostafizur Rahman, Taskin Ahmed, Shariful Islam, Nasum Ahmed, Shahidul Islam, Mohammad Naeem.

Headline_English: Tamim's century seems to answer many questions
Content_Enlish:
The regret of Tamim returning to international T20s is not ending easily. This opener is not letting it end. He brought Dhaka victory in a brilliant innings. He scored an unbeaten 111 runs at a strike rate of 173. 

Tamim has two fifties and a century in five matches. This opener has surpassed Mushfiqur to become the owner of the highest runs in BPL history. 

Meanwhile, in the first match of the Chittagong phase, Khulna Tigers defeated the host Chittagong Challengers by 6 wickets with the excellent batting of Fletcher and Mushfiqur. 

Tamim's century, this celebration is surely burning the selectors, giving the board officials a hard time. Despite hundreds of attempts, he could not be returned to international T20s. Stopping the discussion of whether to return or not, he played confidently and scored his second century in the BPL. 

Such a celebration, Dhaka's big victory or Tamim's Vandana would not have happened if Mithun could have caught this catch. Greats do not make mistakes in taking advantage of opportunities. 

He is the most successful batsman of Bangladesh in the BPL. After this innings, he is the only local player in the tournament to have more than one century. Tamim also has the most centuries among Bangladeshi batsmen in recognized T20Is. Where others have no more than two, he has four centuries. His name is on many other pages of records. 

Even then, there has been a lot of discussion and criticism about Tamim's batting in T20 cricket. Especially his strike rate and innings pace have always been under fire. This topic would inevitably come up in every news conference, and would be brought up in the dock. He refused to ask any questions about this topic at one point, feeling annoyed. 

He has scored consecutive runs in this BPL, scoring fifties in the first two matches. This time he shone on the home field. 

Not only did he hit four sixes, he also answered the criticism that he had about his strike rate. He surpassed Mushfiqur and became the highest run scorer in the BPL. 

Khan Saheb ruled the Sylhet bowlers by putting Shahzad in the anchor role after setting a target of 176 runs. He turned 360 degrees on the home field today. He reached fifty in 28 balls. He did not respect any bowler, spin or pace. 

After fifty, Tamim seemed to be in even more fearsome form. He reached a century in 61 balls. By then, Dhaka's victory was just a matter of time. 

Even though Shahzad returned, the Tiger opener played the last over brilliantly. He also hit the winning shot with four. He hit 17 fours and four sixes in his 111-run innings. 

Tamim, who shone in his own light, advised the youngsters to play their own way. He said that if you want, you can take your time in T20 cricket too. 

After the match, Tamim said, "You should work hard on your skills. If you have any weaknesses, you should work hard on them. You should play cricketing shots. T20 is not a cricket where you have to try to hit every ball. You should keep yourself in shape and play cricketing shots. Then you can be successful in this version too."

Headline_English: Gautam Adani surpasses Ambani as richest person
Content_Enlish:
Not only India, but also Asia's richest man Mukesh Ambani has surpassed another industrialist Gautam Adani, who has increased his wealth by $100 million. Adani Group's share price increased on Thursday, and he topped the list of rich people. 

After the Indian stock market closed on Thursday, industrialist Gautam Adani surpassed India and Asia's richest man Mukesh Ambani. This is not the first time, Adani's total wealth value had surpassed Ambani once before in November 2021. 

At that time, it was known that Adani's wealth had increased by about 1,808 percent in the previous two years. In contrast, Ambani's wealth has increased by about 250 percent during the same period. 

According to Forbes magazine's 'Realtime Data Networth', Adani is now the 11th richest person in the world. Despite the recent decline in the stock market, the Adani Group has not suffered much. It has been claimed that this rise of Adani is due to that. 

Adani's current assets are $89.5 billion. Which is about 6.72 lakh crore rupees in Indian currency. Mukesh Ambani's assets are $89.4 billion or 6.71 lakh crore rupees. 

The next five in this list of the richest are Shiv Nadar, Radhakrishnan Damani and Lakshmi Mittal respectively. 

Meanwhile, Ambani Reliance is going to invest a large amount in Gujarat. The Reliance Group has signed a memorandum of understanding to invest a total of 5.95 lakh crore rupees in Gujarat. They have confirmed that they will invest 5 lakh crore rupees to build a 100 gigawatt unconventional power plant and hydrogen energy generation system. 

For this, the work of looking at the land will start. In addition, about 60 thousand crore rupees will be invested in setting up four factories including solar power, battery storage. The remaining investment will be in other businesses of the Ambani Group. 

On the other hand, the Gujarat-based Adani Group, which is primarily involved in the port industry, has now expanded its business into various sectors. This month, the Adani Group signed an agreement with South Korean company POSCO to expand its business opportunities in steel, renewable energy and other sectors. 

This investment could be around Rs 37,500 crore. The Adanis signed this agreement in the presence of Gujarat Chief Minister Bhupendra Patel.

Headline_English: Nearly 7.5 lakh people in the country have received booster doses
Content_Enlish:
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina said that 741,265 people have been given corona booster doses so far in the country. She said this in response to a written question during the 16th session of the 11th National Parliament on Wednesday. 

At the time, she also said that after the corona outbreak started around the world, the government has prioritized the issue of providing free vaccination as an effective measure to prevent infection. In addition, even before the corona vaccine was discovered and permission was obtained to use it, the government took all initiatives to procure and administer the vaccine. 

The Prime Minister said that under the nationwide vaccination program, 891,63,978 people have been given the first dose and 570,20,834 people have been given the second dose, making a total of 146,184,812 doses of Covid-19 vaccine. 

She also told the parliament that considering the Covid-19 pandemic situation in the country like the rest of the world, the Bangladesh government also decided to provide booster doses under the ongoing Covid-19 vaccination program. 

He also said that as per the recommendations of the National Immunization Technical Advisory Group, Bangladesh (NITAG, B) and with the approval of the National Committee on the Implementation of the Coronavirus Vaccine Distribution Program, booster doses have been started nationwide from December 28, 2021.

Headline_English: This year's election is to protect the interests of artists: Elias Kanchan
Content_Enlish:
Film actor Ilias Kanchan has said that this election is to protect the interests of artists. He made this comment while announcing his panel's 22-point manifesto ahead of the Film Artists' Association elections. 

Ilias Kanchan and Nipun Parishad announced a 22-point manifesto ahead of the Film Artists' Association elections on Wednesday. The manifesto was announced by the panel's president candidate, film actor Ilias Kanchan, at a restaurant in the capital. 

And just a day later, the last-minute campaign is now underway centered on the Artists' Association elections on January 28. Artists are flocking to the FDC every day. There is an election atmosphere in the cinema area. 

The slogan of this election manifesto of the Kanchan-Nipun panel is dignity and our artists on the screen. 

Ilias Kanchan highlighted 22 points in the manifesto. Among them, the first is to take the initiative to visit the Prime Minister at the FDC built by Bangabandhu. 

The manifesto emphasizes on the assured and prosperous future of artists. At this time, Ilyas Kanchan assured that if he wins the election, he will provide medical insurance to sick artists. 

In addition, he also announced that loans will be arranged on easy terms for film production, subject to discussions with the government. 

Ilyas Kanchan also said that the committee will work to restore the membership of artists who have lost their membership. 

Meanwhile, there is no shortage of excitement and interest among artists and fans surrounding the election of the Film Artists Association. FDC is bustling around the election. This arena is known as the den of cinema, bustling with stars. The same question is on everyone's mind: who will represent the Film Artists Association for the next 2 years? 

This time, the new panel, Ilyas Kanchan-Nipun panel, is opposite Misha Saudagar-Zayed Khan. There are opposing allegations and arguments for and against, and both panels are optimistic about winning. 

The Misha Zayed panel wants to give importance to the issue of ensuring accommodation for artists. On the other hand, the Elias-Kanchan Nipun panel promises to activate cinema halls. 

The Election Commission has taken all measures to ensure a fair election. Law enforcement will be deployed if necessary. 

The 17th election of the Bangladesh Film Artists Association will be held next Friday. 

42 film actors are competing in two panels in this year's film artist election. The Elias Kanchan and Nipun panels include Amit Hasan, Shakil Khan, Riaz, Ferdous, DA Tayeb, Simon, Shahnoor, Nirab, Emon, Azad Khan, Parimoni, Armaan, Afzal Sharif, Keya, Nana Shah, Jasmine, Sankopanja, Gangua and Simanta. 

On the other hand, Misha Sawdagar and Zayed Khan's panel includes Dipjol, Rubel, Subrata, Mousumi, Aruna Biswas, Rozina, Aliraj, Sucharita, Nadir Khan, Anjana, Bapparaj, Asif Iqbal, Chunnu, Alexander Bo, Joy Chowdhury, Jackie Alamgir, Zakir Hossain, Farhad Hossain and Hasan Jahangir.

Headline_English: Information on 69 money launderers submitted to High Court
Content_Enlish:
The Bangladesh Financial Intelligence Unit-BFIU has submitted information on 69 Bangladeshis involved in money laundering to the High Court. The report names only those in the Panama and Paradise Papers. 

On Wednesday, the state's lawyer, Deputy Attorney General AKM Aminuddin Manik, confirmed the matter. However, as per the High Court's order, no one who laundered money in Canada was named in the report. 

The report said that an investigation is underway against Abdul Awal Mintu and his family, Dilip Kumar Modi and his family, and some others on the two lists. Earlier, the High Court had sought a list of money launderers in 2020. 

The agencies have not been able to provide a complete list in the last one and a half years. This week, the relevant agencies including Bangladesh Bank and the Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC) again applied for time. The High Court also granted a week's time. Later in the afternoon, the list was submitted to the High Court. 

The Criminal Investigation Department (CID) of the police submitted its report on the money laundered from Bangladesh to various foreign banks, especially Swiss banks, including Singapore, Thailand, Malaysia, Dubai, and the United Arab Emirates.

Headline_English: Shabi students' demands to be implemented gradually
Content_Enlish:
Calling for an end to the ongoing agitation program at Shahjalal University of Science and Technology in Sylhet, Education Minister Dr. Dipu Moni said that the students' demands will be implemented gradually. He said this at a press conference on Hare Road in the capital on Wednesday evening. 

At the time, the Education Minister said that the students' demands will be implemented gradually. He also said that all the recent incidents at the university will be investigated and action will be taken against those involved. 

Stating that the reasons for the agitation will be investigated, the Education Minister said that we will investigate how the students' several-phase agitation turned into a single-phase agitation. In addition, if there is any lapse or negligence on the part of the university administration in this incident, appropriate action will be taken against them, no matter who they are. 

Meanwhile, he also said that there will be discussions to withdraw the case filed against five former students of Shabiprabi who were arrested for funding the agitation. 

Regarding the resignation of the Vice-Chancellor, the Education Minister said that the departure of the Vice-Chancellor is not a solution, the main goal is to solve the problems. Whether a vice-chancellor is there or not has no impact on solving their (students') problems. If one vice-chancellor leaves, another vice-chancellor will come. But if their problems remain, then they have no benefit. We will solve the problem. 

Dipu Moni said, they are upset and exhausted by the prolonged movement. Let them recover a little. If they say, they want to sit for a few days, then that will happen. This movement is an expression of their grievances. Where is the real problem, we students, teachers, administration, we will all address it together. 

Describing the students' movement as peaceful, the education minister said, we have no side or opponent here. We are all on one side, the problem is on the other. We are saying, solving the problem is very important. This problem must be solved so that the study environment of students in universities is healthy and fair, so that they can study. 

Earlier, on Wednesday morning, at the request of Professor Dr. Muhammad Zafar Iqbal, students protesting demanding the resignation of the Vice-Chancellor broke their hunger strike after 7 days. Dr. Zafar Iqbal and his wife, Professor Dr. Yasmin Haque, broke their hunger strike by giving them water to drink around 10 am on Wednesday. 

Dr. Zafar Iqbal went to the Shahjalal University of Science and Technology campus around 4 am on Tuesday to break the deadlock for several days demanding the resignation of the Vice-Chancellor. He and his wife, Professor Dr. Yasmin Haque, spoke to the sick students who had been on hunger strike since January 19. 

After about 2 hours of persuasion, the students finally agreed to break their hunger strike. Then, in the morning, the students who were sick and undergoing treatment in the hospital due to the hunger strike were brought to the campus by ambulance. At around 10 am, Dr. Zafar Iqbal and Dr. Yasmin Haque served water to all the hunger strikers. 

Expressing gratitude to the students for agreeing to the request, Zafar Iqbal said that the method used to suppress the movement was inhumane. The teacher couple also questioned the role of the university teachers in the ongoing movement. 

After breaking the hunger strike, the hunger strikers were sent to the hospital for treatment. 

The students' movement began on January 13. That night, several hundred students of the hall started a movement demanding three points, including her resignation, accusing the university's Begum Sirajunnesa Chowdhury Hall's principal, Zafrin Ahmed, of misconduct. 

On the evening of January 15, the Chhatra League attacked the students' movement. The next afternoon, the students blocked the vice-chancellor at the university's ICT building. 

Then, the police beat the students with sticks and fired shotgun pellets and sound grenades at them. 

That night, the authorities closed the university indefinitely and ordered the students to leave the hall. The students ignored this and started a movement demanding the resignation of the vice-chancellor.

Headline_English: Russia has the highest number of sanctions in the world, unemployment is rising
Content_Enlish:
Russia is now at the top of the list of countries with the highest sanctions. This information was reported in a report by the US website Castellum.ai, which monitors sanctions. As a result, ordinary Russians are in crisis. Unemployment is rising. The sanctions are also affecting the industry. 

After the start of the campaign against Ukraine, Russia is now the country with the most sanctions in the world. Before February 22, there were 2,754 sanctions against the country. However, after the Russian campaign in Ukraine began on February 24, another 2,778 sanctions were imposed. Now the total sanctions in various fields, including economic, are 5,532. 

The United States has imposed 21 percent of these sanctions. On the other hand, the United Kingdom and the EU have imposed 18 percent. Various countries around the world are imposing sanctions one after another to increase pressure on Moscow to stop the war. 

Before this war, Iran was at the top of the sanctions. They have 3,616 sanctions. Then Syria. However, in just two weeks, Russia has surpassed Iran and Syria in terms of sanctions. 

Moscow residents are in trouble after Russian banks were expelled one after another from the world's banking system SWIFT. As a result, Russians are withdrawing cash from banks. This time, many things, from individuals to banks and institutions, are under sanctions. 

With Visa and MasterCard suspending operations in Russia, Muscovites are having trouble making online purchases, money transfers, and even shopping at the market. 

Several Western brands are winding down their businesses in Russia. As a result, people have recently lost their jobs and become unemployed. Analysts believe that the medical and technology sectors will face shortages as imports of goods are stopped. 

Russia has not only been subject to economic sanctions. Various social and cultural sanctions have been imposed. Disney, Warner Brothers, and Paramount have stopped releasing films in Russian theaters. 

With Russia banned from all international matches and competitions for Russian athletes, Russians are unable to participate in various tours of artists, cultural and scientific venues.
