Headline_English: Top 10 photos
Content_Enlish:
Two years ago, the movie 'Barbie' was at the top of the global box office. Last year, the movie 'Inside Out-2' was at the top. It is a common belief that the box office of a movie usually means the dominance of Hollywood. But this year, that familiar picture has changed. In 2025, the world's highest-grossing movie will no longer be from Hollywood, but a movie from a different language and country. This list indicates changing audience tastes, global markets and new trends. This report is about 10 movies that are at the top in terms of revenue.
1. 'Ne Zha-2'
The movie came into the discussion at the beginning of the year. It has been breaking records in revenue one after another. This movie with an 8 rating on IMDb is still at the top of the revenue at the end of the year. Not Hollywood, this Chinese movie that has set a billion dollar revenue record this year is called 'Ne Zha-2'. This Mandarin-language movie speaks of China's uniqueness. The movie is so loved by the audience that its revenue has reached almost two billion dollars. Its revenue is 1.9 billion dollars or 1.9 billion dollars, which is a record for Chinese films so far.
2. ‘Zootopia-2’
‘Zootopia 2’ has written a surprising success story in the global cinema market this year. This animated film, which has been at the top of the audience since its release, is currently in second place on the list of the highest-grossing films of the year. In this sequel to the popular film ‘Zootopia’ from 2016, the rabbit, the police, Judy Hopps and the cunning fox Nick Wilde are back. However, this time the story is more mature, deeper. The story of ‘Zootopia 2’ progresses with new mysteries, social messages and the complexities of modern urban life. In particular, the questions of inequality, power and morality have come up anew in this episode.
3. ‘Leo and Stitch’
This movie is about a lonely Hawaiian girl. She becomes friends with an alien creature. That friendship helps the alien or alien girl put her broken family back together. The movie 'Leo and Stitch', made with the story of an alien and a child, has also set a new record this time. This year, three movies have earned billions of dollars. This is the last of its kind. The movie's total income is $103.8 million. The budget was $100 million.
4. 'A Minecraft Movie'
The movie is based on a story of adventure, friendship and creativity. 'A Minecraft Movie', which has come from a video game to the big screen, has been able to attract family viewers as well as video game lovers. It has surprised the world box office this year. Due to the huge interest of the audience since its release, the movie has taken the fourth place in the list of the highest-grossing films of the year. Its income is $95.8 billion. Familiar characters, funny dialogues and beautiful animation are the film's big strengths. Through box office success, 'A Minecraft Movie' has proven that game-based movies can also win the hearts of global audiences.

5. ‘Jurassic World: Rebirth’
Although it failed to cross the billion-dollar mark this year, the movie ‘Jurassic World: Rebirth’ was in the news. The world of prehistoric dinosaurs has returned to its story. In this new installment of the popular Jurassic franchise, new characters and new crises have been added to the continuity of the previous story. The film shows the ever-familiar theme of human greed, science and nature in a broader scope. Stunning VFX, realistic dinosaurs and tense action scenes are the film’s biggest strengths. In addition, questions of emotion and morality have also gained importance in the story. The movie is in the top 5 in terms of revenue this year, earning $869 million.
6. ‘Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle’
‘Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba-Infinity Castle’ has earned $715 million. It won the hearts of the audience in 2025 and occupied the top 6 positions at the global box office. The film continues the original story and depicts Tansy's journey and the battle against demons. The captivating animation, dramatic action sequences and emotional moments touch the hearts of the audience. The message of friendship, sacrifice and heroism is strongly reflected in the story. The visual effects and soundtrack have also been praised. Its popularity makes it clear that the magic of the Demon Slayer is still intact. The film has an IMDb rating of 8.5.
7. 'How to Train Your Dragon'
'How to Train Your Dragon' has occupied the top 7 position in the global box office revenue of 2025. The film beautifully depicts the story of Hiccup and Toothless' friendship. Where the main messages of courage, trust and friendship are reflected. The emotions of concentration, heroism and family ties are deeply revealed in the story. Both children and adult audiences enjoyed the emotional moments and exciting adventures of the film. This proves that the story of friendship between dragons and humans has a large audience. The movie grossed $63.6 million.
8. ‘F One: The Movie’
‘F One: The Movie’ is mainly based on the world of Formula One racing. The story of the movie revolves around competition, teamwork, and the personal struggles of the racers. As the main character, a young racer tries to reach the top using his skills, courage, and strategy. The spectacular scenes of the race track, fast-paced action sequences, and the morale and courage of the racers are dramatically portrayed. The story of competition, victory, defeat, and personal struggles in the movie shakes the emotions of the audience. This movie is not only for sports fans, but also attracts adventure and drama lovers. The movie is in the top 8 in the revenue this year. It grossed $630 million.

9. ‘Superman’
The 2025 Superman movie has won the hearts of the audience. The story showcases Superman's morals, courage and humanity, as he saves lives and confronts enemies. The audience is captivated by the excellent visual effects, action-packed sequences and emotional moments. The message of heroism, sacrifice and human values ​​is clearly reflected in the movie. Both children and adults have experienced excitement and entertainment from this movie. The movie has an IMDB rating of 7.1. More than three lakh movie lovers have voted for it.

10. 'Mission: Impossible - The Final Reckoning'
'Mission: Impossible - The Final Reckoning' has ranked number 10 in the top 10 global films of 2025. Ethan Hunt's last mission is full of excitement and risky action. The shocking chase sequences, dramatic revenge and unexpected twists entertained the audience. The excellent combination of visual effects and stunts made the movie more exciting. Both action-loving audiences and fans of the Mission series have experienced a full experience of excitement and entertainment from this movie. The movie has grossed $61.6 million. The movie has an IMDb rating of 7.2.

Headline_English: Climate change: its impact on coastal areas and ways to remedy it
Content_Enlish:
A departmental dialogue titled ‘Climate Change: Its Impact and Remedies in Coastal Regions’ was held on 28 December 2025 at Khulna Press Club, organized by Uttaran, Dorp, ESDO and Prothom Alo in collaboration with Helvetas Bangladesh. 
 থেকে মানুষকে বিকল্প আয়ের পথে নিতে নানা উদ্যোগ থাকলেও তা এখনো যথেষ্ট নয়।

এই অঞ্চলে জলবায়ু পরিবর্তনের অভিঘাত সবচেয়ে বেশি বহন করছেন নারীরা। কৃষিকাজ, বিশেষ করে তরমুজখেতে শ্রম দেওয়া নারীদের জীবনে রয়েছে বহুমাত্রিক সংকট। অনেক নারী দূরবর্তী এলাকা থেকে এসে অস্থায়ীভাবে বসবাস করেন। নিরাপত্তার অভাব, প্রভাবশালী ও মধ্যস্বত্বভোগীদের চাপ এবং ন্যায্য মজুরি না পাওয়া তাঁদের নিত্যদিনের বাস্তবতা। সমান শ্রম দিয়েও নারীরা পুরুষের তুলনায় কম মজুরি পান,যা দেশের উন্নয়ন ভাবনার সঙ্গে সাংঘর্ষিক।

জেন্ডার বৈষম্য এখানে স্পষ্ট। পুরুষেরা দিনের বড় সময় অলসতায় কাটালেও নারীদের দায়িত্ব শেষ হয় না। ঘরের কাজ, সন্তান লালন, খাবার প্রস্তুত—সবকিছুর পরও নারীদের কোমরপানিতে নেমে কাদাজলে কাজ করতে হয়। এতে তাঁদের স্বাস্থ্যঝুঁকি বাড়ে। স্ত্রী রোগসহ নানা জটিলতায় ভুগলেও চিকিৎসার সুযোগ ও সাহস—দুটোই সীমিত। অনেক ক্ষেত্রে বাল্যবিবাহ এই সংকটকে আরও গভীর করে তোলে।

জলবায়ু পরিবর্তনের প্রভাবে পানির সংকট নারীদের কষ্ট বাড়িয়েছে। দূর–দূরান্ত থেকে খাবার পানি সংগ্রহ করতে হয়, কারণ পানি সংরক্ষণের পর্যাপ্ত ব্যবস্থা নেই। সামাজিক সংস্কারের অভাবে এসব কাজে পুরুষদের অংশগ্রহণও কম।

স্বাস্থ্যসেবার অবস্থা আরও উদ্বেগজনক। গর্ভবতী নারী বা প্রসবকালীন জরুরি পরিস্থিতিতে কমিউনিটি ক্লিনিকে পৌঁছানোর কার্যকর ব্যবস্থা নেই। সামান্য উদ্যোগ—যেমন স্থানীয় পর্যায়ে সহজ পরিবহনব্যবস্থা—পিপিপি বা দানশীল সহায়তায় গড়ে তোলা সম্ভব হলেও তা বাস্তবায়িত হচ্ছে না।

সব মিলিয়ে উপকূলীয় অঞ্চলে জলবায়ু পরিবর্তনের অভিঘাত মোকাবিলায় নারীকেন্দ্রিক উদ্যোগ জরুরি। প্রয়োজন নারীর নিরাপত্তা নিশ্চিত করা, ন্যায্য মজুরি বাস্তবায়ন, স্বাস্থ্যসেবা সহজ করা, বাল্যবিবাহ রোধ এবং স্থানীয় উপযোগী হস্তশিল্প ও কুটিরশিল্পে প্রশিক্ষণ বাড়ানো। জলবায়ু অভিযোজনের সফলতা নির্ভর করবে এই নারীদের মর্যাদা, সুরক্ষা ও অংশগ্রহণ নিশ্চিত করার ওপরই।


গৌরাঙ্গ নন্দী

লেখক ও গবেষক

একসময় উপকূলীয় অঞ্চলের মানুষের নিজস্ব পানির ব্যবস্থাপনা ছিল—নোনা ও মিঠাপানির ভারসাম্য রক্ষা করে জীবনযাপন চলত। ১৯৬০-এর উপকূলীয় বাঁধ প্রকল্প এই নোনাপানি রক্ষার প্রচেষ্টা হলেও, নদী ব্যবস্থাপনা ও সেচ প্রকল্পগুলো—বিশেষ করে গঙ্গা-কপোতাক্ষ (জিকে) প্রকল্প—ক্ষতি করেছে। উজানের পানি কমে যাওয়ায় লবণাক্ততা বেড়েছে, নদী ও বনসংস্থান ক্ষতিগ্রস্ত হয়েছে।

চীন ও ভারতের বাঁধ প্রকল্পও পানিপ্রবাহকে নিয়ন্ত্রণ করছে। ব্রহ্মপুত্রসহ বড় নদীগুলোর পানির হ্রাস উপকূলীয় অঞ্চলের জলের ভারসাম্য নষ্ট করছে। ফলে সুন্দরবনের নোনা-মিঠাপানির ভারসাম্য হারাচ্ছে, গাছপালা মারা যাচ্ছে, নারকেল, খেজুর ও তালগাছ বিলুপ্তির পথে। নদীভাঙন ও বাঁধ দুর্বল হওয়ার কারণে ফসল, বসতি ও জীবনযাত্রায় সরাসরি প্রভাব পড়ছে। আইলা ও সিডরের মতো দুর্যোগে হাজারো পরিবার বাস্তুচ্যুত হয়েছে।

উপকূলীয় জলবায়ু পরিবর্তনের সঙ্গে যুক্ত সমস্যার সমাধান আংশিকভাবে স্থানীয় প্রকল্পে সম্ভব। দাকোপের উদাহরণ উল্লেখযোগ্য—লবণাক্ত জমিতে শুধু বৃষ্টির পানি ধরে রাখার মাধ্যমে ধান উৎপাদন সম্ভব হয়েছে। তবে প্রাকৃতিক পুকুর ও ঐতিহ্যগত পানি ব্যবস্থাপনার গুরুত্ব অপরিসীম। প্রাকৃতিক পদ্ধতিতে পানি সংরক্ষণ না করলে কৃত্রিম ব্যবস্থা দীর্ঘ মেয়াদে কার্যকর হবে না।

কাঁকড়া চাষের মতো উদ্যোগ নিলে অর্থনৈতিক সুযোগ তৈরি হয়, কিন্তু সুন্দরবনের বাস্তুসংস্থানের সংরক্ষণ অপরিহার্য। লবণাক্ততা সহনশীল জাত উদ্ভাবন করা হলেও, স্থানীয় পর্যায়ে কার্যকর বাস্তবায়ন প্রয়োজন।

উপকূলীয় অঞ্চলে জলবায়ু পরিবর্তনের প্রভাব মোকাবিলায় প্রয়োজন নোনা-মিঠাপানির ভারসাম্য রক্ষা, নদী ও বন সংরক্ষণ, প্রাকৃতিক পানি ব্যবস্থাপনা পুনঃপ্রতিষ্ঠা এবং মানুষের অংশগ্রহণভিত্তিক পরিবেশবান্ধব প্রকল্প। শুধু আন্তর্জাতিক বা সরকারি প্রকল্পে নির্ভর করে সমস্যার স্থায়ী সমাধান সম্ভব নয়।

বেগম রেহানা ঈসা

শিক্ষক ও নারীনেত্রী

বাংলাদেশের উপকূলীয় অঞ্চল প্রতিবছরই জলোচ্ছ্বাস ও বন্যার শিকার হয়। বাঁধ নির্মাণের চেষ্টা থাকলেও অতিরিক্ত জলোচ্ছ্বাসে এগুলো টিকছে না। আইলার সময় দেখা গেছে, ছোটবাঁশের ঘরগুলো পুরোপুরি ধ্বংস হয়েছে; মানুষ অস্থায়ী বেড়িবাঁধের ওপর ছাদ দিয়ে বাস করছে। তাই শক্তিশালী ও কার্যকর বাঁধ নির্মাণে সরকারিভাবে উদ্যোগ নেওয়া জরুরি।

উপকূলীয় অঞ্চলে লবণাক্ত পানি ও মানুষের কর্মকাণ্ডের কারণে পানির মান খারাপ হচ্ছে। এর প্রভাব স্বাস্থ্যক্ষেত্রেও দেখা দেয়। বিশেষ করে নারীদের কষ্ট বেশি। তারা দূরদূরান্ত থেকে খাওয়ার পানি আনে, পরিষ্কার পানির অভাবে সঠিকভাবে বাথরুম ব্যবহার করতে পারে না। ফলে পেটের পীড়া, চর্মরোগ ও অন্যান্য স্বাস্থ্যঝুঁকি বেড়ে যায়। নারীরা ঘরবাড়ি, শিশু দেখভাল ও অন্যান্য দৈনন্দিন কাজের সঙ্গে এসব ঝুঁকিও বহন করে।

আশ্রয়কেন্দ্রের প্রয়োজনীয়তা থাকলেও জনগণ প্রায়ই সেখানে যেতে চায় না। তারা নিজের ঘরবাড়ি ছেড়ে অন্যত্র আশ্রয় নিতে স্বাচ্ছন্দ্যবোধ করে না। শেষ মুহূর্তে ঘর ভাঙা বা পানি ঢোকার আশঙ্কায় মানুষ আশ্রয় কেন্দ্রে আসে। তা ছাড়া বিদ্যমান আশ্রয়কেন্দ্রগুলো নারীবান্ধব নয়; একই রুমে ছেলেমেয়ে, শিশু একসঙ্গে থাকায় সেখানে অনেকে যেতে চায় না। ফলে বড় ও মানসম্পন্ন আশ্রয়কেন্দ্রের অভাব অনুভূত হয়।

উপকূলীয় নদী, বাঁধ ও খালগুলো ক্রমশ ক্ষতিগ্রস্ত হচ্ছে। আন্তর্জাতিকভাবে নদী বাঁধ দেওয়ার ফলে নদীর প্রবাহও কমছে। এসব প্রকল্পের দীর্ঘমেয়াদি প্রভাব বিবেচনা করে পরিবেশবান্ধব ও কার্যকর ব্যবস্থা গ্রহণ জরুরি।

এ ছাড়া নারীদের কর্মসংস্থান ও অর্থনৈতিক সক্ষমতা বৃদ্ধি করতে হবে। তাদের ঘরবাড়ি, কৃষি ও অন্যান্য কাজের সঙ্গে সমন্বয় করে প্রশিক্ষণ ও সুযোগ দিলে নারীর ক্ষমতায়ন ও উপকূলীয় সমাজের স্থায়িত্ব নিশ্চিত করা সম্ভব। ছোট ছোট উন্নয়নমূলক উদ্যোগ ও এনজিও কার্যক্রম উপকূলীয় মানুষের জীবনযাত্রা উত্তরণে সাহায্য করতে পারে।

হোসেনুর রহমান

সহকারী পরিচালক, জেলা সমাজসেবা কার্যালয়, খুলনা

জলবায়ু পরিবর্তন একটি বৈশ্বিক সমস্যা, যা মরুভূমি থেকে বরফগিরি পর্যন্ত প্রভাব ফেলে। বাংলাদেশের উপকূলীয় অঞ্চলে এর প্রভাব বিশেষভাবে প্রকট—কৃষি ও স্বাস্থ্য দুই ক্ষেত্রেই। বর্ষার সময় বন্যা, লবণাক্ততা বৃদ্ধি, অতিবৃষ্টি বা খরা—সবই ফসল ও মানুষের জীবনযাত্রাকে সংকুচিত করছে। স্বাস্থ্যক্ষেত্রে চর্মরোগের সমস্যা বাড়ছে, পাশাপাশি ক্যানসার, কিডনি ও লিভারের রোগের প্রভাবও লক্ষ্যযোগ্য। বটিয়াঘাটার মতো এলাকায় এই রোগীর সংখ্যা ক্রমবর্ধমান।

এ ক্ষেত্রে সরকারি ও এনজিও স্বাস্থ্যসেবা আরও কার্যকর করা দরকার। উপজেলা স্বাস্থ্য কমপ্লেক্সে চর্মরোগ বিশেষজ্ঞ চিকিৎসক নিয়োগ, রোগের সঠিক নিরীক্ষণ ও চিকিৎসা প্রদান জরুরি। সমাজকল্যাণ মন্ত্রণালয় ও অন্যান্য সংস্থা ইতিমধ্যেই ক্ষতিগ্রস্তদের জন্য আর্থিক সহায়তা দিয়ে আসছে, যা আরও বিস্তৃত করার প্রয়োজন রয়েছে।

কৃষিক্ষেত্রে জলবায়ু পরিবর্তনের কারণে ফসল উৎপাদনে বড় ধরনের বাধা দেখা দিচ্ছে। লবণাক্ততা নিয়ন্ত্রণ ও সেচব্যবস্থার উন্নতি অপরিহার্য। বাঁধ নির্মাণ ও মেরামত, নদী ও খাল খনন, ছোট খালগুলোর ড্রেজিং—এসব পদক্ষেপ জলাবদ্ধতা নিরসনে কার্যকর হতে পারে। সুন্দরবনের বিশেষ জলবায়ুর প্রভাব বিবেচনায় এসব প্রকল্পের বাস্তবায়ন অত্যন্ত গুরুত্বপূর্ণ।

উপকূলীয় কৃষক, বিশেষ করে নারীরা জলবায়ু পরিবর্তনের প্রভাবে সরাসরি ক্ষতিগ্রস্ত। তাঁদের সুরক্ষা, নিরাপত্তা ও প্রশিক্ষণ নিশ্চিত করা প্রয়োজন। নারীর অর্থনৈতিক সক্ষমতা বৃদ্ধি, স্থানীয় অংশগ্রহণভিত্তিক প্রকল্প এবং ঐতিহ্যগত প্রাকৃতিক ব্যবস্থার পুনঃপ্রতিষ্ঠা দীর্ঘ মেয়াদে স্থায়িত্ব আনতে পারে।

নবনীতা দত্ত

উপজেলা মহিলাবিষয়ক কর্মকর্তা, দিঘলিয়া, খুলনা

উপকূলীয় অঞ্চলে জলবায়ু পরিবর্তনের প্রভাব সরাসরি সবচেয়ে বেশি নারীদের ওপর পড়ছে। লবণাক্ততা, আর্সেনিকের বৃদ্ধি, নদীভাঙন ও জলোচ্ছ্বাস—সবই তাঁদের দৈনন্দিন জীবনে সমস্যা সৃষ্টি করছে। আশ্রয়কেন্দ্র থাকলেও স্থানীয় মানুষ, বিশেষ করে নারীরা সেগুলো ব্যবহার করতে চান না; নারীবান্ধব ব্যবস্থা এখনো পর্যাপ্ত নয়।

জলবায়ু পরিবর্তনের ফলে কৃষি ও জীবনযাত্রার ওপর প্রভাব ক্রমবর্ধমান। লবণাক্ত জমিতে ধান, চিংড়ি ও কাঁকড়া চাষ করা হচ্ছে। তবে নদী ব্যবস্থাপনা ও বাঁধ প্রকল্প—বিশেষ করে জিকে প্রজেক্ট—বাস্তুসংস্থান ও নদীর স্বাস্থ্য ক্ষতিগ্রস্ত করেছে। নদীভাঙন, লবণাক্ততা বৃদ্ধির সঙ্গে মানবসৃষ্ট পরিবর্তন জড়িত, যা শুধু প্রকৃতির ওপর দায় চাপিয়ে সমস্যার সমাধান পেছনে ফেলে।

প্রতিটি প্রকল্পের ক্ষেত্রে স্থানীয় মানুষের অংশগ্রহণ ও প্রাকৃতিক পদ্ধতির গুরুত্ব অপরিসীম। ঐতিহ্যগত পানি ব্যবস্থাপনা, যেমন পুকুর সুপেয় পানির জন্য কার্যকর। বর্তমানে অস্থায়ী প্রকল্প ও এনজিও কার্যক্রম স্থায়িত্ব ও মালিকানা সৃষ্টি করতে ব্যর্থ হচ্ছে। কংক্রিট এবং আধুনিকায়নের সঙ্গে আমরা প্রকৃতির কাছ থেকে দূরে যাচ্ছি, যার ফলে সমাধান দীর্ঘ মেয়াদে কার্যকর হয় না।

উপকূলীয় নারীদের জন্য প্রশিক্ষণ শুধু সেলাই নয়, ফ্যাশন ডিজাইন ও দরজিবিজ্ঞানেও দেওয়া প্রয়োজন। অর্থনৈতিক স্বাধীনতা ও সক্ষমতা বৃদ্ধির মাধ্যমে তাঁরা পরিবার ও সমাজে ভারসাম্য বজায় রাখতে পারেন।


আবদুল করিম

জেলা ত্রাণ ও পুনর্বাসন কর্মকর্তা, খুলনা।

উপকূলীয় অঞ্চলে জলবায়ু পরিবর্তনের অভিঘাত মোকাবিলায় কৃষি বিভাগ নিজ নিজ দায়িত্ব অনুযায়ী কাজ করছে। আর দুর্যোগ ব্যবস্থাপনা ও ত্রাণ মন্ত্রণালয় মূলত দুর্যোগ, জলবায়ু পরিবর্তনজনিত ঝুঁকি ও অভিবাসনসংক্রান্ত বিষয়গুলোকে বেশি গুরুত্ব দিয়ে কাজ করছে। জলবায়ু পরিবর্তনের ফলে দুর্যোগের ধরন ও তীব্রতা বাড়ছে—এই বাস্তবতা সামনে রেখে আগাম সতর্কবার্তা ও দুর্যোগ প্রস্তুতির কার্যক্রম আগের তুলনায় আরও যুগোপযোগী করার চেষ্টা চলছে।

বর্তমানে নির্মিত বহুমুখী ঘূর্ণিঝড় আশ্রয়কেন্দ্রগুলোতে স্বাস্থ্যবিধি কর্নারসহ বিভিন্ন সুবিধা যুক্ত করা হয়েছে। এসব আশ্রয়কেন্দ্রে নারী, বৃদ্ধ, স্তন্যদানকারী মা ও বিশেষ চাহিদাসম্পন্ন ব্যক্তিদের জন্য আলাদা ও উপযোগী ব্যবস্থা রাখা হচ্ছে। এতে দুর্যোগকালে সবাই নিরাপদ আশ্রয় পাওয়ার সুযোগ পাচ্ছেন।

তবে বাস্তব অভিজ্ঞতায় দেখা যায়, অনেক মানুষ দুর্যোগের সময় আশ্রয়কেন্দ্রে আসতে চান না। কারণ, তাঁদের স্থায়ী সম্পদ—গবাদিপশু, হাঁস-মুরগি বা অন্যান্য সম্পদ ফেলে আসার ঝুঁকি নিতে তাঁরা রাজি নন। এই সমস্যা সমাধানে আশ্রয়কেন্দ্রের পাশে গবাদিপশুর জন্য আলাদা শেড ও মাটির কিল্লা নির্মাণ করা হচ্ছে, যাতে মানুষ তাঁদের সম্পদসহ নিরাপদে আশ্রয় নিতে পারেন।

জলবায়ু পরিবর্তনের আরেকটি বড় প্রভাব হলো অভিবাসন। কর্মসংস্থানের অভাবে মানুষ বাধ্য হয়ে এলাকা ছাড়ছে। এই অভিবাসন দুই ধরনের—মৌসুমি অভিবাসন এবং স্থায়ী অভিবাসন। অভিবাসন ঠেকাতে হলে ক্ষতিগ্রস্ত এলাকাগুলোতে কর্মসংস্থান বাড়ানো জরুরি। স্থানীয় সম্পদের উন্নয়ন ঘটিয়ে মানুষ যেন নিজ এলাকাতেই কাজ করে জীবিকা নির্বাহ করতে পারে, সে লক্ষ্যে দীর্ঘমেয়াদি ও ব্যাপক উদ্যোগ প্রয়োজন। জলবায়ু অভিযোজনের মূল প্রতিকার এখানেই নিহিত।

এ ছাড়া গোলটেবিল বৈঠকে আরও অংশগ্রহণ করেন উত্তরণের টেকনিক্যাল ম্যানেজার রেজওয়ান উল্লাহ, খুলনা প্রেসক্লাবের আহ্বায়ক এনামুল হক, খুলনার সংবাদকর্মী আবু হেনা মোস্তফা জামাল, কৌশিক দে, আহমেদ মুসা, বাগেরহাটের সংবাদকর্মী ইনজামামুল হক, তানজীম আহমেদ। স্বাগত বক্তব্য দেন প্রথম আলোর খুলনা প্রতিনিধি উত্তম মণ্ডল।

Abu Ferdous Chowdhury 
Disaster Risk Reduction and WASH Officer, Uttaran, Morelganj, Bagerhat 
The impact of climate change is becoming visible every day in coastal Bangladesh. Salinity, waterlogging, reduced river navigability and frequent tides—these are having a direct impact on people's lives and livelihoods. In such a reality, Uttaran is implementing the ‘Access’ project in collaboration with Helvetas Bangladesh to take action against climate change and ensure sustainable solutions. This project is being implemented in 24 wards of eight unions in the coastal Morelganj and Sharankhola upazilas of Bagerhat. The three most vulnerable wards of each union have been selected considering the level of risk. The first year of the project is nearing its end. 
The main areas of work of this project are disaster risk reduction, water and WASH, agriculture, advocacy, migration centers and information centers. Due to climate change, many roads and agricultural lands in the coastal areas are becoming saline and waterlogged. During high tide, roads are submerged, and roads connecting to cyclone shelters become impassable. To address these problems, soil and brick paving roads are being repaired, drains are being constructed, and iron and floating bridges are being constructed, so that people can easily reach shelters during disasters and water does not accumulate in agricultural lands. 
Along with structural work, awareness activities are also being given importance. People are being prepared for potential hazards at the field level through regular training, meetings, exhibitions and disaster drills. 
School-based programs have been taken in the water and WASH sector. School brigades have been formed in each school, based on whose opinions new initiatives are being taken. As part of this, vending machines are being installed in schools so that students can manage their menstrual periods safely. In addition, the supply of sanitary napkins is being ensured. Training and material support have been provided to local service providers so that sanitation services can easily reach the doorsteps of people and at the same time their livelihoods are also sustainable. Tanks for safe water and filters for rainwater conservation have been installed in schools. 
Migration centers are operating to address the increasing migration risk due to climate change. Here people are getting necessary information and assistance before going for work. In addition, farmers are getting modern seeds, materials and decision-making advice from the agricultural information center - which is helping them to face the challenges of climate change. 
Abul Hasnat 
Agricultural Officer, Uttaran, Morelganj, Bagerhat 
The biggest change that is becoming clear in working on the south coast is the impact of climate change—especially the spread of salinity. In 2010, the amount of saline land in the country was 1 million 55 thousand hectares. It has increased to 1 million 60 thousand hectares in the last 15 years. That is, in a little over a decade, more than one lakh hectares of land have been affected by salinity. This trend is undoubtedly an ominous sign. 
Soil salinity in some coastal areas has reached 40 ds per meter, which is terrible bad news for agriculture. About 30 percent of the country's total land is located in the coastal region. Salinity is spreading rapidly in various coastal districts including Satkhira, Khulna, Bagerhat. This is having a direct impact on crop production and yield. In particular, the shortage of animal feed is becoming more acute day by day. 
Long-term and ongoing planning is needed to deal with this situation. It is now important to develop a process so that the activities do not stop once the project is completed. This requires the participation of all government and private parties. International aid and research organizations, national research institutions and the Department of Agriculture must work together. 

There is a need to pay special attention to the development and expansion of salt-tolerant, drought-tolerant and disaster-tolerant varieties of animal feed, food grains, oilseeds and various crops. In addition, if the relevant ministries of the government, including the Ministry of Agriculture, pay attention to freshwater conservation, farmer training and improved irrigation systems, a clear guideline can be created to sustain coastal agriculture. 

Professor Anwarul Quadir 

Executive Director, Sundarbans Academy 

The impact of climate change on the coastal regions of Bangladesh is becoming more pronounced every year. Tidal waves, cyclones, saltwater and human activities are having a profound impact on the environment and lifestyle of the region. But the activities of government and NGO organizations to solve the problems are not coordinated in many cases. Each department is working separately. As a result, development projects are not sustainable. 

There are also problems in agriculture and economics. For example, foreign exchange is earned through shrimp or dragon fruit cultivation, but social and environmental damage is not considered. There are also irregularities in food security. New crops, such as watermelon, are being cultivated in the southwestern region, where the use of excessive fertilizers and pesticides is posing a risk to food security. Priority should be given to crop production—rice, wheat. If food self-sufficiency is not ensured, dependence on foreign imports will increase. 

Health problems are also serious in coastal areas. Skin diseases, stomach ailments, and women's illnesses are common due to the use of saline water. Due to distance problems, people are unable to drink safe water. Although shelters have been built, they are not women-friendly and people do not want to leave their homes. Therefore, large, quality and women-friendly shelters are needed. 

The Sundarbans and river environment are increasingly being damaged due to natural and man-made hazards. Mongla port, power plants and industrial areas are destroying forest land and water resources. Without proper management of dams and canals, river dredging and forest conservation, projects will not be effective. Sustainable solutions are not possible without coordination between migration, food production, environment and social management. 

Without an integrated plan, river management, agricultural development, forest conservation and women's empowerment will all be half-hearted efforts. A unique forest area like the Sundarbans requires a separate ministry. In addition, cyclone shelters can be restructured as markets, entertainment centres and safe shelters, so that risks are reduced and the quality of life of local people is improved. 

Integrated planning, strong dams, healthcare, safe shelters, food security and Sundarbans conservation are essential to address the impacts of climate change in coastal areas. If these steps are taken, coastal people will be able to live a safe, healthy and sustainable life. 

Nazrul Islam 

Deputy Director, Department of Agricultural Extension 

Due to the decrease in water flow upstream, the freshwater crisis in coastal areas has increased. This is directly affecting agriculture. Due to increasing salinity, crop production has decreased in many areas, and much land is falling into disrepair. Where various crops including sesame were once cultivated, production has now dropped significantly. Although climate change is an international problem, human activities have also intensified this crisis locally. 

Climate change has created a deep crisis in the environment, agriculture and livelihoods of the coastal southwest region. Although this region adjacent to Khulna, Satkhira and Bagerhat—Sundarbans—was formed by thousands of years of sediment accumulation, its natural balance is now being destroyed by the effects of climate change. 

In this situation, various adaptive initiatives are being taken to survive in agriculture. Crop replacement is an example of this. After the decline in sesame cultivation, watermelon cultivation has expanded, which on the one hand creates new possibilities, but on the other hand also increases risks. The use of excessive fertilizers and pesticides is becoming a concern for the future. If the permitted levels are not followed, agriculture will suffer the most in the long run. 

Due to the effects of climate change, salinity is increasing, making it difficult for conventional crops to survive. Therefore, efforts are being made to cultivate alternative and tolerant crops—such as sweet pumpkin, corn, sunflower, peanut, dragon fruit, or chuijhal—in addition, initiatives such as ginger cultivation in sacks, digging mini ponds, and restoring small canals are being taken to conserve fresh water. 

However, most of these initiatives are on a small scale. To solve major crises, coordinated action is needed at the national and international levels. Local-level initiatives are as important as national and international cooperation for adaptation to climate change. Only with the combination of these two can the agriculture, environment, and human existence of the coastal region be sustained. 

Roni Hawlader 

Project beneficiary, Morelganj, Bagerhat 

Since Cyclone Sidr in 2007, there has been a kind of permanent pressure on agriculture in the southern region. Even after a long time, its wounds have not been completely overcome. Rice production in this region is still very low. The main reason for this is the rapid spread of salinity. Due to the increasing salt content in the soil due to climate change, conventional crop cultivation, including rice, is becoming increasingly difficult. 

In addition to the crisis in rice production, the livestock sector has also been hit hard. Where cattle were once an important part of livelihood, the number of livestock has now decreased significantly. The existence of the livestock that has survived is also under threat - because there is a severe shortage of animal feed in the area. If this shortage continues, there is a fear that the livestock sector will almost go extinct. 

In this reality, there is a need to rethink agriculture to deal with the impact of climate change. Especially, giving importance to animal feed production and weather and salt tolerant crops is the demand of the hour. In this regard, the coordinated efforts of the divisional agriculture departments and non-governmental development organizations can play an important role. 

If animal feed and tolerant crops that are compatible with local realities are expanded, farmers and ranchers in the coast can get some relief. Although it is not possible to completely prevent the effects of climate change, the biggest solution for the people of the coastal region is to sustain the agriculture and livestock sectors through proper planning and adaptive initiatives. 

Khalilur Rahman 

Project beneficiary, Morelganj, Bagerhat 

Nishanbaria Union of Morelganj Upazila, located right next to the Sundarbans, is one of the areas most affected by the effects of climate change. In this region, along with agriculture and crop production, the livestock sector is also suffering greatly. Farmers have been facing various crises for a long time due to salinity and climate-related risks. 

In this reality, various training programs on agriculture, livestock and climate change are being conducted through Utran NGO in collaboration with Helvetas. Through these trainings, it has been possible to make local-level groups skilled. Positive changes are being seen in agricultural production, especially in Nishanbaria Union. 

Farmers are changing the method of cultivation used earlier and are leaning towards using new and advanced technologies. এর ফল হিসেবে কৃষি উৎপাদন ও বাজারজাতকরণে উল্লেখযোগ্য অগ্রগতি হয়েছে। ২০২৩ সালে পরিচালিত এক জরিপে দেখা যায়, শুধু নিশানবাড়িয়া ইউনিয়ন থেকেই শসা, মিষ্টিকুমড়া ও শিম বিক্রি করে প্রায় ২২ কোটি টাকা আয় হয়েছে। এটি প্রমাণ করে, সঠিক প্রশিক্ষণ ও প্রযুক্তি প্রয়োগ করলে উপকূলীয় এলাকাতেও কৃষি সম্ভাবনা তৈরি করা সম্ভব।

তবে এই অগ্রযাত্রা ধরে রাখতে আরও উদ্যোগ প্রয়োজন। কৃষকদের উন্নত প্রশিক্ষণ, আধুনিক যন্ত্রপাতি ও প্রয়োজনীয় উপকরণ সহায়তা দেওয়া গেলে কৃষি ফলন আরও বাড়বে। এতে শুধু সবজি নয়, ধান চাষেও ইতিবাচক পরিবর্তন আসতে পারে বলে আশা করা হচ্ছে। জলবায়ু পরিবর্তনের ঝুঁকির মধ্যেও প্রশিক্ষণভিত্তিক অভিযোজন ও প্রযুক্তিনির্ভর কৃষিই হতে পারে উপকূলীয় অঞ্চলের টেকসই প্রতিকার।

মাহফুজুর রহমান

খুলনা বিভাগীয় সমন্বয়কারী, বাংলাদেশ পরিবেশ আইনবিদ সমিতি (বেলা)

উপকূলীয় অঞ্চলে জলবায়ু পরিবর্তন নিয়ে আলোচনা যত বাড়ছে, ততই একটি প্রশ্ন সামনে আসছে—আমরা কেন শুধু প্রভাব মেনে নিচ্ছি, প্রশমনের কথা ভাবছি না? স্থানীয় পর্যায়েই যে সমস্যার সমাধান সম্ভব, তার বাস্তব উদাহরণ আছে। ২০০৭ সালের সিডরের পর দাকোপ উপজেলায় একসময় বলা হয়েছিল, লবণের আস্তরণ পড়ে থাকা একটি মাঠে আর কখনো ধান হবে না। কিন্তু কৃষকেরা হাল ছাড়েননি। লবণাক্ত পানি ঢুকতে না দিয়ে শুধু বৃষ্টির পানি জমতে দেওয়া হয় এবং অতিরিক্ত পানি বের করে দেওয়া হয়। এর ফলেই লবণ ধুয়ে যায়, আর সেই জমিতে আবার ধানের ফলন ফিরে আসে; অর্থাৎ সঠিক ব্যবস্থাপনায় লবণাক্ততাও নিয়ন্ত্রণ করা সম্ভব।

কিন্তু বাস্তবে আমরা অনেক সময় লবণাক্ততা ও জলাবদ্ধতাকে মেনে নিয়েই প্রকল্প গ্রহণ করছি। প্রশ্ন হচ্ছে, জলাবদ্ধতা নিরসনের সুযোগ থাকা সত্ত্বেও কেন তা আগে গুরুত্ব পাচ্ছে না। জলবায়ু পরিবর্তন নিয়ে আলোচনাও অনেক ক্ষেত্রে শব্দবন্ধে আটকে যাচ্ছে। পরিবর্তন প্রকৃতির নিয়ম, কিন্তু যখন পরিবর্তনের গতি অস্বাভাবিক হয়ে ওঠে, তখন সেটাই সংকট। এই সংকটের বড় অংশই মানবসৃষ্ট। উজানের পানিপ্রবাহ বন্ধ, নদী ভরাট, গাছ কেটে ফেলা—এসবের দায় শুধু জলবায়ু পরিবর্তনের ঘাড়ে চাপানো যায় না।

খুলনা অঞ্চলের বহু নদী– গড়াই, কপোতাক্ষ, কালীগঙ্গা মরতে বসেছে মূলত অপরিকল্পিত সেচ ও বাঁধ প্রকল্পের কারণে। গঙ্গা-কপোতাক্ষ প্রকল্পের মতো উদ্যোগ নদীর স্বাভাবিক প্রবাহ নষ্ট করেছে। অথচ দোষ দেওয়া হচ্ছে জলবায়ু পরিবর্তনকে। দুর্বল ও অনুপযোগী বাঁধও ঝুঁকি বাড়াচ্ছে, যা নতুন করে ভাবার দাবি রাখে।

সুন্দরবন প্রসঙ্গে আরও স্পষ্ট হয় এই সংকট। এই বন আসলে নোনা ও মিঠাপানির ভারসাম্যের ওপর দাঁড়িয়ে। উজানের পানির অভাবে সেই ভারসাম্য নষ্ট হচ্ছে, ফলে গাছ মারা যাচ্ছে। এর সঙ্গে যোগ হয়েছে অপরিকল্পিত পর্যটন, প্লাস্টিক ও অন্যান্য বর্জ্যের চাপ। নানা প্রকল্প নেওয়া হলেও স্থানীয় মানুষ, গবেষক ও অভিজ্ঞদের মতামত প্রকৃত অর্থে প্রতিফলিত হচ্ছে না।

উপকূলীয় অঞ্চলে জলবায়ু পরিবর্তনের প্রভাব মোকাবিলায় প্রকল্প হতে হবে পরিবেশবান্ধব, বাস্তবভিত্তিক এবং মানুষের অংশগ্রহণে গড়ে ওঠা। তা না হলে আমরা বারবার একই কথা বলব—সবই জলবায়ু পরিবর্তনের কারণে—কিন্তু সমাধানের পথে এগোতে পারব না।

‘জলবায়ু পরিবর্তন: উপকূলীয় অঞ্চলে এর প্রভাব ও প্রতিকারের উপায়’ শীর্ষক বিভাগীয় সংলাপে অংশগ্রহণকারীরা, ২৮ ডিসেম্বর ২০২৫ খুলনা প্রেসক্লাবে

Headline_English: Cigarettes worth Tk 3 million seized at Chattogram Shah Amanat Airport
Content_Enlish:
Customs officials have seized 1,340 cartons of cigarettes under import control at Chattogram Shah Amanat International Airport. These cigarettes were seized at 10:45 pm today, Wednesday. 
Customs officials said that 200 cartons of cigarettes were seized from the baggage of passenger Minhajul Karim and 350 cartons of cigarettes from the baggage of Minhajul Islam, who came from Dubai. In addition, 690 cartons were seized in an abandoned state. In total, these cartons contain 248,000 cigarettes. The market value of these cigarettes is 3 million taka. 
According to the baggage rule, a passenger can bring one carton of cigarettes with him. No customs duty will be paid for this. There is no opportunity to bring more than this. And according to the import policy order, cigarettes are conditional import goods. For cigarette imports, the package must have the words 'smoking is harmful to health' written in Bengali. 
Customs officials said that the cigarette consignment has been deposited in the warehouse of the Chittagong Custom House. Now, steps are being taken according to the customs law.

Headline_English: Khaleda Zia buried with state honours next to husband Ziaur Rahman
Content_Enlish:
BNP Chairperson and former Prime Minister Khaleda Zia was buried next to the grave of her husband, former President and BNP founder Ziaur Rahman. Khaleda Zia was buried with state honors at the capital's Zia Udyan shortly before 5 pm on Wednesday. 
Earlier, a large crowd gathered at the National Parliament Building and Manik Mia Avenue for Khaleda Zia's funeral. People have been coming in droves since morning to attend Khaleda Zia's funeral. As soon as noon rolled around, various streets in Dhaka from Manik Mia Avenue to Karwan Bazar became crowded. Khaleda Zia's funeral began at 3:03 pm. The funeral ended at 3:05 pm. 
After the funeral, which was attended by a large crowd, Khaleda Zia's body was taken from the Parliament Building to Zia Udyan in a flag-draped hearse under tight security by law enforcement agencies. At around 4:30 pm, Khaleda Zia's body was taken to the tomb of former president and her husband Ziaur Rahman in a special vehicle. 
After being taken near the tomb, members of the army and navy carried Khaleda Zia's coffin on their shoulders. 

During the burial process, Tarique Rahman, his wife Zubaida Rahman, daughter Zaima Rahman, younger brother Arafat Rahman's wife Shamila Rahman, his elder daughter Zahia Rahman, younger daughter Zafira Rahman and other family members, BNP leaders and activists, and leaders of various political parties stood up to pay their respects and pay their respects.

Headline_English: Indian diplomat asked to keep meeting secret: Jamaat Ameer to Reuters
Content_Enlish:
Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami Ameer Shafiqur Rahman met with an Indian diplomat after his bypass surgery in 2025. The news agency Reuters reported that the Jamaat Ameer confirmed the meeting in an interview given at his residence on Wednesday. 
The Jamaat Ameer told Reuters that the Indian diplomat did not meet him publicly like diplomats from other countries. The Indian official asked him to keep the meeting secret. 
“Why? Many diplomats came to me and it was made public. Where is the problem?” Shafiqur Rahman said. In this context, he added, “We have to be open to everyone and to each other. We have no other option but to improve our relations.” 
Reuters did not immediately receive a response from India’s Foreign Ministry when asked about the Jamaat Ameer’s statement. However, an Indian government source confirmed that contacts were being made with various political parties, the report said. 
Shafiqur Rahman was asked by Reuters about Jamaat-e-Islami’s historical closeness to Pakistan. “We maintain relations with everyone in a balanced way. We are never interested in leaning towards any one country,” he replied. 
The Jamaat ameer also told Reuters that Sheikh Hasina’s continued presence in India after fleeing Dhaka is a concern, with relations between the two countries at their lowest point in decades since her fall. 

South Asia’s biggest power, Hindu-majority India, has maintained close ties with Hasina, according to a Reuters report. 
Unity government 
The once-banned Jamaat-e-Islami is set to show its strength in the elections due in February, according to a Reuters report. The party is open to joining a unity government and has spoken to several parties about it, its chief said. 
Opinion polls show that Jamaat-e-Islami, which is contesting the elections for the first time in nearly 17 years, will come in second place behind the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). The gap will be smaller there. Jamaat was last in power as an ally of BNP from 2001 to 2006. 
In an interview given a few days after forming an electoral alliance with the Jan-Jid party (NCP), the Jamaat Ameer told Reuters about the unity government, "We want to see the country stable for at least five years. If the parties come to one place, then we will run the government together." 
Anti-corruption stance 
In an interview given to Reuters, the Jamaat Ameer said that the anti-corruption stance must be a common agenda for any unity government. He also said that the party that gets the most seats will become the prime minister. If Jamaat gets the most seats, then the party will decide whether to be the prime minister's candidate or not. 

According to the Reuters report, the rise of Jamaat-e-Islami came after the fall of long-time Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina in the face of a youth-led coup in August last year. Hasina's party, the Awami League, is not able to participate in the elections this time. 

Hasina has been a fierce critic of Jamaat-e-Islami, and several Jamaat leaders were sentenced to death for war crimes during her tenure in the 1971 war of independence with Pakistan. Jamaat opposed the war of independence. 

Jamaat-e-Islami has been banned from participating in elections since 2013 after a court ruling. The government led by Nobel laureate Professor Muhammad Yunus lifted the ban on the party in August 2024. 

In an interview, the Jamaat ameer said that if a government is formed with Jamaat, that government will not be “comfortable” with President Md. Shahabuddin. 

He was elected president unopposed in 2023 with the support of the Awami League. Earlier this month, President Shahabuddin himself told Reuters that he wanted to resign midway through his term as president. 

However, in a telephone conversation with Reuters on Wednesday, President Md. did not want to comment on the Jamaat ameer’s position. Sahabuddin said he did not want to "complicate this matter further."

Headline_English: Messi or Ronaldo: Whom did Modric choose as the best?
Content_Enlish:
Last summer, Real Madrid fans were left with a cloud of sadness when Luka Modric left. The Croatian magician spent 13 long seasons in the Spanish capital. His on-field and off-field charm made him the apple of the eye for Madrid fans. 
He turned 40 last September, but his legs haven't lost any of their edge. Even though he left Real Madrid to join Italian club AC Milan, he still rules the midfield in a familiar rhythm. He has been accompanied by many great coaches and teammates during his long career at Real Madrid. 
In a recent interview with 'Corriere della Sera', Modric talked about his childhood, upbringing, and his long journey in football. Naturally, the topic of Messi-Ronaldo also came up. He was asked directly - Lionel Messi or Cristiano Ronaldo, who is better? 
Usually, footballers weigh their preferences when asked such questions. But Modric has taken a different path. Instead of choosing one, he called the two superstars 'artisans of a unique football era'. 

His relationship with Ronaldo is quite strong due to playing together at Real for a long time. However, he did not shy away from expressing his admiration for Messi. Modric said, 'I do not like this question at all. They both ruled an entire football era.' 

From the experience of sharing the dressing room with Ronaldo, Modric added, 'My relationship with Cristiano is a little closer, because we played together. I can tell you for sure that he is not only a great footballer, but also unique as a person. People do not know how big his heart is! He always tries to help people. He is as simple and straightforward as ten other ordinary people.' 

And Modric's assessment of Messi? The former Real Madrid midfield general said, "I don't know him (Messi) personally as a person. But I have no doubt that he is an extraordinary person. And as a footballer? He is simply magical!"

Headline_English: Rajshahi University student's hanging body recovered from dormitory

Confirming the matter, Motihar Police Station Officer-in-Charge Abul Kalam Azad told Prothom Alo that the student had hanged herself by hanging her headscarf from a fan. Police rescued her from the scene and took her to Rajshahi Medical Hospital, where doctors declared her dead. The body has been sent to the hospital morgue for an autopsy. 
University Proctor Professor Mahbubur Rahman told Prothom Alo that the student was recovered hanging from the mess. The student's father has been spoken to. The body will be handed over after the legal process is completed.

Headline_English: Funeral procession crosses Manik Mia Avenue and enters surrounding roads
Content_Enlish:
Since Wednesday morning, lakhs of leaders, workers and ordinary people from different parts of the country have been gathering at Manik Mia Avenue, the South Plaza of the Jatiya Sangsad Bhaban and the surrounding areas for the funeral of BNP Chairperson and former Prime Minister Khaleda Zia. Apart from BNP workers and supporters, a large number of ordinary people spontaneously participated in the funeral. 
Manik Mia Avenue, the South Plaza of the Jatiya Sangsad Bhaban and the surrounding areas were filled to the brim before noon. As a result, people who came to attend the funeral for Khaleda Zia stood on various roads, metro stations, elevated expressways or sidewalks in the vicinity. Apart from this, prayers and silent funerals were held for the former head of government in various districts and divisional cities of the country. Whoever could or got the opportunity, participated in the funeral there. Party leaders, workers, supporters and fans prayed heartily for the former Prime Minister. 
Since noon, people have been gathering at the places designated for the funeral of Khaleda Zia. The crowd of people attending the funeral extended beyond the capital's Mirpur Road's Lalmatia Ground, Dhanmondi Road No. 27, Bijoy Sarani, Sher-e-Bangla Nagar, Agargaon, Shyamoli. People who came to attend the funeral stood in line at Farmgate, Karwan Bazar, the road beyond Bangla Motor, Moghbazar and Panthapath. Apart from this, there were crowds of people attending the funeral at Bijoy Sarani, the Office of the Chief Advisor, Agargaon, Farmgate and Karwan Bazar Metro stations. People also stood at the Farmgate-bound descent of the elevated expressway. 
There was a large presence of people outside the main roads of the capital and on the surrounding roads and alleys surrounding the funeral. Residents of these areas were also in front of their houses, and there was spontaneous participation of BNP leaders, workers, supporters and ordinary people on the sidewalks. Apart from this, people stood and participated in the prayers at Khaleda Zia's funeral wherever they got the opportunity, including on the roofs of various buildings in the capital, overbridges, etc. 
Apart from this, many people who could not come to the funeral on time due to the rush of people participated in the prayers from afar. Those who could not come had their eyes on the live broadcast of various media and social media. From afar, they raised their hands and prayed for their beloved leader. They bid farewell to this uncompromising former Prime Minister with tearful eyes. 
Missing Janaza and Prayers 
Missing Janaza of Khaleda Zia and prayers were offered for her in various districts and divisional cities of the country. Missing Janaza was held in various major cities of the country including Feni, Bogra, Dinajpur, Rangpur, Rajshahi, Sylhet, Chittagong, Mymensingh, Barisal. In Bogra, Khaleda Zia's missing Janaza was held at the historic Altafunnesa playground. People from all walks of life of the district participated in the funeral held at 3 pm. Then they participated in a special prayer for the forgiveness of Khaleda Zia. 

A funeral was also held in Sonagazi, Feni. The funeral was held at the Solaiman Bhuiyan Government Primary School grounds in the Dakshin Char Sahavikari area of ​​Char Darbesh Union of the upazila at 3:30 pm. Apart from this, funerals were held in Nawabganj and Hakimpur of Dinajpur. Khaleda Zia's funeral was also held at Chittagong University. 

After the biggest funeral in history, BNP Chairperson and former Prime Minister Khaleda Zia was buried next to the graves of former President and her husband and BNP founder Ziaur Rahman. Khaleda Zia was buried with state honors at the capital's Zia Udyan shortly before 5 pm today. 

After the funeral, attended by a large crowd, Khaleda Zia's body was taken from the Parliament Building to Zia Udyan in a flag-draped hearse under tight security by law enforcement agencies. At around 4:30 pm, Khaleda Zia's body was taken to the grave in a special vehicle. 

After being taken to the grave, members of the army and navy carried the coffin carrying Khaleda Zia's body on their shoulders. During the burial process, Tarique Rahman, his wife Zubaida Rahman, daughter Zaima Rahman, younger brother Arafat Rahman's wife Shamila Rahman, his elder daughter Zahia Rahman, younger daughter Zafira Rahman and other family members, BNP leaders and activists, and leaders of various political parties stood up to pay their respects and mourn.

The voting equation also says that the huge vote of women made her the Prime Minister three times. 

Shahinur Nargis said, Khaleda Zia was able to bring the people of the country under the banner of unity. That is why people spontaneously came to her funeral.

Khaleda Zia's family members, advisory council and prominent women participated in the funeral of Khaleda Zia in a specific place reserved for women's participation. Photo: Press Wing of the Chief Advisor

Atiqur Rahman brought his son Huzaifa from Malibagh 
Atikur Rahman brought his son Huzaifa from MalibaghPhoto: Prothom Alo 
Not only women, many people came to attend Khaleda Zia's funeral with their children. Md. Atiqur Rahman, owner of the New Rang Raj shop in Malibagh, brought his six-year-old son Huzaifa. He said that his son had been wearing pajamas and Punjabi since morning. He first went to Manik Mia Avenue with his son. However, he left there, thinking that the son would have more trouble in the crowd.

Headline_English:
Dipu murder case 
Man who snatched mobile phone during incident arrested
Content_Enlish:
During the incident of Dipu Chandra Das (27), a garment factory worker, being beaten and burnt to death in Bhaluka, Mymensingh, his mobile phone was snatched by Md. Ershad (27), a construction worker. Police arrested Ershad along with Dipu Das' mobile phone at around 5 pm today, Wednesday. 
The arrested Ershad is the son of Saidur Rahman of Nehara Joypur village in Mohanganj, Netrokona. Police arrested him from Dubaliapara area of ​​Habirbari union in Bhaluka upazila. 
Police said that Ershad used to work as a mason in the surrounding areas from Dubaliapara area. On the day of the incident, he joined the Pioneer Knitwears (BD) Limited factory after seeing the tension there. He took Dipu Das out of the factory and also participated in the beating. At that time, when Dipu started being beaten, his mobile phone fell out of his pocket and Ershad took it. Since Dipur's mobile phone was not found since the incident, the location of the mobile phone was confirmed with the help of technology, and the Detective Branch (DB) of the district police went on a drive this afternoon. Ershad was arrested at that time. 
Mymensingh Additional Superintendent of Police (Administration) Abdullah Al Mamun said that Ershad was there from the beginning of the incident. He will be handed over to the court tomorrow, Thursday. 
Dipu Chandra Das, an employee of Pioneer Knitwears (BD) Limited factory, was arrested and beaten to death on the night of December 18 in Dubaliapara area of ​​Habirbari union in Bhaluka on charges of insulting religion. Later, his body was hanged from a tree on the road divider in Square Masterbari area of ​​​​Dhaka-Mymensingh highway, one kilometer away from the factory, and his body was set on fire. 
The deceased Dipu Chandra Das is the son of Ravi Chandra Das of Mokamiakanda village of Banihala union in Tarakanda upazila. His brother Apu Chandra Das filed a case against 140 to 150 unidentified people in the incident. Law enforcement agencies have arrested 19 people in the case. Five of them have given confessional statements in court, according to the police.

Headline_English: Water shortage in hospitals
Content_Enlish:
Shaheed Suhrawardy Medical College Hospital is one of the country's leading government medical institutions. Every day, numerous patients from different parts of the country come here. Although the other management of the hospital is good, the lack of adequate clean water has been a cause of suffering for patients for a long time. 
Patients are in a miserable condition due to the lack of water in the bathrooms and toilets. Although there are two drinking water booths on the ground floor, patients have to buy it and use it. It is difficult to maintain hygiene due to the lack of water in the basin. Due to the lack of adequate water, various water-borne diseases including diarrhea and skin diseases are occurring. Doctors, nurses, ward staff and other staff are also suffering from problems. 
Patients coming from far away have to buy water from outside, which is putting additional pressure on them. Patients have to stand in line because there is water in the bathrooms at certain times of the day. The main reasons for these problems are unplanned management, old infrastructure, lack of adequate maintenance and lack of accountability of those responsible. 
If patients suffer from basic problems in such a major hospital in Dhaka, it is natural to raise questions about the fragility of the country's health sector. To solve the problem, it is important to install pure water filters in every ward and ensure a constant supply of water in bathrooms and sinks.

Headline_English: Stop the fireworks madness.
Content_Enlish:
The colorful lights and sounds of fireworks on New Year's Eve are an expression of joy for many. But the question remains, how safe is this joy? In the excitement of the moment, we often forget that loud noises and bright lights pose a serious risk not only to nature and wildlife, but also to sick people, children and the elderly. Especially heart patients cannot tolerate such noises, which pose a serious threat to their health. 
Although flying lanterns in Dhaka was banned in 2018, its implementation is very limited. The risk of accidents is increasing every year due to dangerous fireworks, low-quality crackers, densely populated areas and non-compliance with safety rules. If emergency services are delayed, the damage also increases manifold. 
Earlier, a child with heart disease died due to the sound of fireworks on New Year's Eve, which is a matter of deep thought for us. Every year, arson incidents occur on the Thirty-First Night. On the first day of the New Year, we see the death of numerous birds due to loud noises and fireworks. Every year, migratory birds come to our country to escape the severe cold. But due to our cruelty, they die a cruel death. This is unacceptable in any way.

Headline_English: Putin will benefit from US invasion of Venezuela
Content_Enlish:
The escalation of the threat surrounding Venezuela can easily be dismissed as a whim of US President Donald Trump. But the issue is so intertwined with a conflict that it would be wrong to view it as a regional incident of limited impact. Like Ukraine, Venezuela is now becoming a bargaining chip for global superpowers. This does not mean that the world is definitely heading towards World War III. Although that fear is always there. The two main characters in Russia-US relations, Trump and Vladimir Putin, are now more inclined towards mutually beneficial transactions than conflict. Therefore, the possibility of global compromise now seems more likely than global war.

Venezuela is not a major power. Yet the country is globally important. Because it has the world's largest oil reserves. At the same time, the country is a political ally of China, Iran and Russia. These countries are seen as their main rivals by the US-led Western world. Of the three countries, Russia is in the most complicated position on the Venezuela issue. US pressure poses a risk to the Kremlin. But there are potential benefits. As soon as Trump returns to the White House in early 2025, relations with Russia will suddenly return to a kind of partnership.

The ideal situation for Russia would be if the United States were to remain involved in Venezuela for years. But even if Maduro quickly loses power, that would be acceptable to them. Once everything is settled, the situation might look like a kind of transaction. For example, a pro-American Venezuela in exchange for an end to the war in Ukraine on Russian terms.

The United States has almost completely cut off financial aid to Ukraine. It has taken a mostly neutral stance. However, it continues to provide crucial intelligence to the Ukrainian military. The United States also removed Russia from the list of “direct threats” in the latest version of its National Security Strategy. Peace talks with Ukraine, initiated by Trump, are slowly progressing. In this situation, Putin has every reason to believe that the war is coming to an end on his terms.

All this suggests that the Kremlin will not now be severing ties with the Trump administration over a distant issue like Venezuela, which is not directly related to Russia’s core interests. Russia will not be desperate to save a friendly Latin American government. Russia’s support for Venezuela will always be directly related to the level of pressure the US is putting on Russia over the Ukraine issue.

The potential fall of Nicolas Maduro’s government is not the end of the world for the Kremlin. Russia has a long history of adapting to new political systems in countries where Russia’s traditional allies have lost power due to the US’s addiction to regime change. It is also acting as a ruthless political pawn here. If the US were to launch a military attack on Venezuela, the geopolitical gains from that move could outweigh the potential losses for Russia. Because it would put Russia and the US on the same moral footing on the issue of the Ukraine war. If the US can impose its will with military force in its ‘own backyard’, why can’t Russia do the same on its own territory?

Read more
'Battlefield' Venezuela: Trump backs down 2-0 to face Putin again
March 15, 2019
'Battlefield' Venezuela: Trump backs down 2-0 to face Putin again
Russians generally see themselves as defenders of the old international order. They consider themselves extremely conservative in their foreign policy. In their view, the US-led West is a revisionist force responsible for dismantling the post-World War II international order. They see the Ukraine war as a way to stop that revisionism. But their argument is that if there is no possibility of returning to the old order, and the West is responsible for it, then let's negotiate a new order.

An order in which the US does as it pleases in its Western Hemisphere, while Russia maintains its influence in the former Soviet territories. The ideal situation for Russia would be if the US remained involved in Venezuela for years. But even if Maduro quickly lost power, that would be acceptable to them. Once everything settles down, the situation may look like some kind of deal, like an end to the Ukraine war on Russian terms in exchange for a pro-US Venezuela.

Headline_English: Khaleda Zia's funeral processions in various districts
Content_Enlish:

Headline_English: Chief Advisor extends greetings to Bangladeshis and the world on the occasion of the Christian New Year
Content_Enlish:
On the occasion of the Christian New Year 2026, Principal Advisor Professor Muhammad Yunus has extended his greetings to all Bangladeshis living in the country and abroad, including the entire world. 
The Principal Advisor extended these greetings in a message given on Wednesday on the occasion of the 'English New Year' tomorrow, Thursday. 
Muhammad Yunus said, 'May the bonds of harmony, goodwill and brotherhood be further strengthened in the new year. May the new year bring unwavering happiness, peace and prosperity to everyone's lives. Happy New Year to everyone.' 
The Principal Advisor said, 'New Year means the beginning of new dreams, new hopes and new possibilities. This message of the arrival of the new excites us. Forgetting all the sorrows, it provides new inspiration and inspiration for a beautiful future.’ 
The Chief Advisor expressed the hope that in a democratic Bangladesh, we will all love the country and devote all our strength to the welfare of the people. ‘In the new year, we will face all the challenges together and build a Bangladesh based on equality and justice without discrimination.’ 
Muhammad Yunus said, ‘In the changed context after the July mass uprising, the new year is very important for our national life. We hope that the journey we have started on the path of democratic transition by repairing the flawed state system will be completed in the new year through a national election and a referendum on the July Charter implementation order.’ 

In the message, the Chief Advisor said, this election and referendum will further accelerate our democratic progress by resisting all conspiracies—this is our biggest hope in the new year.

Headline_English: Discussion and criticism of Ronaldo's goal celebration with his waist
Content_Enlish:
Al Nasr was flying in the Saudi Pro League. After 10 consecutive wins, Al Ittifaq finally stopped their winning streak. Cristiano Ronaldo's team drew 2-2 at the opponent's field last night. However, more than the scoreline of the match, the football world is now discussing Ronaldo's 957th career goal. Why? Because he didn't score the goal with his foot or head, but literally with his waist! 
The start of the match was not happy for Al Nasr. They fell behind in the 16th minute to a goal by former Liverpool star Georginio Wijnaldum. Joao Felix equalized for Al Nasr in the 47th minute just after the break. Then came the moment—Ronaldo's 'strange' goal in the 67th minute of the match. 
Ronaldo didn't have to work hard to score the goal. Felix's powerful shot hit Ronaldo's back or lower back and changed direction and went into the net. With luck, everything happens! CR7's ever-familiar 'swoooooo' celebration as soon as the ball hit the net. 

Ronaldo is still essential for three reasons, says Portugal coach 
However, Al Nasr could not hold on to the lead gained by luck. Wijnaldum scored his second goal in the 80th minute to equalize Ittifaq. In the end, the two teams had to leave the field sharing the points. 
Despite not winning the match, Al Nasr still holds the top spot in the table. They are at the top with 31 points from 11 matches with 10 wins and 1 draw. Ending the year with such a goal, Ronaldo wrote on social media, ‘We are on the right track and we know what we have to do in 2026!’ 
Meanwhile, the internet is abuzz with laughter over Ronaldo’s ‘waist poem’. One fan, while crediting Ronaldo, wrote, ‘GOAT can score goals with any part of his body if he wants!’

Headline_English: Can Trump's 20-point plan stop Israel's 'yellow' plan to occupy Gaza?
Content_Enlish:
Although US President Donald Trump's 20-point peace proposal did not bring permanent peace to the Palestinian Gaza Strip, Israel's two-year indiscriminate killings ended in October. Although the "unilateral" ceasefire continues to kill Gazans, the Israeli military chief has made it clear that Israel's so-called "Yellow Line" dividing Gaza into two is a blueprint for occupying the besieged territory. 
Despite Israel's various tricks, President Trump is trying to move forward with the second phase of his 20-point peace proposal. The two important points of the second phase are the complete withdrawal of Israeli forces from Gaza, the deployment of an international "temporary" force there, and the disarmament of Hamas. But Israel is not willing to withdraw troops, and Hamas is only willing to lay down its arms once a Palestinian state is established. 
All in all, the future of Gaza is still uncertain. Israel's continued ceasefire violations and Hamas's pledge to continue its resistance against the plan to occupy Gaza - both of which will determine how long the conflict that ended this year will last, and everyone will be watching in the new year. 

'Global Sumud Flotilla' 

The Israeli massacre in Gaza began on October 7, 2023. On that day, Hamas and other Gaza independence organizations entered southern Israel and launched an unprecedented attack. Capitalizing on this attack, Israel began an indiscriminate attack on Gaza on the same day. This massacre continued for two years, with a few days' break for prisoner exchanges. The Israeli army's 'scorched earth policy' turned the besieged valley into a wasteland. Famine descended on Gaza due to the all-out blockade. Children began to die from lack of milk. 

The Global Sea Flotilla set sail for Gaza by sea to break Israel's inhumane blockade. The first flotilla set sail from Barcelona, ​​Spain, on August 31. More ships from Tunisia and Sicily, Italy, joined the flotilla from September 13 to 15. More ships from the Greek island of Cyrus later joined the flotilla with relief supplies. The ships carried a symbolic but significant humanitarian cargo of food, medical supplies and other essential items for the people of Gaza. 

A woman walks with a child through the rubble of Khan Younis, Gaza 
A woman walks with a child through the rubble of Khan Younis, Gaza File photo: Reuters 
Initially, the flotilla consisted of more than 50 ships and hundreds of international volunteers, activists and lawmakers representing at least 44 countries. The flotilla also included Swedish climate activist Greta Thunberg and Bangladeshi photographer Shahidul Alam. The activists in the flotilla faced adverse weather conditions at sea. There were also suspected drone attacks near Malta and Crete, which damaged some ships and forced them to retreat. When the flotilla reached the eastern Mediterranean, there were 44 ships in the flotilla. 

But Israel did not allow any of the flotilla's ships to dock in Gaza. Israeli forces took control of all the ships in the flotilla. They were taken to Israeli seaports. More than 500 activists were detained. However, they were later sent back to their respective countries. 

‘Operation Gideon’s Chariot’ 

In mid-May of this year, the Israeli army announced the start of a new military operation in Gaza called ‘Operation Gideon’s Chariot’. The Israeli forces launched this attack mainly targeting Gaza City. To avoid this operation, Hamas offered a two-month ceasefire in exchange for the release of Israeli prisoners. This ceasefire attempt collapsed when Israel did not respond. 

The remaining houses and structures in Gaza City were demolished through this new operation. The almost defunct hospitals there and their doctors and staff were not spared from this operation. In addition, the Israeli forces used unmanned armored vehicles filled with explosives to demolish houses. 

The number of people killed in Gaza due to Israel’s continued attacks has exceeded 71,000. About 170,200 Palestinians have been injured. A UN-backed commission and several international organizations have described Israel’s massacre in Gaza as “ethnic cleansing.” 

Trump’s 20-point and “unilateral” ceasefire 

The White House released a plan to end the war in Gaza in late September. At the time, it was said that if both sides accepted the 20-point proposal of the plan, the war would stop immediately. According to the proposal, all hostages, both living and dead, held in Gaza would be returned within 72 hours and Palestinian prisoners held in Israel would be released. 

According to the proposal, a Palestinian technocratic government would take responsibility for governing Gaza in the new system. Hamas would have no role in it. The independence-seeking organization would lay down its arms. Israel would also not occupy Gaza or annex it. The proposal also called for the formation of an international stabilization force (ISF) for the Gaza Strip. In continuation of this, a ceasefire between Hamas and Israel came into effect on October 10. According to the agreement, Hamas handed over all prisoners, both living and dead. 

According to the ceasefire agreement, 600 trucks carrying relief goods were allowed to enter Gaza every day. However, according to the United Nations and various non-governmental organizations, currently only 100 to 300 trucks carrying relief goods are able to enter Gaza every day. Israel is not even allowing the necessary tents to enter Gaza. Even violating the terms of the agreement, Israel has not allowed the Rafah crossing on the Egyptian border to open. 
Although the ceasefire came into effect in October, Israeli attacks on Gaza have not stopped. Since the ceasefire came into effect, Israel has carried out about 800 attacks on Gaza, killing at least 411 Palestinians. Among them, on December 13, an Israeli attack on Gaza City killed Raed Saad, a senior commander of Hamas' military wing, the Qassam Brigades. 

In addition, according to the ceasefire agreement, 600 relief trucks are allowed to enter Gaza every day. But according to the United Nations and various non-governmental organizations, currently only 100 to 300 trucks are able to enter with relief every day. Israel is not even allowing the necessary tents to enter Gaza. 

Even violating the terms of the agreement, Israel has not allowed the Rafah crossing on the Egyptian border to open. As a result, the entry of relief into Gaza is being severely disrupted. And at the end of the year, a natural disaster occurred like a nightmare. Heavy rains and bitter cold disrupted the lives of Gaza residents who took shelter in tents. 

The 'yellow' plan for the occupation of Gaza 

In the first phase of the ceasefire agreement, Israel withdrew its troops along a specific border in the valley. That border is called the 'yellow line'. A draft map shows that by drawing the yellow line, about 58 percent of the area of ​​Gaza has been placed under Israeli control. 

Palestinians are being shot and killed by drone strikes as they approach the Yellow Line. On December 6, Israeli forces killed seven Palestinians. Among the dead were a 70-year-old woman and her son. 

Two of them were chased and attacked by an Israeli drone in Gaza City. The Israeli army claims that three people were killed in separate attacks. The three had crossed the ‘Yellow Line.’ 

The Yellow Line will be the ‘new border’ between Gaza and Israel, Israeli military chief Yal Zamir has announced. He made the remarks during a recent meeting with Israeli troops deployed in Gaza. 

Palestinian homes being demolished in the West Bank 
Palestinian homes being demolished in the West Bank File photo: Reuters 
The Israeli withdrawal from the Yellow Line means that Israel will control more than half of Gaza. This includes much of Gaza's farmland and the Rafah border crossing with Egypt. 

"The Yellow Line will be (Israel's) new border. It will serve as our front line of defense. Our operations will continue along this line. Large parts of Gaza are under Israeli control. We will not move from this line of defense," said Ya'al Zamir. 

So far, the Israeli government has not promised to completely withdraw troops from Gaza. It has said it will maintain a buffer zone "unless there is a new threat of terrorism." According to experts, these loopholes in the terms will allow Israel to remain in Gaza indefinitely.

Movement to deploy international forces 

Official talks on the deployment of the International Security Assistance Force (ISF) to Gaza as part of the ongoing ceasefire recently began in Doha, the capital of Qatar. The talks are led by the US military's Central Command (CENTCOM). 

The conference discussed the leadership structure of the international force and other issues. If all goes well, troops from different countries could be deployed to Gaza in the first month of the new year. 

Indonesia has already said it is ready to send up to 20,000 troops to Gaza for health and construction work. "This is still in the initial and preparatory stages," said Defense Ministry spokesman Rico Sirait. 

So far, the Israeli government has not promised to completely withdraw its troops from Gaza. It has said it will abide by a buffer zone "unless there is a new terrorist threat." Experts say the loopholes in the terms would allow Israel to remain in Gaza indefinitely. 
However, deploying international forces in Gaza will not be easy. It is not yet clear where these forces will be deployed. Hamas says the international forces should be deployed along the border. On the other hand, Israel wants international forces to be deployed in Gaza. And Hamas to hand over their weapons to those forces. 

However, US sources say that international forces may be deployed in the Israeli-controlled part of Gaza.

Israel is devouring the West Bank 

The occupied West Bank is not immune to Israeli aggression. The Israeli cabinet's security committee has approved the establishment of 19 new illegal settlements there. Israel's hard-right Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich said that such a step has been taken to prevent the establishment of an independent Palestinian state. 

In a statement on December 21, Smotrich said that he himself had proposed the establishment of new settlements. He was accompanied by Defense Minister Israel Katz. According to their proposal, the cabinet has approved the establishment of 19 settlements in the West Bank's Judea and Samaria area. In this regard, the Israeli government has allowed the establishment of 69 settlements in the West Bank in the past three years. 

The permission to establish new illegal settlements was given at a time when the United Nations had expressed deep concern about this a few days ago. The United Nations, stating that the Jewish settlements built in the West Bank are illegal under international law, said at the time that illegal settlement activity in this Palestinian territory had reached its highest level since at least 2017. 

The United Nations has been collecting data on Israeli settlements in the West Bank since 2017. Citing calculations made since then, UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres said, "Illegal settlement activity has increased rapidly in recent years. An average of 12,815 houses were built illegally each year from 2017 to 2022." 

In addition, Israeli forces have committed no less atrocities in the West Bank in recent times. They have killed at least 1,027 Palestinians in the West Bank since the start of the Gaza offensive in October 2023. Israel has tightened military control over several towns there. 

The passing year will be a source of relief for Palestinians as Israel’s indiscriminate attacks on Gaza finally come to an end. However, the Israeli plan to occupy Gaza and expand its occupation of the West Bank is threatening another difficult year for Palestinians.

Headline_English: Gold price drops by another Tk 2,741 in Bhoori
Content_Enlish:
In the space of two days, the price of gold in the domestic market is decreasing again. As a result, the price of a good quality, i.e. 22-carat gold will be around 224,000 taka. The new price will be effective from tomorrow, Thursday. 
Bangladesh Jewelers Association announced the adjustment of gold prices on Wednesday night. The Jewelers Association said that the price of acidic gold has decreased in the local market. Due to this, the price of gold at the consumer level has been adjusted. The price of gold in the domestic market last Tuesday decreased by 2500 taka per bori. As a result, the price of gold per bori decreased to about 227,000 taka that day. Gold has been sold at this price till today. 
Earlier, last Monday, the price of gold increased by 3,149 taka per bori. As a result, the price of good quality 22-carat gold is 2,29,431 taka per bori. That was the highest price of gold in the country's history so far. 
According to the new price announced by the Jewelers Association, 22-carat gold will be sold at 224,182 taka from tomorrow, Thursday. Apart from this, 21-carat gold will be sold at 214,034 taka, 18-carat at 183,416 taka and traditional gold at 152,857 taka. 
Meanwhile, till Wednesday, 22-carat gold was sold at 226,923 taka, 21-carat at 216,600 taka, 18-carat at 185,691 taka and traditional gold at 154,723 taka in the domestic market. 
Accordingly, from Thursday, 22-carat gold will be sold at 2,741 taka, 21-carat at 2,566 taka, 18-carat at 2,275 taka and traditional gold at 1,866 taka. 
Although the price of gold has decreased, the price of silver remains unchanged. The price of silver last increased last Sunday. Currently, 22-carat silver is being sold at 6,065 taka per piece. Apart from this, 21-carat silver is being sold for 5,774 taka, 18-carat silver for 4,957 taka, and traditional silver for 3,733 taka.
