In the first round of reform dialogue, the political parties have agreed on many issues. There is no news of their implementation starting. Meanwhile, almost 10 months have passed since the government took office. During this time, three acceptable elections have been held in this country under three caretaker governments in the past. They also faced no less adversity. They were proactive in changing some rules and regulations on their own initiative, including administrative reshuffles. This has also yielded benefits later. This demand is much stronger for the current government. No one would object to 'fundamental reforms' if political consensus could be reached. But if there is no consensus on some issues, then there is no reform - this cannot be an acceptable position. 

There are reports in the newspapers that the budget that the government is going to present is not taking into account the recommendations of the committee and task force formed on the economy after the popular uprising. Is its 'opportunity' less? If there is little opportunity to take steps on economic reforms in the interim, the question can also be raised as to how much opportunity there is for consensus on serious issues like politics. No one denies the need for discussion to resolve differences of opinion. In this situation, it would be appreciated if the recommendations that are not in disagreement were implemented. If the government is accused of wasting valuable time by not going that way, it cannot be dismissed. Rather, the suspicion that the government is on the path to postponing the elections by delaying the reform dialogue will be concentrated in this. 

Apart from issues such as bank reforms, increasing reserves, and managing the commodity market, the interim government has not been successful in any other area. Government supporters are also criticizing its failure to maintain law and order. The day before writing this article, two young men were killed in a mob lynching in the capital. The picture of the increase in arrests during the Yunus government's tenure is clear. Although this can be presented as evidence of increased police activity, the picture of law and order is inconsistent with it. It also has a clear impact on the economy. The economy is not getting going because anxiety and uncertainty are not going away. If the government had moved towards elections with a wave of reforms, it would have created momentum in this regard! Unless public safety and trust increase, the budget being given will not be easy to implement. The government's predicament over NBR reform has led to a crisis in revenue collection in the current fiscal year. If the economy is not dynamic, revenue will not increase anyway. It will also be difficult to meet the government's regular expenses. 
The situation created in the economy is also strengthening the demand for early elections. Meanwhile, the longer the election ceremony is delayed, the more the power of forces without widespread public support will increase. This seems to be more and more evident in the experience of the past few months. The government has failed to adopt strictness in this situation. Its political neutrality is also more or less questionable. It is also seen as indecisive on reforms. In this situation, reform talks may seem pointless. Dialogue may seem urgent to take a clear decision on the timing of the elections. There was some talk between December and June about the possibility of holding elections before Ramadan. Discussions on establishing a consensus on that issue may also inspire hope at this time.

Headline_English: Ten years of new outposts in the UK
Content_Enlish:
Politicians tell a lot of lies about immigration to the UK. But some of the big things are made very easy. For example, it is very easy to get into Britain; it is very easy to get financial support; it is also very easy to gain citizenship. The UK is presented as a lifeless country, as if it is how future Britons are accepted, who do not need any charges, tests or invitations. 

The government’s latest policies to deal with the ‘failed experiment’ of ‘open borders’ are heavily influenced by these lies. Because they are designed to make things even harder for migrants. One of these policies has attracted a lot of attention. It is a trivial point in Keir Starmer’s anguished speech. But the consequences will be catastrophic. The policy increases the period required to live in Britain permanently from five years to 10 years. Then you can live permanently and get citizenship. Where one used to get citizenship after five years, this news has disappointed me. 

If the government’s new policies are implemented, it will now take at least 11 years to complete the citizenship process. Furthermore, this does not include time spent in the UK on student or other visas. I know from experience that five years is already a long test of holding on to a job against all odds and battling sudden changes in the law. Doubling that time adds to everything from professional security to the anxiety about immigration, or ‘inclusion’. 
Many data summaries and flawed decisions provide misleading information about citizenship. The number of work visas has increased in the short term due to the need to support the struggling health and care sectors after Brexit and the pandemic. And the important thing about immigration numbers is the misclassification of different types. For example, there is an implicit assumption that all those entering on long-term visas with the prospect of permanent residence will stay. 

A 2023 report found that only 38 per cent of workers who were in the workforce in 2018 still had valid or indefinite leave to remain after five years. This means that all workers and their families, or even half, are unlikely to apply for UK citizenship. And the pain of the extension will vary at different levels. It would be unnecessarily cruel, especially to apply to those who have already reached the 10-year mark. Those who came to the UK on the basis that citizenship was an option and that they had taken major steps in their lives on the basis of that, now find themselves literally unable to settle down. 
I received countless letters and phone calls after the proposed new rules were announced. ‘I think it’s unfair’, said Christine, a skilled worker who was due to become a citizen in a year’s time. ‘The decision to come to a new country is not a trivial matter in life.’ 

Herein lies the real crisis of this short-sighted and cruel change. Those who come to this country and build a life, have or bring up children, become part of the social fabric and work consistently throughout their citizenship could soon be cutting ties with the British state for more than a decade – marked by more than fear and anxiety. If ever there was a ‘failed experiment’, this would be it.

Headline_English: Iran-Israel war, 'peace' in the Middle East and the United States
Content_Enlish:
Iran occupies a unique place in the geopolitical history of the Middle East. As an important center of ancient civilizations, traditions, and culture, Iran has withstood attacks from both enemies and allies throughout the ages and has set a unique example of overcoming adversity and surviving. When analyzing Iran’s role in the modern era, it is clear that the country is not just a state, but an ideal—a symbol of the struggle against Western imperialism and hegemony. Iran’s recent political and military stance, especially its steadfast support for Muslim countries such as Palestine, Syria, and Lebanon, has made Iran an indispensable part of the Muslim world in the Middle East. 

Israel’s aggression and its brutal treatment of the Palestinian people are nothing new. Since the establishment of Israel in 1948, it has been a constant threat to the rights of Palestinians and peace in the Muslim world. Israel has repeatedly committed occupation, aggression, and human rights violations in disregard of international law. Recently, Israel's massacre of the Palestinian people has been condemned worldwide. The bombing of mosques, hospitals, and civilian settlements has brought a terrible disaster to the lives of Palestinians. The Israeli attack on Gaza since October 7, 2023 is the latest example of this atrocity. In addition to advancing on the path of destruction of the Palestinians, Israel has made Iran a strategic target in its aggressive policy. 

This position of Iran has clearly created two poles in international politics. On the one hand, the Western alliance led by the United States and Israel, and on the other hand, Iran and its allies. The Western world has long been trying to limit Iran's influence. In this regard, economic sanctions, political pressure, and military threats are their main weapons. But in the meantime, Iran has been able to maintain its own technological and military progress. 

One example of Iran's military capabilities is its missile technology and regional defense system. This progress is a major cause of concern for Israel and its Western allies. Iran's military research and development have made it a power that is a challenge to the Western world. In contrast to Israel's aggressive attitude, Iran's deterrent military policy is not only important for protecting its sovereignty, but also for regional stability. 
Israel's surprise attack on Iran on June 13, 2025, opened a new chapter in international politics. Although several Iranian military bases were targeted in this attack, Iran quickly responded by demonstrating its resilience. Iran targeted various strategic Israeli installations in retaliation. The retaliation caused significant damage to Israel. The situation became more complicated when the United States attacked Iran's nuclear facilities. 

In response to this US attack, Iran launched an unprecedented missile attack on US military bases in the Middle East. Iran's move not only demonstrated its resilience, but also challenged the US strategic position in the Middle East. The Iranian attack caused significant damage to various US military installations, which limited their activities in the Middle East. 

The situation became even more heated on June 23, when an Iranian attack from Iran's ally Qatar directly hit US military bases in Iraq. This attack caused significant damage to US military bases, which further weakened their regional influence. This bold move by Iran sent a clear message to international politics that they would not compromise on their sovereignty and regional security. 

Following this incident, the US diplomatically proposed a ceasefire, which has been implemented. Although this ceasefire brought temporary stability to the Middle East, it is being seen as a kind of defeat for the US and Israel in the face of resistance from Iran and its allies. Iran's strong resistance and counterattacks have made it clear that any aggression against them will not only fail but will also bring disaster to the aggressor. 

In the wake of this conflict, international concern has intensified. The ceasefire came into effect amid fears that tensions in the Middle East could escalate further. The ceasefire was brokered by Iran, Israel, and the United States. Although the ceasefire has brought temporary peace to the Middle East, it is doubtful how long it will last. 

The attack was carried out without any provocation, which is a clear example of Israel's aggressive policy. Israel's behavior is a serious signal not only to the Muslim countries of the Middle East, but also to the entire world. The strategic relations of countries such as Saudi Arabia, Qatar, and the United Arab Emirates with the West have made their neutrality and helplessness clear. 

Iran's response to this incident was significant. By taking countermeasures to the attack on its military base, Iran has proven that it is not only capable of resisting, but also capable of retaliating against any aggression. This firm stance by Iran has further strengthened its position in regional politics. However, it has increased instability in the Middle East and further complicated the regional peace process.

There are many reasons behind Israel’s attack on Iran. First, Iran’s nuclear program poses a major threat to Israel. The West also sees Iran’s nuclear development as a threat to its hegemony. Second, Iran’s regional allies—especially Hezbollah and the Syrian government—pose a challenge to Israel’s security. Third, Iran’s economic and military advances have increased its deterrence capabilities and challenged Western influence in the Middle East. 

In this context, the attack on Iran has created new instability in the geopolitics of the Middle East. But the long-term impact of this attack will not be limited to Iran and Israel. It will also challenge the role and political position of other Muslim countries in the Middle East. The silence of countries like Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates has made clear their loyalty to their Western allies. However, this silence could be harmful for them in the long run, as it questions their regional influence and their responsibility towards the Muslim world. 

The recent actions of the United States are also noteworthy in this context. The United States has long been a patron of Israel and has increased its military presence in the Middle East. A possible US attack on Iran could create a dangerous situation for them. First, Iran has built a strong deterrent system that is a challenge to US military operations. Second, Iran can harm US interests through cooperation with regional allies. Iran can disrupt US energy supplies in strategic locations such as the Strait of Hormuz. Third, any attack on Iran would create instability in the entire Middle East and endanger US allies. 

Iran has long been under Western economic sanctions and military threats. But the country has not allowed these adversities to hinder its development. Iran's progress in science, technology, and the military has set a remarkable example. Their progress has not only helped to protect the country's sovereignty, but it has also served as a new hope and inspiration for their people. 

This strong position of Iran is not only important for their own security, but also significant in a larger context. Iran's support for countries such as Palestine, Lebanon, and Syria is a symbol of their commitment to the Muslim world. This role of Iran can serve as an important foundation for the unity and stability of the Muslim world. 

However, the Western world's plans for Iran are not only military or strategic. They try to create instability in Iran's internal politics, which includes economic pressure and creating social divisions. But the Iranian people and leadership have proven by uniting against all these conspiracies that their mantra of firmness and resistance cannot be cracked. 

The current situation in the Middle East is going through a transitional period. The role of a country like Iran is particularly significant in this transitional period. Their resilience and commitment to human values ​​are forcing the Muslim world in the Middle East to rethink. Their stand for the rights of the Palestinian people, their response to Israeli aggression, and their efforts to preserve the unity of the Muslim world have established Iran not just as a country, but as a symbol. 

This conflict between Iran and Israel is not limited to just the two countries, it will have a profound impact on the future of the Middle East. The outcome of this conflict between the plans of the Western world and the resistance of Iran will determine the geopolitical balance of the Middle East. The story of this resistance of Iran is an inspiration not only for their nation, but for the entire Muslim world. This mantra of resistance and progress of Iran has set an important precedent in world politics.

Headline_English: When the protector is the eater
Content_Enlish:
The way stones are being openly extracted from the railway's reserved stone quarry, or 'rail bunker', in Bholaganj, Sylhet and hundreds of boats are being filled with them is nothing short of looting. According to a Samakal report published on Wednesday, the Railway Protection Force-RNB is there to monitor the reserved area. Since it is a border area with India, BGB members are also active there. 

Yet, it doesn't take an expert to understand how such organized looting can take place. It's not just the railway bunker; stones have been looted from the Bholaganj quarry itself. This has happened at such a high rate in the past 10 months that instead of stones, numerous small and large holes are now visible in this empire. In recent times, this negligence has been going on with political support. However, even though the railway bunker area is within the security cordon, the picture of looting there is a testimony to the critical situation in the entire area. 

Samakal's pictorial report shows a crowd around the railway's stone field. Tarpaulin and plastic covers have been installed on the property to protect it from the heat of the sun and rain. The inaction of the guards of this property owned by the railway and the government proves that the protectors have taken on the role of the devourers. Samakal correspondents have confirmed in their meetings with the concerned that RNB members take two to three hundred taka from each boat in their left hands. BGB members have to pay three hundred to five hundred taka and stones are sold for three to five thousand taka per boat. In other words, a smuggling market has been established at various places in the local Dhalai river in the process of looting stones! 

Due to the extraction of about 80 percent of the stone of the railway bunker of about 350 acres in this way, the hills have become almost flat land. Numerous holes have been created there, which have turned into sinkholes in the rain. Due to this stone extraction, there is a fear of a terrible environmental and humanitarian disaster. As a result, there are incidents such as destruction of biodiversity, river erosion, landslides and loss of life. 

According to the information of the Bangladesh Environmental Lawyers Association, there are eight stone quarries in Sylhet district. In all these places, stone extraction using 'bomb machines' has caused terrible damage to the environment and the people. For this reason, the High Court has ruled to stop the extraction of stone by mechanical methods. But after the fall of the government on August 5, local influential politicians have again started the evil practice of stone plundering, ignoring the aforementioned verdict. 

After this looting from the stone quarry in Bholaganj, we are seeing that even the stones of the reserved area railway bunker are not being recovered. 

We think that if the security forces are proactive, it will not be difficult to prevent such looting. They will have to be held accountable for why they have shown indifference in performing their duties for so long. If the administration plays its proper role, it is possible to restore this stone kingdom of Sylhet. In particular, the environment where tourists go to see the beauty of the white stone will have to be protected. If the administration conducts regular operations, the illegal trade in stones can be stopped. Otherwise, as the looting of the country's resources increases, the environment will also be at risk.

Headline_English: Trump-Erdogan meeting and Middle East stability
Content_Enlish:
Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan and US President Donald Trump met on Tuesday. This was their first meeting since Trump took office for a second term in January. Their meeting was held on the sidelines of the NATO summit in The Hague, Netherlands. The meeting took place at a critical moment in Turkish-US relations. The two leaders discussed the Iran-Israel ceasefire, Ukraine-Russia talks, Gaza, Syria and the F-35 fighter jet program. 

Each issue deserves separate discussion. However, it is important to analyze Turkey's response to the US attack on Iran at the outset. When America attacks the region, it affects the dynamics of regional powers, as well as global markets and the animosity and alliance with Washington. In that regard, Ankara's reaction has been intriguing. 

The US attacked Iran at the same time as Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi was visiting Turkey. Araghchi held a press conference in Istanbul shortly after the attack, where he directly addressed the Turkish media. There were no Turkish officials at his press conference. The point is that Turkey is mediating as a third party. Turkey is still one of the potential active forces in establishing contact between Washington and Tehran. However, the way Turkey is reacting cautiously to regional issues may be a matter of strategy, as the country is emphasizing diplomatically addressing the crisis. The Turkish foreign minister expressed deep concern in a strong statement after the attack on Iran’s nuclear facility. But he did not mention the word “condemnation.” Turkey used the word calculatedly so that Turkey could play a mediating role in the future. 

Turkey had been working to bring Iran to the negotiating table before the US attack. At the same time, it urged the US not to launch a military strike on Tehran. In mid-June, Erdogan spoke twice with Trump to restart Iran-US nuclear talks. He also spoke of greater diplomatic efforts. 
Ankara's move in a turbulent environment seems to be planned. However, the effectiveness of this move largely depends on the regional situation. Erdogan's expectations from the United States are very high in various ways. First, he is working on a meeting with Trump at the White House in the next few months. He also wants to host the 2026 NATO summit in Turkey, which is a significant diplomatic opportunity for Ankara. 

Second, Erdogan hopes that Turkey can be the venue for peace talks between Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin. This is an ambitious diplomatic goal. But Trump has already said that he can sit in on such talks if Putin agrees. 

Third, Turkey is very interested in discussing the Israeli genocide in Gaza with Washington. This issue is overshadowed by the Iran-Israel war and the situation in Syria. Turkey is trying to convince Washington to stop this inhuman tragedy in Gaza. 

Fourth, Syria is in a difficult position in Turkey-US relations. Erdogan welcomed the US decision to lift the blockade on Syria. However, Turkey views the Syrian Democratic Forces, which the US has been supporting, as a terrorist organization and a threat to its national security. This support is a source of discomfort for Turkey. 
Another priority for Turkey is to make the Iran-Israel ceasefire permanent. This issue gained momentum in Erdogan's 45-minute meeting with Trump as an immediate issue. Finally, Erdogan said that he had not given up hope of receiving F-35 fighter jets from the US. Turkey had previously abandoned plans to obtain the aircraft from Russia and the country hopes to reach $100 billion in US-Turkish military-industrial cooperation agreements. 
Gaza, F-35s from Syria and US-Russian diplomacy are not issues that can be resolved overnight. This requires real political will and mutual understanding from both sides. Turkish-US relations are clearly at a stage of real planning and adaptation to the new situation. It may be seen in a new light with time. 

Dr. Sinem Cengiz: Turkish Middle East expert and Turkish politician; lightly abridged translation from Arab News by Mahfuzur Rahman Manik

Headline_English: How vigilant is the future leadership regarding public expectations?
Content_Enlish:
The July Uprising was a historic event. A spontaneous student uprising. The dream of the uprising was that accountability, law and justice would be at the top of the priority list in the country. But is that turbulent wave gradually calming down? There was universal trust in the students' movement. Yet today they are divided, confused, and hesitant; some of the leaders are accused of irregularities. 

In this context, when the discussion of the general election is gradually intensifying, the people's expectations are increasing towards the future leadership. The responsibility is especially greater on the BNP. They have to prove that they are not just partners in power politics. Rather, they are capable of building an inclusive democratic state; where the hopes and aspirations of the people will be reflected. The party must be proactive in building a democratic outline of an alternative non-discriminatory participatory governance structure. The party will learn from the mistakes of the past and form a democratic state and society in the coming days - this is what the people want to see. 
The BNP must also clarify its position. They must tell the people how they will ensure secularism, human rights, the judiciary and decentralization of power. It is not just about seeking elections; it is also the party's political responsibility to present a good governance framework to the people after the elections. 

If the BNP comes to power, the pressure of public expectations will increase further. The leaders will have to pay the price of the people's demands. They will have to clearly explain to the people their position on the issue of Indian hegemony. Because India has supported the fascist government for the last 15 and a half years. The relationship between the two countries should be one of equality - this is the people's desire. In addition, they must express active political promises and programs to build a democratic society without discrimination by keeping the spirit of the July Uprising and discarding old customs. 

On the NCP question, it must be remembered that the power and ambition of youth were the driving force of change. The July Uprising, the participation of millions of young people, and the sacrifice of thousands of lives have initiated a historic political shift. If politics is again subjected to manipulation in the context of those sacrifices, public trust will not return. Despite its flaws, the strong participation of the youth will hold politics accountable – this is what everyone expects. 

In reality, there is a dual reaction in the public mind regarding the NCP. They are talking about an alternative political settlement. On the other hand, allegations and suspicions have been raised against some of their leaders regarding corruption, corruption and Jamaat-like stance. These questions are not unusual in a democratic society, but rather necessary for political purification. However, the Jamaat-NCP relationship may also become an obstacle to the democratic transition in the future if the NCP does not make its position clear to the people. 

Allegations of corruption, usurpation, abuse of power, etc. are spreading on social media against NCP leaders. However, there is no statement on them from the government or the intellectual community. Are they a force for change at all, or are they just an opportunistic group waiting for an opportunity? Or are they becoming the new scapegoat? 

Students are still active in the field. But do they understand that some are using them as a trap? Politics today is not just a place for ideals. It has become a game of dice; a game of those old oligarchs. In the game of politics, those who are weak in the chess game are the ones who suffer the most – we must remember. 
The upcoming elections are an important moment in determining the future of this country. One side wants sanctions, the other side wants coexistence. The third side wants justice and transparency. Where will Bangladesh go in this conflict? If we really want a new Bangladesh, then it is not just blood; we need a politics of compromise and trust. We need credible leadership, a clear political program, and a disciplined electoral plan. The country does not change just by banning someone. It has to change with the mentality, structure, and philosophy of leadership. 

So we need a politics of mutual trust, a politics of compromise. Without falling for anyone's trickery, everyone should clearly stand before the people and stand before them. The people do not forgive anyone. If they believe that they have been cheated; the people will pay for it. This applies to all political forces. 
On the other hand, the interim government must take initiatives to make the Election Commission, administration, judiciary and other state institutions more neutral and effective within the remaining time. All kinds of work must be completed to organize fair elections. People are no longer satisfied with words. They want to see proof of work. 
Finally, it must be remembered that it is the moral duty of every political party to respect the spirit of the young generation who gave their lives on the streets demanding democratic transformation in this country. If that spirit is forgotten; if the change of power becomes the only objective, then the young society will again take to the streets and raise slogans – ‘A great storm in the chest, shoot me in the chest’. 
The historic political opportunity that has come before Bangladesh at this moment, if properly utilized in accordance with the aspirations of the people, can be the beginning of not just an election, but a new political chapter.

Headline_English: Women-friendly budget: expectations and reality
Content_Enlish:
In the fiscal year 2025-26, significant progress has been made in the sectors of ‘Women and Child Development’, ‘Social Welfare’, ‘Health’, ‘Education’, ‘Poverty Alleviation’ and ‘Women’s Empowerment’. The budget has been allocated considering women’s participation in 48 women-friendly ministries and departments. According to government estimates, the budget for women this year is about Tk 2 lakh crore, which is about 28 percent of the total budget. This is a slight increase compared to the previous year. 

For the first time, institutional recognition has been promised for women’s unpaid and unrecognized care and household work. However, it would have been better if more allocation was made for care centers. 
The minimum tax rate of Tk 1,000 for new taxpayers is a welcome initiative to broaden the tax base. However, the proposed changes in the tax-free personal income level and the personal income tax structure will hurt low and middle-income families, who have been facing a loss of purchasing power for the past few years. 
The decision to make digital tax filing mandatory next year is commendable. The introduction of the rule of filing returns from monthly to quarterly is a positive step, especially for small businesses. However, increasing VAT on online product sales commission from 5 to 15 percent will significantly increase the operating costs for e-commerce platforms and will at least partially shift it to the service recipients. 

Increasing the fixed tax from Tk 3 per kg to Tk 5 per kg at the production stage of man-made fibres and cotton yarn will increase the cost of production for local textile manufacturing companies. Withdrawal of existing VAT exemption for local production of refrigerators, freezers, air conditioners and their compressors will be passed on to consumers in the form of higher prices. Withdrawal of VAT exemption on imports of sterile surgical catgut, surgical sutures will increase healthcare expenditure. Reduction of VAT exemption on LPG cylinders, lifts and household appliances will increase consumer prices. However, it will gradually broaden the VAT base. 

The Finance Minister has announced a special fund of Tk 125 crore for women entrepreneurs. The government has proposed an initiative to create 15,000 new entrepreneurs in the small and medium enterprises (SME) sector in the next three years. It also plans to set up product display and sales centers in divisional cities, organize regional SME product fairs in districts, and train 25,000 SME entrepreneurs to create a central database of CMSME entrepreneurs. 

The government has also set a target of disbursing Tk 10 billion in loans to 10,000 entrepreneurs in the marginal CMSME sector (including women entrepreneurs) and connecting 3,000 women entrepreneurs with corporate buyers through a digital platform to support the growth of the sector. 

It would have been better if the budget included a provision to reserve a portion of government procurement from women-owned businesses, which could be at least 15 percent of total government procurement. 
Food security is important. Tk 17,241 crore has been allocated for agricultural subsidies for the fiscal year 2025-26, which is 1 percent more than RBFY 25. Agricultural subsidies account for 37 percent of the total AAS budget in the fiscal year 2026. However, subsidy utilization in FY2024 stood at Tk 24,935 crore. It is not clear how to reduce subsidies and how they can help meet additional costs. 
Farmers have not fully benefited from subsidies. This highlights the need for improved monitoring and subsidy management. Women are primarily engaged in agriculture and are the first to suffer in times of food insecurity and poverty. Therefore, recognizing women as farmers and providing input support cards to women in agriculture can be important steps. The subsidy structure is reasonable and resources need to be allocated for training and providing subsidies to women farmers. 

Budgetary Shortages and Challenges 
1. Allocation and Implementation Gap: Sometimes, even though allocations are made in the budget, they are not implemented on time or properly. The implementation of women-friendly projects does not yield the desired results due to weaknesses at the local level, lack of transparency, and monitoring deficiencies. 
2. Lack of Gender-Sensitive Expenditure Analysis: Although gender-sensitive budgeting is in place, genuine gender-based analysis is absent in many cases. It is difficult to determine how much women actually benefit from this. 
3. Urban vs. Rural Disparity: While educated and middle-class women in cities get some opportunities, backward rural and poor women are deprived of those benefits. Special initiatives need to be taken for them. 
4. Limited allocation for women's protection and prevention of violence: Budget allocation for legal support and rehabilitation measures required to prevent violence against women, sexual harassment and cybercrime is still insufficient. 
5. Obstacles to women's participation in unconventional sectors: Policies and budget support supporting women's participation in unconventional sectors such as technology, transportation, construction, etc. are absent in many cases. 

Recommendations 
1. Strengthen implementation monitoring: Monitoring and evaluation systems need to be strengthened to ensure proper use of budget allocation. 
2. Priority for rural women: Special allocation for rural and marginalized women should be increased in women-friendly projects. 
3. Women's access to technology: Budget support and training programs need to be increased to increase women's participation in information technology and emerging sectors. 
4. Gender-sensitive analysis: Gender-sensitive analysis should be made mandatory at every stage of budget formulation. 
5. Single window for women entrepreneurs: A 'one-stop service' should be introduced for women entrepreneurs to get banking and government support. 
6. There should be steps to ensure government support and incentives for the formation of organizations of women entrepreneurs, so that women can organize and protect their interests and play an effective role in business development. 

Small and medium enterprises (SMEs) are a very strong pillar in the country's economic structure. They play a major role in employment generation, income growth, poverty reduction and economic development. But this sector with huge potential is lagging behind due to lack of necessary support. Currently, the number of SME companies in the country is 11.8 million. This sector has provided employment to 36 million people. That is, 87 percent of the employment in the industrial sector is in this sector. Those concerned say that the number of unemployed people in the country is increasing abnormally. A large part of them are educated. After completing their education and entering the labor market, they are not getting the desired employment. Currently, 47 out of 100 graduates in the country are unemployed. As a result, this sector can play an important role in reducing unemployment. Although much has been said about this sector in speeches and statements, effective initiatives are very limited. Training and technology support to increase skills, connecting SMEs to e-commerce and digital market places, simplifying the tax structure and licensing process, and organizing exhibitions to help them enter local and international markets. 

Nasreen Fatema Awal: President, Women Entrepreneurs Association of Bangladesh (WEB), Director, SME Foundation

Headline_English: The second phase of genocide in Palestine?
Content_Enlish:
Israel has maintained Western support for the genocide through a propaganda campaign of lies for 15 months. The country has been talking about Hamas war crimes, such as the beheading of children and gang rape, but no evidence has yet been found. Conversely, Israel has committed serious war crimes in response to Hamas’s response. According to the International Court of Justice (ICJ), Israeli leaders are desperately trying to divert attention from a new war. 

They need new lies to justify resuming the genocide. In this, as always, the Western establishment media is actively assisting. Both Hamas and Israel are using the regular exchange of hostages in the first phase of the ceasefire to seize the moral high ground. 

Israel again has all the cards. Yet despite rock-solid Western support and public relations, they are failing to win the war. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu recently blamed Hamas for the release of Israeli hostages, calling it a “disgraceful” and “reprehensible event.” 

Western media, including the BBC, echoed Israel’s position that the killing of 130 people since the ceasefire began on January 19 was a more serious legal violation than the killing of Israelis. The media has similarly downplayed the latest Israeli atrocities in the occupied West Bank. Thousands of homes have been demolished; entire communities have been ethnically wiped out. Western media outlets have failed to note the extent of the war crimes, which are also a flagrant violation of the ceasefire agreement. 

Now Netanyahu is taking a new tack before the second phase begins next week. He has used the apparent rapprochement between Israeli prisoners and Hamas as an excuse to blow up the ceasefire. The second phase is expected to begin once Israel fully withdraws from Gaza and allows it to rebuild. 
Israeli prisoners are only useful to Netanyahu and his narrow-minded apologists if they help to create a narrative that justifies genocide. The Israeli prime minister, cornered by Trump, had to negotiate a compromise before he could resume the indiscriminate killing of Gazan children. In this case, he had to pay a price for raising at least some issues, so as to keep the new US president and his own people calm. 

He has repeatedly made it clear that he has no intention of moving towards a permanent ceasefire after the first major hostage exchange. For Netanyahu, the importance of Israeli prisoners is only to pave the way for genocide. Hamas, on the other hand, has every incentive to use the short cut by releasing prisoners. This suggests that it is not intimidated by Israeli-engineered and Western-infused doctrines. 

This is to be expected, given how much they are still in charge of Gaza despite Israel’s devastating onslaught.

Headline_English: Robbery again on the national highway in Sadullapur
Content_Enlish:

Victim Sharmin Nahar said that her father died in Dhaka on Monday. At around 4 pm, I left for the village in a Hayes microbus from my home in Dhaka. My daughter, niece, cousin, brother-in-law and their children were with me in the microbus. 

At around 12:30 am, when the microbus reached Ekbarpur in Dhaparhat, Sadullapur on the highway, a gang of 7-8 robbers cut down two trees and threw them on the road and seized the microbus. At that time, they broke the glass of the microbus with sharp weapons and looted everything that was in everyone's possession, including mobile phones, various gold ornaments, and cash. One person was also injured when the glass of the car was broken. We immediately reported the incident to the patrol police and went to Atirerpara village in Shukurerhat, Rangpur. 

Victim Sharmin Nahar further said that the robbers, who were wearing shirts, jeans, and pants, were between 20 and 25 years old. The robbers fled with gold ornaments, mobile phones, and cash worth about 4 lakh taka from them. 

Was the ambulance carrying the body with them at that time? In response to a question, she said that the ambulance carrying the body left the scene an hour before we reached the spot. 

After completing the burial of my father, I have filed a written complaint with the police station regarding this incident. He also demanded the immediate arrest of those involved in this robbery incident and the recovery of the looted gold ornaments and money including mobile phones. 

Since the 32-mile area is the estuary of the two districts, robberies have occurred in this area several times. Therefore, taking into account the issue of public safety, the senior police officials of Rangpur and Gaibandha districts have visited the scene of the incident after the incident.

Headline_English: Historic verdict by the Supreme Court of India on the formation of the Election Commission
Content_Enlish:
The country's top court has given a historic ruling that the prime minister and the chief justice of the Supreme Court will now be able to participate in the appointment of India's Chief Election Commissioner and two election commissioners. India's top court ordered the formation of this bipartisan panel on Thursday. Reuters news. 

A five-judge constitution bench of the country's Supreme Court, headed by Justice KM Joseph, gave this ruling. The ruling ended the government's long-standing exercise of exclusive power in the appointment of India's Chief Election Commissioner and two election commissioners. 

Although the Election Commission of India is an autonomous constitutional authority, the country's opposition parties have regularly accused the body of following the instructions of the ruling party. However, the country's autonomous constitutional body has denied such allegations. 

The bipartisan panel that the Supreme Court has ordered to appoint the Chief Election Commissioner and two election commissioners; It is also said that the leader of the opposition in the lower house of the country's parliament or the opposition party with the largest number of members in parliament will also be included in it. 

The five-judge Constitution bench of the Supreme Court passed the order after hearing several petitions filed in the Supreme Court seeking the formation of an independent committee to appoint the Election Commissioner. While pronouncing the verdict, Justice KM Joseph said that the new rules will remain in force till a law is made by Parliament in this regard. 

“The Election Commission of India will have to perform the difficult and overwhelming task of staying away from all forms of subordination and interference by the executive branch.” 

Currently, the President of India, who basically follows the orders of the government, appoints the Chief Election Commissioner and two commissioners for a six-year term. This practice of appointing Election Commissioners through a bureaucratic process in India is decades old. 

Advocate Prashant Bhushan, who fought for the PIL filed in the Supreme Court demanding the scrapping of the old rules for appointing Election Commissioners, described the new Supreme Court verdict as “historic”.

Headline_English: NASA spacecraft to land at night for the first time

Headline_English: All the symptoms of diabetes
Content_Enlish:

According to experts, it is important to eat a healthy diet and follow a lifestyle to keep diabetes under control. If it is not controlled, it can cause serious health risks. If the symptoms of diabetes appear in the body, it is necessary to be alert from the very beginning. Usually, the symptoms that appear in the body when diabetes occurs are- 

Frequent urination: When the blood sugar level increases, the kidneys cannot filter the sugar properly. As a result, sugar accumulates in the urine. Due to this, frequent urination occurs. However, it can also be due to bacteria and other infections. However, if you urinate more often than usual, it can be a sign of diabetes. 

Weight loss: When the blood sugar level increases, you start losing weight unexpectedly. If you lose weight quickly even without trying, it can be a sign of diabetes. 

Decreased vision: The presence of high blood sugar can damage your vision. This can have a negative impact on eye health and increase the risk of vision loss. Therefore, sudden changes in vision should not be taken lightly. In this case, you should definitely consult a doctor. 

Skin color changes: When blood sugar levels increase, the skin color changes. You should consult a doctor, especially if you notice changes in the neck, joints, and skin of the feet.

Headline_English: How long after dinner should you go to bed?
Content_Enlish:
Overeating often causes drowsiness. Then there is difficulty in moving. Some people lie down immediately when they experience such a problem. Some are so tired from working all day that they fall asleep after eating. But according to experts, such a habit only increases the amount of damage to health. It can cause indigestion, heartburn, acidity, weight gain and even stroke. 

Experts say that there should be a gap of at least three hours between eating dinner and sleeping. As a result, the food moves from the stomach to the small intestine and improves digestion. This does not cause problems like heartburn and insomnia. 

According to experts, there are some foods that help in increasing sleep. For example, foods like turkey and meat chops contain a substance called tryptophan in large quantities. Which disrupts the body's sleep-promoting agents serotonin and melatonin. Therefore, whenever you eat a heavy meal, make sure that there is a sufficient time gap between eating dinner and sleeping. 

According to nutritionists, there are many foods that disrupt sleep. Eating these foods right before bed can undoubtedly worsen sleep. Eating too much can cause restlessness. This can lead to heartburn, restlessness, and a bitter taste in the mouth. Spicy and acidic foods make this problem worse. In addition, alcohol, chocolate, and peppermint can also increase heartburn and reflux problems. Therefore, these foods should be avoided. 

According to nutritionists, caffeine-rich coffee, tea, soda pop, energy drinks, and chocolate should be avoided before bed. Caffeine blocks adenosine. This is a chemical that can cause insomnia if consumed during sleep.

Headline_English: Why eat oranges in winter?
Content_Enlish:
Orange is one of the popular fruits in winter. It is the favorite fruit of many because of its unique taste. However, in addition to its taste, the fruit is also nutritious. Eating this fruit regularly provides many benefits. For example- 

Improves immunity: Many people suffer from colds and various types of infections in winter. The phytonutrients, vitamin C and antioxidants in oranges increase immunity. They also help prevent various types of illnesses including colds and flu. 

Good for skin and hair: Oranges provide about 120 percent of the vitamin C required by the body. The vitamin C in oranges helps in the production of collagen in the body, which is essential for the health of skin and hair. Apart from this, the vitamin A in oranges keeps the hair fresh. You can eat oranges regularly to increase the glow of the skin in winter and get smooth hair. The antioxidants in it prevent skin damage due to free radicals. Using orange peels as a face mask protects the skin from acne. 

Keeps the heart healthy: Oranges contain a lot of fiber, vitamin B6, potassium, and vitamin C, so they play a role in keeping the heart healthy. In addition, oranges improve the body's iron absorption system and vitamin B6 increases the production of hemoglobin. If someone has iron deficiency in their body, they can eat oranges regularly to fill it. In addition, the magnesium in oranges maintains the cholesterol level in the blood. 

Improves digestion: Oranges contain both soluble and insoluble fiber, which keeps the intestinal health good. The soluble fiber in oranges helps in digestion. Eating oranges regularly relieves constipation and improves stomach health. 

Easy breakfast: You can have oranges with other foods for breakfast. It does not have to be cut. Peeling is also quite easy. Oranges do not contain any fat or sodium. They contain a small amount of calories. You can eat the fruit at home in the morning or at any time of the day during work. Since oranges contain fiber, it helps in keeping the stomach full for a long time. As such, it is also very beneficial for weight loss. 

Interestingly, in terms of nutritional value, orange peel is more beneficial than the fruit. The flavonoids in it keep the heart healthy. Orange peel is also beneficial for digestion. It also helps prevent allergies. Orange peel helps increase immunity, reduce bad breath, and maintain good skin health. 

How to store orange peel 

To use orange peels all year round, first boil them in water. Then make a chutney using coconut, tamarind, jaggery, black pepper, and salt. It is good to eat, as well as healthy. You can also dry orange peels and store them in powder.

Headline_English: Spices that help control diabetes
Content_Enlish:
Many people take medicine and insulin to control diabetes. However, diabetes control depends on daily lifestyle and diet, which is about 80 percent dependent on it. Along with that, meditation and exercise can provide more benefits. Even some spices in the kitchen help in controlling diabetes. For example- 

Cinnamon: Cinnamon has multiple therapeutic components, so it helps in controlling diabetes. Studies have shown that eating 3-6 grams of cinnamon daily reduces blood sugar levels. Cinnamon reduces insulin sensitivity and blood glucose levels. When blood sugar levels decrease, the risk of diabetes decreases. 

Turmeric: Turmeric has thousands of properties. In addition to healing cuts and wounds, turmeric acts as an anti-diabetes agent. It prevents diabetes from progressing, improves beta-cell function and prevents their death. The curcumin component in turmeric reduces heart disease and kidney complications. 

Fenugreek: Blood sugar levels increase in diabetes. Fenugreek helps in reducing sugar levels. It also helps in reducing hyperglycemia. Studies have shown that consuming fenugreek for 3 years reduces the risk of diabetes. 

Red pepper: The capsaicin component in red pepper acts as an anti-diabetic. It prevents the problems caused by diabetes such as obesity and lower abdominal pain. A study has shown that capsaicin can help in the production and metabolism of insulin. Insulin is a hormone that regulates blood sugar levels. 

Bay leaf: Bay leaf helps in controlling type 2 diabetes. Eating 1-3 grams of bay leaf daily reduces the risk of diabetes-related complications such as heart disease. The antioxidants in it also help in improving cell function. 

Cardamom: Cardamom contains anti-inflammatory, antioxidant and hypolipidemic components, keeps blood glucose levels in check. It can improve energy, cell function and release insulin properly. 

Clove: Clove helps in maintaining glucose levels by storing excess glucose. Studies have shown that cloves contain polyphenols like gallic acid, catechin and quercetin which help in maintaining liver function and converting liver glycogen into glucose, which controls diabetes. 

Cumin: Cumin reduces blood glucose, body fat, leptin levels in diabetic patients. When these are reduced, insulin resistance increases and complications of diabetes are reduced.

Headline_English: How much walking per day will help you lose weight?
Content_Enlish:
There is no substitute for regular walking to keep your body healthy. Regular walking keeps your body fresh. In addition, you lose weight. But it is important for those who are walking to lose weight to be aware of a few things. For example- 

How many calories do you lose if you walk: In the modern era, it is easy to know how many calories you burn with the help of technology. It has been shown that when a person walks 1000 steps, 30 to 40 calories are burned. In that case, if you walk 10,000 steps, 300 to 400 calories can be easily shed. The faster you walk, the more calories you will burn per minute. If you walk slowly, you may burn about 3 calories per minute. And if you walk a little faster, you will burn almost twice as many calories. And if you can run or jog, then the calorie burning will increase twice as much as walking fast. And if you stop walking and start running completely, the calorie burning rate will continue to increase. 

What will be the walking speed: Many people do not understand what the walking speed will be while walking. However, there is no specific speed for walking. First, you should start walking slowly and then increase the speed gradually. You should increase the speed as much as possible according to your body. Many people start walking as soon as they wake up. This is not right at all. You should go out for a walk at least 30 minutes after waking up. 

Exercise with walking: Along with walking, start some new exercises after a few days. At first, you can run a little while walking for a few days or do a little yoga. If you get bored with these, do weightlifting or play tennis or badminton along with walking for a few days. This will not only reduce weight, but also prevent boredom from coming from walking.

Headline_English: How to keep pickles fresh for a long time
Content_Enlish:
Many people like to eat pickles. It is incomparable in enhancing the taste of food. But sometimes it becomes a cause for concern about how to keep pickles well throughout the year. Although it is not a problem during winter, many times the pickles get fungus as soon as the monsoon arrives. Usually, yeast or fungus grows in sour fruits in the presence of water or air. This spoils the taste of the pickles. However, by following some methods, it is very easy to keep pickles fungus-free for a long time. For example- 

1. After washing the things that you will make pickles from, drain the water well and dry them. It is very good if you can leave them in the sunlight for a while. 

2. To keep pickles well, you need to use more oil. You should ensure that there is a layer of oil on the pickles. Oil prevents air from entering the pickles. This stops the supply of oxygen and bacteria cannot survive. If there is less oil, you can heat the oil later and mix it with the pickles. 

3. Salt acts as a preservative. It keeps the taste and smell intact and makes the pickle delicious. If the right amount of salt is not used, bacteria can grow in the pickle. It can even spoil it. 

4. Turmeric, fenugreek powder and asafoetida act as very good preservatives. Sodium benzoate acid and sodium benzoate make the pickles last for a long time. Pickles made with salt, sugar, vinegar and spices stay good for a few years. 

5. Always use glass containers to store pickles. Pickles spoil quickly if kept in plastic jars. However, the container in which you keep the pickles should be washed well and dried in the sun. 

6. If you can keep the pickle jar in the sun for at least an hour every day, the risk of fungus is greatly reduced. 

7. If you keep the pickles in the refrigerator, they stay good for a long time. Fungus cannot grow in a cold place. 

8. Keep the pickles in a small place for daily consumption and keep the rest in a large place. It is best not to open a jar of pickles repeatedly. Never touch the pickles with your hands. Make sure that the spoon you use to scoop out the pickles does not have any water on it.

Headline_English: Physical problems caused by skipping breakfast
Content_Enlish:
Many people spend a lot of time in the morning without eating. Some people delay breakfast due to the rush to leave for the office or the pressure of housework. Some people eat breakfast and lunch at the same time. Some people think that skipping breakfast can help them lose weight. This is a completely wrong idea. This is because the body's metabolic rate is higher in the morning. As a result, what is eaten is digested. Calories are also burned faster. Those who do not eat breakfast naturally eat more in the afternoon. Eating breakfast can control this excess hunger. It also helps in increasing the body's energy. In addition, regular breakfast also keeps diabetes, heart disease, high blood pressure, etc. under control. 

Physical problems caused by not eating breakfast- 

Heart damage: Not eating breakfast every day can lead to heart disease. A study has shown that men who skip breakfast in the morning are more than 27 percent more likely to suffer from heart disease. A healthy breakfast reduces the risk of heart disease. 

Risk of Type 2 Diabetes: A study by Harvard University School of Public Health has shown that there is a close link between diet and health. A study of 46,289 women over a period of about six years has shown that women who have a habit of eating breakfast have a higher risk of type 2 diabetes. 

Weight gain: If you want to lose weight, do not skip breakfast. Because skipping breakfast will increase your hunger. Then you will want to eat whatever you get in front of you. 

Mood swings and lack of energy: Skipping breakfast affects both mood swings and lack of energy. Studies have shown that those who do not eat breakfast are the most tired and forgetful. Skipping breakfast can reduce energy and negatively affect memory. Mood can also be bad. 

Hair loss: Skipping breakfast drastically reduces protein levels in the body, which affects keratin levels. When keratin decreases, hair growth slows down, and hair starts falling out. 

It affects digestion: Breakfast is consumed by the body after sleeping for 8-10 hours. Dinner is eaten shortly before sleeping. The body does not receive food for about 12 hours. If you eat breakfast in the morning, it is digested quickly.

Headline_English: How to stay fit at work
Content_Enlish:
Nowadays, many women are working outside the home as well. However, due to their busy schedules, many do not get time to take care of themselves. But to survive at work, it is important to keep your body healthy. To keep your body healthy or maintain fitness, you can make a habit of doing physical exercises in the morning. Initially, you can get up in the morning and go for a walk two days a week. If you do not feel like walking, you can do whatever you like between running, cycling, swimming. You can also make some other habits to stay fit during work. For example- 

1. If you have to work for a long time, you can do stretching occasionally there. You can do exercises like rotating your arms and legs. You can also easily do neck exercises. 

2. If you have to stand in line for a long time somewhere, stand on your left leg for a while, and on your right leg for a while. Keeping your balance in this way will strengthen the structure of the leg muscles. 

3. While talking on the phone, talk while walking instead of sitting. 

4. While cooking, you can do a few wall pushups or cuff stretches while cooking rice or other dishes. 

5. Do 10-12 squats while brushing your teeth. 

6. You can walk on the treadmill or paddle while watching TV. You can also do some free-hand exercises, couch pushups, star jumps. 

Along with these habits, you can follow some tips to maintain fitness in your body. For example- 

1. Most of the time, planning alone does not work. So, you can take a friend or neighbor from the neighborhood with you in your fitness routine. Plan to go for a morning walk or run together. 

2. Write down your daily routine in a diary. And also write down when and what exercises you will do there. That will act as a reminder. 

3. Make a list of some exercises that can be done sitting or standing with bare hands. If you get a little gap, walk or do light exercises. 

4. Always keep almonds at home. You can take them in your tiffin box when you go to the office or anywhere outside. Since a lot of energy is lost during the day's work, if you feel tired, you can put three or four almonds in your mouth. You can also mix almond powder in milk and eat it.

Headline_English: Apple cider vinegar helps in losing excess fat

Headline_English: When to change the mask
Content_Enlish:
The number of corona infections is increasing day by day. According to experts, to avoid the new strain of corona, it is important to wear masks in the right way, avoid crowds and follow cleanliness. However, many people are not following the rules while wearing masks. Many are going out wearing old, loose, dirty masks. 

Experts say that it is important to follow some rules while wearing masks. For example- 

1. Wear the mask in such a way that the face and nose are completely covered. If only the nose or mouth is open after wearing the mask, then there is no use in wearing the mask. Make sure that the mask can cover the entire face well, starting from the nose. So when buying a mask, check how wide it is and only then buy it. The surgical masks available in the market are single-layer, which is not at all suitable during this pandemic. At least three-layer masks should be used. 

2. Do not use a mask that is loose from the face. If the mask is loose, you will have to touch your face repeatedly to fix it. There is a risk of dust and dirt from your hands getting on the mask. 

3. Masks made of cotton fabric tear quickly. If the color becomes light and small to large holes appear in the mask, immediately throw the mask in the dustbin. If there is a hole, it is better not to wear the mask. Because along with corona, other viruses in the air can also attack. 

4. Masks are now mandatory. If you have various skin problems such as acne, rash, itching, swelling after wearing the mask, then you should change the mask quickly. 

5. If the mask can be cleaned, then you should definitely wash, dry and then wear it. Research says that wearing the right mask in the corona situation reduces the risk of getting corona by about 70 percent. Not only should you wear it, you should also throw it away on time. 

6. If you feel uncomfortable wearing the mask, then definitely avoid that mask. Again, wearing the same mask for hours after hours creates discomfort. This disrupts breathing. Therefore, it is necessary to change the mask. 

7. If the nose clip of the mask becomes loose, replace it immediately. Also, if the elastic or fabric that attaches to the ears becomes loose, it is time to replace the mask.

Headline_English: Precautions required when using elevators and stairs during the coronavirus pandemic
Content_Enlish:
There is no alternative to wearing a mask, keeping your hands clean, and maintaining social distancing to avoid coronavirus infection. This virus is so contagious that to avoid it, it is important to be safe while going out, as well as to keep your home and its surroundings clean. Experts say that it is important to use a mask, hand sanitizer before leaving the house, and change and wash your clothes after returning. In addition, it is necessary to be careful when using elevators. Because, according to experts, there is a risk of coronavirus infection from elevator buttons. 

Experts say that if an infected person presses the elevator button with his finger, the virus in his body remains on the button. Then if a healthy person presses that button, the virus enters his body. This is how infection can spread from the elevator. 

You can follow some things to avoid infection from the elevator. For example- 

1. Before entering the elevator, you must wear a mask. 

2. Do not lean on the elevator. 

3. Use a toothpick, earbud or tissue paper instead of your fingers to press the elevator button. 

4. Be careful not to let the object you used to press the button touch any part of your body. 

5. Throw the used object in a dustbin with a lid. 

6. Wash your hands thoroughly with soap or apply sanitizer. 

Along with using the elevator, it is necessary to follow some rules when using the stairs. Experts say that you should not touch the railings of the stairs in any way. Because, if a person infected with Covid-19 has touched the railing before, you can also get infected. However, if you accidentally touch the railing, wash your hands thoroughly with soap before touching anywhere else.

Headline_English: Is coconut water beneficial for everyone?
Content_Enlish:
Coconut water has many benefits. It maintains the body's moisture. It also helps to keep the body cool. This water contains a lot of minerals. They are also beneficial to the body. But coconut water is not beneficial for some people at all. 

According to experts, it is not right for everyone to drink coconut water. Then the harm will be more than the benefit. That is why they have advised some people to avoid coconut water. For example- 

1. Those who want to lose weight should not eat coconut. Because it contains a lot of calories. As a result, regular consumption of coconut water can lead to weight gain. 

2. Coconut water, like other minerals, contains a lot of sodium. As a result, excessive consumption of coconut water can increase blood pressure. For those who already have high blood pressure problems, excess coconut water can cause problems. 

3. Coconut water also increases blood sugar levels. Coconut water can increase the problems of those who are suffering from diabetes. 

4. Those who have kidney problems tend to accumulate potassium in their bodies. Coconut water also contains a lot of potassium. As a result, it is better not to drink coconut water if you have kidney problems. Drinking excess coconut water for kidney problems increases the potassium levels in the body. This can damage both the heart and kidneys.

Headline_English: How to tell if you have a vitamin deficiency by looking at your face
Content_Enlish:
All types of vitamins are necessary to keep the body healthy. However, sometimes the amount of one or two vitamins decreases in the body. Then various types of problems arise. There are various types of tests to understand exactly which vitamin is deficient. Many times, it is possible to know whether there is a deficiency of any vitamin in the body without undergoing tests. And that is possible by looking at the face. For example- 

1. If the brightness of the skin decreases day by day, it should be understood that there is a deficiency of vitamin B complex in the body. If there is fatigue all day long, and you do not taste food - then you can be sure about this. Usually these problems are caused by a lack of B complex. 

2. If there is chapped lips or blood comes out from the roots of the teeth, then it should be understood that there is a deficiency of vitamin C in the body. If there is such a problem, start eating citrus fruits quickly. Before that, definitely talk to your doctor. 

3. If there is a deficiency of vitamin A, there is a problem of dark circles under the eyes or swelling around the eyes. However, if this vitamin enters the body in excess, it can also cause problems. So if you see such symptoms, definitely consult a doctor. 

Vitamin deficiency is not uncommon. If you initially think there is a problem with your face, you should consult a doctor. Many times, a vitamin deficiency is not noticeable. However, some of its symptoms can be detected on the face.

Headline_English: 5 hours of physical exercise a week reduces cancer risk
Content_Enlish:

In this case, the data of cancer patients in two regions of the United States that have many geographical differences were analyzed. 

Analyzing the data of cancer patients from 2012 to 2016, the most cancer patients were identified in the southern states of the country, Mississippi, Kentucky, Tennessee, Louisiana and West Virginia.

While the annual cancer detection rate among Kentucky residents is 3.7 percent, the rate in the Utah mountains is 2.3 percent.

Headline_English: Antibody-producing drug effective against all Omicron mutations: Research

Headline_English: If you have severe pain in your elbow
Content_Enlish:
Tennis elbow is a long-term condition that causes pain and weakness in the elbow. Tennis elbow is not only common in tennis players, but also in people who work in professions that require the use of the elbow to the wrist. Plumbers, masons, and bricklayers can also be victims of the disease. 

Causes of Tennis Elbow 

The exact cause of the disease is not known. It is believed that the disease can occur if the bones of the upper arm or the muscles attached to the lower end of the humerus are partially torn, the ligaments of the lower bone-radius are damaged, the joints of the radius and humerus are inflamed, or the blood vessels supplying the joints are inflamed. Again, the inflammation of the bony sheath can cause pain due to constant muscle contraction. 

Symptoms of Pain 

Elbow pain occurs gradually. The pain will be mainly on the outside of the elbow, it may be constant, or a constant discomfort will spread to the wrist, and the pain will increase in intensity when you try to squeeze something with your hand. Pain will be felt when you apply pressure to the elbow bone with your fingers from the front or outside. Due to this disease, there will be a feeling of weakness while squeezing something with your hand, and even heavy objects may fall from your hand. However, the tendency to swell in the elbow is rarely seen in this disease. There is no difficulty in moving the elbow. 

How to understand tennis elbow 

Elbow pain and weakness can be caused by many reasons. However, to understand that it is really tennis elbow, a test can be done. First, the elbow should be straightened and the hand part up to the wrist should be turned upside down. In this situation, if you forcefully bend the wrist, you will feel pain in the elbow. Then, if the wrist is forced to bend in the opposite direction and pull against the force from the wrist to the elbow, the intensity of pain and discomfort at the site of the tennis elbow injury will increase. 

Examination 

There is no way to understand much through X-rays, since the muscles attached to the elbow are partially torn and are not supposed to be understood on X-rays. However, in some cases, small detached bones and rough bone coverings can be understood on X-rays, which are sometimes helpful in diagnosing the disease. 

Treatment 

The elbow must be rested for a certain period of time. In this case, an elbow cast or splint can be used. Along with a light heat treatment on the elbow. Shock wave diathermy, ultrasound therapy and radiation therapy can also be given in some cases. Painkillers are recommended. Although this initial procedure is effective in many cases, recurrence of symptoms can often occur. 

If the disease becomes complicated, surgery is the way to quickly and long-term relieve symptoms. It is possible to get rid of tennis elbow by seeking the advice of a specialist doctor in time.

Headline_English: The impact of the Ukraine and Gaza wars on the arms market
Content_Enlish:
History shows that two things are essential to surviving a war – proper training of soldiers and production of weapons. Current wars are no exception. The destruction of thousands of weapons in the Russia-Ukraine war in 2022 and the Israel-Hamas war in 2023 slowed down modern warfare. The use of a wide variety of military means on the battlefield brings to the fore an important but forgotten aspect of war. That is, the rate of production of military equipment affects the outcome of the war. 

The rate of production of weapons also affects the effectiveness of military strategies and campaigns. Victory in war does not come only due to the technological superiority of weapons. Therefore, the production and availability of weapons are also essential. The demand for them is greater than the amount of weapons that Russia can currently produce. On October 7, Israel attacked Gaza, focusing on Hamas terrorist attacks. As a result, the rate of production of lethal weapons in Israel has also increased. These two examples illustrate how contemporary wars have increased the capacity to produce weapons beyond the expectations of military planners. The same importance of weapons production applies to China and the United States; the United States, in particular, is struggling to produce weapons at the rate at which Ukraine is using its weapons. 

Russia exports the most military equipment in the world. The impression of their inability to meet domestic needs is also visible in the international market. This makes the situation fragile for importers and creates opportunities for markets like China. In the meantime, Israel is providing services to refurbish military equipment collected from NATO and Russia. At the current rate of Russia’s production, the issue of weapons used in the frontal war with Ukraine is gaining prominence. Since the Cold War, Russia has been trying for decades to reduce its over-reliance on old weapons and reduce costs. In this regard, their changing technology is remarkable, where new equipment has been added to the legacy. 

Despite the changing strategy, Russia is moving towards using outdated and refurbished weapons in the war in Ukraine. Moreover, Russia’s ability to meet the demand for high-end or most expensive equipment in the international market has been reduced due to its own needs, limited industrialization, and Western sanctions. A notable example is the Indian Air Force, one of the first-line agents that procures Russia’s most expensive weapons. They no longer expect to receive any components or any other type of military services from Russia. They plan to manufacture them themselves. 

Eastern European countries are already taking advantage of Russia’s absence in terms of high-value weapons. Algeria is one of the countries that buy the most expensive and advanced weapons from Russia. The North African country recently decided to procure the autonomously flying Nora B52 combat aircraft from Serbia. Russia’s arms sales fell by 22 percent in 2022 due to the ongoing war. 

The ongoing war has already stretched Israel’s weapons production capacity to its limits. Israel is a leading supplier of high-end weapons and has been a major player in setting arms prices for the past century. However, its war with Hamas in Gaza has hampered its exports, especially in the West Bank and northern Lebanon, and its conflict with Hezbollah. The use of weapons and the shortage of skilled workers caused by the war have both contributed to a shortage of weapons in Israel. Israeli businesses are currently facing an 18 percent job loss. This includes the defense-related high-tech manufacturing sector, which is facing a further 20 percent job loss. If Israel were to withdraw from the high-tech arms market, the arms trade with Russia and NATO would be rendered ineffective. 

Israel's role in producing genuine military equipment and improving NATO and Russian weapons has increased its status in the arms market. India is its largest buyer. In the absence of the United States in providing appropriate weapons and services, Israel is the leading non-NATO supplier, dominating this market. This indirectly supports the United States, whose defense and diplomatic relations are tied to Israel. 

This negative situation in the high-value arms market has global implications for Israel, its allies, their consumers and competitors. First, Israel and Ukraine’s dependence on other countries for military equipment reinforces an old principle: military strength depends on production capacity. Second, this negative situation in the high-value arms market will also affect importing countries. For example, India depends on arms exports and cooperation with Russia and Israel.

Headline_English: The Mistake of 'Islamophobia' and the West's New Understanding
Content_Enlish:
The world is a big village. The total population of this village is 8 billion. 6 billion people follow some religion or the other and about 2 billion people are Muslims. After the Twin Towers accident in New York on September 11, 2001, the behavior of the people of the world changed. Everyone started suspecting everyone. Since the responsibility for the Twin Towers accident was placed on a specific religious group, Muslims; people all over the world started pointing fingers of hatred towards Muslims. Even Muslims started cowering in fear when they saw a bearded man on the street. You are boarding a plane, and there is a bearded man in the seat next to you. You are in fear all the time – will the man explode a bomb on the plane? This ‘Islamophobia’ has spread everywhere; as a result, some of the radical Muslims, motivated by revenge, started behaving more violently. They started carrying out terrorist attacks here and there in the world. To show their power, whenever a terrorist incident occurs somewhere, they started taking responsibility (credit) for it. The world became more unstable than ever before. Gradually, the most advanced, educated, and scientifically minded people in the world, the Europeans and Americans, learned to understand that problems cannot be solved with hatred. To establish peace in an unstable world, love is needed. They began to emphasize the establishment of a multi-racial, multi-ethnic society. 

In 2000, I went to Kosovo as a UN worker. Kosovo, a predominantly Albanian province, was separated from Serbia through a bloody war. Although about 90 percent of its people were Albanians, 10 percent of the Serbs were still in Kosovo. Will they stay here? The Albanians of Kosovo want to drive them back to Serbia. But the international community, with whose support Kosovo won the war, ruled them out. The international community said that they would stay here. Not just them; Croats, Turks, Roma; everyone will stay in this land. You have to create a peaceful country of a multi-ethnic people with everyone. Since then, I have begun to feel the importance of establishing a multi-identity society. 

Today, in 2023, this belief has stood on a stronger foundation among the people of developed countries. They have come to understand that the seedlings that grew from the seeds of hatred they sowed against Muslims on 9/11 have now started to grow into poisonous trees. The air of the world has become heavy with the poisonous fumes emitted from their breath. The time has come to destroy those poisonous trees and sow the seeds of love. 

On July 29, 2022, Texas Congressman Al Green introduced a bill in Congress to recognize Islam as a great religion of the world. The bill is said to be in favor of this bill, saying that the principles of Islam work to establish peace and harmony in the world. However, for more than two decades, the West has been saying that Islam creates unrest and creates militancy. The propaganda of a false idea has brought it to such a height that today they have to officially declare jihad (combat) against Islamophobia.
