Sheikh Russell and Dhaka Abahani will face Rahmatganj and Sheikh Jamal in Group D. It will be confirmed tomorrow who will play against whom among these two teams. Tomorrow, Mohammedan and Swadhinata will also finalize the line-up of their opponents in Group C in the quarterfinals of Group A.

Headline_English: Kuwait holds art exhibition to mark Bangabandhu's birth centenary
Content_Enlish:
On the occasion of the Golden Jubilee of Independence and the birth centenary of Father of the Nation Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman, the Bangladesh Embassy in Kuwait has organized a painting exhibition for children and adolescents of the Bangladeshi community in the country. 

The painting exhibition was held at the Kuwait Arts Association hall in Hawalli area of ​​Kuwait on Thursday (December 23). 

The program was jointly organized by the First Secretary of the Bangladesh Embassy in Kuwait, Head of the Embassy Niaz Morshed and Counselor Iqbal Akhter, and the Assistant Secretary General of the Kuwait Arts Sector, Dr. Badr Al-Daish, was present as the chief guest. 

The exhibition, jointly organized by Arts Association-Kuwait, Bangarupa Charukaru Sangeet Shishu Mela and Family Forum Kuwait, was inaugurated by the chief guest Dr. Bader Faisal Al-Dais, Bangladesh Ambassador to Kuwait Major General Mohammad Ashiquzzaman and ambassadors of various countries in Kuwait. 

The event was attended by the ambassadors of India, Nepal, Tajikistan and representatives of various countries in Kuwait. In addition, local citizens of various levels and expatriates of the Bangladeshi community were present.

Headline_English: 'RRR' is bringing a bang in the new year
Content_Enlish:
The release of Shahid Kapoor's 'Jersey' has already been postponed due to the new variant of the Corona pandemic in India, Omicron. The state government has closed all theaters in Delhi to prevent the spread of Omicron. In such a situation, there was a fear about the release of 'Baahubali' fame director SS Rajamouli's new movie 'RRR'. But dispelling all speculations, it has been announced that the much-discussed movie will be released on the scheduled date (January 7, 2022). 

In an official statement, the director has said that the movie will be released in theaters on the scheduled date. Indian film critic and trade analyst Taran Adarsh ​​​​told this by tweeting. 

Taran wrote in the tweet, 'Breaking news... 'RRR' is coming on January 7, 2022... said SS Rajamouli... the date will not be postponed any more. ' 

South Indian superstar Ram Charan and Jr NTR are playing the lead roles in the movie 'RRR'. They will be accompanied by Bollywood stars Ajay Devgn, Alia Bhatt and many others. 

This movie, which has created a stir in the Indian cinema scene, is said to have earned Rs 800 crore before its release. This includes the income from the sale of film rights as well as the songs. The total budget of the movie is said to be Rs 400 crore. Apart from Hindi, the movie is scheduled to be released in Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam and Kannada.

Headline_English: SSC and equivalent exam results to be announced today
Content_Enlish:
The results of the Secondary School Certificate (SSC) and equivalent examinations will be published today, Thursday. Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina will publish the results virtually at the Bangabandhu International Conference Center (BICC) in Sher-e-Bangla Nagar in the capital at 10 am. She will also inaugurate the distribution of free books among students, it is said. 

This information was given in a press release of the Bangladesh Inter-Education Board Coordination Committee. 

The release said that the results of the SSC and equivalent examinations of the Secondary and Higher Secondary Education Boards of Dhaka, Rajshahi, Comilla, Jessore, Chittagong, Barisal, Sylhet, Dinajpur, Mymensingh, Bangladesh Madrasa Education Board and Bangladesh Technical Education Board will be published simultaneously on December 30 at 12 noon on the websites of the country's education boards, the concerned examination centers/educational institutions and through SMS. 

Students will be able to know the results through the websites of the education boards and SMS after the official publication of the results. 

The result can be known by selecting the roll number, registration number, exam name, year and education board on this website and clicking on the submit button. 

Apart from this, the result can also be known through SMS on mobile phones. Go to the message option of the mobile phone and write SSC with a space, write the first three letters of the board name, write the roll number with a space, and write the year of passage with a space and send it to 16222. Example—SSC DHA 123456 2021 and send it to 16222. The result will be known in the return SMS. 

For Madrasa Education Board, write DAKHIL with a space, write the first three letters of the board name with a space, write the roll number with a space and send it to 16222. Example—DAKHIL MAD 123456 2021 and send it to 16222. The result will be known in the return SMS. 

The SSC and equivalent examinations started on November 14. The examinations ended on November 23. This year, the total number of candidates for the SSC and equivalent examinations was about 2.2 million.

Headline_English: Ross Taylor announces retirement from international cricket
Content_Enlish:
New Zealand legend Ross Taylor has announced his retirement from international cricket. The Test against Bangladesh will be his last Test match in white. 

He will then play his last international matches in coloured clothes against Australia and the Netherlands. 

Since making his debut in 2007, the 37-year-old Ross Taylor has played 110 Test matches and scored 7,584 runs. Ross Taylor is one of four New Zealand cricketers to have played more than 100 Test matches. He has also scored 8,581 runs in ODIs and 21 centuries.

Headline_English: The culture of the outgoing year
Content_Enlish:
Another year is being added to the calendar. Among other things, the question may arise, what was the trend of culture in the outgoing year? Where life is in crisis due to the Corona pandemic, the cultural arena naturally contracted. From stage plays to silver screen theaters, the world of art and culture has been revived, even in the middle of the year. 

The long break of the lockdown was broken and the cultural arena has returned to its normal form from August. Along with new productions of stage plays, exhibitions of old productions also started. At the same time, the Academy's Music and Dance Auditorium was bustling. 

Apart from this, multi-dimensional art collections are also seen in the galleries of the Academy's National Art Gallery. The works of art from the Fifth National Sculpture Exhibition are particularly attracting the attention of visitors. 

Meanwhile, this year's Dhallywood Para begins with a rather traditional movie. As a result, on the one hand, the lockdown and on the other hand, the theaters are suffering from a lack of viewers due to the lack of good films. However, after the release of several different genres of movies, the number of viewers in the halls has increased. Movies like Rehana Mariam Noor or Mission Extreme have attracted viewers to the halls. In addition, the released movies including Destination, Spark, Padma Puran, Lal Morger Jhuti, Mridha vs Mridha have been praised by the audience and critics. 

On the other hand, the media para has been questioned about various incidents involving some film actors and heroines. With the boat club, RAB raids, cases, remands, arrests, bails, and releases, film actress Pori Mani has become the most talked about character of this year. 

On the other hand, the name of Mahiya Mahi has come up in the discussion after being a victim of the state minister's indecent language.

Headline_English: Maradona's brother also left for the country of no return
Content_Enlish:
Maradona's younger brother Hugo Maradona left the country, never to return, 13 months after his death. Hugo did not get a chance to play in the main team. At the request of Diego Maradona, Napoli brought his younger brother Hugo Maradona to the team. The 52-year-old footballer died of a heart attack in Naples yesterday. 

Police recovered Hugo's body from his home on Tuesday. Hugo, who got a chance in the Argentine U-16 team, played in the domestic leagues of Argentina, Uruguay, Italy, Austria, Canada, and Japan, meaning half the world. 

Read more: Body of a young man recovered from a residential hotel 

After retiring in 1999, Hugo married a woman from Naples and lived there. 

Argentine football legend Diego Maradona left this world in November 2020 at the age of just 60. His death still makes his fans and supporters cry. This time, his younger brother also passed away at an even younger age.

Headline_English: Salman Khan announces 'Bajrangi Bhaijaan 2'
Content_Enlish:
Bollywood Bhaijaan Salman Khan means a storm at the box office. At least before the release of Tubelight and Radhe, Salman Khan had written such history in Bollywood. But Salman's confidence was somewhat weakened when the audience did not accept those two films in the same way. However, the film that Salman had not only locked the box office but also the critics was Bajrangi Bhaijaan. 

Bollywood Bhaijaan One of Salman Khan's most successful and popular films is 'Bajrangi Bhaijaan'. The film released in 2015 earned Rs 918 crore worldwide. As a result, its name is particularly notable in the history of the highest-grossing Hindi film. 

Even apart from business, 'Bajrangi Bhaijaan' made a special place in the hearts of the audience. Most people's eyes got wet with Salman and Harshali Malhotra's performance as little Munni. The second installment of this film, which has gained immense popularity beyond India and in the international arena, is coming. The announcement was made by Bollywood Bhaijaan himself 

The story is that Salman was present with the film team on Sunday (December 19) at the promotion of Baahubali fame director SS Rajamouli's new film RRR. Amidst that promotion, Salman said that the shooting of the sequel to the film Bajrangi Bhaijaan will start very soon. The script has already been written. Director Rajamouli's father KV Vijayendra will write the script for this film. He was also the scriptwriter of the previous film. 

'Bajrangi Bhaijaan' was produced by Kabir Khan. However, who will direct the new film has not yet been finalized. Kareena Kapoor was with Salman in the first film. It is not yet known whether she will be retained this time too. 

It is necessary to say that 'Bajrangi Bhaijaan' depicts a different story between India and Pakistan.

Headline_English: Rafael Nadal tests positive for coronavirus
Content_Enlish:
20-time Grand Slam champion Rafael Nadal has tested positive for coronavirus, the 35-year-old Spaniard announced on Twitter on Monday. 

Nadal tested positive for the coronavirus after returning to Spain from the Mubadala World Tennis Championship in Abu Dhabi. However, he tested negative for COVID-19 in every test he took while in Kuwait and Abu Dhabi. 

The last test he took on Friday was negative. The test he took back home came back positive. 

Nadal returned to the court for the first time since August after recovering from a foot injury at the Abu Dhabi exhibition event. He lost to Britain's Andy Murray in the semi-finals last Friday. He was eliminated from the French Open semi-finals last June by Novak Djokovic. He later withdrew from Wimbledon, the Tokyo Olympics and the US Open.

Headline_English: Imo introduces new features
Content_Enlish:
Popular instant messaging app Imo has introduced new features for sharing images and voice messages. Imo has introduced new features for sharing images and voice messages. Earlier, Imo introduced the ‘Secret Chat’ feature. ‘Secret Chat’ is a feature that prevents either party from downloading or taking screenshots or videos of their chats. Once the chat ends, all chats between the two parties will be deleted immediately. This feature will keep user information safe through end-to-end encryption. 

In a statement, Imo said that based on user feedback, Imo has added two new options for sharing images: ‘Original Image’ with the highest definition and ‘High Quality’ with medium definition. In addition, Imo has worked to further improve the image definition for the existing ‘Data Saver’ mode. So far, Imo has three options for sharing images based on quality. 

Imo is introducing an innovative voice messaging receiver function for the convenience of users. Imo users can manually select the ‘ear speaker’ mode while playing voice messages. This feature will benefit those who do not want to hear loud voice messages in front of others. Among other features, the voice messaging function has already been launched for users.

Headline_English: Champion Bangladesh
Content_Enlish:
Bangladesh won the SAFF Under-19 Women's Championship. The Bengal women won 1-0 against India in the final. 

In the final at the Bir Shrestha Shipahi Mustafa Kamal Stadium in Kamalapur, Bangladesh women took the lead through a goal by Anai Magini in the 79th minute. They took home the title unbeaten with that goal. In the group stage match, Golam Rabbani Chhota's students also won 1-0 against the powerful India. In their last match in the group stage, Tahura-Akhira defeated Sri Lanka 12-0.

Headline_English: Chhatra League leader arrested with 20 domestic weapons in Thakurgaon
Content_Enlish:
Locals arrested a man named Sabur (28) with 20 country-made weapons and ammunition in Mouhubhasi village of Rahimanpur union constituency in Thakurgaon and handed him over to the police. Sabur is the organizing secretary of Thakurgaon Sadar Upazila Chhatra League. 

On Wednesday (December 22) night, police arrested Sabur with a TVS car and 20 ammunition in Rahimanpur union constituency. The arrested Sabur is the son of Nazrul Islam of Islam Nagar area. 

According to eyewitness sources, locals arrested Sabur after seeing him on a motorcycle with a bag of weapons. As soon as the crowd increased, everyone started beating him. Later, after receiving information, the police rescued him from the scene. Locals believe that the seized ammunition could be used in election violence. However, Sabur, lying on his hospital bed, claimed innocence to the reporter. He said, a person named Alamin framed me to defame a boat candidate. 

Tanvirul Islam, officer-in-charge of Thakurgaon Sadar Police Station, said, "We went to the spot after receiving the information. He was rescued by the locals and admitted to the hospital. The case is under process."

Headline_English: Calls for delay in 5G rollout in the US
Content_Enlish:
The world's two top aircraft manufacturers have called for a delay in the introduction of 5G technology in the United States. The two companies are Boeing and Airbus. BBC News. 

According to the BBC report, in a letter, Boeing and Airbus warned the US administration that the technology could have a major negative impact on the aviation industry. 

Earlier, C-Band Spectrum had expressed concerns about 5G technology. Their statement was that 5G technology could hinder the performance of aircraft equipment. 

It is known that US telecom giants AT&T and Verizon will introduce 5G technology in the United States from January 5, 2022. 

In a letter to US Transportation Secretary Pete Buttigieg, Boeing and Airbus chiefs Dave Calhoun and Jeffrey Knittel wrote that there is a concern that interference with 5G technology could negatively affect the safe operation of aircraft. 

The letter cited data from a study by 'Airlines for America'. The research report said that if the Federal Aviation Administration's (FAA) 5G policy goes into effect in 2019, there were fears that about 345,000 passenger flights and 5,400 cargo flights would be delayed or canceled. 

The new technology could cause complications in sensitive equipment in the US aviation industry. The FAA also warned in December of this year that the complications caused by this technology could lead to flights being diverted. The FAA has promised to provide more information after the widespread introduction of 5G technology on January 5, 2022.

Headline_English: Viewers will have more fun: Sunerah
Content_Enlish:
National Film Award-winning model and actress Sunerah Binte Kamal. This is her first time acting in a web film. This Dhallywood actress shared her work experience and personal details at that time. 

Talking about the film titled A Night to Remember, the heroine said, 'The work went very well. As much as I had fun as an artist during the shooting, I believe that the audience will have more fun while watching the content.' 

She also said, 'It doesn't happen often that the audience enjoys watching the work, but the artists worked hard and didn't enjoy it. But this time, the work is completely the opposite. Life ends while laughing while doing this work.' 

'A Night to Remember' is directed by Abrar Atahar. Regarding OTT and working on the big screen, the actress said that it is not possible to compare OTT with the big screen. The two are different. There are many arrangements for the cinema hall. In short, big screen work is done in big arrangements, and small screen work is done in small arrangements. The processes that have to be gone through in big screen work, from shooting to appearing on the screen, are not so important in OTT work. However, its importance is also increasing, and will increase further in the future. 

I started acting with big screen films. I came to work in cinema with a lot of thought. There is more risk in love and liking. Apart from that, I am not saying that OTT films are bad. OTT is a new platform through which new content can reach people quickly.

Headline_English: Admission applications for class 11 begin on January 5
Content_Enlish:
The online admission application process for class XI in the current academic year will continue from January 5 to January 22. The online application fee for admission has been set at Tk 150. After the admission process, class XI classes will start from March 2.

On Thursday, these decisions were taken at a meeting of the Ministry of Education chaired by Education Minister Dr. Dipu Moni.

This time, admission will be completed by publishing the results in three phases. The first phase will be published on February 19. The last result will be published on February 24. And all the admission processes will be completed by February 28.

According to sources in the Ministry of Education, the results of the SSC and equivalent exams will be published on January 5 before the admission application begins. The date for publishing the results of this exam will be determined after the Prime Minister returns home after her visit to Nepal.

This time, students of any age will be able to take admission in class XI. Students who passed the General and Technical and Madrasa Education Boards before 2019 will be able to take admission with the permission of the concerned board.

Headline_English: Kareena is free from Corona
Content_Enlish:
Bollywood's popular actress Kareena Kapoor has tested positive for COVID-19. 

Kareena Kapoor herself announced this information on social media Instagram. 

Kareena Kapoor wrote on her Instagram story, 'My COVID-19 test result has come back negative. Thank you to my dear sister for keeping us safe during this difficult time. My dear friend Amrita, we made it.' 

It is known that the actress was in a hotel after being infected with COVID. 

It is worth noting that a few days ago, news agency ANI reported that Kareena was partying at various times, violating COVID rules. She was accompanied by Kareena's manager Poonam Damania and actress Neena Gupta's daughter, costume designer Masaba Gupta. Everyone who came in contact with Kareena and her friend Amrita was ordered to get tested for COVID.

Headline_English: Abid Ali leaves hospital
Content_Enlish:
Abid Ali has been discharged from the hospital after four consecutive days of treatment. The Pakistani opener underwent two angioplasty procedures in two days to treat heart complications. 

He was discharged from the hospital on Saturday. Abid's father confirmed to Cricket Pakistan on Saturday that he was discharged from the hospital. He said that the 34-year-old batsman is on the road to recovery. 

He also said that Abid's rehabilitation program will be for two weeks and he will be checked up in Karachi. The Pakistan Cricket Board (PCB) has arranged for us to stay. We are grateful to those who prayed for Abid's recovery. Last Tuesday, Abid was batting for Central Punjab in the first-class tournament Quaid-e-Azam Trophy. That's when he first felt chest pain. Shortly after, Abid felt chest pain again in the same place. After that, he was rushed to the hospital for treatment and other tests under the supervision of team manager Ashraf Ali. Shortly after, it was learned that Abid had a heart problem.

Headline_English: Pope Francis warns on Yemen and Palestine issues
Content_Enlish:
In a message given on the occasion of Christmas or the big day, Pope Francis, the highest religious leader of Catholic Christians, has strongly warned against silence regarding the humanitarian disasters occurring in different parts of the world. 

Referring to the deep crises and conflicts prevailing in Yemen, Palestine, Afghanistan, Syria, Ukraine, Sudan and other countries, he said that there seems to be no sign of an end to these crises. 

He said, we will face the terrible consequences of not listening to the suffering of countless brothers and sisters and their cries. 

Observers say that Pope Francis has pointed to the West, especially the United States, for its inaction in the humanitarian disasters in different parts of the world, especially in Yemen and Palestine, which are playing a role in creating the ongoing crises. 

The military aggression of the Saudi coalition against Yemen with the support of the West has caused a terrible humanitarian disaster in this poor Arab country. With the green light of the United States, Saudi Arabia and the Emirates have been carrying out genocide and destruction against the people of Yemen since March 2015. 

The efforts of Saudi Arabia and the Emirates to expand their dominance and influence in Yemen are one of the reasons for the ongoing conflict. Various UN agencies have warned that if the aggression of the Saudi-led military coalition in Yemen continues, the people of that country will face an unprecedented and even more terrible humanitarian disaster and famine. The situation in Yemen has become so dire that even US Democratic Senator Chris Murphy said in a Twitter message that the Yemen war has created the world's largest humanitarian disaster.

Headline_English: 10,000 Russian troops return to permanent base
Content_Enlish:
More than 10,000 Russian troops have returned to their permanent bases after a month-long exercise near the Ukrainian border. 

Interfax says that military exercises are still underway in several areas near Ukraine. Meanwhile, Western countries have expressed concern over the deployment of thousands of Russian troops in the north, east and south. 

Western countries fear that Moscow is planning an attack on Ukraine. 

According to US intelligence agencies, the number of Russian troops near Ukraine has increased from 60,000 to 90,000. The intelligence agency also estimates that the number of troops could increase to 175,000.

Headline_English: Hero Sohel Rana infected with Corona
Content_Enlish:
Popular Bengali film actor and producer freedom fighter Sohel Rana has been infected with coronavirus. Family sources say that he is currently undergoing treatment at a hospital in the capital. 

Film actor Rubel said that Sohel Rana has been receiving treatment in the hospital for 3 days. 

He said, 'Brother is under treatment in the hospital after being infected with Corona. Everyone will pray for brother.' 

Hero Sohel Rana entered the film world as a producer of the liberation war film 'Ora 11 Jan'. The film was directed by Chashi Nazrul Islam. He has also won the hearts of fans by acting in numerous films.

Headline_English: Launch fire in Barisal: Launch owner arrested
Content_Enlish:
Launch owner Md. Hamjalal Sheikh has been arrested in connection with the death of 41 passengers in the horrific fire incident on MV Abhiyan-10. RAB arrested him from Keraniganj. 

Earlier, around 6 pm on Thursday, MV Abhiyan-10 left Sadarghat with about 400 passengers. The launch stopped at Chandpur and Barisal terminals and passengers boarded and disembarked. It caught fire at around 3 am when it reached the Sugandha River in Jhalakathi. 

41 people died in this horrific fire. In addition, more than 80 passengers were burnt. Many passengers survived by jumping into the river during the accident, but more than a hundred are still missing. A case has been filed against launch owner Hamjalal Sheikh in this incident. 20-25 more people have been made unknown accused in this. 

On Sunday morning, the case was filed in the Barguna Chief Judicial Magistrate Court by Barguna Bar member lawyer and UP Chairman Md. Nazmul Islam. 

Chief Judicial Magistrate Muhammad Mahbub Alam accepted the case and ordered the OC of Barguna Police Station to take the complaint. The address of the launch owner has been shown as Sutrapur, Dhaka. 

The case states that on Thursday, the launch caught fire and drifted to the shore of Kalabagan area of ​​Jhalakathi district. Fire service and Jhalakathi administration personnel rescued some passengers in burnt condition and admitted them to Jhalakathi General Hospital and Barisal Sher-e-Bangla Medical College Hospital. After recovering about fifty bodies, some of the identified bodies were handed over to their relatives and the rest were handed over to the Barguna District Commissioner. 

Although a long time has passed since the incident, neither the accused himself nor any of his representatives even consoled the parents who lost their relatives at the scene. The defendants committed the crime of recklessly operating the launch, carrying people on the waterways in an unsafe, overloaded launch, leaving errors regarding fire or flammable materials, leaving errors regarding explosive materials and equipment, and recklessly driving the vehicle, causing the deaths of hundreds of passengers. The launch owner himself is responsible for these deaths. 

The plaintiff in the case told the media, if the owner had repaired the launch's engine errors and installed fire extinguishing equipment; then so many people would not have died, injured, and damaged property. Most of the launch's passengers are from Barguna. That is why I have filed the case in the public interest as a public representative. 

The lawyer in the case, Saifur Rahman, said, when I filed the case in court, the learned magistrate said that the launch drivers could have quickly pulled the launch to any shore. If the launch had pulled the launch to the shore, so many people would not have lost their lives. The people of Barguna are happy with the court's order.

Headline_English: Dhaka team ownership is changing in BPL
Content_Enlish:
Dhaka franchises Rupa Fabrics and Marn Steel lost ownership in the BPL. If a franchise is not found, the Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) can take charge of the team itself! 

Tamim Iqbal, who was in this category in the draft, can play there. Mahmudullah Riyad has already joined the team. Meanwhile, the players' draft will be held today at 12 noon at a hotel in Dhaka. 

Incidentally, the Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) had mentioned Rupa Fabrics and Marn Steel as Dhaka-owned organizations in a press release issued on December 22. But the BCB is changing the ownership as the conditions were not met. 

BCB CEO Nizam Uddin Chowdhury said in this regard, 'We had some conditions. We have decided not to proceed with them because they did not fulfill those requirements. 

Six teams will participate in this year's BPL - Barisal (Fortune Shoes), Chittagong (Delta Sports), Comilla (Comilla Legends), Khulna (Mind Tree) and Sylhet (Pragati Green Auto Rice Mills). 

The BPL Players Draft will be broadcast live today by Gazi TV and T Sports. It can also be seen on the BCB's Facebook page.

Headline_English: Sachin is taking on a big responsibility at BCCI!
Content_Enlish:
Sourav Ganguly is going to bring his friend Sachin Tendulkar to a big responsibility in the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI). 

Recently, Sourav Ganguly said, Sachin Tendulkar is definitely different from others. He does not want to be involved in these matters. However, if Sachin can be involved in Indian cricket in some way, nothing can be bigger news than that. 

Former Indian captain Sourav Ganguly also said, there can be issues of conflict of interest in several areas. Whatever we do not want to do, the issue of conflict of interest is always in the mind. Sometimes some issues seem completely unrealistic. Somehow Sachin will be involved in Indian cricket. 

Before Sachin, the Indian Cricket Board led by Sourav Ganguly has associated his friends Rahul Dravid and VVS Laxman with Indian cricket.

Headline_English: 38 arrested in the capital
Content_Enlish:
38 people have been arrested from different areas of the capital on charges of selling and consuming drugs. The Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) has arrested them in an anti-drug drive on Saturday. 

This information was given by the DMP's Media and Public Relations Department on Saturday morning. 

During this time, 540 pieces of Yaba, 114 grams of heroin and 27 kg 870 grams of marijuana were seized from the arrested people.

Headline_English: New curriculum to start in primary schools from 2022: Education Minister
Content_Enlish:
Education Minister Dr. Dipu Moni said that the new curriculum will be fully implemented in 2025. It has been decided to introduce it in stages from 2023. To implement the new curriculum, piloting is starting in 100 primary and 100 secondary institutions from 2022. For this, teacher training programs are underway and teachers' guides are being prepared. 

He told reporters this after a reception organized by Quantum Foundation in Kakrail, the capital, on Saturday. 

He said that 100 primary, 100 secondary and higher secondary educational institutions are being brought under piloting in 2023. Madrasas and technical medium educational institutions will be included along with secondary. In the sixth, seventh and eighth grades of secondary level, the learning assessment of Bengali, English, mathematics, science and social science subjects will be 60 percent and the overall assessment at the end of the year will be 40 percent. 

He also said that the new curriculum program will start across the country from 2023. We will introduce new curricula in different classes in phases. It will be fully implemented across the country from 2025. 

Major reforms are coming in the education system from primary to secondary level. In light of this, there will be no science, business education and humanities groups in classes 9 to 10. Apart from this, there will be no Primary Education Completion (PEC) examination for class 5 and Junior School Certificate (JSC) examination for class 8.

Headline_English: 'Pushpa: The Rise' is clashing with Spiderman
Content_Enlish:
Allu Arjun's South film 'Pushpa: The Rise' has crossed the Rs 100 crore mark worldwide on the third day of its release. The film, which was released in Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Kannada as well as Hindi, is also competing with Hollywood's much-talked-about film 'Spider-Man: No Way Home' at the box office. According to Anandabazar Patrika. 

Trade analyst Ramesh Bala tweeted that Pushpa has crossed the Rs 100 crore mark worldwide in just 2 days. 

The film's collection from the US is $1.3 million. The story of red sandalwood smuggler Pushpa Raj has also done business of more than Rs 91 lakh in Australia. 

Allu Arjun had full confidence in his film. This South actor was not particularly worried about competing with popular franchises like 'Spider-Man'. Before the film's release, he said, "'Spider-Man' will bring people back to the theaters. Similarly, 'Pushpa' will bring Indian audiences back to the theaters. It's time to celebrate cinema again." 

Apart from Allu Arjun, the film also stars actors like Rashmika Mandanna, Fahadh Faasik and Samantha Prabhu.

Headline_English: Gavi breaks Messi's record wearing a Barca jersey
Content_Enlish:
Barcelona defeated Elche 3-2 in a thrilling match. Young player Gavi caught the eye with one goal and one assist in this match. Not only did he catch the eye, but he also surpassed Messi in scoring the youngest goal in the Barcelona jersey. ESPN reports. 

Messi scored his first goal for Barca at 17 years and 331 days. Gavi scored his first goal at 17 years and 135 days. However, Ansu Fati surpassed everyone in this list. His first goal was at 16 years and 304 days. 

Although coach Xavi Hernandez praised Gavi after the match, he could not be satisfied with the team's performance, 'Gavi's performance as a 17-year-old boy was surprising. At his age, everything seemed difficult to me.' 

In another league match, Atletico Madrid lost 2-1 to Sevilla. And Villarreal defeated Sociedad 3-1. Sevilla is now second with 37 points from 17 matches. Real Madrid, who are at the top, have 42 points. 

On the other hand, Atletico are fifth with 29 points and Barcelona are seventh with 27 points.

Headline_English: Neymar will not be able to play for 8 weeks
Content_Enlish:
Neymar's tears suggested he would be out for a long time. Finally, the prediction was correct. The PSG forward will be out for at least eight weeks due to an ankle injury he sustained in a match against St Etienne on November 28. As a result, he will miss PSG's next seven league matches and the knockout stages of the Champions League. 

In a statement, PSG said, "Tests have shown that Neymar has sprained his ankle. It seems that he will be out for six to eight weeks. After 72 hours of observation, it will be known for sure how long it will take him to recover from the injury." 

Injuries have been a constant companion for Neymar throughout his career. He has missed a total of 74 matches for PSG in the last four seasons. If you take into account the ban, the number stands at 91.

Headline_English: Kolkata and Rajasthan have released Shakib and Mustafizur
Content_Enlish:
A total of 10 teams will participate in the upcoming season of IPL. The two new teams are Lucknow and Ahmedabad. For this reason, the BCCI had earlier informed that each team will be able to retain only 4 cricketers for the upcoming season and the rest will have to be released for the auction. Basically, this decision is made so that Lucknow and Ahmedabad get the same opportunity as everyone else in team formation. As a result, the 15th season of IPL is going to start completely anew. 
Tuesday (November 30) was the last chance to retain players. And in that, the teams released the two Bangladeshi cricketers who played in the IPL, Shakib Al Hasan and Mustafizur Rahman. That is, these two cricketers will have to go to the auction again in the upcoming season. 

In the last season, Shakib played for Kolkata Knight Riders and Mustafiz for Rajasthan Royals. As a result of the new rules, Kolkata has kept their two foreign players, West Indies Andre Russell and Sunil Narine, and two Indians, Venkatesh Iyer and Varun Chakravarty. On the other hand, Rajasthan have retained captain Sanju Samson, Jos Buttler and Yashavi Jaiswal.

Kolkata Knight Riders: Sunil Narine, Andre Russell, Varun Chakravarthy and Venkatesh Iyer. 
Sunrisers Hyderabad: Kane Williamson, Abdul Samad and Umran Malik.

Royal Challengers Bangalore: Virat Kohli, Glenn Maxwell and Mohammed Siraj. 
Delhi Capitals: Rishabh Pant, Prithvi Shaw, Axar Patel and Anrikh Narkia. 
Rajasthan Royals: Sanju Samson, Jos Buttler and Yashasvi Jaiswal. 
Punjab Kings: Mayank Agarwal and Arshdeep Singh.

Headline_English: 'Mayurakshi' will be about love and betrayal, not plane hijacking
Content_Enlish:

Headline_English: How to control high blood pressure
Content_Enlish:
High blood pressure or hypertension is a serious problem. High blood pressure can increase due to various reasons. If high blood pressure is not controlled, various diseases can occur. Events like stroke or heart attack can also occur. 
Therefore, it is very important to keep blood pressure under control. Let's know how to control high blood pressure: 

Reduce sodium intake 
Excessive sodium intake can cause stroke. Not only for high blood pressure patients, but everyone should avoid processed foods with salt to stay healthy. You should not consume more than 2,300 milligrams (mg) of salt a day. 

Increase potassium intake 
Potassium is an essential nutrient for those suffering from high blood pressure. This mineral is very beneficial for the body. If there is enough potassium in the body, it reduces the pressure on the blood vessels. Potassium also helps reduce the amount of excess sodium in the body. For this, potassium-rich foods should be added to the diet. For example- 
Vegetables- greens, tomatoes, potatoes and sweet potatoes. 
Fruits - Watermelon, banana, avocado, orange and apricot. 
Others - Nuts and seeds, milk, yogurt, tuna and salmon. 

Exercise regularly 
There is no substitute for regular exercise or physical activity. Everyone should exercise for 30-45 minutes regularly to stay healthy and reduce the risk of chronic diseases. This is even more necessary for those who suffer from high blood pressure. Regular exercise keeps the heart healthy. As a result, blood flow increases and the pressure on the arteries decreases. Even walking for 40 minutes every day will keep you healthy. 

Quit alcohol and smoking 
Both smoking and alcohol increase high blood pressure. Alcohol and nicotine can temporarily increase blood pressure levels and damage blood vessels. Since both substances are harmful to health, it is better to quit them. 

Eat less carbohydrates 
Carbs and sugar increase high blood pressure. Therefore, carbohydrate-based foods help control blood pressure levels. Foods like bread and white sugar increase blood sugar levels. Therefore, those suffering from high blood pressure must follow a low-carb diet. Avoid white sugar, flour and various processed foods. 

Keep your weight under control 
If you have high blood pressure, it is important to keep your weight under control. That is why know your BMI level. Find out from your doctor what your ideal weight should be according to your age, height and other physical symptoms. Try to maintain that weight. If you feel that you are gaining weight, you should try to reduce it. 

Reduce stress 
If you want to control high blood pressure, you need to reduce stress. Do regular meditation and breathing exercises. Avoid anything that can cause you anxiety. Do not let depression come. Try to be happy all the time. Try to do things that you enjoy. You can do hobbies. This will relieve anxiety.

Headline_English: Advantages and disadvantages of birth control pills
Content_Enlish:
Worried about avoiding pregnancy? That's why there are many methods. As well as the advantages of these methods, there are also disadvantages. Many people are not aware of these issues. So it is important to be aware of the issues initially. 
Let's find out what are the advantages of taking the pill: 

Regular menstrual cycle 
Taking the pill for irregular menstruation is an effective treatment. It normalizes the abnormal fluctuations in the body's hormones and makes menstruation regular. 

Cysts are not formed 
It prevents the formation of ovarian cysts. It also reduces menstrual bleeding and prevents anemia. 

Protects the uterus 
This pill thickens the mucus of the uterine mouth and prevents the entry of germs into the uterus, thus protecting the uterus from bacterial infections. 

Now let's find out what problems can occur with birth control: 

Headache 
The most popular means of birth control is the birth control pill. Headaches can occur with any birth control pill. Headaches can occur with progestin and estrogen. Even with progestin, headaches can occur. 

Dizziness 
If you take the pill the day after sex, you may experience dizziness. The estrogen in the pill is especially likely to cause this problem. 

Menstrual cycle problems 
Birth control can cause menstrual cycle problems. You may experience irregular periods or have your period suddenly. 

Mood swings 
Birth control can also change your mood. Mood swings can also affect your relationships.

Headline_English: How much life has changed in a year
Content_Enlish:
In a few hours, 2021 will be over. Then the new year will begin. Since the detection of Corona in the country in early March 2020, people's lifestyle and behavior have started changing. Even eating habits, daily routines, and clothing have changed. From social activities to professional behavior. How much of that change was there, let's take a look back before welcoming the new year. General Lifestyle 

At the beginning of 2021, people had to stay indoors. Amidst the loose lockdown, people were wearing casual dresses. As a result, people's interest in loose clothes has awakened. Even after everything became normal, people's interest in tight jeans has decreased. Celebrities are also often seen in loose jeans now. In 2021, people's attention was on comfortable clothes. Especially in the summer, the use of gabardine increased. The use of loincloths or Punjabis was normal during Eid, Puja, or national festivals. However, heavy work was not seen much in Punjabis. Various famous brands have also tried to keep the design as simple as possible this time. 

People have tried to keep everything simple in 2021. However, there has been a lot of change in hair fashion. At this time, many people started growing their hair. Especially since schools, colleges, and universities are closed, many people grow their hair. In addition, the trend of changing hair color has also started. Many people have changed their hair color due to the influence of social media like TikTok and Likee. There has been an interest in medium-sized hair and bleached hair among girls. In 2021, the sales of leather shoes have decreased slightly. People were looking at sneakers, or lightweight shoes. The popularity of Burmese sandals has been noticed especially among boys. However, sneakers and high heels were more popular among women. 
Mask usage 

Inclusion of masks in fashion 

Mask fashion was popular in 2021. Masks of different colors and designs have been seen on sidewalks, shops, online shops, and pharmacies. Masks of different prices and designs have started to be seen frequently in the fashion world. Many people have started using masks for events or to enhance their fashion. Many have developed the habit of wearing masks with their clothes. 

We spoke to one such mask seller under the Farmgate overbridge. He said that cotton masks and dust-resistant sponge masks are in high demand in the market. Everyone goes to the pharmacy to buy a mask that will provide protection. However, people go to sidewalks or online shops for cotton mask fashion. There are masks of different designs and prints in the market. Many people can now make masks with their own prints. 
Hand-painted sarees. 

The value of hand-painted dresses 

In 2021, the value of hand-painted pictures started to increase. Instead of needles, threads, beads, and lace, the value of hand-painted clothes has started to increase. Hand-painted dresses are especially being sold through various pages on social media. 

Since different artists create different styles of work, diversity can also be seen in this type of clothing. Taking care of the lips.

Especially the trend of changing eyebrow and eye color. The use of nude colors has been seen more in lipstick. Also, although the use of soap, gel, mascara, etc. has increased, there is a tendency towards natural and no-makeup looks. In this regard, Sharmin Nishu, a student of a private university, said, "I am not very comfortable wearing heavy makeup in my regular life. I feel comfortable wearing no makeup every day in class or regular work." 

Products ordered online. 

Popularity of online shopping 

Various establishments were closed at the beginning of 2021. At this time, confidence in online shopping has increased. Especially, the popularity of many online shops, including Daraz, has started to increase. As a result, the quality of service of these shops has also started to increase. 

However, some online shops have also caused many customers to suffer through scamming. The biggest advantage of online shops was 'customization'. Consumers have also been easily attracted to this direction since online shops provide the opportunity to order custom clothes, bags, masks or other products. In this regard, dancer Sanjida Rahman said, since I dance, I often need various costumes. I don't always have much time to go to the market and buy them. Then I have to rely on online shopping.

Understanding food ordered online. 

Food at home

In addition, many were able to buy food at affordable prices due to the various discount opportunities. Since the food is delivered and the facility to complain and maintain proper quality standards, its demand will increase in the coming years. 

In this regard, the owner of Dhanmondi Cafe Basmati said, "We didn't have to face much trouble. Usually, we just have to inform the number of orders we have for order delivery. This has enabled many food chains to survive in the beginning." 

The use of smartwatches has increased. 

The convenience of smartwatches, not watches

In this regard, the seller of Bashundhara's K R Y Shop said, "Usually, smartwatches will give you the opportunity to customize. You get the opportunity to change the strap and it can be used in various fields because it has other features attached to it. That is why everyone is leaning towards smartwatches. A person working on a laptop.
