Headline_English: Tunisian president says he will not be a dictator
Content_Enlish:
Tunisian President Kais Saied has vowed not to become a dictator. He also rejected allegations of a military-backed coup against him on Friday. This information was reported in a report by the news agency Reuters. 

After the political unrest in Tunisia, various international media outlets reported that Kais Saied is trying to consolidate all power one by one. 

He arrested two Tunisian MPs when he took control of the government last week. 

Last Sunday, President Kais Saied dismissed Prime Minister Hisham Meshchi and suspended parliament for the next 30 days. The people concerned believe that the country has fallen into a deep political crisis. 

A day after dismissing the prime minister, Kais Saied also dismissed the country's defense and justice ministers on Monday. Due to this, political dissatisfaction has reached an extreme level. After suspending parliament, government supporters took to the streets at the call of Speaker Rashed Ghannouchi. In addition, political organizations opposing President Saied have been calling his decisions a military coup. 

Kais Saied has not yet given any specific direction to get out of this situation. Political analysts believe that he will have to quickly appoint an interim prime minister and set a specific action plan to get out of the ongoing state of emergency. 
Quoting a former law professor, Kais Saied said, "I have read the constitution. I respect the constitution a lot and I have studied the constitution a lot. This much is certain, I will not become a dictator as many people think."

Headline_English: 'Outside the Network' is flooded with praise
Content_Enlish:
Four friends are traveling to St. Martin by trawler around Cox's Bazar. The sound of the wind and waves makes it impossible to hear anything on the other end of the phone. The network is also intermittent. At one point, Tania calls Munna. 

They meet on the bus on the way to visit. Munna falls asleep on the way. Tania also gets off at her destination without saying anything. Then Munna finds her. Although Tania does not pay attention to her. She is five years older than Munna. Still, Munna falls in love with Tania, who is of the same age. He is shocked when he receives the call from that girl. From the other end of the phone, he hears Tania saying, 'Why do I miss you?' Munna says, 'Shh, why do you kiss?' Tania says, 'Don't kiss, miss.' Munna says, 'What a pity....' 

The end of the love between the Tania-Munna couple of unequal ages may make your eyes water. At one point, unemployed Ratul, who cannot find a job, agrees to work in his father's vegetable shop. Abir, who has repeatedly failed in love, promised that he would not break up again, but this time he would get married. But suddenly everything gets messed up in a storm. Mizanur Aryan has woven a movie on the screen of Charkir in the story of four young men. 

A 90-minute web film ‘Beyond the Network’. Contemporary issues have dominated. Shariful Raj, Nazia Haque Orsha, Nazifa Tushi, Yash Rohan, Tasnia Farin, Tasnuva Tisha, Khairul Bashar, Jonayed Bogdadi, and almost everyone has given a very strong performance in this film of travel-thriller-tragedy, various genres. 

Actress Suborna Mustafa wrote, ‘Mizanur Rahman Aryan certainly has a unique style of storytelling. “Beyond the Network” is another part of his talent. Telling a simple story in a simple way is probably the most difficult task. Aryan has done it skillfully. Congratulations to the director and the entire cast and crew. This is a must watch film.’ 

Ahmed Mostaq wrote, ‘What a great making, direction, cinematography, acting, color tone, sound design, editing work. Everything is very well done. You get a premium feel just by watching it. It seems that Charki will truly become the capital of Bengali content.’ Abdul Khalek wrote, ‘I never write about any media work on Facebook, let alone say. But the producer of the Bengali drama industry, Aryan, has made his first web film “Beyond the Network”. While watching the film, each scene was like hitting the heart. For those who have stayed in a mess or hostel during their student life, it is something to always remember and something to leave a mark on the heart.’ 

Arman wrote, ‘It reminded me of the bond of friendship that was filled with laughter and tears once again. It felt like I had gone back a few years for 89 minutes. Towards the end, tears were coming to the corners of my eyes without my knowing. At that moment, I really went off the network.’ 

Charki’s Chief Operating Officer Redwan Rony has been receiving positive responses to this web film since yesterday. He wrote on Facebook at night, ‘I am getting a great response for the web film “Outside the Network”. I expressed my feelings very quickly. I could not wait to express my feelings. The film will generate an expected response for the OTT platform Bengali original content. It may even break the previous record. Best wishes to the director Mizanur Rahman Arian and his shooting unit.’ 

The filming and music of the film are interesting. Needless to say, no one has shown Cox’s Bazar and St. Martin like this on the screen before. The film was released on the video streaming platform Charki at 9 pm on August 19. 

Viewers have already given reviews on social media expressing their reactions to watching the film. Some gave the film a 10 out of 10, with an average rating of more than 8. What did the viewers write? Faisal Khalilur wrote, ‘I first went to St. Martin’s on a tour from the university. At the end of my honors life, I also went with my friends to “Outside the Network”. Every moment was as beautiful as a dream. Mizanur Rahman Aryan’s “Outside the Network” took me back to university life.’

Headline_English: This is why Amitabh Bachchan didn't take even a single rupee as remuneration.
Content_Enlish:
What will happen if he turns 78? Amitabh Bachchan is one of the busiest actors in Bollywood right now. His much-awaited film 'Chehere' will be released in cinemas on August 27. It is learnt that Big B did not agree to take a single rupee for this film. Apart from the travel expenses to the shooting spot, he did not take any other incidental expenses. Big B even paid for his chartered plane himself. He uses this plane to travel to international locations. Why is professional actor Amitabh so generous? 
He is said to have liked the story of 'Chehere' very much. So much so that the Shahenshah of Bollywood has decided to work in the film without any remuneration. Not only that, he is also working hard to promote the film. He is constantly posting promos, songs and other things of 'Chehere' on social media. Amitabh Bachchan has recited a poem in the film. His recitation can be heard in the title track. 
The film has not been released for so long due to Corona. Apart from Amitabh Bachchan, Emraan Hashmi will be seen in an important role in this mystery-thriller film. This is the first time they are coming together on screen. Directed by Rumi Jaffrey, the film also features Annu Kapoor, Dhritarashtra, Sidharth Kapoor, Raghubir Yadav, Rhea Chakraborty. Big B will be seen in various films including Jhund, Mayday, Brahmastra and others in the coming days.

Headline_English: Nusrat becomes mother of a son
Content_Enlish:
Indian actress and MP Nusrat Jahan has become the mother of a son. Today, Thursday, at 1:15 pm Bangladesh time, she gave birth to a child. Both the newborn weighing about three kilograms and the mother are doing well. Actor Yash Dasgupta was present at the hospital during Nusrat's delivery. 
Nusrat was admitted to the private hospital in Kolkata yesterday, Wednesday. Yash was by her side since her pregnancy. The actress has taken a stand against various ridicule and rumors in this fight to become a mother. She had earlier said that the father of the child is not her ex-husband Nikhil Jain. Even the preparations for separation from him are almost complete. However, Nusrat has not yet opened her mouth about the identity of the father of the child. 

Regarding Nusrat's pregnancy, Nikhil told Anandabazar Online that he did not know anything about it. He said, 'I have not been in a relationship with Nusrat for a long time. This child is not mine.' However, sources close to her know that the father of the child is actor Yash Dasgupta. 

Nusrat was seen closely associating with Yash soon after her breakup with Nikhil. However, she has not made any statement about the identity of the child's father so far. Regarding having a child, Nusrat said, 'Motherhood is a blessing, there is no way to deny that. But one should not decide to become a mother if one's body and mind are not ready.'

Headline_English: Tom Cruise's scariest stunts
Content_Enlish:
What has been known about Tom Cruise's stunts for so long should be forgotten. His stunts in the new film of the Mission Impossible series, Mission: Impossible Seven, will make all other films' stunts fade. 
Last Thursday, some special footage of the film was shown at CinemaCon. This is an important and large event for movies, where people related to the world's theaters gather. There, everyone was shocked to see a motorbike stunt by Tom Cruise. Which is the most dangerous stunt Tom Cruise has ever done. 
According to the film's director Christopher McQuarrie, this is the most dangerous stunt Cruise has ever done. It is known that before filming the scene, 500 hours of sky diving training were arranged. He had to jump on a motorbike 13,000 times. The video clip ends with Tom Cruise's stunt. A crew said that Tom jumped from a high place six times in one day with a motorbike. 

Cruise also did a terrifying stunt in August last year. Apart from this, a stunt video from this film once went viral on social media. It was seen that someone was jumping from a high ramp on a motorbike into a mountain gorge. This video went viral on Twitter. British media Daily Mail says that this stunt was filmed in Oxfordshire, England. 
Tom Cruise jumped from a 650-foot high ramp. It cost 2.6 million US dollars to film this scene. 
The Mission: Impossible film series was made from the popular TV series of the same name. This franchise has moved forward with all the deadly stunts and thrilling missions. Mission: Impossible Seven will be released on May 27, 2022.

Headline_English: 'Rupkathaar Jagate' crosses 1 million views
Content_Enlish:
The song ‘Roopkathar Jagate’, released on the YouTube channel of Bangladeshi streaming platform Charki, has crossed a million views. This month, the movie ‘Networker Baire’, about a friendship story, was released on Charki. ‘Roopkathar Jagate’ is a song from the movie. The song has been sung by Rehan Rasul and Avanti Sinthi. ‘In a world of fairy tales/ You came from me/ In some world of fairy tales/ You are my constant companion, on this path of life’—the lyrics of the song were written by Someshwar Oli, and the music and music arrangement were done by Sajid Sarkar. The song was released on Charki’s YouTube channel on August 21. The visuals of the song are mainly by Tasnia Farin and Jonayed Bogdadi. 

Rehan Rasul, one of the artists of the song, is excited that the video of the song has crossed a million views. Yesterday, he wrote on Facebook, ‘Some people, they told me the news of the million views of my song in a big way! My joy is like mine before mine! Celebrate! May the owner rest in peace to the people who have embraced me so beautifully. The song “Roopkathar Jagate” crossed one million views today. Thank you Aryan Bhai, Oli Bhai and Sajid Bhai. You are the ones who give me the opportunity to receive love. Let us pray for the injured actors and actresses of the web film “Beyond the Network”. The Facebook wall of Avanti Sinthi, another artist of the song, is also filled with praise and congratulatory messages. 

Listeners are praising the video of the song “Roopkathar Jagate” on YouTube. Nipu wrote, “Such films and songs are really not seen in our country these days. Thank you very much.” Abhishek Roy wrote, “The song gives a different feeling of love.” Osama Abdur Rahim wrote, “This is how a song should be. I want to listen to it again and again. Thank you to the entire team for giving such a beautiful song along with such a beautiful web series.” The song’s comment section is filled with more than two thousand such comments.

One of the artists of the song, Avanti Sinthi, came in ninth place in the singing reality show Close-up One 2012. She gained popularity from the popular Indian reality show Sare Gama Pa in 2018. On the other hand, Rehan Rasul became known among the audience with his song 'Baje Swabhaab'. 

'Beyond the Network' is the story of four friends. They organize a trip, this is their first trip together. Their wish is that they will go on such a trip every year. But suddenly an unexpected incident happens.

Headline_English: National Film Awards Film Call
Content_Enlish:
The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting has invited applications for the National Film Award-2020. The invitation was made through a notification signed by Jasim Uddin, Vice Chairman of the Film Censor Board. 
It has been asked to submit Bengali films released in 2020 by 5 pm on September 19. Interested producers are requested to submit a high-quality CD, DVD and pen drive of their film and a biographical sketch (in Bengali) of the producer, director and related artists and crew members, along with their names, addresses, telephone numbers, film synopsis, lyrics, etc., in a prescribed format, 15 sets each, within the prescribed time. 

It has also been informed that this information should be sent to the address ‘Vice Chairman, Bangladesh Film Censor Board and Member Secretary, Jury Board, National Film Award-2020, Information Building (Level 13 and 14), 112 Circuit House Road, Ramna, Dhaka-1000’. 

This time, it has been decided to give the National Film Award in 28 categories. Bhavna

Ashna Habib Bhabna

Headline_English: ICC tries to bring cricket back to Olympics
Content_Enlish:
The ICC, the world cricket governing body, has been trying to include cricket in the Olympic Games for a long time. The 2028 Olympics will be held in Los Angeles, America. The ICC is still optimistic about the inclusion of cricket in those games. The ICC is continuing to try to include cricket, albeit as an 'additional sport'. 

The Olympic organization has announced 28 sports in the initial program for the 2028 Olympics. Among them, skateboarding, surfing and sports climbing have taken their place. Despite this situation, the ICC is optimistic that cricket will finally make its place as an 'additional sport' in the Los Angeles Games. 

An ICC spokesperson told the Times of India, 'Our goal of making cricket part of the Olympics has not changed, even though we know that we have to compete with many big events in the world. Cricket will never be in the initial list. Additional sports will be selected through a selection process by the host city next year. Cricket will also be part of that process. We are optimistic.' 

The ICC is desperate to secure a place in the Olympics by relying on T20. Many believe that America has been given the responsibility of hosting the World Cup to secure a place in the Olympics. The 2024 T20 World Cup will be held in the United States. 

The list of sports will be put up for voting in Beijing, China, in February next year. Along with cricket, baseball, softball and American football will be in the running to be included as 'additional sports'.

Headline_English: Cricketer banned for life for threatening to kill umpire
Content_Enlish:
Kiwi cricketer Timothy Weir has been banned from all levels of cricket for life for physically abusing and threatening to kill an umpire. Weir will not have the opportunity to appeal the punishment for this serious charge. 

Weir is a well-known face of New Zealand domestic cricket. He used to play for the OBR Cricket Club in Gisborne. Weir threatened to kill the umpire at the end of a match against the High School Old Boys Cricket Club on December 4. He was later charged with breaching the code of conduct. Since the charges were serious, the trial began through an independent judicial panel. 

The investigation found evidence of physical abuse and threats to kill the umpire. In addition, evidence was found that Weir had breached the code of conduct on two other occasions before this incident. Weir also admitted his guilt to the judicial panel. 

After the investigation, the judicial panel ruled to ban Weir from all levels of cricket for life, charging him with breaching the Level-4 clause. However, the cricketer will not have the opportunity to appeal for the cancellation or reduction of the punishment for breaking the serious level-4 clause. 

The head of the Poverty Bay Cricket Association, Isaac Hughes, believes that the life ban is right in view of Weir's crime. At the same time, he announced that he would never tolerate such crimes. 

In this context, Isaac said, 'The severity of the punishment reflects the crime of the offender. It is the right decision. Such heinous behavior will never find a place in a game like cricket.'

Headline_English: Taylor to play final Test against Tigers
Content_Enlish:
Ross Taylor has officially announced his retirement ahead of the Bangladesh series. The two-Test series against Bangladesh will be his last in white. The veteran New Zealand batsman is also retiring from the rest of the formats. After the Test series, he will play a total of 6 ODIs against Australia and the Netherlands. 

In an emotional post on Twitter on Thursday, Ross Taylor wrote, 'I will be retiring from international cricket after playing two more Tests against Bangladesh at home next summer and six ODIs against Australia and the Netherlands. Thank you for your incredible support over the past 17 years.' 

Taylor said, 'It is an honour to represent my country. It has been an incredible journey and I feel fortunate to have represented my country for as long as I have. It has been a privilege to walk alongside the best, play against them and make so many memories and friendships along the way. But good times come to an end and the time feels right for me to retire.' 

The 37-year-old Taylor has played 110 Tests and 233 ODIs. He is the leading batsman in both formats, with totals of 7584 and 8581 runs respectively. 

Taylor made his international debut in an ODI against the West Indies in March 2006. He then earned his first Test cap against South Africa in November 2007. His highest score of 290 came against Australia in Perth in 2015. 

Taylor was at the crease with Kane Williamson on the day New Zealand won the World Test Championship final earlier this year. A month ago, he had said he would play in the 2023 ODI World Cup. But now he has decided it is time.

Headline_English: Mominul's 'New Year Test' in New Zealand
Content_Enlish:
The incident of playing a Test match on the first day of the year has never happened in Bangladesh cricket before. The Tigers' second series in the second edition of the World Test Championship has given them that opportunity. That too is in a paradise like New Zealand. In Bangladesh, Mominul will bathe in the soft sunshine of the new year's new sun six hours before. After wiping away the sorrow of the failures of the old year, Mominul will play the first Test of the year against the host New Zealand at the Bay Oval in Mount Maunganui with new dreams. For the first time, Mominul will play in the 'New Year Test' with a white dress and red ball in the city of the sea and mountains with a white and white heart. 

It is not known whether the Bangladesh team wants to achieve anything from this two-Test series of the World Test Championship. After spending a relaxing holiday yesterday, the team management members may have forgotten about the time difference between Bangladesh and New Zealand. The BCB's media department is also busy passing the year by swimming in the current. So, let alone the Zoom press conference of captain Mominul Haque or coach Russell Domingo or team director Khaled Mahmud Sujon, even the video message was not available. Although the Kiwi board archived the pictures of the trophy unveiling, the team management could not provide them to the Bangladesh media. This may be the last failure of the BCB and Team Bangladesh this year. It is only possible that the cricketers are not so indifferent on the field in the new year. Because Mominul has accompanied the dream of doing something good in the new year. 

Although the condition of New Zealand is the big opponent of the Bangladesh team. The Tigers have not been able to win a match in any edition in 20 years while playing in the country. Because the Kiwis are unstoppable on the home soil. Even a cricket superpower like Australia cannot gain much advantage by going to New Zealand. Expecting to win against the Test world champions there is like a moon landing for Mominul at the moment. Rather, if they can play competitive cricket and take the match to five days, that achievement will be equal to victory. 

Out of the 12 Test matches Bangladesh has played against New Zealand, seven have been innings defeats. The remaining three Tests that were drawn were played in Bangladesh. The Bangladesh team played its best Test in New Zealand in 2017 under the leadership of Mushfiqur Rahim. Even after coming close to a draw in the first match at Basin Reserve, it lost due to a wrong decision by coach Chandika Hathurusingha. Shakib and Mushfiqur's record partnership declared their innings at 595 for 8 in the first innings and handed the match to the hosts. Mushfiqur could not play in the second innings after being hit by a body line ball. Imrul Kayes was scared by the ball. Shakib's double century Test had to be lost due to some adverse events. In the next Test in Christchurch, injuries knocked out several key players of the team. The team returned home after losing the match by 9 wickets. 

No one would dream of winning with a rookie team where it was not possible to win the match even with the best cricketers of the country at that time. The team will be happy if they can give the best cricket possible. The goal will be to have a good spell, five wickets in an innings or a century and a team performance. Bangladesh was also seen practicing that in the two-day warm-up match against New Zealand XI.
